name: 托福词汇
description: 托福考试词汇（来源：english-wordlists/TOEFL.txt），按 COCA 词频排序

words.meaning: a.  平坦的,偶数的,相等的,均匀的,连贯的,均等的,公平的,荹玫?平静的,
words.example:
Everyone I know likes the smell of bacon - even Mike does and he's a vegetarian.  我认识的所有人都喜欢培根的味道——即使麦克也不例外，他可是个素食主义者呀。
We were all on time - even Chris and he's usually late for everything.  我们都准时到达——就连平时做事一向拖拖拉拉的克利斯都没迟到。
It's a very difficult job - it might even take a year to finish it.  这是项非常艰巨的工作——甚至可能要花一年时间才能完成。

words.meaning: n.  蒸馏室,寂静,剧照vt.  vi.  蒸馏,(使)平静,(使)静止a.  静止的,不
words.example:
I'm still hungry.  我还是很饿。
There is still no news about the hostages.  仍旧没有人质的消息。
Do you still work for the government?  你还在为政府工作吗？

words.meaning: n.  情况; 国家; 州; v.  陈述
words.example:
The building was in a state of disrepair.  这栋大楼年久失修。
She was found wandering in a confused state (of mind).  有人发现她到处游荡，神智恍惚。
Give me the keys - you're in no fit state to drive.  把锁匙给我——你状态不佳，不能开车。

words.meaning: a.  低劣的,卑贱的,卑鄙的,麻烦的,简陋的,吝啬的,惭愧的,中间的vt.  意
words.example:
What does this word mean?  这个词是甚么意思？
What do you mean by that remark?  你那句话是甚么意思？
She's quite odd though. Do you know what I mean?  可是她有点怪。你明白我指甚么吗？

words.meaning: n.  公司,友伴,交际,一群,朋友,连队vt.  陪伴vi.  交往
words.example:
He works for a software company/a company that makes software.  他在一家软体公司工作。
No smoking is company policy.  禁止吸烟是公司的规定。
It was a long journey and I was grateful for his company.  旅途漫漫，我感谢有他作伴。

words.meaning: n.  发行,问题,后果,争端,出口vi.  发行,流出,传下,进行辩护,造成. . .
words.example:
As employers we need to be seen to be addressing (= dealing with) these issues sympathetically.  作为雇主，我们需要让大家知道我们在处理这些问题时富有同情心。
Don't worry about who will do it - that's just a side issue (= not the main problem).  不要担心这件事由谁来做——那只是次要问题。
The point at issue is what is best for the child.  问题的关键在于甚么样的东西对孩子最好。

words.meaning: n.  头,头脑,最前的部分,脑袋,领袖vt.  为首,朝向,前进,用头顶vi.  成
words.example:
Put this hat on to keep your head warm.  戴上这顶帽子，给头部保暖。
He banged his head on the car as he was getting in.  他上车时撞了一下头。
She nodded/shook her head (= showed her agreement/disagreement).  她点点／摇摇头表示同意／不同意。

words.meaning: a.  长的,长久的,冗长的,做多头的vi.  渴望,热望,极想ad.  长久,始终n.
words.example:
I've been waiting a long time.  我已经等了很久了。
It's a long time since I worked there.  我不在那里工作已经很久了。
Apparently the sessions are an hour long.  显然这些会议都长达一个小时。

words.meaning: vt.  提供,供应,预备,装备vi. 作准备,瞻养,规定
words.example:
This booklet provides useful information about local services.  这本小册子提供了有关当地服务机构的有用资讯。
All meals are provided throughout the course.  整个期间都提供三餐。
The author provides no documentary references to support her assertions.  作者没有提供参考文献来支援她自己的论点。

words.meaning: n.  站立,站住,停顿,讲台,法院证人席,立场vi.  站,立,坐落,停滞,维持原
words.example:
Granny says if she stands (up) for a long time her ankles hurt.  奶奶说她站久了脚踝会痛。
As a sign of politeness you should stand (up) when she comes in.  她进来时你应该站起来以示礼貌
Stand still and be quiet!  站好了，不要出声！

words.meaning: n.  社区,公众,共有,共同体
words.example:
He's well-known in the local community.  他在当地非常闻名。
There's a large black/white/Jewish community living in this area.  在该地区有一个大的黑人／白人／犹太人社区。
Her speech caused outrage among the gay community.  她的演说激起了同性恋群体的愤怒。

words.meaning: n.  总统，(大学)校长，总经理
words.example:
[as form of address] Thank you, Mr/Madam President.  谢谢您，总统阁下。noun countable
mainly US She's a friend of the president of the bank.  她是银行总裁的朋友。

words.meaning: n.  分,分钟,笔记,备忘录,片刻vt.  记录,摘录,测定时间a.  微小的,详细
words.example:
It takes me twenty minutes to get to work.  我上班路上要花20分钟。
The train leaves at three minutes to eight, so we'd better get there a few minutes before then.  火车7点57分开出，我们最好提前几分钟到。
Hang on/Wait a minute - I'll just get my bag.  等一下——我去拿我的袋子。

words.meaning: n.  铅,铅条,领导,提示,领引,导线,主角,榜样vt.  引导,带领,领导,指挥,
words.example:
I've asked Gemma to lead the discussion.  我已请杰玛带领大家讨论。
Who will be leading the inquiry into the accident?  谁来领导事故的调查工作？verb (led, led)
After thirty minutes the challengers were leading by two goals.  30分钟过后挑战者已经领先两分。

words.meaning: n.  手表,看守,值班人,监视vt.  看,注视,照顾,监视,守护,看守vi.  观看
words.example:
He spent the entire afternoon watching a cricket match.  他整个下午都在看一场板球比赛。
Bonner watched helplessly as the ball sneaked in at the near post.  邦纳无助地看着球从近端的球门柱旁滚进球门。
She'll pretend that she hasn't seen us - you watch.  她会假装没看见我们的——你看着吧。

words.meaning: n.  水平(高度); 级别; a.  水平的; v.  夷平，使平坦
words.example:
The water level in the lake is much higher after heavy rain.  暴雨过后这个湖的水位上升了很多。
Inflation is going to rise 2% from its present level.  通货膨胀率将比目前上涨2%。
Chess requires a very high level of concentration.  下棋需要注意力高度集中。

words.meaning: n.  宴会,党,政党,社交聚会,当事人vt. vi.  举行社交聚会
words.example:
Peter has/gives/throws really wild parties.  彼得举办的聚会很疯狂。
The Labour party has/have just elected a new leader.  工党刚选出了一名新领袖。
He was elected as party leader in 2001.  他于2001年当选为该党的领袖。

words.meaning: n.  理由,原因,理智,理性,前提,道理vt.  说服,推论,辩论vi.  推论,劝说
words.example:
The reason for the disaster was engine failure, not human error.  这次灾难的原因是引擎故障，而非人为错误。
not standard The reason I walked out was because I was bored.  我走出去是因为我感到很无聊。
She was furious, and with reason (= with good cause).  她很生气，这也有情可原。

words.meaning: n.  出价,提议,意图,报价vt.  提供,出价,奉献,演出,使出现,企图vi.  出
words.example:
She was offered a job in Paris.  她在巴黎得到了一份工作。
Can I offer you (= Would you like) a drink?  你要一杯饮料吗？
Dear Lord, we offer up our prayers...  亲爱的主，我们向您祈祷…UK verb

words.meaning: n.  年龄,年老vt. vi.  成熟,变老
words.example:
Do you know the age of that building?  你知道那座楼的历史有多久吗？
What age (= How old) is your brother?  你弟弟多大了？
I'd guess she's about my age (= she is about as old as I am).  我猜她和我年龄差不多。

words.meaning: n.  政策，方针; 保险单
words.example:
They believe that the European Community needs a common foreign and security policy.  他们认为欧洲共同体需要采取共同的外交和安全政策。
What is your party's policy on immigration?  你们党对于移民的政策是甚么？UK noun countable
You should check your policy to see if you're covered for flood damage.  你应该查看一下你的保险单看看是否保了洪水险。

words.meaning: n.  程序,进行,过程vt.  加工,处理,对. . . 处置,对. . . 起诉a.  经加
words.example:
Increasing the number of women in top management jobs will be a slow process.  增加高级管理职位女性的人数将是一个缓慢的过程。
This decision may delay the process of European unification.  这一决策可能会延后欧洲一体化的进程。
The party has begun the painful (= difficult) process of rethinking its policies and strategy.  该党开始了重新审视其政策和战略的艰难历程。

words.meaning: vt. vi.  考虑,思考,认为
words.example:
Don't make any decisions before you've considered the matter.  在仔细考虑过这个问题之前别作任何决定。
She's being considered for the job.  目前正在考虑是否由她来做这项工作。
I'd like some time to consider before I make a decision.  我想花点时间斟酌斟酌再作决定。UK verb

words.meaning: vi.  出现,显得,来到
words.example:
He suddenly appeared in the doorway.  他突然出现在门口。
We'd been in the house a month when dark stains started appearing on the wall.  墙上开始出现一些深色的斑迹时，我们在这幢房子里已经住了一个月。
His name appears in the film credits for lighting.  他作为灯光师出现在电影演职人员名单中。

words.meaning: n.  人,人类a.  人类的,人性的,有同情心的
words.example:
The human body is composed of about 60% water.  人体约60%由水组成。
Early human remains were found in the Dordogne region of France.  在法国的多尔多涅地区发现了早期人类的遗迹。
Victory in the war was achieved at the cost of great human suffering.  战争的胜利是以人类的巨大痛苦为代价换来的。

words.meaning: n.  市场; 股市; v.  销售
words.example:
Are you sure there's a market for the product?  你肯定这种产品有市场吗？
We estimate the potential market for the new phones to be around one million people in this country alone.  我们估计，仅在这个国家新型电话的潜在市场就有100万人左右。
The domestic market is still depressed, but demand abroad is picking up.  国内市场仍然低迷，但国外需求正逐步上升。

words.meaning: n.  兴趣; 利息; [常pl.  ]权益，利益
words.example:
I've always had an interest in astronomy.  我一直对天文学感兴趣。
He never seems to show any interest in his children.  他好像从不关心他的子女。
Unfortunately, I lost interest half way through the film.  遗憾的是，这部电影我才看了一半就失去了兴趣。

words.meaning: n.  结果,影响,效果,印象vt.  招致,引起,完成v.  效果
words.example:
The radiation leak has had a disastrous effect on/upon the environment.  核辐射外泄给环境带来了灾难性的影响。
She has a lot of confidence which she uses to good effect (= to her advantage) in interviews.  她很自信，在面试时她充分利用这一点，占尽了优势。
They had to wait ten minutes for the anaesthetic to take effect before they stitched up the cut.  他们不得不等了十分钟，在麻醉药起作用后才缝合伤口。

words.meaning: vt.  提议,建议,促成,使人想起,启发,暗示
words.example:
They were wondering where to hold the office party and I suggested the Italian restaurant near the station.  他们在考虑在哪里开办公室聚会，我提议去车站附近的义大利餐馆。
formal Might I suggest a white wine with your salmon, sir?  我建议来一杯白葡萄酒配您的鲑鱼吧，先生？
Liz suggested (that) I try the shop on Mill Road.  莉兹建议我去米尔街的那家店看看。

words.meaning: n.  上升,高地,增高,提出vt.  升起,举起,唤起,提高,使出现,使复活,提出
words.example:
Would all those in favour please raise their hands ?  赞成的人请举手好吗？
He raised the window and leaned out.  他把窗户推上去后探出身子。
Mary Quant was the first fashion designer to raise hemlines.  玛丽．匡特是第一个把裙子裁短的时装设计师。verb transitive

words.meaning: a.  从前的,前者的n.  形成者,模型,样板
words.example:
The house, a former barn, has been attractively converted.  这座房子以前是谷仓，现已改建一新，十分漂亮。
The painting was then restored to its former glory (= returned to its original good condition).  这幅油画又恢复了原先的光彩。
It was a long time after the accident before he seemed like his former self (= behaved in the way he had done before).  事故过后很长时间，他似乎才恢复了先前的样子。UK noun only singular

words.meaning: n.  主修课,成年人,陆军少校a.  主要的,较多的,严重的,成年的vi.  主修
words.example:
All of her major plays have been translated into English.  她的主要剧本都被译成了英文。
Sugar is a major cause of tooth decay.  糖是造成蛀牙的主要原因。
There are two problems with this situation, one major, one minor.  这个情况牵涉到两个问题，一个主要的，一个次要的。

words.meaning: v.  需要; 要求; 规定
words.example:
Please telephone this number if you require any further information.  如需更多资讯请拨此电话号码垂询。
Skiing at 80 miles per hour requires total concentration.  以每小时80英里的速度滑雪需要全神贯注。
You are required by law to stop your car after an accident.  法律规定，发生事故后必须停车。

words.meaning: n.  角色,职份,任务
words.example:
What is his role in this project?  他在这个工程中负责甚么？
Schools play an important role in society.  学校在社会中起着非常重要的作用。
Six people have been put on trial for their role (= involvement) in the anti-government demonstrations.  六人因为参与反政府示威游行而受审。UK noun countable

words.meaning: vt. vi.  决定,判决
words.example:
They have to decide by next Friday.  他们必须在下周五前作出决定。
He can't decide wh ether to buy it.  他决定不了要不要把它买下来。
The committee decided in favour of (= made a formal judgment to choose) the cheapest option.  委员会决定选用最经济的方案。

words.meaning: a.  军(事、用)的; n. [the ~]军队
words.example: The military has opposed any cuts in defence spending.  军方反对任何裁减国防开支的举措。

words.meaning: vt.  发展,发达,显影,洗印,进步vi.  发展,生长
words.example:
It became clear that he wasn't developing like all the other little boys.  显然他没有像其他小男孩那样正常生长发育。
The fear is that these minor clashes may develop into all-out confrontation.  人们担心这些小小的冲突可能会演变成全面的对抗。
Over time, their acquaintance developed into a lasting friendship.  随着时间的推移，他们的泛泛之交变成了巩固的友谊。

words.meaning: a.  联邦(制、政府)的
words.example: the federal government  联邦政府

words.meaning: n.  动作,作用,诉讼,行为,战斗控告
words.example:
This problem calls for swift/prompt action from the government.  这个问题需要政府马上采取行动。
We must take action (= do something) to deal with the problem before it spreads to other areas.  在这个问题蔓延到其他地区之前我们一定要采取行动将其解决。
So what's the plan of action (= What are we going to do) ?  那么行动计划是甚么？

words.meaning: n.  季(节); 时期
words.example:
How long does the dry/hurricane/monsoon season last?  旱／飓风／季风季要持续多久？
The British football season begins in August and ends in May.  英国足球赛季始于八月，止于五月。
Air fares are more expensive during the holiday season.  机票在度假旺季比较贵。

words.meaning: n.  导演; 主管; 负责人
words.example: She has become the director of the new information centre.  她成了新的资讯中心的主任。

words.meaning: n.  位置; 职位; 立场; v.  安置
words.example:
Well, I've found our position on the map if you want to see where we are.  好啦，如果你想知道我们现在所在位置的话，我已经在地图上找到了。
You've moved the furniture around - the sofa is in a different position.  你把家俱移动过了——沙发的位置变了。
The troops took up their battle positions at the front line.  部队进入了前线的战斗阵地。

words.meaning: a.  特殊的; 专门的; n.  特别节目
words.example:
The car has a number of special safety features.  这辆汽车配备有一些特别的安全装置。
Is there anything special that you'd like to do today?  今天你有没有甚么特别的事要做？
Passengers should tell the airline in advance if they have any special dietary needs.  乘客如有特殊的饮食需要，须事先向航空公司说明。

words.meaning: n.  空地; 空间; 太空; v.  隔开
words.example:
Is there any space for my clothes in that cupboard?  那个衣橱还放得下我的衣服吗？
I've got to make (some) space for Mark's things.  我得为马克挪点地方放他的东西。
When the roads are wet, you've got to leave plenty of space between you and the car in front.  路面湿滑，你必须和前车保持足够的距离。

words.meaning: n.  位置,场所,地点vt.  定位
words.example:
The council haven't yet chosen the site for the new hospital.  市政会尚未选定新医院的院址。
This is the site of the accident.  这就是事故现场。
There are two restaurants on site.  内部有两家餐厅。

words.meaning: n.  方案，项目; v.  放映，规划
words.example:
Her latest project is a film based on the life of a nineteenth-century music hall star.  她最近计划拍摄一部关于某位19世纪歌厅歌星一生的影片。
My next project is decorating the kitchen.  我下一步计划整修厨房。
He's doing a class project on pollution.  他正在做一个有关污染的学校作业。

words.meaning: n.  活动; 活跃
words.example:
There was a lot of activity in preparation for the Queen's visit.  大家都在为准备迎接女王来访而忙碌。
Ministers are concerned by the low level of economic activity.  各部长都为经济不景气而担忧。
There was a sudden flurry of activity when the director walked in.  经理一走进来，大家马上一片手忙脚乱。UK noun

words.meaning: n.  法院,庭院,奉承vt.  献殷勤,追求,招致危险vi.  求爱
words.example:
Protestors gathered outside the court to await the verdict.  抗议者聚集在法庭外等待判决。
He's due to appear in court again on Monday.  他定于周一再次出庭。
Please describe to the court exactly what you saw.  请向法官陈述你看到的真实情况。

words.meaning: n.  勤奋; 工业，行业
words.example:
The city needs to attract more industry.  这个城市需要吸引更多的工业。
The strike seriously reduced coal deliveries to industry.  罢工使得向工业输送的煤炭量大幅下降。noun
The computer industry has been booming.  电脑行业已经日益蓬勃起来了。

words.meaning: n.  盖子,封面,藉口vt.  覆盖,掩饰,包括,掩护,保护vi.  覆盖
words.example:
The light was so bright that I had to cover my eyes.  灯光太亮，我只好遮住眼睛。
Snow covered the hillsides.  白雪覆盖了山坡。
She covered him (up) with a blanket.  她给他盖上了毯子。

words.meaning: n.  陆地,地面,地界,土地,国土,地产vi.  登陆,登岸,到达vt.  使上岸,使
words.example:
It is cheaper to drill for oil on land than at sea.  在陆地上钻探石油比在海上更经济。
The treaty has led to a dramatic reduction in the number of land -based missiles in Europe.  该条约的签订导致了欧洲陆基导弹的数量大幅减少。
The military commanders won't deploy their land forces until they're satisfied that the air attacks have done their job.  军队指挥官们将一直等到他们觉得空中打击奏效了之后才会开始部署地面部队。

words.meaning: v.  描写，描述; 称做
words.example:
Could you describe your attacker?  你能描述一下袭击者的样子吗？
He described the painting in detail.  他详细地描述了那幅油画的内容。
She described Gary as shy.  她说加利很害羞。

words.meaning: a.  个人的，私人的; 亲自的
words.example:
My personal opinion/view is that the students should be doing more work outside the classroom.  我个人认为学生应该多做一些课外作业。
Her uncle takes a personal interest in her progress.  她叔叔本人很关心她的进步。
She has her own personal secretary/bodyguard/fitness instructor.  她有自己的私人秘书／保镖／健身教练。

words.meaning: ad.  简单地; 简直; 只不过
words.example:
You look simply (= really) beautiful in that dress.  你穿那条裙子看起来真漂亮。
The hunger in parts of Africa is terrible - there's (quite)simply (= without doubt) no other word for it.  非洲部分地区的饥荒真可怕——简直是言语难以形容。
He explained it as simply as he could, but the class still didn't understand.  他尽可能解释得简单些，但学生们依然理解不了。adverb

words.meaning: ad.  几乎,密切地
words.example:
It's been nearly three months since my last haircut.  从我上次理发到现在，已经快三个月了。
I've nearly finished that book you lent me.  你借给我的那本书我快要看完了。
She's nearly as tall as her father now.  她现在几乎和她父亲一样高了。

words.meaning: vt.  选择,宁愿,欲vi.  选择,喜欢
words.example:
She had to choose between the two men in her life.  面对生命中的两个男人，她不得不从中作出选择。
Danny, come here and choose your ice cream.  丹尼，到这里来挑你喜欢吃的霜淇淋。
He chose a shirt from the many in his wardrobe.  他从衣柜里众多衬衫中选了一件。

words.meaning: n.  原因,目标vt.  引起,使产生,成为. . . 的原因
words.example:
The police are still trying to establish the cause of the fire.  警方仍在努力调查失火的原因。
She had died of natural causes.  她是自然死亡。
He's never given me any cause for concern.  他从未让我担心过。UK noun

words.meaning: n.  证据,迹象
words.example:
The police have found no evidence of a terrorist link with the murder.  警方没有发现任何证据证明这宗谋杀案和恐怖分子有关。
Several experts are to give evidence on the subject.  几位专家将就这个问题提出证据。
There is only circumstantial evidence against her, so she is unlikely to be convicted.  只有间接证据对她不利，所以她不大可能被定罪。

words.meaning: n.  文化，文明; 培养; vt.  培养
words.example:
She's studying modern Japanese language and culture.  她在研究现代日本语言和文化。
You won't find much culture in this sleepy little town, I'm afraid!  在这座死气沉沉的小镇里，恐怕你不会发现多少文化内涵！

words.meaning: vt.  了解,实现,使显得逼真,把. . . 变为现金vi.  变卖为现金
words.example:
They didn't realize the danger they were in.  他们没有意识到自己身处危险之中。
As he watched the TV drama, he suddenly realized (that) he'd seen it before.  他在看那部电视剧的时候，忽然意识到以前曾看过。
Lots of money, a luxury house, a fast car - Danny had realized all his ambitions by the age of 25.  钜款、豪宅、跑车——丹尼所有的愿望都在25岁前实现了。

words.meaning: a.  有用的,有空的
words.example:
Is this dress available in a larger size?  这件衣服有更大一号的吗？
Our autumn catalogue is now available from our usual stockists.  秋季商品目录现已推出，请到我们公司定点批发零售商处索取。
There's no money available for an office party this year.  今年没有钱举办办公室派对了。

words.meaning: n.  机会,时机
words.example:
Everyone will have an opportunity to comment.  每个人都有机会发表意见。
An ankle injury meant she missed the opportunity to run in the qualifying heat.  脚踝受伤意味着她失去了参加跑步资格赛的机会。
formal Please contact us at the earliest opportunity (= as soon as possible).  请尽快和我们联系。

words.meaning: n.  情况,条件vt.  以. . . 为条件,决定,支配,使适应
words.example:
Mum's still got our pram - it's very old, but it's in perfect condition.  妈妈还留着我们的婴儿车——虽然很旧了，但仍然完好。
They left the flat in a terrible condition - there was mess everywhere.  他们把公寓房间弄得一团糟——到处一片狼藉。
The hospital say her condition (= state of health) is improving slowly.  医院说她的健康状况正在慢慢好转。

words.meaning: n.  选择,精选品,选择权a.  精选的,挑三拣四的,可选的
words.example:
If the product doesn't work, you are given the choice of a refund or a replacement.  如果产品不能使用，可选择退款或换货。
It's a difficult choice to make.  这很难抉择。
It's your choice/The choice is yours (= only you can decide).  这由你决定。

words.meaning: n.  行政,管理,中央政府
words.example:
Teachers complain that more of their time is taken up with administration than with teaching.  教师抱怨他们花在行政工作上的时间超过了教学的时间。
She has little experience in administration (= in organizing a business, etc.).  她没有甚么管理经验。noun
There are strict controls on the administration of drugs.  药品的施用受严格管制。

words.meaning: n.  议会，国会; (代表)大会
words.example: Congress has rejected the recent presidential proposal on firearms.  国会否决了总统最近关于枪支的提案。

words.meaning: n.  竞选活动; vi.  竞选; 参加战斗
words.example:
The protests were part of their campaign against the proposed building development in the area.  抗议是他们反对拟在该地区进行房地产开发的运动的一部分。
This is the latest act of terrorism in a long-standing and bloody campaign of violence.  这是由来已久的血腥暴力运动中的最新一次恐怖活动。
The endless public appearances are an inevitable part of an election campaign.  没完没了的公开露面是竞选活动不可或缺的组成部分。

words.meaning: n.  材料; [常pl.  ]原料; a.  物质的，身体上的; 重要的
words.example:
Crude oil is used as the raw (= basic) material for making plastics.  原油是制造塑胶的原料。UK noun
I'm in the process of collecting material for an article that I'm writing.  我正在为所写的一篇文章搜集资料。UK noun
How much material will you need to make the skirt?  做这条裙子你需要多少布料？UK noun

words.meaning: n.  经济(制度); 节俭，节约
words.example:
Tourism contributes millions of pounds to the country's economy.  旅游业为这个国家带来数百万英镑的经济收入。UK noun
They've had to make economies since Colin lost his job.  自从科林失业以来，他们不得不节俭度日。
This can be done by machines with more speed and economy.  这可以用机器来完成，又快又经济。

words.meaning: n.  结束,完结a.  靠近的,亲近的,亲密的,狭窄的秘密的,关闭的vt.  关,
words.example:
Could you close the door/window please?  请关上门／窗，好吗？
Close your eyes - I've got a surprise for you.  闭上眼睛——我有个惊喜给你。
The banks had closed (to customers) so I couldn't get any money out.  银行关门了，所以我取不了钱。

words.meaning: n.  冒险,危险,保险额vt.  冒. . . 的危险,冒险干
words.example:
In this business, the risks and the rewards are high.  这个行业的风险和回报都很高。
There's a high risk of another accident happening in this fog.  这样大的雾，很有可能再次出事故。
The company is quite a good risk (= safe to lend money to).  贷款给这间公司风险很小。

words.meaning: n.  涌流,趋势,流a.  流通的,现在的,最近的a.  当前的
words.example:
Have you seen the current issue of (= the most recently published) Vogue magazine?  最新一期《时尚》杂志你看过了吗？
The word 'thou' (= you) is no longer in current use.  thou 这个单词现在已不再使用了。UK noun countable
He was swept out to sea by the strong current.  他被急流冲到了海里。

words.meaning: v.  牵涉; 包含; 使参与
words.example:
The second accident involved two cars and a lorry.  第二次意外涉及两辆小汽车和一辆大卡车。
Research involving the use of biological warfare agents will be used for defensive purposes.  与使用生物战手段有关的研究将用来防御。
She's been involved with animal rights for many years.  她多年来一直参与保护动物权益的活动。

words.meaning: n.  防御，防卫
words.example: The team tightened its defense in the second half.  下半场球队加强了防守。

words.meaning: n.  木板,甲板,会议桌,海岸vt.  乘船,供膳食,用板铺vi.  搭伙n.  板
words.example:
Cut the vegetables on a UK chopping / US cutting board.  在砧板上切菜。
There was a 'For Sale' board outside the house.  房子外有一块“待售”牌。
The teacher wrote her name up on the board.  老师在黑板上写下了她的名字。

words.meaning: n.  主题，对象; a.  (to)受…支配的; v.  (to)使服从
words.example:
Our subject for discussion is homelessness.  我们讨论的话题是无家可归问题。
She has made a series of documentaries on the subject of family relationships.  她拍摄了一系列以家庭关系为题材的纪录片。
The guest lecturer took as her subject (= decided to speak about) 'punishment and imprisonment in modern society'.  特别讲师演讲的题目是“现代社会的刑罚与监禁”。

words.meaning: n.  行为,举止
words.example: His behavior improved after the warning.  警告之后他的行为有所改善。

words.meaning: n.  交易,协定,松木,买卖,份量vi.  处理,应付,做生意vt.  分配,发牌,给
words.example:
The unions and management have made a two-year pay and productivity deal.  工会和管理层签订了一份为期两年的工资与生产效率协议。
I'll make/do a deal with you - you wash the car and I'll let you use it tonight.  我和你做个交易吧——你把车洗了，今晚就让你用。
She got a good deal (= paid a low price) on her new house.  她买新房子时捡了个大便宜。

words.meaning: vt.  代表; 表现; 描绘
words.example:
They chose a famous barrister to represent them in court.  他们选了一位著名律师为他们出庭辩护。
Union officials representing the teachers met the government today.  代表教师的工会干事今天与政府官员会谈。
Women were well/poorly represented at the conference (= there were many/few present).  出席会议的女性很多／少。

words.meaning: n.  代理处; (政府等的)专门行政部门
words.example: She was freed from prison through the agency of her doctor.  在她的医生的推动下，她获释出狱。

words.meaning: ad.  最近
words.example:
Have you seen any good films recently?  你最近看过甚么好电影吗？
Until very recently he worked as a teacher and he still shudders at the memories.  他一直做老师，直到最近才不做。现在他一想起那段经历还不寒而栗呢。
Recently, I've been feeling a bit depressed.  近来我感到有点忧郁。

words.meaning: vt.  减少,分解,降低,把. . . 归纳,把. . . 分解vi.  减少,变瘦,归纳为
words.example:
Do nuclear weapons really reduce the risk of war?  核武器真的可以减小战争爆发的危险吗？
The plane reduced speed as it approached the airport.  当飞临机场时，飞机减慢了速度。
My weight reduces when I stop eating sugar.  我停止吃糖时体重就会下降。

words.meaning: v.  似乎; a.  可靠的; 健康的; 合理的
words.example:
They could hear the sound of a bell tolling in the distance.  他们能听到远处的钟声。
She stood completely still, not making a sound.  她静静地站在那里，一声不吭。
Suddenly we heard a loud knocking sound from the engine.  突然我们听见引擎发出响亮的砰砰声。

words.meaning: n.  罚款,罚金,晴天a.  好的,晴朗的,精细的,细小的,健康的vt.  罚款,精
words.example:
The apartments are very small, which is fine for one person.  这些公寓很小，一个人住正合适。
The world's finest collection of Impressionist paintings is housed in the Musée d'Orsay in Paris.  巴黎奥塞美术馆拥有世界上最棒的印象派画作馆藏。
This building is the finest example of its type.  这栋建筑是同类建筑中最杰出的代表。adjective

words.meaning: n.  天生的白痴a.  自然的,自然界的,本能的,天然的,天生的,物质的,正常
words.example:
People say that breast-feeding is better than bottle-feeding because it's more natural.  人们认为母乳喂养比用奶粉喂养好，因为母乳更为天然。
He died from natural causes (= because he was old or ill).  他是自然死亡。
Floods and earthquakes are natural disasters.  洪水和地震是自然灾害。

words.meaning: n.  系列，连续; 连续剧
words.example:
There has been a series of sexual attacks on women in the area.  这个地区发生了一连串针对女性的性侵害案件。
She gave a series of lectures at Warwick University last year on contemporary British writers.  她去年在华威大学举行了一系列有关当代英国作家的讲座。
The Yankees have a four-game series against the Orioles at home.  洋基队主场有一连四场对金莺队的比赛。

words.meaning: a.  重要的,有含义的,非偶然的,有效的,暗示的
words.example:
There has been a significant increase in the number of women students in recent years.  近年来，女学生的人数有了显著增加。
The talks between the USA and the USSR were very significant for the relationship between the two countries.  美国和苏联的谈判对两国间的关系非常重要。adjective
She looked at him across the table and gave him a significant smile.  她隔着桌子望着他，给了他一个意味深长的微笑。

words.meaning: a.  (to)相似的，类似的
words.example:
My father and I have similar views on politics.  我和父亲在政治上观点相似。
Paul is very similar in appearance to his brother.  保罗和他哥哥长得很像。

words.meaning: n.  回答; 反应，响应
words.example:
Responses to our advertisement have been disappointing.  人们对我们的广告反应平淡，令人失望。
Her proposals met with an enthusiastic response.  她的提议得到热烈的回应。
Management have granted a 10% pay rise in response to union pressure.  面对工会的压力，资方以加薪10%应对。

words.meaning: a.  死的,不活泼的,麻木的,熄灭的n.  死者ad.  完全地,突然地
words.example:
She's been dead for twenty years now.  到现在她已经去世20年了。
The motorcyclist was dead on arrival at the hospital.  那位摩托车骑士被送到医院时已经死亡。
He was shot dead (= killed by shooting) outside his home.  他在家门外被人开抢打死了。

words.meaning: n.  要素，因素; 【数】因数; 变量
words.example:
People's voting habits are influenced by political, social and economic factors.  人们的选举习惯受政治、社会和经济因素的影响。
Heavy snow was a contributing factor in the accident.  大雪是引发这次意外的一项因素。
Price will be a major/crucial factor in the success of this new product.  价格将是这款新产品能否畅销的主要／关键因素。

words.meaning: n.  十年
words.example: The last decade saw rapid growth.  过去十年增长迅速。

words.meaning: n.  文章,冠词,物品,条款
words.example:
There was an interesting article on vegetarianism in the paper yesterday.  昨天报纸上登了一篇关于素食主义的有趣文章。UK noun countable
Guests are advised not to leave any articles of value in their hotel rooms.  建议房客不要将任何贵重物品放在饭店房间里。
An article of clothing was found near the river.  有人在河边发现了一件衣服。

words.meaning: n.  救球vt.  解救,救,挽救,储蓄,保存,保留,保全,节省vi.  挽救,节省,
words.example:
Wearing seat belts has saved many lives.  系安全带挽救了许多人的生命。
He fell in the river but his friend saved him from drowning.  他掉进河里，不过他的朋友救了他的命。
He had to borrow money to save his business.  他只好借钱挽救自己的企业。

words.meaning: n.  库存; 股票; v.  储存
words.example:
It is now halfway through winter and food stocks are already low.  现在冬天刚刚过半，但食物的储备已经不足。
The local shop has a good stock of postcards and guidebooks.  本地商店备有大量明信片和旅游指南。
Much of the city's housing stock (= the number of houses in the city) is over 100 years old.  城市中许多房子都有100多年历史了。

words.meaning: n.  事业,生涯,速度
words.example:
He's hoping for a career in the police force/ as a police officer.  他希望当一名员警。
When he retires he will be able to look back over a brilliant career (= a working life which has been very successful).  等退休的时候，他可以回顾自己光辉灿烂的职业生涯。
It helps if you can move a few rungs up the career ladder before taking time off to have a baby.  如果你能在事业的阶梯上再攀登几级然后再去休假生小孩，那样会好一些。

words.meaning: n.  治疗,待遇,处置
words.example:
Peter gets special treatment because he knows the boss.  彼得认识老板，所以受到特殊待遇。
The same subject matter gets a very different treatment by Chris Wilson in his latest novel.  在克里斯‧威尔逊最新的小说中，对同样的主题作出了完全不同的处理。noun
Perhaps it's time to try a new course of treatment.  也许该是试试接受新疗程治疗的时候了。

words.meaning: vt. n.  接近; n.  方法，手段
words.example:
We could just see the train approaching in the distance.  我们刚好能看到火车从远处驶来。
If you look out of the window on the left of the bus, you'll see that we're now approaching the Tower of London.  如果你从公车左侧的视窗望出去，就可以看到我们正在驶向伦敦塔。
In my opinion, no other composers even begin to approach (= come near in quality to) Mozart.  我认为，任何作曲家和莫劄特相比，都难以望其项背。

words.meaning: n.  基金,资金,贮藏,财源,存款vt.  提供资金,积累
words.example:
The hospital has set up a special fund to buy new equipment.  医院专门设立了一项基金以购买新设备。
Contributions are being sought for the disaster fund.  正在寻求对救灾基金的捐助。
Following the repairs to the roof, church funds are now seriously depleted.  在对屋顶进行修缮之后，教堂的资金现在严重吃紧。

words.meaning: a.  严肃的,认真的,重要的,严重的
words.example:
There were no reports of serious injuries.  没有接到有人重伤的报告。
The new tax regulations have landed some of the smaller companies in serious trouble.  新的纳税规定使一些较小的公司陷入严重的困境。
Drugs have become a serious problem in a lot of schools.  吸毒在许多学校已经成了很严重的问题。

words.meaning: vi.  发生，出现; 想到
words.example:
An accident involving over ten vehicles has occurred in the east-bound lane.  在东向车道上发生了一起涉及十多辆汽车的交通事故。
If any of these symptoms occur while you are taking the medicine, consult your doctor immediately.  服药期间如果产生了这些症状中的任何一种，要立即就医。UK US (-rr-)
Violence of some sort seems to occur in every society.  每个社会似乎都会存在某种形式的暴力。

words.meaning: n.  媒介，媒体
words.example: The issue has been much discussed in the media.  大众媒体对这件事讨论得很多。

words.meaning: a.  单独的; 独特的; n.  个人，个体
words.example:
Every individual has rights which must never be taken away.  每个人都有一些不可剥夺的权利。
Like many creative individuals, she can be very bad-tempered.  像许多富有创造力的人一样，她的脾气有时会很不好。
We try to treat our students as individuals.  我们力图把学生当成独立的个体来对待。noun countable

words.meaning: n.  品质,特质,才能,质量a.  优质的n.  品质
words.example:
The food was of such poor/low quality.  这种食品的品质很差。
Their products are of very high quality.  他们产品的品质很高。
The quality of the picture on our television isn't very good.  我们电视的画面品质不好。

words.meaning: n.  压,榨,按,强制,压强,压迫,压力vt. 迫使,使增压,密封
words.example:
He put too much pressure on the door handle and it snapped.  他用力过猛，把门的把手弄断了。
You can stop bleeding by applying pressure close to the injured area.  压住伤口边缘可以止血。
The new material allows the company to make gas pipes which withstand higher pressures.  新材料使得公司可以生产出抗压力更强的输气管。

words.meaning: n. [常pl.  ]资源，财力
words.example:
The country's greatest resource is the dedication of its workers.  这个国家最大的资源就是劳动者的奉献精神。
Britain's mineral resources include oil, coal and gas deposits.  英国的矿产资源包括石油、煤炭和天然气。
He can't cope with difficult situations on his own - he has no inner resources.  他不能独力应付困难局面——他心理素质很差。UK verb transitive

words.meaning: vt.  识别,认明,鉴定,使等同于vi.  一致,变成一致
words.example:
Even the smallest baby can identify its mother by her voice.  就连年龄最小的婴儿也能根据声音分辨出自己的母亲。
The gunman in Wednesday's attack has been identified as Lee Giggs, an unemployed truck driver.  周三袭击事件中的枪手已被确认为李‧吉格斯，一个失业的卡车司机。
The research will be used to identify training needs.  该研究将用来确定培训的需求。

words.meaning: vt. vi.  决定,决心
words.example:
The number of staff we can take on will be determined by how much money we're allowed to spend.  我们雇用的人数将取决于可支配资金的多少。
Your health is determined in part by what you eat.  在某种程度上你的健康状况取决于你的饮食。
Eye colour is genetically determined.  眼睛的颜色是由遗传基因决定的。

words.meaning: n.  疾病
words.example:
They reported a sudden outbreak of the disease in the south of the country.  他们报告说该国南部地区突然爆发了这种疾病。
The first symptom of the disease is a very high temperature.  这种病的最初症状是高烧。
She has caught/contracted (= begun to have) a lung disease/disease of the lungs.  她患上了肺病。

words.meaning: n.  数量,总额vi.  总计,等于
words.example:
They didn't deliver the right amount of sand.  他们运来的沙子数量不对。
Small amounts of land were used for keeping animals.  少量的土地用于饲养动物。
He paid regular amounts of money to a charity.  他定期向一家慈善机构捐钱。

words.meaning: n.  能力,才干
words.example:
There's no doubting her ability.  她的能力毋庸置疑。
She's a woman of considerable abilities.  她是个非常有才干的女性。

words.meaning: n.  全体人员,同事,棍棒,杆,权杖,支柱,拐杖vt.  为. . . 配备人员
words.example:
There is a good relationship between staff and pupils at the school.  学校里教职员工和学生的关系很融洽。
The staff are not very happy about the latest pay increase.  员工们对最近一次加薪不太满意。
There are over a hundred staff in the company.  公司有100多名员工。

words.meaning: vt.  认出,认可,赏识,公认vi.  具结
words.example:
Doctors are trained to recognize the symptoms of different diseases.  医生受过训练可以辨识出不同疾病的症状。(UK usually recognise) ['rek.əg.naɪz]
The international community has refused to recognize (= officially accept the existence of) the newly independent nation state.  国际社会拒绝承认这个新独立的国家。
You must recognize the seriousness of the problems we are facing.  你必须认识到我们现在面临的问题有多严重。

words.meaning: vt.  显示,象征,指示,指出
words.example:
Exploratory investigations have indicated large amounts of oil below the sea bed.  勘测调查显示海床下有大量的石油。
The gauge indicates a temperature below freezing point.  测量器显示温度在冰点以下。verb
specialized Antihistamine is indicated for this patient as a treatment for her allergies.  该病人患过敏症，建议用抗组织胺来治疗。

words.meaning: n.  个性,字元,人物,资格,品格
words.example:
Politeness is traditionally part of the British character.  待人礼貌客气向来是英国人性格的一部分。
It would be very out of character (= not typical) of her to lie.  撒谎可不符合她的个性。
One of the joys of being a parent is watching the child's character develop.  为人父母的一大乐趣就是观察孩子的性格发展。

words.meaning: n.  地区，区域; (大气等的)层
words.example:
He said he had sharp pains in the stomach region/the region of the stomach.  他说他的胃部剧痛。
They estimate that the temperature yesterday was (somewhere) in the region of -30°C.  他们估计昨天的气温在零下30摄氏度左右。

words.meaning: n.  选举,当选,选择权
words.example:
The Government is expected to call an election (= allow the country to vote) very soon.  预计政府会很快举行大选。
Local government elections will take place in May.  地方政府选举将在五月份举行。
The first election results have started to come in.  初步选举结果开始揭晓。

words.meaning: a.  身体的; 物理的; 物质的; n.  体检
words.example:
I'm not a very physical sort of person (= I don't enjoy physical activities).  我不是那种喜欢体育活动的人。
The referee stepped in because the game had started to get a bit physical.  因为比赛开始变得有些粗暴了，所以裁判进行了干涉。
There was obviously a great physical attraction between them.  他们之间明显有很强的肉体吸引力。adjective

words.meaning: vt.  下(蛋); 放置; 位于
words.example:
She laid the baby on the bed.  她把婴儿放在了床上。
He laid the tray down on the table.  他把托盘放在桌子上。
She laid aside her book and went to answer the phone.  她把书放在一边去接电话。

words.meaning: n.  一般,将军,大体a.  一般的,普遍的,总的,大体的n.  常规
words.example:
The general feeling at the meeting was that a vote should be taken.  所有与会者都感到应该投票表决。
There is general concern about rising crime rates.  人们普遍对犯罪率上升感到担忧。
My general impression of the place was good.  我对这个地方的总的印象很好。

words.meaning: n.  标准; a.  标准的
words.example:
This essay is not of an acceptable standard - do it again.  这篇文章未达标准——重新写。
This piece of work is below standard/is not up to standard.  这工作做得不合要求。
We have very high safety standards in this laboratory.  我们这个实验室有很高的安全标准。

words.meaning: n.  帐单,钞票,鸟嘴,清单,票据,法案vt.  送帐单,宣布
words.example:
They sent us a bill for the work they had done.  他们寄给我们索取工资的帐单。
She ran up (= caused herself to have) a huge phone bill talking to her boyfriend for hours.  由于与男友在电话聊天数小时，她的电话费大增。
They asked the waitress for the bill.  他们叫女侍者把帐单拿来。

words.meaning: n.  分析
words.example:
Chemical analysis revealed a high content of copper.  化学分析结果显示出极高的铜含量。
In the final analysis, the only people who will benefit are property owners.  归根究柢，唯一受益的群体将是房产业主。

words.meaning: n.  利益vt.  有益于vi.  受益
words.example:
The discovery of oil brought many benefits to the town.  石油的发现给该镇带来很多利益。
One of the many benefits of foreign travel is learning how to cope with the unexpected.  学会如何应付突发事件是海外旅游的众多益处之一。
He's had the benefit of an expensive education and yet he continues to work as a waiter.  他接受过昂贵的教育，但却继续当一名侍者。

words.meaning: n.  部分; 地区; 部门
words.example:
Does the restaurant have a non-smoking section?  这个餐馆有禁烟区吗？
The poorest sections of the community have much worse health.  该社区最穷的居民健康状况糟糕得多。
He was charged under section 17 of the Firearms Act (= according to that part of the law).  他被控违反了《枪械法》第17款。noun

words.meaning: n.  阶段; 舞台; 戏剧; v.  筹划
words.example:
The project is in its final stages and should be completed by August.  这个企划案已进入最后阶段，应于八月份前完成。
They did the last stage of their journey on foot.  他们徒步走完了旅途的最后一段路。
Our marriage is going through a difficult stage at the moment.  目前我们的婚姻正走到难关。

words.meaning: vt.  比较,比喻,匹敌vi.  相比n.  比较
words.example:
If you compare house prices in the two areas, it's quite amazing how different they are.  如果比较一下两个地段的房价，你会惊讶地发现两者差别竟如此之大。
That seems expensive - have you compared prices in other shops?  那好像很贵——你有没有比较一下其他店里的价格？
Compare some recent work with your older stuff and you'll see how much you've improved.  把你近来的作品与以前的对照一下，你就会知道你的进步有多大。

words.meaning: n.  权威,专家,威信
words.example:
The United Nations has used/exerted/exercised its authority to restore peace in the area.  联合国行使其权力以恢复该地区的和平。
We need to get the support of someone in authority (= an important or high-ranking person).  我们需要得到一个有实权的人的支持。
They've been acting illegally and without authority (= permission) from the council.  他们的行动都是非法的，而且没有得到市政委员会的授权。

words.meaning: n.  设计,图样,企图vt. vi.  设计,计划
words.example:
Who designed this building/dress/furniture?  是谁设计这座建筑物／这款裙子／这套家俱？
This range of clothing is specially designed for shorter women.  这系列服装是专为身材较矮的女性设计的。verb
This dictionary is designed for advanced learners of English.  本词典是为高级英语学习者编写的。

words.meaning: n.  所; 站; 台
words.example:
Our office is near the station.  我们的办事处在火车站附近。
We looked on our map to find the nearest UKunderground/tube / USsubway/metro station.  我们在地图上找最近的地铁站。
The reception is not very good - try to tune in to another station.  接收效果不太好——换个频道（台）试试。noun countable

words.meaning: n.  战略，策略
words.example:
The president held an emergency meeting to discuss military strategy with his defence commanders yesterday.  总统昨天召开紧急会议，和国防指挥官商讨军事战略。
Their marketing strategy for the product involves obtaining as much free publicity as possible.  他们对这产品采取的市场策略包括尽可能去争取免费的宣传机会。

words.meaning: a.  民主的
words.example:
We must accept the results of a democratic election (= an election in which all people can vote).  我们必须接受民主选举结果。
Do you think Australia is a more democratic country (= there is greater social equality there) than Britain?  你觉得澳大利亚比英国更民主吗？

words.meaning: n.  检查,支票,象棋中将军,行李票vt.  检查,阻止,托运,寄存,核对vi.
words.example:
You should always check your oil, water and tyres before taking your car on a long trip.  你每次开车长途旅行前都应当检查一下油箱、水箱和轮胎。
Customs stopped us and checked (= searched) our bags for alcohol and cigarettes.  海关人员要求我们停下，检查我们的随身行李里有没有烟酒。
After I'd finished the exam, I checked my answers for mistakes.  我做完考卷后检查答案有没有错误。

words.meaning: a.  不同的,各种的,多方面的,杂色的,个别的,许多的
words.example:
We had various problems on our journey, including a puncture.  我们在旅途中遇到了各种各样的问题，包括轮胎被扎破了。
The author gave various reasons for having written the book.  作者给出了写那本书的各种理由。
Girardo was out of action with various injuries for most of last season.  上个赛季大多数时间吉拉多都因为各种伤病而不能上场。

words.meaning: v. n.  声称; 要求; 索赔; n.  断言
words.example:
All parties have claimed success in yesterday's elections.  所有党派都声称在昨天的选举中取得了胜利。
An unknown terrorist group has claimed responsibility for this morning's bomb attack.  一个不知名的恐怖组织声称对今天上午的炸弹袭击事件负责。
The police said that if no one claims the watch, you can keep it.  警方说如果没人认领这只表，你可以留着它。

words.meaning: n.  阶级,升级,距离,搬家,移动vt.  移动,调动,除去,移交,开除,迁移vi.
words.example:
The men came to remove the rubbish from the backyard.  这些人来清除后院的垃圾。
This detergent will remove even old stains.  这种洗涤剂就连以前的顽渍也能除去。
It got so hot that he removed his tie and jacket.  天气太热了，他解下领带，脱掉外套。

words.meaning: n.  结局,决赛,期末考试a.  最后的,终极的,决定性的
words.example:
The game is in its final stages.  比赛到了最后阶段。
In the final analysis, it is the drug companies that are going to profit from this policy.  归根结底，从这项政策中获益的将是那些制药公司。
It's no use begging me - I'm not coming and that's final.  求我也没有用——我已经决定了，我不会来。noun

words.meaning: n.  细胞; 单人房间; 基层组织
words.example: the cells of a honeycomb  蜂巢的巢室

words.meaning: v.  建立，安置
words.example:
The brewery was established in 1822.  这家啤酒厂建于1822年。
These methods of working were established in the last century.  这些工作方法是上个世纪开始采用的。verb
His reputation for carelessness was established long before the latest problems arose.  在最近的一连串问题出现之前，他早就是个公认的糊涂虫了。

words.meaning: n.  审判,试验,考验,麻烦事a.  尝试的,试验性的
words.example:
Trial by jury is a fundamental right.  由陪审团审判是一项基本权利。
It was a very complicated trial that went on for months.  该审判非常复杂，历时数月。
She's going on/standing trial for fraud.  她因诈骗而将受审。

words.meaning: n.  春天,弹簧,跳跃,弹性,源泉,泉a.  春天的vi.  跳,弹跳,涌出,高耸,裂
words.example:
Many bulbs bloom in (the) spring.  很多球茎植物春天开花。
Janet's coming over for a couple of weeks next spring.  珍妮特明年春天要来这里待几个星期。noun
The children have jumped on the couch so much that they've ruined the springs.  孩子们老是在沙发上跳来跳去的，把弹簧都跳坏了。

words.meaning: n.  公司,商号a.  坚定的,坚强的,牢固的,结实的,坚硬的,确定的,严格的,
words.example:
I'd rather sleep on a firm mattress than a soft one.  我宁愿睡硬床垫，也不要软的。
These pears are still too firm to eat.  这些梨还太硬，没法吃。UK adjective
The bridge provided a firm platform for the bungee jumpers.  这座桥为高空弹跳者提供了稳固的平台。

words.meaning: n. [Democrat]美国民主党人
words.example: The democrat won the primary.  这位民主党人赢得了初选。

words.meaning: vt.  避免,消除
words.example:
The report studiously avoided any mention of the controversial plan.  这份报告有意避而不谈那个有争议的计划。
The plane narrowly avoided disaster when one of the engines cut out on take-off.  飞机起飞时有一个引擎熄火，差点酿成重大事故。
Unnecessary paperwork should be avoided (= prevented) at all costs.  应该尽可能避免不必要的文书工作。

words.meaning: n.  冲击,冲突,影响,效果vt.  挤入,撞击,压紧,对. . . 发生影响
words.example:
The impact of the crash reduced the car to a third of its original length.  撞车时的冲击力使车身变形，仅剩原来长度的三分之一。
The bullet explodes on impact (= when it hits another object).  子弹击中物体时爆炸。
The anti-smoking campaign had had/made quite an impact on young people.  禁烟运动对年轻人造成了不小的影响。

words.meaning: vi.  (to)回答; 做出反应
words.example:
He responded by marching off and slamming the door behind him.  他的反应是大步走出房间，狠狠甩上了门。
How did she respond to the news?  她听了这消息有甚么反应？
The police respond to emergencies (= arrive and are ready to deal with emergencies) in just a few minutes.  紧急事件发生时，员警在短短几分钟内就会作出反应。

words.meaning: vt.  维持,维修,保持,主张,供养,坚持
words.example:
The army has been brought in to maintain order in the region.  军队已调配到这个地区来维持秩序。
We have standards to maintain.  我们要坚持原则。
Despite living in different countries, the two families have maintained close links.  尽管住在不同的国家，两个家庭仍保持着紧密联系。

words.meaning: n.  指控,费用,冲锋,电荷,炸药,嘱咐,被托管人,主管vt.  控诉,加罪于,使
words.example:
How much/What do you charge for a haircut and blow-dry?  剪发和吹风要收多少钱？
The bank charged commission to change my traveller's cheques.  银行兑现我的旅行支票收取了手续费。
The local museum doesn't charge for admission.  当地博物馆不收门票费。

words.meaning: a.  通俗的; 受欢迎的，流行的
words.example:
She's the most popular teacher in school.  她是学校里最受欢迎的老师。
That song was popular with people from my father's generation.  那首歌在我爸爸那一代很流行。
Walking is a popular form of exercise in Britain.  在英国，走路是很流行的运动方式。

words.meaning: vt.  露出,显示,透露,(神)启示,泄露n.  窗侧,门侧
words.example: He was jailed for revealing secrets to the Russians.  他因为向俄国人泄密而被监禁。

words.meaning: n.  职员,员工,受雇人员
words.example:
The number of employees in the company has trebled over the past decade.  在过去的十年中，这个公司的雇员人数增加了两倍。
She's a former council employee/employee of the council.  她以前是为该委员会工作的雇员。

words.meaning: vt.  包含，容纳; 控制
words.example:
How much liquid do you think this bottle contains?  你认为这个瓶可装多少液体？
I've lost a file containing a lot of important documents.  我丢了一个装有大量重要文件的文件夹。
Try to avoid foods which contain a lot of fat.  尽量别吃脂肪含量高的食物。

words.meaning: n.  尺寸; 测量; [常pl.  ]措施; v.  (测)量
words.example:
This machine measures your heart rate.  这台机器可测量你的心率。
He measured the flour into the bowl.  他量好面粉，倒入碗中。
The area, measuring/which measures 5 kilometres by 3 kilometres, has been purchased by the army.  这个长5公里、宽3公里的区域已被军方购买下来。UK verb

words.meaning: n.  摇动,震动vt.  摇动,动摇,使震动,挥舞vi.  震动,发抖,动摇
words.example:
Babies like toys that make a noise when they're shaken.  婴儿喜欢摇晃时能发出声响的玩具。
The explosion shook buildings for miles around.  爆炸震动了好几哩以内的房屋。
She shook her hair loose from its ribbon.  她抖了抖头发，把丝带抖掉。

words.meaning: v.  操纵; 管理，控制
words.example:
Don't worry about us - we'll manage!  别担心我们——我们应付得了的！
Can you manage dinner on Saturday (= Will you be able to come to dinner) ?  你星期六能来吃晚餐吗？
mainly UK I'm afraid I can't manage the time (= I'm too busy) to see you at the moment.  恐怕我现在抽不出时间去见你。

words.meaning: a.  特定的; 独特的; 详细的; 挑剔的
words.example:
She wanted a particular type of cactus.  她要某一品种的仙人掌。
He wouldn't take just any book - he had to have this particular one!  他不会随便买书——他要买这本！
What in particular did you like about the last apartment that we saw?  我们最后看的那个公寓你特别喜欢它哪一点？

words.meaning: n.  政治; 政见
words.example:
Joe is very active in left-wing politics.  乔在左翼政治中很活跃。
The group is campaigning to get more women into politics.  该组织正发起运动以使更多女性有机会从政。
He is planning to retire from politics next year.  他打算明年退出政坛。

words.meaning: vt.  表演; 执行
words.example:
Computers can perform a variety of tasks.  电脑能执行多项工作。
The operation will be performed next week.  手术将于下周进行。
Most of the students performed well in the exam.  大多数学生都考得很好。

words.meaning: n.  候选人,投考者
words.example:
There are three candidates standing in the election.  有三位候选人参加竞选。
The English Department is a likely candidate for staff cuts.  英语系很有可能要裁员。
Candidates must write their names on the top page of the exam paper.  考生必须将自己的名字写在试卷首页。

words.meaning: vt.  影响,假装,倾向于,感动n.  感情
words.example:
Both buildings were badly affected by the fire.  两座大楼都被大火严重焚毁。
The divorce affected every aspect of her life.  离婚使她生活的各个方面都受到了影响。
It's a disease which affects mainly older people.  这是一种主要侵扰老年人的疾病。

words.meaning: n.  会议
words.example:
They frequently hold conferences at that hotel.  他们常在那家饭店举办会议。
I'm speaking at/attending a conference next week.  我下周要在一个会议上发言／出席一个会议。
Should I book the conference room for the meeting?  我要为会议预订会议室吗？

words.meaning: n.  范围; 山脉; v.  (在某范围内)变动
words.example:
There is a wide / whole range of opinions on this issue.  在这个问题上，存在着很多不同的意见。
We stock the full range of model railway accessories.  我们备有铁路模型玩具的全套零配件。
This jacket is part of our autumn/spring range.  这种外套是我们系列秋／春装中的一款。

words.meaning: n.  提到,言及,陈述vt.  提到,提及
words.example:
I'll mention your ideas to Jacinta.  我会跟哈辛塔说一下你的想法。
Did she mention me in her letter?  她在信中提到我了吗？verb transitive
He's one of the kindest and most intelligent, not to mention handsome, men I know.  他是我所认识的人当中其中一个最友善、最聪明的人，此外他还很英俊。verb transitive

words.meaning: n.  边缘,尖锐,刀刃,优势vt.  使锐利,挤进,镶边,开刃vi.  缓缓移动
words.example:
He'd piped fresh cream around the edge of the cake.  他用鲜奶油沿蛋糕边挤花。
They built the church on the edge of the village.  他们把教堂建在村庄边缘。
Careful with that open tin - it's got a very sharp edge.  小心那罐打开的罐头——开口的地方很锋利。noun

words.meaning: n.  条,棒,障碍物,栅,酒吧vt.  禁止,阻挡,妨碍
words.example:
They noticed him going into the hotel bar.  他们看见他走进饭店的酒吧里。
There weren't any free tables, so I sat at the bar.  没有空位了，我只好坐在吧台旁。
Why don't you ask the guy behind the bar (= serving drinks there) ?  你怎么不问一问吧台里的那个职员？UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.  财产; 特性; 所有权; 房地产
words.example:
The club does not accept responsibility for loss of or damage to club members' personal property.  该俱乐部不承担会员个人财产遗失或损坏的责任。
Both books have 'Property of Her Majesty's Government' stamped inside them.  这两本书里都盖著「女王陛下政府之财产”的印章。
Children need to be taught to have respect for other people's property.  孩子应该被教导要尊重他人的财产。

words.meaning: n.  方法; 秩序
words.example:
Travelling by train is still one of the safest methods of transport.  乘坐火车仍是最安全的交通出行方式之一。
The new teaching methods encourage children to think for themselves.  新的教学方法鼓励孩子独立思考。noun countable

words.meaning: v.  反射; 反映
words.example:
He saw himself reflected in the water/mirror/shop window.  他在水中／镜子里／商店橱窗玻璃上看到了自己的影像。
The light reflected off the surface of the water.  光在水面上产生反射。verb
The statistics reflect a change in people's spending habits.  这些统计资料显示出人们的消费习惯发生了变化。verb

words.meaning: vi.  存在,发生,生存
words.example:
Poverty still exists in this country.  这个国家仍存在贫困现象。verb intransitive
Some species exist in this small area of forest and nowhere else on Earth.  一些物种仅存于这一小片森林中，地球上其他地方都没有。
Few people can exist without water for more than a week.  很少有人能在断水的情况下生存超过一星期。

words.meaning: n.  样式，图案; v.  仿制
words.example:
The pattern of family life has been changing over recent years.  近年来家庭生活的模式一直在变化。
In this type of mental illness, the usual pattern is bouts of depression alternating with elation.  这种精神病通常的发病症状是时而萎靡不振，时而兴高采烈。
Many behaviour(al) patterns have been identified in the chimp colony.  黑猩猩群体中的许多行为模式已被识别。UK noun

words.meaning: n.  一代人; 发生
words.example:
The younger generation smoke/smokes less than their parents did.  年轻的一代比他们父母这一代人吸烟要少。
There were at least three generations - grandparents, parents and children - at the wedding.  婚礼上至少有三代人——祖父母、父母和孩子们。
It's our duty to preserve the planet for future generations.  为了子孙后代保护好这个星球的环境是我们的职责。

words.meaning: n.  地址; 讲话; v.  作(正式)讲话; 写姓名地址
words.example:
She gave an address to the Royal Academy.  她在皇家艺术院作了场演讲。noun countable UK US [ˈæd.res/
He addressed a few introductory remarks to the audience.  他向观众说了几句开场白。
He likes to be addressed as 'Sir' or 'Mr Partridge'.  他喜欢被称为“先生”或“派特里奇先生”。verb transitive /əˈdres/

words.meaning: n.  打,敲打声,拍子vt. vi.  打,打败,搜索a.  疲乏的,颓废的
words.example:
Simon always beats me at tennis.  西蒙在打网球时总是赢我。
Holland beat Belgium (by)3-1.  荷兰队以3比1战胜比利时队。
Our team was comfortably/easily/soundly beaten in the first round of the competition.  在第一轮比赛中，我们队被对手轻易地／毫不费力地／彻底打败了。

words.meaning: a.  肯定的,积极的,绝对的
words.example:
On a more positive note, we're seeing signs that the housing market is picking up.  更乐观地说，我们看到了房地产市场正在好转的迹象。
The past ten years have seen some very positive developments in East-West relations.  在过去的十年里，东西方关系有了一些非常积极的发展。
There was a very positive response to our new design - people seemed very pleased with it.  我们的新设计获得非常积极的回应——看来人们对该产品非常满意。    Opposite negativeUK adjective

words.meaning: n.  消费者
words.example: The new telephone rates will affect all consumers including businesses.  新的电话费率会影响到所有用户，包括工商企业。

words.meaning: n.  预算vi.  编预算vt.  编入预算,安排a.  廉价的
words.example:
The firm has drawn up a budget for the coming financial year.  公司草拟了下一财政年度的预算方案。
Libraries are finding it increasingly difficult to remain within (their) budget.  图书馆感到想把支出维持在预算之内越来越难。
An extra £20 million has been budgeted for schools this year.  今年学校预算增加了2000万英镑。adjective [before noun]

words.meaning: n.  代理人,律师
words.example: a defense attorney  辩护律师

words.meaning: n.  得分，分数; 乐谱; v.  评分
words.example:
Tennant scored (a goal)in the last minute of the match.  坦南特在比赛的最后一分钟进了一球。
In American football, a touchdown scores (= is worth) six points.  在美式橄榄球中，攻方持球触地就得六分。
She scored 18 out of 20 in the spelling test.  拼写考试满分20分，她得了18分。

words.meaning: n.  帐目,报告,估计,原因,记录,算账vi.  解释,认为,占,杀死,得分vt.
words.example:
I've opened an account with a building society.  我在房屋互助协会开了个帐户。
She gave a thrilling account of her life in the jungle.  她把在丛林中生活的经历描述得惊险刺激。
He kept a detailed account of the suspect's movements.  他详细纪录了嫌疑犯的一举一动。

words.meaning: n.  听众,观众
words.example:
She lectures to audiences all over the world.  她向世界各地的听众发表演讲。
The secret to public speaking is to get the audience on your side.  当众演讲的秘诀是，一定要让听众支持你的观点。
The audience was/were clearly delighted with the performance.  无疑，观众非常喜欢这场演出。

words.meaning: n.  投票,选举,选票,得票数,选举权vi.  投票,选举vt.  投票选举,投票决
words.example:
She was too young to vote in the national election.  她的年龄太小，不能在全国大选中投票。
The committee voted on the proposal, and accepted it unanimously.  委员会就这一提议进行投票表决，结果一致通过。
Did you vote for or against the motion?  对这项动议你投了赞成票还是反对票？

words.meaning: n. v.  辩论; 讨论，争论
words.example:
Education is the current focus of public debate.  教育是目前大众谈论的焦点。
How we proceed from here is a matter for debate.  我们还需要讨论下一步该怎样做。
Over the year we have had several debates about future policy.  一年来，我们就未来的政策进行了几次讨论。verb

words.meaning: vt. vi.  预防,防止,妨碍,阻止,避免
words.example: Label your suitcases to prevent confusion.  在你的手提箱上贴上标签以防搞混。

words.meaning: n.  多数,大半
words.example:
The majority of the employees have university degrees.  大部分员工都有大学文凭。
In Britain women are in the/a majority.  在英国，妇女占多数。    Compare minority
The Socialists won by a narrow/large majority.  社会党党员获得的票数稍微／远远超出对手，在选举中获胜。UK noun

words.meaning: vt.  允许进入,承认,接纳,容纳vi.  容许有,开向,承认
words.example:
He admitted his guilt/mistake.  他承认有罪／犯了错误。
At first he denied stealing the money but he later admitted (to) it.  初时他否认偷了钱，但是后来就承认了。
After several attempts to untie the knot, I admitted defeat and cut through it with a knife.  我试了几次都没有把这个结解开，最后认输了，就用刀子把它割开了。verb (-tt-)

words.meaning: a.  地位较高的; n.  较年长者; 四年级学生
words.example:
Senior pupils are expected to set an example to the younger children.  高年级的学生应该给低年级的学生树立榜样。    Compare junior
Hello, may I speak to Ken Griffey senior, please?  喂，请问老肯‧格里菲在吗？UK adjective
She's senior to me, so I have to do what she tells me.  她是我的上级，所以我得听她的。    Compare juniorUK noun

words.meaning: vt.  假定; 承担
words.example:
Let's assume (that) they're coming and make plans on that basis.  我们还是假定他们会来，并以此来作出计划。
We mustn't assume the suspects' guilt.  我们千万不能想当然地认为疑犯有罪。UK verb transitive
Moving to a different town, he assumed a false name.  搬家到了另外一个城镇后，他用了个假名字。

words.meaning: a.  职业的; 专业的; n.  专业人员
words.example:
Chris, you're a nurse, so can I ask your professional opinion on bandaging ankles?  克丽丝，你是个护士，能否征求一下你对踝部包扎的意见？
Both doctors have been charged with professional misconduct (= bad or unacceptable behaviour in their work).  这两位医生都被控渎职。    Compare amateur
It would look more professional if the letter was typed.  这封信如果列印出来的话看起来会更正式些。

words.meaning: n.  代表团; 任务，使命
words.example:
Your mission is to isolate the enemy by destroying all the bridges across the river.  你的任务是破坏这条河上所有的桥梁，以孤立敌军。
My mission in life is to educate the rich about the suffering of the poor.  我一生的使命就是让富人认识穷人所受的痛苦。
She's a woman with a mission and she's absolutely determined to finish the project.  她是个有使命感的女人，已下定决心完成这项计划。

words.meaning: a.  孤独的,单独的,独自的ad.  独自地
words.example:
He likes being alone in the house.  他喜欢自己一个人呆在家里。
She decided to climb the mountain alone.  她决定独自去爬那座山。
Do you like living alone?  你喜欢独居吗？

words.meaning: a.  成功的,一帆风顺的,飞黄腾达的
words.example:
My second attempt at making flaky pastry was a bit more successful.  我第二次尝试做千层酥时就做得好一些了。
This year's harvest was one of the most successful since the record crop of 1985.  今年的收成是自1985年创纪录的大丰收以来最好的一年。    Opposite unsuccessful
She runs a very successful computer business.  她的电脑公司生意非常兴隆。

words.meaning: n.  选择权,挑选n.  选项
words.example:
The best option would be to cancel the trip altogether.  最好的选择是彻底取消这次行程。
There are various options open to someone who is willing to work hard.  愿意努力工作的人有多种选项。
They didn't leave him much option - either he paid or they'd beat him up.  他们没有给他多少选择余地——要不付钱，要不挨打。

words.meaning: n.  参议院; 上院
words.example: The senate debated the treaty.  参议院辩论了这项条约。

words.meaning: n.  改革,改正,感化vt.  改革,改过,重新组成,改善,革新vi.  革新,改过,
words.example:
Who will reform Britain's unfair electoral system?  谁将改革英国不公正的选举制度呢？
For years I was an alcoholic, but I reformed when the doctors gave me six months to live.  我酗酒多年，但当医生预计我只能再活六个月时，我就改过自新了。UK noun countable or uncountable
Some reforms of/to the system will be necessary.  有必要对该制度进行一些改革。

words.meaning: n.  通路,进入,使用权,发作n.  访问
words.example:
The only access to the village is by boat.  到那个村子去的唯一方法是乘船。
The main access to (= entrance to) the building is at the side.  大楼的主入口在侧面。
The tax inspector had/gained complete access to the company files.  税务稽查员拥有／获得了查看公司所有档的权利。

words.meaning: v. n.  释放，解放; 发布
words.example:
He was released from prison after serving two years of a five-year sentence.  他被判五年徒刑，但是服刑两年后就被释放出狱了。
She was arrested for shoplifting but was released on bail (= after paying a sum of money to the law court).  她因为在商店行窃而被捕，但是在交纳保释金后就被释放了。
figurative The operation released him from years of pain.  手术使他摆脱了多年的病痛。

words.meaning: n.  信用,信任,学分,贷款,荣誉vt.  归功于,赞颂,信任,相信
words.example:
She got no credit for solving the problem.  她没有因为解决了这一问题而得到任何赞许。
Her boss took credit for it/ took (all) the credit instead.  她的老板反倒为此赢得了声誉／把一切全归功于自己。
To her (great) credit, she admitted she was wrong.  她承认自己错了，这（很）值得称赞。

words.meaning: a.  批评的,决定性的,危险的,临界的
words.example:
The report is highly critical of safety standards at the factory.  这篇报道尖锐地批评了那家工厂的安全标准。UK adjective
The President's support is critical (to this project).  总统的支援（对该计划）至关重要。
She has written a major critical appraisal/study of Saul Bellow's novels.  她著有一篇重要的评论文章，对索尔‧贝娄的小说作了评价／研究。

words.meaning: a.  关心的
words.example:
I'm a bit concerned about/for your health.  我有点担心你的健康。
Concerned parents have complained about the dangerous playground.  忧心忡忡的家长抱怨那个儿童游乐场太危险。UK adjective
I'd like to thank everyone concerned for making the occasion run so smoothly.  我要感谢为本次活动顺利进行而付出努力的所有相关人员。

words.meaning: n.  回忆,召回,取消vt.  回想,回忆,召回,恢复,取消,撤消
words.example:
The old man recalled the city as it had been before the war.  这位老人回忆起战前这座城市的样子。
His paintings recall the style of Picasso.  他的画作使人联想起毕卡索的风格。UK verb
The ambassador was recalled when war broke out.  战争爆发后大使就被召回了。

words.meaning: n.  版本,翻译
words.example:
The official version of events is that the police were attacked and were just trying to defend themselves.  事件的官方说法是员警受到了攻击，他们只是想自卫。
You can make a reduced fat version of the cheesecake by using cottage cheese instead of cream cheese.  你可以用茅屋起司代替奶油起司来制作低脂肪的起司蛋糕。
An English-language version of the book is planned for the autumn.  那本书的英语版本计划在秋天推出。

words.meaning: a.  有效的,有力的,实际的n.  有生力量
words.example:
It's an extremely effective cure for a headache.  这种药物治疗头痛极其有效。
The lighting for the production made a very effective use of shadow.  该戏剧的舞台灯光设计巧妙地运用了阴影效果。
She's a very effective teacher.  她课上得不错。    Opposite ineffectiveadjective

words.meaning: a.  最初的,原始的,有创意的n.  原物,原作
words.example:
Is this the original fireplace?  这是原先的壁炉吗？
The gardens have recently been restored to their original glory.  这些园林最近恢复了原先的辉煌。
Is this an original Rembrandt (= Was it painted by him) ?  这是伦勃朗的原作吗？adjective

words.meaning: n.  种类，类群
words.example:
Mountain gorillas are an endangered species.  山地大猩猩属于濒危物种。
Over a hundred species of insect are found in this area.  这一地区有上百种昆虫。
figurative humorous Women film directors in Hollywood are a rare species.  女性电影导演在好莱坞属于稀有物种。

words.meaning: v.  打，敲; 侵袭; n.  罢工
words.example:
Democratization has brought workers the right to strike and join a trade union.  民主化赋予工人罢工和加入工会的权利。
We're striking for a reduction in the working week and improved safety standards.  我们举行罢工，要求减少每周工作时间并提高安全标准。verb
I've got a life insurance policy that will look after my family if disaster strikes.  我有人寿保险，这样即使灾难降临，我的家人也会有保障。

words.meaning: adv.  完全地; 绝对地
words.example:
You must be absolutely silent or the birds won't appear.  你必须绝对安静，不然鸟儿就不会飞出来。
We've achieved absolutely nothing today.  我们今天真是一事无成。
It's absolutely impossible to work with all this noise.  噪音这么大，根本没法工作。

words.meaning: vt.  完成
words.example:
The government's training policy, he claimed, was achieving its objectives.  他称政府制定的培训方针即将达到预期目标。
She finally achieved her ambition to visit South America.  她终于实现了去南美洲旅游的梦想。
I've been working all day, but I feel as if I've achieved nothing.  我干了整整一天，但觉得好像甚么都没有做成。

words.meaning: vt.  提交,谈及,使求助于,指点把. . . 提交,归诸于vi.  提到,涉及,咨询
words.example:
In her autobiography she occasionally refers to her unhappy schooldays.  在其自传中，她偶尔提及了她不幸的学生时代。
He always refers to the house as his "refuge".  他总是把这座房子称为他的“避难所”。
The new salary scale only refers to company managers and directors.  新的工资级别标准只适用于公司经理和主管人员。UK US (-rr-)

words.meaning: n.  概念，思想
words.example:
The very concept of free speech is unknown to them.  他们没有言论自由的概念。
It is very difficult to define the concept of beauty.  很难给美这个概念下一个定义。
Kleenbrite is a whole new concept in toothpaste!  Kleenbrite 是牙膏生产领域的一个全新概念！

words.meaning: n.  委托人，当事人; 顾客
words.example:
Mr Black has been a client of this firm for many years.  布莱克先生是这家公司多年的老主顾。
We always aim to give our clients personal attention.  我们一向致力于为顾客提供体贴入微的照顾。noun countable

words.meaning: n.  完成式a.  完美的,全然的,理想的,完成式的,正确的vt.  使完美,修改
words.example:
What is your idea of perfect happiness?  你认为完美的幸福是怎么样的？
This church is a perfect example of medieval architecture.  这座教堂是中世纪建筑的完美典范。
You have a perfect English accent.  你有一口道地的英格兰口音。

words.meaning: n.  行为,举动,指导vt.  引导,指挥,管理,实施vi.  引导,传导,指挥
words.example:
We are conducting a survey to find out what our customers think of their local bus service.  我们正在进行一项调查，了解顾客对当地公共交通服务系统的看法。
The experiments were conducted by scientists in New York.  这些实验是纽约的科学家做的。
How you choose to conduct your private life is your own business!  你选择怎么过你的私生活是你自己的事！verb[kənˈdʌkt/

words.meaning: vt.  宣布,显示,预告vi.  当报幕员,宣布参加竞选
words.example:
They announced the death of their mother in the local paper.  他们在一家当地报纸上刊登了他们母亲去世的讣告。
She announced the winner of the competition to an excited audience.  她向激动的观众宣布了比赛的获胜者。
The first few leaves in the gutter announced the beginning of autumn.  排水沟中最先落下的几片叶子标志着秋天的来临。

words.meaning: n.  交谈; 会话
words.example:
She had a strange conversation with the bloke who's moved in upstairs.  她跟搬到楼上的那个家伙进行了一次奇怪的交谈。
It's impossible to hold/carry on a conversation with all this noise going on!  周围这么吵根本无法谈话！
Because of television, many people have lost the art of conversation (= talking to each other).  由于电视的缘故，许多人变得不善于与他人交谈了。

words.meaning: vt.  参加,照料,陪伴vi.  专心,照顾,服侍
words.example:
Over two hundred people attended the funeral.  二百多人参加了葬礼。
The meeting is on the fifth and we're hoping everyone will attend.  会议将在5号举行，我们希望大家都能出席。
Which school do your children attend?  你们的孩子在哪间学校就读？

words.meaning: a.  核子的,原子能的,核的,中心的
words.example: How many nations have a nuclear capability (= have nuclear weapons) ?  有多少国家拥有核武器？UK adjective

words.meaning: n.  报刊，新闻界，通讯社; 挤压; v.  挤压; 催促
words.example:
Press the button to start the machine.  按下按钮，启动机器。
He pressed his face against the window.  他把脸贴在窗户上。
Can you press a bit harder on my shoulders, please?  你按压我的肩膀时能再用力一点吗？

words.meaning: n.  冲突，不一致，争论;  v.  冲突，不一致，争论
words.example:
There was a lot of conflict between him and his father.  他和父亲之间存在着许多分歧。
It was an unpopular policy and caused a number of conflicts within the party.  这项政策不得人心，在党内引起了一些分歧。
His outspoken views would frequently bring him into conflict with the president.  他对自己的看法总是直言不讳，这常常使他和总统发生争执。

words.meaning: vt.  鼓励,支持,激励
words.example:
transitive + to infinitive We were encouraged to learn foreign languages at school.  在校时，学校鼓励我们学习外语。
The council is encouraging the development of the property for both employment and recreation.  市政委员会鼓励开发该项房地产的目的在于促进就业和增加娱乐设施。
They've always encouraged me in everything I've wanted to do.  不论我想做甚么，他们总是会鼓励我。

words.meaning: n.  脑vt.  打碎脑部
words.example:
Doctors tried desperately to reduce the swelling in her brain.  医生想尽一切办法缩小她脑部的肿块。
The accident left him with permanent brain damage.  事故给他造成了永久大脑损伤。
His wife died from a brain tumour.  他妻子死于脑瘤。

words.meaning: n.  保险，保险业
words.example:
I'll need to take out extra car insurance for another driver.  我必须为另一名驾驶者购买汽车保险。
The insurance doesn't cover you for (= include) household items.  这份保险没有包括你的家居物品。    Compare assurance

words.meaning: ad.  通常,逐渐地,普遍地
words.example:
Your health is generally good, but you do have a few minor problems.  大体上，你身体状况不错，但有些小毛病。
He wants more money to be given to the arts generally.  他希望各艺术门类都能得到更多的资金。
The baby generally wakes up three times during the night.  通常这个婴儿会在夜间醒三次。

words.meaning: a.  完全的,熟练的,完成的vt.  完成,完工,使圆满
words.example:
Complete the sentence with one of the adjectives provided.  从所给形容词中选择一个使句子变得完整。
He only needs two more cards to complete the set.  他只需再有两张牌就凑成一副了。
All she needed to complete her happiness was a baby.  只需再有个孩子她的生活就幸福美满了。

words.meaning: n.  棍，棒; 手杖; v.  粘住; 放置
words.example:
The old man was carrying a load of sticks.  那个老人抱着一捆树枝。
Police said that the child had been beaten with a stick.  警方说那个孩子被人用木棍打了。
Find some dry sticks and we'll make a campfire.  找些干树枝，我们来生营火。

words.meaning: v.  定义，解释
words.example:
In this dictionary 'reality' is defined as 'the state of things as they are, rather than as they are imagined to be'.  在本词典中，reality 被解释为 the state of things as they are, rather than as they are imagined to be。
Before I answer your question, could you define your terms a little more (= explain what you mean by the words you have used) ?  在回答你的问题前，你能不能再解释一下你要表达的意思？
Your rights and responsibilities are defined in the citizens' charter.  你的权利和义务在公民宪章中有明确的界定。

words.meaning: n.  元件,元素,要素
words.example:
List the elements which make up a perfect dinner party.  列举出一次尽善尽美的晚宴的所有构成要素。
The film had all the elements of a good thriller.  这部电影具备了一部精彩的惊栗片的一切要素。
We weren't even taught the elements of (= basic information about) physics at school.  学校连基本的物理知识都没有教给我们。noun

words.meaning: n.  状态,情形,地位,重要身分n.  状态
words.example:
The association works to promote the status of retired people as useful members of the community.  这个协会旨在提高退休人员的地位，使其成为社会中有用的成员。
There has been an increase in applications for refugee status.  越来越多的人申请难民身份。
The success of her book has given her unexpected celebrity status.  她的书的成功给她带来意想不到的名气。

words.meaning: n.  溶液; 解答，解决(办法)
words.example:
There's no easy solution to this problem.  这个问题没有容易的解决办法。
She just seems so unhappy and I don't know what the solution is.  她似乎很不高兴，但我不知道该怎么办。
When you finish doing the crossword, the solution is on the back page.  完成填字游戏后，可以翻到背面去找答案。

words.meaning: n.  刻度,衡量,比例,比例尺,数值范围,等级,规模,天平,秤盘,秤,鳞,水?vt
words.example:
How would you rate his work on a scale of 1 to 5?  按照一到五的等级，你给他的作业打几分？
This map is large scale (= things are shown in detail).  这张地图的比例尺很大。
Is the bridge drawn to scale (= so that it shows the exact shape of the bridge, but much smaller) ?  这座桥是按比例画的吗？

words.meaning: n. vi.  尝试，努力
words.example:
He attempted a joke, but no one laughed.  他开了个玩笑，试图调和气氛，但没有一个人笑。
There's no point in even attempting an explanation - he'll never listen.  试图去解释是毫无意义的——他根本不会听。noun countable
He made no attempt to be sociable.  他不合群，也不试图去改变这一点。

words.meaning: n.  污点,地点,斑点,点,少量,处境,缺点a.  当场的,现场的,现货买卖的vt
words.example:
He had a spot of grease on his tie.  他的领带上有一小块油渍。
Teenagers often suffer a lot from spots.  青少年常常深受粉刺的困扰。
Shall we stop for a spot of lunch?  我们停下来吃点午饭好吗？

words.meaning: n.  柄,把手,把柄,手感vt.  触摸,运用,操作,处理,买卖vi.  搬运,易于操
words.example:
She turned the handle and slowly opened the door.  她转动把手，慢慢地打开门。noun countable
That's some handle to go through life with!  一辈子取那样一个名字也够奇怪的！verb
Some people are brilliant with computers, but have no idea how to handle (= behave with) other people.  有些人在电脑方面很出色，却不会与人打交道。

words.meaning: n.  纵览,视察,测量,概观,调查,俯瞰vt.  审视,视察,俯瞰,通盘考虑vi.
words.example:
His new book is a survey of European theatre in the nineteenth century.  他的新书概括介绍了19世纪的欧洲戏剧。
The researchers surveyed the attitudes of 2500 college students.  研究人员调查了2500名大学生的看法。
Many of the listeners surveyed said that they were not satisfied with the station's programmes.  许多接受调查的听众都说，他们不满意这个电台的节目。verb

words.meaning: v.  (使)滚动，转动; n.  (一)卷，卷形物
words.example:
The vase rolled off the edge of the table and smashed.  花瓶从桌边滚落下来摔得粉碎。
The dog rolled over onto its back.  那只狗翻了个身四爪朝天躺着。
The piano's on wheels, so we can roll it into the room.  钢琴装有轮子，所以我们可以把它推进屋里来。

words.meaning: n.  屏,幕,银幕,屏风,筛子,屏蔽,掩蔽物vt.  掩蔽,放映,拍摄,甄别,筛,掩
words.example:
Our television has a 19-inch screen.  我们的电视萤幕是19吋的。
Coming to your screens (= cinemas) shortly, the amazing adventures of 'Robin Hood'.  请马上来电影院欣赏“罗宾汉”的神奇冒险吧。
Her ambition is to write for the screen (= for television and films).  她的理想是给电影、电视写剧本。

words.meaning: n.  居民,常驻程序,居住者,留鸟a.  居留的,定居的
words.example:
The local residents were angry at the lack of parking spaces.  当地居民对停车位短缺一事非常恼火。
The hotel bar was only open to residents (= to people staying at the hotel).  这家旅馆的酒吧只对其住客开放。noun countable
She's a first-year resident in oncology at Boston General Hospital.  她现在波士顿综合医院肿瘤科做高级专科住院实习医生，正处在第一年实习期。

words.meaning: vi.  躲藏; 掩藏; 掩盖; n.  兽皮
words.example:
She used to hide her diary under her pillow.  她过去常把自己的日记藏在枕头下。
He tries to hide his bald patch by sweeping his hair over to one side.  他试图把头发梳向一边来掩盖他头顶上的秃块。
She tried to hide her disappointment at not getting the promotion.  她试图掩饰自己对没有得到擢升的失望。

words.meaning: n.  潜在性,可能性,潜力,位,势,潜能a.  有潜力的,可能的,潜在的
words.example:
Many potential customers are waiting for a fall in prices before buying.  很多潜在的顾客都在等着降价再购买。
The accident is a grim reminder of the potential dangers involved in North Sea oil production.  该意外残酷地提醒人们生产北海石油可能会出现的危险。UK noun uncountable
The region has enormous potential for economic development.  该地区经济发展潜力无穷。

words.meaning: a.  独立的; 自立的; n.  无党派者
words.example:
They all made the same comment, quite independent of each other (= without deciding together to do so).  他们都不约而同作出了相同的评论。
Belize became fully independent from Britain in 1981.  贝里斯于1981年脱离英国完全独立。
Tibet, once an independent country, is now part of China.  西藏曾经是一个独立国家，现在却是中国的一部分。adjective

words.meaning: n.  合约,婚约,契约vt.  使缩短,感染,缔结,承包,订约vi.  订约,承包
words.example:
They could take legal action against you if you break (the terms of) the contract.  如果你违反合同（条款），他们可以起诉你。
My solicitor is drawing up (= writing) a contract.  我的律师正在起草一份合同。
Don't sign/enter into any contract before examining its conditions carefully.  没有仔细核查合同条款，不要签定任何合同。

words.meaning: n.  公寓住宅
words.example:
I'll give you the keys to my apartment.  我会把我公寓的锁匙给你。
They have six holiday/luxury apartments for sale.  他们有六套渡假／豪华公寓套房出售。
The Royal Apartments are open to the public.  皇室套间向公众开放。

words.meaning: a.  早先的,前面的,过急的ad.  早先,前面
words.example:
The previous owner of the house had built an extension on the back.  这栋房子以前的主人对房子后部进行了扩建。
Training is provided, so no previous experience is required for the job.  这项工作提供培训，因此不要求以前有相关经验。
He has two daughters from a previous marriage.  他在前次婚姻中育有两个女儿。

words.meaning: v.  传送，传递; 陈述
words.example:
Mail is delivered to our office twice a day.  邮差每天给我们办公室投递两次邮件。
The shop is delivering our new bed on Thursday.  该店将于周二把我们的新床送来。UK verb
The priest delivered a passionate sermon/speech against war.  牧师发表了一篇充满激情的反战布道词／演讲。

words.meaning: n.  交通工具，车辆
words.example:
Road vehicles include cars, buses and trucks.  道路交通工具包括汽车、公车和卡车。
Tractors are farm vehicles.  拖拉机是农用车辆。
The number of thefts of motor vehicles rose by a third last year.  去年机动车失窃案数量上升了三分之一。noun

words.meaning: vt.  观察,遵守,注意到,纪念vi.  注意,评论
words.example:
The role of scientists is to observe and describe the world, not to try to control it.  科学家的任务是观察和描述这个世界，而不是试图控制它。
Children learn by observing adults.  儿童透过观察成年人来学习。UK verb transitive
Jack observed a look of anxiety on his brother's face.  杰克注意到了他哥哥脸上焦急的神情。

words.meaning: n.  设备,容易,灵巧
words.example: His facility for languages is astonishing.  他的语言天赋惊人。

words.meaning: n.  平均,平均数,海损a.  一般的,通常的,平均的vt.  平均为,均分,使平
words.example:
The average of the three numbers 7, 12 and 20 is 13, because the total of 7, 12 and 20 is 39, and 39 divided by 3 is 13.  7、12和20这三个数的平均数是13，因为7、12和20的和是39，而39除以3是13。
Prices have risen by an average of 4% over the past year.  物价与去年相比平均上涨4%。
My income's rather variable, but I earn £73 a day on average.  我的收入很不稳定，但是平均每天赚73英镑。UK noun

words.meaning: vi.  浮现,形成,(由某种状态)脱出,(事实)显现出来
words.example:
She emerged from the sea, blue with cold.  她浮出了海面，浑身冻得发青。
The Prince emerged unscathed from the scandal.  王子安然走出了丑闻。UK verb intransitive
The facts behind the scandal are sure to emerge eventually.  丑闻背后的真相最终一定会水落石出。

words.meaning: vt.  猛击; 捣碎; n.  磅; 英镑
words.example:
There are one hundred pence in a pound.  1英镑等于100便士。
They stole jewellery valued at £50 000 (= 50 000 pounds).  他们偷了价值五万英镑的珠宝。
"Have you got any change?" "Sorry, I've only got a five-pound note.  “你有零钱吗？”“抱歉，我只有一张五英镑的纸钞。”

words.meaning: vt. vi.  操作,运转,动手术
words.example:
How do you operate the remote control unit?  你是怎么操作这个遥控器的？
Does the company operate a pension scheme?  这家公司实行退休金制度吗？
For several years she operated a dating agency from her basement flat.  有好几年她在她的半地下室公寓里经营一个婚姻介绍所。

words.meaning: n.  样品,标本vt.  抽取样品,尝试n.  示例,字样
words.example:
Please bring some samples of your work to the interview.  请带一些你的作品范本去面试。
As the food looked so good, he decided to sample a little from each dish.  这些食物看起来很诱人，于是他决定每样菜都尝一点。
So you're going to sample the delights/pleasures of the new restaurant?  那么你要去体验一下在那家新餐厅用餐的乐趣了？UK verb transitive

words.meaning: v.  贡献，捐赠; 有助于; 投稿
words.example:
Aren't you going to contribute towards Jack's leaving present?  你不打算凑一份钱给杰克买送别礼物吗？
Come to the meeting if you feel you have something to contribute.  要是你觉得有甚么要讲的就来开会吧。
Her family have contributed £50,000 to the fund.  她家给这项基金捐了五万英镑。

words.meaning: a.  很少的,微小的
words.example: a tiny flower  极小的花

words.meaning: n.  街区,木块,石块vt.  阻塞,封锁,使成块状n.  块
words.example:
The museum is just six blocks away.  博物馆离这儿只有六条街。
My friend and I live on the same block.  我和我的朋友住在同一个街区。
He lives just round the block.  他就住在前面刚拐过去弯的地方。UK noun

words.meaning: v.  收集; 聚集; adv. a.  (打电话)由对方付费(的)
words.example:
After the party I collected (up) twenty bottles from various parts of the house.  聚会后我从房屋各处一共收拾了20个瓶子。
We're collecting (money) for the homeless.  我们在为无家可归者筹款。
These china ornaments just collect dust.  这些瓷器摆在那里只会招灰尘。

words.meaning: a.  附加的，额外的
words.example: There will be an extra charge for any additional passengers.  如额外再上乘客，将会加收费用。

words.meaning: n.  身份; 特性
words.example:
The man's identity was being kept secret while he was helping police with enquiries.  这个男子在协助警方调查时，他的身分是保密的。
The informant was given a new identity (= a different name and new official documents) for protection.  给了线民一个新身分以作保护。
The newspaper photo apparently showed him in Rome but it was a case of mistaken identity (= it was the wrong person).  报纸上的照片似乎显示他在罗马，但其实那个人不是他。

words.meaning: ad.  大概,大部分,主要
words.example:
In the smaller villages, it's mostly (= usually) very quiet at nights.  在小村庄里，晚上通常很安静。
The band are mostly (= Most of them are) teenagers, I think.  我想这支乐队的成员大多数是十几岁的青少年。

words.meaning: vt.  促进，提升，宣传
words.example:
Advertising companies are always having to think up new ways to promote products.  广告公司总是得想出新办法来促销。
The Institute is intended to promote an understanding of the politics and culture of the Arab world.  该协会旨在促进人们对阿拉伯世界政治文化的了解。
Greenpeace works to promote awareness of the dangers that threaten our planet today.  绿色和平组织致力于促使人们更了解当前威胁地球的危机。

words.meaning: n.  技术; 技能，技巧
words.example:
We have developed a new technique for detecting errors in the manufacturing process.  我们开发了一项新技术，用于检测生产流程中的错误。
She's a wonderfully creative dancer but she doesn't have the technique of a truly great performer.  她是个很有创造力的舞蹈演员，但她缺乏一个真正伟大的舞蹈家的技巧。

words.meaning: n.  道路; 路线
words.example:
This is the path to the cliffs.  这条路通向悬崖。
It will be several days before snowploughs clear a path (through) to the village.  要过几天铲雪机才能清出一条通向该村的小路。
They followed the path until they came to a gate.  他们沿着这条路走到了一个大门口。

words.meaning: n.  原则; 原理
words.example:
The country is run on socialist principles.  这个国家推行社会主义制度。
The machine works according to the principle of electromagnetic conduction.  这台机器根据电磁传导原理运行。
The organization works on the principle that all members have the same rights.  该组织运作的原则是所有的成员都享有同等的权利。

words.meaning: vt.  生存,生还,幸免于vi.  活下来,幸存
words.example:
The baby was born with a heart problem and only survived for a few hours.  这个婴儿生下来就有心脏病，只活了几个小时。
These plants cannot survive in very cold conditions.  这些植物无法在非常寒冷的条件下生存。
None of Shakespeare's plays survives in its original manuscript form.  莎士比亚的戏剧手稿都没有保存下来。

words.meaning: n.  适宜,合身,发作,痉挛a.  适宜的,对的,准备好的vt.  适合,安装,使合
words.example:
That jacket fits you perfectly.  那件外套你穿着很合身。
The dress fits like a glove (= very well).  这件连衣裙非常合身。
Our new sofa doesn't fit through the door.  我们的新沙发通不过这道门。

words.meaning: n.  装备,设备品,才能
words.example: office/camping/kitchen equipment  办公设备／野营用具／厨房用具

words.meaning: n.  同伴,伙伴vt.  联合,联想vi.  交往n.  关联
words.example:
Most people associate this brand with good quality.  大多数人把这个品牌和优良品质联系在一起。verb transitive UK   Phrasal Verbs   associate sth with sth
The cancer risks associated with smoking have been well documented.  抽烟有引发癌症的危险，这两者的关联是有详尽的文献为证的。verb transitive UK   Phrasal Verbs   associate with sb

words.meaning: n.  评论家，批评家
words.example:
Her critics say she is leading the party to disaster.  批评她的人说她在把该党引向灾难。
He's his own worst critic (= He judges himself severely).  他对自己要求非常严格。
She's a film/theatre critic for the 'Irish Times'.  她是《爱尔兰时报》的一位电影／戏剧评论员。

words.meaning: n.  外观,方面,方向
words.example:
Which aspects of the job do you most enjoy?  你最喜欢这份工作的哪些方面？
His illness affects almost every aspect of his life.  他的疾病几乎影响到他生活的各方面。
That's the most worrying aspect of the situation.  这是局势最令人担心的一面。

words.meaning: vi. vt.  坚持,强调
words.example:
Please go first - I insist!  请先走——我坚持这样！
She insisted on seeing her lawyer.  她坚持要见她的律师。

words.meaning: a.  每年的; 一年一度的
words.example: Companies publish annual reports to inform the public about the previous year's activities.  公司发布年度报告，告知公众上一年的具体业务。noun countable

words.meaning: n. vi.  评论; 注释
words.example:
He made negative comments to the press.  他向报界作了些负面的评论。
She was asked about the pay increase but made no comment (= did not give an opinion).  有人问她关于加薪的事，但她拒绝评论。
My mum always comments on what I'm wearing.  我妈妈总是对我的衣着指指点点。

words.meaning: a.  有责任的,负责的,责任重大的,可靠的
words.example:
Paul is directly responsible for the efficient running of the office.  保罗直接负责办事处的高效运作。
Her department is responsible for overseeing the councils.  她的部门负责监督各市政会的工作。
In Australia, the Prime Minister and the Cabinet are responsible to the House of Representatives.  在澳大利亚，总理和内阁对众议院负责。

words.meaning: n.  程序，手续，步骤
words.example:
The company has new procedures for dealing with complaints.  公司采取了新的处理投诉事宜的程式。
You must follow correct procedure at all times.  你必须随时按照正确的步骤操作。UK noun
It's a routine/standard surgical procedure.  这是一个普通的外科手术。UK noun

words.meaning: a.  有规律的; 正常的; 经常的
words.example: Regular meals keep you energetic.  规律饮食让你有精神。

words.meaning: v. n.  展开; 蔓延; 散布
words.example:
The fire spread very rapidly because of the strong wind.  风很大，火势迅速蔓延开来。
It started off as cancer of the liver but it spread to other areas of the body.  开始的时候是肝癌，后来扩散到了身体的其他部位。
The redundancies are spread across the clothing, banking and building industries.  裁员风气席卷了服装业、银行业和建筑业。

words.meaning: a.  柔软的; 柔和的; 不含酒精的
words.example:
Soft tissue , such as flesh, allows X-rays through.  X光能穿透肌肉等软组织。
Look at you! You need more exercise. You're going/getting soft.  看看你！你需要多加锻炼，你的身体越来越虚弱了。UK adjective
She thinks I'm too soft on the kids when they misbehave.  她认为孩子们不守规矩的时候我的态度过于软弱。

words.meaning: vt.  不理睬,忽视,驳回v.  忽略
words.example:
She can be really irritating but I try to ignore her.  她有时会特别烦人，不过我尽量不去理会她。
Safety regulations are being ignored by company managers in the drive to increase profits.  为了增加利润，公司经理都对安全章程熟视无睹。
How can the government ignore the wishes of the majority?  政府怎么能不顾大多数人的意愿呢？

words.meaning: vt.  示范,证明vi.  示威
words.example:
These figures clearly demonstrate the size of the economic problem facing the country.  这些数字清楚表明了该国经济问题的严重程度。
These problems demonstrate the importance of strategic planning.  这些问题显示出了战略规划的重要性。
He's got a job demonstrating kitchen equipment in a department store.  他找到一份在百货店示范厨房设备的工作。

words.meaning: n.  宗教,信仰
words.example:
Football is a religion for these people.  这些人对足球入了迷。noun
He suddenly got religion when he went to college.  他念大学时，突然变得很虔诚。    US

words.meaning: v.  审查; 复习; n.  复习; 评论
words.example:
The committee is reviewing the current arrangement/situation.  委员会正在审查目前的安排／研究当前的形势。
Let's review (= talk about) what has happened so far.  我们谈谈到目前为止发生的事情吧。
He reviewed (= thought about) his options before making a final decision.  他在最后作出决定之前，对各种选择进行了斟酌权衡。verb transitive

words.meaning: vt.  恐吓,威胁,预示. . . 的凶兆vi.  威胁,恫吓,可能来临
words.example:
They threatened the shopkeeper with a gun.  他们用枪威胁店主。
Changing patterns of agriculture are threatening the countryside.  农业模式的不断变化可能会对农村造成破坏。
Look at those clouds! There's a storm threatening.  看那些云！暴风雨要来了。

words.meaning: vt.  承诺; 负责; 犯(错)
words.example:
He was sent to prison for a crime that he didn't commit.  他蒙冤入狱。
The government must commit itself to improving health care.  政府必须致力改善医疗保健服务。
Once we have committed to this course of action there is no going back.  一旦我们承诺采取这个行动，就没有回头路。

words.meaning: n.  女性; a.  女(性)的; 母的，雌性的
words.example:
She was voted the best female vocalist.  她当选最佳女歌手。
Female lions do not have manes.  母狮没有鬃毛。
