The kitten was actually a female, not a male.  这只小猫的确是母的，不是公的。

words.meaning: n.  四分之一,一刻钟,季度,地区vt.  四等分,四肢分解vi.  驻扎,住宿
words.example:
He cut the orange into quarters.  他把橘子切成了4块。
Under a quarter of people questioned said that they were happily married.  不到1/4的受访者表示他们的婚姻很幸福。
My house is situated a mile and three-quarters from here.  我的房子距离这里1.75英里。

words.meaning: vt. vi.  否认,拒绝
words.example:
He will not confirm or deny the allegations.  他既不肯定也不否认那些说法。
There's no denying that this has been a difficult year for the company.  今年对该公司而言，是非常困难的一年，这一点毋庸置疑。verb transitive
Her request for time off work was denied.  她的休假请求未获得批准。

words.meaning: n.  远景,看法,透视a.  透视的n.  透视
words.example:
Her attitude lends a fresh perspective to the subject.  她的态度为这个问题提供了新的视角。
He writes from a Marxist perspective.  他从一个马克思主义者的角度写作。
Because of its geographical position, Germany's perspective on the situation in Eastern Europe is rather different from Britain's.  由于地理位置不同，德国对东欧局势的看法与英国大相迳庭。

words.meaning: n.  智力,情报,神
words.example:
It's the intelligence of her writing that impresses me.  是她作品中表现出的智慧让我印象深刻。noun
They received intelligence (reports) that the factory was a target for the bombing.  他们接到情报说这家工厂是轰炸目标。

words.meaning: n.  上下文; 背景; 环境
words.example:
It is important to see all the fighting and bloodshed in his plays in historical context.  结合历史背景解读他戏剧作品中所有的争斗和流血事件，这点很重要。
This small battle is very important in the context of Scottish history.  这场小战役在苏格兰历史上非常重要。UK noun countable
In this exercise, a word is blanked out and you have to guess what it is by looking at the context.  在这个练习中，有一个单词被抽去了，你必须根据上下文猜测这个单词是甚么。

words.meaning: n.  委员会
words.example:
She sits on/is on the school's development committee.  她是学校发展委员会的成员。
The local council have just set up a committee to study recycling.  当地市政会刚刚成立了一个研究资源再利用问题的委员会。

words.meaning: a.  知道的; 意识到的
words.example:
Were you aware of the risks at the time?  你当时意识到危险了吗？
She was well (= very) aware that he was married.  她很清楚他已结了婚。

words.meaning: n.  机能; 功能; 作用
words.example:
The function of the veins is to carry blood to the heart.  静脉的功能是将血液输送回心脏。
I'm not quite sure what my function is within the company.  我拿不太准自己在公司里有甚么职责。
As a mayor, he has a lot of official functions to attend.  作为市长，他要参加很多官方活动。

words.meaning: a.  活跃的,积极的,有效的,主动的,现役的,现行的,活性的a.  活动的
words.example:
You've got to try to keep active as you grow older.  年纪大了，应该尽量保持身心活跃。
Enemy forces remain active in the mountainous areas around the city.  敌军在城市周围的山区仍活动猖獗。
She's very active in (= involved in) local politics.  她积极参与当地的政治活动。

words.meaning: v.  延长，延伸
words.example:
The Sahara Desert extends (= reaches) for miles.  撒哈拉沙漠延绵几百英里。
The path extends (= continues) beyond the end of the road.  这条小路一直通到大路尽头很远的地方。
Rain is expected to extend to (= reach) all parts of the country by this evening.  预计今天傍晚之前的降雨范围会扩大到全国各个地区。

words.meaning: n.  首领; a.  主要的; 总的
words.example:
The chief problem we have in the area now is the spread of disease.  目前我们在这个地区面临的首要问题是疾病的蔓延。
The weather was our chief reason for coming here.  天气是我们来这里的主要原因。adjective [before noun]
[as form of address] UK humorous Can you sign this form for me, chief?  长官，您能给我在这张表上签字吗？noun countable

words.meaning: v.  (使)联合，(使)结合
words.example:
None of us has much money so let's combine what we've got.  我们谁都没多少钱，因此就把我们所有的钱凑在一起吧。
Sickness, combined with (= together with) terrible weather, contrived to ruin the trip.  疾病，加上恶劣的天气，毁掉了这次旅行。
The two countries combined against their common enemy.  两国联合起来对抗共同的敌人。

words.meaning: a.  危险的
words.example: The intersection is dangerous in winter.  这个路口冬天很危险。

words.meaning: vt.  提醒,使想起
words.example:
Could you remind Paul about dinner on Saturday?  你能否提醒一下保罗周六晚宴的事？
Your hair and eyes remind me of your mother.  看到你的头发和眼睛就使我想起了你妈妈。verb transitive

words.meaning: a.  道德的; 精神的; n. [常pl.  ]道德
words.example:
It's her moral obligation to tell the police what she knows.  她把所知道的事告诉警方是道义上的责任。
It is not part of a novelist's job to make a moral judgment.  小说家并不需要作道德上的批判。
She was the only politician to condemn the proposed law on moral grounds (= for moral reasons).  她是唯一一个从道德角度，对提议施行的法律作出谴责的政治家。

words.meaning: n.  种类; 范畴
words.example: There are three categories of accommodation - standard, executive and deluxe.  有三种住宿标准——标准房、商务房和豪华房。

words.meaning: ad.  相对地; 相当地
words.example:
He's a relatively good squash player.  他是个比较不错的壁球运动员。
There was relatively little violence.  暴力事件相对较少。
Relatively speaking, it's a fairly poor country.  相对而言，这是个很贫穷的国家。

words.meaning: a.  学院的,理论的,不够实际的
words.example: academic subjects/qualifications/books  学科／学历／学术书籍

words.meaning: a.  否定的; 消极的; 负的; n.  底片
words.example:
We received a negative answer to our request.  我们的请求遭到拒绝。    Opposite affirmative
'I've never seen him in my life' is a negative sentence.  “我一生从未见过他”是句否定句。
'Don't' and 'do not' are negative forms of 'do'.  don't 和 do not 是 do 的否定形式。UK adjective

words.meaning: v.  (on)依靠，依赖; 取决于
words.example:
Whether or not we go to Spain for our holiday depends on the cost.  我们去不去西班牙渡假取决于需要花上多少钱。
You can always depend on Michael in a crisis.  遇到危机的时候你总是可以相信麦克。
humorous You can depend on Jane to be late (= she is always late).  简总是迟到。

words.meaning: n.  抓握,掠夺,强占,挖掘机vi.  抓取,抢去vt.  攫取,霸占
words.example:
He grabbed (hold of) his child's arm to stop her from running into the road.  他抓住孩子的手臂防止她跑到路中间去。verb (-bb-)
If you don't grab this opportunity, you might not get another one.  如果你不抓住这次机会，可能就没有第二次了。
We'd better get there early, or someone else will grab the best seats.  我们最好早些赶到那里，否则好座位就给别人占了。

words.meaning: a.  直接的,坦白的vt.  指示,指挥,命令,导演vi.  指导,指挥ad.  直接地
words.example:
Is there a direct train to Edinburgh?  有到爱丁堡的直达列车吗？
She decided to take direct control of the project.  她决定直接管理这个企划案。
He denied that he had any direct involvement in the deal.  他否认自己与这笔交易有任何直接关系。

words.meaning: n.  法官; 公正; 司法
words.example:
There's no justice in the world when people can be made to suffer like that.  如果人们被迫遭受这样的痛苦，那么世上就没有公平正义可言了。
The winner has been disqualified for cheating, so justice has been done (= a fair situation has been achieved).  获胜者因舞弊而被取消了资格，正义得以伸张。    Opposite injusticenoun
the justice system in this country consists of a series of law courts at different levels.  这个国家的司法体系由各级法庭组成。

words.meaning: v.  (in)参与，参加
words.example: She never participates in any of our discussions, does she?  她从不参加我们的任何讨论，不是吗？UK verb intransitive

words.meaning: a.  公平的，合理的; n.  展览会; 集市
words.example:
Why should I have to do all the cleaning? It's not fair!  为甚么我要做所有的打扫工作？这不公平！
It's not fair on Joe (= It is not right) to make him do all the work!  所有的工作都由乔做，这对他不公平！
It's not fair that she's allowed to go and I'm not!  允许她去，却不许我去，这不公平！

words.meaning: a.  适当的
words.example:
Is this film appropriate for small children?  这部电影适合幼童观看吗？
Is this an appropriate occasion to discuss finance?  这个场合适合讨论财政问题吗？
Please complete the appropriate parts of this form (= the parts that are right or necessary for your particular situation) and return it as soon as possible.  请正确填写表中相应部分并尽快交回。    Opposite inappropriateverb transitive UK US     formal

words.meaning: n.  民主政治,民主主义
words.example:
The government has promised to uphold the principles of democracy.  政府承诺将坚守民主原则。
The early 1990s saw the spread of democracy in Eastern Europe.  20世纪90年代初，民主思想在东欧迅速传播。
Few of the Western democracies still have a royal family.  西方民主国家鲜有仍然保留皇室者。

words.meaning: n.  最主要者,原色a.  主要的,初期的,根本的,基本的,首要的,原始的
words.example:
The Red Cross's primary concern is to preserve and protect human life.  红十字会最关心的是维护人的生命安全。
The primary responsibility lies with those who break the law.  主要的责任在于那些违法者。UK adjective

words.meaning: n.  装置,设计,策略,发明物n.  设备
words.example: Rescuers used a special device for finding people trapped in collapsed buildings.  救援者使用特殊器械来寻找被困在倒塌建筑物下面的人。noun countable

words.meaning: n.  进步,发展,前进vi.  促进,进步,进行
words.example:
Technological progress has been so rapid over the last few years.  在最近几年中，科技进步如此迅猛。
I'm not making much progress with my Spanish.  我的西班牙语没多大进步。
The doctor said that she was making good progress (= getting better after a medical operation or illness).  医生说她的情况正在好转。

words.meaning: n.  交换,汇兑,交易所vt. vi.  交换,交易,兑换
words.example:
They were given food and shelter in exchange for work.  他们帮人工作以换取食宿。
She proposes an exchange of contracts at two o'clock.  她提议两点钟办理房屋产权过户手续。
Several people were killed during the exchange of gunfire.  交火中有几个人丧生。

words.meaning: a.  干净的,清白的,巧妙的ad.  清洁地,完全地vt.  清理,使干净,出空vi.
words.example:
Make sure your hands are clean before you have your dinner.  饭前一定要把手洗干净。
Hospitals need to be kept spotlessly (= extremely) clean.  医院必须保持一尘不染，干干净净。adjective
The judge took the defendant's clean record (= the absence of previous involvement in crime) into account when passing sentence.  法官在宣判时考虑到被告没有前科。

words.meaning: n.  工作室，录音室
words.example: The photographer works from a small studio.  摄影师在小工作室工作。

words.meaning: n.  应用,申请,志愿书n.  应用程序
words.example:
Free information will be sent out on application to (= if you ask) the central office.  请来函至总部索取免费资料。
I've sent off applications for four different jobs.  我投寄申请四份不同工作的求职信。
Have you filled in the application form for your passport yet?  你填写护照申请表了吗？

words.meaning: n.  盘子; 版图
words.example:
There's still lots of food on your plate.  你的盘子里还有很多食物。
Stephen ate three plates of spaghetti.  史蒂芬吃了三盘义大利面条。noun
Thick bony plates protected the dinosaur against attack.  厚厚的骨质鳞甲帮助恐龙抵御攻击。

words.meaning: a.  男(雄)的; n.  男子; 雄性动物
words.example:
What percentage of the adult male population is unemployed?  成年男性中的失业比例是多少？
The male parts of the flower are the stamens and the anthers.  花的雄性部分是雄蕊和花药。
The male of the species is less aggressive.  这个物种的雄性攻击性较弱。

words.meaning: n.  滥用,恶习,辱骂vt.  滥用,辱骂,虐待
words.example:
She is continually abusing her position/authority by getting other people to do things for her.  她不断滥用职权／权力让别人替她做事。
Several of the children had been sexually/physically/emotionally abused.  几个儿童受到了性虐待／肉体折磨／精神上的伤害。verb transitive /əˈbjuːz/
The crowd started abusing him after he failed to save a goal.  他没有守住球门，丢了一分，观众开始对他破口大骂。noun]əˈbjuːs/

words.meaning: n.  期间,开庭期,会议,学期
words.example:
The parliamentary session is due to end on May 27th.  议会会议将于5月27日结束。
The UN Security Council met in emergency session to discuss the crisis.  联合国安理会举行了紧急会议讨论该危机。noun
The 21-year-old runner twisted his ankle in a training session last Friday.  这位21岁的跑者上周五在训练时扭伤了脚踝。

words.meaning: a.  家庭的,国内的,驯服的
words.example: Domestic opinion had turned against the war.  国内舆论已转而反对战争。adjective

words.meaning: n.  文学; 文学作品; 文献
words.example:
'Wuthering Heights' is a classic of English literature.  《咆哮山庄》是一部经典的英国文学作品。UK noun uncountable
It's important to keep up-to-date with the literature in your field.  跟踪阅读最新的专业文献非常重要。
There is very little literature on the disease.  关于这种疾病的文献资料很少。UK noun uncountable

words.meaning: n.  欲望,要求vt.  想要,请求vi.  愿望
words.example:
There is a strong desire for peace among the people.  人民极盼和平。
He needed to satisfy his desire for revenge.  他需要满足自己复仇的愿望。
Several people have expressed a desire to see the report.  有几个人表示想要看看这份报告。UK noun

words.meaning: v.  尊重; n.  尊重; 方面
words.example:
She is a formidable figure who commands a great deal of respect (= who is greatly admired by others).  她是个令人敬畏的人，赢得了大家的无限敬重。
New teachers have to earn/gain the respect of their students.  新教师必须要赢得学生的尊重。
You really should treat your parents with more respect.  你待你父母真应该多几分尊重。

words.meaning: n.  点头,打盹,摆动vi.  点头,打盹,vt.  点头表示,点(头)
words.example:
Many people in the audience nodded in agreement.  许多听众点头表示赞同。
When I suggested a walk, Elena nodded enthusiastically.  当我提议去散步时，埃琳娜使劲地点头。
She looked up and nodded for me to come in.  她抬起头，点头示意要我进来。    Compare shakeUK US  (-dd-)

words.meaning: n.  教导; [常pl.  ]用法说明; 指示
words.example:
The police who broke into the house were only acting on/under instructions.  员警破门而入只是奉命行事。
The cooking instructions say bake it for half an hour.  烹调说明书上说烘烤半个小时。
You obviously didn't read the instructions properly.  你显然没有好好看说明书。

words.meaning: n.  引擎，发动机
words.example: My car's been having engine trouble recently.  我的汽车引擎最近老出问题。

words.meaning: vt.  使膨胀,详述,扩张vi.  张开,发展v.  展开
words.example:
The air in the balloon expands when heated.  气球里的空气受热后膨胀。
They expanded their retail operations during the 1980s.  20世纪80年代他们扩大了零售业务。verb intransitive or transitive
She mentioned a few ideas, but she didn't expand on them.  她提到了几个想法，但并没有进行详细说明。

words.meaning: a.  共同的; 公司的
words.example: All adults take corporate responsibility for the upbringing of the tribe's children.  部落里所有成年人集体承担抚养孩子的责任。

words.meaning: a.  都市的,住在都市的,习惯于都市的
words.example: urban development  城市发展

words.meaning: a.  精神的; 智力的
words.example:
His physical and mental health had got worse.  他的身心健康进一步恶化。
Many people suffer from some form of mental illness during their lives.  许多人一生中都会患上某种精神疾病。
She had a mental picture (= a picture in her mind) of how the house would look when they finished decorating it.  她脑海中已经有房子装修好以后的样子。    Compare physical    UK slang

words.meaning: n.  行星
words.example:
Might there be intelligent life on other planets?  其他星球上有可能存在智慧生物吗？noun countable
Some days that girl seems as if she's on another planet.  那个女孩有时候看来很怪异。

words.meaning: vt. vi.  探险,探测,探究
words.example:
The best way to explore the countryside is on foot.  在农村考察，步行是最好的方法了。
The children have gone exploring in the woods.  孩子们去树林里观察大自然了。
Let's explore this issue/idea more fully.  让我们进一步探讨一下这个问题／计划。

words.meaning: vt.  获得,达到vi.  流行
words.example:
First editions of these books are now almost impossible to obtain.  这些书的第一版现在已几乎弄不到了。
In the second experiment they obtained a very clear result.  第二次试验他们获得了明确的结果。
Sugar is obtained by crushing and processing sugar cane.  蔗糖是透过对甘蔗进行压榨和加工获得的。 formal

words.meaning: n.  合成物,情结,复杂a.  复杂的,合成的
words.example:
The company has a complex organizational structure.  公司组织结构非常复杂。
It's a very complex issue to which there is no straightforward answer.  这个问题错综复杂，没有简单直接的答案。
The film's plot was so complex that I couldn't follow it.  这部电影的情节太复杂，我看不懂。noun countable UK BUILDING  建筑物

words.meaning: n.  运动员,运动选手
words.example:
He became a professional athlete at the age of 16.  16岁时他成了一名职业运动员。
She has the build of an athlete.  她有一副运动员的体格。

words.meaning: n.  面板，镶板; vt.  镶嵌
words.example:
The competition will be judged by a panel of experts.  这次竞赛将由一个专家小组评审。noun
White silk panels were inset into the sides of the dress.  衣边镶有白绸布。
At the bottom of each page is a panel with grammatical information.  每页底部都有文法知识栏。noun

words.meaning: n.  工具,手段,仪器
words.example:
Which instrument do you play ?  你演奏哪一种乐器？noun countable
The man's injuries had obviously been caused by a blunt instrument.  这人的伤口显然是由钝器所致。
The lightning had damaged the plane's instruments, and they weren't giving any readings.  闪电击毁了飞机的仪表，上面甚么资料都显示不出来。

words.meaning: v.  预言，预测
words.example: It's still not possible to accurately predict the occurrence of earthquakes.  现在仍无法准确预报地震的发生。

words.meaning: n.  天气,气候,气象,处境a.  迎风的vt.  使受风吹雨打,侵蚀,使风化,经
words.example:
The weather in the hills can change very quickly, so take suitable clothing.  山里的天气瞬息万变，所以要带上合适的衣服。
We're going to have a picnic, weather permitting (= if the weather is good enough).  如果天气好的话，我们打算去野餐。UK noun uncountable
I'm feeling a bit under the weather - I think I've caught a cold.  我觉得有点不舒服——可能是感冒了。UK noun uncountable

words.meaning: a.  感情(上)的，情绪(上)的
words.example:
My doctor said the problem was more emotional than physical.  我的医生说问题主要出在情感方面而不是身体机能上。
Amnesia can be caused by emotional trauma.  情感创伤可以使人罹患健忘症。
He's a very emotional man.  他是个感情易冲动的人。

words.meaning: n.  承诺; 支持; 允许; 致力，献身
words.example:
She is known chiefly for her commitment to nuclear disarmament.  她主要以全力支持核裁军运动而闻名。
I'd like to thank the staff for having shown such commitment.  我要对全体员工作出的巨大奉献表示感谢。
Try the product out in the comfort of your own home with absolutely no commitment to buy!  可在家随意试用本产品且根本无须购买！

words.meaning: n.  至高,霸权a.  至高的,终极的,极端的,最大的
words.example:
The present constitution gives supreme authority to the presidency.  现行宪法赋予总统至高无上的权力。
From 1960 to 1970, Ayatollah Mohsen al-Hakim reigned supreme among the Shi'ites of Iraq, Iran and elsewhere.  自1960年至1970年，阿亚图拉‧穆赫辛‧哈基姆是伊拉克、伊朗及其他地方什叶派的最高领袖。adjective
She was awarded a medal for showing supreme bravery.  她因为表现非常英勇而获得一枚奖章。

words.meaning: n.  熊vt.  忍受,负荷,使跌价,怀有,产生vi.  忍受,结果实,转向,开动,压
words.example:
The strain must have been enormous but she bore it well.  当时压力一定很大，但她承受得了。
Tell me now! I can't bear the suspense !  现在告诉我吧！ 我等不及了！
It's your decision - you must bear the responsibility if things go wrong.  是你作出的决定——如果出了差错，你必须承担责任。

words.meaning: n.  温度,发烧,热度
words.example:
Preheat the oven to a temperature of 200 degrees Celsius.  把炉子预热到摄氏200度。
There has been a sudden rise in temperature over the past few days (= The weather has become warmer).  最近几天气温突然上升了。
The doctor examined him and took his temperature (= measured it).  医生给他做检查，并量了他的体温。

words.meaning: n.  提议,计划,求婚
words.example:
Congress has rejected the latest economic proposal put forward by the president.  议会否决了总统最近提出的经济计划。
Have you read Steve's proposals for the new project?  你看了史蒂夫对新专案的建议了吗？

words.meaning: n.  结果; 影响; 推理
words.example:
Not making a will can have serious consequences for the people you might wish to benefit.  不立遗嘱可能会给你所希望受益的人带来严重后果。
Scientists think it unlikely that any species will actually become extinct as a consequence of the oil spill.  科学家们认为实际上不太可能会有甚么物种因为石油泄漏而灭绝。
Well, if you insist on eating so much, you'll have to suffer/take (= accept and deal with) the consequences!  好吧，要是你坚持吃这么多，你会自食其果的！

words.meaning: n.  平衡,差额vi.  平衡,相等vt.  称,权衡,比较,抵消,结算
words.example:
The toddler wobbled and lost his balance (= started to fall sideways).  那个刚学走路的小孩摇摇晃晃的，走了几步就失去平衡。
She had to hold onto the railings to keep her balance (= to stop herself from falling).  她必须扶着围栏才能保持平衡。
New tax measures are designed to redress the balance (= make the situation more equal) between rich and poor.  新的税收措施旨在透过重新分配，使贫富差距趋于合理。

words.meaning: vt.  采用,收养,接受
words.example:
They've adopted a baby girl.  他们领养了一个女婴。
She had the child adopted (= She gave her baby to someone else to look after).  她把自己的孩子送给别人抚养。
They have no children of their own, but they're hoping to adopt.  他们没有亲生子女，但是他们希望能领养。    Compare fosterUK verb

words.meaning: n.  少数,未成年,少数民族a.  少数的,属于少数派的
words.example:
It's only a tiny minority of people who are causing the problem.  惹麻烦的只是极少数的人。
Children with single parents at my school were very much in the minority (= there were very few).  在我的学校里单亲孩子只占极少数。
This section of the bookstore caters for minority interests (= subjects that interest only a few people).  书店的这个专柜主要满足少数读者的兴趣。    Opposite majorityUK noun

words.meaning: n.  忠告,通知
words.example:
Steven gave me some good advice.  斯蒂芬给了我一些好建议。
Can I give you a piece of advice?  你想听听我的建议吗？
We went to Paris on Sarah's advice.  我们听从萨拉的建议去了巴黎。noun uncountable

words.meaning: n.  空的东西,空物a.  空的,空虚的,空腹的,空洞的vt.  倒空,使变空,使
words.example:
Shall I take the empty bottles for recycling?  我把这些空瓶子拿去回收吧？
The train was empty (= There were no passengers) by the time it reached London.  火车到达伦敦的时候，车内已经没有乘客了。adjective
They're just empty promises.  这些承诺只不过是些空头支票。adjective

words.meaning: n.  小说; a.  新颖的
words.example:
Have you read any of Jane Austen's novels?  你读过简．奥斯汀的小说吗？
His latest novel is selling really well.  他的最新小说非常畅销。UK adjective
Keeping a sheep in the garden is a novel way of keeping the grass short!  在花园里养只羊来阻止草长高，这办法可真新奇！

words.meaning: n.  密码，代码; 法规; v.  把…编码
words.example:
The message was written in code.  电报是用密码写的。
She managed to decipher/break/crack (= succeed in understanding) the code.  她成功地破译了密码。
Each entry in this dictionary has a grammar code.  这本词典的每个词条都有一个文法标记。UK noun

words.meaning: vt.  承认,答谢,认知
words.example:
You must acknowledge the truth of her argument.  你必须承认，她的论点是事实。
Historians generally acknowledge her as a genius in her field.  历史学家公认她在该领域中是天才。
They refused to acknowledge (= to recognize officially) the new government.  他们拒绝承认新政府。

words.meaning: a.  主要的; 最初的; 最好的
words.example:
This is a prime example of 1930s architecture.  这是20世纪30年代建筑风格的一个重要范例。
The president is a prime (= likely) target for the assassin's bullet.  总统是这名刺客的主要目标。
The hotel is in a prime location in the city centre.  该旅馆位于市中心的黄金地段。noun only singular

words.meaning: vt.  结束,作结论,推断vi.  结束,断定
words.example:
She concluded the speech by reminding us of our responsibility.  她在演讲结束时提醒我们所承担的责任。
Before I conclude, I'd like to thank you all for coming.  在结束发言前，我想感谢诸位的光临。
The concert concluded with a rousing chorus.  音乐会以激动人心的大合唱结束。

words.meaning: v. n.  转移; 改变
words.example:
She shifted (her weight) uneasily from one foot to the other.  她不安地把身体的重心由一只脚转移到另一只脚。
The wind is expected to shift (to the east) tomorrow.  预计风明天转向（为东风）。
Media attention has shifted recently onto environmental issues.  媒体关注的焦点最近转到了环保问题。

words.meaning: n.  收入,岁入,税务局,税收,岁入细目
words.example:
Taxes provide most of the government's revenue.  政府岁入的大部分来自税收。
Government revenues fell dramatically.  政府财政收入大幅下降。

words.meaning: vt.  找出,设于,位于vi.  定居
words.example:
Our office is located in the city centre.  我们的办事处位于市中心。UK verb
Police are still trying to locate the suspect.  员警仍在努力寻找嫌疑人。UK verb
The company hopes to locate in its new offices by June.  该公司希望在六月前搬进新的办公楼。

words.meaning: vt.  推荐,介绍,托付,使受欢迎,劝告
words.example:
She has been recommended for promotion.  已经有人推荐给她升职。
The headmistress agreed to recommend the teachers' proposals to the school governors.  女校长同意把这位老师的建议提请学校董事们考虑。
The city has much/little to recommend it (= It has a lot of/few pleasant qualities).  这个城市可圈可点的地方很多／几乎没有。verb transitive

words.meaning: a.  明显的,明白的,显然的
words.example:
They have a small child so for obvious reasons they need money.  他们有个年幼的孩子，所以显然很需要钱。
Am I stating the obvious (= saying what everyone already knows) ?  我说的大家早就知道了吗？
There is no obvious solution.  还没有合情合理的解决办法。

words.meaning: vt.  产生,发生,导致
words.example:
Her latest film has generated a lot of interest/excitement.  她最近的一部影片引起了广泛的兴趣／使众多观众很是兴奋。
The new development will generate 1500 new jobs.  新开发项目将会创造1500个新的就业岗位。
These measures will increase the club's ability to generate revenue/income.  这些措施将会提升俱乐部的创收能力。UK verb transitive

words.meaning: vt.  计划,打算,求(婚),向. . . 提议,建议vi.  打算,求婚
words.example:
She proposed a boycott of the meeting.  她建议抵制这次会议。
He proposed a motion that the chairman resign.  他提出动议请主席辞职。
To be nominated for union president you need one person to propose you and another to second you.  要被提名为工会主席，你需要有一个推荐人和一个附议人。

words.meaning: n.  趋势,倾向,方位vi.  倾向,转向n.  趋势
words.example:
Surveys show a trend away from home-ownership and towards rented accommodation.  调查显示，出现了一种从私人拥有住房转向租赁住房的趋势。
There's been a downward/upward trend in sales in the last few years.  过去几年，销售额一直呈下降／上升趋势。
Whatever the latest fashion trend, you can be sure Nicki will be wearing it.  不管是甚么样的流行款式，尼基肯定会穿。

words.meaning: n.  贷款,借出,债权人vt. vi.  借,供应货款,借给
words.example:
She's trying to get a $50 000 loan to start her own business.  为了开办自己的公司，她正在争取一笔五万美元的贷款。
We could apply for/take out a loan to buy a car.  我们可以申请贷款去买汽车。UK noun
Thank you very much for the loan of your bike.  谢谢你把脚踏车借给我。

words.meaning: n.  全体人员,群众,全体机员
words.example:
The aircraft has/carries a crew of seven.  这架飞机上有七名机组人员。
Apart from the 10 officers, a crew of 90 looks after the 300 passengers.  除了这10位高级船员，还有90名船员为300名乘客服务。verb intransitive or transitive

words.meaning: n.  肌肉; 体力，力量
words.example:
He flexed his muscles (= tightened, especially his arm muscles, to make them look large and strong) so that everyone could admire them.  他将肌肉紧绷起来，这样大家就能欣赏到他的肌肉块。
These exercises build muscle and increase stamina.  这些运动能强健肌肉、增强体力。
Russell pulled a back muscle early in the game.  比赛开始没多久拉塞尔就拉伤了背部肌肉。noun

words.meaning: n.  概念，观念; 想法
words.example: He clung to the notion that luck matters.  他坚持运气很重要的看法。

words.meaning: a.  独一无二的,独特的,蟍钡?
words.example:
Each person's genetic code is unique except in the case of identical twins.  每个人的遗传密码都是独一无二的，同卵双胞胎除外。
I'd recognise your handwriting anywhere - it's unique.  无论在哪里，我都能认出你的笔迹——它太与众不同了。
Do not miss this unique opportunity to buy all six pans at half the recommended price.  购买全部六个平底锅只需半价——不要错过这难得的机会。

words.meaning: a.  内在的,国内的
words.example:
He sustained injuries to his arms, legs and several internal organs.  他的手臂、腿部和一些内脏都受了伤。
The bank conducted its own internal investigation into the robbery.  银行针对抢劫案进行了内部调查。
The government warned its neighbours not to interfere in its internal affairs.  该国政府警告邻国不要干涉其内政。

words.meaning: adj.  1 民族 [人种] 的2 民族特有的 (C) 少数民族的成员
words.example:
The factory's workforce reflects the ethnic mix from which it draws its labour.  这个工厂的员工组成反映了劳动力来源的种族杂居状况。
Conflicts between the different ethnic groups in the country exploded into civil war.  该国不同族群之间的冲突激化，引发了内战。

words.meaning: n.  压力; 强调; v.  强调
words.example:
People under a lot of stress may experience headaches, minor pains and sleeping difficulties.  压力大的人可能会出现头痛、轻微疼痛和睡眠障碍。
Yoga is a very effective technique for combating stress.  练瑜伽是舒缓压力非常有效的方法。
The meaning of a sentence often depends on stress and intonation.  句子的意思常常取决于重音和语调。

words.meaning: n.  内容,满足,意义,要旨a.  满足的,满意的,意义的vt.  使. . . 满足,
words.example:
He seems fairly content with (his) life.  他好像对生活相当满足。
Not content with having upset my parents, he then insulted my sister!  他惹得我父母生气还不够，又欺辱我姐姐！noun UK SUBJECT  主题
It's a very stylish and beautiful film, but it lacks content.  这出电影很新潮而且画面美丽，但内容空洞。

words.meaning: v.  表明; 宣称
words.example:
America declared war on Japan in 1941 (= announced officially that it was at war).  美国在1941对日本宣战。
figurative The government have declared war on (= publicly announced their opposition to) the drug dealers.  政府已对贩毒者宣战。
The country declared independence in 1952 (= announced that it was no longer under the control of another country).  该国于1952年宣布独立。

words.meaning: vt.  赏识,鉴赏,感激,欣赏vi.  增值,涨价
words.example:
There's no point buying him expensive wines - he doesn't appreciate them.  给他买名贵的酒没有用——他不懂品酒。
We appreciate the need for immediate action.  我们充分意识到了马上采取行动的必要性。
We really appreciate all the help you gave us last weekend.  上周末得到你们的大力帮助，我们非常感谢。

words.meaning: a.  真实的,实际的
words.example:
We had estimated about 300 visitors, but the actual number was much higher.  我们估计大约会有300名来宾，可实际人数要多得多。
The exams are in July, but the actual results (= the results themselves) don't appear until September.  考试是在七月份，但是真正成绩要到九月份才公布。

words.meaning: ad.  刚刚,几乎不,勉强是
words.example:
The party had hardly started when she left.  她离开的时候派对才刚刚开始。
He hardly ate anything/He ate hardly anything.  他几乎甚么都没吃。
We hardly ever (= almost never) go to concerts.  我们几乎从不去听音乐会。

words.meaning: n.  环境; 背景; 布景; [常pl.  ]设置，安装
words.example:
Their cottage is in an idyllic rural setting.  他们的农舍地处恬静宜人的乡村。
The play has its setting in a wartime prison camp.  这部戏的背景是战争时期的战俘营。
My hairdryer has three settings - high, medium and low.  我的吹风机有三段——高温、中温和低温。

words.meaning: n.  下水,汽艇,发射vt.  使下水,发射,发动,发出vi.  起飞,下水,投入,开
words.example:
How much champagne will we need for the launch?  这次发表会我们需要多少香槟？
Illness prevented her attending the launch party for her latest novel.  她因病无法出席为她新近推出的小说举办的庆祝派对。UK noun countable
The launch of the space shuttle was delayed for 24 hours because of bad weather.  因天气情况不佳，太空船的发射延迟了24个小时。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.  档案; 行列; v.  归档; 提出
words.example:
You'll find it in the files under 'C'.  你会在标着C字母的资料夹里找到它。
We keep your records on file for five years.  我们把你的纪录归档保存五年。noun
The police have opened a file on local burglaries.  警方已为当地的入室行窃案设立了档案。noun

words.meaning: n.  病人a.  不舒服,有病的,恶心的,病态的,渴望的,厌恶的vt.  呕吐,使
words.example:
My father has been off sick (= not working because of illness) for a long time.  因为生病，我父亲已经很久没有去上班了。
Anyone who could hurt a child like that must be sick (= mentally ill).  那样伤害孩子的人，脑子一定有毛病。
The old woman fell/took/was taken sick (= became ill) while she was away and had to come home.  那个老妇人出门在外时生病了，不得不回家。

words.meaning: n.  结果,出口,演变
words.example: It's too early to predict the outcome of the meeting.  现在预言会议的结果还言之尚早。

words.meaning: vt.  防护,辩护,防卫
words.example:
How can we defend our homeland if we don't have an army?  如果没有军队，我们怎能保护我们的家园？
White blood cells help defend the body against infection.  白细胞有助于保护身体免受感染。
They are fighting to defend their beliefs/interests/rights.  他们在为为捍卫自己的信仰／利益／权利而战。

words.meaning: n.  天主教徒,旧教徒a.  天主教的,旧教的,宽宏大量的,一般的,普遍的
words.example:
Is he (a) Catholic?  他是天主教徒吗？
As a young person he had more catholic tastes than he does now.  他年轻的时候兴趣比现在要广泛得多。

words.meaning: n.  程度，范围
words.example:
From the top of the Empire State Building, you can see the full extent of Manhattan (= the area it covers).  你可以从帝国大厦的顶楼看到曼哈顿全景。
We don't yet know the extent of his injuries (= how bad his injuries are).  我们还不知道他的伤势有多严重。
Rosie's teacher was impressed by the extent of her knowledge (= how much she knew).  罗西的知识很丰富，给她的老师留下了深刻的印象。

words.meaning: n.  元件,组件,成分a.  组成的,合成的n.  组件
words.example:
The factory supplies electrical components for cars.  这家工厂供应汽车电器零件。
The course has four main components: business law, finance, computing and management skills.  这门课由四大部分组成：商业法、金融、电脑操作和管理技巧。
Fresh fruit and vegetables are an essential component of a healthy diet.  新鲜水果和蔬菜是健康饮食的一个基本要素。

words.meaning: n.  差别,对比,对照物vt.  使对比vi.  成对照
words.example:
The antique furnishing provides an unusual contrast to the modernity of the building.  这座建筑物的古典装饰与它自身的现代风格形成了不同寻常的对比。
There's a marked contrast between his character and hers.  他的性格与她形成了鲜明对比。
Their economy has expanded enormously, while ours, by/in contrast, has declined.  他们的经济快速增长，相比之下，我们的经济则下滑了。

words.meaning: n.  地域，地带
words.example:
He was charged with driving 75 mph in a 55 mph zone.  他被指控在限速55英里的区域内驾车时速达到75英里。
This stretch of coast has been designated a danger zone.  这段海岸已被划定为危险地带。
The UN Security Council has established a no-fly zone (= one into which aircraft are not permitted to fly).  联合国安全理事会设定了一处禁飞区。

words.meaning: n.  飞行员，领航员; a.  试验性的
words.example:
If you'd seen the pilot, you'd know why they decided not to make a complete series of programmes!  如果你看了试播节目的话，就会明白他们为甚么决定不制作整套节目了。noun countable
If the UKpilot scheme / USpilot program is successful many more homes will be offered the new television service.  如果试验计划成功，会有越来越多的家庭享受到新的电视服务。verb
She piloted the aircraft to safety after one of the engines failed.  其中一个引擎发生故障后，她把飞机驾驶到安全的地方。verb

words.meaning: vt.  警告,注意,通知vi.  发出警告
words.example:
There were signs warning of fog as soon as we got onto the motorway.  我们一上高速公路，就看到有“大雾”的警示牌。
This particular curry is extremely hot - be warned!  这种特别的咖哩食品极辣——小心食用！
Put that ball down and come over here, Laura - I'm warning you (= I will punish you if you do not) !  放下那个球到这里来，萝拉——我是在警告你！

words.meaning: ad.  最终; 基本上
words.example:
Everything will ultimately depend on what is said at the meeting with the directors next week.  一切将最终取决于下周开会和董事们商议的结果。
Ultimately, of course, he'd like to have his own business but that won't be for some time.  当然，他最终想拥有自己的企业，但那不会很快实现的。
Ultimately, he'll have to decide.  他终究要作出决定。

words.meaning: n.  能力; 容量; 身份
words.example:
The stadium has a seating capacity of 50 000.  这个体育场能容纳五万人。
The game was watched by a capacity crowd/audience of 50 000 (= the place was completely full).  比赛场座无虚席，五万观众观看了比赛。
She has a great capacity for hard work.  她特别能吃苦耐劳。

words.meaning: n.  地产
words.example:
It's a typical country estate with a large house for the owner, farm buildings and estate workers' houses.  这是一个典型的乡村庄园，建有主人的大宅子、许多农舍以及庄园工人的宿舍。
She left her entire estate to her niece.  她把所有的遗产都留给了自己的侄女。noun

words.meaning: n.  环境; 境况
words.example:
Obviously we can't deal with the problem until we know all the circumstances.  显然，我们只有在了解全部情况后才能处理这个问题。
She died in suspicious circumstances.  她死得很蹊跷。
We oppose capital punishment in/under any circumstances.  无论在甚么情况下，我们都不赞成死刑。

words.meaning: v.  继续; 从事; 追击; 追踪
words.example:
The car was pursued by helicopters.  这辆车遭到多架直升机追捕。
The hunters spent hours pursuing their prey.  猎人们花费数小时追捕猎物。
He was killed by the driver of a stolen car who was being hotly pursued by the police.  他被车撞死了，撞他的人开的是一辆赃车，警方正在加紧追捕。UK verb transitive

words.meaning: v.  滑(过、落); n.  (木、纸)片; 滑倒
words.example:
She slipped on the ice.  她在冰上滑倒了。
Careful you don't slip - there's water on the floor.  小心别滑倒了——地板上有水。
The razor slipped while he was shaving and he cut himself.  他刮胡子时刮须刀一滑，把自己划伤了。verb (-pp-)

words.meaning: a.  正确的,品行端正的vt.  改正,订正
words.example:
It 's not correct to describe them as 'students'.  把他们说成学生不确切。
He's very correct in his dress/speech/manner, isn't he?  他穿着／谈吐／举止很得体，是不是？verb transitive
Students said it was helpful if the teacher corrected their pronunciation.  学生们说老师纠正他们的发音错误会对他们很有帮助。

words.meaning: n.  过失,责备vt.  责备,归咎于
words.example:
Don't blame me (= It is not my fault) if you miss the bus!  如果你没赶上车可别怪我！
Hugh blames his mother for his lack of confidence.  晓治把自己缺乏自信心归咎于他的母亲。
Hugh blames his lack of confidence on his mother.  晓治把自己缺乏自信心归咎于他的母亲。

words.meaning: n.  估计,判断vt.  估计,评价,判断vi.  估计
words.example:
Government sources estimate a long-term 50% increase in rail fares.  政府消息人士估计火车票价将有一个涨幅达50%的长期调涨。
The number of people who applied for the course was 120 compared with an initial estimate of between 50 and 100.  最初估计申请选修这门课程的学生也就是50到100人，可是实际上报名的有120人。
We'll accept the lowest of three estimates for the building work.  在对这项建筑工程的三个投标中，我们将采纳报价最低的那个。

words.meaning: n.  应得的东西,应付款a.  到期的,应得的,应付的,约定的
words.example:
What time is the next bus due?  下一班公车甚么时候来？
The next meeting is due to be held in three months' time.  下次会议预计将在三个月后召开。
Their first baby is due in January.  他们的第一个孩子预产期在一月份。

words.meaning: vt. vi.  调查,研究
words.example: Police are investigating allegations of corruption involving senior executives.  警方正在调查对高级管理人员涉嫌贪污的指控。

words.meaning: a.  发狂的,狂热的
words.example:
It's a crazy idea.  这是个荒唐的想法。
You're crazy to buy a house without seeing it.  看都没看就买下一所房子，你真荒唐。
The constant noise drove me crazy (= made me become angry).  吵声不断简直要把我逼疯了。adjective

words.meaning: ad.  值得注目地; 相当地
words.example:
My piano playing has improved significantly since I've had a new teacher.  自从换了一位新老师，我的钢琴水准有了明显提升。adverb
He said that he would be bringing a friend with him but, significantly, didn't say who it was.  他说会带一个朋友来，但耐人寻味的是，他没说出那人是谁。

words.meaning: n.  组合,合并,联合n.  组合图
words.example:
Strawberries and cream - a perfect combination.  草莓加奶油——完美的组合。
This drug can be safely used in combination with other medicines.  这药可以与其他药物一起安全服用。
Her experience and energy are a winning combination (= a successful mixture) in business.  经验加干劲是她在生意上成功的秘诀。

words.meaning: n.  省长; 州长; 总督
words.example: the governor of Texas  德克萨斯州州长

words.meaning: n.  浮雕; 缓解
words.example:
After the exam, I felt an incredible sense of relief.  考试过后，我感到轻松无比。
Pop stars have raised millions of pounds for famine relief in Africa.  流行歌星们已经筹集了数百万英镑的善款救济非洲饥民。noun
Coins have pictures on them in relief.  硬币上面有浮雕图案。

words.meaning: n.  方式，风格; [pl.  ]礼貌; 习惯
words.example:
She stared at me in an accusing manner.  她以责备的目光注视着我。
He was elected in the normal manner.  他依正常程式当选。
It was the manner of her death that stuck in the public's mind.  她的死亡方式使公众很受触动。

words.meaning: a.  古代的; 古老的
words.example:
People have lived in this valley since ancient times.  人们自古就居住在这个山谷里。
History, ancient and modern , has taught these people an intense distrust of their neighbours.  古今历史向这些人灌输了对其邻国极度不信任的思想。
He's got an ancient computer.  他有一台老掉牙的电脑。

words.meaning: n.  移动,手势,动作,提议,请求vt. vi.  打手势
words.example:
The violent motion of the ship upset his stomach.  船的剧烈摇晃使他的胃很不舒服。
He rocked the cradle with a gentle backwards and forwards motion.  他轻轻地前后晃动摇篮。
They showed the goal again in slow motion (= at a slower speed so that the action could be more clearly seen).  他们用慢动作又播了一次进球画面。

words.meaning: n.  性别
words.example:
Does this test show the gender of the baby?  这种检测能测出胎儿的性别吗？
Discrimination on the basis of race, gender, age or disability is not allowed.  基于种族、性别、年龄或残疾的歧视都是不能容许的。

words.meaning: n.  风景; 风景画; 地形
words.example:
The landscape is dotted with the tents of campers and hikers.  乡间散布着宿营者和远足者搭起的帐篷。
The cathedral dominates the landscape for miles around.  大教堂在方圆数英里的乡间高高耸立着。
a watercolour landscape.  水彩风景画

words.meaning: n.  对手,匹敌,同辈a.  相等的,平等的,胜任的,不相上下的,平静的vt.
words.example:
All people are equal, deserving the same rights as each other.  所有人都是平等的，享有同等的权利。
They've got a long way to go before they achieve equal pay/status for men and women.  要实现男女同工同酬／地位平等，他们仍有很长的路要走。
One litre is equal to 1.76 imperial pints.  1升等于1.76 英制品脱。

words.meaning: ad.  往前,向外
words.example:
They set forth on their travels in early June.  他们六月初起程旅行。
From that day forth he never drank again.  从那天起，他再也没有沾过酒。

words.meaning: n.  框架; v.  设计，构成
words.example:
My sister has a much bigger frame than me.  我姐姐的骨架比我大很多。
The most important thing is to go into the exam in a positive frame of mind.  最重要的是要以积极的心态参加考试。
How can Christians and atheists ever come to understand each other when their frames of reference are so different?  基督徒和无神论者的思想观念差异如此之大，他们又怎么能相互理解呢？noun countable

words.meaning: a.  典型的,象征性的
words.example:
This sort of hot and spicy food is very typical of the food in the south of the country.  这种辛辣食品是该国南部具代表性的食物。
Typical symptoms would include severe headaches, vomiting and dizziness.  典型的症状包括剧烈的头痛、呕吐和眩晕。
It's just typical of Ian to spend all that money on the equipment and then lose interest half way through the course.  伊恩就是这种人，先把所有钱花在买装备上，中途又失去兴趣。

words.meaning: a.  保守的,守旧的,有保存力的
words.example:
Did you vote Conservative at the last election?  上次选举你投的是保守党的票吗？
Older people tend to be quite conservative and a bit suspicious of any supposed advances.  上年纪的人往往很保守，对任何所谓的进步都有些怀疑。    Compare liberal
He's a very conservative dresser - he always looks like he's wearing his father's clothes!  他穿着十分保守——看上去总像是穿着他父亲的衣服！UK adjective

words.meaning: vt.  消除; 淘汰
words.example:
We eliminated the possibility that it could have been an accident.  我们排除了这或许是一埸意外事故的可能性。
The police eliminated him from their enquiries.  员警已把他排除在调查对象之外。
He was eliminated in the third round of the competition.  他在第三轮比赛中被淘汰。

words.meaning: n.  主人; 【生】寄主
words.example:
We thanked our hosts for the lovely evening.  我们感谢主人家让我们渡过了一个愉快的夜晚。
The local language school is advertising for host families (= families with whom people stay when they are visiting another country).  当地的语言学校正在招募能接待外国访客的家庭。UK noun
Our host for tonight's show is Terry Wogan.  我们今晚节目的主持人是泰瑞‧沃根。UK noun

words.meaning: vt.  提供,供应得起,给予
words.example:
Few people are able to afford cars like that.  很少人买得起那样的车。
She couldn't afford the time off work to see him.  她工作太忙，抽不出时间去看他。
The hut afforded little protection from the elements.  这间棚屋几乎不能遮风挡雨。

words.meaning: n.  划分; 除法
words.example:
Norwich are currently top of Division one.  诺里奇队目前在第一组中居于首位。noun
Disagreements about defence cuts have opened up deep divisions within the military.  在削减国防开支问题上的看法不一导致军方内部出现了严重的分歧。
Division within the party will limit its chances at the election.  内讧将会降低该党在选举中获胜的机会。

words.meaning: vt.  确定,批准,使巩固,使有效v.  确认
words.example:
Flights should be confirmed 48 hours before departure.  应该在起飞前48小时确认航班。
I've accepted the job over the phone, but I haven't confirmed in writing yet.  我已在电话中接受了这份工作，但还没有书面确认。UK verb
The leader's speech was impressive and confirmed her faith in the party.  这位领导人的讲话令人难忘，坚定了她对该党的信心。UK verb

words.meaning: n.  恳求,上诉,吸引力,要求vi.  求助,诉请,要求vt.  控诉
words.example:
They're launching (= starting) an appeal to raise money for famine victims.  他们正在呼吁社会为饥民捐款。
The case went to the court of appeal/the appeal court.  案件被提交到上诉法院。
He won his appeal and the sentence was halved.  他上诉获胜，刑期减半。

words.meaning: n.  变数,可变物a.  可变的,不定的,易变的,变量的
words.example:
British weather is perhaps at its most variable in the spring.  在英国，春季的天气可能是最变幻莫测的。UK noun countable specialized
The variables in the equation are X, Y and Z.  方程式中的变数是X，Y 和 Z。
The data was analysed according to neighbourhoods, but other key variables like credit rating, job history, savings and marital status were ignored altogether.  对这些资料按照所在街区进行了分析，但像信用等级、工作经历、存款情况、婚姻状况等其他关键变数则一概忽略不计。

words.meaning: vt.  吸引
words.example:
These flowers are brightly coloured in order to attract butterflies.  这些花朵都有着鲜艳的色彩以便能够吸引蝴蝶。
The circus is attracting huge crowds/audiences.  马戏团吸引了大批的观众。
Magnets attract iron filings.  磁铁吸铁屑。

words.meaning: n.  信心
words.example:
She's very timid - completely lacking in (self-)confidence.  她很腼腆——一点自信也没有。
They talked endlessly, exchanging confidences.  他们聊个不停，互诉心事。

words.meaning: n.  债务,罪过
words.example:
He managed to pay off his debts in two years.  他设法在两年内还清债务。
The firm ran up huge debts.  公司很快就负债累累。
They are in debt to (= owe money to) the bank.  他们欠银行的钱。

words.meaning: a.  稀有的，罕见的; (肉类)半熟的
words.example:
The museum is full of rare and precious treasures.  这所博物馆里收藏的满是奇珍异宝。
a rare occasion/opportunity/visit/treat, etc.  难得的时机／机会／探访／款待等
It's very rare to find someone who combines such qualities.  同时具有这些素质的人非常罕见。UK adjective

words.meaning: n.  结合,债券,契约,粘合剂,关栈保留,键,保证人vt.  存入关栈,粘着vi.
words.example:
There has been a close bond between them ever since she saved him from drowning.  他溺水被她救了以后他们之间一直来往密切。
In societies with strong family bonds (= relationships) , people tend to live longer.  在家庭关系牢固的社会中，人们的寿命往往更长。UK noun
They have entered into a solemn bond.  他们已经缔结了一项正式契约。

words.meaning: n.  快乐,愉快,希望vt. vi.  (使)高兴
words.example:
His visits gave his grandparents such pleasure.  他来探望爷爷奶奶，这让他们非常开心。
Why do so many boys take pleasure in torturing insects and small animals.  为甚么有这么多的男孩子喜欢以虐待昆虫和小动物为乐？
He wrote an article on the pleasures and pains of camping.  他写了一篇关于露营甘苦的文章。

words.meaning: n.  纪元; 时代
words.example:
They had worked for peace during the long era of conflict.  在漫长而冲突不断的年代里，他们努力争取和平。
The fall of the Berlin wall marked the end of an era.  柏林围墙的倒塌标记着一个时代的结束。

words.meaning: a.  分离的，个别的; v.  分离，划分，区别
words.example:
The art department and the main college are in two separate buildings.  艺术系和主要的学院在两座独立的大楼中。
Three youths have been shot and killed in separate incidents this month.  这个月有三名年轻人在不同的事件中被枪杀。adjective UK go your (own) separate ways
In 1983 the group disbanded and went their separate ways.  1983年乐队解散，成员各奔东西。verb UK  ESSENTIAL  intransitive or transitive

words.meaning: n.  某物,几分ad.  多少,几分
words.example:
The resort has changed somewhat over the last few years.  近几年来，这个旅游胜地出现了些变化。
She's somewhat more confident than she used to be.  她比过去自信了一些。
We were somewhat tired after our long walk.  走了很长的路之后，我们有些累了。

words.meaning: v.  搅拌; 煽动，刺激
words.example:
Stir the sauce gently until it begins to boil.  慢慢搅动酱汁直至煮沸。
Stir the egg yolks into the mixture.  将蛋黄搅拌至混合料中。
She paused to stir some milk into her coffee.  她停了一下，往咖啡里掺了点牛奶。

words.meaning: n.  裁判,宣告,判决书
words.example:
I'm going to reserve judgment (on the decision) (= not say whether I think it is good or bad) for the time being.  我将暂时（对这项决定）保留看法。
It proved difficult to come to/form/make a judgment about how well the school was performing.  事实证明要判断这所学校的运作情形是很难的。
In my judgment, we should let the solicitor deal with this.  在我看来，我们该让律师处理此事。(also judgement) ['dʒʌdʒ.mənt]

words.meaning: n.  提到; 参考; 介绍信
words.example:
Knowing what had happened, I avoided making any reference to (= mentioning) weddings.  因为我知道发生了甚么，所以就避开不谈婚礼的事情。
formal I am writing with/in reference to (= in connection with) your letter of 15 March.  现就3月15日贵函致覆。UK noun
In all future letters on this subject, please use/quote our reference JW/155/C/1991.  今后有关此事项的所有信件都请标明我方信函编号UK noun

words.meaning: n.  怀疑,疑惑vt. vi.  怀疑,不信
words.example:
I'm having doubts about his ability to do the job.  我对他是否能胜任此项工作还有一些疑问。
If there's any doubt about the rocket's engines, we ought to cancel the launch.  如果对火箭引擎还存有任何疑虑，我们都应该取消此次发射。
The prosecution has to establish his guilt UK beyond (reasonable) doubt] US beyond a (reasonable) doubt.  此次起诉必须证明他所犯的罪行证据确凿。

words.meaning: v.  给予，授予; 同意; 承认; n.  拨款
words.example:
He was granted asylum.  他的避难请求被接受了。
formal She granted their request/wish.  她答应了他们的请求／满足了他们的愿望。UK verb
One of the problems with relationships is that after a while you just take each other for granted.  恋爱中会遇到的一个问题是，相处一段时间后，双方就都把对方为自己所做的一切视为理所当然。

words.meaning: a.  工业的,实业的,产业的n.  工业工人,工业股票
words.example:
He has an industrial background (= He has worked in industry).  他在工业领域工作过。noun countable specialized
He owns a series of industrials across the US and beyond.  他在美国以及其他地区拥有一系列工业公司。
Industrials were up 1.2% at the close of trading.  在交易结束的时候工业股票上升了1.2个百分点。

words.meaning: v.  延伸，拉长; n.  一段路程; 延伸
words.example:
She stretched out her hand and helped him from his chair.  她伸手将他从椅子上扶起来。
"I'm so tired, " she said, yawning and stretching.  “我太累了。”她打着呵欠伸了个懒腰说。
It's a good idea to stretch before you take vigorous exercise.  在进行剧烈运动前，应该先伸展一下身体。verb

words.meaning: n.  体积,大小,册,卷,容量,大量,音量,份量,许多vi.  成团卷起vt.  收集
words.example:
Which of these bottles do you think has the greater volume?  你认为这些瓶子中哪个容积最大？
It's the sheer volume of traffic in the city that is causing the problems.  造成这些问题的就是城里的交通流量。UK noun
Could you turn the volume down, please, I'm trying to sleep.  你能把音量调低些吗？我要睡觉。

words.meaning: n.  方式; 流行，风尚; v.  形成，把…塑造成
words.example:
Long hair is back in fashion for men.  男士又流行留长发了。
Fur coats have gone out of fashion.  皮草大衣已经过时了。
She always wears the latest fashions.  她总是穿着最新款式的服装。

words.meaning: n.  副本,摹仿,一册vt. vi.  复印,抄袭n.  副本v.  复制
words.example:
They've copied the basic design from the Japanese model and added a few of their own refinements.  他们仿照日本模型的基本设计，又加上了一些自己的改良。
Patricia's going to copy her novel onto disk and send it to me.  帕特里夏打算把她的小说复制到磁片上寄给我。
He tends to copy his brother in the way he dresses.  他常常仿效哥哥的穿着。

words.meaning: n.  顶,尖端,梢,末端,倾斜,垃圾场,小费,秘密消息vt.  装顶端,使倾斜,使
words.example:
The table tipped and all our drinks fell on the floor.  桌子翻了，结果我们的所有饮料都掉在地上。
If you put too many books on one end of the shelf, it'll tip up.  如果你在书架的一头放太多书，书架就会翻掉。
Don't tip your chair back like that, you'll fall.  不要那样向后仰椅子，你会翻倒的。

words.meaning: n.  目标,瞄准vi.  对准目标,打算vt.  瞄准
words.example:
My main aim in life is to be a good husband and father.  我人生的主要目标是做一个好丈夫和好爸爸。
Our short-term aim is to deal with our current financial difficulties, but our long-term aim is to improve the company's profitability.  我们的短期目标是解决当前的财政困难，但长远目标是提高公司的盈利。
The leaflet has been produced with the aim of increasing public awareness of the disease.  印发该传单的目的是为了提高公众对这种疾病的认识。noun

words.meaning: vt.  引用,引证,例证
words.example:
She cited three reasons why people get into debt.  她举出了人们负债的三个原因。
The company cited a 12% decline in new orders as evidence that overall demand for its products was falling.  公司举出新订单减少12%这一事实，以此来证明其产品的总需求在下降。
She cites both T.S. Eliot and Virginia Woolf in her article.  她在文章中引用了托马斯‧斯特恩斯‧艾略特和维吉尼亚‧伍尔芙的作品。verb transitive

words.meaning: n.  福利,安宁,幸福,福利事业a.  福利的
words.example:
This national fund pays for welfare benefits such as unemployment and sickness pay.  此项国家基金提供多项福利救济，例如失业和医疗等。
The police are very concerned for the welfare of the missing child.  警方非常担心失踪儿童的安危。
These organizations have fought very hard for the rights and welfare of immigrants.  这些机构竭力为移民争取权利和福利。

words.meaning: vi.  分开,分类,分裂vt.  分,分开,分裂,除n.  分配,分水岭v.  除
words.example:
At the end of the lecture, I'd like all the students to divide into small discussion groups.  讲座结束后，我想让所有学生分成几个讨论小组。
After World War Two, Germany was divided into two separate countries.  第二次世界大战之后，德国被分成了两个独立的国家。
There's a narrow alley which divides our house from the one next door.  一条窄窄的小巷将我们的房子和邻居的隔开了。

words.meaning: n.  字首,首字母a.  开始的,最初的,字首的vt.  签姓名的首字母
words.example:
My initial surprise was soon replaced by delight.  我最初的惊讶很快变成了兴奋。
Initial reports say that seven people have died, though this has not yet been confirmed.  最初的报道说有七人丧生，但这个消息还未得到证实。noun countable usually plural
He wrote his initials, P.M.R., at the bottom of the page.  他在页尾写上了他名字的首字母P.M.R.。

words.meaning: v.  反对，对抗
words.example:
The proposed new examination system has been vigorously opposed by teachers.  实行新考试制度的提议遭到教师们的强烈反对。
Most of the local residents opposed the closing of their hospital.  当地大多数居民反对关闭他们的医院。

words.meaning: a.  当代的，现在的; n.  同时代的人
words.example:
Although it was written hundreds of years ago, it still has a contemporary (= modern) feel to it.  尽管它写于几百年前，但读来仍具现代感。UK adjective
Almost all of the contemporary accounts of the event have been lost.  几乎所有关于这一事件的同时期的记载都遗失了。
Most of the writers he was contemporary with were interested in the same subjects.  和他同时代的大多数作家都对同样的题材感兴趣。UK noun countable

words.meaning: a.  多样的; 多重的; n.  倍数
words.example:
The youth died of multiple burns.  那个年轻人因多处烧伤死亡。
We made multiple copies of the report.  我们把报告影印了多份。
These children have multiple (= many different) handicaps.  这些孩子身患多种残疾。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.  要素,要点,本质a.  必要的,重要的,本质的
words.example:
Government support will be essential if the project is to succeed.  这个企划案能否成功，政府的支援至关重要。
There is essential work to be done before the building can be re-occupied.  这栋建筑在重新入住前必须进行必要的维修。
Water is essential for/to living things.  水对于生物来说是不可或缺的。

words.meaning: n.  同盟,联盟,盟约vt. vi.  组联盟,(使)加盟
words.example:
Who do you think will win the league championship this year?  你认为谁会获得今年的联赛冠军？
Liverpool were top of the Football League that year.  利物浦队是那一年的足球联赛冠军。
They are currently bottom of the league.  他们目前在联赛中垫底。noun countable

words.meaning: a.  巨大的,广大的,非常的,大量的
words.example:
The amount of detail the book contains is vast.  该书所包含的细节内容非常丰富。
The people who have taken our advice have saved themselves vast amounts/sums of money.  那些听从了我们建议的人省了一大笔钱。
The vast majority of pupils attend state-funded schools.  绝大部分学生就读于州立学校。

words.meaning: n.  家庭; a.  家庭的，家用的; 家喻户晓的
words.example: By the 1960s, most households had a TV.  到了20世纪60年代，绝大多数家庭都拥有电视。

words.meaning: n.  证人,目击者,证词,证明,证据vt.  目击,作证,经历,表明,证明vi.  作
words.example:
Police are appealing for witnesses to the accident to come forward.  警方呼吁那场事故的目击者站出来。
According to (eye) witnesses, the robbery was carried out by two teenage boys.  据目击者说，抢劫案是两个十几岁的少年犯的。
She was witness to the tragic event.  她目睹了这悲剧。

words.meaning: n.  比赛; 对手; v.  和…相配
words.example:
We won/lost the match.  我们赢／输掉了比赛。
Liverpool have a match with (= against) Blackburn next week.  利物浦队下周将与布莱克本队对赛。
You should always strike a match away from you.  擦火柴时应该离身体远一些。

words.meaning: ad.  几乎不能
words.example:
They have barely enough (= no more than what is needed) to pay the rent this month.  他们这个月差一点就付不起房租了。
She was barely (= only just) fifteen when she won her first championship.  她初次获得冠军时刚满15岁。

words.meaning: n.  事情，事件
words.example: Despite fears of violence, the demonstration passed off without incident.  尽管担心发生暴力事件，示威活动还是平静地结束了。

words.meaning: n.  全体教职员工; 能力
words.example:
Even at the age of 100, she still had all her faculties.  尽管年届一百高龄，她的一切身体机能仍然保持正常。
Is he in command/possession of all his faculties (= Can he still hear, speak, see and think clearly) ?  他身体一切机能均正常吗？
She has a faculty for inspiring confidence in people.  她具有激发他人信心的能力。

words.meaning: n.  块,大多数,质量,弥撒,群众a.  群众的,大规模的,集中的vt.  使集合,
words.example:
Thousands of troops have massed along the border in preparation for an invasion.  数千大军已经集结在边境上，准备入侵。adjective [before noun]
Opposition groups plan to stage mass demonstrations all over the country.  反对派计划在全国发起大规模游行示威。noun
The explosion reduced the church to a mass of rubble.  爆炸使教堂变成一堆瓦砾。

words.meaning: vt.  强调,加强语气,着重
words.example:
You can use italics or capitals to emphasize a word in a piece of writing.  你可以用斜体或者大写来强调文章中的某个词。
Tight jeans will only emphasize any extra weight that you are carrying.  紧身牛仔裤只会使你身上的赘肉更明显。

words.meaning: a.  巨大的,庞大的
words.example:
He earns an enormous salary.  他工资极高。
You've been an enormous help.  你真是帮了大忙。

words.meaning: n.  自由主义者,开明的人a.  慷慨的,不拘泥的,宽大的,自由主义的
words.example:
Her parents were far more liberal than mine.  她父母比我父母开明得多。    Opposite illiberal or intolerantUK adjective
He was very liberal with the wine.  对于酒他毫不吝啬。UK adjective
He's a good old-fashioned liberal.  他是个老式的自由主义者。

words.meaning: a.  大而重的,宽大的,宏伟的
words.example:
They've got a massive house.  他们有一座很大的房子。
She died after taking a massive overdose of drugs.  她在吸食过量毒品后死亡。
If the drought continues, deaths will occur on a massive scale.  如果旱情持续，将有大批人死亡。

words.meaning: n.  衰微,跌落,下降vt.  使降低,婉谢vi.  下降,衰落,偏斜
words.example:
His interest in the project declined after his wife died.  妻子死后，他对该企划案的兴趣逐渐淡薄了。
The party's popularity has declined in the opinion polls.  民意调查显示该党的支持率已经下滑。
formal The land declines sharply away from the house.  地势从房屋那边开始大幅度向下倾斜。verb

words.meaning: n.  缆绳; 电缆; 电报
words.example:
The road has been dug up in order to lay cables.  道路已被挖开，以便铺设电缆。
The office has gone over to cable.  办公室改用有线系统了。
This channel is only available on cable.  这个频道只有透过有线电视才能收到。

words.meaning: a.  乡村的，农村的; 田园的
words.example: The area is still very rural and undeveloped.  这个地区仍是一片乡村景象，没有被开发。    Compare urban

words.meaning: a.  固体的; 实心的; 稳固的; n.  固体
words.example:
The lecture hall was packed solid (with students).  演讲大厅里挤满了（学生）。
Liquid and solid waste is collected in the tank.  液体和固体废弃物集中在箱罐里。
Freeze the mixture for about 3 hours or so until solid.  把混合物冷冻三小时左右，直到其变成固体。

words.meaning: adv.  1 (无比较级、最高级)[修饰整句]不幸地,倒楣地,不巧地,遗憾地2
words.example: Unfortunately, I didn't have my credit card with me or I'd certainly have bought it.  很不凑巧，我没带信用卡，否则我肯定早买了。UK adverb

words.meaning: n.  法律，法规; 立法
words.example: The legislation took effect in June.  该法规六月生效。

words.meaning: vt.  赞美; 庆祝
words.example:
We always celebrate our wedding anniversary by going out to dinner.  每年的结婚纪念日我们都出去吃饭庆祝。
If this plan works, we'll celebrate in style (= in a special way).  要是这个计划奏效，我们就隆重地庆贺一下。verb
His work celebrates the energy and enthusiasm of the young.  他的作品赞颂年轻人的活力和热情。verb

words.meaning: vt.  责备,控告,谴责
words.example:
He's been accused of robbery/murder.  他被指控犯有抢劫／谋杀罪。
Are you accusing me of lying ?  你是在指责我撒谎吗？
The surgeon was accused of negligence.  这名外科医生被控怠忽职守。

words.meaning: n.  被拒之人,被弃之物,不合格品,落选者,不及格者vt.  拒绝,抵制,否决,
words.example:
The appeal was rejected by the High Court.  上诉被最高法院驳回。
Coin-operated machines in England reject Irish money.  英格兰的投币机不接受爱尔兰钱币。
The prime minister rejected the suggestion that it was time for him to resign.  首相拒绝了他该辞职的建议。

words.meaning: n.  才能,有才干的人,天才,天资
words.example:
Her talent for music showed at an early age.  她小时候就表现出了音乐天赋。
His artistic talents were wasted in his boring job.  他的艺术天分被枯燥乏味的工作消磨殆尽。noun
There was plenty of talent at the party last night.  昨晚的派对上有许多佳丽。

words.meaning: n.  味道,品味,味觉,感受,体验,爱好,审美,少量,得体,大方vt.  尝,体会,
words.example:
Olives are perhaps an acquired taste (= you only like them after you have become familiar with their taste).  橄榄的味道可能要慢慢习惯才会喜欢。
Have a taste of the sauce and tell me if it needs salt.  尝尝酱汁，看看是否需要加盐。noun
I've never really cared much for flash new cars - old vintage cars are more to my taste (= what I like).  我一向不怎么喜欢豪华的新款车——倒是更喜欢老式汽车。

words.meaning: a.  特有的; 典型的; n.  特性
words.example:
Unfortunately a big nose is a family characteristic.  不幸的是，大鼻子是家族特征。
Sentimentality seems a characteristic of all the writers of that period.  多愁善感似乎是那个时期所有作家的特征。
The male bird displays (= has) several characteristics which distinguish him from the female.  雄鸟有几个有别于雌鸟的特征。UK adjective

words.meaning: n.  逃亡,避难设备,出口,逃跑vi.  逃脱,避开,溜走vt.  逃避,避免,被忘
words.example:
Two prisoners have escaped.  两个犯人逃走了。
She was lucky to escape serious injury.  她真是万幸，逃过一劫，没有受重伤。
He narrowly (= only just) escaped a fine.  他差一点被罚款。

words.meaning: n.  铸件; vt.  浇铸; 投掷
words.example:
He was often cast as the villain.  他经常演反面角色。
In her latest film she was cast against type (= played a different character than the one she usually played or might be expected to play).  在最近拍的电影中，她改变了戏路。
figurative They like to cast the opposing political party as (= to say that they are) the party of high taxes.  他们喜欢把敌对政党说成是征收高额税收的政党。

words.meaning: v.  使确信，说服
words.example: He managed to convince the jury of his innocence.  他使陪审团相信他是无辜的。

words.meaning: n.  内科医生
words.example: The physician prescribed a mild medicine.  内科医生开了温和的药。

words.meaning: vt.  估定,评定
words.example:
The insurers will need to assess the flood damage.  保险公司需要对洪水造成的损失进行评估。
They assessed the cost of the flood damage at £1500.  他们估计洪水造成的损失为1500英镑。
Examinations are not the only means of assessing a student's ability.  考试并不是评定学生能力的唯一手段。

words.meaning: ad.  事实上
words.example:
Their twins are virtually identical.  他们的双胞胎长得几乎一模一样。
That wine stain on my shirt has virtually disappeared.  我衬衣上的那块酒渍几乎已经看不见了。

words.meaning: vt.  降低; a.  较低的; 下级的，下等的
words.example:
They lowered the coffin into the grave.  他们把棺材放入了墓穴。
He lowered his eyes (= looked down) in embarrassment when he saw me.  他看到我后尴尬地垂下了双眼。UK verb transitive
Interest rates have been lowered again.  利率又降了。

words.meaning: vt.  赞同,核准,证实vi.  赞许
words.example:
She doesn't approve of my friends.  她不喜欢我的朋友。
He doesn't approve of smoking.  他反对抽烟。
We had to wait months for the council to approve our plans to extend the house.  我们要等几个月，直到政务委员会批准我们扩建房屋的计划。

words.meaning: a.  正确的; 适当的; 特有的
words.example:
This is Sara's first proper job - she usually does temporary work just for the money.  这是莎拉的第一份正式工作——她通常只是为了赚钱而打零工。
If you're going to walk those sort of distances you need proper walking boots.  如果你要走那么远的路，就需要一双合脚的健步鞋。
I've had sandwiches but I haven't eaten a proper meal.  我吃了三明治，但还没有好好吃一顿饭。

words.meaning: a.  内疚的
words.example:
She must have done something wrong, because she's looking so guilty.  她一定是做错甚么事了，因为她一脸愧疚。
You've got a guilty conscience - that's why you can't sleep.  你问心有愧——所以会睡不着觉。UK adjective
The jury has to decide whether a person is guilty or innocent of a crime.  陪审团必须就一个人是否有罪作出裁决。

words.meaning: vt.  获得,学到
words.example:
He acquired the firm in 1978.  他于1978年收购了这家公司。
During this period he acquired a reputation for being a womanizer.  这期间他得了个玩弄女性的名声。UK verb transitive
Olives are an acquired taste.  橄榄这种东西吃得多就爱吃了。

words.meaning: vi.  竞争,对抗
words.example:
It's difficult for a small supermarket to compete against/with the big supermarkets.  小超市很难与大超市竞争。
Both girls compete for their father's attention.  两个女孩在父亲面前争宠。
figurative Turn the music down - I'm not competing against/with that noise (= I can't/won't try to speak louder than that music) !  把音乐调小声一点——我可不想跟那噪音较量！

words.meaning: n.  (自外国移入的)移民; a.  移民的; (从外国)移来的
words.example: Illegal immigrants are sent back across the border if they are caught.  非法移民如果被抓住就会从边境被遣返。

words.meaning: n.  二中择一,变通办法a.  二中择一的,选择性的
words.example:
There must be an alternative to people sleeping on the streets.  一定要想办法解决街头露宿者的问题。
I'm afraid I have no alternative but to ask you to leave (= that is what I have to do).  恐怕我别无选择，只有让你离开。UK adjective
The opposition parties have so far failed to set out an alternative strategy.  反对党到目前为止还没有提出其他的策略。

words.meaning: n.  圆柱; 专栏; 长列
words.example:
She writes a weekly fashion/gossip column for the Evening Standard.  她每周都在《旗帜晚报》的时尚／漫谈专栏中发表文章。
Add the column of figures and divide the sum by three.  把这列数字相加，再将总数除以3。UK noun countable
The roof of the temple was held up by a row of thick stone columns.  这座寺庙的屋顶由一排粗大的石柱支撑着。

words.meaning: n.  个性; 性格
words.example:
She has a very warm personality.  她个性非常热情。
He is well qualified for the job, but he does lack personality (= he is a boring person).  他非常胜任这份工作，但他确实缺乏个性。UK noun
The show is hosted by a popular TV personality.  该节目由一位广受欢迎的电视名人主持。

words.meaning: n.  信号，标志; v.  发信号
words.example:
When she gave (them) the signal, they all cheered.  她发出信号后，他们都欢呼起来。
The signal for a race to start is often the firing of a gun.  赛跑常以发令枪响作为开始的信号。
The poor result is a clear signal of his deteriorating confidence.  糟糕的结果清楚地显示他信心日渐不足。

words.meaning: n. [pl.  curricula]课程
words.example: the school curriculum  学校课程

words.meaning: n.  协会
words.example:
The British Medical Association is/are campaigning for a complete ban on tobacco advertising.  英国医学协会正发起一项全面禁止烟草广告的运动。UK noun
This event was organized in association with the Sports Council.  这场赛事由体育委员会协办。
The south of France has positive associations for me as I used to holiday there as a child.  法国南部总能给我一种美好的联想，因为我童年时代常去那里渡假。

words.meaning: vt.  包装; 裹
words.example:
She wrapped the present and tied it with ribbon.  她把礼物包起来，并用丝带扎紧。
Wrap the chicken in foil and cook it for two hours.  用锡纸将鸡肉包起来，加热两个小时。
She wrapped the baby in a blanket.  她用一块毯子把婴儿包起来。

words.meaning: v. n.  陈列; 展示; 显示
words.example:
Family photographs were displayed on the wall.  墙上挂着全家人的照片。verb transitive
The British traditionally tend not to display much emotion in public.  传统上，英国人不太喜欢在公开场合表露感情。noun
There's an Egyptian art collection on display (= being shown) at the museum at the moment.  埃及艺术收藏展正在博物馆举行。

words.meaning: n.  资产,有用的东西
words.example:
He'll be a great asset to the team.  他将会成为球队的得力主将。
Her eyes are her best asset (= most attractive feature).  她的眼睛是她最迷人的地方。
Knowledge of languages is a real asset in this sort of work.  做这项工作，通晓数种语言确实是一种优势。

words.meaning: n.  不景气,消沉,沮丧,洼地
words.example:
Tiredness, loss of appetite and sleeping problems are all classic symptoms of depression.  乏力、没有食欲和失眠都是抑郁症的典型症状。
If you suffer from depression, it's best to get professional help.  如果你患有抑郁症，最好向专业人士求助。
The stock market crash marked the start of a severe depression.  股市大跌标志着大萧条的开始。noun

words.meaning: a.  音乐的; 悦耳的; 有音乐天赋的; n.  音乐喜剧
words.example:
Mozart's musical compositions include symphonies and operas.  莫劄特的音乐创作包括交响乐和歌剧。
The family all play instruments - they're all very musical.  这家人都会演奏乐器——他们都很喜欢音乐。noun countable

words.meaning: n.  嫌疑犯a.  令人怀疑的,不可信的,可疑的vt. vi.  怀疑,猜想
words.example:
So far, the police do not suspect foul play.  目前，员警没有怀疑是谋杀案件。
No one knows who killed her, but the police suspect her husband.  没有人知道谁杀了她，但是警方认为她丈夫有嫌疑。
The police suspect him of carrying out two bomb attacks.  警方怀疑他发动两宗爆炸案。

words.meaning: n.  学者
words.example:
Dr Miles was a distinguished scholar of Russian history.  迈尔斯博士是一位研究俄国历史的著名学者。
David's never been much of a scholar.  戴维从来不是一个善于学习的人。

words.meaning: n.  气候,民意状况,社会趋势,风土
words.example:
The Mediterranean climate is good for growing citrus fruits and grapes.  地中海气候适宜柑橘属水果和葡萄的生长。
When we retire, we're going to move to a warmer climate.  我们打算退休后搬到气候比较暖和的地方去。noun
Terrorism creates a climate of fear.  恐怖主义制造了一种恐惧气氛。

words.meaning: n.  观察,注目,观测
words.example:
The police are keeping the suspect under observation.  警方监视着犯罪嫌疑人。
She was admitted to hospital for observation (= so that doctors could watch her and see if anything was wrong with her).  她被收治入院接受观察。UK noun
She has remarkable powers of observation (= is very good at noticing things).  她具有非凡的观察力。

words.meaning: n.  许可证,许可,执照vt.  允许,容许vi.  容许
words.example:
The regulations do not permit much flexibility.  这些规章不允许有太大的弹性空间。
As it was such a special occasion, she permitted herself a small glass of champagne.  鉴于场合特殊，她破例喝了一小杯香槟。
formal The law permits of no other interpretation.  法律不容许有其他解释。

words.meaning: n.  在先; 优先权
words.example:
The management did not seem to consider office safety to be a priority.  管理部门似乎并不认为应该优先考虑办公室安全问题。
My first/top priority is to find somewhere to live.  我首先要考虑的是找个地方住。
You have to learn to get your priorities right/straight (= decide which are the most important jobs or problems and deal with them first).  你必须学会先处理最重要的事。

words.meaning: n. v.  要求，请求
words.example:
They received hundreds of requests for more information.  数以百计的人要求他们提供更多的资讯。
The clause was added to the contract at Carlos's request (= because Carlos asked for this).  这一条款是在卡洛斯的要求下添加到合同中的。
An application form will be sent to you on request (= if you ask).  申请表格承索即寄。    Compare order

words.meaning: n.  感情; 情绪
words.example:
Like a lot of men, he finds it hard to express his emotions.  像很多男人一样，他不大会表达自己的感情。
My mother was overcome with emotion and burst into tears.  我母亲控制不住自己的感情，泪如雨下。

words.meaning: a.  引人注目的; 戏剧性的; 生动的
words.example:
We watched scenes of the dramatic (= exciting) rescue on the news.  我们在新闻中看到了惊心动魄的救援场面。UK adjective
She bought me the complete dramatic works (= texts to be performed) of Brecht for my birthday.  她买了全套的布莱希特戏剧集送给我作生日礼物。

words.meaning: n.  宇宙,星系,思想等范围
words.example:
Is there intelligent life elsewhere in the universe?  宇宙中其他地方存在有智慧的生命吗？
Scientists have speculated about the possibility of parallel universes.  有科学家思考过平行世界存在的可能性。
The characters in his novels inhabit a bleak and hopeless universe.  他小说中的人物生活在一个悲凄无望的世界里。

words.meaning: n.  缝隙,缺口,间断vt.  打开缺口,造成缝隙vi.  豁开n.  间距n.  通用
words.example:
The children squeezed through a gap in the wall.  孩子们从墙的一个缺口处硬挤了过去。
She has a small gap between her front teeth.  她的门牙之间有条细缝。
There is a gap in the magazine market that needs to be filled.  在杂志市场上还有一个缺口需要填补。noun

words.meaning: a.  优良的,杰出的,出色的
words.example:
The food was excellent.  这食物非常美味。
Her car is in excellent condition.  她的汽车车况非常好。
The fall in interest rates is excellent news for borrowers.  对于借贷人来讲，利率降低是个好消息。

words.meaning: n.  拖,拖累vt. vi.  拖累,拖拉,慢条斯理地走v.  拖动
words.example:
Pick the chair up instead of dragging it behind you!  把椅子拿起来，不要在地上拖！
She dragged the canoe down to the water.  她把独木舟拉到水边。
She had to drag her child away from the toy shop.  她不得不把孩子从玩具店硬拉出来。

words.meaning: n. pl.  议程,应办事项
words.example:
There were several important items on the agenda.  会议议程中有几项重要的议题。
The question of security is high on the agenda for this afternoon's meeting.  今天下午的议程中，安全问题是首要议题。
Women's rights have been put back on the agenda (= are being discussed publicly again).  妇女权益的问题再次得到广泛关注。

words.meaning: vt.  重新获得,恢复,复原,使改过vi.  痊愈,复原,胜诉v.  恢复
words.example:
It took her a long while to recover (= become completely well again) from/after her heart operation.  她心脏动手术后很长时间身体才复原。
He never really recovered from the shock of his wife dying (= He was never happy after his wife died).  他再也没有从丧妻之痛中真正恢复过来。
She went into a coma and died without recovering consciousness.  她陷入昏迷后再也没有醒过来。

words.meaning: n.  选择,选文,选品
words.example:
Success is achieved by the careful selection of projects.  成功是靠仔细慎选计划而取得的。
The coach made her selection (= chose who she wanted) for the team.  教练为球队挑选了她的意中人选。
Most schools would have a good selection of these books in their libraries.  大多数学校的图书馆都有许多这样的书供选择。

words.meaning: n.  日常饮食,议会vt.  照规定饮食vi.  忌食
words.example:
Diet varies between different countries in the world.  世界各国的饮食各不相同。
Rice is the staple diet (= most important food) of many people in China.  在中国大米是很多人的主食。
The children seem to exist on a diet of burgers and chips.  孩子们好像离不开汉堡包和炸薯条。

words.meaning: n.  用发行长期债券的方法来收回短期债券
words.example:
Ian is trying to get funding for his research.  伊恩正在为他的研究寻求资助。
They received state funding for the project.  这个企划案他们得到了国家的资助。

words.meaning: n.  治疗，疗法
words.example: Joining a club can be a therapy for loneliness.  加入俱乐部可能是消解孤独的一种方法。

words.meaning: n.  时间表,一览表,计划表,议事日程vt.  预定,编制目录,制. . . 表,安
words.example:
Everything went according to schedule (= as planned).  一切按照排程进行。
We expect the building work to be completed ahead of schedule.  我们希望建筑工程能提前竣工。
The meeting has been scheduled for tomorrow afternoon.  会议安排在明天下午。

words.meaning: a.  简短的，短暂的
words.example:
His acceptance speech was mercifully brief.  幸而他的提名演讲很简短。
It'll only be a brief visit because we really haven't much time.  我们的时间真的不多，所以只能作短暂的参观游览。
After a brief spell/stint in the army, he started working as a teacher.  在军队呆了短暂的一段时间以后，他当起了教师。

words.meaning: n.  购买,购买品,起重装置,紧握,价值vt.  购买,赢得,努力取得,举起
words.example:
Tickets must be purchased two weeks in advance.  门票必须提前两周购买。
Except under clearly defined circumstances, it is illegal in Britain for a company to purchase its own shares.  在英国，除非是在明确规定的情况下，否则一间公司购买自己的股票是违法的。
She purchased her first house with the money.  她用这笔钱买了她的第一栋房子。UK US  formal

words.meaning: a.  视觉的; 看得见的
words.example: visual stimulus/impact/abilities  视觉刺激／冲击／视力

words.meaning: adv.  相当地; 公正地
words.example:
She's fairly tall.  她个子比较高。
I'm fairly sure that this is the right address.  我相当肯定这个地址没错。
We get on fairly well.  我们相处得不错。

words.meaning: n.  碎片; 芯片; v.  削(或凿)下
words.example:
Polly fell and knocked a chip out of her front tooth.  波莉摔了一跤，磕掉了一小块门牙。
This mug's got a chip in it/ out of it.  这个马克杯上有个缺口。noun
figurative The hostages are being held as a bargaining chip by terrorist organizations.  恐怖组织扣押了人质作为讨价还价的筹码。noun

words.meaning: a.  暴力的,猛烈的,激烈的,歪曲的,凶暴的,极端的
words.example:
He shouts a lot but I don't think he's ever been physically violent towards her.  他常大吼大叫，但我认为他不曾对她使用暴力。
There was a violent clash/confrontation between rival supporters after the match.  那次比赛后两队的支持者发生了暴力冲突。
The more violent scenes in the film were cut when it was shown on television.  这部电影在电视上播放时剪掉了一些更为暴力的镜头。

words.meaning: vt.  推想,假设,假定,猜想,以为vi.  料想
words.example:
He found it a lot more difficult to get a job than he supposed it would be.  他发现找工作比他想像的要难多了。
It is widely supposed (that) the minister will be forced to resign.  很多人都猜测首相会被迫辞职。
Her new book is supposed to be (= generally people think it is) very good.  大多数人都认为她的新书写得很好。

words.meaning: vt.  感觉,认知,理解
words.example:
How do the French perceive the British?  法国人是如何看待英国人的？
Women's magazines are often perceived to be superficial.  人们往往认为女性杂志内容肤浅。UK verb transitive
Bill perceived a tiny figure in the distance.  比尔注意到远处有个很小的身影。

words.meaning: n.  比较; 比喻
words.example:
They made a comparison of different countries' eating habits.  他们对不同国家的饮食习惯作了一番比较。
By/In comparison with the French, the British eat far less fish.  与法国人相比，英国人吃鱼要少得多。UK noun countable or uncountable
She drew a comparison between life in the army and life in prison.  她把军队生活和狱中生活作了比较。

words.meaning: n.  住宅区
words.example:
It now seems unlikely that it will be possible to negotiate/reach a peaceful settlement of the conflict.  现在看来和平解决这一冲突是不可能的。
As part of their divorce settlement, Geoff agreed to let Polly keep the house.  作为离婚协议的一部分，杰夫同意房子归波莉所有。
They reached an out-of-court settlement.  他们达成了庭外和解。

words.meaning: n.  层，层次
words.example:
There was a thin layer of oil on the surface of the water.  水面上有一层薄薄的油膜。
We stripped several layers of paint off the door.  我们从门上剥落了好几层漆。UK verb transitive
Layer the pasta with slices of tomato.  把番茄片分层摆放在义大利粉里。

words.meaning: v.  滑动; n.  滑动; 幻灯片
words.example:
When I was little I used to like sliding on the polished floor in my socks.  小时候我喜欢穿着短袜在光亮的地板上滑行。
We've got one of those doors in the kitchen that slides open.  我们厨房的门中有一扇装的是那种滑动开关的。
He slid the letter into his pocket while no one was looking.  趁没人看见，他把信塞进了口袋。

words.meaning: v.  通知; 告诉
words.example:
The name of the dead man will not be released until his relatives have been informed.  在通知死者亲属之前，不会公布死者的姓名。
Why wasn't I informed about this earlier?  为甚么不早点将这件事通知我？
Walters was not properly informed of the reasons for her arrest.  沃尔特斯并未按规定被告知其被捕的原因。

words.meaning: n.  部分,一份,命运,嫁妆vt.  将. . . 分配,分配,给. . . 嫁妆
words.example:
The portions are very generous in this restaurant.  这家餐厅每道菜量都很足。verb UK   Phrasal Verbs   [M] portion sth out
We'll have to portion the money out among/between the six of us.  我们得把这些钱在我们六个人中分。

words.meaning: n.  领土，领域
words.example:
He was shot down in enemy territory.  他在敌方领土上被击落。
The UN is sending aid to the occupied territories.  联合国正在向被占领地区提供援助。
The robin keeps other birds off that part of the garden - that's his territory.  这只知更鸟不许其他鸟进入花园的那块地方，那是它的领地。UK noun countable or uncountable

words.meaning: a.  立即的,直接的,近的
words.example:
We must make an immediate response.  我们必须立即作出反应。
Dioxin is a poison that takes immediate effect.  二恶英是一种速效毒药。
There are few facilities in the immediate area.  在邻近地区几乎没有甚么设施。

words.meaning: n.  对手,敌手,反对者a.  敌对的,反对的
words.example:
Leading opponents of the proposed cuts in defence spending will meet later today.  反对削减国防开支建议的带头人将在今天晚些时候会面。
In the second game, her opponent hurt her leg and had to retire.  在第二局，她的对手拉伤了腿，不得不退出比赛。

words.meaning: vt.  放弃,沉溺n.  放任
words.example:
We had to abandon the car.  我们不得不弃车而去。
By the time the rebel troops arrived, the village had already been abandoned.  当叛军杀到时，村民已经撤离了村庄。
As a baby he'd been abandoned by his mother.  他在繦褓之中就被母亲遗弃了。

words.meaning: vt.  转换,改变,改造,使. . . 变形vi.  改变,转化,变换
words.example: The reorganization will transform the British entertainment industry.  这次重组将使英国的娱乐业大为改观。

words.meaning: n.  紧张; 拉紧; 张力
words.example:
You could feel the tension in the room as we waited for our exam results.  我们等待考试结果出来的时候，你可以感觉到屋里的紧张气氛。
There are growing tensions betweeen the two countries.  两国间的关系日益紧张。noun

words.meaning: n.  领导,指挥,疏导,铅板a.  领导的,主要的,在前的
words.example: a leading expert on the country's ecology  研究该国生态的顶级专家

words.meaning: vt.  使能够
words.example: The upgrade will enable faster charging.  升级后能实现更快充电。

words.meaning: n.  节省; [常pl.  ]存款，积蓄
words.example:
He spent all his savings on an expensive car.  他花了自己所有的存款买了一辆昂贵的汽车。
You can make huge savings (= save a lot of money) by buying food in bulk.  大量购买食品会省下很多钱。

words.meaning: n.  沙漠a.  沙漠的,不毛的vt.  放弃,遗弃,逃跑vi.  逃掉n.  应得的赏
words.example:
They were lost in the desert for nine days.  他们在沙漠里迷路已经有9天了。
We had to cross a large area of arid, featureless desert.  我们必须穿越一大片干燥荒芜的沙漠。
This town is a cultural/intellectual desert.  这个城镇是一片文化沙漠。verb UK RUN AWAY  跑掉

words.meaning: vt.  保护,保持,维护,保存,保藏,维持,禁猎vi.  做蜜饯,禁猎n.  蜜饯,果
words.example:
We want to preserve the character of the town while improving the facilities.  我们想在改善市镇设施的同时保存其特色。
The agreement preserved our right to limit trade in endangered species.  这项协定保留了我们限制濒危物种贸易的权利。
Putting varnish on wood is a way of preserving it.  在木料上涂清漆是保护木料的一种方法。

words.meaning: n.  文章，一段
words.example:
The bathroom's on the right at the end of the passage.  浴室在走廊尽头的右边。
Several passages from the book were printed in a national newspaper before it was published.  该书出版前，书中有几段文字被刊载在一份全国性的报纸上。noun
The gunman then took a hostage and demanded a plane and safe passage to an unspecified destination.  持枪歹徒随后劫持了一名人质，要求派飞机把他安全送到某个未指明的目的地。

words.meaning: a.  正式的,形式的,礼仪的n.  正式的社交活动
words.example: Tom had little in the way of a formal education.  汤姆没怎么受过正规教育。UK adjective

words.meaning: n.  转变,转换,变调,过渡时期,跃迁
words.example:
The health-care system is in transition at the moment.  医疗保健制度目前正在变革。
There will be an interim government to oversee the transition to democracy.  将会有一个临时政府来进行监督过度到民主政治的过程。

words.meaning: vt. vi.  安排,排列,协商
words.example:
I'm trying to arrange my work so that I can have a couple of days off next week.  我正设法把工作安排好，以便下周能够休息一两天。
The meeting has been arranged for Wednesday.  会议已经安排在周三了。
I've already arranged with him to meet at the cinema.  我已和他约好了在电影院见面。

words.meaning: n.  大气,气氛
words.example:
These factories are releasing toxic gases into the atmosphere.  这些工厂向大气中排放有毒气体。
The atmosphere in the room was so stuffy I could hardly breathe.  房间里空气污浊，我都快喘不过气来了。
There's a very relaxed atmosphere in our office.  我们办公室的气氛非常轻松。

words.meaning: n.  关节; 接合处
words.example:
The project was a joint effort/venture between the two schools (= they worked on it together).  这个项目是两所学校共同合作的。
The two Russian ice-skaters came joint second (= They were both given second prize) in the world championship.  两名俄罗斯溜冰运动员在世界锦标赛中并列第二。
In court, the parents were awarded joint custody of their son (= the right to care for him was shared between them).  法庭上这对父母获判对他们的儿子共同拥有监护权。

words.meaning: a.  (to)对立的，相反的; n.  相反的事物
words.example:
You'd never know they're sisters - they're completely opposite to each other in every way.  你怎样也不会知道她们是姐妹——她们各方面都全然不同。
Police attempts to calm the violence had the opposite effect.  警方试图平息暴力活动，却适得其反。UK adjective
My brother and I live on opposite sides of London.  我哥哥和我住在伦敦两个方向相反的区。

words.meaning: vt.  该得到,值得vi.  应得报答
words.example:
After all that hard work, you deserve a holiday.  辛劳过后，你该放假了。
Chris deserves our special thanks for all his efforts.  我们应该特别感谢克里斯所付出的心血。
She deserves a medal for putting up with that husband of hers.  她能够忍受那样的丈夫真不容易。UK verb transitive not continuous

words.meaning: a.  一致的; 稳定的; 调和的; 始终如一的
words.example:
There has been a consistent improvement in her attitude.  她的态度一直在改进。
Her work is sometimes good, but the problem is she's not consistent.  她工作有时不错，问题是她不能始终如一。    Opposite inconsistentadjective
What the witness said in court was not consistent with the statement he made to the police.  证人在法庭上的证供和他对警方的陈述不一致。

words.meaning: n.  暴露,揭发,揭露
words.example:
You should always limit your exposure to the sun.  无论甚么时候，都不要长时间晒太阳。
Even a brief exposure to radiation is very dangerous.  即使只是短期接受辐射也是非常危险的。UK noun
The exposure of the minister's love affair forced him to resign.  部长在风流韵事曝光后，被迫辞职。UK noun

words.meaning: n.  姿势,姿态,装模作样,伪装vi.  摆姿势,装模作样,假装vt.  使摆好姿
words.example:
Nuclear weapons pose a threat to everyone.  核子武器对所有人都构成了威胁。
The mountain terrain poses particular problems for civil engineers.  这个高山地势为土木工程师带来了特殊问题。UK verb
Can we go back to the question that Helena posed earlier?  我们能否回到海伦娜早先提出的那个问题？UK verb

words.meaning: n.  溪流; 股; v.  涌
words.example:
There's a lovely stream that flows through their garden.  有一条美丽的小溪流过他们的花园。
She stopped rowing and let the boat float with the stream.  她不再划，任由小船顺流漂荡。noun countable
There has been a steady stream of phone calls from worried customers.  不断有忧心忡忡的顾客打电话来。

words.meaning: a.  壮观的,显赫的,神气活现的,重大的,主要的,最高的,雄伟的,傲?豪华的
words.example:
She has all kinds of grand ideas.  她脑子里都是些经天纬地的想法。
His job has a grand title, but he's little more than a clerk.  他的工作听起来名堂很大，可他不过是个职员。adjective
The Palace of Versailles is very grand.  凡尔赛宫非常宏伟。

words.meaning: n.  矿,富源,地雷vt.  挖掘,开采,在. . . 布雷,破坏vi.  开矿,埋设地雷
words.example:
Your son is the same age as mine.  你儿子的年纪和我儿子一样大。
She's an old friend of mine.  她是我的一个老朋友。noun countable
My grandfather used to work in/ UKdown the mines.  我祖父以前在矿井里工作。noun countable

words.meaning: n.  决定之事,决心,坚决vi.  决定,分解,决心vt.  使分解,解析,决心,消
words.example:
Have you resolved the problem of transport yet?  你们解决交通问题了吗？
The couple resolved their differences and made an effort to get along.  这对夫妻消除了他们之间的分歧，尽力融洽相处。UK verb

words.meaning: n.  时期,局面,阶段vt.  使调整相位,逐步执行,实行
words.example:
The project is only in the initial phase as yet, but it's looking quite promising.  该专案计划到目前为止才刚起步，但看起来大有可为。
We're entering a new phase in international relations.  我们现正进入国际关系的新阶段。
When I was in my early teens I went through a phase of only ever wearing black.  我在十几岁的时候有一阵子只穿黑色衣服。

words.meaning: n.  症状,征候,征兆
words.example:
He's complaining of all the usual flu symptoms - a high temperature, headache and so on.  他抱怨所有常见的感冒症状——高烧、头痛等，都出现在他身上。
He's been HIV-positive for six years, but just recently he's started to develop the symptoms of AIDS.  他 HIV 病毒检测呈阳性反应已有六年了，但直到最近才开始出现爱滋病的征状。
It's her feeling that the recent outbreaks of violence are a symptom of the dissatisfaction that is currently affecting our society.  她觉得最近爆发的暴力事件，显示了目前不满的情绪正在影响我们的社会。

words.meaning: n.  哲学，人生观
words.example:
René Descartes is regarded as the founder of modern philosophy.  勒奈‧笛卡尔被视为现代哲学的奠基人。
Live now, pay later - that's my philosophy of life !  现在享受，以后付出——这是我的人生哲学。

words.meaning: n.  引文; v.  引用
words.example:
He's always quoting from the Bible.  他总是引用《圣经》上的话。
"If they're flexible, we're flexible", the official was quoted as saying.  援引那位官员的话说：“如果他们能变通，我们也能变通。”
She worked, to quote her daughter, "as if there was no tomorrow".  用她女儿的话来说，她工作起来“就像没有明天似的”。

words.meaning: n.  商议; 谈判
words.example:
The agreement was reached after a series of difficult negotiations.  该协议是经历了一系列艰难的谈判之后达成的。
The exact details of the agreement are still under negotiation.  协议的确切条款尚待磋商。
Negotiation for the pay increase is likely to take several weeks.  加薪谈判可能要持续数周。

words.meaning: n.  冲动,推动力,迫切的要求vt.  驱策,力劝,力陈,推动vi.  强烈要求
words.example:
The two of them seem unable to control their sexual urges.  他们两个似乎欲火焚身。
Police urged continued vigilance in the fight against crime.  警方呼吁继续保持警惕打击犯罪。
The dogs are urged into fighting more fiercely by loud shouts from the crowd.  人群里发出的高声叫喊使这些狗咬斗得更凶了。

words.meaning: vt.  捆扎; 塞满; n.  包裹
words.example:
We're leaving early tomorrow morning, so you'd better pack (= put clothes and other possessions into a bag or bags) tonight.  我们明天一大早就要出发，所以你最好今晚就收拾行李。
She packed a small suitcase for the weekend.  她收拾好一小箱行李准备度周末。
He just packed his bags and walked out on his wife and children.  他收拾了行李就抛下妻儿离家出走了。

words.meaning: a.  很多的,数目众多的,多数的
words.example:
We have discussed these plans on numerous occasions.  我们已经多次讨论过这些计划。
