Shops of this type, once rare, are now numerous (= there are many of them).  这种商店从前很少见，但现在已经遍地开花。

words.meaning: n.  物质; 要旨，实质
words.example:
What sort of substance could withstand those temperatures?  哪种物质能够承受那样的温度？
There is no substance in/to the allegation.  这项指控毫无根据。
This new information gives substance to the stories we have heard.  这项新资讯为我们所听到的情况提供了根据。

words.meaning: n.  纪律; 学科; v.  训练; 惩罚
words.example:
There should be better discipline in schools.  学校的纪律应该更严一些。
Maintaining classroom discipline (= control of the students) is the first task of every teacher.  维护课堂纪律是每位教师的首要任务。noun

words.meaning: a.  实际的,现实的,实用性的
words.example:
Qualifications are important but practical experience is always an advantage.  资历固然重要，但实际经验总是个优势。
The service offers young people practical advice on finding a job.  这项服务为年轻人提供就业方面的实用建议。
What's the use of theoretical knowledge that has no practical application ?  理论知识如果没有实际应用又有甚么用呢？

words.meaning: n.  激情，热情
words.example:
Football arouses a good deal of passion among its supporters.  足球唤起了球迷巨大的热情。
At school, his early interest in music developed into an abiding passion.  他早年对音乐萌生的兴趣在求学时期发展成一种始终不渝的热爱。
Politics and philosophy were his lifelong passions.  政治学和哲学是他毕生热爱的学科。

words.meaning: n.  志愿者a.  志愿的vt. vi.  自愿
words.example:
The Health clinic is relying on volunteers to run the office and answer the telephones.  这家健康门诊依靠志愿者来负责办公室的日常工作和接听电话。
Since it would be a highly dangerous mission, the Lieutenant asked for volunteers.  由于那项任务非常危险，所以中尉请大家自告奋勇。
It's a volunteer army with no paid professionals.  这是一支志愿军，没有领军饷的职业军人。    Compare conscriptUK verb

words.meaning: n.  工具,器具vt.  实现,使生效,执行
words.example:
The changes to the national health system will be implemented next year.  国民医疗保健制度的改革将于明年实行。noun countable /ˈɪm.plɪ.mənt/
Shopkeepers are not supposed to sell knives and other sharp implements to children.  店主不应该向儿童出售小刀或其他锋利的器具。

words.meaning: n.  基因
words.example: The illness is believed to be caused by a defective gene.  据信，这种疾病是由基因缺陷引起的。

words.meaning: n.  沙司; 调味汁，佐料
words.example:
Gran's been on the sauce again - she's passed out in the den.  奶奶又喝酒了——她醉倒在房间里。UK noun
That's enough of your sauce, my girl!  你无礼的话说够了吧，我的小姐！UK noun

words.meaning: a.  非常的,强烈的,紧张的,热情的
words.example: He suddenly felt an intense pain in his back.  他突然觉得背部一阵剧痛。

words.meaning: n.  前进,进步,进步的例子vi.  前进,增加,上涨vt.  促进,提出,提高,预
words.example:
The fire advanced steadily through the forest.  大火在森林中不断蔓延。
The troops advanced on the city (= approached it, ready to attack).  军队向该城推进。
We have advanced greatly in our knowledge of the universe.  在认识宇宙方面，我们已经取得长足的进步。

words.meaning: n.  雇主,老板
words.example: We need a reference from your former employer.  我们需要你前任雇主的推荐信。UK noun countable

words.meaning: vt.  鼓舞，激励; 给…以灵感
words.example:
His confident leadership inspired his followers.  他那自信的领导风采激励着他的追随者。
She inspires great loyalty among her followers.  她激起了追随者强烈的忠诚感。
The captain's heroic effort inspired them with determination.  船长的英勇行为激发了他们的决心。

words.meaning: vt.  调整,使适应于,校准vi.  调整,适应于,校准
words.example:
If the chair is too high you can adjust it to suit you.  如果椅子太高了，你可以把它调到适合你的高度。
As a teacher you have to adjust your methods to suit the needs of slower children.  作为一名老师，你必须调整教学方法来适应那些学得较慢的孩子的需要。
She adjusted her skirt, took a deep breath and walked into the room.  她整理一下裙子，深吸一口气，走进了房间。verb

words.meaning: a.  看得见的，明显的
words.example:
You should wear something light-coloured when you're cycling at night so that you're more visible.  夜里骑脚踏车的时候你应该穿浅色的衣服，这样就会更加显眼。
The writing on the tombstone was barely visible.  墓碑上的文字看不大清楚了。
There are few visible signs of the illness that kept her in hospital for so long.  她因病住院这么久，但表面上却看不出甚么症状。

words.meaning: n.  汁，液
words.example:
Fry the meat first to seal in the juices.  先把肉煎一煎锁住肉汁。noun
My cousin Gianni's got all the juice in this neighborhood.  我的堂哥吉安尼在这一带很有影响力。noun
This early in the morning it's hard to get the creative juices flowing (= to start thinking of good ideas).  这么一大早很难想出甚么好点子。

words.meaning: vt. vi.  支配,占优势
words.example:
He refuses to let others speak and dominates every meeting.  每次开会他都专横跋扈，不让他人讲话。
They work as a group - no one person is allowed to dominate.  他们以团队的形式工作——不允许其中任何人独揽大权。

words.meaning: v.  转移; 转学; n.  转移; 换乘
words.example:
Black's transfer to an Italian football club came as a shock to Coventry supporters.  布莱克转会到义大利足球会，使考文垂队的球迷大为震惊。
The official transfer of ownership will take a few days to complete.  所有权的正式移交要花几天时间才能办妥。noun UK SPORTS  运动
They've a new transfer from Tottenham playing for them.  他们有一个从托特纳姆队转会来为他们效力的新球员。noun UK TRAVEL TICKET  车票

words.meaning: vt.  分析，研究
words.example: Analyze the data before drawing conclusions.  下结论前先分析数据。

words.meaning: vt.  连接; 贴上，依附于
words.example:
Use this cable to attach the printer to the computer.  用这条数据线连接列印机和电脑。
In Britain, packets of cigarettes come with a government health warning attached to them (= on them).  在英国，香烟的包装盒上都印有政府的健康警告。
slightly formal I attach (= am sending, usually with a letter) a copy of our latest report.  兹附上我们的最新报告一份。    Compare detachverb transitive

words.meaning: n.  灾祸,不幸
words.example:
An inquiry was ordered into the recent rail disaster (= a serious train accident).  有关方面下令调查最近这次铁路灾难事故。
It would be a disaster for me if I lost my job.  对我而言，如果丢了工作那将是一场灾难。
This is one of the worst natural disasters ever to befall the area.  这是该地区所经历的最严重的自然灾害之一。

words.meaning: n.  景色,希望,展望vt.  勘探,寻找vi.  勘探,有前途
words.example:
Is there any prospect of the weather improving?  天气有可能好转吗？
There seems little prospect of an end to the dispute.  争端似乎不大可能平息。
There's every prospect of success.  有百分之百成功的希望。

words.meaning: n.  诉苦,抱怨,控诉
words.example:
We've received a complaint from one of our listeners about offensive language.  我们收到了一位听众有关用语粗俗的投诉。
I've made a complaint (= formally complained) to the police about the noise.  我向警方投诉了噪音问题。
Do you have any grounds for complaint (= reason to formally complain) ?  你有投诉的理由吗？

words.meaning: n. [常pl.  ]锦标赛
words.example:
The world championships will be held in Scotland next year.  世界锦标赛将于明年在苏格兰举行。
He has been playing championship tennis for three years now.  他参加网球锦标赛至今已有三年了。
She has held the championship for the past three years.  在过去三年里她一直保持着冠军称号。noun

words.meaning: n.  基本原理,原则,基谐波a.  基本的,重要的,原音的
words.example:
We need to make fundamental changes to the way in which we treat our environment.  我们需要从根本上改变对待环境的态度。
It's one of the fundamental differences between men and women.  这是男女之间的基本差别之一。
The school is based on the fundamental principle that each child should develop its full potential.  这所学校的基本原则是充分发挥每个孩子的最大潜力。

words.meaning: a.  严格的,凶猛的,严肃的,朴素的,严厉的,严重的
words.example:
This is a school for children with severe learning difficulties.  这是一所为有严重学习障碍的孩子设立的学校。
In parts of Africa there is a severe food/water shortage.  非洲的一些地方存在严重的粮食／水资源短缺问题。
There is expected to be a severe frost tonight.  今晚预计会出现严重的霜冻。

words.meaning: vt.  提高,加强,增加
words.example: These scandals will not enhance the organization's reputation.  这些丑闻并不会提高这个组织的声誉。

words.meaning: vt.  把…强加于; 征(税)
words.example:
Very high taxes have recently been imposed on cigarettes.  最近对香烟开征很高的税。
Judges are imposing increasingly heavy fines for minor driving offences.  法官对轻微的违规驾驶开始处以越来越重的罚款。
The council has imposed a ban on alcohol in the city parks.  市政会禁止在城市公园中饮酒。

words.meaning: n.  贫困
words.example:
Two million people in the city live in abject (= very great) poverty.  这个城市有两百万人生活在赤贫中。
He emigrated to Australia to escape the grinding (= very great) poverty of his birthplace.  他为了逃避家乡极为贫困的生活而移民到了澳大利亚。
Helping to alleviate poverty in developing countries also helps to reduce environmental destruction.  帮助缓解开发中国家的贫困也有助减少对环境的破坏。

words.meaning: n.  进入(权); 入口处
words.example:
The actress's entry into the world of politics surprised most people.  这位女演员进入了政界，这使得大多数人都感到诧异。
She made her entry to the ceremony surrounded by a group of photographers.  她在一群摄影师的簇拥下走进典礼仪式现场。
The burglars gained entry by a top window.  窃贼是从屋顶的天窗进入室内的。

words.meaning: vt.  评估,评价,赋值
words.example: It's impossible to evaluate these results without knowing more about the research methods employed.  如不能对使用的研究方法有更多了解，就无法对其结果作出评价。

words.meaning: n.  符号,象征,代号,信条
words.example:
The wheel in the Indian flag is a symbol of peace.  印度国旗上的轮子象征和平。    Compare emblem
Water, a symbol of life, recurs as an image throughout her poems.  水作为生命的一种象征，在她的诗歌中反覆出现。
The symbol for oxygen is O 2.  氧的化学元素符号是 O2。

words.meaning: vt.  达到; 完成; 实现
words.example:
The students accomplished the task in less than ten minutes.  学生不到十分钟就完成了任务。
She accomplished such a lot during her visit.  她在访问期间取得了丰硕的成果。

words.meaning: vt.  举例说明,作图解,阐明vi.  举例
words.example:
The lecturer illustrated his point with a diagram on the blackboard.  讲师在黑板上用图表来说明自己的观点。
This latest conflict further illustrates the weakness of the UN.  最近的这次冲突进一步说明了联合国的软弱。

words.meaning: n.  监督器,级长,监听员,告诫物,监视器,班长vt. vi.  监视,监听,监督n.
words.example:
United Nations monitors were not allowed to enter the area.  联合国核查员没有获准进入这个地区。UK noun countable
Doctors watched the old man's heartbeat on a monitor.  医生透过萤幕监测着这个老翁的心跳。UK noun countable
The new findings suggest that women ought to monitor their cholesterol levels.  新发现显示女性应当注意她们的胆固醇浓度。

words.meaning: n.  司令官,指挥官
words.example: The commander ordered the troops to hold.  指挥官命令部队坚守。

words.meaning: n.  山顶,顶点,帽舌a.  最高的vi.  到达最高点,消瘦,缩小vt.  使竖起,
words.example:
Holiday flights reach a peak during August.  八月份度假班机的数量达到高峰。
Beat the egg whites until they are stiff enough to form firm peaks.  不停地搅拌蛋白直至其变成硬尖状为止。
We saw a victory by an athlete at the very peak of her fitness and career.  我们见证过一位运动员在她的体能和运动生涯的颠峰时期取得比赛胜利。noun countable

words.meaning: n.  混乱，动乱; 失调
words.example:
The whole office was in a state of disorder.  整个办公室里凌乱不堪。
The opposition party have been in such disorder for so long that they pose no real threat to the present government.  反对党长期处于混乱状态，因而不会对现政府构成真正的威胁。UK noun
The family have a history of mental disorder.  该家族有精神病史。UK noun

words.meaning: vt.  改变,使多样化vi.  变化,不同,违反
words.example:
Salary scales vary between states/ from state to state/ according to state/ with each state.  工资高低各州／州与州／不同的州／每个州都不同。
The samples varied in quality but were generally acceptable.  这些样品品质有差异，但是大体上可以接受。UK verb intransitive or transitive
My taste in classical music varies greatly/widely , but I usually prefer Mozart or Brahms.  我对各种古典音乐的喜好程度很不相同，但我通常比较喜欢莫劄特或布拉姆斯的音乐。

words.meaning: n. v.  命令; 指挥，掌握
words.example:
You will run forward at (= when you hear) my command.  听到我的命令你们就向前冲。
When I give the command, fire!  我一下命令就开火！
He hated being in the army because he had to obey commands.  他讨厌当兵，因为当兵必须服从命令。

words.meaning: n.  委任状,任官令,命令,佣金,代办,委托,犯法vt.  委任,委托制作,使服
words.example:
The newspaper commissioned a series of articles on the worst excesses of the fashion industry.  报社请人撰写了一系列针砭时装界放肆行为的文章。verb
Grandfather was commissioned as Group Captain in the RAF just before the war.  就在战争爆发前夕祖父获任命为皇家空军上校。noun
The government have set up / established a commission to investigate the problem of inner city violence.  政府设立了专门委员会来调查市中心区的暴力问题。noun

words.meaning: a.  所谓的
words.example:
It was one of his so-called friends who supplied him with the drugs that killed him.  是他一个所谓的朋友提供毒品给他，让他因此丧命。
It isn't yet clear how destructive this so-called 'super virus' is.  目前还不清楚这种名叫“超级病毒”的东西有多大的破坏力。

words.meaning: n.  常数,恒量a.  不变的,一定的,时常的
words.example:
He's in constant trouble with the police.  他与警方麻烦不断。
We've kept up a fairly constant speed.  我们保持了比较平稳的速度。
The fridge keeps food at a constant temperature.  冰箱在恒温下保存食物。UK adjective

words.meaning: n.  诊所,临床教学
words.example:
Bring your baby to the clinic and we'll take a look at her.  把你的宝宝带到诊所来，我们帮她检查一下。
Antenatal clinics provide care for pregnant women.  产前检查诊所为孕妇提供医疗服务。noun countable
Dr Clark holds a clinic on Tuesday mornings.  克拉克医生每周二上午门诊。    UK

words.meaning: n.  老手,退伍军人,老兵,老树a.  老兵的,老练的,经验丰富的
words.example:
She's also a veteran campaigner for human rights.  她还是一位经验丰富的人权活动家。
He collects veteran cars (= cars made before 1905).  他收藏老爷车（1905年前生产的车）。    Compare vintage

words.meaning: n.  味道,气味,嗅觉,风味,臭味,嗅vt.  闻,探出,察觉,发出. . . 的味道v
words.example:
My hands smell UKof / USlike onions.  我手上有洋葱味。
That cake smells good.  那蛋糕闻起来不错。
There's something in the fridge that smells mouldy.  冰箱里有东西闻起来发霉了。

words.meaning: a.  有能力的,能的,能干的
words.example:
She's a very capable woman/worker/judge.  她是个很能干的女人／很熟练的工人／能力很强的法官。
We need to get an assistant who's capable and efficient.  我们需要一个能力强、效率高的助理。
Only the Democratic Party is capable of running the country.  只有民主党才有能力治理这个国家。

words.meaning: a.  神经紧张的,不安的,神经的
words.example:
Do you feel/get nervous during exams?  考试时，你感到紧张吗？
She's always been nervous around dogs.  她一直很怕狗。
He had/was of a nervous disposition.  他是个神经质的人。

words.meaning: a.  决定性的,重要的,严厉的
words.example: Her work has been crucial to the project's success.  她的工作对于这个专案的成功至关重要。

words.meaning: n.  例外,除外,异议
words.example:
Men are usually quite good at map-reading but Tim is the exception.  通常男性都很会看地图，但提姆却是例外的。
There are exceptions to every rule.  每条规则都有例外。
Her books are always entertaining and this one is no exception.  她写的书总是妙趣横生，这本也不例外。

words.meaning: n.  奶油,黄油vt.  涂黄油于
words.example:
We were served scones with butter and jam.  我们吃的是涂有奶油和果酱的烤饼。
Have some bread and butter (= bread spread with butter).  吃些奶油面包片吧。
Tommy looked as if butter wouldn't melt in his mouth.  汤美装出一副老实相。UK verb transitive

words.meaning: n.  赤字,不足额
words.example:
The country is running a balance-of-payments/budget/trade deficit of $250 million.  该国的收支差额／预算赤字／贸易逆差已达2.5亿美元。
The UK's deficit in manufactured goods fell slightly in the last three months.  在过去的三个月里，英国制造业的亏损略有好转。

words.meaning: n.  目的,受格,实物a.  客观的,外在的,受词的
words.example:
Her main/prime objective now is simply to stay in power.  她现在的主要目标就是继续掌权。
Can the sales force achieve/meet its financial objectives?  销售人员能否完成财务目标？adjective

words.meaning: n.  盟友,同盟国vt.  联盟,联合,与. . . 有关系vi.  结盟
words.example:
North Korea is one of China's staunchest allies.  朝鲜是中国最忠实的盟友之一。
During World War One, Turkey and Germany were allies/Turkey was an ally of Germany.  在第一次世界大战期间，土耳其和德国是盟国／土耳其是德国的盟国。
He is generally considered to be the Prime Minister's closest political ally.  人们普遍认为他是首相最亲密的政治盟友。verb[əˈlaɪ/

words.meaning: n.  塔,高楼,堡垒vi.  高耸,翱翔
words.example:
There's a clock on the church tower.  教堂塔楼上有一座钟。
He works in an office tower in downtown San Francisco.  他在旧金山市中心的一座高层办公大楼里工作。
Polly was a tower of strength to me when I was ill.  我生病时，波莉就是我的精神支柱。UK verb intransitive usually + adverb or preposition

words.meaning: vt.  使面临; 对抗
words.example:
As she left the court, she was confronted by angry crowds who tried to block her way.  她离开法庭时，愤怒的人群试图拦住她的去路。
It's an issue we'll have to confront at some point, no matter how unpleasant it is.  不管它有多讨厌，我们终究要面对这个问题。

words.meaning: a.  纯洁的; 纯净的; 完全的
words.example:
The mountain air was wonderfully pure.  山上的空气极为纯净。
Tap water is never chemically pure.  自来水绝对不是化学上的纯水。    Opposite impureUK adjective
It was pure coincidence/chance that we met.  我们见面纯属巧合。

words.meaning: n.  尺寸,次元,容积,维数vt.  表出尺寸
words.example:
Please specify the dimensions (= the height, length and width) of the room.  请明确说明房间的大小。
His personality has several dimensions.  他是个有多重性格的人。
These weapons add a new dimension to modern warfare.  这些武器为现代战争增添了一个新的特点。

words.meaning: n.  家伙; 同事; a.  同道的
words.example:
She introduced me to some of her fellow students.  她把我介绍给她的几位同班同学。
Our fellow travellers were mostly Spanish-speaking tourists.  和我们同行的旅伴大多是讲西班牙语的游客。UK noun countable
He seemed like a decent sort of a fellow.  他似乎是个正派的人。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.  人员,职员
words.example:
The new director is likely to make major changes in personnel.  新主管可能会在人事上做出大变动。
Personnel will help you find a flat to rent.  人事部会帮你租一个公寓。
For more information about the job, please contact the personnel manager.  如欲了解这份工作的详情，请联络人事部经理。

words.meaning: a.  相对的; 有关的; n.  亲属
words.example:
All her close/distant relatives came to the wedding.  她所有的近亲／远亲都来参加她的婚礼了。UK adjective formal
We weighed up the relative advantages of driving there or going by train.  我们权衡了一下，看看开车去那里和乘火车去哪种方式更有利。
Since I got a job, I've been living in relative comfort (= more comfort than before).  自从我有了工作，日子过得就相对舒适一些了。UK adjective formal

words.meaning: n.  地带; 腰带
words.example:
She fastened her belt tightly around her waist.  她把腰带束紧。
He had eaten so much that he had to undo his belt a couple of notches.  他吃得太多，不得不把腰带放松几个扣。noun
Basic computer skills are a good thing to have under your belt.  掌握基本的电脑使用技巧对你有好处，将来说不定有用。verb

words.meaning: n.  含意; 暗示
words.example:
She accused the party and, by implication, its leader too.  她指责了该政党，也含蓄地指责了该党的领袖。
The company is cutting back its spending and I wonder what the implications will be for our department.  公司正在削减开支，真不知道这将会对我们部门产生甚么影响。
What are the implications of the new law?  这部新法意味着甚么呢？

words.meaning: vt.  陪伴,带有,为. . . 伴奏vi.  伴奏
words.example:
The course books are accompanied by four cassettes.  这些课本配有四盒录音带。
Depression is almost always accompanied by insomnia.  忧郁症几乎总是和失眠分不开。
The salmon was accompanied by (= served with) a fresh green salad.  那道鲑鱼菜佐以新鲜的蔬菜沙拉。

words.meaning: n.  赞誉,认得,承认,重视,认识,认可
words.example:
It's a new country, hoping for diplomatic recognition from the international community.  这是个新国家，它希望在外交上得到国际社会的承认。
Ella complained that the company never gave her any recognition for her work.  艾拉抱怨说公司从未认可过她的工作。
He was presented with a gold watch in recognition of (= to show respect for) his years as club secretary.  俱乐部赠予他一只金表，以感谢他多年作为俱乐部干事所付出的心血。noun

words.meaning: n.  旗帜; 标记
words.example:
Flags of all the participating countries are flying outside the stadium.  所有参赛国家的国旗都挂在体育场外。
Flags were flapping/fluttering in the breeze.  旗子在和风中飘扬。
The guard waved his flag and the train pulled away from the station.  护卫挥旗示意，火车从车站驶离。noun countable

words.meaning: n. a.  内部(的); 内心(的)
words.example:
Leading off the main hall is a series of small inner rooms.  从主客厅开始是一系列小的内室。
humorous Few people ever managed to penetrate the director's inner sanctum (= very private room).  很少人进过经理的私人密室。
Sarah seemed to have a profound sense of inner peace.  萨拉内心好像非常平静。

words.meaning: v.  (使)摇荡; 转向; n.  摇摆
words.example:
He walked briskly along the path swinging his rolled-up umbrella.  他摇着收起的伞，步履轻快地走在路上。
The door swung open.  门开了。
His mood swings between elation and despair.  他情绪多变，一下子兴高采烈，一下子又伤心绝望。verb (swung, swung)

words.meaning: n.  出版，发行; 出版物
words.example:
The brochure will be ready for publication in September.  这本小册子将在九月份出版。
Will you arrange the publication of the names of the winners?  你能安排公布优胜者的姓名吗？
When is the publication date (= When will the book be available to buy) ?  （书）哪天出版？

words.meaning: a.  永久的,不变的,固定的,持久的n.  电烫的头发a.  永久的
words.example:
She is looking for a permanent place to stay.  她正在寻找一个固定的住所。
Are you looking for a temporary or a permanent job?  你是想找一份临时的还是固定的工作？
The disease can cause permanent damage to the brain.  这种疾病可能导致大脑永久性损伤。

words.meaning: n.  现象; 特殊的事物
words.example:
Gravity is a natural phenomenon.  重力是一种自然现象。
Do you believe in the paranormal and other psychic phenomena?  你相信超自然及其他通灵现象吗？
There's evidence to suggest that child abuse is not just a recent phenomenon.  有证据显示虐待儿童并不是近来才有的现象。UK US  (plural phenomena)

words.meaning: adv.  照原文地; 确切地
words.example:
He missed that kick literally by miles.  他那一脚踢丢得确实相差好几英里远。
They were responsible for literally millions of deaths.  他们的确对数百万人的死负有责任。
We live literally just round the corner from her.  我们住的地方离她那里真的只需要转一个弯。

words.meaning: vt. vi.  抵抗,耐得住,抵制,反抗n.  防染剂
words.example:
The soldiers resisted (the enemy attacks) for two days.  （面对敌人的进攻）士兵们抵抗了两天。
The party leader resisted demands for his resignation.  该党领导人拒不答应他辞职的要求。
He tried to run away from the police and was charged with resisting arrest.  警方逮捕他时，他企图逃跑，结果被控拒捕。

words.meaning: n.  大会,协定,惯例n.  约定
words.example:
Where are they holding their party convention?  他们在哪里召开党员大会？noun
They defied/flouted/broke with convention by giving up their jobs and becoming self-sufficient.  他们离经叛道，放弃了工作，开始过自给自足的生活。
Convention dictates that it is the man who asks the woman to marry him and not the reverse.  根据习俗，应由男人向女人求婚而不是反过来。

words.meaning: n.  拥抱vt.  拥抱,互相拥抱,包含,收买vi.  拥抱
words.example:
This was an opportunity that he would embrace.  这样的机会他是求之不得的。verb
She saw them embrace on the station platform.  她看到他们在月台上拥抱。
He leant over to embrace the child.  他弯腰去拥抱那个孩子。verb

words.meaning: n.  帮助,协助vt.  帮助,搀扶vi.  协助,参加
words.example:
The army arrived to assist in the search.  军队赶到协助搜寻。
You will be expected to assist the editor with the selection of illustrations for the book.  希望你能帮助编辑为此书挑选插图。

words.meaning: vt.  构造,建造,想出,作图n.  构成物
words.example:
The walls are constructed of concrete.  墙是用混凝土建成的。
His reputation as an eccentric is largely a media construct.  他行为古怪的名声多半源于媒体的杜撰。

words.meaning: vt.  获得; 保护; a.  安全的，有保障的; 确定的
words.example:
That ladder doesn't look very secure to me.  那梯子我看不太稳固。
Check that all windows and doors are secure.  检查一下，看门窗是否都关紧了。
figurative Her promotion has made her position in the company more secure.  她的升职使她在公司的地位更加稳固。

words.meaning: n.  美元
words.example:
Can I borrow a couple of bucks?  我能借几美元吗？
He charged me twenty bucks for a new hubcap.  一个新的毂盖他要了我20美元。
He earns mega- bucks (= a lot of money) working for an American bank.  他在一家美国银行工作，赚钱很多。

words.meaning: v.  使结合，绑; 装订
words.example:
They bound the packages with brightly coloured ribbon.  他们用鲜艳的彩带把包裹扎起来。
Bind together the two broken ends.  把断了的两端连起来。
The prisoner was bound hand and foot.  那名囚犯手脚被绑。

words.meaning: adv.  不断地，坚持不懈地; 经常地
words.example:
He's constantly changing his mind.  他的想法时常在变。
She has the television on constantly.  她总是开着电视。

words.meaning: n.  企业,事业心,进取心,干事业
words.example:
Don't forget this is a commercial enterprise - we're here to make money.  不要忘记这是一个商业组织——我们到这儿来是为了赚钱的。
Those were the years of private enterprise (= businesses being run privately, rather than by the government) , when lots of small businesses were started.  那是一个私人企业的时代，许多小公司就是那时创建的。
Her latest enterprise (= plan) is to climb Mount Everest.  她最新的雄心壮志是攀登圣母峰。UK noun

words.meaning: a.  显然的，明显的
words.example:
Her unhappiness was apparent to everyone.  谁都看得出她很不开心。
There are one or two apparent discrepancies between the two reports.  这两份报告看上去有一两处出入。
She has this apparent innocence which, I suspect, she uses to her advantage.  她貌似天真，但我认为，这只是对她有利的伪装。

words.meaning: vt.  安装,安置,使就职
words.example:
The plumber is coming tomorrow to install the new washing machine.  水管工明天来安装新的洗衣机。
Andrew, can you help me install this software?  安德鲁，你能帮我安装这个软体吗？(UK also instal) UK verb transitive
She has installed a couple of young academics as her advisers.  她任用几名年轻的大学教师作为顾问。(UK also instal) UK verb transitive

words.meaning: a.  敏感的,易感的,灵敏的,感光的
words.example:
Her reply showed that she was very sensitive to criticism.  她的回答显示她对批评很敏感。
He was very sensitive about his scar and thought everyone was staring at him.  他对自己的伤疤很敏感，以为每个人都在盯着他看。
Sex education and birth control are sensitive issues.  性教育和计划生育都是敏感的话题。

words.meaning: n.  食谱; 方法
words.example:
For real South Asian food, just follow these recipes.  要做地道的印度饭菜，只需遵照这些食谱即可。
Do you know a good recipe for wholemeal bread?  你知不知道怎样做很棒的全麦面包？noun countable
All those children unsupervised sounds to me like a recipe for disaster.  那些孩子全都没人看管，在我听来这会出大乱子。

words.meaning: a.  初步的,基本的
words.example:
They made some elementary mistakes.  他们犯了一些很基础的错误。
Millions of travellers fail to take even the most elementary of precautions.  上百万的旅客甚至没有采取最基本的预防措施。
This book contains a series of elementary exercises for learners.  本书含有为学习者设计的一系列基础练习。

words.meaning: n.  音乐会,合奏,一致vt.  协定,协调vi.  协力
words.example:
She was appearing in concert at Carnegie Hall.  她参加了在卡内基音乐厅的演出。    formal
If the member countries would act in concert, the problem might be solved more easily.  如果成员国行动一致，这个问题可能会更容易解决。

words.meaning: a.  侵略的,攻击性的
words.example:
Men tend to be more aggressive than women.  男性往往比女性更具有攻击性。
If I criticize him, he gets aggressive and starts shouting.  如果我批评他，他就会寻衅大吵大闹。
Both players both won their first-round matches in aggressive style.  两名选手都以全力以赴、志在必得的打法赢得了第一轮比赛。

words.meaning: n. [常pl.  ]通道
words.example:
She switched/turned to another channel to watch the football.  她换到另一个频道看足球比赛。noun countable
There are drainage/irrigation channels all over this flat agricultural land.  在这片平坦的农田上遍布着排水／灌溉渠。
The boats all have to pass through this narrow channel.  所有船只都必须通过这条狭窄的航道。

words.meaning: a.  极度的; n.  极端
words.example:
In extreme cases , the disease can lead to blindness.  这种疾病最严重可导致失明。adjective
He has rather extreme views.  他的观点很偏激。
He's on the extreme right-wing of the party.  他属于这个政党的极右翼势力。adjective

words.meaning: n.  管; 显像管
words.example:
Gases produced in the reaction pass through this tube and can then be collected.  反应中产生的气体透过这个管子就可以收集起来。
What's on the tube this weekend?  这个周末有甚么电视节目？UK noun
If business doesn't pick up soon, the company will go down the tubes.  如果生意近期没有起色的话，公司将会倒闭。UK noun

words.meaning: n.  蛋白质a.  蛋白质的
words.example: Fish and eggs are rich in protein.  鱼和鸡蛋富含蛋白质。

words.meaning: v.  停止; 放弃; 离开; 辞(职)
words.example:
Would you quit your job if you inherited lots of money?  假如继承了一大笔钱，你会辞掉工作吗？
Quit wasting my time!  别浪费我的时间！
Press Q to quit the program.  请按Q结束程式。

words.meaning: n.  缺席; 缺乏，不存在
words.example:
She has had repeated absences from work this year.  今年她屡次旷工。noun
He drew attention to the absence of concrete evidence against the defendant.  他使大家注意到，并不存在可以证明被告有罪的确凿证据。
In the absence of (= because there were not) more suitable candidates, we decided to offer the job to Mr Conway.  由于没有更为合适的人选，我们决定把这个工作机会给康韦先生。noun

words.meaning: a.  拉丁的，拉丁文的; n.  拉丁语
words.example: a Latin poem  拉丁语诗歌

words.meaning: n.  多样性
words.example:
Does television adequately reflect the ethnic and cultural diversity of the country?  电视节目能充分反映出这个国家民族和文化的多样性吗？
There is a wide diversity of opinion on the question of unilateral disarmament.  对于单方面裁军问题，人们的看法各不相同。

words.meaning: n.  散文，短文，评论
words.example:
For homework I want you to write an essay on endangered species.  我想让你们写一篇关于濒危物种的文章作为作业。verb transitive /eˈseɪ/    old-fashioned
The procedure was first essayed in 1923.  1923年有人首次尝试这种做法。

words.meaning: a.  巨大的; 超群的; n.  巨大的动植物
words.example:
He was one of the intellectual/political giants of this century.  他是本世纪知识界的巨擘／政界巨头之一。
The takeover battle is between two of America's industrial/retail giants (= large companies).  这场收购战是在两个美国工业／零售业巨头之间展开的。adjective

words.meaning: vi.  商议,谈判,交涉vt.  谈妥,转让,处理
words.example:
The government has refused to negotiate with the strikers.  政府拒绝与罢工者谈判。
I'm negotiating for a new contract.  我正在为签订一份新合同进行协商。
I've managed to negotiate (= get by discussion) a five per cent pay increase with my boss.  透过与老板协商，我的薪水将提高5%。UK verb

words.meaning: vt.  恢复，修复
words.example:
The badly neglected paintings have all been carefully restored.  那些由于严重疏忽而损毁的画作得到了精心修复。
After a week in bed, she was fully restored to health (= she felt healthy again).  卧床一周后，她完全恢复了健康。
The former leader was today restored to power in the first free elections for twenty years.  今天，在20年来首次举行的自由选举中，这位前领导人又重新当选上台。

words.meaning: n.  重要部分,本质a.  实质上的,物质的,有内容的,结实的
words.example:
The findings show a substantial difference between the opinions of men and women.  这些发现显示男性和女性之间存在重大的意见分歧。
She inherited a substantial fortune from her grandmother.  她从祖母那里继承了一笔数目可观的遗产。
The first draft of his novel needed a substantial amount of rewriting.  他小说的初稿有很多地方需要重写。adjective

words.meaning: vt.  劝告,通知,与. . . 商量,建议vi.  提意见,商量
words.example:
His doctor advised him against smoking.  他的医生劝他戒烟。
I'd strongly advise against making a sudden decision.  我会极力奉劝不要草率作出决定。
She advises the President (= gives information and suggests types of action) on African policy.  她是总统的非洲政策顾问。

words.meaning: a.  传统的，惯例的
words.example: disapproving I find his art rather dull and conventional.  我觉得他的艺术作品乏味俗套。    Opposite unconventional

words.meaning: n.  壳; 外壳
words.example:
Brazil nuts have very hard shells.  巴西果的壳很坚硬。
Artillery and mortar shells were landing in the outskirts of the city.  大炮和迫击炮弹落在城市周边地区。noun
Derek has really come out of his shell since he started working here.  自从开始在这里工作以后，德里克真正变得活跃起来。noun

words.meaning: n.  代理人,代表
words.example:
I'd like you to meet Ann Gregory, my deputy.  我想请你见见我的副手安•葛列格里。
I'm acting as deputy while the boss is away.  老板不在的时候，我就代理他的工作。
She's deputy (head) of a large North London school.  她在伦敦北部一间很大的中学里当副校长。

words.meaning: a.  平(坦)的; n.  平地，平面
words.example:
An ice rink needs to be completely flat.  溜冰场地必须十分平坦。
Roll out the pastry on a flat surface.  在平的面板上把油酥面团擀薄。
Much of the countryside in East Anglia is very flat.  英吉利亚东部的许多乡村都地势平坦。adjective (flatter, flattest)

words.meaning: n.  商标
words.example:
This isn't my usual brand of deodorant.  这不是我通常用的那个牌子的除臭剂。
When I go to a supermarket I usually buy own (US store / Australian generic)brands (= the cheaper products with the shop's own name on them).  我去超市时常常购买超市的自家品牌产品。
Do you like his brand of humour?  你喜欢他那种幽默吗？noun countable

words.meaning: vt.  保证,确告,担保
words.example:
The unions assured the new owners of the workers' loyalty to the company.  工会向新企业主保证，工人们对公司是忠诚的。
The Prime Minister assured the electorate (that) taxes would not be increased after the election.  首相向选民保证选举后不会增税。
You can rest assured (= feel confident) that I shall be there as promised.  你放心，我答应了就一定会到的。UK verb transitive

words.meaning: n.  商人，小贩
words.example: a second-hand car dealer  二手汽车经销商

words.meaning: n.  公用程序,实用品,实用,公用事业a.  实用的,有多种用途的n.  实用程
words.example: utility bills  水电煤气帐单UK noun

words.meaning: adv. conj.  然而，不过
words.example: It was late; nevertheless, he kept working.  时间晚了；尽管如此他还在干。

words.meaning: n.  常式,日常工作,惯例,例行公事a.  日常的,常规的n.  例程
words.example:
There's no set/fixed routine at work - every day is different.  工作内容不固定——每天都不同。
He checks under the car for bombs as a matter of routine.  他只要开车就先习惯性地检查车下是否被安了炸弹。
He went into his usual 'I'm the head of the family' routine (= usual way of speaking).  他又故态复萌，重弹“我是一家之主”的老调子。

words.meaning: n.  成分，要素; (烹调的)原料
words.example:
The list of ingredients included 250g of almonds.  清单上列出的材料包括250克的杏仁。
Trust is a vital ingredient in a successful marriage.  信任是婚姻幸福的重要因素。

words.meaning: n.  利害关系
words.example:
He holds (= owns) a 40% stake in/of the company.  他拥有公司40%的股份。
Employers have a stake in the training of their staff.  雇主很重视员工训练。noun countable
She spent two weeks in Las Vegas playing high- stakes blackjack at the casinos.  她在拉斯维加斯的赌场里玩了两个星期高赌注的二十一点。

words.meaning: n.  纤维; 光纤
words.example: Fiber-rich food aids digestion.  高纤维食物有助于消化。

words.meaning: vt.  咬断,猛咬,争夺,拉断,使有啪啪声,用快照拍摄vi.  咬,扑,抓,折断,
words.example:
You'll snap that ruler if you bend it too far.  如果你把那把尺子弯得太厉害，它就会哢嚓一下折断。
Some vandal's gone and snapped off my car aerial again.  某个蓄意作恶的家伙又把我的汽车天线折断了。
When she asked me to postpone my trip to help her move house, I just snapped (= got angry).  她叫我把旅行延期去帮她搬家时，我一下子就恼火了。verb (-pp-)

words.meaning: v.  纳入; 合并
words.example:
Suggestions from the survey have been incorporated into/in the final design.  调查中取得的建议已被纳入最终的设计之中。
This aircraft incorporates several new safety features.  这种飞机具有几个新的安全功能。

words.meaning: n.  终极,根本,顶点,基本原理a.  终极的,根本的,极限的,最大的,最后的
words.example:
Of course the ultimate responsibility for the present conflict without doubt lies with the aggressor.  当然，挑起事端的一方毫无疑问应对目前的冲突承担首要责任。
The ultimate decision about who to employ lies with Andrew.  最终决定雇用谁取决于安德鲁。
Infidelity is the ultimate betrayal.  通奸是最可耻的背叛。

words.meaning: n.  开关; v.  转换
words.example:
Can you flip the switch?  你能打开那个开关吗？
She started studying English at college, but switched to Business Studies in her second year.  她刚上大学时是学英语，但二年级的时候改学商了。
In 1971, Britain switched over (= changed completely) to a decimal currency.  1971年，英国改用十进制货币。

words.meaning: n.  假定,假装,视为当然之事
words.example:
People tend to make assumptions about you when you have a disability.  如果你有残疾，人们往往就会对你妄加假设。
These calculations are based on the assumption that prices will continue to rise.  这些计算是基于价格会继续上升这一假定之上的。noun
The revolutionaries' assumption of power took the army by surprise.  革命者突然夺取政权，使军队措手不及。

words.meaning: n.  齿轮,工具vt.  以齿轮连起,开动,配搭活动,安排vi.  连接上,适合
words.example:
Does your car have four or five gears?  你的车是四档的还是五档的？
The car should be in gear (= with its gears in position, allowing the vehicle to move).  车档应该挂着。
When you start a car you need to be in first/ US also low gear.  汽车启动时应该使用一档。

words.meaning: n.  障碍,栅栏
words.example:
Barriers have been erected all along the route the Pope will take.  在罗马教皇将要经过的路上，沿途都设置了路障。
The mountains acted as a natural barrier to the spread of the disease.  群山成为了阻止这疾病扩散的天然屏障。
Passengers are requested to show their tickets at the barrier.  乘客需要在剪票口出示车票。UK noun countable

words.meaning: a.  较小的; 次要的
words.example:
It's only a minor problem.  那只是个小问题。
There's been an increase in minor offences , such as traffic violations and petty theft.  轻微的违法活动有所增加，如违反交通规则、小偷小摸等。
She suffered only minor injuries.  她只是受了轻伤。

words.meaning: n.  预备,准备,粮食,规定,供应,食物vt.  供给. . . 食物及必需品
words.example:
The provision of good public transport will be essential for developing the area.  提供良好的大众运输对该地区的发展极为重要。
Of course there's provision in the plan for population increase.  当然这项计划里有应对人口增长的措施。
When designing buildings in this area, you have to make provision against earthquakes.  在该地区设计建筑物时，需要考虑防震措施。

words.meaning: v.  指派; 分配; 布置(作业)
words.example:
The case has been assigned to our most senior officer.  这宗案件已经指派给我们最高职级的警官来处理。
Have you assigned a day for the interviews yet?  你们定了哪一天进行面试了吗？
Detectives have been unable to assign a motive for the murder.  侦探们一直无法确定谋杀的动机。

words.meaning: a.  经典的; 典型的; n.  经典作品; [pl.  ]古典文学
words.example:
Have you ever read Fielding's classic novel 'Tom Jones'?  你有没有读过菲尔丁的经典小说《汤姆‧琼斯》？
Another classic goal there from Corley!  科利又踢进一个漂亮球！
Then she fell over backwards into the flowerbed - it was absolutely classic!  然后她仰面倒进了花坛——真是太滑稽了！

words.meaning: n.  标签; v.  标记
words.example:
Remember to put some address labels on the suitcases.  别忘了把地址标签贴在行李箱上。
Washing instructions should be on the label.  标签上应该注明洗涤注意事项。
He seems to be stuck with the label of 'troublemaker'.  他好像被人贴上了“麻烦制造者”的标签。noun countable

words.meaning: n.  提倡者,拥护者vt.  主张,提倡
words.example:
He advocates the return of capital punishment.  他主张恢复死刑。noun countable /ˈæd.və.kət/
He's a strong advocate of state ownership of the railways.  他极力支持铁路国有。

words.meaning: n.  草图，草稿; v.  起草; a.  供役使的
words.example:
This is only a rough draft - the finished article will have pictures as well.  这只是一个粗略的草稿——定稿后的文章中还会有一些图片。
She asked me to check the (first) draft of her proposal.  她请我检查一下她的（第一稿）提案草稿。UK noun
He avoided the draft because of a foot injury.  他因脚伤而躲过了服兵役。UK noun

words.meaning: a.  特别的; 非凡的
words.example:
He told the extraordinary story of his escape.  他讲述了他离奇的逃亡经历。
Her voice had an extraordinary hypnotic quality.  她的声音有一种奇怪的催眠效果。

words.meaning: n.  粗糙的东西,毛坯,未加工品,梗概,艰难,暴徒a.  粗糙的,粗暴的,蓬乱
words.example:
It was a rough mountain road, full of stones and huge holes.  那是一条崎岖的山道，满是石头和巨大的坑洼。
My hands get very rough in the cold.  天一冷我的手就变得特别粗糙。
The builder did a rough sketch of how the new stairs would look.  建筑工人画了张新楼梯草图。

words.meaning: vi.  大叫,忍不住笑vt.  叫着说n.  叫声,喊声
words.example:
Our neighbours were yelling (obscenities) at each other this morning.  今天早晨我们的邻居在互相破口大骂。
The child yelled out in pain.  孩子痛得大叫起来。

words.meaning: a.  怀孕的,充满的,含蓄的
words.example:
She's five and a half months pregnant.  她怀孕有五个半月了。
My mother stopped smoking when she became pregnant.  我母亲自从怀孕后就不吸烟了。
He believes that men who get (= make) young girls pregnant should be severely punished.  他认为让少女怀孕的男人应受严惩。

words.meaning: a.  远的,疏远的
words.example:
She could hear the distant sound of fireworks exploding.  她能听到远处放烟花的声音。
At some point in the distant future I would like to have my own house.  将来我要拥有自己的房子。
They plan to have children in the not-too-distant future.  他们打算在不远的将来要孩子。adjective

words.meaning: n.  卫星; 人造卫星
words.example:
The World Cup was transmitted around the world by satellite.  世界杯透过卫星向全球转播。
The moon is the satellite of the Earth.  月球是地球的卫星。UK noun countable

words.meaning: v.  打扫; 席卷; n.  摆动
words.example:
Everyone looked up as she swept into the room.  她冲进房间时，每个人都抬头看她。
The fire swept (= spread quickly) through the house.  火势迅速在房子里蔓延开来。
The National Party swept into power (= easily won the election) with a majority of almost 200.  民族党以近200票的领先优势顺利当选。

words.meaning: a.  全世界的,普遍的,,通用的n.  一般概念
words.example:
Food, like sex, is a subject of almost universal interest.  像性一样，食物几乎也是人们普遍感兴趣的话题。
The new reforms have not met with universal approval within the government.  新的改革措施在政府内部还没有得到一致赞同。

words.meaning: v.  旋转; 纺(纱); n.  旋转
words.example:
The Earth spins on its axis.  地球绕地轴旋转。
The roulette players silently watched the wheel spin around/round.  玩转盘游戏的玩家们默不作声地注视着轮盘旋转。
He was killed when his car hit a tree and spun off the road.  他的车撞到树上后甩出路面，他因此而丧生。

words.meaning: n.  等级,排,阶级,队伍,横列a.  繁茂的,恶臭的,讨厌的,下流的vt.  排列
words.example:
He has just been promoted to the rank of captain.  他刚被提升为上尉。
Ministers of Cabinet rank receive a higher salary than other ministers.  进入内阁的部长比其他部长的薪金高。
Having a large income is one of the advantages of rank (= high position).  职位级别高的好处之一就是收入高。

words.meaning: n.  衣服
words.example:
Protective clothing must be worn.  必须穿上防护服。
You can only take three articles/items of clothing into the changing room.  你只能带三件衣服进试衣间。

words.meaning: v.  出产; n.  产量，收益
words.example:
The investigation yielded some unexpected results.  调查得出了一些出乎意料的结果。
Favourable weather yielded a good crop.  好天气带来了好收成。verb
They were forced to yield (up) their land to the occupying forces.  他们被迫将领土割让给占领军。

words.meaning: n. 肖像,人像,半身像,人物描写n.  纵向
words.example:
She's commissioned an artist to paint her portrait/paint a portrait of her.  她委托一位画家为她画一幅肖像。
Her latest novel paints a very vivid portrait of the aristocracy in the 1920s.  她最新的一部小说生动地描绘了20世纪20年代的贵族生活。UK adjective

words.meaning: ad.  大致地; 粗糙地
words.example:
There has been an increase of roughly 2.25 million.  大概增长了225万。
Roughly speaking , it's 2.25 million.  大致来说，有225万。
We have roughly similar tastes/roughly the same tastes.  我们的口味大致相同。adverb

words.meaning: n.  诉讼,控诉
words.example: Two of the directors have brought/ mainly USfiled a lawsuit against their former employer.  其中的两位董事已经对其前雇主提出诉讼。

words.meaning: n.  证言,证据,声明
words.example:
Some doubts have been expressed about his testimony.  有人对他的证词提出了一些质疑。
The reports are testimony to the many hours of research completed by this committee.  这些报告充分表明该委员会花了很多时间进行研究。

words.meaning: n.  房间; 洞穴
words.example:
Meetings of the council are held in the council chamber.  委员会的会议在会议厅举行。
There are two chambers in the British parliament - the House of Commons is the lower chamber, and the House of Lords is the upper chamber.  英国议会有两院——众议院是下议院，贵族院是上议院。
The human heart has four chambers.  人的心脏有四个心室。

words.meaning: n.  家具,附属品
words.example:
They have a lot of antique furniture.  他们有很多古董家具。
The only piece/item of furniture he has in his bedroom is a bed.  他卧室里唯一的家俱就是一张床。
We've just bought some new garden furniture (= tables, chairs, etc. for use in the garden).  我们刚刚买了些花园里用的新家俱。UK noun uncountable

words.meaning: n.  合作,协力,合作社
words.example:
This documentary was made with the cooperation of British Rail.  该纪录片系与英国铁路局合作拍摄。
There's very little cooperation between the two countries.  两国间少有合作。
The company produces computers in cooperation with a German firm.  该公司与德国一家公司合作生产电脑。

words.meaning: n.  弦; 细绳，带子
words.example:
When you pull the strings, the puppet's arms and legs move.  你扯动细绳，木偶的手脚就会动。
What do you think of the recent string of political scandals?  你怎么看最近一连串的政治丑闻？
He had a string of top-twenty hits during the eighties.  在20世纪80年代，他创作了一系列打入排行榜前20名的热门作品。noun

words.meaning: n.  典礼,仪式,礼节
words.example: She arrived at the airport without the pomp and ceremony that usually accompanies important politicians.  她抵达了机场，没有通常与重要政界人士相伴的盛况和礼仪。

words.meaning: vt.  沟通,传达,感染vi.  通讯
words.example:
We can now communicate instantly with people on the other side of the world.  我们现在可以与生活在地球另一端的人进行即时交流。
Unable to speak a word of the language, he communicated with (= using) his hands.  那种语言他一窍不通，只好用手势来沟通。
Has the news been communicated to the staff yet?  消息传达给员工了吗？

words.meaning: n.  侧面,轮廓,人物素描vt.  描绘. . . 轮廓,评论人物
words.example:
We need to increase our company's profile in Asia.  我们需要扩大公司在亚洲的影响力。
There is a growing number of women in high- profile positions (= positions where they are noticed) in the government.  在备受注目的政府职位上，女性的数量在逐渐增长。UK noun countable
Drawing profiles is somehow easier than drawing the full face.  不知为甚么画侧面像要比画整张脸容易。

words.meaning: n.  机械装置; 机制
words.example:
These automatic cameras have a special focusing mechanism.  这些自动相机有特殊的对焦装置。noun countable
The mechanism for collecting taxes needs revising.  税收制度需要检讨。noun countable
She's actually rather insecure, and her rudeness is just a defence mechanism.  她其实很缺乏安全感，她的粗鲁不过是出于防卫心理。

words.meaning: n.  度假胜地; (to)求助
words.example:
He got hold of the money legally, without resort to violence.  他没有采取暴力手段，而是透过合法途径拿到了这笔钱。UK noun
You have to help me - you're my last resort.  你一定要帮我——你是我最后的希望了。UK verb

words.meaning: n.  毁坏，毁灭
words.example:
Many people are very concerned about the destruction of the rainforests.  许多人都非常关注雨林遭破坏的问题。
Unusually high winds left a trail of destruction over southern Britain.  罕见的大风在英国南部造成了一连串的破坏。

words.meaning: n.  薄的纱织品,薄纸,连篇,组织,棉纸
words.example:
His face is covered with scar tissue where he was badly burned.  他脸上严重烧伤的地方满是疤痕。noun
She handed me a tissue just as I sneezed.  我打喷嚏时，她递给我一张面纸。
He used a piece of tissue to clean his sunglasses.  他用一张面纸擦太阳镜。    Compare handkerchief

words.meaning: n.  感染; 传染病
words.example: Bandage the wound to reduce the risk of infection.  包扎伤口以减少感染的危险。

words.meaning: n.  内阁; 贮藏橱; 陈列柜
words.example:
The Cabinet meet/meets every Thursday.  内阁成员每周四开会。
a cabinet minister.  内阁大臣
The Prime Minister has announced a cabinet reshuffle (= changes in the Cabinet).  首相已宣布内阁改组。noun

words.meaning: vi.  进行,开始,起诉,继续进行
words.example:
His lawyers have decided not to proceed with the case.  他的律师已经决定不再继续打那场官司了。
Preparations for the festival are now proceeding smoothly.  艺术节的准备活动正在顺利进行中。
She sat down and proceeded to tell me about her skiing holiday.  她坐了下来，接着告诉我有关她滑雪度假的事情。

words.meaning: a.  文学(上)的
words.example: a literary critic  文学评论家

words.meaning: n.  病毒
words.example: Evidence suggested that the AIDS virus was spreading very quickly among the heterosexual community.  有证据表明爱滋病病毒正在异性恋群体中迅速传播。

words.meaning: n.  争论; 纠纷; v.  争论
words.example:
They have been unable to settle/resolve the dispute over working conditions.  他们无法解决工作条件方面的争端。
The unions are in dispute with management over pay.  工会与管理层在工资问题上存在分歧。
He is beyond all dispute the finest actor in Hollywood today.  无可置疑，他是当今荷里活最好的演员。

words.meaning: n.  财富,运气,兴隆,命运,好运,大量财产
words.example:
She inherited a fortune from her grandmother.  她从祖母那里继承了一大笔财产。
He lost a fortune gambling.  他赌博输了一大笔钱。
You can make a fortune out of junk if you call it 'antiques'.  把破烂叫做“古董”，就可以从中发一笔财。

words.meaning: v.  战胜，克服
words.example:
Juventus overcame Ajax in a thrilling match.  尤文图斯队在这场扣人心弦的比赛中，战胜了阿贾克斯队。
Eventually she managed to overcome her shyness in class.  她终于克服了上课时的羞怯。
Twenty thousand demonstrators sang "We shall overcome" as they marched through Washington today.  今天，两万名示威者高唱著「我们会胜利”在华盛顿街头游行。UK US (overcame, overcome)

words.meaning: a.  不平常的,值得注意的,显著的
words.example:
Nelson Mandela is a truly remarkable man.  纳尔逊．曼德拉确实是个了不起的人。
Meeting you here in Rome is a remarkable coincidence.  能在罗马这地方遇到你可真是惊人的巧合。
The 20th century was remarkable for its inventions.  20世纪因层出不穷的重大发明而引人瞩目。

words.meaning: vt.  占用; 占据
words.example:
The bathroom's occupied - I think John's in there.  浴室有人——我想是约翰在里面。
The rest of the time was occupied with writing a report.  剩下的时间用来写了份报告。
The house hasn't been occupied (= lived in) by anyone for a few months.  这幢房子已经有几个月没人住了。

words.meaning: n.  统计学,统计表
words.example: Statistics reveal a clear trend.  统计数据揭示了明显趋势。

words.meaning: n. vt.  偶然碰到; 遭遇
words.example:
This meeting will be the first encounter between the party leaders since the election.  这是自大选以来两党领导人首次狭路相逢。
In their last encounter with Italy, England won 3-2.  在上次和义大利队的对垒中，英格兰队三比二获胜。UK verb transitive
On their way home they encountered a woman selling flowers.  在回家的路上他们碰到一位卖花的女子。UK verb transitive

words.meaning: adv.  开头，最初; 首先
words.example:
Initially, most people approved of the new scheme.  起初，大部分人都同意这个新方案。
The damage was far more serious than initially believed.  损失比开始认为的要严重得多。

words.meaning: n.  电; 电流
words.example: The electricity has been turned off.  电已被断掉了。

words.meaning: a.  基因的，遗传(学)的
words.example: a genetic defect/disease  基因缺陷／遗传疾病

words.meaning: vt.  保持,保有,聘请,记得,留住
words.example:
She has lost her battle to retain control of the company.  她被打败了，失去了继续掌管公司的权力。
He managed to retain his dignity throughout the performance.  在整个表演过程中，他设法保持了自己的尊严。
She succeeded in retaining her lead in the second half of the race.  在比赛的后半程中，她成功地保住了领先地位。

words.meaning: a.  后面的，后者的; 后期的
words.example:
Building of the new library should begin in the latter part of next year.  新图书馆的建设应该在明年下半年开工。
In the latter stages of the fight he began to tire.  到那场拳击赛的后半段他开始支援不住了。UK noun only singular
She offered me more money or a car and I chose the latter.  她提出给我更多的钱或者一辆汽车，我选择了后者。    Compare the former    not standard

words.meaning: n.  动机a.  激励的
words.example:
Tax incentives have been very effective in encouraging people to save and invest more of their income.  税收措施在鼓励人们将收入多储蓄和多投资方面很有效。
Bonus payments provide an incentive to work harder.  支付奖金能鼓励人们更努力工作。

words.meaning: a.  正确的,精确的
words.example:
The figures they have used are just not accurate.  他们引用的数字太不准确。
Her novel is an accurate reflection of life in post-war Spain.  她的小说是战后西班牙生活的真实写照。
We hope to become more accurate in predicting earthquakes.  我们希望能更准确地预测地震。    Opposite inaccurate

words.meaning: n.  恐怖,可怕的人
words.example:
They fled from the city in terror.  他们惊恐万分地逃离该市。
There was sheer/abject terror in her eyes when he came back into the room.  当他回到屋里时，她双眼充满了恐惧。
Lots of people have a terror of spiders.  许多人害怕蜘蛛。

words.meaning: n.  精华,精锐,中坚分子
words.example:
disapproving A powerful and corrupt elite has bled this country dry.  该国专权腐败的权贵阶层榨干了人民的血汗。adjective [before noun]
Elite (= A group of excellent) troops were airlifted to the trouble zone.  精锐部队被空运到骚乱地区。

words.meaning: a.  奇异的; 单数的; n. [常pl.  ]可能性
words.example:
Her father was an odd man.  她父亲是个古怪的人。
What an odd thing to say.  说起来多古怪的一件事啊。
The skirt and jacket looked a bit odd together.  这裙子和夹克搭配看上去有点怪。

words.meaning: n.  图表; vt.  用图说明
words.example:
There is a chart on the classroom wall showing the relative heights of all the children.  教室墙上有一张图表，显示出所有孩子的相对身高。
The sales chart shows a distinct decline in the past few months.  销售图显示在过去几个月里销售量明显下降。
It's been number one in the charts for six weeks.  它占据排行榜之首已达六周之久。UK noun countable

words.meaning: a.  太阳的,日光的,源自太阳的
words.example: solar radiation  太阳辐射

words.meaning: n.  正方形,街区,直角尺,平方,广场a.  正方形的,正直的,公正的,两讫的,
words.example:
First draw a square.  首先画一个正方形。
It's a square-shaped room.  这是个正方形的房间。
When cooled, cut the chocolate brownies into squares.  冷却之后，将巧克力蛋糕切成四方块。

words.meaning: n.  专心; 集中; 浓度
words.example:
The noise outside made concentration difficult.  外面吵得我难以集中注意力。
There was a look of intense concentration on her face.  她脸上带着全神贯注的表情。
The government's concentration on tax reduction has won them a lot of support.  政府集中推行减税政策，从而赢得了广泛的支持。UK noun

words.meaning: a.  难懂的; 复杂的
words.example:
The rules are rather complicated to follow.  这些规定遵守起来挺复杂的。
The relationship is a bit complicated. He's my mother's cousin's daughter's child.  关系有点复杂，他是我母亲的表姐的女儿的孩子。

words.meaning: n.  冠军,拥护者,战士vt.  保卫,拥护a.  优胜的
words.example:
She is the world champion for the third year in succession.  她第三次蝉联世界冠军。
The defending champion will play his first match of the tournament tomorrow.  卫冕冠军将在明天参加锦标赛的第一场比赛。
Who are the reigning European football champions?  谁是目前的欧洲足球冠军？noun countable

words.meaning: n.  望远镜
words.example: We had to telescope five visits into two days.  我们只得把五个拜访压缩在两天之内完成。

words.meaning: n.  反映,沉思,映像,责难,想法,思考
words.example:
In Greek mythology, Narcissus fell in love with his own reflection in a pool of water.  希腊神话中的那喀索斯爱上了自己在水池中的倒影。
He put silver foil around the fire to increase heat reflection.  他用银箔围住火炉来增加热的反射。noun
The fact that soldiers are on the streets is a reflection of how terrified the government is.  街头部署了士兵，这一情况显示出政府是多么惊恐。noun

words.meaning: n.  革命
words.example:
The French Revolution changed France from a monarchy to a republic.  法国大革命使法国由君主政体变成共和政体。
The country seems to be heading towards revolution.  这个国家似乎正在走向革命。noun
Penicillin produced a revolution in medicine.  青霉素的发现引起了医学上的一次革命。noun

words.meaning: n.  长条,条状,带,脱衣舞vt.  脱衣,被剥去,剥夺,拆卸vi.  脱衣服
words.example:
Because of the pollution, the trees are almost completely stripped of bark.  由于受到污染，树木的表皮几乎完全剥落。
The paintwork was so bad that we decided to strip off all the paint and start again.  漆面太糟，我们决定铲去所有油漆，重漆一遍。
It was so hot that we stripped off our shirts.  天气太热，我们脱掉了衬衫。

words.meaning: v.  解释; 理解; 表现
words.example:
It's difficult to interpret these statistics without knowing how they were obtained.  不了解这些统计数字是怎样得来的就难以理解它们。
If Shakespeare's plays are to reach a large audience they need to be interpreted in a modern style.  要使莎士比亚的戏剧得到广大观众的接受，就需要用现代的风格去演绎。UK verb
We had to ask our guide to interpret for us.  我们不得不请导游为我们翻译。    Compare translate

words.meaning: n.  比赛; 锦标赛
words.example: They were defeated in the first round of the tournament.  他们在锦标赛的第一轮就被打败了。

words.meaning: n.  小说,虚构的故事,法律的拟制
words.example:
The book is a work of fiction and not intended as a historical account.  这本书是一部小说作品而并非史实陈述。
When he's telling you something, you never know what's fact and what's fiction.  他向你叙事时，你永远都不知道哪些是事实，哪些是杜撰的。

words.meaning: vt.  发现,察觉,探测
words.example:
Some sounds cannot be detected by the human ear.  有些声音是人的耳朵无法察觉到的。
Financial experts have detected signs that the economy is beginning to improve.  金融专家已经注意到经济开始有好转的迹象。
High levels of lead were detected in the atmosphere.  经检测发现大气中铅的含量很高。

words.meaning: a.  巨大的,非常的,可怕的
words.example:
They were making the most tremendous amount of noise last night.  昨晚他们弄出的噪声震天响。
She's been a tremendous (= very great) help to me over the last few months.  过去几个月里，她给我的帮助极大。
You won? That's tremendous!  你赢了？太棒了！

words.meaning: n.  担保,抵押品,保证书vt.  保证,担保
words.example:
The system costs £99.95 including postage, packing and a 12-month guarantee.  包括邮资、包装费用，该系统价格共计99.95英镑，保用12个月。
The video recorder comes with/has a two-year guarantee.  这台录像机保修期为两年。
The shop said they would replace the television as it was still under guarantee.  商店说会给我们退换那台电视机，因为它还没有过包退期。

words.meaning: a.  无罪的,不懂事的,无知的n.  天真的人,笨蛋
words.example:
He firmly believes that she is innocent of the crime.  他坚信她是清白的。
She has such an innocent face that I find it hard to believe anything bad of her.  她一脸天真无邪，我很难把她往坏的方面想。
It was an innocent remark, I didn't mean to hurt his feelings.  那句话没有恶意，我并不想伤害他的感情。    Compare guilty

words.meaning: n.  边界,分界线
words.example:
The Ural mountains mark the boundary between Europe and Asia.  乌拉尔山脉是欧洲和亚洲的分界线。
Residents are opposed to the prison being built within the city boundary.  居民们反对把监狱建在市区。
Electronic publishing is blurring the boundaries between dictionaries and encyclopedias.  电子出版使得字典与百科全书的界限变模糊了。

words.meaning: a.  遥远的,偏僻的,疏远的,细微的n.  远程
words.example:
It happened in the remote past , so no one worries about it any more.  这件事发生在很久很久以前了，所以没有人再为此担心了。
They take little interest in a conflict far from their homes and remote from their everyday problems.  这是一场远在他们家乡千里之外的冲突，和他们每天遇到的问题也毫不沾边，他们对其不怎么感兴趣。
The chances of a visit by Martians to the Earth are remote.  火星人访问地球的可能性微乎其微。UK adjective

words.meaning: n.  定期刊物，杂志; 日记，日志
words.example: She kept a travel journal during her trip to South America.  她在南美旅行期间持续记录旅行日志。

words.meaning: a.  未加工过的
words.example:
raw fish.  生鱼UK adjective
Oil is an important raw material which can be processed into many different products, including plastics.  石油是一种重要的原料，可以加工成包括塑胶在内的许多种产品。
They claimed that raw sewage was being pumped into the sea.  他们断言，下水道的污水未经处理就被直接排入了大海。

words.meaning: n.  知道，注意
words.example:
Public awareness of the problem will make politicians take it seriously.  一旦公众意识到这个问题，政客们就会严肃对待它了。
Environmental awareness has increased dramatically over the past decade.  在过去的十年间，环保意识明显增强。

words.meaning: vt.  撤回,萞?撤消,移开,拉开vi.  撤退,离开
words.example:
This credit card allows you to withdraw up to £200 a day from cash dispensers.  这张信用卡允许你每天从自动提款机中提取200英镑。
The UN has withdrawn its troops from the country.  联合国已从该国撤军。
Eleven million bottles of water had to be withdrawn from sale due to a health scare.  因为害怕危害健康，有1100万瓶水不得不停止销售。

words.meaning: n.  地极; 磁极; 杆
words.example:
Most weather satellites are stationed over the Equator or travel over the poles.  大部分气象卫星定位于赤道上空或绕地球两极飞行。UK noun countable
These two men might be thought to represent the opposite poles of economic ideology.  这两个人可能被认为是两种极端的经济思想体系的代表。UK noun countable
My sister and I are poles apart in personality.  我和妹妹在性格上截然相反。

words.meaning: vt. vi.  证明,作证,声明,表明
words.example: The expert will testify tomorrow.  专家明天出庭作证。

words.meaning: n.  方式; 风格; 时尚
words.example:
Each department in the company has its own mode of operation and none of them are compatible.  这家公司的每一个部门都有自己的运作方式，互不相容。
Railways are the most important mode of transport for the economy.  铁路对经济而言是最重要的运输方式。UK noun
Miniskirts were very much the mode in the 60s.  迷你裙在20世纪60年代风靡一时。

words.meaning: n.  对话vi.  对话vt.  用对话表达
words.example:
The play contained some very snappy/witty dialogue.  这出戏里有一些非常俏皮／风趣的对白。
Act Two begins with a short dialogue between father and son.  第二幕以父子间的简短对白开场。
The rebel leaders stated that they are willing to enter into dialogue with the government.  叛军首领发表声明说他们愿意与政府进行对话。

words.meaning: vt.  意味着，暗示
words.example:
I'm not implying anything about your cooking, but could we eat out tonight?  我并不是暗示你做的饭不好吃，只是想提议我们今晚去外面吃，好吗？
Socialism implies equality.  社会主义必然包含平等。

words.meaning: a.  相互的,共有的
words.example:
Theirs was a partnership based on mutual respect, trust and understanding.  他们的合作是建立在互相尊重、信任和理解的基础之上的。
Both countries are acting to their mutual advantage.  两国的做法对彼此都有好处。
The agreement was terminated by mutual consent.  经双方同意，这项协议被终止了。

words.meaning: a.  先进的; 高级的
words.example: This is the most advanced type of engine available.  这是现有的最先进的引擎。

words.meaning: v.  烘，烤
words.example:
Bake at 180°C for about 20 minutes.  以摄氏180度烘烤20分钟。
Bake for 5-7 minutes in a preheated oven.  在预热过的烤箱中烤五至七分钟。
It's baking outside.  外面热得跟蒸笼似的。

words.meaning: n.  财政,财务vt.  供给. . . 经费,负担经费vi.  筹措资金
words.example:
You need to speak to someone in the finance department.  你需要和财务部的人谈一谈。
The finance committee controls the school's budget.  财务委员会掌管着学校的预算。
We keep a tight control on the organization's finances.  我们严格控制该组织的资金。

words.meaning: a.  吸引人的，有魅力的
words.example:
Spending 12 hours on a plane isn't a very attractive (= pleasant) prospect.  连坐12个小时的飞机，可不是甚么令人向往的事。
We need to make the club attractive to a wider range of people.  我们要让这个俱乐部吸引更广的人群。

words.meaning: a.  不同的,变化多的
words.example:
Students from countries as diverse as Colombia and Lithuania use Cambridge textbooks.  来自哥伦比亚、立陶宛等不同国家的学生都在使用剑桥的课本。
New York is a very culturally/ethnically diverse city.  纽约是一个在文化／种族方面十分多元化的城市。

words.meaning: a.  有关联的,中肯的,有关系的,相应的,成比例的,适当的
words.example:
Education should be relevant to the child's needs.  教育应和孩子的需要挂钩。
For further information, please refer to the relevant leaflet.  欲知详情，请参阅有关广告单张。
The point is highly relevant to this discussion.  这一点和这次讨论的议题密切相关。

words.meaning: a.  理想的; 完美的; n.  理想
words.example:
She's the ideal person (= exactly the right type of person) for the job.  她是这项工作的理想人选。
The television also comes in a compact 36 cm screen size, ideal for bedroom or kitchen use.  这款电视机也有萤幕大小为36厘米的袖珍型，非常适合在睡房和厨房使用。
It's the ideal opportunity to meet people.  这是结识朋友的绝好机会。

words.meaning: vi.  进展,进化,展开vt.  使发展,推论,使进化
words.example:
Humans evolved from apes.  人类是由猿进化而来的。
The company has evolved over the years into a multi-million dollar organization.  这间公司在几年内逐步发展成为一间拥有几百万美元资产的大企业。
Bacteria are evolving resistance to antibiotics.  细菌正逐渐对抗生素产生抵抗力。

words.meaning: vt.  替. . . 辩护,证明vi.  证明合法
words.example:
Are you sure that these measures are justified?  你确定这些措施合理吗？
It was the only thing that I could do - I don't have to justify myself to anyone.  这是我唯一能做的——我不必向任何人解释。

words.meaning: n.  抗议，反对; v.  抗议，反对
words.example:
Protests have been made/registered by many people who would be affected by the proposed changes.  许多将因拟议改变而受到影响的人举行了抗议活动。
Conservation groups have united in protest against the planned new road.  环境保育组织联合起来，抗议计划建造的新公路。
They protested bitterly to their employers, but to no avail.  他们向老板表达强烈抗议，但一点用也没有。

words.meaning: n.  轰隆声,猛撞,崩溃,粗布vi. vt.  撞碎,破碎,迫降a.  速成的
words.example:
We skidded on the ice and crashed (into another car).  我们在冰上打滑撞了（另一辆）车。
The plane crashed into a mountainside.  飞机撞到了山坡上。
Her brother borrowed her motorbike and crashed it.  她弟弟借用她的摩托车，结果给撞坏了。verb

words.meaning: n.  技艺,手艺,诡计vt.  巧手制作
words.example:
Eighteen craft (= boats) set out in the race.  比赛出发时有18艘船。
These bracelets were crafted by native Americans.  这些手镯是美洲印第安人制作的。

words.meaning: n.  洞察力; 领悟
words.example: It was an interesting book, full of fascinating insights into human relationships.  这是一本有趣的书，充满了对人际关系独到的见解。

words.meaning: vt.  具有，拥有
words.example: In the past the root of this plant was thought to possess magical powers.  过去这种植物的根被认为具有神奇的力量。verb transitive

words.meaning: a.  广的,广泛的,多方面的
words.example:
Her knowledge of music is extensive (= she knows a lot about music).  她的音乐知识非常渊博。
The wedding received extensive coverage in the newspapers.  报纸对这场婚礼进行了全面报道。

words.meaning: n.  插曲,插话,有趣的事件,一段情节
words.example:
This latest episode in the fraud scandal has shocked a lot of people.  诈骗丑闻最新爆出的事件让很多人瞠目结舌。
The drugs, the divorce and the depression - it's an episode in his life that he wants to forget.  吸毒、离婚和抑郁——这是他人生中不堪回首的一段经历。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.  过错; 【地质学】断层
words.example:
It's not my fault she didn't come!  她没来不是我的错！
She believes it was the doctor's fault that Peter died.  她认为彼得的死医生需要负责。
The fault was/lay with the organizers, who failed to make the necessary arrangements for dealing with so many people.  是组织者的过错，他们没有做好必要的安排来接待这么多人。

words.meaning: n.  解放,放任,放纵a. 宽松的,松的,宽的,不牢固的,不精确的,自由的,散
words.example:
There were some loose wires hanging out of the wall.  墙上搭着几根没有接好的电线。
The nails in the bridge had worked them selves loose.  桥上的钉子已经松动了。
The prisoners were so thin that their skin hung loose.  囚犯们瘦得很厉害，身上的皮肤都松垮垮地垂着。

words.meaning: ad.  不久; 简要地
words.example:
We will shortly be arriving in King's Cross Station.  我们马上就要到国王十字车站了。
Shortly after you left, a man came into the office looking for you.  你离开后不久就有一名男子来到办公室找你。

words.meaning: ad.  本来,原来,最初
words.example: Originally it was a bedroom, but we turned it into a study.  这原本是间睡房，但我们把它改成了书房。

words.meaning: a.  相当的,可观的,重要的
words.example: The fire caused considerable damage to the church.  那场火灾令教堂造成了重大损失。

words.meaning: ad. a.  (to)在…之前; 优先(的)
words.example:
The course required no prior knowledge of Spanish.  这门课不要求先前学过西班牙语。
They had to refuse the dinner invitation because of a prior engagement (= something already planned for that time).  因为事先另有约会，他们只好拒绝了吃饭的邀请。
Mothers with young children have a prior claim on funds.  抚育幼儿的母亲拥有优先获得补助的权利。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.  有知识者,知识分子,凭理智做事者a.  智力的,知性的,聪明的
words.example:
Looking after a baby at home all day is nice but it doesn't provide much intellectual stimulation.  整天在家照顾婴儿虽然不错，但让人不怎么动脑筋。
She was too much of an intellectual to find popular films interesting.  她太书卷气了，认为流行电影没甚么意思。

words.meaning: n.  攻击,突袭vt.  袭击,突袭vi.  动武
words.example:
He was charged with sexual assault.  他被指控性侵犯。
They launched an assault on the capital yesterday.  昨天他们进攻首都。
Women's groups have demanded a nationwide assault on sexism in the workplace.  妇女团体已经要求在全国范围内发动一场反对工作场所性别歧视的硬仗。

words.meaning: vi.  放松,松懈,松弛,休养,休息vt.  使松驰,缓和,使松懈,使休息
words.example:
After work she relaxed with a cup of tea and the newspaper.  下班后，她喝杯茶读着报纸放松放松。
He relaxed his grip on my arm (= He began to hold it less tightly).  他紧抓着我手臂的手不再那么用力了。verb
Two weeks after the police relaxed security at the airports, there was a bomb attack.  警方放松了对机场采取的安全措施两周后就发生了一起炸弹袭击事件。verb

words.meaning: n.  奇遇; 冒险活动
words.example:
She had some exciting adventures in Egypt.  她在埃及经历了一些很刺激的奇遇。
We got lost on the Metro - it was quite an adventure.  我们在地铁里迷路了，还真是挺惊险的。
Sam won't come - he's got no sense of adventure (= he does not enjoy dangerous or exciting situations).  萨姆不会来的，他不喜欢冒险。

words.meaning: n.  外部,外面a.  外部的,客观的,表面的
words.example:
Female kangaroos carry their young in pouches that are external to their bodies.  雌袋鼠把幼鼠放在体外的育儿袋中。
This cream is for external use only (= it must not be put inside the body).  这种药膏仅限外用。
In later years, his paintings began to show a number of external influences (= influences coming from other people).  他晚年的画作开始表现出很多受其他画家影响的痕迹。

words.meaning: n.  证据; 试验
words.example:
If anyone needs proof of Andrew Davies' genius as a writer, this novel is it.  如果有人需要证据证明安德鲁•大卫斯是天才作家，这本小说就是。
Keep your receipt as proof of purchase.  保留收据作为购物证明。noun
It says on the bottle that it's 60 percent proof.  瓶子上写着酒精浓度为60度。adjective [after noun]

words.meaning: a.  有信心的,有把握的
words.example:
Be a bit more confident in yourself!  你应该再自信一点！
They don't sound confident about the future of the industry.  他们听起来对该行业的未来信心不足。
I'm confident of his skills as a manager.  作为经理他相当老练，我对此很有信心。

words.meaning: n.  违反,违背,妨碍
words.example:
He claimed that the way he'd been treated was a gross violation of his civil/constitutional/human rights.  他声称他们如此对待他是对他的公民权／宪法所赋予的权利／人权的粗暴侵犯。
The takeover of the embassy constitutes a flagrant/blatant violation of international law.  占领大使馆是公然违反国际法的行为。
It was clear that they had not acted in violation of the rules.  很显然他们的行为并没有违反规章。

words.meaning: n.  许可证，执照; v.  给执照
words.example: The license expires next month.  执照下月到期。

words.meaning: n.  掩蔽处，庇护所; vt.  保护
words.example:
They opened a shelter to provide temporary housing for the city's homeless.  他们开设了一个收容所，为该市的无家可归者提供临时的住宿。
The trees gave/provided some shelter from the rain.  这些树遮了一些雨。
We took shelter for the night in an abandoned house.  我们在一栋废弃的房子里躲了一夜。UK verb

words.meaning: n. v.  擦，摩擦
words.example:
She yawned and rubbed her eyes sleepily.  她打着哈欠睡意蒙地揉着眼睛。
He rubbed (at) the stain on his trousers and made it worse.  他去擦裤子上的污渍，结果越擦越脏。
We rubbed some polish into the surface of the wood.  我们在木头表面刷了一些亮光漆。

words.meaning: n.  论争,辩论,论战,争论
words.example:
There was a big controversy surrounding/over the use of drugs in athletics.  体育界对使用违禁药物争议很大。
The policy has caused fierce/heated controversy ever since it was introduced.  这项政策自推行以来已引起了激烈的争论。

words.meaning: v.  褪色; 凋谢; 消失
words.example:
If you hang your clothes out in the bright sun, they will fade.  衣服挂在光线强的地方晾晒会褪色。
My suntan is already fading.  我晒黑的肤色已经开始变浅了。
They arrived home just as the light was fading (= as it was going dark).  夕阳西下时，他们到家了。

words.meaning: n.  悲剧,惨案,悲惨
words.example:
The pilot averted a tragedy when he succeeded in preventing the plane from crashing.  飞行员成功阻止飞机的坠毁，从而避免了一场悲剧。
Hitler's invasion of Poland led to the tragedy of the Second World War.  希特勒入侵波兰，引发第二次世界大战这场浩劫。
His life was touched by hardship and personal tragedy.  他的一生充满了艰辛和不幸。

words.meaning: vt.  以…为特征; 刻画…的性格
words.example:
Bright colours and bold strokes characterize his early paintings.  明亮的色彩和大胆的笔触是他早期绘画作品的特征。
In her essay, she characterizes the whole era as a period of radical change.  她在文章中将整个时代的特征归纳为一个急剧变化的时期。

words.meaning: n.  职业; 同行; 专业
words.example:
He left the teaching profession in 1965 to set up his own business.  他1965年离开教师岗位自己创业。
The report notes that forty per cent of lawyers entering the profession are women.  这份报告指出，执业律师中有40%是女性。
Teaching as a profession is very underpaid.  教书作为一种职业，酬劳其实过低。

words.meaning: vt. vi.  改变
words.example:
We've had to alter some of our plans.  我们不得不对一些计划作出改动。
Although long-distance phone calls are going up, the charge for local calls will not alter.  尽管长途电话费涨价，本地电话费将不会有变动。
Giving up our car has radically altered our lifestyle.  弃车不用使我们的生活方式发生了根本性的变化。

words.meaning: vt.  构成,组成,任命
words.example:
This latest defeat constitutes a major setback for the government.  最近的这次失败是对政府的一次重挫。UK verb
Women constitute about 10% of Parliament.  女性在议会中约占10%。
The under-18s constitute nearly 25% of the town's population.  18岁以下的人口占该城镇人口的近25%。

words.meaning: n.  紧握,挤,榨,佣金,压榨,榨取vt.  紧握,挤,榨取vi.  压榨,榨
words.example:
Cut the lemon in half and squeeze the juice into the bowl.  把柠檬对切，将汁挤到碗里。
As she waited to go into the exam, he squeezed her hand (= pressed it affectionately with his hand) and wished her good luck.  在她等待应考时，他捏了捏她的手，祝她好运。
Once he had finished cleaning the floor, he squeezed the cloth out.  他擦完地板之后，把抹布拧干。

words.meaning: n.  化装舞会; 面具
words.example:
The bank robbers wore masks throughout the raid.  劫匪抢劫银行时一直戴着面罩。UK noun countable
The newspaper revealed the sordid truth behind his mask of respectability.  报纸揭露了他体面外表下龌龊肮脏的真实嘴脸。UK noun countable
I've put some flowers in there to mask the smell.  我在那里放了一些花来掩盖那种气味。

words.meaning: n.  皈依者,改宗者vt.  使改变信仰,兑换,倒置vi.  皈依n.  转换
words.example:
Could we convert the small bedroom into a second bathroom?  我们能把这间小睡房改建成第二间浴室吗？
What's the formula for converting pounds into kilos?  把磅换算成千克的公式是甚么？
He converted to (= started believing in) Catholicism when he got married.  他婚后信奉了天主教。

words.meaning: a.  广泛的,有理解力的,包容力大的
words.example:
We offer you a comprehensive training in all aspects of the business.  我们向你提供这个行业各方面的综合培训。
Is this list comprehensive or are there some names missing?  这份名单是完整的还是遗漏了一些名字？
He has written a fully comprehensive guide to Rome.  他写了一本内容详尽的罗马旅游指南。

words.meaning: a.  卓越的,显著的,凸出的,突起的
words.example:
The government should be playing a more prominent role in promoting human rights.  政府应该在促进人权方面发挥更重要的作用。UK adjective
She has a rather prominent chin/nose.  她的下巴翘得厉害／鼻子很高。
New books are displayed in a prominent position on tables at the front of the shop.  新书陈列在商店前方桌上的一个显眼位置。

words.meaning: ad.  (of)不顾，不管
words.example:
The plan for a new office tower went ahead regardless of local opposition.  尽管遭到当地居民的反对，新建高层办公大楼的计划还是付诸实施了。
She knew it was dangerous to visit him except at night, but she set out regardless (of the risk).  虽然她知道除了晚上别的时候去看他都很危险，可她还是（不顾危险）动身去了。
This job is open to all, regardless of previous experience.  这份工作任何人都可以应聘，不管其以前的工作经历如何。

words.meaning: n.  负荷(量)，负担; vt.  装载，使负担
words.example:
The maximum load for this elevator is eight persons.  这部电梯的最大载客量为八人。
One truck involved in the accident was carrying a heavy load of coal.  事故中的一辆货车上装了大量煤炭。
I've got a load of work to get through before tomorrow.  明天之前我要完成很多工作。

words.meaning: n.  马房,牛棚a.  稳定的,安定的,坚固的,坚定的vt.  赶入马房
words.example:
If the foundations of the house aren't stable, collapse is possible.  如果房子的地基不稳，就有可能倒塌。
After several part-time jobs, he's now got a stable job in a bank.  做了几份兼职工作之后，他目前在银行找到了一份稳定的工作。
The hospital said she was in a stable condition (= not likely to get worse) following the operation.  院方说她手术之后情况稳定。

words.meaning: vt. vi.  假装,伪称,自命,自称
words.example:
The children pretended (that) they were dinosaurs.  孩子们装扮成恐龙。
She's not really hurt - she's only pretending.  她并不是真的受了伤——她只是在装。
Of course I was angry - I can't pretend otherwise.  我当然生气了——怎么可能会是假装的。

words.meaning: v.  分开，分裂; n.  分化
words.example:
The prize was split between Susan and Kate.  这笔奖金被苏珊和凯特平分了。
Split the aubergines in half and cover with breadcrumbs.  把茄子切成两半，裹上面包屑。
The teacher split the children (up) into three groups.  老师把孩子们分成三组。

words.meaning: vt.  违犯,亵渎,干扰,妨碍,侵犯,违反
words.example:
They were charged with violating federal law.  他们被控违犯了联邦法律。
It seems that the planes deliberately violated the cease-fire agreement.  那些飞机似乎是故意违反停火协议。
The doctor has been accused of violating professional ethics.  那名医生被控违反了职业道德。

words.meaning: n.  散发(物)，发射
words.example: The Green Party have called for a substantial reduction in the emission of greenhouse gases by the UK.  绿党要求英国切实减少温室气体的排放量。

words.meaning: a.  稳定的,不动摇的,沉着的,可靠的,坚定的,稳固的vt.  使稳定,使坚定v
words.example:
The procession moved through the streets at a steady pace.  队伍稳步穿过街道。
Orders for new ships are rising, after several years of steady decline.  新船的订单数量经过几年的持续下降之后开始增加了。
Over the last 10 years he has produced a steady flow/stream/trickle of articles and papers.  过去十年，他连续发表了一系列文章和论文。

words.meaning: a.  重要的,生命的,致命的,生死攸关的
words.example:
She had found out some information of vital importance.  她已经查出了一些极为重要的资讯。
The kidney plays a vital role/part in the removal of waste products from the blood.  肾脏对于排除血液中的废物起着至关重要的作用。
He had never felt so vital and full of life.  他从来没有像现在一样感到如此精神焕发，充满活力。

words.meaning: n.  片段,部分,分节vt. vi.  分割,分裂n.  段
words.example:
The salad was decorated with segments of orange.  沙拉上点缀了橙瓣。
People over the age of 85 make up the fastest-growing population segment.  85岁以上者成为人口增长最快的部分。verb intransitive or transitive UK US     specialized
City Insurance segmented the market into three by issuing three types of policy.  城市保险公司透过推出三种保单把市场分割为三个部分。

words.meaning: a.  仅仅的，纯粹的
words.example:
The plane crashed mere minutes after take-off.  飞机起飞后仅仅几分钟就坠毁了。
It cost a mere twenty dollars.  那只需花费20美元。
The mere thought of it makes me ill.  一想起它就让我不舒服。

words.meaning: n.  变更,变化,变种,变奏
words.example:
Unemployment rates among white-collar workers show much less regional variation than corresponding rates among blue-collar workers.  白领工作者的失业率与蓝领工人相比，地区性差异要小得多。
The medical tests showed some variation in the baby's heart rate.  医学检验显示出婴儿的心率有些不齐。
There are wide variations in the way pensioners have benefited from the system.  养老金领取者从这个体制中受益的情况有很大差别。

words.meaning: n.  激进分子,语根,基础a.  激进的,根本的,基本的,根的
words.example:
He was known as a radical reformer/thinker/politician.  他是个著名的激进改革者／思想家／政治家。
These people have very radical views.  这些人观点很偏激。adjective
We need to make some radical changes to our operating procedures.  我们需要对操作流程进行一些根本性的变革。

words.meaning: vt.  使适应,改编vi.  适应
words.example:
Many software companies have adapted popular programs to the new operating system.  许多软体公司已经改编了常用的程式以适应新的作业系统。
The recipe here is a pork roast adapted from Caroline O'Neill's book 'Louisiana Kitchen'.  这道菜是根据卡洛琳•奥尼尔《路易斯安那厨房》一书中烤猪肉的做法改进而来的。
The play had been adapted for (= changed to make it suitable for) children.  这个剧本已被改编成儿童剧。

words.meaning: a.  苍白的; 淡的
words.example:
You're looking pale - do you feel ill?  你看起来脸色苍白——你病了吗？
She has a naturally pale complexion and dark hair.  她天生肤色白晰，头发乌黑。    See beyond the pale
She wore a pale blue hat.  她戴着一顶浅蓝色的帽子。

words.meaning: n.  音乐家，乐师
words.example: The concert features dancers, singers and musicians of all nationalities.  这场音乐会云集了各国的舞蹈家、歌唱家和音乐家。

words.meaning: n.  船; 容器; 血管
words.example:
The remains of some Roman earthenware vessels were found during the dig.  挖掘过程中发现了一些古罗马人的陶瓷器皿的残片。noun countable
As a young and spirited politician, he seems a worthy vessel for the nation's hopes.  他是位充满活力的年轻政治家，似乎是可以寄托国家希望的人。noun countable

words.meaning: n.  库房; 贮藏，存储
words.example: We've had to build some cupboards to give us more storage space.  我们不得不做了些壁橱来增加储藏空间。

words.meaning: vt.  逃避,逃跑,逃走vi.  逃,消失
words.example:
She fled (from) the room in tears.  她哭着跑出房间。
In order to escape capture, he fled to the mountains.  为了免遭俘虏，他逃到了山里。
It is likely that the suspects have fled the country by now.  很有可能几名嫌疑犯现在已经逃到了国外。

words.meaning: n.  皮革
words.example: a leather coat/belt/handbag  皮衣／带／包

words.meaning: vt.  分配,散布,分发
words.example:
The books will be distributed free to local schools.  这些书将免费发放给当地学校。
Several people were arrested for distributing racist leaflets/pamphlets (to the spectators).  有数人因为（向观众）散发宣扬种族主义的小册子而被捕。
The company aims eventually to distribute (= supply for sale) its products throughout the European Union.  公司计划最终让产品行销欧盟国家。

words.meaning: n.  草地,草坪,薄麻布
words.example: Will you mow the lawn at the weekend?  周末你修剪一下草坪好吗？

words.meaning: a.  易受伤害的,有弱点的,成局的,脆弱的,易受攻击的
words.example:
It is on economic policy that the government is most vulnerable.  政府最易受人诟病的是经济政策。
Tourists are more vulnerable to attack, because they do not know which areas of the city to avoid.  游客更容易受到攻击，因为他们不知道城里哪些地方不该去。

words.meaning: n.  例子，事例
words.example:
There have been several instances of violence at the school.  学校里发生过几次暴力事件。
In the electronics industry, for instance, 5000 jobs are being lost.  例如，电子业就会失去5000份工作。verb transitive UK formal
She argued the need for legal reform and instanced several recent cases with grossly unfair verdicts.  她极力说明有必要进行司法改革，并援引了最近出现的几个非常不公平的判例。

words.meaning: n.  能力; 性能; 容量
words.example:
These tests are beyond the capability of an average 12-year-old.  这些测试超出了一个普通12岁孩子的能力。
Several countries are trying to develop a nuclear capability.  几个国家正在试图发展核力量。

words.meaning: n.  名声,名人
words.example: A celebrity endorsed the product.  一位名人代言了该产品。

words.meaning: n.  幻想,白日梦
words.example:
Steve's favourite fantasy was to own a big house and a flashy car.  史蒂夫最爱幻想拥有一座大房子和一辆豪华轿车。
She retreated into a fantasy world , where she could be anything she wanted.  她遁入了幻想世界，在那里她想要成为甚么都可以。

words.meaning: n.  小块土地,地区图,情节,阴谋,图vt.  划分,绘图,密谋vi.  密谋,策划v
words.example:
The film has a very simple plot.  这部电影情节很简单。
The plots of his books are basically all the same.  他的书情节基本上都一样。UK noun countable
The plot was discovered before it was carried out.  这项阴谋还未得逞就暴露了。

words.meaning: n.  心理学; 心理
words.example: She studied psychology at Harvard.  她在哈佛大学攻读心理学。

words.meaning: n.  顾问，法律顾问
words.example: [as form of address] I don't think that question is relevant, counselor.  我认为那个问题与本案无关，律师先生。

words.meaning: n.  管子
words.example:
Hot water is piped to all apartments from the central boiler room.  热水从中央锅炉房经管道输送到每个公寓套房。
figurative Music is piped throughout the hotel complex.  音乐声在整栋饭店大楼里回荡。verb
Will you please pipe down, you two? I'm trying to read!  你们两个能安静下来吗？我在看书呢！verb

words.meaning: n.  轻蔑,怠慢a.  轻微的,纤细的,,苗条的,脆弱的vt.  轻视,忽略,怠慢
words.example:
I've got a slight headache.  我头有点痛。
Like most long-distance runners she is very slight.  和大多数长跑运动员一样，她十分苗条。verb transitive

words.meaning: n.  荫,阴暗,荫凉处,遮光物,灯罩,些微,浓淡,帘vi.  渐变vt.  使阴暗,使
words.example:
The sun was hot, and there were no trees to offer us shade.  太阳火辣辣的，没有树让我们遮阳。
The children played in/under the shade of a large beach umbrella.  孩子们在一把大沙滩遮阳伞下的阴凉处玩耍。
The lamps all had matching purple shades.  这些灯都有与之相配的紫色灯罩。

words.meaning: vt.  承受,支持,支撑,供养,继续,忍受,准许,证实,蒙受
words.example:
The economy looks set to sustain its growth into next year.  看来经济增长会持续到明年。
He seems to find it difficult to sustain relationships with women.  他似乎觉得和女人维持关系并不容易。
The soil in this part of the world is not rich enough to sustain a large population.  这里的土地不够肥沃，无法供养大量人口。verb transitive

words.meaning: n.  山，峰; v.  增加
words.example:
The children's excitement is mounting as Christmas gets nearer.  随着圣诞临近，孩子都越来越兴奋。verb
She mounted her horse and rode off.  她骑上马走了。verb
He mounted the platform and began to speak to the assembled crowd.  他登上讲台，开始对集会的群众发表演讲。

words.meaning: n.  角,角落vi.  钓鱼,夺取,追逐,转变角度vt.  使转动角度
words.example:
The interior angles of a square are right angles or angles of 90 degrees.  正方形的内角是直角，即90度角。
The boat settled into the mud at a 35 degree angle.  船身呈35度角倾斜着陷入烂泥中。
The boat settled into the mud at an angle of 35 degrees.  船身呈35度角倾斜着陷入烂泥中。

words.meaning: n.  习惯,风俗,海关v.  定制n.  自定义
words.example:
He left the house at nine exactly, as is his custom.  他九点准时离开了家，这是他的习惯。noun
Most of our custom comes from tourists nowadays.  如今我们大部分生意来自游客。
If we don't give good service, people will take their custom elsewhere.  如果我们不能提供良好的服务，人们就会光顾别处。noun

words.meaning: a.  有效率的,能干的
words.example:
The city's transport system is one of the most efficient in Europe.  这座城市的交通系统运行效率很高，在全欧洲名列前茅。
We need someone really efficient who can organize the office and make it run smoothly.  我们需要的人必须要高效干练，善于组织筹划，能使这个办事处顺畅运作。

words.meaning: n.  成分，构成; 作品，作文
words.example:
This concerto is one of her earlier/later compositions.  这首协奏曲是她早期／后期的作品之一。
At music school I studied piano and composition.  我在音乐学校学习钢琴和作曲。

words.meaning: n.  碳,副本,复写纸
words.example: Carbon dioxide traps heat.  二氧化碳会困住热量。

words.meaning: vt.  消耗,消费,消灭vi.  消灭,毁灭
words.example:
Our high living standards cause our present population to consume 25 percent of the world's oil.  我们的高生活水准致使我们目前的人口要消耗世界石油的25%。
He consumes vast quantities of chips with every meal.  他每一餐都要吃掉大量的薯条。UK verb transitive
He was consumed with jealousy.  他心里满是嫉妒。

words.meaning: n.  计划，方案
words.example:
There's a new scheme in our town for recycling plastic bottles.  我们镇上有一个回收利用塑胶瓶的新计划。
Class sizes will increase under the new scheme.  按照新的设计，班级规模将扩大。
He's got a hare-brained/crazy/daft scheme for getting rich before he's 20.  他有一个轻率的／疯狂的／愚蠢的计划，好让自己在20岁前致富。noun countable

words.meaning: v.  (使)破裂; n.  裂(缝、纹)
words.example:
The walls cracked and the roof collapsed in the earthquake.  地震中墙壁开裂，屋顶坍塌。
Stress and overwork are causing teachers to crack (up).  压力和过度劳累使老师们身心疲惫。
Their relationship began to crack (up) after their child died.  孩子夭折后，他们的关系开始出现问题。

words.meaning: ad.  此外prep.  除. . . 之外
words.example:
Do you play any other sports besides football and basketball?  除了足球和篮球外，你还参与别的体育活动吗？
She won't mind your being late - besides, it's hardly your fault.  她不会因为你迟到而耿耿于怀——何况这并不是你的错。adverb preposition

words.meaning: n.  银河,星系,一群显赫的人物
words.example: Present tonight at the long-awaited opening of this film are a whole galaxy of stars from the acting and musical professions.  人们期待已久的电影首映礼今晚举行，一大批影星歌星前来捧场。

words.meaning: a.  特定的; 假定的
words.example:
Given his age, he's a remarkably fast runner.  考虑到他的年龄，他可称得上是个很出众的赛跑运动员了。
Given (the fact) that he's had six months to do this, he hasn't made much progress.  鉴于他有六个月时间去完成该工作，所以现在依然进展不大。adjective
At the given signal, the group rushed forward to the barrier.  预定信号一发出，人群便向关卡冲去。

words.meaning: n.  痕迹,踪迹,缰绳,迹线vt.  追踪,回溯,描绘vi.  上溯,沿路走
words.example:
The police are trying to trace the mother of a newborn baby found abandoned outside a hospital.  员警试图查出那位把新生婴儿抛弃在医院外面的母亲。
Attempts to trace the whereabouts of a man seen leaving the scene of the crime have so far been unsuccessful.  有人曾看到一名男子离开犯罪现场，但迄今为止，尚未成功追查到该名男子。
Their missing daughter was finally traced to (= found in) Manchester.  他们失踪的女儿最终在曼彻斯特找到了。

words.meaning: n.  约会，约定
words.example:
I'd like to make an appointment with Doctor Evans, please.  劳驾，我要预约埃文斯医生的门诊。
She had to cancel her dental appointment.  她不得不取消去看牙医的预约。
If he didn't have a secretary to remind him, he wouldn't keep (= remember to be present at) any of his appointments.  如果没有秘书提醒，他会把所有的约会通通忘掉。

words.meaning: n.  偏爱,优先,喜爱物n.  首选项
words.example:
Her preference is for comfortable rather than stylish clothes.  她更注重衣服的舒适性，而非时髦的款式。
Choosing furniture is largely a matter of personal preference.  挑选家俱主要是个人喜好的问题。
It would be wrong to discriminate against a candidate because of their sexual preference (= the sex of the people they are sexually attracted to).  出于应聘者的性倾向而对他们有所歧视是错误的。

words.meaning: a.  难以置信的
words.example:
The latest missiles can be fired with incredible accuracy.  最新型导弹的准确度高得令人难以置信。
It seems incredible that no one foresaw the crisis.  令人难以置信的是没有人预见到危机会发生。adjective
Yeah, it was an incredible performance.  对，这是一场非常出色的表演。

words.meaning: n.  准许进入; 入场费; 承认
words.example:
Her silence was taken as an admission of guilt/defeat.  她的沉默被认为是承认自己有罪／失败。
By/On his own admission (= as he has said) he has achieved little since he took over the company.  据他自己说，自从接手公司以来，他几乎一事无成。noun
Admission to the exhibition will be by invitation only.  只有持请帖者才可进入展览会场。

words.meaning: n.  婴儿，幼儿
words.example:
Jenny is a top-year infant now.  珍妮现在是一所幼儿学校的大班生。
Andrew's still in the infants.  安德鲁还在上幼儿学校。adjective UK

words.meaning: vt. vi.  计算,考虑,计划,打算
words.example:
The cost of the damage caused by the recent storms has been calculated as/at over £5 million.  据计算，近期风暴造成的损失超过了500万英镑。
