The new tax system would be calculated on the value of property owned by an individual.  新税制将按照个人财产价值计算税额。
We're calculating on about 30 guests.  我们预期约有30名客人。

words.meaning: n.  趋向,倾向
words.example: There is a tendency for unemployment to rise in the summer.  夏季的失业率有上升趋势。

words.meaning: n.  制服; a.  统一的; 均匀的
words.example:
Photographs show him wearing the scruffy T-shirt and jeans that were the student's uniform of the time.  照片上的他穿着当时的校服，就是那种脏兮兮的T恤和牛仔裤。UK adjective
As in so many offices that you see, the walls and furniture are a uniform grey.  和你看到的很多办公室一样，墙壁和家俱一律都是灰色的。
Small businesses are demanding that they receive uniform treatment from the banks.  小企业要求银行给予它们一视同仁的待遇。

words.meaning: n.  形成，构成; 编队
words.example: a rock formation  一块岩石的结构

words.meaning: n.  学问,学术成就,奖学金
words.example:
He got/won a scholarship to Eton.  他获得了伊顿公学的奖学金。
Paula went to the Royal College of Music on a scholarship.  宝拉靠奖学金进到皇家音乐学院。

words.meaning: v.  (使)具有资格，(使)合格
words.example:
She hopes to qualify (as a lawyer) at the end of the year.  她希望在年底取得（律师）资格。
She doesn't qualify for maternity leave because she hasn't been in her job long enough.  她无权休产假，因为她任职的时间不够长。
To qualify for the competition you need to be over 18.  18岁以上才有资格参赛。

words.meaning: v.  (from)得自，源于
words.example:
The institute derives all its money from foreign investments.  该机构的资金均来自海外投资。
She derives great pleasure/satisfaction from playing the violin.  拉小提琴能给她得到极大乐趣／满足。verb
The English word 'olive' is derived from the Latin word 'oliva'.  英语的 olive 一词源自拉丁语中的 oliva。

words.meaning: n.  丑闻,中伤,流言蜚语,反感,耻辱
words.example:
Their affair caused/created a scandal in the office.  他们的风流韵事在办公室里成了丑闻。
The scandal broke (= became public knowledge) right at the beginning of the Conservative Party Conference.  就在保守党大会开幕的那一刻，丑闻爆了出来。
If there is the slightest suggestion/hint of scandal, the public will no longer trust us.  只要有哪怕一丝丑闻，民众就再也不会信任我们。

words.meaning: vt.  相似,类似,象
words.example:
You resemble your mother very closely.  你长得很像你妈妈。
After the earthquake, the city resembled a battlefield.  地震过后，这座城市看上去就像战场一般。

words.meaning: n.  布，织品; 结构
words.example:
Unhappiness was woven into the natural fabric of people's lives.  苦恼忧愁原是人们日常生活的一部分。
We must invest in the fabric of our hospitals and start rebuilding them.  我们必须对医院建筑进行投资并开始重建工作。

words.meaning: n.  竞赛; 辩论
words.example:
She's won a lot of beauty contests.  她多次在选美大赛中获胜。noun countable UK ATTEMPT  努力
The contest for deputy leadership of the party is gathering speed.  该党副领袖职务的竞选争夺正在加剧。verb transitive /kənˈtest/
We will certainly contest any claims made against the safety of our products.  我们肯定会驳斥任何批评我们产品安全性的说法。verb transitive /kənˈtest/

words.meaning: n.  比例,比率,均衡,大小,面积,部分vt.  使成比例,使均衡,分摊
words.example:
Children make up a large proportion of the world's population.  孩童占世界人口的很大一部分。
The report shows that poor families spend a larger proportion of their income on food.  报告显示，贫困家庭食物支出所占其收入比例更大了。
The proportion of women to men at my college was about five to one.  我所在大学的男女比例大约为1：5。

words.meaning: n. [常pl.  ]指导方针
words.example: The EU has issued guidelines on appropriate levels of pay for part-time manual workers.  欧盟已经颁布了有关兼职体力劳动者适宜的酬劳标准。

words.meaning: n.  维护，保养
words.example:
Old houses need a lot of maintenance.  老房子需要大量保养。
There are thorough maintenance checks on each plane before take-off.  每架飞机起飞前都要经过彻底的维修检查。
The magazine offers tips on cutting your house maintenance costs.  这本杂志教你一些降低房屋维修花费的妙计。noun uncountable

words.meaning: a.  有机的
words.example: Organic chemicals are used in the manufacture of plastics, fibres, solvents and paints.  有机化学物用于生产塑胶、纤维、溶剂和油漆。

words.meaning: vt.  加强,变坚固vi.  变强,股票上涨
words.example:
They have been strengthening their border defences in preparation for war.  他们一直在为备战而强化边防。
His battle against cancer has strengthened his belief in God.  他跟癌症的斗争坚定了他对上帝的信仰。
The accident strengthens the case for better safety measures at fairgrounds.  这宗事故充分显示露天游乐场的安全防护需要加强。

words.meaning: n.  神话，虚构的故事
words.example:
The children enjoyed the stories about the gods and goddesses of Greek and Roman myth.  那些孩子都喜欢听希腊、罗马神话中诸神的故事。
Most societies have their own creation myths.  大多数社会都有自己的创世神话。noun
Statistics disprove the myth that women are worse drivers than men.  统计数据证明，女人驾驶技术比男人差的观念是错误的。

words.meaning: a.  老练的; 精密的; 复杂的，先进的
words.example:
She was slim, svelte and sophisticated.  她身材苗条，体态娇美，处事练达。
He was older than me and from London and I thought him very sophisticated.  他比我大，而且来自伦敦，我觉得他为人很老练。
These are among the most sophisticated weapons in the world.  这些属于世界上最尖端的武器。

words.meaning: n.  桶
words.example:
They drank a whole barrel of beer (= the contents of a barrel) at the party.  他们在派对上喝了整整一桶的啤酒。
She knows I need the work so she's got me over a barrel in terms of what she pays me.  她知道我需要这份工作，所以就在薪水上为难我。verb intransitive [+ adv/prep] (-ll- or US USUALLY -l-)    informal
We were barrelling along the autobahn at 180 kph.  我们以每小时180公里的速度在高速公路上飞驰。

words.meaning: n.  比,比率
words.example:
The ratio of men to women at the conference was ten to one/10:1.  出席会议者的男女比例为10：1。
The school is trying to improve its pupil-teacher ratio (= the number of teachers compared with the number of students).  该校正大力优化其师生间的人数比例结构。

words.meaning: n.  菜单
words.example:
The waiter brought the menu and the wine list.  侍者拿来了菜单和酒单。
What's on the menu today?  今天菜单上有甚么菜？noun countable
Select the 'Edit' menu and then choose 'Copy'.  选择“编辑”功能表，再选择“复制”。

words.meaning: a.  争论的,论争的,被议论的
words.example: The book was very controversial.  这本书很有争议。

words.meaning: a.  不顾死活的,危急的,令人绝望的,极渴望的
words.example:
The situation is desperate - we have no food, very little water and no medical supplies.  形势非常严峻——我们没有食物和药物，只有很少的水。
The earthquake survivors are in desperate need of help.  地震幸存者极需帮助。
He has a desperate desire to succeed.  他非常渴望成功。

words.meaning: a.  充分的,足够的
words.example:
This recipe should be sufficient for five people.  这份食谱应该足够五个人吃。
It was thought that he'd committed the crime but there wasn't sufficient evidence to convict him.  人们都认为他是犯罪凶手，但没有足够证据将他定罪。    Opposite insufficient

words.meaning: n.  叙述; 记叙文
words.example: It's a moving narrative of wartime adventure.  这是对战时经历的感人描述。

words.meaning: a.  谦逊的,羞怯的,端庄的,适度的
words.example:
They live in a fairly modest house, considering their wealth.  就他们拥有的财富而言，他们的住所不大。
There has been a modest improvement/recovery in housing conditions for the poor.  穷人的居住条件有了些许改善。
The party made modest gains in the elections, but nothing like the huge gains that were predicted.  这个党派在选举中取得了一定成绩，但和人们预计的巨大收获相差甚远。

words.meaning: n.  耽搁,迟滞vt. vi.  耽搁,延迟v.  延迟
words.example:
My plane was delayed by an hour.  我乘坐的飞机延误了一个小时。
Could we delay the meeting a few days?  我们可以把会议延后几天吗？
If you delay now, the opportunity might be lost.  现在你如果不赶快行动就会失去机会。noun countable or uncountable

words.meaning: vi.  爆炸,爆发,激发vt.  使爆炸
words.example:
He was driving so fast that his car tyre exploded.  他的车开得太快导致爆胎。    Compare implodeUK verb
The children exploded into giggles (= suddenly started laughing uncontrollably).  孩子们突然咯咯地笑起来。UK verb
The population has exploded in the last ten years.  在过去十年中，人口激增。UK verb

words.meaning: n.  范围,机会,广度,导弹射程,观察仪器,眼界
words.example:
I'm afraid that problem is beyond/outside the scope of my lecture.  恐怕那个问题超出了我的课程范围。
Oil painting does not come within the scope of a course of this kind.  油画不在这类课程范围内。
We would now like to broaden/widen the scope of the enquiry and look at more general matters.  我们现在要扩大调查的范围，多注意一些普遍情况。UK noun uncountable

words.meaning: n.  地平线; [常pl.  ]眼界，视野
words.example:
The moon rose slowly above the horizon.  月亮慢慢从地平线升起。
We could see a row of camels silhouetted on the horizon.  我们能看到地平线上一队骆驼的轮廓。noun only singular
Travelling certainly broadens your horizons.  旅行肯定会开阔你的眼界。noun only singular

words.meaning: a.  好奇的,求知的,古怪的
words.example:
Babies are curious about everything around them.  婴儿对周围的一切都很好奇。
There was a curious -looking man standing outside.  外面站着个长相古怪的男人。
It's curious (that) Billy hasn't phoned when he promised he would.  比利说他会打电话来，可是还没打过来，真蹊跷。

words.meaning: adv. a.  在市区(的)，往市区(的)
words.example: downtown Los Angeles  洛杉矶市中心

words.meaning: n.  提示,提醒,提白,付款期限a.  迅速的,敏捷的,立刻的,提白员的vt.
words.example:
The bishop's speech has prompted an angry response from both political parties.  主教的发言激起了两大政党的愤怒回应。
Recent worries over the president's health have prompted speculation over his political future.  最近对总统健康状况的担忧引发了对其政治前途的猜测。
What prompted you to say that?  是甚么促使你那么说的？

words.meaning: n.  胆固醇
words.example: an oil which is high in polyunsaturates and low in cholesterol  不饱和脂肪含量高而胆固醇含量低的食用油

words.meaning: vt.  吸收,并吞,全神贯注,同化
words.example:
Plants absorb carbon dioxide.  植物吸收二氧化碳。
In cold climates, houses need to have walls that will absorb heat.  在气候寒冷的地方，房屋的墙壁必须能吸收热量。
Towels absorb moisture.  毛巾吸收水汽。

words.meaning: a.  热心的,渴望的,热望的
words.example: They crowded round the spokesperson, eager for any news.  他们把发言人围了个水泄不通，渴望能得到点消息。

words.meaning: n.  校长,首长,本金,委托人,资本,主犯a.  主要的,重要的,首要的
words.example:
Iraq's principal export is oil.  伊拉克最重要的出口商品是石油。
He was principal dancer at the Dance Theatre of Harlem.  他是哈莱姆舞剧院的头号舞伶。
That was my principal reason for moving.  那是我搬家最主要的原因。noun

words.meaning: n.  动机,刺激,推动
words.example:
He's a bright enough student - he just lacks motivation.  他是个很聪明的学生，只是不够积极。
There seems to be a lack of motivation among the staff.  员工似乎都缺乏干劲。UK noun
What was the motivation for the attack?  这次袭击的动机是甚么？

words.meaning: n.  实验室
words.example: Laboratory tests suggest that the new drug may be used to treat cancer.  实验室测试显示这种新药可用于治疗癌症。

words.meaning: a.  浪漫的
words.example:
You used to be so romantic, but now you never tell me that you love me.  你以前是那么多情，可现在你从来就不对我说你爱我。
We thought that Egypt was an incredibly romantic country.  我们以前认为埃及是个充满传奇色彩的国家。
She has a romantic idea of what it's like to be a struggling young artist.  她不切实际地想像着做一个挣扎求生的年轻艺术家是如何浪漫。UK noun countable mainly disapproving

words.meaning: n.  发动机，电动机
words.example:
The pump is powered by a small electric motor.  这个泵是由一个小马达提供动力的。
Our washing machine needs a new motor.  我们的洗衣机需要换个新马达。
mainly US I've had a new motor (= engine) put in my car.  我请人在我的车里安装了一个新引擎。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.  滋味,香料vt.  加味于
words.example: The spice adds flavor to the soup.  这香料给汤添了风味。

words.meaning: vt.  俯瞰,远眺,没注意到n.  眺望,俯瞰中的景色
words.example:
Our hotel room overlooked the harbour.  从我们饭店的房间可眺望港口。
The house is surrounded by trees, so it's not overlooked at all (= it cannot be seen from any other buildings).  这栋房子四周绿树环绕，所以从其他建筑处根本看不到它。verb transitive UK NOT NOTICE  没注意
No one will be overlooked in the selection of the team.  在组队时不会忽略任何人。verb transitive UK FORGIVE  原谅

words.meaning: v.  (使)漂浮
words.example:
An empty bottle will float.  空瓶子能浮起来。
You can float very easily in/on the Dead Sea because it's so salty.  因为死海含盐量很高，人可以轻松浮在水面上。UK verb
We spent a lazy afternoon floating down/along the river.  我们沿河漂流而下，懒洋洋的渡过了一个下午。

words.meaning: v.  经历; 遭受
words.example:
She underwent an operation on a tumour in her left lung last year.  她在去年做了一次左肺肿瘤切除手术。
Cinema in Britain is undergoing a revival of popularity.  英国的电影院正经历着一场复兴。

words.meaning: n.  序列,继起的事,次序,连续,顺序vt.  按顺序排好n.  顺序
words.example:
The first chapter describes the strange sequence of events that lead to his death.  第一章描述了造成他死亡的一连串奇特事件。
Is there a particular sequence in which you have to perform these tasks?  你是否得按一定的顺序完成这些任务？
For the sake of convenience the photographs are shown in chronological sequence (= in the order in which they were taken).  为方便起见，照片按时间顺序展示。noun

words.meaning: n.  消耗(量)，消费(量); 食用
words.example:
As a nation, our consumption of junk food is horrifying.  我们整个国家对垃圾食品的消费量十分惊人。
We need to cut down on our fuel consumption by having fewer cars on the road.  我们需要透过减少路上行驶的车辆以降低燃料消耗。
The meat was clearly unfit for human consumption (= not suitable for people to eat).  这肉显然不适合供人食用。

words.meaning: vt.  主张,声明,断言
words.example:
Throughout the Cold War, the Allies asserted their right to move freely between the two Berlins.  冷战期间，盟国自始至终坚持其在东西柏林之间自由来往的权利。
She very rarely asserts her authority over the children.  她很少摆出大人的权威来管教孩子。

words.meaning: n.  刃，刀片
words.example: a sword with a steel blade  钢剑

words.meaning: a.  暂时的,临时的n.  临时工n.  临时
words.example: The ceasefire will only provide a temporary solution to the crisis.  停火只能暂时解决危机。

words.meaning: n.  小屋
words.example: a log cabin  原木小屋noun countable

words.meaning: n.  高度，音调
words.example:
Supporters invaded (= ran onto) the pitch.  球迷都跑进了球场。noun
The piano and organ were tuned to the same pitch (= note).  钢琴和风琴被调校到同一音调上。
If you teach children and adults in the same class, it's difficult to get the pitch (= level of difficulty or interest) right.  如果你把孩子和成人放在同一个班里教，就很难完全找出适合学生的难度和他们的兴趣。

words.meaning: n.  松树
words.example:
Pine is a softwood.  松木是一种软木。verb intransitive
Carter died in 1904 after an accident and Leno pined away and died in London six months later.  1904年卡特死于非命，莱诺日渐憔悴，六个月后死于伦敦。verb intransitive
He's still pining for his ex-girlfriend.  他还在苦苦思念着他的前女友。

words.meaning: a.  闪耀的; 杰出的
words.example:
She's got a brilliant sense of humour.  他极富幽默感。
Oh, brilliant! My parcel's arrived.  噢，太棒了！我的包裹到了。adjective
Her mother was a brilliant scientist.  她母亲是一位才华横溢的科学家。

words.meaning: a.  绝对的,专制的,完全的,独立的n.  绝对
words.example:
There was no absolute proof of fraud.  没有确凿的证据能证明是诈骗行为。
He's an absolute idiot!  他是个十足的白痴！
That's absolute rubbish!  那完全是一派胡言！adjective

words.meaning: n.  差别,岐视,辨别力
words.example: Until 1986 most companies would not even allow women to take the examinations, but such blatant discrimination is now disappearing.  直至1986年大多数公司甚至还不允许女性参加这种考试，但目前这种明目张胆的歧视做法正在消失。noun uncountable

words.meaning: a.  令人不快的,侮辱的,攻击用的
words.example:
This programme contains language that some viewers might find offensive.  这个节目使用了某些观众可能觉得不快的语言。
He told some really offensive sexist jokes.  他讲了一些极令人不快的性别歧视的笑话。    Opposite inoffensive
Since the other side had taken offensive action (= attacked) , we had no choice but to defend ourselves.  既然对方已经采取了攻势，我们除了自卫别无选择。

words.meaning: n.  繁荣; vi.  迅速增长
words.example:
This year has seen a boom in book sales.  今年图书销售激增。
The insurance business suffered from a vicious cycle of boom and bust.  保险业经历了繁荣和萧条的恶性循环。
The cannons boomed (out) in the night.  大炮在晚上隆隆作响。

words.meaning: n.  寄存器,记录,注册,登记,登记簿vt.  记录,登记,注册,提示,套准,把.
words.example:
Within two weeks of arrival all foreigners had to register with the local police.  所有外国人在到达后两周内必须在当地警察局登记。
Students have to register for the new course by the end of April.  选修这门新课程的学生必须在四月底之前注册。UK verb
The Geiger counter registered a dangerous level of radioactivity.  盖氏计算器显示辐射强度达到了危险级别。

words.meaning: vt.  任命,指定,命令
words.example:
We've appointed three new teachers this year.  我们今年已经任用了三名新教师。
He's just been appointed (as) director of the publishing division.  他刚刚被任命为出版部主任。

words.meaning: n.  遗产,祖先所留之物,继承物
words.example: These monuments are a vital part of the cultural heritage of South America.  这些纪念碑是南美文化遗产的重要部分。

words.meaning: a.  占优势的,支配的
words.example: Unemployment will be a dominant issue at the next election.  失业将成为下届选举中的主要辩论问题。

words.meaning: vt.  使服从,使受到,认为,提出vi.  屈服,服从
words.example:
You must submit your application before January 1st.  申请须于1月1日前提交。
The developers submitted building plans to the council for approval.  开发商向市政会提交待批准的建筑规划。
In conclusion, I submit that the proposal will not work without some major changes.  最后，我认为这项提案必须进行重大修改方能实施。 (-tt-)

words.meaning: n.  经济学
words.example:
Their ideas sound fine in principle but they haven't worked out the economics behind the policies.  他们的计划理论上听起来不错，但是他们没有搞清楚这些政策背后的经济因素。
She's in her third year of economics at York University.  她在约克大学主修经济学，现在上大三。

words.meaning: a.  裸露的，无遮盖的
words.example:
He was naked to the waist (= not wearing clothes above his waist).  他上身赤裸。
The children were half naked (= partly naked).  孩子们半裸着身体。
They stripped naked (= took off their clothes) and ran into the sea.  他们脱光衣服，奔向大海。

words.meaning: vt.  预期,占先,提前使用
words.example:
We don't anticipate any trouble.  我们不希望出现任何问题。
We had one or two difficulties along the way that we didn't anticipate.  在进行的过程中，我们遇到一两个没有预料到的难题。
Are you anticipating a lot of people at the party tonight?  你预计今晚的聚会会有很多人来吗？

words.meaning: n.  祖先传下来之物,遗赠物
words.example:
An elderly cousin had left her a small legacy.  一位堂兄留给她一小笔遗产。
The Greeks have a rich legacy of literature.  希腊人有丰富的文学遗产。
The war has left a legacy of hatred.  那场战争给人们留下了仇恨。

words.meaning: n.  延长,扩充,范围n.  扩展名
words.example:
Martin Luther King, Jr, campaigned for the extension of civil rights to (= for them to include) black people.  小马丁‧路德‧金发起了为黑人争取公民权利的运动。
The extension (= increasing) of police powers in the province has been heavily criticized.  在该省增加警力的做法遭到严厉的抨击。
His report contained serious criticisms of the finance director, and, by extension (= therefore) , of the entire board of management.  他的报告对财务总监进行了严厉批评，进而又扩及到整个管理委员会。

words.meaning: n.  电池
words.example:
This alarm clock takes two medium-sized batteries.  这个闹钟需要装上两枚中号电池。
In the kitchen an impressive battery of stainless steel utensils hangs on the wall.  厨房的墙上挂着一套不锈钢厨具，非常显眼。UK noun
The shore battery opened fire.  岸边的炮阵开火了。UK noun

words.meaning: n.  方向，定位; 介绍性指导
words.example:
We employ people without regard to their political or sexual orientation.  我们聘请员工时并不考虑其政治或性取向。UK noun uncountable
The department has arranged an orientation session.  系里安排了一次迎新活动。UK noun uncountable
The building has an east-west orientation (= It is built on a line between east and west).  这幢大楼是东西向的。

words.meaning: n.  胀大,夸张,通货膨胀
words.example: high/low inflation  高／低通货膨胀

words.meaning: n.  火焰; 光辉; v.  闪耀
words.example:
The flames grew larger as the fire spread.  火势蔓延，火焰越来越高。
The car flipped over and burst into flames (= started burning immediately).  汽车翻了，顿时起火烧了起来。
When the fire engine arrived the house was already in flames (= burning).  消防车赶到时，房屋已是一片火海。noun

words.meaning: n.  串,丛,群vi.  成串,丛生vt.  使聚集n.  簇
words.example:
Have a look at the cluster of galaxies in this photograph.  看看这张照片上的星系群。
There was a cluster of fans around him, asking for autographs.  一大群仰慕者围着他，找他签名。

words.meaning: n.  依赖他人者a.  依赖的,从属的
words.example:
He has three dependent children.  他有三个需要照顾的孩子。
It's very easy to become dependent on sleeping pills.  人很容易对安眠药产生依赖性。adjective
Whether I go to university or not is dependent on what exam grades I get.  我能不能上大学要看我能考多少分。adjective

words.meaning: n.  淋浴(器); 阵雨
words.example:
The shower is broken - you'll have to have a bath.  淋浴器坏了——你得用浴缸洗澡了。
Many British homes have a shower attachment fixed to the bath taps.  英国的许多家庭都在浴缸龙头上安装了淋浴器。
Have I got time to (UK)have/(US)take a shower before we go out?  我们出去之前我还有时间冲个澡吗?

words.meaning: vt.  描述,描写
words.example:
Her paintings depict the lives of ordinary people in the last century.  她的油画反映了上个世纪普通人的生活。
In the book, he depicts his father as a tyrant.  在那本书里，他把自己的父亲描写成了一个暴君。

words.meaning: n.  操作员,行家,经营者,算子n.  运算符
words.example: He has shown himself to be a canny operator in wage negotiations.  他在薪酬谈判过程中表现得精明老练。

words.meaning: n.  崩溃,倒塌,虚脱vi.  倒塌,崩溃,瓦解vt.  使倒塌v.  折叠
words.example:
Thousands of buildings collapsed in the earthquake.  数以千计的建筑物在地震中倒塌了。
The chair collapsed under her weight.  椅子承受不了她的重量散架了。
figurative He thought his whole world had collapsed when his wife died.  妻子去世后他觉得自己的整个世界都坍塌了。

words.meaning: n.  喜剧
words.example:
His latest film is described as a 'romantic comedy'.  他的最新影片被描述为一部“浪漫喜剧”。
The vicar's forgetting his lines in the middle of the speech provided some good comedy.  牧师讲到一半忘了词这件事提供了很不错的笑料。

words.meaning: n.  平民,文官a.  平民的,文官的,民间的
words.example: The bomb killed four soldiers and three civilians.  炸弹炸死四名士兵及三名平民。

words.meaning: n.  (动物或植物的)自然环境; 栖息地
words.example: With so many areas of woodland being cut down, a lot of wildlife is losing its natural habitat.  大片林地被砍伐，很多野生动物在失去它们的天然栖息地。

words.meaning: n.  谷物; 颗粒; 少量
words.example:
Grain (= the crop from food plants like grasses) is one of the main exports of the American Midwest.  谷物是美国中西部地区主要的出口商品。
There wasn't a grain of truth in anything she said.  她无论说甚么都没有半句实话在里面。
Anyone with a grain of common sense would have known what to do.  稍微有一点常识的人都会知道应该做甚么。noun

words.meaning: n.  毛笔; v.  刷，拂
words.example:
You'll need a stiff brush to scrape off the rust.  你需要用硬刷子把锈迹刷掉。
These shoes need a good brush.  这些鞋子需要好好刷一下。
Don't forget to give your hair a brush before you go out.  出门前别忘了梳一下头发。noun

words.meaning: v.  (to)为…付出(时间、精力等); 献身于; 作…之用
words.example:
He left government to devote more time to his family.  为了能有更多时间陪伴家人，他离开了政府部门。
She has devoted all her energies/life to the care of homeless people.  她为照料无家可归者倾注了全部心血／奉献了一生。
Over half his speech was devoted to the issue of unemployment.  他那篇演讲用了一半多的篇幅讨论失业问题。

words.meaning: n.  不费力
words.example:
To ease the problem of overcrowding, new prisons will be built.  为了缓解监狱里人满为患的情况，将修建新的监狱。
These pills should ease the pain.  这些药丸能缓解疼痛。
After the arrival of the United Nations soldiers, tension in the area began to ease.  联合国维和士兵到达后，这个地区的紧张局势开始得到缓解。verb

words.meaning: vt.  抓住,逮捕,俘获,掌握,扣押vi.  突然抓住,利用
words.example:
He seized the chance/opportunity of a free flight with both hands (= with eagerness or enthusiasm).  他急切地紧抓住搭乘免费航班的机会。
The rebels have seized ten soldiers to use as hostages.  叛乱者俘获了十名士兵作为人质。
Political instability helped the army to seize power.  政治动荡使军队攫取了权力。

words.meaning: n.  道德规范
words.example: The course covers research ethics.  这门课涵盖科研道德。

words.meaning: n.  顶点,最高阶层a.  政府首脑的
words.example:
World leaders will meet next week for their annual economic summit.  世界各国领袖将在下周齐聚一堂，参加一年一度的经济高峰会。noun countable
On this day in 1784, Dr Michel Paccard and Jacques Balmat reached the summit of Mont Blanc.  1784年的今天，麦克‧帕卡德医生和雅克‧巴尔马特登上了勃朗峰的顶峰。

words.meaning: n.  酸,酸类物质a.  酸的,酸性的,讽刺的
words.example:
When she spoke her tone was acid.  她说话时，语气尖酸刻薄。noun
Vinegar is an acid.  醋是一种酸。noun

words.meaning: n.  媒体,方法,媒介a.  半生熟的,中的n.  媒体,中
words.example:
Would you like your steak rare, medium, or well-done?  你的牛排要嫩的、半熟的还是熟透的？noun countable
They told the story through the medium of dance.  他们用舞蹈的形式来讲述这个故事。noun countable

words.meaning: v.  区别，辨别; 出名
words.example:
He's colour-blind and can't distinguish (the difference) between red and green easily.  他是色盲，很难分清红色和绿色（的不同）。
It's important to distinguish between business and pleasure.  分清哪是正事、哪是娱乐非常重要。
It's not the beauty so much as the range of his voice that distinguishes him from other tenors.  他与其他男高音大不相同，并非因为他那华美的声音，而是他宽广的音域。

words.meaning: n.  海滨，岸
words.example:
You can walk for miles along the shore.  你可以沿着海岸走上好几哩。
The boat was about a mile from/off (the) shore when the engine suddenly died.  船离岸边还有一哩左右时引擎突然熄火了。
We waited until we were on shore before repairing the sails.  我们等到上了岸才开始修帆。

words.meaning: a.  明显的; 明确的; 不同的
words.example:
There's a distinct smell of cigarettes in here.  这里确实有一股烟味儿。adjective
The two concepts are quite distinct (from each other).  这两个概念（之间）有显著的差别。
There are two distinct factions within the one political party.  在同一政党内有两个不同的派系。

words.meaning: a.  艺术(家)的
words.example:
His friends are all artistic - they're painters, musicians and writers.  他的朋友们都很有艺术造诣——他们尽是些画家、音乐家和作家。
That's a very artistic flower arrangement you have there.  你那篮插花太精美了！

words.meaning: n.  谈话,演讲vi.  谈论,演说
words.example: a discourse on/upon the nature of life after death  关于来世之实质的文章

words.meaning: a.  给人深刻印象的
words.example:
That was an impressive performance from such a young tennis player.  这么年轻的网球选手居然打得那么好。
There are some very impressive buildings in the town.  镇上有一些非常雄伟的建筑物。    Opposite unimpressive
She's a very impressive public speaker.  她是个不同凡响的演说家。

words.meaning: vt.  描绘,描写,描写. . . 的肖像,逼真地描写
words.example:
The painting portrays a beautiful young woman in a blue dress.  这幅画描绘的是一位身穿蓝色连衣裙的美丽少妇。
The writer portrays life in a small village at the turn of the century.  作家描写了世纪之交一个小村庄的生活。
The father in the film is portrayed as a fairly unpleasant character.  影片中的父亲被塑造成一个很不讨人喜欢的角色。

words.meaning: n.  粉末
words.example:
You'll get more flavour from the spices if you grind them into a powder.  你把香料磨成粉的话味道会更香浓。
You can buy milk in powder form.  你可以买奶粉。
Dust the face lightly with powder.  在脸上轻扑些粉。

words.meaning: a.  适度的,稳健的,中等的,节制的vt.  节制,使稳定,使缓和vi.  变缓和,
words.example:
He's a moderate drinker.  他是个饮酒有节制的人。
The cabin is of moderate size - just right for a small family.  这间小屋中等大小——正适合一个小家庭。
Imposing sanctions is a moderate action when you consider that the alternative is military intervention.  如果考虑到另一选择是军事干预的话，你就会发现实施制裁并不是过分的举措。adjective UK SLIGHT  轻微的

words.meaning: a.  后来的,并发的
words.example:
The book discusses his illness and subsequent resignation from the government.  书中讲述了他患病及随后辞去政府职务的事。
Those explosions must have been subsequent to our departure, because we didn't hear anything.  那些爆炸一定是在我们离开后发生的，因为我们甚么也没听到。

words.meaning: n.  禁令vt.  禁止,取缔
words.example:
The film was banned (= the government prevented it from being shown) in several countries.  有几个国家都禁止播放这部电影。
There should be a ban on talking loudly in cinemas.  戏院里应该禁止大声交谈。

words.meaning: a.  不舒服的; 糟糕的; 可怕的
words.example:
He suffered awful injuries in the crash.  他在车祸中受了重伤。
We had awful weather.  我们碰上了糟糕的天气。
She's got an awful boss.  她的老板极难相处。

words.meaning: vt.  赞美,钦佩,喜欢,爱慕
words.example: We stood for a few moments, admiring the view.  我们驻足了一会儿，欣赏美丽的景色。

words.meaning: n.  奇事，奇迹
words.example: You've performed a miracle on this kitchen - I've never seen it so clean!  你真是创造了奇迹——我从没见过这个厨房如此干净过！

words.meaning: v.  超过，超出
words.example:
The final cost should not exceed $5000.  最终的费用不应超出5000美元。
The success of our campaign has exceeded our wildest expectations.  我们发起的运动获得了意想不到的成功。
She was found guilty on three charges of exceeding the speed limit.  她被指控三次超速驾驶，并被判有罪。

words.meaning: n.  节奏，韵律
words.example:
He beat out a jazz rhythm on the drums.  他击出爵士乐节奏的鼓点。
I've got no sense of rhythm, so I'm a terrible dancer.  我根本没有节奏感，所以舞跳得很差劲。
She was lulled to sleep by the gentle rhythm of the boat in the water.  船在水中有节奏地轻轻摇动，使她昏昏入睡。

words.meaning: n.  罪,犯罪,失礼,过失,犯法vt. vi.  犯
words.example:
He thinks a lot about sin.  他对罪孽有很多思考。
humorous For my sins (= As if it were a punishment) , I'm organizing the office party this year.  真是活该，今年将由我来安排办公室派对。noun countable or uncountable

words.meaning: n.  慈悲,博爱,慈善团体,施舍
words.example:
She does a lot of work for charity.  她做了很多慈善工作。
People tend to give to (= give money to) charity at Christmas time.  人们往往在圣诞节向慈善组织捐钱。
Proceeds from the sale of these cards will go to (= be given to) local charities.  卖这些贺卡所得的收益将捐献给地方慈善组织。

words.meaning: n.  脚本; 文字体系
words.example:
Bruce Robinson wrote the script for 'The Killing Fields'.  布鲁斯‧罗宾逊为《战火屠城》写了剧本。
The invitation was written in beautiful italic script.  邀请函是用漂亮的斜体字写成的。noun

words.meaning: n.  手段; [常pl.  ]战术
words.example: These bomb attacks represent a change of tactics by the terrorists.  这些炸弹袭击事件表明恐怖分子改变了策略。

words.meaning: n.  冒险,风险vt. 敢于,冒. . . 的危险vi.  冒险
words.example:
She advised us to look abroad for more lucrative business ventures.  她建议我们去国外寻找更有利可图的商业机会。
There are many joint ventures between American and Japanese companies.  有许多美日合资企业。UK verb intransitive usually + adverb or preposition transitive formal
She rarely ventured outside , except when she went to stock up on groceries at the corner shop.  她极少冒险外出，除非要去街角的商店采购杂货。

words.meaning: a.  适当的,足够的
words.example:
Have we got adequate food for twenty guests?  我们的食物够招待20位客人吗？
It's not by any means a brilliant salary but it's adequate for our needs.  薪资一点也谈不上优厚，但足以满足我们的需要了。
The council's provision for the elderly is barely adequate (= is not enough).  地方议会给长者提供的保障不足。

words.meaning: n.  杂货店
words.example: We run out of grocery quickly.  我们的杂货很快吃完了。

words.meaning: n.  展览品,陈列品,展览vt.  展现,陈列,展览vi.  开展览会
words.example:
He frequently exhibits at the art gallery.  他经常在艺廊展出作品。
In the summer the academy will exhibit several prints which are rarely seen.  该学会将于今年夏天对外展出几幅罕见的版画作品。
He exhibited great self-control considering her rudeness.  她那么无礼，他表现得如此克制已经很好了。noun countable

words.meaning: n.  毛毯; 覆盖物
words.example:
The ground was covered by a thick blanket of snow.  地上覆盖着一层厚厚的雪。adjective [before noun]
'Man', as a blanket term for both men and women, is now considered sexist.  man 用作一个广义词来指代男人和女人，现在被认为有性别歧视色彩。verb transitive often passive literary
Outside the fields were blanketed in fog.  外面，田野被浓雾笼罩着。

words.meaning: n.  页边的空白,边缘,界限,余裕,保证金,差额vt.  加边于,加旁注于v.
words.example:
The Senate approved the use of military force by a margin of 52 votes to 47.  参议院以52票对47票通过了使用武力的提议。
The poll shows that the government is leading by the narrowest of margins.  民意调查显示，政府以极其微弱的优势领先。UK noun countable
If I have any comments to make, I'll write them in the margin.  如果我有评语，就会写在页边的空白处。

words.meaning: n.  水泥,混凝土a.  具体的,实在的,水泥的vt. vi.  (使)凝结,(使)结合
words.example:
Why did you concrete over that nice garden?  你为甚么把那个漂亮的花园铺上混凝土？UK adjective
They think she killed her husband, but they've no concrete evidence.  他们认为她杀死了自己的丈夫，但是他们没有确凿的证据。
We've got a general idea of what we want, but nothing concrete at the moment.  我们对需要甚么有个大致的想法，可是具体的东西目前还没有想好。

words.meaning: n.  处方，药方
words.example:
These drugs are only available on prescription (= with a prescription from a doctor).  这些药只能凭处方购买。
Prescription charges (= the standard amount of money you pay for any medicine prescribed by a doctor) are rising in June.  六月份处方药费在上涨。noun
So what is his prescription for success?  那么他认为成功的诀窍是甚么？

words.meaning: n.  新兵,新分子,新会员,补给品vt.  使恢复,补充,征募vi.  征募新兵,复
words.example:
Charities such as Oxfam are always trying to recruit volunteers to help in their work.  诸如牛津饥荒救济委员会这样的慈善组织总是在尽力吸收志愿者来帮助他们工作。
Even young boys are now being recruited into the army.  就连很小的男孩子都被征召入伍了。
Raw recruits (= completely new soldiers) were trained for six months and then sent to the war front.  刚入伍的新兵接受了六个月的训练后就被送往战争前线。

words.meaning: n.  片，块; 斑纹; v.  弄成碎片
words.example:
Our dog has a black patch on his back.  我们的狗背上有块黑斑。
The hotel walls were covered in damp patches.  饭店的墙壁上满是湿渍。
There were lots of icy patches on the road this morning.  今天早上路上有多处地方结了冰。

words.meaning: n.  一致,交感
words.example:
The general consensus in the office is that he's useless at his job.  办公室成员一致认为他在工作中碌碌无为。
Could we reach a consensus on this matter? Let's take a vote.  我们能在这件事上达成共识吗？我们来表决吧。

words.meaning: n.  惊骇,恐怖,惨事
words.example:
The crowd cried out in horror as the car burst into flames.  当汽车突然起火时，人群发出一阵惊恐的叫声。
The thought of speaking in front of so many people fills me with horror.  一想到要在那么多人面前讲话，我心里就不由得一阵害怕。
What the book does convey very successfully is the horror of war.  那本书的确成功描绘出战争的恐怖。

words.meaning: n.  缘故,理由
words.example:
Please do it, for David's sake.  为了戴维，请做这件事。
Their parents only stayed together for the sake of the children.  他们的父母仅仅是为了孩子才没有分居。
Let's not disagree for the sake of (= because of) a few pounds.  我们不要因为几英镑闹别扭。

words.meaning: n.  注视,凝视vi.  注视,凝视
words.example:
Annette gazed admiringly at Warren as he spoke.  沃伦说话时，安妮特一脸崇拜地注视着他。
He spends hours gazing out of the window when he should be working.  他在本应工作的时候一连几个小时盯着窗外发呆。noun only singular
literary As I looked out, my gaze fell on a small child by the road.  我看看窗外，目光落到了路边一个小孩身上。

words.meaning: v.  诅咒; 郑重地说
words.example:
She had a good seat at the President's swearing-in ceremony.  她在总统宣誓就职仪式上占了个好座位。UK US  (swore, sworn)
After years of addiction, he swore off drugs completely.  上瘾几年后，他发誓彻底戒毒。

words.meaning: n.  线索; 提示
words.example:
Police are still looking for clues in their search for the missing girl.  警方仍在寻找能帮助搜索失踪女孩的线索。
I'm never going to guess the answer if you don't give me a clue.  要是你不给我一点提示，我永远也猜不到答案。noun countable
Don't ask your father which key to press - he hasn't got a clue about computers.  别问你父亲该按哪个键——他对电脑一窍不通。verb (clueing, clued, clued)

words.meaning: vt.  加强,增援,补充vi.  求援,得到增援n.  加固物
words.example:
The pockets on my jeans are reinforced with double stitching.  我牛仔裤的裤兜缝了两道线，很结实。
The final technical report into the accident reinforces the findings of initial investigations.  对事故作出的最终的技术性报告进一步证实了最初的调查结果。
His behaviour merely reinforced my dislike of him.  他的行为只能使我更讨厌他。

words.meaning: vt.  切(片); n.  薄片; 片断
words.example:
Would you like another slice of ham/beef?  要不要再来一片火腿／牛肉?
We agreed before we did the deal that we'd both take an equal slice of the profit.  成交前，我们说定双方各拿利润的一半。
The film presents us with a fascinating slice of history.  这部电影向我们展示了一个非常有趣的历史片段。

words.meaning: a.  神圣的,上帝的,庄严的,祭祀的
words.example:
This area is sacred to the Apaches.  对阿帕契人而言，这一个地区是神圣的。
His daily routine is absolutely sacred to him.  对他而言，每天的日常安排绝对是不容改变的。
humorous The cricketers wore blue, not their usual white - is nothing sacred?  板球队员们身穿蓝色队服，不是他们常穿的白色——难道这也是可以改的吗？

words.meaning: n.  叹息vi.  叹息,渴望vt.  叹息着说
words.example:
She sighed deeply and sat down.  她深叹一口气，坐了下来。
He leaned back in his seat with a sigh.  他向后靠在座位上长出了一口气。
"Ah, you're here, " she said and heaved/let out/gave a sigh of relief.  “啊，你在这里，”她说道，如释重负地松了口气。

words.meaning: n.  属性,定语,标志vt.  归于,属于
words.example:
Organizational ability is an essential attribute for a good manager.  组织能力是一个出色经理必备的素质。verb[əˈtrɪb.jʊt/    /-juːt]
The doctors have attributed the cause of the illness to an unknown virus.  医生们认为这种疾病是由一种未知的病毒引起。
To what do you attribute this delay?  你认为造成这次延误的原因是甚么？

words.meaning: n.  走廊,最高楼座,画廊n.  图库
words.example: the National Portrait Gallery  国家肖像画廊

words.meaning: n.  足球
words.example: Soccer practice starts at four.  足球训练四点开始。

words.meaning: n.  隧道; 风洞; 地道; v.  开(隧道)
words.example:
The train went into the tunnel.  火车驶入隧道。verb intransitive or transitive (-ll- or US USUALLY -l-)
The decision has not yet been made whether to tunnel under the river or build a bridge over it.  还没有决定是在河底挖掘隧道还是在河上建桥。
The alternative is to tunnel a route through the mountain.  另一个办法是挖一条穿山隧道。

words.meaning: n.  健康
words.example:
I'm trying to improve my fitness by cycling to work.  我每天骑脚踏车上班，想以此来改善健康状况。noun uncountable
His fitness for the new position is not in question.  他胜任那个新职位，这毫无疑问。

words.meaning: n.  足趾,趾部,脚趾vt.  以趾踏触,用脚尖走vi.  动脚尖
words.example: Ministers who wouldn't toe the party line were swiftly got rid of.  不愿遵从该政党方针的部长立刻被免职。

words.meaning: n.  容器,集装箱
words.example: an airtight container  密封容器

words.meaning: n.  德行,美德,优点,英勇,效力
words.example:
Patience is a virtue.  耐心是一种美德。    Compare viceUK noun
It always looks odd to see an actress on TV extolling (= praising) the virtues of washing-up liquid.  看见女演员在电视上吹捧洗涤剂的种种优点总是让人感觉怪怪的。
Would there be any virtue in taking an earlier train?  乘坐早一班的火车有甚么好处呢？UK noun

words.meaning: n.  建筑师
words.example: Bevan was the architect of the British National Health Service.  比万是英国国民保健制度的创立者。

words.meaning: n.  质询,调查
words.example:
I've been making inquiries about/into the cost of a round-the-world ticket.  我一直在打听环游世界的票价。
formal Inquiry into the matter is pointless - no one will tell you anything.  打听这件事没有用——没有人会告诉你。(UK also enquiry) UK noun
Citizens have demanded a full inquiry into the government's handling of the epidemic.  公众要求全面调查政府对这场传染病的处理是否得当。

words.meaning: n.  加亮区,精彩场面vt.  加亮,使显著,以强光照射n.  突出
words.example:
The report highlights the need for improved safety.  那份报告强调了加强安全的重要性。
The spelling mistakes in the text had been highlighted in green.  文本中的拼写错误用已经用绿色标出了。noun
Highlights of the match will be shown after the news.  比赛的精彩部分将在新闻之后播出。noun

words.meaning: v.  减少
words.example:
Our share of the market has decreased sharply this year.  今年我们的市场份额急剧下降。
We have decreased our involvement in children's books.  我们减少了在儿童读物方面的投入。    Opposite increasenoun countable or uncountable /ˈdiː.kriːs/
There has been a steady decrease in the number of visitors.  访客数量逐渐减少。

words.meaning: n.  联盟,联合
words.example:
The three smaller parties have forged/formed an alliance against the government.  三个小政党结成反政府联盟。
Some of us feel that the union is in alliance with management against us.  我们中一些人感到工会和资方联合起来对付我们。

words.meaning: n.  假设
words.example: Several hypotheses for global warming have been suggested.  已经提出好几种全球变暖的假设。

words.meaning: vt.  创作; 组成; 使安定
words.example:
Prokofiev started composing at the age of five.  普罗高菲夫五岁就开始作曲了。
The music was specially composed for the film.  这音乐是专门为该电影创作的。
He composed this poem for his wife.  他为妻子写了这首诗。

words.meaning: n.  传奇故事，传说
words.example:
The dance was based on several Hindu legends.  这个舞蹈是根据几个印度传说创作的。
She is writing a thesis on Irish legend and mythology.  她正在写一篇关于爱尔兰民间故事和神话的论文。
Legend has it (= People say) that he always wore his boots in bed.  传说他总是穿着靴子上床。

words.meaning: vt.  管理，控制; 调节
words.example: You can regulate the temperature in the house by adjusting the thermostat.  你可以透过调节恒温器来控制室温。

words.meaning: a.  烦乱的,不高兴vt.  颠覆,推翻,使心烦,使不适,扰乱vi.  翻倒
words.example:
It still upsets him when he thinks about the accident.  一想起那次事故他仍很恼火。
Any mechanical problems would upset our plans of driving across the desert.  哪怕是很小的机械故障都有可能搅乱我们驾车穿越沙漠的计划。verb transitive /ʌpˈset/
Our dog upset the picnic table, spilling food everywhere.  狗撞翻了野餐桌，把我们的食物弄得到处都是。verb transitive /ʌpˈset/

words.meaning: v.  评论; 谈论; n.  评论
words.example:
All his friends remarked on the change in him since his marriage.  他所有的朋友都说起他结婚后的变化。UK noun countable
Her remarks on the employment question led to a heated discussion.  她对就业问题的评论引发了热烈的讨论。
The children made rude remarks about the old man.  孩子们粗言恶语地谈论那个老人。

words.meaning: n.  奖赏，报酬; v.  奖赏
words.example:
There's a reward for whoever finishes first.  无论谁先完成都会得到一份奖赏。
The rewards of motherhood outweigh the anguish.  做母亲得到的回报大于经受的痛苦。
The police offered a reward for any information about the robbery.  警方悬赏征求有关劫案的任何线索。UK verb transitive

words.meaning: a.  温柔的; 温和的
words.example:
He's very gentle with his kids.  他对孩子们很温和。
You can actually accomplish a lot more by gentle persuasion.  和声细语耐心说服实际上会收效更大。
The path has a gentle slope/gradient.  这条小路上有个平缓的斜坡／有点平缓的坡度。

words.meaning: n.  咨询服务
words.example: She offers career counseling.  她提供职业咨询服务。

words.meaning: n.  接收器
words.example:
She picked up the receiver and dialled his number.  她拿起电话拨了他的号码。
The company went bankrupt and was put into the hands of the receivers.  公司破产了，由破产管理人接管。

words.meaning: n.  典礼，(宗教等的)仪式; 固定方式; a.  仪式的
words.example:
Coffee and the newspaper are part of my morning ritual.  喝咖啡和读报纸是我早晨必做的事情之一。
The birds were performing a complex mating ritual.  这些鸟在进行程式复杂的交配。

words.meaning: n.  昆虫，虫
words.example:
Ants, beetles, butterflies and flies are all insects.  蚂蚁、甲虫、蝴蝶和苍蝇都是昆虫。
I've got some sort of insect bite on my leg.  我腿上被小虫咬了一口。

words.meaning: vt.  中断,妨碍,插嘴vi.  打断n.  中断
words.example:
She tried to explain what had happened but he kept interrupting her.  她试图解释所发生的事情，但他不停地打断她。
We had to interrupt our trip when we heard John's mother was ill.  听说约翰的母亲病了，我们不得不中止旅行。

words.meaning: n.  鲑鱼，大马哈鱼
words.example: fresh/smoked/tinned salmon  鲜／熏／罐头鲑鱼

words.meaning: a.  (级别或地位)更高的; (质量或价值)更好的
words.example:
This is clearly the work of a superior artist.  这显然是一位优秀艺术家的作品。
She was chosen for the job because she was the superior candidate.  因为她比其他应征者更出色，所以她被选中做这份工作。
For all babies, breastfeeding is far superior to bottlefeeding.  对所有的婴儿来说，喂母乳都比喂奶瓶好得多。

words.meaning: n. v.  格斗，战斗
words.example:
There was fierce combat between the two sides.  双方展开了激烈的战斗。
No one knew how many troops had died in combat.  没有人知道在战斗中死了多少士兵。
The soldiers were engaged in hand-to-hand combat.  士兵展开了肉搏战。

words.meaning: n.  茎,柄,堵塞物,血统,船首vt.  摘掉茎,装柄于,逆行,堵住,阻止vi.  堵
words.example:
Champagne glasses usually have long stems.  香槟酒杯通常有长长的杯脚。noun countable
From the stem 'sav-' you get 'saves', 'saved', 'saving' and 'saver'.  由词干 sav- 可以衍生出 saves，saved，saving 和 saver。noun countable
We overhauled the car from stem to stern.  我们把车从头到尾彻底检修了一遍。verb transitive (-mm-)

words.meaning: n.  外科医师
words.example: The surgeon scrubbed in.  外科医生刷手准备手术。

words.meaning: n.  商议,忠告,法律顾问vi. vt.  商议,劝告
words.example:
The police have provided experts to counsel local people affected by the tragedy.  警方请来专家对受该惨案影响的当地居民提供咨询服务。
My job involves counselling unemployed people on/about how to find work.  我的工作是向失业者提供就业咨询。noun
The judge addressed counsel.  法官向律师问了话。

words.meaning: n.  牛仔裤
words.example: jeans and a T-shirt  牛仔裤和T恤

words.meaning: n.  记录,圆木,日志,记程仪vt.  伐木,切,航行vi.  伐木n.  日志
words.example:
The forest has been so heavily logged that it is in danger of disappearing.  这片森林被过度砍伐，面临消失的危险。UK verb (-gg-)
The Police Complaints Authority has logged more than 90 complaints.  员警渎职投诉局已经记录下了90多宗投诉。
Log on using your name and password.  用你的名字和密码登录。UK verb (-gg-)

words.meaning: n.  雕刻,雕塑vt.  雕刻,雕塑vi.  当雕刻师
words.example:
Tom teaches sculpture at the local art school.  汤姆在当地艺术学校教雕塑。
The museum has several life-sized sculptures of people and animals.  博物馆里陈列着几个实物大小的人和动物雕塑。

words.meaning: n.  混(化)合物; a.  复合的
words.example:
Salt is a compound of sodium and chlorine.  盐是钠和氯的化合物。
Many fertilizers contain nitrogen compounds.  许多化学肥料都含有含氮化合物。
Then there was his manner, a curious compound of humour and severity.  还有他的态度，那是一种幽默与严厉的奇异混合。

words.meaning: vt.  综合,使结合,使成整体vi.  成一体a.  完整的,完全的
words.example:
He seems to find it difficult to integrate socially.  他似乎觉得很难与别人打成一片。
Children are often very good at integrating into a new culture.  孩子通常很善于融入新的文化。
The aim, said the minister, was to integrate Britain both politically and economically into the European Community.  大臣说，目标是使英国在政治和经济上都与欧共体融为一体。

words.meaning: a.  赤裸的,极少的,无遮蔽的,坦率的vt.  使赤裸,露出
words.example:
Don't walk around outside in your bare feet.  别赤脚在外面到处走。
There's no carpet in the room, just bare floorboards.  房间里地板裸露，没有铺上地毯。
There isn't much time, so I'll just give you the bare facts/details.  时间不多了，我只能给你提供一些最基本的事实／细节。

words.meaning: n.  倾斜,斜坡,斜率,掮枪的姿势vt.  使倾斜,弄斜,掮vi.  倾斜,逃走
words.example:
The roof is at a slope (= at an angle to a horizontal surface) of 30°.  屋顶有30°的坡度。
Snow had settled on some of the higher slopes.  雪堆积在一些较高的山坡上。
There's a very steep slope just before you reach the top of the mountain.  在你到达山顶之前要经过一个陡坡。

words.meaning: n.  职位; 任期
words.example:
He has announced that he is running for the presidency.  他已宣布参加总统竞选。
She won the presidency by a wide margin.  她以高额票数当选总统。

words.meaning: a.  细微的，微妙的
words.example:
The room was painted a subtle shade of pink.  房间被刷成了淡粉色。
The play's message is perhaps too subtle to be understood by young children.  这部戏的内涵过于隐晦，小孩子可能难以理解。
There is a subtle difference between these two plans.  两个计划之间有一点细微的差别。

words.meaning: n.  泵; vt.  (用泵)抽
words.example:
Our latest machine can pump a hundred gallons a minute.  我们最新的机器每分钟能抽100加仑的液体。
The new wine is pumped into storage tanks.  新酿的酒被抽送到储藏罐里。
The heart pumps blood through the arteries/ round the body.  心脏透过动脉输送血液／将血液输送到全身。verb

words.meaning: n.  奖牌，奖章
words.example:
He was awarded a medal for bravery.  他因表现英勇而获授勋章。
She won three Olympic gold medals.  她获得了三块奥运金牌。verb intransitive (-ll- or -l-)
She's medalled in both the heptathlon and the long jump.  她在七项全能和跳远两个项目中都获得了奖牌。

words.meaning: n.  发起者; 赞助人; v.  主办; 赞助
words.example:
The team is sponsored by JVC, so the players wear the letters JVC on their shirts.  该队是由JVC公司赞助的，所以队员们的衬衫上都有JVC几个字母。
Eva said she was doing a ten-mile walk for charity and asked if I'd sponsor her for £1 a mile.  伊娃说她打算步行十哩募集慈善捐款，问我愿不愿意一哩赞助她一英镑。

words.meaning: v.  (使)融化，(使)溶化，(使)消散
words.example:
The snow usually melts by mid March.  通常雪到三月中旬就融化了。
Melt the chocolate slowly so that it doesn't burn.  将巧克力慢慢融化，这样就不会烧焦。
The meat's beautifully cooked - it melts in your mouth (= is so pleasantly soft that you do not need to chew it).  肉煮得极好——柔嫩可口。verb

words.meaning: n.  曲线，弯曲; v.  弄弯
words.example: The road curves round to the left.  道路转向左边。

words.meaning: n.  正直,廉正,完整
words.example:
No one doubted that the president was a man of the highest integrity.  没有人怀疑会长是个光明磊落的人。
Keen to preserve his artistic integrity, he refused several lucrative Hollywood offers.  他十分重视保持自己的艺德，几次拒绝了好莱坞报酬丰厚的演出邀请。UK noun uncountable

words.meaning: vt.  取名为,给予名称,叫做
words.example:
Being unemployed entitles you to free medical treatment.  失业时，你有权享受免费医疗。
Her latest novel, entitled 'The Forgotten Sex', is out this week.  她名为《被遗忘的性别》的最新小说将于本周出版。

words.meaning: a.  显然的,明显的
words.example:
The full extent of the damage only became evident the following morning.  直到第二日早上，人们才全面了解到破坏程度有多严重。
From the smell it was evident that the drains had been blocked for several days.  散发出的气味证明下水道显然已经被堵塞好几天了。
Harry's courage during his illness was evident to everyone.  生病期间哈利表现出的勇气大家有目共睹。

words.meaning: n.  本质，精髓
words.example:
The essence of his argument was that education should continue throughout life.  他的观点的要旨是教育应该持续终生。
Yet change is the very essence of life.  然而变迁正是人生的本质。
In essence, both sides agree on the issue.  从本质上说，双方在这个问题上的意见是一致的。

words.meaning: vt.  把…排除在外
words.example:
Women are still excluded from the club.  这间俱乐部仍然不让女性进入。
Microbes must, as far as possible, be excluded from the room during an operation.  在手术过程中，要尽可能防止细菌进入手术室。
Tom has been excluded from school (= he is not allowed to go to school) for bad behaviour.  汤姆因为行为不正被学校开除了。    Compare include

words.meaning: a.  粗糙的,刺耳的,严厉的
words.example:
The children had had a harsh upbringing.  孩子们的家教很严。
We thought the punishment was rather harsh for such a minor offence.  我们认为对这样的小错，这种惩罚太严酷了。
"There is no alternative, " she said in a harsh voice.  “没有选择的余地。”她用生硬的口气说道。

words.meaning: n.  壁橱; a.  隐蔽的
words.example:
The President is closeted with (= having a private meeting with) his advisers.  总统与他的顾问在密谈。UK adjective [before noun]
Dole portrayed the president in campaign speeches as a 'closet liberal'.  杜尔在竞选演讲中将总统描绘为“藏而不露的自由主义者”。

words.meaning: n.  内部,内政a.  内部的,心灵的
words.example:
The estate agent had pictures of the house from the outside but none of its interior.  房地产经纪人有这栋房子的外观照片，但没有其内部的照片。
The car's interior is very impressive - wonderful leather seats and a wooden dashboard.  这款汽车的内部看上去很气派——优质的皮座椅及木制的仪表板。    Compare exterior
The interior walls have patches of damp on them.  内墙上有片片湿斑。

words.meaning: a.  零售的
words.example:
The job is open to applicants with over two years' experience in retail.  这份工作面向有两年以上零售经验的求职者。
The clothing company has six retail outlets (= shops) in south-eastern Australia.  这间服装公司在澳大利亚东南部地区开设了六家零售店。
The company makes and retails moderately priced sportswear.  这间公司生产和零售价格适中的运动服。

words.meaning: n.  进行曲; v.  前进; 行进
words.example:
My birthday is on the eleventh of March/March the eleventh/ mainly USMarch eleventh.  我的生日是3月11日。
He retired last March/is retiring next March.  他在刚过去的／将在下一个三月退休。
The meeting will be one day in/during March.  会议将在三月份的某一天召开。

words.meaning: vt.  原谅,申辩,做为. . . 的托辞n.  致歉,理由,借口,饶恕,口实
words.example:
Please excuse me for arriving late - the bus was delayed.  我来迟了，请原谅——因为公车延误了。
Nothing can excuse that sort of behaviour.  无论如何那种行为都是不可原谅的。
No amount of financial recompense can excuse the way in which the company carried out its policy.  这间公司竟如此执行制度，这种行为无论赔多少钱都不能宽恕。

words.meaning: n.  褶皱; v.  合拢
words.example:
He had a neatly folded handkerchief in his jacket pocket.  他的上衣口袋里有一方叠得整整齐齐的手帕。
Will you help me to fold (up)the sheets?  你能帮我把床单叠起来吗？
She folded her baby in a blanket.  她把婴儿裹在一块毯子里。

words.meaning: vt.  反转; n.  反面; a.  相反的
words.example:
She reversed the car into the parking space.  她把车倒进停车位。
The new manager hoped to reverse the decline in the company's fortunes.  新经理希望能够扭转公司江河日下的状况。
Now that you have a job and I don't, our situations are reversed.  你找到了工作，我倒没有工作了，我们的情况正好相反。

words.meaning: n.  人类，(总称)人
words.example:
The massacre was a crime against humanity.  这次大屠杀是有违人道的罪行。UK noun
If only he would show/display a little humanity for once.  但愿他这次能表现出一点人性。UK noun
I've always been more interested in the humanities than the sciences.  我一直对人文学科比对自然科学更感兴趣。

words.meaning: a.  可靠的,可信赖的
words.example:
Is your watch reliable?  你的表准吗？
Gideon is very reliable - if he says he'll do something, he'll do it.  吉迪恩为人很可靠——他说到做到。    Opposite unreliable

words.meaning: n.  刺激,兴奋
words.example:
Robin's heart was pounding with excitement.  罗宾的心激动得怦怦跳。
If you want excitement, you should try parachuting.  如果你想寻求刺激，应该去试一下跳伞。

words.meaning: a.  偶然的,临时的,备不时之需的
words.example: He has the occasional cigar after dinner.  他饭后偶尔抽支雪茄。

words.meaning: a.  致命的,致死的ad.  非常地,如死一般地
words.example:
The party was deadly.  那个派对非常乏味。adjective
They have been deadly enemies ever since Mark stole Greg's girlfriend.  自从马克抢走了葛列格的女朋友后，他们两人就成了死对头。adverb

words.meaning: vi.  辩护,恳求vt.  为. . . 辩护,托称
words.example:
He was on his knees, pleading for mercy/forgiveness.  他跪在地上，乞求宽恕／原谅。
She appeared on television to plead with the kidnappers.  她出现在电视上，向绑架者求情。
legal The defendant pleaded not guilty/innocent to robbery with violence.  被告不承认暴力抢劫。

words.meaning: n.  入会,开始a.  新加入的vt.  开始,传授
words.example:
Who initiated the violence?  谁先使用暴力的？verb transitive /ɪˈnɪʃ.i.eɪt/
At the age of eleven, Harry was initiated into the art of golf by his father.  哈里11岁时，他的父亲教他高尔夫球基本技巧。
Each culture had a special ritual to initiate boys into manhood.  每种文化都有特殊的男孩成人礼。noun countable /ɪˈnɪʃ.i.ət/    formal

words.meaning: n.  郊区
words.example:
Box Hill is a suburb of Melbourne.  博克斯希尔属于墨尔本的近郊住宅区。
We drove from middle-class suburbs to a very poor inner-city area.  我们从中产阶级的近郊住宅区驱车前往市中心的贫民区。
The company decided to relocate to the suburbs because the rent was much cheaper.  公司决定搬到城郊去，因为那里的租金便宜得多。

words.meaning: n.  传闻，谣言
words.example: The rumor turned out to be false.  谣言结果是假的。

words.meaning: n.  燕子; v.  吞，咽
words.example:
My throat is so sore that it really hurts when I swallow.  我的喉咙很痛，吞咽起来很难受。
He put a grape into his mouth and swallowed it whole.  他把一颗葡萄放进嘴里，整个吞了下去。
An increasing amount of the countryside is being swallowed (up) by the town.  越来越多的乡村被城镇吞并。

words.meaning: vi.  激励; 激发
words.example:
Like so many people, he's motivated by greed.  像许多人一样，他为贪婪所驱使。
He is genuinely motivated by a desire to help people.  他做事完全是出于助人之心。

words.meaning: vt.  报答,归还,汇报,提出,放弃,反映,表示,表达,表演,实施vi.  给予补
words.example:
New technology has rendered my old computer obsolete.  新技术发展太快，我的旧电脑已经过时了。
She is rendering the book into English from French.  她正在把这本书从法语译成英语。UK verb transitive
The singers rendered the song with enthusiasm.  歌手们热情洋溢地演唱了这首歌。

words.meaning: n.  圈套,陷阱,诡计,存水弯vi.  设圈套,设陷阱vt.  诱捕,诱骗,抓住,使
words.example:
The fox got its foot caught in a trap.  狐狸的一只脚被夹子夹住了。
The undercover agents went to the rendezvous knowing that it might be a trap.  尽管知道这可能是个圈套，这些秘密特工还是去了会面地点。
She's too clever to fall into the trap of doing any unpaid work.  她这人很聪明，决不会上当去做任何没有报酬的工作。noun

words.meaning: vt.  限制,限定,约束
words.example:
The government has restricted freedom of movement into and out of the country.  政府已经限制出入境自由了。
Having small children really restricts your social life.  家里有很小的孩子确实会妨碍你的社交生活。verb transitive
If I'm driving, I restrict myself to one glass of wine.  我要开车的时候，只许自己喝一杯葡萄酒。

words.meaning: adv.  1 表面上,外表上2 [修饰整句]看起来 (显然)
words.example:
He remains confident and seemingly untroubled by his recent problems.  他依然自信如初，似乎没有被最近的问题所困扰。
The factory closure is seemingly inevitable.  看来，工厂关闭势在难免。
Seemingly, she's gone off to live with another man.  看样子，她去和另外一个男人同居了。

words.meaning: v.  实施，执行; 强迫
words.example:
It isn't always easy for the police to enforce speed limits.  对员警来说，严格执行限速规定并不总是件易事。
The new teacher had failed to enforce any sort of discipline.  这位新教师一点都管不住学生，搞得纪律涣散。

words.meaning: n.  透镜; 镜头; 镜片
words.example: a camera with a zoom lens  变焦（镜头）照相机

words.meaning: a.  平的; 简单的; 朴素的; n.  平原，草原
words.example:
She wore a plain black dress.  她穿着一件朴素的黑色连身裙。
We've chosen a plain carpet (= one without a pattern) and patterned curtains.  我们挑了一张没有图案的地毯和带图案的窗帘。
He prefers plain food - nothing too fancy.  他喜欢清淡简单的食物——不喜欢太花巧讲究的。

words.meaning: n.  骗子,欺骗,欺诈,诡计
words.example:
He is fighting extradition to Hong Kong to face trial on fraud charges.  他正在力争免于被引渡到香港就诈骗指控接受审判。UK noun
She was a psychic who was later revealed to be a fraud.  她是一个通灵巫师，后来被发现是个骗子。

words.meaning: n.  同伴，共事者
words.example:
The dog has been her constant companion these past ten years.  在过去的这十年里，这只狗一直与她形影不离。
I've still got one of the candlesticks but I've lost its companion.  我还拥有一个烛台，却把另一个配对的弄丢了。noun countable

words.meaning: vi.  奋斗,斗争,竞争vt.  为. . . 斗争
words.example:
There are three world-class tennis players contending for this title.  有三位世界顶级网球选手争夺这项冠军。
He's contending against someone with twice his experience.  他在和经验比他丰富一倍的人竞争。verb
The lawyer contended (that) her client had never been near the scene of the crime.  该律师声称她的委托人从未走近过犯罪现场。verb

words.meaning: n.  排列,衣服,大批vt.  布署,穿着,排列
words.example:
There was a splendid array of food on the table.  满桌子都是美味佳肴。
They sat before an array of microphones and cameras.  他们坐在那里，面对着无数的麦克风和摄影机镜头。verb transitive usually passive
Arrayed (= Standing in a group) before him were 40 schoolchildren in purple and green.  40名身穿紫绿两色校服的小学生列队站在他面前。

words.meaning: a.  严格的; 精确的
words.example:
My parents were very strict with me when I was young.  小时候父母对我要求非常严格。
Stricter controls on air pollution would help to reduce acid rain.  加强控制空气污染将会有助于减少酸雨。
We follow very strict guidelines on the use and storage of personal details on computers.  对于电脑上个人资料的使用和储存，我们遵循极为严格的规定。

words.meaning: vt.  集合,装配vi.  集合
words.example:
We assembled in the meeting room after lunch.  午饭后我们在会议室集合。
At the staff meeting, the manager told the assembled company (= everyone there) that no one would lose their job.  在全体员工大会上，经理对所有与会者说他们谁也不会失业。verb

words.meaning: a.  不可避免的,必然的
words.example:
The accident was the inevitable consequence/result/outcome of carelessness.  这次意外是粗心导致的必然结果。
Eventually the inevitable happened and he had a heart attack.  最终不可避免的情况还是发生了——他心脏病发作。

words.meaning: n.  怪物,恶人,巨物
words.example:
You'd have to be a monster to hit a child like that.  你一定是丧失人性了，这样打一个孩子。UK noun countable
You should have seen the onions he grew for the competition - they were monsters!  你应该看看他为参加这次比赛所种的洋葱，它们都大得离奇！UK adjective [before noun] informal
Andy Smith has been monstered by the media.  安迪•史密斯受到媒体的猛烈批评。

words.meaning: n.  障碍,妨害物,阻碍
words.example:
The biggest obstacle in our way was a tree trunk in the road.  我们路上最大的障碍是横在路上的一棵树。
This decision has removed the last obstacle to the hostages' release.  这个决定清除了释放人质的最后障碍。

words.meaning: vt.  推动，促进
words.example:
The new ramp will facilitate the entry of wheelchairs.  新的坡道将可方便轮椅进入。
The current structure does not facilitate efficient work flow.  当前的体系不利于实施高效的工作流程。

words.meaning: n.  药草，(调味用的)香草; 草本植物
words.example: Basil, oregano, thyme and rosemary are all herbs.  罗勒、牛至、百里香和迷迭香都是香草。

words.meaning: n.  水晶,水晶装饰品,结晶a.  水晶的,水晶一样的,透明的
words.example:
When sea water is allowed to evaporate, salt crystals are deposited.  海水蒸发后，盐的结晶体就沉淀下来。
Cirrus clouds are composed of ice crystals.  卷云是由冰的结晶体构成的。noun
The evidence is now crystal clear.  现在证据很清楚了。

words.meaning: n.  萧条时期
words.example: The country is sliding into the depths of (a) recession.  这个国家一步步滑入经济衰退的谷底。

words.meaning: n.  动机，目的
words.example:
Why would she have killed him? She has no motive.  为甚么她会杀害他？她没有动机。
Does he have a motive for lying about where he was?  他有必要隐瞒自己去过哪里吗？
What is the motive behind (= the reason for) the bombing?  轰炸的动机是甚么？

words.meaning: vi.  商讨,商量,协商,会诊vt.  向. . . 请教,查阅,考虑
words.example:
If the symptoms get worse, consult your doctor.  如果症状恶化就要去就医。
I'm not quite sure how to get there - I'd better consult a map.  我不是很清楚怎么去那里——我最好查查地图。
Why didn't you consult me about this?  你怎么没跟我商量这件事？

words.meaning: n.  诊断
words.example:
The doctor has made an initial diagnosis.  医生已经作出了初步诊断。
Diagnosis of the disease (= saying what it is) is difficult in the early stages.  这种病的早期诊断很难。

words.meaning: adv.  一贯地
words.example: He performs consistently well.  他一贯表现很好。

words.meaning: n. v.  漂流; 漂泊
words.example:
No one noticed that the boat had begun to drift out to sea.  没有人注意到船已经开始漂向大海了。
After the band stopped playing, people drifted away in twos and threes.  乐队演奏结束后，人们便三三两两地散去了。
figurative The talk drifted aimlessly from one subject to another.  谈话漫无目的地从一个主题转向另一个主题。verb intransitive usually + adverb or preposition

words.meaning: n.  排水; 消耗; v.  (使)流走
words.example:
Drain the pasta thoroughly.  把义大利面中的水完全沥干。
We drained the pond and filled it with fresh water.  我们把池塘中的水放干后重新注入清水。
Drain (off) any liquid that is left in the rice.  把大米彻底沥干。

words.meaning: a.  最(大、高、多)的，最大限度的; n.  最大量
words.example:
The bomb was designed to cause the maximum amount of damage.  设计这种炸弹是为了造成最大程度的破坏。noun countable usually singular (plural maxima or maximums)
The temperature will reach a maximum of 27°C today.  今天最高气温将达摄氏27度。    Compare minimum

words.meaning: n.  问卷，调查表
words.example: Visitors to the country have been asked to fill in a detailed questionnaire.  访问该国的游客被要求填写一份详细的调查表。

words.meaning: n.  基础设施
words.example: The war has badly damaged the country's infrastructure.  战争严重破坏了该国的基础建设。

words.meaning: n.  特权,特别恩典,基本人权,特免vt. 给与. . . 特权,特免
words.example:
Healthcare should be a right, not a privilege.  医疗保健应该是权利，而非特权。
Senior management enjoy certain privileges, such as company cars and private healthcare.  高级管理阶层享受公司配车和私人医疗保健等特权。
It was a real privilege to meet her.  见到她真是莫大的荣幸。

words.meaning: vi.  跳跃; n.  跳跃; 骤变
words.example:
He leapt out of his car and ran towards the house.  他跳下车朝那所房子跑去。
The dog leapt over the gate into the field.  狗越过大门朝田野跑去。verb (leapt or leaped, leapt or leaped)
He leapt to his friend's defence.  他立即为他的朋友进行辩护。

words.meaning: a.  随机的，任意的
words.example:
We asked a random sample/selection of people what they thought.  我们随机挑选一些人，问了他们的想法。
The winning entry will be the first correct answer drawn at random.  从所有给出正确答案的参赛者中，随意抽出的第一个将获得大奖。

words.meaning: n.  领域; 领土
words.example:
She treated the business as her private domain.  她把公司看作是自己的私人势力范围。
These documents are in the public domain (= available to everybody).  这些文件已向公众开放。UK noun countable

words.meaning: a.  最(小、低)的; n.  最小(值、化)
words.example:
Wage increases are being kept to a minimum because of the recession.  由于经济衰退，工资增长的幅度被保持在最低水准。
She hoped that her fiftieth birthday would pass with the minimum of fuss.  她希望她的50岁生日能尽量安安静静地度过。
We need a minimum of ten people to play this game.  玩这个游戏我们至少需要十个人。    Opposite maximum (written abbreviation min.)

words.meaning: v.  倾卸，倾倒
words.example:
He came in with four shopping bags and dumped them on the table.  他进门后将手里提着的四个购物袋往桌上一扔。verb transitive
The tax was so unpopular that the government decided to dump it.  这项税款非常不得人心，于是政府决定将其取消。
Several old cars had been dumped near the beach.  几辆旧汽车被丢弃在海滩附近。

words.meaning: vt.  执行; 处死; 完成
words.example:
He was executed for murder.  他因犯谋杀罪被处死。verb transitive
The whole play was executed with great precision.  这出戏由头到尾都表演得丝丝入扣，有板有眼。

words.meaning: n.  肢
words.example:
The accident victims mostly had injuries to their lower limbs (= legs).  事故受害者大多腿上都有伤。
She's going out on a limb in criticizing her own party leadership.  她对自己所在党的领导提出的批评并没有得到大多数人的赞同。

words.meaning: n.  观念学,空论,意识形态,思想
words.example: The people are caught between two opposing ideologies.  民众被夹在两种对立的意识形态之间。

words.meaning: vt.   (耐心地) 忍受,容忍a.  忍耐b.  对<做…事>忍耐,忍受<做…事> vi.
words.example:
We had to endure a nine-hour delay at the airport.  航班延误，我们不得不在机场苦等了九个小时。
She's already had to endure three painful operations on her leg.  她已经承受了三次腿部手术的巨大痛苦。UK verb
The political system established in 1400 endured until about 1650.  建立于1400年的政治体系一直沿用到1650年前后。

words.meaning: n.  (牛、羊、鹿等的)角; 号角，喇叭
words.example:
The driver blew/sounded / informalhonked her horn.  那位司机按了喇叭。
He'll have to draw in his horns now he's lost his job.  由于失业，他将不得不减少开支。UK verb
She's always horning in on our conversations.  她总是在我们说话的时候插嘴。

words.meaning: a.  慢性的,习惯性的n.  慢性瞉颊?
words.example:
There is a chronic shortage of teachers.  教师长期短缺。UK adjective
The acting was chronic.  表演很糟糕。

words.meaning: n.  改革,创新
words.example: the latest innovations in computer technology  电脑科技最新的发展

words.meaning: n.  紧张,拉紧,张力,过劳,扭伤,血统,血缘,种,族,气质,口吻,旋律,曲调vt
words.example:
The hurricane put such a strain on the bridge that it collapsed.  在飓风强大的威力之下，桥塌了。
As you get older, excess weight puts a lot of strain on the heart.  随着年龄的增长，体重过重会给心脏造成很大负担。
Their constant arguments were putting a strain on their marriage.  他们持续不断的争吵使他们的婚姻关系非常紧张。

words.meaning: vi.  举止,行为,表现vt.  使表现好
words.example:
She always behaves well/badly when her aunts come to visit.  每当她姨妈来作客时，她总是表现很好／很差。
Whenever there was a full moon he would start behaving strangely.  每当月圆之时他就怪怪的。

words.meaning: vt.  管理,治理,执行vi.  管理,有助于
words.example:
The country was administered by the British until very recently.  直到不久前，这个国家还由英国人来管辖。
The economy has been badly administered by the present government.  现任政府一直不善处理经济工作。UK verb
Tests will be administered to schoolchildren at seven, twelve and sixteen years.  7岁、12岁和16岁的学生将接受测试。

words.meaning: adv.  1 同时地2 同时地[with]
words.example: The two events happened simultaneously.  两件事同时发生。

words.meaning: vt.  引发，导致
words.example:
It's not clear who actually pulled the trigger.  不清楚究竟是谁扣动的扳机。UK noun
There are fears that the incident may be a trigger for further violence in the capital.  有人担心，这次事件可能在首都引发进一步的暴力活动。UK verb transitive
Some people find that certain foods trigger their headaches.  有些人发现某些食物导致他们头痛。

words.meaning: vi.  溢出，溅出; n.  溅; 溢出的东西
words.example:
You've spilt something down your tie.  你把甚么东西洒在领带上了。
Let's see if I can pour the juice into the glass without spilling it.  来试试看我能不能一滴不漏地把果汁倒进玻璃杯里。
He dropped a bag of sugar and it spilt all over the floor.  他把一袋糖掉在地上，撒得地板上到处都是。

words.meaning: a.  感谢的,感激的,受欢迎的
words.example:
I'm so grateful (to you) for all that you've done.  你为我做了这一切，我（对你）真是感激不尽。
If you could get that report finished by Thursday I'd be very grateful.  如果你能在星期四之前完成那份报告，我将感激不尽。
After the earthquake we felt grateful to be alive.  地震后，我们大难不死，真是应该感谢上苍。

words.meaning: n.  优美，优雅
words.example:
Joanna has natural grace and elegance.  祖安娜举止自然优雅。noun
They accepted their defeat with good grace.  他们很有风度地认输了。
Ken is sadly lacking in social graces.  糟糕的是，肯在社交场合很没有风度。noun

words.meaning: n.  殖民地; (生物)群体
words.example: Australia and New Zealand are former British colonies.  澳大利亚和纽西兰从前是英国的殖民地。

words.meaning: a.  本土的,土著的,国产的
words.example:
Are there any species of frog indigenous to the area?  这个地区是否有本地品种的青蛙？
So who are the indigenous people of this land?  那么谁是这块土地的原住民？

words.meaning: n.  囚犯,罪犯vt.  宣告有罪,使知罪
words.example: He has twice been convicted of robbery/arson.  他两次被判犯有抢劫罪／纵火罪。    Compare acquitnoun countable UK US [ˈkɑːn-/

words.meaning: vt.  修正,变更,减轻,缓和,修饰v.  修改
words.example:
Instead of simply punishing them, the system encourages offenders to modify their behaviour.  这个制度并不是单单惩罚犯罪者，而是鼓励他们改正自己的行为。
The proposals were unpopular and were only accepted in a modified form.  这些建议不受欢迎，修改之后才得以接受。UK verb transitive
In the sentence 'She ran quickly', the adverb 'quickly' modifies the verb 'ran'.  在句子 She ran quickly 中，副词 quickly 修饰动词ran。

words.meaning: n.  粒子,点,极小量
words.example:
In the sentence 'I tidied up the room', the adverb 'up' is a particle.  在句子 I tidied up the room 中，副词 up 是个小品词。UK noun
Dust particles must have got into the motor.  马达一定是进尘了。
Electrons are atomic particles.  电子是原子粒子。

words.meaning: v.  珍视; 估价; n.  奖品; 奖金
words.example:
The critics' prize for best film was won by Marc Abbott for 'Belly Laugh'.  马克•阿博特的《捧腹大笑》被评论家们评为最佳影片。
The first (= main) prize is a weekend for two in Bruges.  头奖是布鲁日双人周末游。
The prize money for literary competitions can be as high as £40 000.  文学创作竞赛的奖金可能高达四万英镑。

words.meaning: n.  登陆; 着陆，降落
words.example: One person has died after the pilot of a light aircraft was forced to make a crash/emergency landing in a field.  飞行员驾驶轻型飞机在田地里迫降／紧急着陆后有一人死亡。noun countable

words.meaning: vt.  提高，推进
words.example:
The theatre managed to boost its audiences by cutting ticket prices.  剧院设法透过降低票价来增加观众数量。
Share prices were boosted by reports of the President's recovery.  总统康复的报导导致股票价格上扬。
The lowering of interest rates will give a much-needed boost to the economy.  利率的下调将会给经济注入急需的推动力。

words.meaning: n.  闹钟; 警报; v.  使惊恐
words.example:
If there's any trouble, raise/sound the alarm by pulling the emergency cord.  如果出现任何问题，拉紧急警报索报警。
The first two bomb alerts were false alarms, but the third was for real.  前两次炸弹警报是一场虚惊，但是第三次是真的。
Villagers have reacted with alarm to news of a proposed new road.  听说有修新路的计划，村民都十分恐慌。UK noun

words.meaning: n.  紧握,柄,手提包,控制,支配,掌握vt.  抓紧,抱住,吸住,控制,支配,掌
words.example:
The baby gripped my finger with her tiny hand.  婴儿的小手紧紧握住我的手指。
Old tyres won't grip (= stay on the surface of the road) in the rain very well.  在雨天，旧轮胎在路面上防滑性能不是太好。verb (-pp-)
This trial has gripped the whole nation.  这场审判引起了全国的关注。

words.meaning: a.  怪异的,超自然的,不可思议的,超乎事理之外的n.  命运,预言,符咒
words.example:
He was sitting alone by a window with a weird contraption on the bench in front of him.  他独自坐在窗边，面前的长椅上摆着个奇怪的装置。
Her boyfriend's a bit weird but she's all right.  她的男朋友有点怪，不过她倒很正常。
That's weird - I thought I'd left my keys on the table but they're not there.  真奇怪——我记得把锁匙放在桌子上，但现在却不见了。

words.meaning: n.  汗(水)
words.example:
It was so hot when we arrived in Tripoli that we started to sweat as soon as we got off the plane.  我们到达的黎波里时天气太热，我们一下飞机就开始出汗。
The prisoners were sweating with fear.  囚犯们吓得直冒汗。
informal I was so afraid, I was sweating like a pig (= sweating a lot).  我害怕极了，浑身冒汗。

words.meaning: vt. vi.  统治,支配,管理
words.example:
The country is now being governed by the Labour Party.  这个国家现在由工党执政。
They accused the government of being unfit to govern.  他们指责这届政府施政无能。UK verb
Prices of goods are governed by the cost of the raw materials, as well as by the cost of production and distribution.  商品的价格不但取决于生产和行销成本，而且取决于原材料的价格。

words.meaning: a.  聪明的,伶俐的,有才智的
words.example: Helen had a few intelligent things to say on the subject.  对于这个主题，海伦有一些颇有见地的想法要说。

words.meaning: n.  投票,投票用纸,抽签vi.  不记名投票,抽签vt.  投票选出,拉选票
words.example:
Representatives were elected by ballot.  代表们是透过不记名投票选举出来的。
They decided to hold a ballot.  他们决定组织一次不记名投票。
The union decided to ballot its members on the issue.  工会决定让会员就这件事进行不记名投票。

words.meaning: n.  狂热,热心
words.example:
One of the good things about teaching young children is their enthusiasm.  教小孩子的好处之一就是他们对甚么都充满了兴趣。
After the accident he lost his enthusiasm for the sport.  经历这场事故后，他对这项体育运动失去了热情。
One of his greatest enthusiasms was yoga.  他最热衷的活动之一就是瑜伽。

words.meaning: vt.  使适应,调节,和解,容纳vi.  适应
words.example:
New students may be accommodated in halls of residence.  新生可以住在学校宿舍里。
formal There wasn't enough space to accommodate the files.  没有足够的空间存放这些档案。UK verb transitive
The new policies fail to accommodate the disabled.  新政策没有照顾到残疾人士的利益。

words.meaning: vt.  伤害,损害,使受冤屈
words.example:
She fell and injured her shoulder.  她摔伤了肩膀。
He was badly injured in the crash.  他在车祸中受重伤。
He claimed that working too hard was injuring his health.  他声称工作过度损害了他的健康。

words.meaning: a.  不停的,无穷尽的,无尽的
words.example:
We used to have endless arguments about politics.  我们过去老是对政治问题争论不休。
He seems to think that I have an endless supply of money.  他好像觉得我的钱永远花不完似的。
The possibilities are endless.  有无数种可能。

words.meaning: n.  命令,指令,要求vt.  委任统治
words.example:
At the forthcoming elections, the government will be seeking a fresh mandate from the people.  在即将举行的选举中，政府将向人民寻求新的支持。
The UN rush to mandate war totally ruled out any alternatives.  联合国匆匆授权开战，完全排除了其他选择。verb transitive

words.meaning: n.  大混乱,混沌
words.example:
Snow and ice have caused chaos on the roads.  冰雪造成道路交通秩序混乱。
Ever since our secretary walked out, the office has been in a state of total/utter chaos.  自从我们的秘书离开后，办公室就陷入了极度混乱中。
We muddled up the name labels and chaos ensued (= resulted).  我们弄乱了姓名标签，结果一片混乱。

words.meaning: a.  机械的,机械性的,力学的
words.example:
The company produces mechanical parts for airplane engines.  这家公司生产飞机引擎的机械零件。
The plane appeared to have crashed because of a mechanical problem.  这架飞机看来是因机械故障而坠毁的。adjective

words.meaning: n.  帆布,画布,油画
words.example: These two canvases by Hockney would sell for £500 000.  这两幅霍克尼的油画能卖到50万英镑。

words.meaning: n.  休息室，大厅
words.example: Small businesses have lobbied hard for/against changes in the tax laws.  小公司极力游说支援／反对修改税法。

words.meaning: a.  深远的; 知识渊博的; 深奥的
words.example:
His mother's death when he was aged six had a very profound effect on him.  他六岁时母亲的过世对他的影响很大。
The invention of the contraceptive pill brought about profound changes in the lives of women.  避孕药的发明为女性的生活带来了重大变化。
Those two lines of poetry express perfectly the profound sadness of loss.  那两行诗贴切表达了失去亲人的深切悲痛。

words.meaning: n.  特色,品质,少许,一笔,特性
words.example:
His sense of humour is one of his better traits.  具有幽默感是他更讨人喜欢的特点之一。
Arrogance is a very unattractive personality/character trait.  傲慢是一种非常令人讨厌的性格特点。

words.meaning: n.  通货,流通,通用n.  货币,货币型
words.example:
His ideas enjoyed wide currency during the last century.  他的思想在上个世纪广为流传。
Many informal expressions are gaining currency in serious newspapers.  许多非正式表达方法正在为严肃报刊所接受。

words.meaning: n.  火鸡(肉)
words.example:
His last film was a complete turkey.  他上一部电影完全是一部失败之作。
What did you do that for, you turkey?  为甚么要那样做，你这个傻瓜？

words.meaning: n.  储备(物); 自然保护区; v.  保留; 预订
words.example:
These seats are reserved for the elderly and women with babies.  这些座位是专留给老人和抱小孩的妇女的。
She keeps a little money in reserve (= for use if and when needed).  她留下了一些钱以备不时之需。
The librarian has put the book on reserve for me (= will keep it for me when it becomes available).  图书管理员已经替我预约了这本书。

words.meaning: n.  束; 横梁
words.example:
We could just pick out the path in the weak beam of the UK usuallytorch/ USflashlight.  我们借着手电筒微弱的光线，仅能勉强认清路。
The rabbit stopped, mesmerized by the beam of the car's headlights.  兔子被汽车车前大灯射出的光束迷住了眼，停了下来。
The sitting room had exposed wooden beams.  客厅顶上的木梁露出来了。

words.meaning: vi.  道歉,辩白
words.example:
Trains may be subject to delay on the northern line - we apologize for any inconvenience caused.  北线列车可能会延误，如果给您造成任何不便，我们在此谨致歉意。
She apologized profusely for having to leave at 3.30 p.m.  她必须在下午三点半离开，对此她再三表示歉意。

words.meaning: n.  教条,学说
words.example: The president said he would not go against sound military doctrine.  总统说他不会反对行之有效的军事学说。

words.meaning: a.  真正的,真实的,诚恳的
words.example:
If it is a genuine Michelangelo drawing, it will sell for millions.  如果这幅画是米高安哲罗（米开朗基罗）的真迹，它的售价将会达数百万。
He's a very genuine person.  他为人很真诚。
Machiko looked at me in genuine surprise - "Are you really going?" she said.  町子真的很惊讶，她看着我问道：“你果真要走吗？”adjective

words.meaning: n.  统一，联合
words.example: European political and economic unity  欧洲政治和经济的统一

words.meaning: n.  妥协，折衷
words.example:
It is hoped that a compromise will be reached in today's talks.  希望今天的会谈能达成妥协。
In a compromise between management and unions, a 4% pay rise was agreed in return for an increase in productivity.  资方与工会达成和解，同意以加薪4%来作为提高生产力的回报。
The government has said that there will be no compromise with terrorists.  政府声称不会对恐怖分子让步。UK verb

words.meaning: a.  独占的,唯一的,排外的a.  独占的
words.example:
This room is for the exclusive use of guests.  这间房是专供客人使用的。
Is the total exclusive of service charges?  总金额是不是不包括服务费？
Some people think that uncontrolled economic growth and environmental stability are mutually exclusive.  有些人认为，无节制的经济发展和生态环境的平衡稳定是互不相容的。noun countable

words.meaning: n.  消散,分散,散播,酒馆,散布,散射vi.  散布,散播,消散vt.  使消散,使
words.example:
The protesters scattered at the sound of gunshots.  听到枪声后抗议者就鸟兽散了。
The soldiers came in and scattered the crowd.  士兵进来把人群驱散了。UK verb
Scatter the powder around the plants.  把这种药粉撒在植物周围。

words.meaning: vt.  传达,运输,转移
words.example:
His poetry conveys a great sense of religious devotion.  他的诗歌表达了献身宗教的强烈感情。
If you see James, do convey my apologies (to him).  要是你见到詹姆斯，一定要转达我（对他）的歉意。
You don't want to convey the impression that we're not interested.  你不想给人留下我们不感兴趣的印象吧。verb transitive

words.meaning: v. n.  缠绕，扭曲
words.example:
The path twists and turns for over a mile.  这条小路弯弯曲曲，长达一英里多。
She sat there nervously twisting the ring around on her finger.  她紧张地坐在那里，不停转着手指上的戒指。
She twisted her head (round) so she could see what was happening.  她扭过头来，想看看发生了甚么事。

words.meaning: vi.  缓解，减轻
words.example:
She was given a shot of morphine to relieve the pain.  医生给她注射了一针吗啡来止痛。
She relieved her boredom at home by learning how to type.  她在家学打字来打发无聊的时光。
The council is considering banning vehicles from the town centre to relieve congestion.  市政会正在考虑禁止车辆驶入市中心，以缓解交通拥堵的问题。verb

words.meaning: a.  技术的，工艺的
words.example: Technological advances in computing and telecommunications will reduce the need for many people to travel to work.  随着电脑及通讯技术的进步，许多人将不必再出门上班了。

words.meaning: vt.  吊，挂; 暂缓
words.example:
The ferry service has been suspended for the day because of bad weather.  因为天气恶劣，渡船已经停开。
The President has suspended the constitution and assumed total power.  总统废除宪法，独揽大权。
When you go to the theatre, you have to be willing to suspend disbelief (= to act as if you believe that what you are seeing is real or true, although you know that it is not).  去戏院看戏时，你得对剧情深信不疑。

words.meaning: n.  叛徒,反叛者vi.  造反,反抗,反感,抵抗,谋反a.  造反的,反抗的
words.example:
The rebels took over the capital and set up a new government.  叛乱分子占领了首都并成立了新政府。
He was a bit of a rebel when he was a teenager and dyed his hair pink.  他十几岁的时候有些叛逆，把头发染成了粉红色。verb intransitive /rɪˈbel/
The people rebelled against the harsh new government.  人民起来反抗这个残暴的新政府。

words.meaning: n.  配偶,夫妻
words.example: In 60% of the households surveyed both spouses went out to work.  在60%的受调查的家庭中，夫妻双方都外出工作。

words.meaning: vt.  重新开始,萞?恢复vi.  再开始n.  摘要,个人简历v.  继续执行
words.example:
Normal services will be resumed in the spring.  春天将恢复正常服务。
The talks are due to resume today.  会谈预定今天继续进行。
Please resume your seats, as the performance will continue in two minutes.  请大家回到自己的座位上去，两分钟后演出继续。

words.meaning: adj.  1 a.  理论 (上) 的,学理的,纯理论性的b.  理论上的,只有理论的,
words.example: theoretical physics  理论物理

words.meaning: n.  钠
words.example: Too much sodium raises blood pressure.  钠太多会升高血压。

words.meaning: a.  细致优雅的,微妙的,美味的
words.example:
Peaches have delicate skins which are easily bruised.  桃子的表皮很娇嫩，容易碰伤。
Delicate plants need to be kept in a greenhouse during the winter.  娇贵的植物需要在温室里过冬。
Molly's health has always been delicate (= She becomes ill easily).  莫莉的身体一直都很娇弱。

words.meaning: v. n.  (使)弹，(使)反弹
words.example:
The ball bounced off the post and into the net.  球击中门柱弹进了球网。
She bounced the ball quickly.  她快速地拍球。
Her bag bounced (= moved up and down) against her side as she walked.  她走起路来身旁的袋子一颠一颠的。

words.meaning: n.  钩，吊钩; v.  连接无线电设备以传送
words.example:
She told him she needed the money for her baby and he fell for it hook, line and sinker.  她告诉他，她需要这笔钱给她的孩子用，他便完全相信了。noun countable
This product has really got its hooks into the American market.  这种产品已经主导了美国市场。noun countable
John's agreed to go to the meeting in my place so that gets/lets me off the hook.  约翰答应帮我去开会，这样我就能脱身了。verb

words.meaning: n.  侦探; a.  侦探的
words.example: a private detective  私家侦探

words.meaning: n.  补偿,赔偿金,薪资
words.example:
She received £40 000 in compensation for a lost eye.  她得到四万英镑，作为对失去一只眼睛的赔偿。
You should claim/seek compensation.  你应该要求赔偿。
Free food was no compensation for a very boring evening.  免费食物并不能弥补晚会的乏味无聊。

words.meaning: n.  出口,退场,离去,去世vi.  退出,脱离,去世v.  退出
words.example:
He saw Emma arrive and made a quick exit.  他见到艾玛匆匆而来又匆匆离去。
She made her exit from the stage to rapturous applause.  在观众热烈的掌声中，她退场走下舞台。    Compare entrancenoun countable
Come off the motorway at the Duxford exit.  从达克斯福德出口驶出高速公路。verb intransitive or transitive

words.meaning: vt.  献出,贡献
words.example:
He has dedicated his life to scientific research.  他把自己的一生都奉献给科学研究工作。
The book is dedicated to the author's husband.  该书为作者的丈夫而作。verb transitive
The church was dedicated on 1st March 1805 to the local Saint Jude.  教堂于1805年3月1日落成以纪念当地的圣裘德。

words.meaning: vt.  切; 雕刻
words.example:
This totem pole is carved from/out of a single tree trunk.  这根图腾柱是由一整根树干雕刻而成的。
He carved her name on a tree.  他将她的名字刻在树上。
Some of the tunnels in the cliff are natural, some were carved out (= cut into the rock) by soldiers for defensive purposes.  峭壁中的一些隧道是天然形成的，一些是士兵在石头上开凿出来用于防御的。

words.meaning: n.  惊吓,恐慌vt.  惊吓,使恐慌vi.  受惊
words.example:
Sudden noises scare her.  突然的响声把她吓了一跳。
She's very brave - she doesn't scare easily.  她很勇敢——她不会那么容易害怕的。
He scared me out of my wits (= made me extremely frightened) when he was driving so fast.  他开得那么快，把我吓得半死。

words.meaning: n.  航天飞机
words.example:
To get across town, you can take the shuttle from Times Square to Grand Central.  要穿越市区，你可以乘坐从时代广场穿梭到中央车站的公车。
The American (space) shuttle can be used many times to put payloads in space.  美国的太空梭可以多次使用，向太空运送物品。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.  交易,办理,执行,和解,学报,报告书
words.example:
Each transaction at the foreign exchange counter seems to take forever.  外币兑换柜枱的每笔交易似乎都要花很长时间。
We need to monitor the transaction of smaller deals.  我们需要监控规模较小的交易。

words.meaning: n.  援救,解救,营救vt.  援救,救出,营救
words.example:
The lifeboat rescued the sailors from the sinking boat.  救生艇将水手们从正在下沉的船上救起。
The government has refused to rescue the company from bankruptcy.  政府已经拒绝援助这间濒于破产的公司。noun countable or uncountable
Lifeboats carry out many rescues every month.  救生艇每月都会执行很多救援任务。

words.meaning: n.  副本,复本,配对物,相应物
words.example: The Prime Minister is to meet his European counterparts to discuss the war against drugs.  首相将会见欧洲各国首脑就打击毒品犯罪进行商讨。

words.meaning: a.  低碳的; 轻微的; 温和的
words.example:
She can't accept even mild criticism of her work.  即使别人对她的作品略有微词，她也不能接受。
He has suffered a mild heart attack - nothing too serious.  他只是轻微的心脏病发作，并不太严重。adjective
We've had a mild winter this year.  我们今年过了个暖冬。adjective

words.meaning: prep.  在…中
words.example:
On the floor, amid mounds of books, were two small envelopes.  地板上的书堆里有两个小信封。
The new perfume was launched amidst a fanfare of publicity.  这种新香水在一阵大张旗鼓的广告宣传下推出市场。

words.meaning: a.  同一的,恒等的,完全相同的
words.example:
I've got three identical blue suits.  我有三套完全相同的蓝色西装。
The two rooms were virtually identical.  这两个房间几乎一模一样。
The interests of both parties may not be identical, but they do overlap considerably.  双方的利益可能并不完全相同，但的确也有很多重合之处。

words.meaning: a.  精确的,严谨的,明白的
words.example:
The bunker's precise location is a closely guarded secret.  掩体的确切位置严格保密。
He caught me at the precise moment that I fainted.  他正好在我晕倒的那一刻抓住了我。
There was a good turnout for the meeting - twelve of us to be precise.  出席会议的人不少——确切地说有我们12个人。UK adjective

words.meaning: a.  忧虑的,热心的,渴望的
words.example:
My mother always gets a bit anxious if we don't arrive when we say we will.  如果我们说好回家却没有回去，我母亲总会有些担心。
The drought has made farmers anxious about the harvest.  这场旱灾使农民因担心收成而焦虑不安。adjective
Developing countries which are anxious for hard currency can rarely afford to protect the environment.  急于获得强势货币的发展中国家很难顾及环保问题。

words.meaning: vt. vi.  诊断
words.example:
The specialist diagnosed cancer.  那位专家作出的诊断是癌症。
His condition was diagnosed as some sort of blood disorder.  他的病被诊断为某种血液病。
She was diagnosed with/as having diabetes.  她被查出患有糖尿病。

words.meaning: n.  自主，自由
words.example:
For most citizens, liberty means the freedom to practise their religious or political beliefs.  对大多数公民而言，自由意味着可以不受限制地信奉自己的宗教或政治信仰。
Hundreds of political prisoners are to be given their liberty (= released from prison).  数百名政治犯将获得自由。
Of the ten men who escaped this morning from Dartmoor Prison, only two are still at liberty (= free or not yet caught).  今晨从达特摩尔监狱逃跑的十人当中，目前只有两人依然在逃。

words.meaning: n.  招贴，海报
words.example:
The children put up posters on the classroom walls.  孩子们在教室的墙上张贴了海报。
We noticed a poster advertising a circus.  我们看到一张马戏演出的海报。

words.meaning: v. n.  缓慢(或费力)地行进，爬行
words.example:
The child crawled across the floor.  那个孩子爬过了地板。
The injured soldier crawled to safety.  受伤的士兵慢慢爬向安全的地方。
The lorry crawled noisily up the hill.  货车轰轰隆隆吃力地爬上山坡。

words.meaning: n.  氧
words.example: Oxygen levels drop at high altitude.  高海拔氧气含量下降。

words.meaning: n.  总数,和,金额,顶点,概略vt.  总计,概括vi.  合计
words.example:
Huge sums of money are spent on national defence.  巨额的钱财都投入到国防上。
He'll get £50 000 from the company when he retires, which is a tidy (= large) sum.  他退休的时候会从公司拿到五万英镑，这可不是一个小数目。
humorous I worked for three whole weeks for which I received the princely (= very low) sum of $100.  我整整工作了三周，却只得到可怜兮兮的100美元。noun

words.meaning: a.  有希望的,前途有望的
words.example:
They won the award for the most promising new band of the year.  他们赢得了该年度最有前途新进乐团奖。
It's a great restaurant but it doesn't look at all promising from the outside.  这间餐厅棒极了，不过从外面看可一点都看不出来。    Opposite unpromising

words.meaning: a.  有意识的,知觉的,觉察的
words.example:
