The tooth doesn't exactly hurt, but I'm conscious of it (= I can feel it) all the time.  牙齿并不痛 ，可是我总觉得不舒服。
He's still conscious but he's fairly badly injured.  他神志还清醒，但伤得很重。
They've brought her out of the operating theatre, but she's not fully conscious yet.  他们把她推出了手术室，可是她还没有完全清醒。

words.meaning: n.  决心,果断
words.example: The determination of policy is not your business - your job is to implement it.  政策的决定与你无关——你的工作就是执行。UK noun

words.meaning: n.  捐赠人
words.example: Thanks to a large gift from an anonymous donor, the charity was able to continue its work.  多亏得到了一位匿名人士的大笔捐助，该慈善机构才得以继续运转。

words.meaning: n.  歌剧
words.example:
'Carmen' is my favourite opera.  《卡门》是我最喜爱的歌剧。
I've never been a huge fan of opera.  我对歌剧一向不是很着迷。
He goes to the opera (= to see an opera) whenever he can.  他一有机会就去看歌剧。

words.meaning: n.  深坑,果核,陷阱,深渊,地窖vt.  窖藏,使凹下,使竞争,使留疤痕,去. .
words.example:
They'd dug a shallow pit and left the bodies in it.  他们挖了一个浅坑把尸体扔在里面。
These pits in my skin are from when I had chickenpox.  我皮肤上的麻子是我出水痘时留下的。
The coal-mining industry wants new pits to be opened.  煤矿业需要开凿新的矿井。

words.meaning: vt.  以雕像装饰n.  雕像
words.example: They planned to put up/erect a statue to the President.  他们计划为总统设一尊雕像。

words.meaning: n.  追求，[常pl.  ]花时间和精力等做的事、职业
words.example:
Three people have been killed in high-speed pursuits by the police recently.  有三人在最近员警的高速追捕中毙命。
The robbers fled the scene of the crime, with the police in pursuit.  抢劫者逃离了犯罪现场，员警紧追不舍。UK noun
The company is ruthless in its pursuit of profit.  公司为追求利润毫不放松。

words.meaning: a.  有分寸的,得体的,大方的
words.example:
Everyone should be entitled to a decent wage/standard of living.  人人都应该有权获得像样的工资／过着体面的生活。
It was very decent (= kind) of you to help.  你能帮忙，真是个大好人啊。
It made quite a decent-sized (= large) hole.  它弄出了一个很大的洞。

words.meaning: a.  口头的，口述的
words.example: When do you have your Spanish oral (= exam in spoken Spanish) ?  你们甚么时候进行西班牙语口试？

words.meaning: n.  目的地n.  目的文件,目的单元
words.example:
We arrived at our destination tired and hungry.  我们到达目的地时又累又饿。
His letter never reached its destination.  他的信没有被送到收信人处。
The Caribbean is a popular tourist / UK holiday / US vacation destination.  加勒比海是人们喜爱的旅游／渡假胜地。

words.meaning: vt.  支持,赞同,背书于,签
words.example:
The National Executive is expected to endorse these recommendations.  预计全国执委会将赞同这些提议。
formal I fully endorse (= agree with) everything the Chairperson has said.  我完全赞同主席所说的一切。
They paid $2 million to the world champion to endorse their new aftershave.  他们付给这位世界冠军200万美元，请他为他们新生产的须后水做广告。UK verb transitive

words.meaning: a.  有雅量的,量大的,慷慨的,丰富的,大量的
words.example:
She's been very generous with her time.  她不吝投入大量时间。
There's a generous (= kinder than deserved) review of the book in today's newspaper.  今天的报纸刊登了一篇书评，对该书赞赏有加。UK adjective

words.meaning: n.  谱，光谱; 范围
words.example:
The colours of the spectrum - red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo and violet - can be seen in a rainbow.  光谱中的红、橙、黄、绿、蓝、靛、紫诸色可以在彩虹中见到。 (plural spectra or spectrums)
He has support from across the whole political spectrum.  他得到了所有政治派别的支援。
The group includes students from both ends of the social spectrum (= range of social classes).  这个团体包括了来自社会上、下两个阶层的学生。

words.meaning: n. a.  紫色(的)
words.example:
Despite occasional patches of purple prose , the book is mostly clear and incisive.  这本书尽管偶尔有几段词藻华丽的文句，但总体来讲文风简洁明了。UK noun countable or uncountable
Purple is my favourite colour.  我喜欢的颜色是紫色。
The evening sky was full of purples and reds.  傍晚的天空布满紫色和红色的云彩。

words.meaning: n.  激光; 激光器
words.example: laser beam  雷射光束

words.meaning: a.  大胆的n.  粗体
words.example:
She was a bold and fearless climber.  她是一位勇敢无畏的登山者。
The newspaper made the bold move /took the bold step of publishing the names of the men involved.  该报采取大胆行动，将有关人员的名字都公布了出来。UK adjective
They painted the kitchen in bold colours - crimson, purple and blue.  他们用于粉刷厨房的油漆色彩鲜艳——有绯红色、紫红色和蓝色。

words.meaning: a.  不情愿的,勉强的,厌恶的
words.example:
Many parents feel reluctant to talk openly with their children.  很多父母都不愿意和儿女们敞开心扉交谈。
She persuaded her reluctant husband to take a trip to Florida with her.  她说服了丈夫跟她一起去佛罗里达旅游，尽管他不太情愿。

words.meaning: n.  专家的意见,专门技术
words.example:
We admired the expertise with which he prepared the meal.  我们很羡慕他那一手烹调绝技。
She has considerable expertise in French history.  她研究法国历史有很深的造诣。

words.meaning: adv.  几乎; 实际上
words.example:
She blamed me for practically every mistake in the report.  她几乎把报告里所有的错误都怪在我头上。
These changes would cost us practically nothing.  这些变化对我们几乎不会有任何损失。
It's practically impossible for me to get home in less than an hour.  要我在一小时内到家几乎是不可能的。

words.meaning: n.  提示; [常pl.  ]忠告
words.example:
Did she give you any hints about where she was going?  她有没有向你暗示过她要去哪里呢？
You can't take (= understand) a hint, can you? Just go away and leave me alone!  你就是听不懂暗示，对不对？滚开，不要管我！noun
Could you give us a hint about how to do this exercise, please?  你能不能给我们一些关于如何做这个练习的建议？

words.meaning: ad.  急剧地
words.example:
Inflation has risen/fallen sharply.  通货膨胀急遽上升／下降。
His health improved/deteriorated sharply this week.  本周他的健康情况迅速好转／恶化。
The road bends sharply to the left.  公路突然左转弯。UK adverb

words.meaning: n.  游行,炫耀,阅兵vt. vi.  游行,炫耀,(使)列队行进
words.example:
For three hours a committee of state senators listened to a parade of local residents giving their opinions.  整整三个小时，州参议员组成的委员会听取了一批又一批当地居民发表自己的看法。
The entire regiment was on parade.  整个军团在接受校阅。noun countable
The Saint Patrick's Day marchers paraded up Fifth Avenue, past the cathedral.  在圣派屈克节那天，游行者一路经过第五大道，途经大教堂。

words.meaning: n.  王国,领土,领域
words.example:
Her interests are in the realm of practical politics.  她的兴趣在于那些需要采取具体行动去做的事情。noun countable
The matter was hotly debated in all the towns of the realm.  此事在该王国内的各个城镇都进行了激烈的讨论。noun countable

words.meaning: n.  取消,撤消,盖销(邮票)vt.  取消,删去,抵销,盖销vi.  相互抵销
words.example:
They've had to cancel tomorrow's football match because of the bad weather.  因为天气太糟，他们不得不取消了明天的足球比赛。
The 7.10 train to London has been cancelled.  7点10分开往伦敦的火车被取消了。
This month's pay cheque will cancel out his debt, but it won't give him any extra money.  这个月的工资支票将抵消他的债务，可那样他就一点钱都不剩了。

words.meaning: vt.  混合n.  混合
words.example:
Their music is a blend of jazz and African rhythms.  他们的音乐融合了爵士乐和非洲音乐。verb intransitive or transitive
Blend the ingredients into a smooth paste.  将这些原料混和成均匀的糊糊。
The cushions blend well with the colour of the carpet.  靠垫与地毯的颜色配搭得十分和谐。verb intransitive or transitive

words.meaning: a.  领受的,容易接受的,感受性强的n.  领受者,容纳者,容器
words.example:
This latest cut in government spending will affect income support recipients and their families.  最近这次政府削减开支会影响到拿政府补助金的人及其家庭。
He was a recipient of the Civilian Service Award.  他被授予平民服务奖章。

words.meaning: vi.  犹豫,迟疑,踌躇,支吾
words.example:
She hesitated slightly before answering the inspector's question.  在回答调查员的问题之前，她稍稍犹豫了一下。
"Do you love me?" she asked. He hesitated and then said, "I'm not sure".  ｢你爱我吗？｣她问道。他犹豫了一下，然后说：｢我不确定。｣

words.meaning: vt.  掷,弹,轻击,空翻vi.  用指轻弹,抽打,蹦跳n.  抛,弹,筋斗
words.example:
When one side is done, flip the pancake (over) to cook the other side.  一面烤熟后，把烤饼迅速翻过来烤另一面。
You turn the television on by flipping (= operating) the switch at the side.  把边上的开关按一下，电视就打开了。
The captains flipped a coin into the air (= made it turn over in the air to see which side it landed on) to decide which side would bat first.  两队队长向空中抛出一枚硬币，决定哪一方先击球。verb intransitive or transitive [usually + adv/prep] (-pp-)

words.meaning: n.  偏见,斜线a. ad.  斜(的)vt.  使有偏见
words.example:
The government has accused the media of bias.  政府指责新闻媒体有偏见。
Reporters must be impartial and not show political bias.  新闻记者必须公正，不应有政治偏见。
There was clear evidence of a strong bias against her.  有明显证据显示，她受到了严重不公平的对待。

words.meaning: n.  实体,实存物,存在
words.example:
The museums work closely together, but are separate legal entities.  这些博物馆密切合作，但它们都是独立的法人实体。
He regarded the north of the country as a separate cultural entity.  他把这个国家的北部地区视为一个独立的文化实体。

words.meaning: n.  垃圾; 废物
words.example:
He talks a lot of garbage about education.  他废话连篇地大谈自己对教育的看法。UK noun uncountable
The meals are pretty poor but then they never use fresh ingredients - garbage in, garbage out.  这饭真难吃，因为他们从来不用新鲜材料——也难怪，垃圾进，垃圾出。

words.meaning: a.  外交的,老练的
words.example: Ask him nicely - be diplomatic.  好好向他提出请求——要委婉一些。

words.meaning: a.  优雅的,端庄的,高雅的
words.example: an elegant woman  举止优雅的女性

words.meaning: n.  接待,欢迎,接收力,招待会,接受
words.example:
The President gave a reception for the visiting heads of state.  总统举行招待会款待来访的外国元首。
Her first book got a wonderful/warm/frosty reception from the critics.  评论家对她的第一本书反应很好／热烈／冷淡。
The new hospital was ready for the reception of its first patients.  新医院已经可以用了，准备收治第一批病人。

words.meaning: vi. 消失,不见,成为零
words.example:
The child vanished while on her way home from school.  那个小女孩在放学回家的路上不见了。
We rushed out of the shop in hot pursuit, but the thief had vanished into thin air (= had completely disappeared).  我们冲出商店，拼命追赶，但小偷已经消失得无影无踪。
Cheap rural housing is vanishing in the south of the country.  廉价的乡间住房在该国南部行将绝迹。

words.meaning: vt. vi.  承认,坦白,忏悔,供认
words.example:
He confessed to sleeping /having slept through most of the film.  他承认看这出电影时，大部分时间都在睡觉。
He has confessed to the murder.  他供认了谋杀罪行。

words.meaning: a.  偶然的,不经意的,便装的n.  临时工,待命士兵
words.example:
The psychologist's attitude seemed far too casual, even brutal.  那个心理学家的态度似乎太过冷淡了，甚至有些冷酷。
Security around the conference hotel seemed almost casual.  举行会议的饭店周围的安全措施似乎不太严格。
Although close to tears, she tried to make her voice sound casual.  尽管都快掉眼泪了，可她还是尽力使自己的声音听起来满不在乎。adjective

words.meaning: n.  地心引力,重力
words.example: the laws of gravity  万有引力定律UK noun uncountable

words.meaning: v.  (in)登记; 注册
words.example: Enroll before the deadline.  在截止前报名。

words.meaning: vt. vi.  (使)减少,(使)变小
words.example:
These memories will not be diminished by time.  这些记忆不会随着时间的流逝而淡漠。
What he did has seriously diminished him in many people's eyes.  他的所作所为严重损害了他在许多人眼里的形象。
We've seen our house diminish greatly/sharply/substantially in value over the last six months.  在最近六个月里，我们这座房屋的价格暴跌。

words.meaning: v.  将…减到最少; 最小化
words.example:
We must minimize the risk of infection.  我们必须将感染的风险降到最低。
Environmentalists are doing everything within their power to minimize the impact of the oil spill.  环保人士正竭尽全力把石油外溢造成的影响减到最少。    Opposite maximize
She accused the government of minimizing the suffering of thousands of people.  她指责政府对成千上万的人所受的疾苦轻描淡写。

words.meaning: n.  厚肉片,排骨,砍,商标,戳记,交换vt.  剁碎,砍,切,割断vi.  砍,突然
words.example:
He was chopping wood in the yard.  他在院子里劈木头。
Add some fresh parsley, finely chopped.  加一些剁碎的新鲜香芹。
Chop (up) the onions and carrots roughly.  把洋葱和胡萝卜切成大块。

words.meaning: n.  意图，目的
words.example:
She had an intent look on her face.  她的面部表情非常专注。adjective

The toll of bankruptcies was rising daily.  倒闭的公司与日俱增。

words.meaning: n.  疫苗
words.example: This vaccine protects against some kinds of the bacteria.  这种疫苗能抵抗这些细菌中的某几种。

words.meaning: n.  奖金,红利
words.example: The company used to give discretionary bonus payments.  公司过去常常会酌情发放一些奖金。

words.meaning: a.  反对的,敌对的,对抗的
words.example:
Two opposed interpretations of the facts have been presented.  人们对事实作出了两种全然不同的解释。
His view of the situation is diametrically (= very strongly) opposed to mine.  他对局势的看法和我的截然不同。
I'd prefer to go on holiday in May, as opposed to September.  我更愿意五月份去渡假，而不是九月份。UK adjective

words.meaning: n.  轨道,常轨,眼眶vt.  绕. . . 轨道而行vi.  进入轨道,盘旋
words.example:
The satellite is now in a stable orbit.  卫星目前在稳定的轨道上运行。
Once in space, the spacecraft will go into orbit around the Earth.  一旦进入太空，太空船将进入环绕地球的轨道。UK noun countable or uncountable
Prices have gone into orbit this year.  今年物价大幅攀升。UK verb intransitive or transitive

words.meaning: n.  把握,抓紧,抓,理解,控制,柄vt.  抓住,紧握,领会vi.  抓
words.example:
Rosie suddenly grasped my hand.  罗茜突然抓住了我的手。
We must grasp every opportunity to strengthen economic ties with other countries.  我们必须把握住一切机会加强与其他国家的经济联系。UK verb transitive
The Government has acknowledged that homelessness is a problem but it has failed to grasp the scale of the problem.  政府已经承认很多人无家可归是个问题，但还没有意识到问题的严重性。UK verb transitive

words.meaning: n.  揭露,泄露,启示,展示
words.example:
Shocking revelations about their private life appeared in the papers.  有关他们私生活的惊人内幕见诸报端。
This book came as a complete revelation to me.  这本书使我茅塞顿开。

words.meaning: n. [总称]首饰; 珠宝
words.example: The jewelry sparkled under the lights.  珠宝在灯光下闪闪发亮。

words.meaning: n.  用力拖拉,拖,拖运距离,捕获物,拉vi.  拖,拉,改变方向,改变主意vt.
words.example:
They hauled the boat out of the water.  他们把船拉上了岸。
She hauled herself up into the tree.  她费劲地爬上了树。UK verb transitive
When the shooting started we hauled ass out of there.  枪击开始后，我们就赶快离开了那里。UK verb transitive

words.meaning: vt.  承认,退让vi.  让步
words.example:
The president is not expected to concede these reforms.  估计总统不会同意这些改革。
He is not willing to concede any of his power/authority.  他不愿交出自己的任何权力。
Britain conceded (= allowed) independence to India in 1947.  英国在1947年承认印度独立。

words.meaning: n.  四轮马车; 货车
words.example:
The first white settlers journeyed across America in covered wagons.  最早的白人定居者是驾着大篷车穿越美洲大陆的。
When her husband died, she fell off the wagon.  她丈夫死后，她又重新喝起酒来。(UK also waggon) ['wæg.ən]
He was on the wagon for ten years, when he was living in Connecticut.  住在康乃狄克期间，他戒了十年的酒。

words.meaning: a.  公开展示的,惊人的n.  展览物
words.example:
He scored a spectacular goal in the second half.  他在下半场攻进了漂亮的一球。
There was a spectacular sunset last night.  昨天的日落非常壮观。
We've had spectacular success with the product.  我们的产品取得了惊人的成功。UK noun countable

words.meaning: v.  破坏，毁灭; n. [常pl.  ]废墟，遗迹
words.example:
Huge modern hotels have ruined this once unspoilt coastline.  庞然大物般的现代旅馆已经完全毁掉了这片曾经如世外桃源般的海岸。
Her injury ruined her chances of winning the race.  她受了伤，毁掉了赢得比赛的机会。
Cheap imported goods are ruining many businesses.  廉价的进口商品使众多公司正走向破产。

words.meaning: a.  绝对的,全然的,彻底的,峻峭的,透明的,纯粹的vi.  躲开,躲避,偏航,v
words.example:
The suggestion is sheer nonsense.  这个建议纯粹是胡言乱语。
His success was due to sheer willpower/determination.  他的成功全靠自己的意志力／决心。
It was sheer coincidence that we met.  我们的相遇纯属巧合。UK adjective

words.meaning: a.  免疫的,免除的,不受影响的n.  免疫者
words.example:
Most people who've had chicken pox once are immune to it for the rest of their lives.  大多数出过水痘的人终生都对此病具有免疫力。
He seems to be immune to colds - he just never gets them.  他好像对感冒具有免疫力——他从不感冒。
The press had criticised her so often that in the end she had become immune (to it).  新闻界如此频繁地批评她，以至于到最后她都（对此）变得无动于衷了。

words.meaning: a.  异国的,外来的n.  外来物,舶来品
words.example: exotic flowers/food/designs  奇花异草／外国风味的食物／奇异的设计

words.meaning: n.  修剪,夹,回形针,剪下来的东西vt.  修剪,痛打,夹牢,剪辑vi.  剪报,
words.example:
The wires were fastened together with a plastic clip.  这些电线用一个塑胶夹子扣在一起。noun
I've seen a clip from the film.  我看过这部电影的一个片段。noun
We set off at a good clip, but we gradually slowed down.  我们出发时速度很快，可是后来渐渐慢了下来。noun

words.meaning: a.  亲密的,私人的,秘密的vt.  暗示,通知,告诉n.  熟友
words.example:
The restaurant has a very intimate atmosphere.  这家餐厅的气氛很幽静。
He's become very intimate with an actress.  他和一名女演员的关系变得非常亲密。adjective UK EXPERT  精通的
She has an intimate knowledge of Tuscany, where she has lived for twenty years.  她在托斯卡纳住了20年，对那里非常熟悉。noun countable UK US     formal

words.meaning: a.  文献的; 记实的; n.  纪录片
words.example:
The documentary took a fresh look at the life of Darwin.  这部纪录片从一个崭新的角度介绍了达尔文的一生。
They showed a documentary on animal communication.  他们放映了一部关于动物之间交流沟通的纪录片。UK adjective [before noun]
Human rights campaigners have discovered documentary evidence of torture.  人权活动家们已经发现了刑讯逼供的书面证据。UK adjective [before noun]

words.meaning: n.  中立者,中立国,非彩色,齿轮的空档a.  中立的,中性的,无色的
words.example:
If there's an argument between my daughter and her mother, it's important that I remain neutral.  如果我女儿和她母亲发生争吵，我保持中立是很重要的。
The peace conference would have to be held in a neutral country.  和平会议必须在一个中立国举行。
I'd rather meet on neutral ground/territory (= somewhere not controlled by or connected to either of us) rather than in his apartment.  我宁愿在一个与双方都无关的地方和他见面，而不是在他的公寓里。UK adjective

words.meaning: a.  易曲的,灵活的,可通融的,能变形的,柔软的
words.example:
My schedule is quite flexible - I could arrange to meet with you any day next week.  我的时间安排很灵活——下周任何一天我都可以安排与你见面。adjective
Rubber is a flexible substance.  橡胶是一种有弹性的物质。
Dancers and gymnasts need to be very flexible (= able to bend their bodies easily).  舞蹈演员和体操运动员的身体必须非常柔韧。

words.meaning: a.  进步的; 渐进的
words.example:
There's been a progressive decline in the standard of living over the past few years.  最近几年的生活水准每况愈下。
The left of the party is pressing for a more progressive social policy.  该政党的左派人士敦促实行更加进步的社会政策。
'He's working hard at the moment' is an example of the present progressive form of the verb 'work'.  He's working hard at the moment 是动词 work 的现在进行式的一个例子。

words.meaning: n.  同谋,阴谋,反叛
words.example: The three men are accused of conspiracy.  这三人被指控图谋不轨。

words.meaning: n.  严重事故,伤亡,受害者
words.example:
The train was derailed but there were no casualties, police said.  警方称，火车出轨了，但没有人员伤亡。
The rebels suffered heavy casualties.  叛乱分子伤亡惨重。noun
She lost her job in 1989, a casualty of the recession.  1989年她失业了，成了经济衰退的受害者。

words.meaning: n.  共和国，共和政体
words.example: the People's Republic of China  中华人民共和国

words.meaning: a.  功能的
words.example: Is the central heating functional yet?  中央暖气系统工作正常吗？

words.meaning: n.  本能，天性
words.example:
All his instincts told him to stay near the car and wait for help.  他的直觉告诉他要留在车旁、等待救援。
It is instinct that tells the birds when to begin their migration.  是本能让鸟类知道何时开始迁徙。
figurative Bob seems to have an instinct for (= is naturally good at) knowing which products will sell.  鲍勃好像能凭直觉知道哪些产品有销路。

words.meaning: n.  铝
words.example: Aluminum is light and strong.  铝既轻又坚固。

words.meaning: n.  裁决,判决,结论,定论,判断
words.example:
The jury reached/returned a unanimous verdict of (not) guilty.  陪审团一致判定有罪／无罪。
Voters gave their verdict on the government's economic record last night by voting overwhelmingly for the opposition.  昨晚选民们以压倒性的多数票支援反对党，由此可以看出他们对本届政府在经济上的作为的评判。

words.meaning: vt.  教,教育,命令,指导
words.example:
The police have been instructed to patrol the building and surrounding area.  员警奉命在这幢大楼里及周围地区巡逻。
He works in a sports centre instructing people in the use of the gym equipment.  他在体育中心工作，教人们如何使用健身器材。

words.meaning: n.  颅骨，头脑
words.example:
The soldiers discovered a pile of human skulls and bones.  士兵们发现了一堆人的头盖骨和白骨。noun countable
Has he got the truth into his thick skull yet?  他还没有弄清楚实情？

words.meaning: a.  合作的，协力的
words.example:
I've asked them not to play their music so loudly, but they're not being very cooperative.  我叫他们不要把音乐声放得这么大，可是他们不肯合作。    Opposite uncooperativeUK noun countable (ALSO UK also co-operative) (also abbreviation co-op)
The magazine is run by a cooperative.  这份杂志由一家合作企业出版。

words.meaning: vt.  操纵,利用,假造,应付
words.example:
Throughout her career she has very successfully manipulated the media.  她在整个职业生涯中非常成功地控制了媒体。
The opposition leader accused government ministers of manipulating the statistics to suit themselves.  反对派领导人指责政府部长篡改统计数据以满足自身利益。verb transitive
The wheelchair is designed so that it is easy to manipulate.  轮椅设计得很容易操纵。

words.meaning: n.  环,圈,弯曲部分vt.  使成环,以圈结,以环连结vi.  打环,翻筋斗n.
words.example:
The tape ran in a continuous loop, repeating the same songs over and over.  这盒磁带处于回圈播放状态，反反复复地播放那几首歌曲。
You can tell she's in the loop. She always knows about policy decisions before the rest of us.  她很明显是圈内人。她总是比我们所有人都更早知道政策决定。
I've been out of the loop since I changed jobs. I didn't realize Wendy and Bob had got engaged.  我换工作之后一直消息闭塞。我还不知道温蒂和巴布已经订婚了呢。noun countable

words.meaning: n.  蘑菇
words.example:
For this recipe choose mushrooms with large caps (= top parts).  做这道菜要选菌盖大的蘑菇。
Unfortunately some poisonous mushrooms look like edible mushrooms.  遗憾的是，某些有毒蘑菇外表与可食用蘑菇相似。    Compare toadstoolverb intransitive
The number of computers in schools has mushroomed in recent years.  近年来，学校里电脑的数量迅速增长。

words.meaning: n.  补助金，津贴
words.example:
The company received a substantial government subsidy.  公司得到大笔政府津贴。
The government is planning to abolish subsidies to farmers.  政府正计划取消对农场主人的补贴。

words.meaning: a.  悲惨的; 悲剧的
words.example:
His friends were deeply shocked and saddened by the tragic news of his death.  朋友得知他不幸去世的消息都深感震惊和哀痛。
The bomb explosion resulted in a tragic loss of life.  炸弹爆炸造成人员丧生的惨剧。
Hospital authorities admitted that a tragic mistake/error had taken place.  医院管理方承认出现了造成悲惨后果的错误／失误。

words.meaning: n.  数学
words.example: Mathematics is the language of science.  数学是科学的语言。

words.meaning: n.  机修工; [pl.  ]力学，机械学
words.example: He knows a lot about the mechanics of running a school.  对于如何管理一所学校，他所知甚多。

words.meaning: n.  广口瓶,震动,刺耳声vi.  震惊,冲突,发刺耳声,不一致vt.  震动,刺激
words.example:
We often have a jar or two at the pub after work.  我们经常在下班后到酒吧喝一两杯啤酒。UK noun countable
With every jar of the carriage, the children shrieked with excitement.  车厢每剧烈震动一下，孩子就兴奋地尖叫。UK verb (-rr-)
The sudden movement jarred his injured ribs.  突然的一个动作震痛了他受伤的肋骨。UK verb (-rr-)

words.meaning: n.  创造(力)
words.example: The job demands creativity.  这份工作需要创造力。

words.meaning: a.  潜在的; 基础的
words.example: And what might be the underlying significance of these supposedly random acts?  这些看似偶然的行为，其暗含的意义可能是甚么呢？

words.meaning: n.  餐后甜点
words.example:
For dessert there's apple pie, cheesecake or fruit.  甜品有苹果派、起司蛋糕和水果可供选择。
If you make the main course, I'll make a dessert.  如果你做主菜，那我就来做甜品。

words.meaning: n.  同情，同情心
words.example:
The president has sent a message of sympathy to the relatives of the dead soldiers.  总统已经向阵亡士兵的家属发出吊唁电报。
Of those people questioned, 93% said their sympathies were with the teachers.  接受调查的人当中有93%表示支持教师。
He is known to have right-wing sympathies.  大家都知道他支持右派。

words.meaning: n.  企业家,主办人
words.example: He was one of the entrepreneurs of the eighties who made their money in property.  他是80年代靠房地产生意赚钱起家的企业家之一。

words.meaning: n.  局，署
words.example: The bureau issued new guidelines.  该局发布了新指南。

words.meaning: vt.  利用
words.example: The vitamins come in a form that is easily utilized by the body.  把维生素制成易被人体吸收的产品。

words.meaning: n.  微风,煤屑,轻而易举的事vi.  吹微风,逃走
words.example:
She let the gentle breeze cool her face.  她任由清凉的微风吹拂着自己的脸颊。noun
You won't have any problems with the entrance test - it's an absolute breeze.  入学考试你决不会有问题——那实在是轻而易举的事。verb intransitive usually + adverb or preposition
She just breezed in as if she'd only been away a day instead of a year.  她如风似地走进来，好像她只离开了一天而不是一年。verb intransitive usually + adverb or preposition

words.meaning: a.  有野心的,抱负不凡的,雄心勃勃的
words.example:
He's very ambitious for his children (= He wants them to be successful).  他望子成龙。
She has some ambitious expansion plans for her business.  她雄心勃勃，打算扩大经营规模。
The government has announced an ambitious programme to modernize the railway network.  政府已经宣布了实现铁路网现代化的宏伟规划。

words.meaning: a.  有影响的,有势力的
words.example:
She wanted to work for a bigger and more influential (= powerful) newspaper.  她希望为一家规模和影响力更大的报纸工作。
Johnson was influential (= important) in persuading the producers to put money into the film.  詹森在说服制作人投资拍摄此片方面起了重要作用。

words.meaning: v.  (使)溶解; 清除
words.example:
Dissolve two spoons of powder in warm water.  将两勺粉末溶解在温水中。
Nitric acid will dissolve most animal tissue.  硝酸能溶解大部分动物组织。UK verb
Parliament has been dissolved.  议会已被解散。

words.meaning: a.  统计(学)的
words.example: statistical errors/evidence  统计错误／证据

words.meaning: a.  美学的,审美的,有美感
words.example: The new building has little aesthetic value/appeal.  新楼几乎没有甚么美学价值。

words.meaning: n.  插入物vt.  插入,镶补vi.  附着n.  插入
words.example: These magazines have too many annoying inserts (= extra loose pages) advertising various products.  这些杂志里令人讨厌的各类产品广告插页太多。

words.meaning: n.  恐慌,惊惶a.  惊慌的,没有理由的,恐慌的vt.  使惊慌,使狂热vi.  惊
words.example:
Panic spread through the crowd as the bullets started to fly.  子弹开始满天飞，人群惊慌起来。
Carmel was in a panic about her exam.  卡梅尔很害怕考试。
He got in(to)a panic that he would forget his lines on stage.  他慌张起来，怕自己在台上会忘记台词。verb intransitive or transitive (panicking, panicked, panicked)

words.meaning: n.  压碎,粉碎,群众,迷恋vt.  压破,征服,挤入,弄皱,冲入vi.  被压碎,起
words.example:
The package had been badly crushed in the post.  包裹在邮寄过程中被压而严重受损。
Add three cloves of crushed garlic.  加入三瓣捣碎的大蒜。
His arm was badly crushed in the car accident.  他的手臂在车祸中被压成重伤。

words.meaning: n.  悬崖，绝壁
words.example: Keep away from the edge of the cliff - you might fall.  离悬崖边远一点——小心不要掉下去。

words.meaning: a.  最小的; 最低限度的
words.example: There were no injuries and damage to the building was minimal.  没有人受伤，建筑物的损坏也极小。

words.meaning: n.  幻影,错觉,幻想
words.example:
He had no illusions about his talents as a singer.  他对自己作为歌手的才华不抱幻想。
I'm under no illusions (= I understand the truth) about the man I married.  我对我所嫁的男人不抱幻想。
My boss is labouring under the illusion that (= wrongly believes that) the project will be completed on time.  我的老板还存有工程能按时完成的幻想。

words.meaning: a.  作者不详的,佚名的,无名的n.  无记录
words.example:
The money was donated by an anonymous benefactor.  这笔钱来自一位不愿透露姓名的捐赠者。
Police said an anonymous caller warned that a bomb was about to go off.  警方说有人打来匿名电话，警告一枚炸弹即将爆炸。
An attempt to implant an embryo using an egg from an anonymous woman donor was unsuccessful.  用一位匿名女性捐赠的卵子来植入胚胎的尝试未获成功。

words.meaning: vt.  宽容,默认,有耐力
words.example: It seems these ants can tolerate temperatures which would kill other species.  看来这些蚂蚁能够忍受可以导致其他物种死亡的高温。

words.meaning: v.  装饰
words.example:
They decorated the wedding car with ribbons and flowers.  他们用丝带和鲜花装饰婚车。
We're going to decorate the kitchen next week.  我们下周要粉刷厨房。
They were decorated for their part in the rescue.  他们因在此次救援行动中的表现而受到嘉奖。

words.meaning: n.  脉搏; 脉冲
words.example:
The child's pulse was strong/weak.  那个孩子的脉搏很有力／虚弱。
Exercise increases your pulse rate.  运动能加快你的脉搏。
The data, normally transmitted electronically, can be changed into pulses of light.  这一资料通常是电子传送的，现在可被改为光波脉冲。noun

words.meaning: n.  同等物,等价物,相等物a.  相等的,相当的,同意义的
words.example:
She's doing the equivalent job in the new company but for more money.  她在新公司做同样的工作，但薪水比以前高。
Is $50 equivalent to about £30?  50美元是不是大约相当于30英镑？noun countable usually singular
There is no English equivalent for 'bon appetit' so we have adopted the French expression.  英语中没有和 bon appetit 相对应的词，所以我们就借用了法语的这个表达方式。

words.meaning: a.  固定的,不变的,准备好的
words.example:
Is the date of the wedding fixed yet?  婚礼日期确定了吗？adjective
How are you fixed for cash?  你有多少现金？
How are you fixed for Saturday evening?  周六晚上你怎么安排？

words.meaning: a.  富有经验的,老练的,熟练的
words.example: She is very experienced in marketing.  她在市场行销方面经验丰富。

words.meaning: n.  嘲讽
words.example:
The irony (of it) is that the new tax system will burden those it was intended to help.  讽刺的是，新的税收制度反而将使该制度本来打算要帮助的人背上沉重负担。UK noun uncountable
Her voice heavy with irony, Simone said, "We're so pleased you were able to stay so long." (= Her voice made it obvious they were not pleased).  西蒙娜说：“你能留这么久，我们真高兴。”语气里明显带有讽刺。    Compare sarcasm

words.meaning: vi.  相互作用; 互相配合
words.example:
Dominique's teacher says that she interacts well with the other children.  多明尼克的老师说她与别的孩子相处得很好。
It's interesting at parties to see how people interact socially.  在聚会上看人们如何交流沟通是很有趣的。
We are studying how these two chemicals interact.  我们在研究这两种化学物质是如何相互作用的。

words.meaning: n.  对手,竞争者a.  竞争的
words.example:
He beat his closest/nearest rival by 20 marks.  他以领先20分的成绩打败了和他水准最接近的对手。
The companies produce rival versions of the toy.  这些公司生产的玩具跟我们的产品争夺市场。verb transitive (-ll- or US USUALLY -l-)
No computer can rival a human brain for/in complexity.  没有任何电脑比得上人脑复杂。

words.meaning: n.  打洞器,钻孔机,冲压机,冲床,混合甜饮料,殴打,力量vt.  以拳重击,开
words.example:
She gave him a punch UKon / USin the nose.  她朝着他的鼻子打了一拳。noun
Have you seen the hole punch anywhere?  你看到打孔器在哪里了吗？verb transitive
He punched him in the stomach.  他朝他的肚子上猛击了一拳。

words.meaning: n.  曲棍球; 冰球
words.example: Hockey is popular in cold regions.  冰球在寒冷地区很流行。

words.meaning: v.  坚持; 持续
words.example:
If the pain persists, consult a doctor.  如果疼痛持续就去看医生。
The cold weather is set to persist throughout the week.  寒冷天气很可能将持续整个星期。
If he persists in asking awkward questions, then send him to the boss.  如果他没完没了地问令人尴尬的问题，就把他打发到老板那里去。

words.meaning: vt.  脱落; 流出; 散发; n.  小屋
words.example:
Psychotherapy helped him to shed some of his insecurity/inhibitions.  心理疗法帮助他摆脱了一些不安全感／自我压抑。
I'm going on a diet to see if I can shed (= become thinner by losing) a few kilos.  我要节食，看能不能甩掉几公斤。
The trees shed their leaves in autumn.  树木在秋天落叶。

words.meaning: n.  液体,流体,流音a.  液体的,透明的,易变的,流动的
words.example:
Mercury is a liquid at room temperature.  水银在室温下为液体。adjective
She has very few liquid assets as most of her wealth is tied up in stocks and shares.  她的流动资金很少，大部分财产都投到了证券和股票上。adjective

words.meaning: adv.  因此，从而
words.example: He missed the bus; consequently, he was late.  他没赶上公交，结果迟到了。

words.meaning: n.  立法机关
words.example: The legislature approved the budget.  立法机关批准了预算。

words.meaning: vt.  鼓励; 培养
words.example:
Would you consider fostering (a child) ?  你会考虑代养一个孩子吗？    Compare adoptUK verb
I'm trying to foster an interest in classical music in my children.  我正努力培养我的孩子们对古典音乐的兴趣。
They were discussing the best way to foster democracy and prosperity in the former communist countries.  他们正在讨论促进前共产主义国家民主和繁荣的最佳办法。UK adjective [before noun]

words.meaning: vi.  痊愈vt.  使复原,使和解,治愈
words.example:
The wounds were gradually healing (up).  伤口在逐渐愈合。
The plaster cast helps to heal the broken bone.  石膏绷带有利于断骨的愈合。
Peace talks were held to try to heal the growing rift between the two sides.  双方举行了和谈以弥合日益扩大的裂痕。

words.meaning: n.  过滤器; vt.  过滤
words.example:
Ozone is the Earth's primary filter for ultraviolet radiation.  臭氧层是地球上阻挡紫外线辐射的主要屏障。UK noun countable
News filtered down to us during the day.  白天的时候消息慢慢传到了我们这里。
Reports about an accident began to filter in.  有关一次意外的报道开始慢慢传开。

words.meaning: n.  硬币,金钱,货币vt.  铸造,创造,杜撰
words.example:
That machine doesn't take 50p coins.  那台机器不收50便士的硬币。
Allen Ginsberg coined the term "flower power".  艾伦•金斯堡创造了 flower power（权力归花）这个说法。verb

words.meaning: n.  功绩,勋绩vt.  开发,利用,开拓,剥削
words.example:
We need to make sure that we exploit our resources as fully as possible.  我们要确保尽可能充分利用资源。verb transitive /ɪkˈsplɔɪt/
Laws exist to stop companies exploiting their employees.  法律规定禁止公司剥削其员工。noun countable usually plural /ˈek.splɔɪt/
She was telling me about her exploits while travelling around Africa.  她跟我讲述了在非洲各地旅游时的奇遇。

words.meaning: a.  易接近的; 可得到的; 可进入的
words.example:
The resort is easily accessible by road, rail and air.  这个旅游胜地交通便利，坐汽车、火车和飞机都可以到达。
The problem with some of these drugs is that they are so very accessible.  此类毒品的问题在于当中一些很容易获取。
Lea Anderson is a choreographer who believes in making dance accessible.  作为一个编舞者，利·安德森认为应该使舞蹈通俗易懂。

words.meaning: n.  生物,有机体,社会组织
words.example: Amoebae and bacteria are single-celled organisms.  变形虫和细菌是单细胞生物。

words.meaning: ad.  部分地,一部分地,不公平地
words.example: The meat was only partially cooked.  这块肉没有完全煮熟。

words.meaning: n.  保守，保存，保持; 守恒
words.example: Energy conservation reduces your fuel bills and helps the environment.  节省能源能减少你的燃油费，而且还有利于环境。

words.meaning: n.  推,挤vt.  推挤,猛推,强使vi.  推
words.example:
She was jostled and shoved by an angry crowd as she left the court.  她离开法庭时，被愤怒的人群推来搡去。
Just wait your turn - there's no need to shove.  请按顺序等——没必要挤来挤去。
Reporters pushed and shoved as they tried to get close to the princess.  记者们推来挤去，想靠近公主身边。verb

words.meaning: n.  宪章; vt.  特许
words.example:
Education is one of the basic human rights written into the United Nations Charter.  受教育权是写入《联合国宪章》的基本人权之一。
The Government have produced a Citizen's/Parents'/Patients' Charter.  政府制定了一套公民／家长／病人权利章程。UK noun
They've chartered a plane to take delegates to the conference.  他们包了一架飞机送代表参加会议。UK verb transitive

words.meaning: v. n.  同意，赞成
words.example:
They can't publish your name without your consent.  未经你的同意他们不能公布你的名字。
You can only come on the trip if your parents give their consent.  只有你父母允许，你才能参加这次旅行。
Her latest film, by common consent, is her best yet.  她的最新电影被普遍认为是她迄今最好的作品。verb intransitive

words.meaning: vt.  包含,构成
words.example:
The course comprises a class book, a practice book and an audio tape.  这门课的教材包括一册课本、一本练习用书和一盒录音带。
The class is comprised mainly of Italian and French students.  这个班主要由义大利和法国学生组成。
Italian students comprise 60% of the class.  义大利学生占全班人数的60%。

words.meaning: n.  坝，堤
words.example: The Aswan High Dam is on the River Nile in Egypt.  阿斯旺水坝位于埃及境内的尼罗河上。    Compare dykeverb transitive (-mm-)

words.meaning: n.  用具,配备,机构vt.  配备,供应vi.  得到装备
words.example:
I've got a cowboy outfit for the fancy dress party.  我有一套牛仔装，参加化装晚会时可以穿。noun
He has recently set up his own research outfit, which has as yet no name.  他最近建立了自己的研究队伍，目前还没有命名。verb transitive often passive (outfitting, outfitted, outfitted)
The ambulances have all been outfitted with new radios.  所有救护车都装备了新的无线电发收设备。

words.meaning: a.  空前的
words.example: This century has witnessed environmental destruction on an unprecedented scale.  环境在本世纪遭到了空前的破坏。

words.meaning: a.  预备的，初步的
words.example:
Preliminary results show that the vaccine is effective, but this has to be confirmed by further medical trials.  初查结果显示疫苗是有效的，但这有待于进一步医学实验的证实。
We've decided to change the design based on our preliminary findings.  我们决定依据初步调查的结果对设计方案进行更改。UK noun countable usually plural
After a few polite preliminaries (= introductions) , we stated our main ideas and intentions.  几句开场白后，我们陈述了我方的主要看法和意图。

words.meaning: n.  专利权; a.  专利的; vt.  申请专利
words.example: "No," he replied, with patent distaste.  “不，”他回答道，语气明显地流露出厌恶感。adjective

words.meaning: n.  惊跳,惊避a.  胆怯的,畏缩的,怀疑的,羞怯的vi.  惊跳,乱投,避开,厌
words.example:
He was too shy to ask her to dance with him.  他太害羞了，不敢邀请她跳舞。
She gave a shy smile.  她害羞地笑了一下。
Children are often shy of/with people they don't know.  孩子们和不认识的人在一起时常常会害羞。

words.meaning: n.  垃圾,废物vt.  废弃
words.example:
There's only trash on the television tonight.  今晚的电视节目尽是些垃圾。
The trash really stinks - why don't you take it out?  这垃圾真臭——你为甚么不拿出去？noun uncountable
We don't have anything to do with the people in the apartment below us - they're trash.  我们与楼下公寓的人没有任何关系——他们是群废物。noun uncountable

words.meaning: v.  总计; n.  一罗(12打，1əə个)
words.example:
Once wrapped, the gross weight of the package is 2kg.  包装后，这个包裹的总重量是两公斤。
She earns £30,000 a year gross.  她每年的总收入是三万英镑。    Compare netUK adjective
I'd put on ten kilos and felt gross in my bikini.  我体重增加了十公斤，穿着比基尼觉得臃肿难看。UK adjective

words.meaning: n.  激素; 荷尔蒙
words.example: male and female hormones  雄性和雌性激素

words.meaning: n.  质地; 纹理; 结构
words.example:
This artificial fabric has the texture of silk.  这种人造织物有丝一样的质感。
The writing has a rich texture.  这篇作品韵味无穷。

words.meaning: n.  水沫,浪花,水花,小树枝,喷雾器,喷雾vt.  喷雾,扫射,喷射vi.  喷,溅
words.example:
Can you feel the spray from the sea/waterfall?  你能感觉到海上的浪花／瀑布溅起的水雾吗？
Farmers use a lot of chemical sprays on crops.  农场主们在农作物上喷了很多化学药剂。noun
All the wedding guests wore sprays of carnations.  所有参加婚礼的来宾都戴着小枝康乃馨。verb intransitive or transitive [usually + adv/prep]

words.meaning: vi.  妨碍,冲突,干涉,抵触
words.example:
It's their problem and I'm not going to interfere.  那是他们的问题，我不想干涉。
I'd never interfere UKbetween a husband and wife/ USwith a husband and wife.  我从不会干涉两夫妻间的事。
Interfering in other people's relationships is always a mistake.  干涉他人谈恋爱从来都是不对的。UK verb intransitive

words.meaning: n.  橡树，橡木
words.example: The timbers of those old sailing ships were mainly oak.  制造那些老帆船的木料主要是橡木。

words.meaning: n.  轮廓; 概要; v.  描绘; 略述
words.example:
She drew the outline of the boat and then coloured it in.  她画了这只船的草图，然后给它着色。
The mountain was visible only in outline as the light faded.  光线暗了下来，只能看见山的轮廓。noun countable
If you read the minutes of the meeting, they'll give you a broad outline of what was discussed.  如果你看了会议记录，就会知道讨论的大概内容。

words.meaning: n.  出席; 出席人数
words.example:
Attendance at lectures is compulsory.  这些讲座必须去听。
Attendances at church are falling.  去教堂做礼拜的人越来越少了。noun
He never goes out without his security men in attendance.  他出门必有保镖跟随左右。

words.meaning: a.  创新的; 富有革新精神的
words.example: She was an imaginative and innovative manager.  她是个具有想像力和创新精神的经理。

words.meaning: vt.  刺激,激励,鼓舞vi.  起刺激作用
words.example:
The government plans to cut taxes in order to stimulate the economy.  政府计划减税以刺激经济发展。
The film was intended to stimulate and amuse.  这部电影的主要目的是助兴和娱乐。
Erotic images are often more sexually stimulating to men than to women.  色情影像在性方面对男性的刺激作用大于女性。

words.meaning: n.  标签,附属物,名称,碎片,结束语,口头禅,陈词滥调,附加语,浑名, 标记
words.example: Tag on a couple of paragraphs about recent events.  添加几段最近发生的事。

words.meaning: a.  垂直的,直立的
words.example:
She looked over the cliff and found she was standing at the edge of a vertical drop.  她从悬崖上向下看，发现自己正站在陡直悬崖的边缘。    Compare horizontalUK noun countable usually singular
In a two-stage operation, the multi-spoked steel structure will be raised to the vertical.  在分成两个步骤的操作中，这个多辐条的钢架将被竖成垂直状态。

words.meaning: n.  目录
words.example: Browse the catalog online.  在线浏览目录。

words.meaning: vt.  强迫,迫使
words.example:
formal The new circumstances compelled a change in policy.  新情况迫使在政策上作出改变。
Over the years her work has compelled universal admiration and trust.  这些年来，她的工作获得了大家的一致钦佩和信赖。

words.meaning: n. v.  首次演出
words.example:
She made her professional stage debut in Swan Lake.  她在《天鹅湖》中完成了她的首次职业舞台演出。
He started as an actor, making his debut as a director in 1990.  他一开始时当演员，1990年首次担任导演。
The programme debuted last year to great acclaim.  这个节目去年首次演出就受到了广泛赞扬。

words.meaning: vt.  宣布,公告,赞扬,表明,宣言
words.example:
All the countries have proclaimed their loyalty to the alliance.  所有的国家都显示了它们对联盟的忠诚。
Republican party members were confidently proclaiming victory even as the first few votes came in.  才刚得到几张选票，共和党员就信心十足准备宣布胜利了。
Wearing scarves and hats which proclaimed their allegiance, the football fans flooded into the bar.  足球迷们戴着表示忠诚的头巾和帽子，如潮水般涌入酒吧。

words.meaning: n.  徒步旅行,远足,涨价,提高vi.  健行,徒步旅行,扬起vt.  使高涨,拉起
words.example:
The recent hike in train fares came as a shock to commuters.  最近火车票价的上涨让通勤者十分震惊。noun countable
The Chancellor has hiked (up) interest rates again.  财政大臣再次提高利率。verb
She hiked up her skirt and climbed onto the bicycle.  她快速撩起裙子，跨上脚踏车。

words.meaning: n.  宪法，章程
words.example:
Britain has no written constitution.  英国没有成文宪法。
Under (= As part of) the union constitution, a new committee must be elected each year.  根据工会章程，委员会必须每年改选一次。UK noun countable
He has a very strong constitution.  他体质很强壮。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.  香气; 气味
words.example:
The hounds had lost the scent of the fox near the river.  猎狗在河边就闻不到狐狸的臭迹了。
"We're on the scent of something big, " said the police chief.  “我们快要抓到大鱼了，”警长说。noun
Halfway through the match, the team could already scent victory.  打了半场以后，这个球队已经嗅到胜利了。verb transitive

words.meaning: n.  堆; vt.  堆积
words.example:
He chose a cartoon from the stack of videos on the shelf.  他从架子上的一堆录影带中挑了盒卡通片。
Don't worry, we've got stacks of time.  别担心，我们有的是时间。
Once the last few people had left the hall, the caretaker began stacking (up) the chairs.  最后几个人一离开大厅，看门人就开始把椅子堆起来。verb transitive

words.meaning: v. n.  结束，停止
words.example:
Whether the protests will cease remains to be seen.  抗议活动是否会停止还说不准。
The company has decided to cease all UK operations after this year.  公司决定从明年开始停止一切在英国的业务活动。

words.meaning: vt.  继承，遗传而得
words.example:
Who will inherit the house when he dies?  他死后由谁继承房子？
All her children will inherit equally.  她所有的子女将平分遗产。verb
Rosie inherited her red hair from her mother.  罗茜那头红发遗传自她母亲。verb

words.meaning: n.  开拓者; v.  开拓，开创
words.example:
The pioneers went west across North America, cutting down forests and planting new crops.  拓荒者横越北美洲向西部进发，砍伐林木，种植新的农作物。UK verb transitive
It was universities that pioneered these new industries.  是大学开创了这些新兴产业。

words.meaning: n.  收缩,萎缩,畏缩vi.  收缩,退缩,畏缩,缩小,萎缩vt.  使收缩,使缩小
words.example:
Your sweater will shrink if you wash it at too high a temperature.  用温度过高的水洗毛衣，毛衣会缩水。
The company's profits have shrunk from £5.5 million to £1.25 million.  公司利润从550万英镑减少到了125万英镑。
The productivity improvements have shrunk our costs by 25%.  生产率的提高使我们的成本下降了25%。

words.meaning: a.  理性的,合理的,推理的n.  有理数
words.example: He was too upset to be rational.  他心烦意乱得很，无法保持头脑清醒。

words.meaning: n.  王国,国度,领域
words.example: The bombs are capable of blasting a whole city to kingdom come.  这些炸弹能将整座城市完全摧毁。noun countable

words.meaning: a.  声音的，有声的
words.example:
The six principal roles in this opera have an average vocal range of two octaves.  这出歌剧里六个主要角色的平均音域覆盖两个八度。UK adjective
He had always been a very vocal critic of the president.  他一直都直言不讳地批评总统。
During these years, suffrage demands by women became increasingly vocal.  近些年，女性要求获得投票权的呼声越来越高。UK noun countable usually plural

words.meaning: a.  不公平的,不正直的,不正当的
words.example: an unfair system  不公平的制度

words.meaning: n.  地势，地形
words.example: The car handles particularly well on rough terrain.  这种汽车特别适宜在崎岖不平的地带行驶。

words.meaning: n.  类型,流派
words.example: What genre does the book fall into - comedy or tragedy?  这本书属于甚么体裁——喜剧还是悲剧？

words.meaning: vt.  转移,分心,使发狂
words.example:
Don't distract her (from her studies).  不要让她（在学习上）分心。
He tried to distract attention from his own illegal activities.  他试图转移人们对其非法活动的注意。

words.meaning: n.  优点,功绩,真相,功过,价值vt.  值得vi.  应受
words.example:
Her ideas have merit.  她的想法很有价值。
Brierley's book has the merit of being both informative and readable.  布赖尔利的书兼具内容丰富和可读性强的优点。
We discussed the merits of herbal tea.  我们讨论了药草茶的好处。

words.meaning: n.  折扣,贴现率vt.  打折扣vi.  贴现
words.example:
They usually give you a discount if you buy multiple copies.  你如果多买几本他们通常会给你打折。
They offer a 10 percent discount on rail travel for students.  他们给乘火车旅行的学生提供10%的折扣。verb[dɪˈskaʊnt/
You shouldn't discount the possibility of him coming back.  你不应该排除他回来的可能性。verb[dɪˈskaʊnt/

words.meaning: vt.  侵入,拥入,侵略,侵袭
words.example:
Concentrations of troops near the border look set to invade within the next few days.  部队在边境附近集结，看来几天内必定会入侵。
Hundreds of squatters have invaded waste land in the hope that they will be allowed to stay.  数百人涌入荒地，希望能获准留在那里。
Maria looks set to invade the music scene with her style and image.  看来玛丽亚准备好了要凭借她自身的风格和形象进军乐坛。

words.meaning: n.  飓风,暴风,暴风雨
words.example:
The state of Florida was hit by a hurricane that did serious damage.  佛罗里达州遭受了飓风袭击，损失严重。
Hurricane force (= very strong) winds are expected tonight.  预计今晚会有飓风级的强风。

words.meaning: vt.  分类; 分等
words.example:
The books in the library are classified by/according to subject.  图书馆的书是按照学科分类的。
Biologists classify animals and plants into different groups.  生物学家把动物和植物归入不同的类别。

words.meaning: n.  密度
words.example:
The area has a high/low population density.  该地区人口密度大／小。
We were unable to move because of the density of the crowd.  人太多，我们根本就动不了。UK noun countable or uncountable
Lead has a high density.  铅的密度大。

words.meaning: n.  好奇心,新奇的事物,珍品
words.example:
I'm burning with curiosity - you must tell me who's won!  我心急火燎地想知道——你一定要告诉我是谁赢了！
She decided to call her ex-boyfriend out of curiosity.  她出于好奇决定给以前的男友打电话。
Cars like mine are curiosities nowadays.  像我拥有的这种车如今实属罕见了。

words.meaning: v.  跳; 不出席; 逃学
words.example:
She watched her little granddaughter skip down the path.  她看着自己的小孙女沿着小路蹦蹦跳跳地往前走。
The lambs were skipping about in the field.  这些小羊在田里蹦来跳去。verb (-pp-)
Sports players often train by skipping.  运动员经常透过跳绳进行训练。verb (-pp-)

words.meaning: n.  进攻,侵略
words.example: Some types of dog are bred for aggression.  某些品种的狗是养来起攻击作用的。

words.meaning: adv.  同样地; 也
words.example: Just water these plants twice a week, and likewise the ones in the bedroom.  这些植物一周浇两次水，睡房里的那些也一样。

words.meaning: a.  非正式的,不拘礼的,通俗的
words.example:
The two groups agreed to hold an informal meeting.  两个集团同意举行一次非正式会议。
He's the ideal sort of teacher - direct, friendly and informal.  他属于那种理想的教师——坦率、友好且不拘礼节。
'Hi' is an informal way of greeting people.  “喂”是一种随意的问候方式。

words.meaning: n.  球,球面,球体,范围,地球仪vt.  包围,使成球体,放入球内
words.example: Doctors have replaced the top of his hip bone with a metal sphere.  医生们用一个金属球替换了他的髋骨顶端。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.  吹牛vi.  吹牛,自夸vt.  夸口说,自恃有
words.example:
He didn't talk about his exam results in case people thought he was boasting.  他没有谈论自己的考试成绩，以免让别人以为他在自我吹嘘。
Parents enjoy boasting about their children's achievements.  父母喜欢夸耀子女所取得的成绩。
Ireland boasts beautiful beaches, great restaurants and friendly locals.  爱尔兰拥有美丽的海滩、很棒的餐馆和友好的当地人。UK noun countable disapproving

words.meaning: n.  脚掌,鞋底,底部a.  唯一的,仅有的,单独的,独身的vt.  上以鞋底,触
words.example:
My sole objective is to make the information more widely available.  我唯一的目的就是让更多的人能了解到这些资讯。
The sole survivor of the accident was found in the water after six hours.  事故唯一的幸存者于六小时后在水里被发现。
She has sole responsibility for the project.  她独立负责该企划案。

words.meaning: n.  生态系统
words.example: Pollution can have disastrous effects on the delicately balanced ecosystem.  污染会对脆弱的生态平衡造成灾难性的破坏。

words.meaning: a.  部分的,偏袒的,偏爱的n.  泛音
words.example:
The general has ordered a partial withdrawal of troops from the area.  将军已下令部队部分人员撤出该地区。UK adjective
The reporting in the papers is entirely partial and makes no attempt to be objective.  报纸上的报道毫不客观，而且也没打算保持客观。    Opposite impartialUK adjective
I'm rather partial to red wine.  我特别爱喝红葡萄酒。

words.meaning: n.  杂草
words.example:
He looks like a real weed in those shorts.  他穿着那条短裤看起来真的很瘦弱。verb intransitive or transitive
I've been weeding (the vegetable garden).  我一直在（菜园子里）除草。verb intransitive or transitive
The first round of interviews only really serves to weed out the very weakest of applicants.  第一轮面试实际上只是要淘汰那些实力最弱的申请者。

words.meaning: n.  一看，一瞥; v.  瞥见
words.example:
We glimpsed the ruined abbey from the windows of the train.  透过火车车窗，我们瞥见了修道院的废墟。noun countable
This biography offers a few glimpses of his life before he became famous.  这部传记展示了他成名前的一些生活情况。

words.meaning: n.  前提,房屋vt.  提论,预述,假定vi.  作出前提
words.example:
The research project is based on the premise stated earlier.  这项研究计划是基于早先提出的假设之上的。verb transitive /prɪˈmaɪz/    /ˈprem.ɪs]    formal
He premised his argument on several incorrect assumptions.  他把自己的论证建立在了几个错误的假设之上。

words.meaning: vt. vi.  认为,相信
words.example: The court deemed the contract valid.  法院认定合同有效。

words.meaning: n.  人工制品; [常pl.  ]史前古器物
words.example: The artifact is four thousand years old.  这件文物有四千年历史。

words.meaning: vi.  鬼鬼祟祟做事vt.  偷偷摸摸地做n.  鬼鬼祟祟的人,旅行鞋,偷偷摸摸
words.example:
Jan hasn't got a ticket but I thought we might sneak her in.  简没有票，但我想我们或许可以把她偷偷带进去。
She was one of those dreadful children who was always sneaking on other kids in the class.  几个讨人厌的孩子总是向老师打小报告，说班里其他孩子的坏话，她就是其中一个。noun countable UK (US snitch) (Australian dobber)    slang disapproving
You told Mrs Cooper that it was me who tipped the paint over, didn't you - you nasty little sneak!  是你告诉了库珀夫人我打翻了油漆，对吗——你这卑鄙的告密者！

words.meaning: n.  闪电
words.example:
That tree was struck by lightning.  那棵树被闪电击中了。
She changed her clothes with lightning speed (= extremely quickly).  她飞快地换了衣服。noun uncountable

words.meaning: a.  过度的,格外的,极端的
words.example:
Excessive exercise can sometimes cause health problems.  过度的运动有时也会导致健康问题。
Any more pudding would simply be excessive.  不能再吃布丁了，再吃就太多了。

words.meaning: n.  废墟，残骸; 碎片
words.example: Debris from the aircraft was scattered over a large area.  飞机残骇散落在一片很大的区域。

words.meaning: n.  杆，棒
words.example:
He was given a fishing rod for his birthday.  别人送给他一根钓鱼竿作为生日礼物。
The concrete is strengthened with steel rods.  混凝土内加入钢筋变得更加牢固。UK noun countable
By giving in to the terrorists' demands, the government will simply be making a rod for its own back.  政府要是屈从于恐怖分子的要求就只会惹火烧身。

words.meaning: a.  合乎逻辑的,合理的
words.example:
Students need the ability to construct a logical argument.  学生要具备逻辑论证的能力。
It was the logical thing to do (= the decision was a reasonable one when all the facts were considered).  这样做才合乎逻辑。    Opposite illogical

words.meaning: n.  商品; 日用品
words.example:
The country's most valuable commodities include tin and diamonds.  该国最有价值的商品包括锡和钻石。
If you're going into teaching, energy is a necessary commodity.  如果你要当教师这一行，就必须有充沛的精力。

words.meaning: n.  矿(物、石); a.  矿物的
words.example: The speaker emphasized that much of South Africa's importance lay in its mineral wealth.  发言者强调说南非的重要性很大程度上源于其丰富的矿藏。

words.meaning: n.  饥饿,渴望,饥馑vt.  使饥饿vi.  挨饿,渴望
words.example:
By about 9 o'clock she started to feel faint from/with hunger.  九点的时候，她开始饿到有点头晕。
All over the world, people die of hunger every day.  世界上每天都有人饿死。UK noun
I've never hungered after power.  我从不渴望权力。

words.meaning: a.  备用的; 空闲的; vt.  节约; n.  备用品
words.example:
Have you got a spare pen?  你有多余的笔吗？
We've got a spare room if you want to stay overnight with us.  要是你想在我们这里过夜的话，我们有一个空房间。
Could I have a word with you when you've got a spare moment/minute ?  如果你有时间，我能否和你谈两句？

words.meaning: ad.  故意地
words.example:
I'm sure he says these things deliberately to annoy me.  我敢肯定他是故意说这些来气我的。
Calmly and deliberately, she poured petrol over the car and set it alight.  她平静而沉稳地把汽油浇在车上，然后点着了火。

words.meaning: n.  通行费,代价,钟声vt.  征收,敲钟,引诱,勾引,鸣钟vi.  征税,鸣钟
words.example:
He's just got a job collecting tolls at the start of the motorway.  他刚刚得到了一份在高速公路入口处收通行费的工作。
Is Bayonne a toll call (= a more expensive telephone call) from New York?  从纽约打电话到贝约纳是长途吗？UK noun
Independent sources say that the death toll from the earthquake runs into thousands.  独立消息人士称地震中的伤亡人数达到数千人。UK noun

words.meaning: n.  边,轮缘,框vt.  镶边,为. . . 装边vi.  形成边状
words.example:
The rim of the cup was chipped and broken.  杯口上碰出了裂纹，碎了。
My reading glasses have wire rims.  我阅读用的眼镜是金属丝边的。verb transitive (-mm-)
The glass was rimmed with sugar.  杯口上沾了一圈糖。

words.meaning: vi.  粘紧,附着,紧贴,坚持
words.example:
We got so wet that our clothes clung to us.  我们湿透了，衣服紧紧地贴在身上。
They clung together in terror as the screams grew louder.  尖叫声越来越大，他们惊慌地紧紧抱在一起。
One little girl was clinging onto a cuddly toy.  一个小女孩紧紧抱着一件可爱的玩具。

words.meaning: a.  分离的，隔绝的; 独一无二的
words.example:
There were only a few isolated cases of violent behaviour.  只有几次个别的暴力事件。
Working at home was making her feel increasingly isolated.  在家工作使她越来越觉得与世隔绝。

words.meaning: vi.  眨眼,闪亮vt.  眨眼,使闪亮n.  眨眼,瞬间,闪光n.  闪烁
words.example:
You've got something in your eye - try blinking a few times.  你眼睛里有东西——眨几下眼睛试试。
When he was told I was expecting twins, Harry didn't even blink.  当哈里得知我要生双胞胎时，他一点也不惊讶。noun countable usually singular
In the blink of an eye, he was gone.  一眨眼他就不见了。noun countable usually singular

words.meaning: a.  可疑的,疑惧的,怀疑的
words.example:
Her behaviour was very suspicious (Australianinformalsuss).  她的举止相当启人疑窦。
The fire at the bank is being treated as suspicious.  银行起火这件事被认为相当可疑。
It 's a bit suspicious that no one knows where he was at the time of the murder.  有点可疑的是，没有人知道谋杀案发当时他在哪里。

words.meaning: n.  班,小队,小集团vt.  编成班
words.example:
An army bomb squad arrived and defused the bomb.  一个陆军防爆小组赶到，拆除了炸弹。
Eight of their 24-man squad are injured.  队里24人中有8人受伤。

words.meaning: a.  符合条件的，合格的
words.example:
Are you eligible for early retirement/maternity leave?  你符合提前退休／休产假的条件吗？
You might be eligible for a grant.  你或许有资格得到奖学金。
Only people over 18 are eligible to vote.  只有18岁以上的人才有资格投票。

words.meaning: n.  钻进,跳进,跳水,跳水池,落下,盲目投资,投入,下跌vi.  投入,跳进,急
words.example:
We ran down to the beach and plunged into the sea.  我们跑向海滩，纵身跳入海中。
The car went out of control and plunged over the cliff.  轿车失去控制坠下悬崖。
Cook the peas by plunging them into boiling water.  把豌豆倒入沸水中煮。

words.meaning: n.  寒冷,寒意,失意a.  寒冷的,冷漠的vt.  使寒心,冷冻vi.  变冷
words.example:
I've put the beer in the fridge to chill.  我把啤酒放到了冰箱里冰镇一下。
Chill the wine before serving.  上酒前先冰镇一下。verb intransitive or transitive
This is a film that will chill you to the marrow.  这是部令人毛骨悚然的影片。verb intransitive or transitive

words.meaning: n.  避难所,安全地带,避难,庇护vi.  躲避vt.  庇护
words.example:
These people are seeking/taking refuge from persecution.  这些受到迫害的人正在寻求庇护。
The climbers slept in a mountain refuge.  这些登山者在山上一个可以避风挡雨的地方睡下了。
She had fled from her violent husband to a women's refuge in Chelmsford.  她从她残暴的丈夫身边逃离，躲进了切姆斯福德的一间妇女庇护所。

words.meaning: v.  驾驶; 引导
words.example:
She carefully steered the car around the potholes.  她小心开车绕过那些坑洞。
This car is very easy to steer.  这辆车很容易开。
The ship passed Land's End, then steered towards southern Ireland.  船绕过兰兹角，接着向爱尔兰南部驶去。

words.meaning: n.  重振旗鼓,集合,示威运动,价格回稳vt. vi.  重整旗鼓,集合,恢复精神
words.example:
The French driver has taken the lead in the Paris-Dakar rally.  在巴黎─达喀尔汽车拉力赛中，法国车手一路领先。noun countable
Share prices fell again today after yesterday's rally.  股票价格在昨天回升后再次下跌。verb
Supporters/Opponents of the new shopping development are trying to rally local people in favour of/against it.  新购物中心开发项目的支持者／反对者们试图召集当地居民支援／反对该项目。

words.meaning: a.  无损伤的，完整的
words.example:
The church was destroyed in the bombing but the altar survived intact.  教堂在轰炸中被毁，但神坛却完好无损。
It's difficult to emerge from such a scandal with your reputation still intact.  经历这样的丑闻难保你的名声不受损害。

words.meaning: vi.  繁荣,兴旺,茁壮成长
words.example:
His business thrived in the years before the war.  战前那些年，他的生意很兴隆。
She seems to thrive on stress.  她似乎很擅长在压力下工作。

words.meaning: a.  精细的,详尽的,精心的vt.  详细地说明,用心地制作,推敲vi.  变复杂
words.example:
You want a plain blouse to go with that skirt - nothing too elaborate.  你应该用一件样式简单的衬衫来配那条裙子，不要样式太复杂的。
They're making the most elaborate preparations for the wedding.  他们正为婚礼做极为精心周到的准备。
He came out with such an elaborate excuse that I didn't quite believe him.  他突然说了那么一大套理由，搞得我不敢相信他。verb intransitive /ɪˈlæb.ə.reɪt/    slightly formal

words.meaning: n.  拍卖
words.example:
They're holding an auction of jewellery on Thursday.  他们将在周四举行一场珠宝拍卖会。
The painting will be sold at / UK also by auction next week.  这幅画将在下周拍卖。
The house and its contents are being put up for auction.  这座房子及里面的家俱已被交付拍卖。UK verb transitive

words.meaning: vi.  顺从,答应
words.example:
He's been ordered to have the dog destroyed because it's dangerous, but he refuses to comply.  那只狗很危险，因此他接到了把它人道毁灭的命令，但他拒绝服从。
There are serious penalties for failure to comply with the regulations.  不遵守规定者将受到严惩。

words.meaning: n.  凯旋,胜利,欢欣vi.  得胜,成功
words.example:
The book celebrates the hostages' remarkable triumph over appalling adversity.  这本书颂扬人质脱离可怕险境的壮举。
The signing of the agreement was a personal triumph for the Prime Minister.  签订该协议对首相而言是一项伟大的个人成就。
It was the Republican Party's third election triumph in a row.  这是共和党连续第三次赢得选举胜利。

words.meaning: a.  可比较的,比得上的
words.example:
The girls are of comparable ages.  这群女孩年龄相仿。
Our prices are comparable to/with those in other shops.  我们的价格和其他商店的差不多。
The two experiences aren't comparable.  这两段经历不能相比。

words.meaning: n.  良心
words.example:
You didn't do anything wrong - you should have a clear conscience (= not feel guilty).  你没做错甚么——你应该觉得问心无愧。
My conscience would really trouble me if I wore a fur coat.  要是我穿件皮草大衣，确实会良心不安。
He's got no conscience at all (= does not feel guilty) about leaving me to do the housework.  他对于把家务丢给我一点都不觉得内疚。UK noun countable or uncountable

words.meaning: n.  间隔时间; 间距; 音程
words.example:
We see each other at regular intervals - usually about once a month.  我们定期见面——通常大约是每月一次。
There's often a long interval between an author completing a book and it appearing in the shops.  从作者完成一本书到它出现在书店里常常有一段较长的间隔。
There will be two twenty-minute intervals during the opera.  歌剧演出中有两次20分钟的幕间休息。

words.meaning: n.  抓痕,搔,抓,擦伤,刮擦声,乱写,未中的一击,起跑线,零vt.  搔,抓,挖
words.example:
We scratched the paintwork trying to get the bed into Martha's room.  我们把床搬进玛莎的房间里时，把漆面给划坏了。
People have been scratching their names on this rock for years.  许多年来人们都在这块岩石上刻写名字。
I'm afraid I scratched some paint off the door as I was getting out of the car.  恐怕我下车时磨掉了车门上的一些漆。

words.meaning: n.  司法权,审判权,管辖权
words.example:
The court has no jurisdiction in/over cases of this kind.  该法庭无权审判此类案件。
School admissions are not under/within our jurisdiction.  我们无权批准入学。

words.meaning: adv.  不可避免地，必然地
words.example: Their arguments inevitably end in tears.  他们的争论不可避免地以眼泪告终。

words.meaning: n.  女权主义者
words.example: All her life she was an ardent feminist.  她一生都是一个充满激情的女权运动者。

words.meaning: n.  远征,探险队,迅速
words.example:
We're going on a shopping expedition on Saturday.  星期六我们要去购物。
Scott died while he was on an expedition to the Antarctic in 1912.  史考特1912年死于南极探险途中。
The British expedition to Mount Everest is leaving next month.  英国珠穆朗玛峰探险队将于下个月启程。noun

words.meaning: n.  烟头,靶,笑柄
words.example:
She told him to get off his butt and do something useful.  她叫他行动起来，干点有用的事。noun
They struck him with their rifle butts.  他们用来褔枪的枪托打他。noun
He was fed up with being the butt of their jokes.  他已经受够了被他们当作笑柄。noun

words.meaning: a.  哑的,不说话的,无声音的
words.example:
He's been deaf and dumb since birth.  他生下来就又聋又哑。
She was struck dumb by what she had seen.  她被自己看到的一切吓得说不出话来。adjective
Are they brave or just dumb?  他们是真的勇敢还是只是匹夫之勇？

words.meaning: n.  大小,体积,大批,大多数vt. 显得大,显得重要,
words.example:
She eased her large bulk out of the chair.  她缓缓地将她那庞大的身躯从椅子上挪开。
It was a document of surprising bulk.  这是一份篇幅惊人的文件。
The office buys paper in bulk to keep down costs.  办公室大量买进纸张以减少成本。

words.meaning: n.  赞助人; 顾客
words.example:
The Princess Royal is a well-known patron of several charities.  众所周知，长公主是好几家慈善机构的赞助人。noun countable
Will patrons kindly note that this shop will be closed on 17th July.  各位顾客请注意，本店7月17日将暂停营业。

words.meaning: a.  市(政)的; 地方性的
words.example: municipal authorities  市政当局

words.meaning: n.  和声; 协调
words.example:
It is a simple melody with complex harmonies.  这是一首和声复杂的简单旋律。UK noun
Imagine a society in which everyone lived together in (perfect) harmony.  设想一下有这样一个社会，所有人都和睦地生活在一起。
We must ensure that tourism develops in harmony with the environment.  我们必须确保旅游业与环境和谐发展。

words.meaning: n.  祝福
words.example:
The mass always ends with a blessing.  弥撒总是以祈神赐福结束。
We ask God's blessing on Joan at this difficult time.  在这个困难时刻我们祈求上帝保佑。noun
It was a blessing that no one was killed in the accident.  事故中没有人死真是万幸。noun

words.meaning: a.  多变的; n.  动的雕塑
words.example:
You've broken your ankle but you'll be fully mobile (= able to walk as usual) within a couple of months.  你摔断了脚踝，但用不了几个月你就可以行动自如了。UK noun countable
My mobile's 07796 10253.  我的手机号码是07796 10253。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.  (日、月)历; 日程表
words.example: the Christian/Jewish/Chinese calendar  基督教／犹太教／中国历法

words.meaning: n.  存款,定金,堆积物vt.  存放,堆积vi.  沉淀
words.example:
The flood waters fell, depositing mud over the whole area.  洪水退去后，留下的淤泥覆盖了整个地区。
The bus deposited me miles from anywhere.  公车把我扔在一个前不着村后不着店的地方。
The cuckoo deposits (= puts) her eggs in other birds' nests.  布谷鸟把自己的蛋下在其他鸟类的窝里。

words.meaning: n.  冲动,驱使,刺激,脉冲,冲力vt.  推动
words.example: an electrical/nerve impulse  电脉冲／神经冲动noun

words.meaning: a.  残忍的,野蛮的,不讲理的
words.example:
He had presided over a brutal regime in which thousands of people had 'disappeared'.  在他残暴的统治下，成千上万的人“失踪”了。
He was imprisoned in 1945 for the brutal murder of a 12-year old girl.  1945年，他因残忍杀害了一名12岁女孩而入狱。
She spoke with brutal honesty - I was too old for the job.  她毫不留情地直接告诉我，我年纪太大，不适合这份工作。

words.meaning: n.  食肉动物
words.example: In court, he was accused of being a merciless predator who had tricked his grandmother out of her savings.  在法庭上，他被指控是一个无情的掠夺者，骗取了祖母的积蓄。

words.meaning: a.  自动的,自愿的,故意的,自发的,非官办的n.  即兴演奏,志愿者
words.example:
They chose to take voluntary redundancy.  他们选择自愿离职。
She does voluntary work for the Red Cross two days a week.  她每周志愿为红十字会服务两天。
The hospital has asked various voluntary organizations to help raise money for the new operating theatre.  医院已经请求各种志愿组织为筹建新手术室募集资金。

words.meaning: a.  有确实根据的,有效的,正当的,正确的
words.example:
My way of thinking might be different from yours, but it's equally valid.  我的想法也许和你的不同，但同样站得住脚。    Compare invalid
My passport is valid for another two years.  我的护照还有两年才到期。
Is this contract/ticket/agreement still valid?  这份合同／这张票据／这份协定还有法律效力吗？

words.meaning: n.  除去; 移动
words.example:
Does your firm do removals?  你们公司承接搬家业务吗？noun uncountable
There have been calls for the president's removal.  一直有要求总统下台的呼声。

words.meaning: n.  自治
words.example:
Demonstrators demanded immediate autonomy for their region.  游行示威者要求立即实现该地区的自治。
The universities are anxious to preserve their autonomy from central government.  大学都迫切希望维护其自主办学权，不受中央政府的控制。

words.meaning: vt.  制定法律,扮演,颁布
words.example: The stories are enacted using music, dance and mime.  这些故事利用音乐、舞蹈和默剧的形式在舞台上被再现出来。

words.meaning: n.  分数,小部分,破片
words.example:
Although sexual and violent crimes have increased by 10%, they remain only a tiny/small fraction of the total number of crimes committed each year.  尽管性犯罪和暴力犯罪案件增长了10%，但它们在每年的罪案总数中所占比例仍然很小。
They can produce it at a fraction of the cost of (= much more cheaply than) traditional methods.  他们能够以大大低于传统方法的成本生产它。

words.meaning: n.  门槛,入口,开端,阈
words.example:
His secretary earns £268 a month, well below the threshold for paying tax.  他的秘书每月赚268英镑，远远不够纳税的标准。UK noun
We are on the threshold of a new era in European relations.  我们欧洲国家间的关系即将进入一个新时代。

words.meaning: n.  排气,排气装置vt.  用尽,耗尽,抽完,使精疲力尽vi.  排气
words.example:
The long journey exhausted the children.  长途旅行后，孩子们疲惫不堪。
I've exhausted myself with all that cleaning.  打扫完，我累得筋疲力尽。UK verb transitive
How long will it be before the world's fuel supplies are exhausted?  再过多长时间地球上的燃料就耗尽了？

words.meaning: a.  易碎的,脆的
words.example:
Be careful with that vase - it's very fragile.  拿那个花瓶要小心——它很容易碎。
The assassination could do serious damage to the fragile peace agreement that was signed last month.  这宗行刺事件可能会对上月签署的脆弱的和平协定造成严重损害。
humorous No breakfast for me, thanks - I'm feeling rather fragile (= ill, upset or tired) after last night's party.  我不吃早餐了，谢谢——昨晚派对后到现在我还觉得很不舒服。

words.meaning: n.  阵,一阵风,爆炸,枯萎病vt.  炸,使枯萎vi.  猛攻,公开批评,枯萎
words.example:
They heard the guns blasting away all night.  他们听到枪炮声响了一整夜。
figurative Their latest record blasted (its way) up the charts (= moved very quickly because of its popularity).  他们最新的唱片在排行榜上名次直线上升。
The government was blasted by the opposition for failing to reduce inflation.  政府因未能缓解通货膨胀而遭到反对派的抨击。UK verb

words.meaning: vi.  获胜,流行,盛行
words.example:
And did reason prevail over (= become a more powerful influence than) emotion?  理智战胜了情感吗？
This attitude still prevails among the middle classes.  这种观点在中产阶级里仍然很普遍。 formal
He was eventually prevailed upon to accept the appointment.  他最后被说服，接受了这项任命。

words.meaning: n.  碎片,破片,断片
words.example:
The road was covered with fragments of glass from the shattered window.  马路上到处是车窗的碎玻璃片。
Literary scholars are piecing together her last unpublished novel from fragments of a recently discovered manuscript.  文学研究者们正在把最近发现的她最后一部未发表小说的手稿残片一点点拼凑起来。verb intransitive or transitive /frægˈment/
The satellite will fragment and burn up as it falls through the Earth's atmosphere.  卫星坠经地球大气层时会碎裂起火，化为灰烬。

words.meaning: a.  适当的,相配的
words.example:
The film is suitable for children.  这部电影适宜儿童观看。
My mother doesn't like me wearing short skirts to church - she doesn't think they're suitable.  我妈妈不喜欢我穿着短裙去教堂——她认为这不太合适。    Opposite unsuitable

words.meaning: v.  钻(孔)，打眼; n.  钻(孔); 操练
words.example:
In some of these schools, army-style drills are used to instil a sense of discipline.  这些学校中有一些利用军训来培养纪律观念。
What's the drill for getting money after four o'clock?  四点钟以后怎么取钱？verb
Drill three holes in the wall for the screws.  在墙上打三个拧螺丝钉用的小孔。

words.meaning: n.  公寓，府邸; 大厦
words.example: The street is lined with enormous mansions where the rich and famous live.  街道两旁是富人及名人的大豪宅。

words.meaning: vt.  授权与,批准,委托代替
words.example: Who authorized this expenditure?  这项支出是谁批准的？

words.meaning: a.  忠诚的，忠贞的
words.example:
Jack has been a loyal worker in this company for almost 50 years.  杰克是这间公司忠诚的员工，已经工作了快50年了。
When all her other friends deserted her, Steve remained loyal.  当其他朋友都离她而去的时候，史蒂芬依然对她不离不弃。
She's very loyal to her friends.  她对朋友非常忠诚。    Opposite disloyal

words.meaning: n.  泥土，粘土
words.example: The figurine is made of clay.  这塑像是黏土做的。

words.meaning: n.  费用; v.  进展
words.example:
Train fares are going up again.  火车票又涨价了。
How did you fare in your exams?  你考得怎么样？
Low-paid workers will fare badly/well under this government.  在这届政府执政期间，低收入工人的境况会很糟／很好。

words.meaning: n.  雷达
words.example: Other vessels in the area show up on the ship's radar (screen).  该船的雷达（萤幕）显示这一海域有其他船只。UK noun uncountable

words.meaning: n.  皱眉vi.  皱眉头vt.  皱眉表示
words.example:
She frowned at me, clearly annoyed.  她皱着眉头看着我，显然是生气了。
He frowned as he read the instructions, as if puzzled.  他看说明书时皱着眉头，一副迷惑不解的样子。verb intransitive
Smoking is frowned upon in many restaurants.  很多餐馆里都禁止吸烟。

words.meaning: vi.  退却，撤退; n.  退却; 隐退处
words.example:
Attacks by enemy aircraft forced the tanks to retreat (from the city).  敌机的轰炸迫使坦克（从这座城市）撤离。
When she came towards me shouting, I retreated (behind my desk).  她大叫着冲向我时，我就后退（到了桌子后面）。
When he's done something wrong, he retreats to his bedroom.  他要是做了甚么错事，就会躲到自己睡房里去。verb

words.meaning: n.  分子,些微
words.example: A molecule of glucose has six carbons.  一个葡萄糖分子含六个碳。

words.meaning: a.  良好的; 赞成的; 有利的
words.example: The weather looks favorable for the launch.  天气看来适合发射。

words.meaning: vt.  淹没; 压倒
words.example:
Government troops have overwhelmed the rebels and seized control of the capital.  政府军已击败了叛乱者，控制了首都。UK verb
They were overwhelmed with/by grief when their baby died.  婴儿夭折时他们悲痛欲绝。

words.meaning: vt.  注视,沉思,打算vi.  冥思苦想
words.example:
You're not contemplating a change of job, are you?  你没考虑要换工作，是吗？
It's too awful/horrific/dangerous to contemplate.  这件事太糟糕／可怕／危险，简直不敢想。

words.meaning: v.  激发; 引起; n.  火花，火星
words.example:
That small incident was the spark that set off the street riots.  那件小事是引发街头暴动的导火线。UK noun
Sparks were flying out of the bonfire and blowing everywhere.  营火中飞溅出很多火星，迸得到处都是。
You can start a fire by rubbing two dry pieces of wood together until you produce a spark.  你可以透过摩擦两块干木头直到产生火花来点火。

words.meaning: adv.  具有讽刺意味地; 嘲讽地
words.example: Ironically, the expert made a basic error.  讽刺的是，专家犯了个低级错误。

words.meaning: n.  劳累; (金属材料等)疲劳
words.example:
She was suffering from fatigue and a stress-related illness.  她劳累不堪，还患了与压力有关的疾病。
The crash was caused by metal fatigue in one of the propeller blades.  坠机事件是因一片螺旋桨叶发生金属疲劳造成的。
Get dressed right now or you'll find yourself on fatigues.  马上整装，否则罚你做杂役。verb transitive old use or formal

words.meaning: vi.  深思,推测,投机
words.example:
Journalists are speculating about whether interest rates will be cut.  记者们在猜测是否会降息。
He made his money speculating on the London gold and silver markets.  他在伦敦黄金市场和白银市场上做投机生意赚了钱。
The company has been speculating in property for years.  这家公司做房地产投机生意已经有好几年了。

words.meaning: vt. vi.  传道,讲道,鼓吹,宣讲,说教n.  说教,布道
words.example:
Father Martin preached to the assembled mourners.  马丁神父向聚集的哀悼者们布道。
During the sermon, he preached about the need for forgiveness.  在布道期间，他宣讲了宽恕的必要性。verb
They preach the abolition of established systems but propose nothing to replace them.  他们竭力鼓吹废除现行体制，但没有提出取代方案。verb

words.meaning: n.  供认，承认
words.example:
I've got a bit of a confession to make - I've lost that book you lent me.  我要承认一件事——我把你借给我的那本书丢了。
Confession is the first stage of coming to terms with what you've done.  坦白是你正视自己所作所为的第一步。
He made a full confession to the police.  他向警方甚么都招了。

words.meaning: vt.  激怒,惹起,驱使
words.example:
The prospect of increased prices has already provoked an outcry.  物价上涨的预测已经引发了强烈抗议。
Test results provoked worries that the reactor could overheat.  检测结果引发了核子反应炉可能过热的担忧。UK verb transitive
It was a vicious-looking dog and I didn't want to provoke it.  那只狗看起来很凶，我并不想招惹它。

words.meaning: n.  大理石,石弹,雕刻品a.  大理石的,冷酷无情的,坚硬的
words.example: a marble floor/statue  大理石地板／雕像UK noun

words.meaning: a.  外在的,清楚的
words.example: She was very explicit about (= said very clearly and exactly) what she thought was wrong with the plans.  她明确地指出了计划中她认为有误的地方。

words.meaning: a.  磁(性)的
words.example: The magnetic stripe on the card stores data.  卡上的磁条存着数据。

words.meaning: vi.  离开,出发,去世,违反,放弃
words.example:
The plane departs at 6.00 a.m.  那架飞机在早上六时起飞。
The train for London departs from Platform 2.  前往伦敦的列车从2号月台开出。UK US  formal
In loving memory of my dear husband, who departed this life on May 5, 1978.  深切怀念我亲爱的丈夫，他于1978年5月5日辞世。UK US  formal

words.meaning: n.  (打印机等的)色带; 带状物
words.example:
Sandra often wears a ribbon in her hair.  桑德拉常在头发上扎条丝带。
He tied up the present with ribbon.  他用缎带将礼物包扎起来。
My typewriter needs a new ribbon.  我的打字机得换色带了。noun

words.meaning: adv. n.  其时，其间
words.example: Your computer won't be arriving till Thursday. In the meantime, you can use Jude's.  你的电脑星期四才到。在这段时间里你可以用祖德的。

words.meaning: v.  传输; 传播
words.example:
Radio Seven transmits on 201 medium wave (= uses those particular radio waves to broadcast on).  广播七台透过中波201千赫广播。
The information is transmitted electronically to the central computer.  这些资讯以电子化的方式传送到中央电脑。UK US  (-tt-)
Cholera is transmitted through contaminated water.  霍乱是透过受污染的水传播。

words.meaning: n.  收获,成果,收获物,收获期vt. vi.  收割,收获
words.example:
We had a good harvest this year.  今年我们收成不错。
Farmers are reporting a bumper (= very big) harvest this year.  农民说今年的收成非常好。
It won't be long now till harvest (time).  现在离收获时节不远了。UK verb intransitive or transitive

words.meaning: a.  连续的,联贯的,始终一贯的
words.example: This is the fifth consecutive weekend that I've spent working, and I'm a bit fed up with it.  这是我连续第五个周末加班，我有点厌倦了。

words.meaning: n.  同等的人物,同位格,坐标a.  同等的,等位的vt. vi.  (使)协调
words.example:
We need someone to coordinate the whole campaign.  我们需要有个人来协调整个活动。
The bed linen coordinates with the bedroom curtains.  床单和睡房的窗帘很相配。

words.meaning: n.  暴动,喧闹,奔放vi.  参加暴动,纵情,放荡vt.  浪费,挥霍
words.example:
Inner-city riots erupted when a local man was shot by police.  在市中心的贫民区，由于一名当地男子被员警开枪打死而突然引发了暴乱。
Jim's rose garden is a riot of colour.  占姆的玫瑰园五彩缤纷。noun
My imagination was running riot, thinking of all the ways that I could spend the money.  我的思维像匹脱缰的野马，放任地想着花掉那笔钱的种种方法。verb intransitive

words.meaning: n.  滋养物，营养品; a.  有营养的
words.example: It's good soil - full of nutrients.  这土壤肥沃——养分很充足。

words.meaning: n.  主权,独立国
words.example: Talks are being held about who should have sovereignty over the island.  关于该岛主权归属问题的会谈正在进行。

words.meaning: n.  脊，山脊
words.example:
We walked along the narrow mountain ridge.  我们沿着狭窄的山脊行进。
figurative A ridge (= narrow area) of high pressure will bring good weather this afternoon.  今天下午高压脊将会带来好天气。

words.meaning: vt.  使具体化
words.example:
He said we should meet but didn't specify a time.  他说我们应该见个面，但没说具体时间。
The peace treaty clearly specifies the terms for the withdrawal of troops.  和平条约明确规定了撤军的条件。
The loan must be repaid within a specified period/by a specified date.  贷款必须在指定期限内／指定日期前偿还。

words.meaning: vt.  挫败,击败,破坏a.  无益的,挫败的,挫折的
words.example:
It frustrates me that I'm not able to put any of my ideas into practice.  我的任何想法都无法付诸实践，这让我很灰心。verb transitive
The continuing civil war is frustrating the efforts of relief agencies.  持续的内战使救济机构的努力受挫。

words.meaning: a.  有关节的; vt.  明确有力地表达
words.example:
Many people are opposed to the new law, but have had no opportunity to articulate their opposition.  很多人不赞成这项新法律，但是却没有机会表达他们的反对意见。
When children first learn to talk, there are some sounds that they find difficult to articulate.  小孩子刚学说话时，有一些音他们很难发出来。

words.meaning: n.  运输(线); 转变
words.example:
He was seen driving a white Transit van near Leeds.  有人看到他在利兹附近开着一辆白色的“全顺”客货两用车。
It is possible to make an insurance claim for any goods lost or damaged in transit.  为在运输中丢失或受损的货物索取保险赔偿是有可能的。
The question is whether road transit is cheaper than rail.  问题在于公路运输是否比铁路运输便宜。

words.meaning: a.  密集的,浓厚的
words.example:
The body was found hidden in dense undergrowth.  尸体被发时是藏在密密的树丛下面。
We've got some really dense people in our class.  我们班有些人特笨。adjective
Plutonium is very dense.  钚的密度很大。

words.meaning: n.  研讨会
words.example: I'm giving a seminar on the latest developments in genetic engineering next week.  下周我将举行一个有关遗传工程最新进展的研讨会。

words.meaning: n.  增大,隆起的部分,巨浪,肿大a.  优秀的,一流的vi.  增大,膨胀,骄傲,
words.example:
It was obvious she had broken her toe, because it immediately started to swell (up).  她的脚趾显然已经骨折，因为它开始肿胀了。
Twenty-five employees have joined the union in this month alone, swelling its ranks (= increasing its size) to 110.  仅这个月就有25位员工加入工会，使工会的人数增加到110人。
literary His heart/breast swelled with pride (= He felt very proud) as he stood watching his son graduate.  当他站在那里观看儿子的毕业典礼时，心中充满自豪。

words.meaning: n.  控告,指控,非难
words.example:
You can't just make wild accusations like that!  你不能那样胡乱指责人！
He glared at me with an air of accusation.  他瞪着我，一脸责备的样子。

words.meaning: n.  暗示，提示
words.example:
She watched his lips carefully and took her cue from him.  她紧盯着他的嘴唇，照他的吩咐行事。noun countable
The architects took their cue for the design of the new pub from the nearby Jacobean house, Aston Hall.  建筑师们对新酒吧的设计深受附近詹姆斯一世时期的建筑——阿斯顿大厅的影响。verb transitive (cueing, cued, cued)    (also cue in)
With a nod of his head, the drummer cued the lead singer in.  鼓手点了一下头，给领唱作了个暗示。

words.meaning: n.  传记
words.example: He wrote a biography of Winston Churchill.  他撰写了温斯顿‧丘吉尔的传记。    Compare autobiography ; hagiography

words.meaning: n.  冒险,危险,机会vt.  冒. . . 的危险,赌运气,使遭危险
words.example:
The busy traffic entrance was a hazard to pedestrians.  那个繁忙的车辆入口处对行人来说很不安全。UK verb transitive
The policy hazarded the islands and put the lives of the inhabitants at risk.  这项政策将这些岛屿和岛上的居民置于危险的境地。

words.meaning: v.  铺瓦于
words.example: We're going to tile the bathroom.  我们要给浴室贴瓷砖。

words.meaning: n.  便利; 便利设施
words.example:
Just for convenience, I'm going to live at my mother's place until my new house is ready.  为了方便，我打算在我的新居收拾好之前先住在我母亲那里。
The goods will be delivered at your convenience.  货物随传随到。
Please return the completed form at your earliest convenience.  请将填好的表格尽快交回。noun

words.meaning: n.  使人高兴的东西; v.  (使)愉快
words.example:
My sister's little boy is a real delight.  我姐姐的小儿子很讨人喜欢。
The children squealed in delight when they saw all the presents under the Christmas tree.  孩子们看到圣诞树下的各种礼物时兴奋地叫了起来。
He seems to take great delight in (= enjoys) teasing his sister.  他似乎觉得逗他妹妹玩很有趣。

words.meaning: n.  木材,木料vt.  用木材建造
words.example: These trees are being grown for timber.  这些树是供材用而栽种的。

words.meaning: n.  恳求,辩解,托词,请愿
words.example:
He made a plea for help/mercy.  他恳求得到帮助／宽恕。noun countable
Mr Wilson entered a plea of not guilty.  威尔逊先生提出了无罪申诉。

words.meaning: n.  植物的球茎，球形物; 灯泡
words.example: tulip bulbs  郁金香球茎noun countable

words.meaning: n.  货物
words.example: The ship was carrying a cargo of wool from England to France.  这艘船正将羊毛货品从英格兰运往法国。

words.meaning: n.  背骨,脊柱,尖刺
words.example:
She injured her spine in a riding accident.  她在一次坠马事故中脊椎受伤。
figurative The Apennine mountains form the spine (= central row of mountains) of Italy.  亚平宁山脉是义大利的中心山脉。noun countable

words.meaning: n.  舰队,水兵,海运业a.  海的,海产的,海运的,船舶的,海底的
words.example:
The oil slick seriously threatens marine life around the islands.  浮油严重威胁着岛屿周围的海洋生物。
Marine biologists are concerned about the effects of untreated sewage that is flowing into coastal waters.  污水未经处理就排到近海海域，海洋生物学家对其后果十分担心。
One plane, a marine F18, was lost in the raid.  突袭行动中损失了一架F18舰载战斗机。

words.meaning: n.  雾,迷惑,苔藓vi.  被雾笼罩,变模糊vt.  使困惑,以雾笼罩
words.example:
Thick/Heavy/Dense fog has made driving conditions dangerous.  浓雾使开车颇为危险。
Mists, freezing fogs and snow are common in this area.  薄雾、寒雾和雪在这个地区很常见。
It took several hours for the fog to lift.  几个小时以后雾才散去。UK noun

words.meaning: n.  外交官
words.example: a Spanish/British diplomat  西班牙／英国外交官

words.meaning: a.  烦人的,无聊的,无趣的
words.example:
She finds opera boring.  她觉得歌剧很乏味。
It's boring to sit on the plane with nothing to read.  坐在飞机上没东西可读真是无聊。
The film was so boring I fell asleep.  这部电影非常乏味，我都睡着了。

words.meaning: n.  摘要，概要
words.example: At the end of the news, they often give you a summary of the main news stories.  在新闻结束的时候，他们常常会总结一下主要的新闻内容。UK adjective [before noun]

words.meaning: n.  流行; 流行病
words.example:
Poverty in this country has reached epidemic proportions.  这个国家很多人处于贫困之中。
Crime and poverty are epidemic in the city.  犯罪和贫穷如瘟疫一般在这个城市肆虐。

words.meaning: a.  致命的; 毁灭性的
words.example:
This illness is fatal in almost all cases.  这种病几乎是不治之症。
He made the fatal mistake/error of believing what they told him.  他听信了他们的话，犯了灾难性的错误。
It just shows how you should never say how well things are going for you - it's fatal (= it causes bad things to happen).  这件事恰恰说明你决不能说事情进展很顺利——这么讲会带来大麻烦。

words.meaning: n.  仓库，货栈
words.example:
The goods have been sitting in a warehouse for months because a strike has prevented distribution.  因为罢工无法发货，货物已经堆在仓库里好几个月了。
We bought both sofas from a big furniture warehouse that's just off the motorway.  这两张沙发都是我们在高速公路旁的一家大型家俱店里买的。

words.meaning: vt. vi.  加速
words.example:
Inflation is likely to accelerate this year, adding further upward pressure on interest rates.  今年通货膨胀可能会加剧，迫使利率持续上升。
They use special chemicals to accelerate the growth of crops.  他们使用特殊的化学品来刺激农作物生长。

words.meaning: n.  青铜
words.example:
The church bells are made of bronze.  教堂大钟是青铜制成的。
He got a bronze in the high jump.  他跳高得了铜牌。UK adjective

words.meaning: a.  固有的,与生俱来的
words.example: There are dangers/risks inherent in almost every sport.  几乎每种运动本身都带有危险／风险。

words.meaning: n.  真空,空间,真空吸尘器a.  真空的,产生真空的,利用真空的vt.  用吸
words.example:
The withdrawal of troops from the area has created a security vacuum which will need to be filled.  部队撤军之后，那个地区出现了一个有待填补的安全性漏洞。
No artist works in a vacuum - we are all of us influenced by others.  没有哪个艺术工作者可以脱离现实——我们都受到他人的影响。verb intransitive or transitive (UK also hoover)
Vacuum (up) the cake crumbs, would you?  请用吸尘器把蛋糕屑清理掉，好吗？

words.meaning: v.  规定; 决定
words.example:
The UN will dictate the terms of troop withdrawal from the region.  联合国将决定军队从该地区撤军的条件。
The party's change of policy has been dictated by its need to win back the support of voters.  该党政策上的变化是由于它需要赢回选民的支持。
She spent the morning dictating letters to her secretary.  她花了一上午的时间向秘书口述信件。verb UK   Phrasal Verbs   dictate to sb

words.meaning: n.  洗衣店; 洗熨
words.example:
I've got to do (= wash) my laundry.  我要把衣服洗了。
It wasn't much of a speech - just a laundry list of accusations against the government.  这不算是演讲，只是在将一连串对政府的控诉罗列出来。

words.meaning: a.  手工的; n.  手册，指南
words.example:
She tried to cure the pain in my knee by putting manual pressure on the joint.  她尝试用手按压我的膝关节来治疗我的膝痛。
He still works on an old manual typewriter.  他还在用一台老式手动打字机。
Computer-controlled robots are taking over manual jobs in many industries.  在许多行业中，体力工作正逐步由电脑控制的机器人代劳。noun countable

words.meaning: a.  海军的,军舰的,有舰队的
words.example: a naval officer  海军军官

words.meaning: n.  原告
words.example: The plaintiff demanded compensation.  原告要求赔偿。

words.meaning: vt.  娱乐,招待,怀抱vi.  款待
words.example:
We hired a magician to entertain the children.  我们请了一位魔术师表演节目让孩子们开心。
Most children's television programmes aim to educate and entertain at the same time.  大多数儿童电视节目都旨在寓教于乐。UK verb
We entertain a lot of people, mainly business associates of my wife's.  我们经常在家请客，主要都是我妻子的业务伙伴。

words.meaning: a.  奇异的
words.example: a bizarre situation  异乎寻常的情形

words.meaning: adv. a.  在海外(的); 在国外(的)
words.example:
We need to open up overseas markets.  我们需要开拓海外市场。
There are a lot of overseas students in Cambridge.  剑桥有许多外国留学生。
My brother is a student overseas.  我哥哥在外国留学。

words.meaning: vt.  萞?挽回,弥补,回忆,补偿vi.  找回猎物n.  萞?恢复的希望,救险球v.
words.example:
We taught our dog to retrieve a ball.  我们教狗捡球。
Computers are used to store and retrieve information efficiently.  电脑用于快速高效地存储和检索资讯。

words.meaning: vt.  设计,发明,图谋,遗赠给n.  遗赠
words.example:
He's good at devising language games that you can play with students in class.  他善于设计可供师生在课堂上使用的语言游戏。
The cartoon characters Snoopy and Charlie Brown were devised by Charles M. Schultz.  卡通人物史诺比和查理‧布朗是由查尔斯设计的。

words.meaning: vt.  提名,任命,命名
words.example:
He's been nominated by the Green Party as their candidate in the next election.  他被绿党提名为下届选举的候选人。
Would you like to nominate anyone for/as director?  请您推荐一下经理的候选人，好吗？
The film was nominated for an Academy Award.  这部电影获得奥斯卡提名。UK verb transitive

words.meaning: adj. 怀疑的；多疑的
words.example: Reviewers were skeptical at first.  评审起初持怀疑态度。

words.meaning: vt.  抑制，阻止
words.example:
The Hungarian uprising in 1956 was suppressed by the Soviet Union.  1956年匈牙利起义受到苏联武力镇压的。verb transitive
She couldn't suppress her anger/annoyance/delight.  她无法抑制内心的愤怒／气恼／喜悦。
His feelings of resentment have been suppressed for years.  他的怨恨之情已经压抑多年。

words.meaning: n.  黄铜(器); 铜管乐器
words.example:
The door handles were made of brass.  门把手是黄铜做的。
The church has several beautiful medieval brasses.  这个教堂有几块精美的中世纪黄铜纪念牌。
The brass seems to me too loud in this recording.  我觉得这张唱片中铜管乐器部分似乎太响了。UK noun

words.meaning: vt.  紧固，使固定
words.example:
We dropped anchor (= lowered the anchor into the water) and stopped.  我们抛锚停船。
It was time to weigh anchor (= pull up the anchor and sail away).  该是起锚开船的时候了。UK noun countable
