She was my anchor when things were difficult for me.  我身处困境时，她就是我的精神支柱。

words.meaning: vt.  取出，提取; n.  提出物，汁
words.example:
They used to extract iron ore from this site.  他们曾经在这个地方开采铁矿。
The oil which is extracted from olives is used for cooking.  这种橄揽油是用于烹饪的。
The tooth was eventually extracted.  那只牙终于拔掉了。

words.meaning: a.  加强的,集中的n.  加强器
words.example: Intensive bombing had reduced the city to rubble.  密集轰炸曾把城市炸成一片瓦砾。

words.meaning: vt.  出卖,背叛,辜负,暴露
words.example:
He was accused of betraying his country during the war.  他被指控在战争期间背叛了祖国。
She felt betrayed by her mother's lack of support.  她觉得母亲背弃了她，因为母亲没有支持她。
For years they betrayed Britain's secrets to Russia.  他们持续多年向俄国出卖英国的机密情报。

words.meaning: n.  批评，评论
words.example: a Marxist critique of neo-liberal policy  以马克思主义观点评论新自由政策的文章

words.meaning: a.  美味的
words.example:
The delicious smell of freshly-made coffee came from the kitchen.  新煮好的咖啡的芳香从厨房里飘了出来。
This wine is delicious.  这种酒味道很好。
I've got some delicious gossip.  我听到了一些有趣的小道消息。

words.meaning: v.  繁殖; 复制
words.example:
His work was reproduced on posters, leaflets and magazines.  他的作品被翻印在海报、宣传页和杂志上。
They said the printing was too faint to reproduce well.  他们说这材料印得太模糊，无法复印清楚。
The new design unfortunately reproduced some of the problems of the earlier model.  很遗憾，新的设计中又出现了原来型号的一些问题。UK verb

words.meaning: (U)  (真诚的) 同情 (心) ,怜悯 [on,upon,for]
words.example: She treated the poor with compassion.  她同情地对待穷人。

words.meaning: a.  有益的
words.example: The improvement in sales figures had a beneficial effect /influence on the company as a whole.  销售额的上升使整间公司受益。

words.meaning: a.  笨拙的
words.example:
It's an awkward corner to drive round, so take it slowly.  这个转弯不好过，开慢一点。
Some of the questions were rather awkward.  有些问题是很难回答的。
It was an awkward ascent, but we reached the top eventually.  那段上坡路很难走，但最后我们还是爬到了山顶。

words.meaning: adj.  1 传说 (上) 的2 传奇性的ɔ  (指褒义或贬义上) 著名的 (C) 1 传
words.example:
He became editor of the legendary Irish journal 'The Bell'.  他当上了著名的爱尔兰杂志《钟》的编辑。
The British are legendary (= well known) for their incompetence with languages.  英国人语言能力欠佳是出了名的。UK adjective
Was King Arthur a real or a legendary character?  亚瑟王是确有其人还是一个传说中的人物？

words.meaning: n.  特许,让步,认可
words.example:
Both sides involved in the conflict made some concessions in yesterday's talks.  在昨天的谈判中，冲突双方都作出了让步。
He stated firmly that no concessions will be made to the strikers.  他强硬地宣称不会对罢工者作出任何让步。
The former president's concession came even before all the votes had been counted.  选票还没完全统计出来，前总统就承认落败了。

words.meaning: a.  真实的,可靠的,可信的
words.example: He was there and saw what happened, so his is the only authentic account.  他在现场，并看到了事情的经过，所以他的叙述是唯一可靠的说法。

words.meaning: n.  社论; a.  社论的
words.example:
All the papers deal with the same subject in their editorials.  所有的报纸都针对同一问题发表了社论。UK adjective
Editorial decisions are generally made by senior editors.  通常由资深编辑们来决定编务事宜。
It's plain reporting of the facts - there's not much editorial content (= opinion).  那只是纯粹的事实报道，没有多少评论内容。

words.meaning: a.  忠实的,详确的,可靠的n.  信徒
words.example:
They are faithful supporters of the Labour Party.  他们是工党的忠实拥护者。
His faithful old dog accompanied him everywhere he went.  无论去哪里，他那只忠诚的老狗总是陪伴左右。
Was your wife faithful during your marriage?  你的妻子婚后忠诚吗？

words.meaning: n.  常到的地方,生息地vt.  常到,出没于,萦绕于vi.  出没,作祟
words.example:
Fighting in Vietnam was an experience that would haunt him for the rest of his life.  越南战争的经历给他日后的生活留下了挥之不去的阴影。
Thirty years after the fire he is still haunted by images of death and destruction.  那场火灾过去30年之后，死亡和毁灭的场景仍在他脑海中挥之不去。UK verb transitive
This pub used to be one of your old haunts, didn't it Jim?  这个酒吧你以前经常去，对不对，吉姆？

words.meaning: a.  天然的,未成熟的,粗糙的,粗鲁的n.  天然的物质
words.example: a crude device/weapon  简陋的装置／粗制的武器adjective

words.meaning: a.  含糊的,不清楚的,茫然的
words.example:
The patient had complained of vague pains and backache.  患者自述说隐约感到疼痛和背酸。
Through the mist I could just make out a vague figure.  透过雾霭，我只能看到一个模糊的身影。
My aunt is incredibly vague - she can never remember where she's left things.  我的姨妈极其迷糊——她老是记不得自己把东西放在甚么地方。

words.meaning: vt.  唤起,引起
words.example: That smell always evokes memories of my old school.  那种气味经常唤起我对母校的回忆。

words.meaning: n.  完成，实现
words.example:
You'll be paid on completion of the project.  工程完工后给你发工资。
The road repair work is nearing completion (= almost finished).  道路维修工作已接近尾声。

words.meaning: n.  血管,静脉,情绪,性情,纹理vt.  使成脉络,象脉络般分布于
words.example:
In its bid to be elected, the party is attempting to tap (= use) an underlying vein of nationalism in the country.  该党正试图利用国内潜在的民族主义倾向来竞选上台。noun
The opening scene is very violent, and the rest of the film continues in (a) similar vein.  影片一开场就充满暴力，而其余部分也是类似风格。
After laughing over the photo, they began to talk in (a) more serious vein about the damaging effect it could have on his career.  他们笑过那张照片之后，开始认真谈论它可能会对他的事业造成的破坏性影响。

words.meaning: n.  疤痕; v.  (给…)留下伤痕
words.example:
That burn will leave a nasty scar.  烫伤会留下严重的伤疤。
His early years in the refugee camp left a deep psychological scar.  早年的难民营生活给他留下深深的心理创伤。
Every village bears the scars of war.  每一个村庄都布满了战争留下的疮痍。UK verb transitive often passive (-rr-)

words.meaning: v.  投降
words.example:
They would rather die than surrender (to the invaders).  他们宁死也不（向侵略者）投降。
The police demanded that the gang surrender their weapons.  警方要求那个团伙交出武器。
Neither side is willing to surrender any territory/any of their claims.  双方都不愿意在领土上作出任何让步／坚持各自对所有权的主张，谁也不愿放弃。UK noun countable or uncountable

words.meaning: v.  汹涌奔腾; n.  汹涌，澎湃; 猛涨
words.example:
An unexpected surge in electrical power caused the computer to crash.  突然出现的电压遽增导致电脑当机。
There has been a surge in house prices recently.  最近房价飞涨。
At the end of the game, there was a surge of fans onto the field.  比赛结束后，大群球迷涌向比赛场地。

words.meaning: vt.  检查,调查,监查vi.  检查
words.example: Inspect the goods before signing.  签字前验货。

words.meaning: n.  评论，注释
words.example:
The commentary on the Olympic games was much better on the other channel.  另一个频道对奥运比赛的实况报道好多了。
There's a good arts coverage in the newspaper, but not much political commentary.  报纸上有很多艺术方面的报道，可是政治时事评述却不多。

words.meaning: n.  悬架; 暂停
words.example:
The suspension of fighting is to take effect at 6 am on Monday.  停战协定于周一早上六点生效。
There have been calls for the drug's immediate suspension, following reports that it has dangerous side effects.  有报导指出，这种药物有危险的副作用后，人们呼吁立即停止使用该药。
The union is protesting about the suspension of a restaurant worker.  工会因一名饭店员工被停职而在进行着抗议。

words.meaning: vt.  赔偿，弥补
words.example:
Victims of the crash will be compensated for their injuries.  车祸的受害者会得到伤害赔偿。UK verb
Nothing will ever compensate for his lost childhood.  甚么也不能弥补他失去的童年。
His enthusiasm more than compensates for his lack of experience.  他的热情大大弥补了经验的不足。

words.meaning: n.  化石; a.  陈腐的; 化石的
words.example: The fossil shows early fish forms.  化石展示了早期鱼类形态。

words.meaning: vi.  徘徊
words.example: Inflation is hovering at 3%.  通货膨胀率在3%左右徘徊。

words.meaning: a.  可行的
words.example:
In order to make the company viable, it will unfortunately be necessary to reduce staffing levels.  很遗憾，为使公司继续运转下去，将不得不裁员。
There is a continuing debate about the age at which a human fetus can be considered viable.  关于人类胎儿在何时可被视为已有生命的问题仍处于争论中。

words.meaning: n.  光线,放射线,微量,光辉,闪烁vi.  射出光线,浮现,放射光线vt.  放射
words.example:
Light rays bend as they pass from air to water.  光线从空气射入水中会发生折射。noun
There's still a ray of hope that the missing child will be found alive.  失踪的孩子尚有一丝被活着找到的希望。noun
We love looking after our grandchild. He's a ray of sunshine!  我们喜欢照顾孙儿，他给我们带来了快乐！

words.meaning: n.  素描,草图,小品vt. vi. 描绘略图,写生
words.example:
My mother made a (pencil) sketch of my brother reading a book.  我母亲画了一张我弟弟在读书的（铅笔）素描。
The art students were told to sketch the landscape.  艺术专业的学生被告知要画一张实地风景素描。
When I have some spare time, I like to sketch.  有空闲的时候，我喜欢画素描。

words.meaning: vi.  澄清,阐明vt.  使明晰
words.example:
Could you clarify the first point please? I don't understand it completely.  请你把第一点再阐释一下，好吗？我一点也不明白。
The position of all shareholders will be clarified next month when we finalize our proposals.  下月我们将计划书定下后，所有股东的立场便清晰明确了。UK verb transitive

words.meaning: n.  闲谈vi.  闲谈,聊天
words.example: We chatted over coffee.  我们边喝咖啡边聊天。

words.meaning: a.  数不尽的,无数的
words.example:
There are countless arguments against this ridiculous proposal.  这项荒谬的提议招来无数批驳意见。
I've heard it played countless times on the radio.  这首歌我听电台播过无数次了。

words.meaning: n.  铜,警察
words.example: Rosie's hair shone copper (= reddish brown) in the sunlight.  罗茜的头发在阳光下闪着红褐色。

words.meaning: n.  瞳孔; 小学生
words.example:
The school has over 400 pupils.  这所学校有400多名小学生。
There is a very relaxed atmosphere between staff and pupils at the school.  这所学校师生之间的气氛很轻松。
Her school report described her as a very promising pupil.  她在成绩单中被描述成一个非常有前途的学生。

words.meaning: vi.  努力,奋斗,斗争
words.example: In her writing she strove for a balance between innovation and familiar prose forms.  她在写作中力图在创新和传统散文形式之间取得平衡。

words.meaning: n.  疏忽,忽略,怠慢vt.  疏忽,忽视,不顾
words.example:
He neglects that poor dog - he never takes him for walks or gives him any attention.  他对那只可怜的狗漠不关心——从不带它散步，也从不关心它。
I'm afraid I've rather neglected my studies this week.  恐怕这个星期我忽略了自己的功课。
I'd neglected to give him the name of the hotel where I'd be staying.  我忘记告诉他我住的宾馆的名字。

words.meaning: a.  中世纪的
words.example: a medieval building/painting/town  中世纪建筑／画作／城镇

words.meaning: n.  繁荣,幸运,成功
words.example: The war was followed by a long period of peace and prosperity.  战争过后是长时间的和平与繁荣。

words.meaning: n. [常pl.  ]抗生素; a.  抗生的
words.example:
I'm taking antibiotics for a throat infection.  因为喉咙发炎我正服用抗生素。
Some types of antibiotic are used to promote growth in farm animals.  某些种类的抗生素用于促进牲畜的生长。
He's on antibiotics for an ear infection.  他耳朵发炎，正服用抗生素。

words.meaning: vt. vi.  积聚,堆积
words.example:
As people accumulate more wealth, they tend to spend a greater proportion of their incomes.  人们积累了更多财富后，他们的花费占收入的比重也往往会增加。
The company said the debt was accumulated during its acquisition of nine individual businesses.  该公司称其在收购九家个体公司的过程中，债务越积越多。
We've accumulated so much rubbish over the years.  多年来我们已经堆积了这么多的垃圾。

words.meaning: vt.  进行,实行,起诉,告发,从事vi.  告发,起诉,作检察官
words.example:
Shoplifters will be prosecuted.  商店扒手将遭到起诉。
He was prosecuted for fraud.  他因诈骗而被起诉。
Any manufacturer who does not conform to the standards could be prosecuted under the Consumers Protection Act, 1987.  对任何不遵守标准的生产商都可依据1987年通过的《消费者保护法》予以起诉。

words.meaning: vt.  具体表达,使具体化
words.example:
She embodied good sportsmanship on the playing field.  在运动场上，她展现了优秀的体育精神。
Kennett embodied in one man an unusual range of science, music and religion.  肯尼特集科学、音乐、宗教等方面一系列非凡成就于一身。

words.meaning: n.  (小)地毯; 围毯
words.example: My dog loves lying on the rug in front of the fire.  我的狗喜欢趴在炉火前的小地毯上。

words.meaning: a.  单调的; 迟钝的
words.example:
She wrote dull, respectable articles for the local newspaper.  她为当地报纸写一些乏味的官样文章。
He's pleasant enough, but deadly dull (= very boring).  他很和善，但太乏味。adjective
We could just see a dull glow given off by the fire's last embers.  我们只能看见炉火的余烬发出的微弱的光。

words.meaning: vi.  插入,调停,干涉
words.example:
The Central Bank intervened in the currency markets today to try to stabilize the exchange rate.  中央银行今天对货币市场进行了干预，试图稳定汇率。
Two decades intervened between the completion of the design and the opening of the theatre.  从设计完成到剧场投入使用相隔20年。

words.meaning: n.  袭击,突袭,搜捕vt. vi.  奇袭,搜捕
words.example:
The commandos made/staged/carried out a daring raid (on the enemy).  突击队大胆（向敌人）发起了突袭。
Millions of dollars were stolen in a bank raid last night.  昨晚一间银行被劫走数百万美元。
The drugs were found during a police raid on the house.  这些毒品是在警方查抄这栋房子时发现的。verb transitive

words.meaning: v.  发光
words.example:
This substance is so radioactive that it glows in the dark.  这种物质辐射性很强，在黑暗中都可以发出亮光。
The children's faces were glowing with excitement.  孩子们兴奋得满脸通红。
They came back from their week by the sea, glowing with health.  他们在海边渡假一周，回来时个个都容光焕发。

words.meaning: n.  王冠; 顶，冠
words.example:
He plans to defend his Olympic crown.  他计划卫冕奥运会冠军。noun countable
Queen Elizabeth II was crowned (queen) (= made queen in a special ceremony) in 1953.  伊丽莎白女王二世于1953年加冕。
The church was crowned with golden domes.  教堂顶部是金色的穹顶。

words.meaning: n.  蟹
words.example:
We walked along the beach collecting small crabs.  我们沿着海滩走，一路捡拾小螃蟹。
All the shops on the seafront had crab for sale.  滨海区的所有商店都出售螃蟹。
This crab meat/salad is delicious!  这份蟹肉／蟹肉色沙拉味道好极了！noun countable or uncountable

words.meaning: n.  杰出人物,有价值的人,家伙a.  有价值的,可敬的,值得的,相称的
words.example:
He is unlikely to succeed in getting his bill through Congress, however worthy it is.  无论他的提案多么有价值，他也不可能使其在国会上通过。
Every year she makes a large donation to a worthy cause.  她每年都为一项高尚的事业捐一大笔钱。
Two points in this report are especially worthy of notice.  这份报告中有两点特别值得注意。

words.meaning: n.  氢
words.example: Hydrogen fuels the rocket.  氢气为火箭提供燃料。

words.meaning: n.  药物,治疗法,赔偿,补救,治疗vt.  治疗,补救,矫正,修缮,修补,改善
words.example:
The best remedy for grief is hard work.  排解忧伤的最好办法就是努力工作。
We have exhausted all possible legal remedies for this injustice.  为了纠正这一不公正的行为，我们已经采取了一切法律手段。verb transitive formal
This mistake must be remedied immediately.  这一错误必须立即予以纠正。

words.meaning: n.  打碎,粉碎,猛击,扣球,杀球,假硬币a.  非常的,了不起的vt.  打碎,粉
words.example:
Rioters ran through the city centre smashing windows and looting shops.  暴动者穿过市中心，砸碎商店橱窗，掠劫店铺里的东西。
She dropped her cup and watched it smash to pieces/to smithereens on the stone floor.  她失手摔落了杯子，看着它在石地板上摔得粉碎。verb
Several boats were smashed against the rocks during the storm.  暴风雨期间，几艘小船撞上了礁石。

words.meaning: a.  奇特的; 异样的
words.example:
Do you fancy a drink this evening?  你今晚想喝一杯吗？
He could tell she fancied him.  他看得出她喜欢他。
That Dave really fancies himself, doesn't he?  那个戴夫挺自命不凡的，是吧？verb

words.meaning: a.  命令的,托管的
words.example:
The minister is calling for mandatory prison sentences for people who assault police officers.  部长呼吁把袭警者须受的惩罚定为强制监禁。
Athletes must undergo a mandatory drugs test before competing in the championship.  运动员在参加锦标赛前必须接受强制性药检。
In 1991, the British government made it mandatory to wear rear seat belts in cars.  1991年，英国政府强制要求汽车后座乘客佩带安全带。

words.meaning: n. v.  跳水; 潜水
words.example:
Look at those children diving for oysters over there!  看那边那些潜水摸蚝的孩子们！
They ran to the pool, dived in , and swam to the other side.  他们跑到池边，一头栽进水里，然后游到池子的另一侧。
Mark dived off the bridge into the river.  马克从桥上跳进了河里。

words.meaning: n.  苏打; 碳酸水
words.example: Add soda to the batter.  面糊里加点苏打水。

words.meaning: v.  为…做广告，宣传
words.example:
We advertised our car (= published a description of it together with the price we wanted for it) in the local newspaper.  我们在当地报纸上登了广告出售我们的轿车。
He advertises his services on the company notice board.  他在公司的布告版上张贴广告来宣传其服务业务。
I'm going to advertise for (= put a notice in the newspaper, local shop, etc., asking for) someone to clean my house.  我打算登广告雇个人来做家庭清洁。

words.meaning: vt.  使晕倒,使惊吓,打晕n.  晕眩,猛击
words.example:
News of the disaster stunned people throughout the world.  灾难消息使全世界的人震惊。
She was stunned by the amount of support she received from well-wishers.  居然有这么多人送上祝福，他们的支持令她受宠若惊。 (-nn-)
Stunned by the impact, he lay on the ground wondering what had happened.  遭重击昏倒后，他躺在地上想弄清楚发生了甚么事。

words.meaning: a.  投入的,深爱的
words.example: Lucy is devoted to her cats.  露西对她的猫十分疼爱。

words.meaning: n.  产品,制造vt.  制造,假造vi.  制造
words.example:
He works for a company that manufactures car parts.  他在一家生产汽车零件的公司工作。
The report notes a rapid decline in manufactured goods.  报告指出工业产品数量迅速下滑。UK verb transitive
She insisted that every scandalous detail of the story had been manufactured.  她坚称报道中每一个骇人听闻的细节都是捏造出来的。UK noun uncountable

words.meaning: n.  爱,情感,影响,病
words.example:
He had a deep affection for his aunt.  他非常喜爱他的姑妈。
She felt no affection for the child.  她一点都不疼爱这个孩子。
The former president still holds a place in the nation's affections.  前总统仍深得全国人民的爱戴。

words.meaning: a.  成熟的; 深思熟虑的; v.  (使)成熟
words.example:
He's very mature for his age.  以他的年纪来说，他已非常成熟。
Upon mature reflection, we find the accused guilty.  经过慎重考虑，我们裁定被告有罪。UK adjective
Mature male gorillas have silver-grey hairs on their backs.  成年雄性大猩猩背部有银灰色毛发。

words.meaning: n.  一次所孵的卵(或蛋); v.  企图抓住，抓紧
words.example:
Silent and pale, she clutched (onto) her mother's hand.  她一声不吭，面色苍白，死死抓着母亲的手。
Clutching the money to his chest, he hurried to the bank.  他把钱紧紧捂在胸前，急急忙忙赶到了银行。
He collapsed, clutching his stomach.  他紧紧捂着肚子，倒了下去。verb intransitive or transitive

words.meaning: n.  崩溃,故障
words.example:
Both sides blamed each other for the breakdown of talks.  双方都指责对方导致了谈判的破裂。
We asked for a breakdown of the accident figures into day time and night time.  我们要白天和夜间事故的统计数字的分列明细表。
The rate of breakdown of muscle protein was assessed.  肌肉蛋白质的分类比率测定统计出来了。noun

words.meaning: vt.  隐藏,掩盖,掩蔽
words.example:
The listening device was concealed in a pen.  窃听装置藏在笔里。
It was said that the police concealed vital evidence.  据说警方隐瞒了关键的证据。
Is there something you're concealing from me?  你是不是有事瞒着我？

words.meaning: a.  有治疗功用的
words.example: The healing process takes weeks.  愈合过程需要几周。

words.meaning: n.  命运,定数
words.example:
The destiny of our nation depends on this vote!  我们国家的前途取决于这次选举！
She felt that her destiny had been shaped by her gender.  她觉得自己的性别已经决定了自己的命运。
People want to control/determine/take charge of their own destinies.  人们想要掌控自己的命运。

words.meaning: n.  漏洞,漏处,漏出,泄漏vi.  漏,泄漏vt.  使渗漏
words.example:
Water was leaking from the pipe.  水正从管子里漏出来。
Oil leaked out of the car.  油从车里漏了出来。
The tin was leaking.  罐漏了。

words.meaning: a.  单独的; n.  独奏(曲)
words.example:
He used to play with a group but now he's going solo/pursuing a solo career.  他以前曾经加入过某个乐队，但如今已单独发展。UK noun countable (plural solos)
Parker's solo on 'A Night in Tunisia' was so amazing that the pianist backing him simply stopped playing.  派克的独奏《突尼斯之夜》实在是太精彩了，以至于为他伴奏的钢琴手干脆停了下来。

words.meaning: n.  杀人,杀人者
words.example:
He was convicted of homicide.  他被判犯下谋杀罪。
The number of homicides in the city has risen sharply.  这个城市的杀人案件急剧增加。

words.meaning: n.  国会，议会
words.example:
On Tuesday the country's parliament voted to establish its own army.  该国议会于周二投票决定建立自己的军队。
She was elected to Parliament in 1997.  她于1997年获选为国会议员。

words.meaning: n.  兽群(尤指牛群)
words.example:
Poor Janine - she just follows the herd (= does what all the other people are doing).  可怜的雅尼娜——她只是在跟随主流。UK verb
The football fans complained that they had been herded into a small alley.  足球迷抱怨说他们被集中赶进了一条小巷里。

words.meaning: a.  热情的,热烈的,易怒的
words.example:
The Italians are said to be the most passionate people in Europe.  据说义大利人是欧洲最富激情的民族。
The child's mother made a passionate plea for help.  那孩子的母亲激动地向人们求助。
Joe is passionate about baseball (= he likes it very much).  乔非常喜欢打棒球。

words.meaning: n.  探针,调查,探测针vt.  用探针测,详细调查vi.  探索,调查
words.example:
The interviewer probed deep into her private life.  采访者深入打探她的私生活。
Detectives questioned him for hours, probing for any inconsistencies in his story.  侦探们盘问了他好几个小时，寻找他话里任何自相矛盾之处。
The article probes (= tries to describe and explain) the mysteries of nationalism in modern Europe.  这篇文章探索了现代欧洲民族主义的奥秘。

words.meaning: n.  原子,微粒,微量
words.example: figurative He hasn't an atom of sense (= He has no sense) , that boy.  那个孩子啊，一点头脑也没有。

words.meaning: n.  快餐，小吃
words.example:
Fresh or dried fruit makes an ideal snack.  新鲜水果或果干是理想的点心。
Many snack foods are high in salt, sugar and fat.  很多速食都是高盐、高糖、高脂肪。verb intransitive
I've been snacking all day.  我吃了一天的零食。

words.meaning: n.  补充，增补; vt.  补充，增补
words.example:
The doctor said she should be taking vitamin supplements.  医生说她应该服用维生素补充剂。
The money I get from teaching evening classes provides a supplement to my main income.  我晚上教课所赚的钱可以补充我的主要收入。
We paid a supplement (= an extra amount of money) so that we could have a cabin on board the ship.  我们多付了一些钱，这样我们在船上就可以有一个单独的小舱住。

words.meaning: n.  痛苦，不幸
words.example:
She claimed that the way she had been treated at work had caused her extreme emotional and psychological distress.  她说自己在工作中受到的待遇让她在情感和心理上都感到非常痛苦。
Many of the horses were showing signs of distress at the end of the race.  比赛接近尾声时，许多马匹都表现出非常痛苦的样子。
Six people were rescued by helicopter from a fishing boat in distress off the Cornish coast.  直升机从康沃尔郡海岸附近的一艘遇险渔船上救出了六个人。

words.meaning: n.  胜任; 能力
words.example:
Her competence as a teacher is unquestionable.  她的执教能力无可置疑。
He reached a reasonable level of competence in his English.  他的英语能力已达到了一定水准。    Opposite incompetence

words.meaning: n.  改编,适应,改编成的作品
words.example:
Evolution occurs as a result of adaptation to new environments.  进化是生物适应新环境的结果。
Last year he starred in the film adaptation of Bill Cronshaw's best-selling novel.  去年他主演了那部由比尔‧克朗肖的畅销小说改编的电影。

words.meaning: n.  保证,誓言,抵押vt.  保证,使发誓,举杯祝. . . 健康,典当,抵押
words.example:
Thousands of people made pledges (= promised to give money) to the Children in Need charity campaign.  数千人承诺捐款给救助儿童慈善运动。
What's this then, you're only drinking orange juice - have you signed the pledge or something?  这是怎么回事？你只喝柳橙汁——你是发过誓不再喝酒了，还是其他甚么原因？verb transitive
We are asking people to pledge their support for our campaign.  我们正请求人们承诺支持我们的运动。

words.meaning: n.  等级制度; 阶层
words.example:
Some monkeys have a very complex social hierarchy.  某些猴群有非常复杂的种群阶级。
He rose quickly through the political hierarchy to become party leader.  他的政治地位迅速提升，成了该党领袖。

words.meaning: vt.  传染,感染
words.example:
The ward was full of children infected with TB.  病房里住满了感染结核病的孩子。
All the tomato plants are infected with a virus.  所有的番茄植株都染上了一种病毒。verb transitive
Her optimism seemed to infect all those around her.  她的乐观情绪似乎感染了周围所有的人。verb transitive

words.meaning: ad. a.  向后地(的),相反地(的)
words.example:
When he was a child, his teachers thought he was backward (= unable to learn as much as most children).  小时候，老师认为他愚笨迟钝。
People still think of it as a backward country/region/area (= one without industry or modern machines).  人们仍然认为这是一个落后的国家／地区。UK adjective
She left without a backward glance.  她头也不回地离去了。

words.meaning: n.  胃口，食欲
words.example:
All that walking has given me an appetite.  走了那么远的路，我胃口大开。
The children all have healthy/good appetites (= they eat a lot).  孩子胃口都很好。
Both viruses cause fever and loss of appetite.  两种病毒都会引起发烧以及食欲不振。noun

words.meaning: a.  有同情心的,合意的,赞成的n.  交感神经,容易感受的人
words.example:
He suffers from back trouble too, so he was very sympathetic about my problem.  他自己也受背痛的困扰，所以对我的烦恼深表同情。
She just needed someone who would lend a sympathetic ear to her (= listen to her in a kind and understanding way) once in a while.  她只是需要一个人能不时以一种理解的态度听她倾诉。    Opposite unsympathetic
She comes across as a more sympathetic character in the film.  她在影片中扮演的角色很能引起观众的共鸣。UK adjective

words.meaning: n.  观众,目击者,旁观者
words.example: They won 4-0 in front of over 40 000 cheering spectators.  他们在四万多名观众的加油声中以四比零获胜。

words.meaning: vi.  流血,悲痛,渗出vt.  使出血,榨取
words.example:
Your arm is bleeding.  你的手臂在流血。
He was bleeding heavily.  他在大量失血。
The West is bleeding poorer countries dry through interest payments on their debts.  西方国家透过收取债务利息正在把穷国榨干。

words.meaning: n. 彗星
words.example: A comet appeared once every 76 years.  彗星每 76 年出现一次。

words.meaning: vt.  窒息,阻塞,噎,抑制vi.  窒息,阻塞,噎n.  窒息,噎,阻气门
words.example:
She choked to death on a fish bone.  她被鱼刺鲠住后窒息而死。
Children can choke on peanuts.  小孩子吃花生会噎住的。
Peanuts can choke a small child.  花生会噎住小孩。

words.meaning: n.  杀虫剂，农药
words.example: The pesticides that farmers spray on their crops kill pests but they can also damage people's health.  农民在作物上喷洒的农药在杀死害虫的同时也会危害人们的健康。    Compare herbicide ; insecticide

words.meaning: n.  代表vt.  委派. . . 为代表
words.example:
Delegates have voted in favour of the motion.  代表们对这项动议投了赞成票。
Each union elects several delegates to the annual conference.  每个工会选出数名代表参加年度大会。verb[ˈdel.ɪ.geɪt/
As a boss you have to delegate (responsibilities to your staff).  你作为老板必须要分派工作。

words.meaning: n.  战栗,颤抖vi.  战栗,忧虑,微动
words.example:
When he came out of the water, he was trembling with cold.  他从水里出来时，冷得直打哆嗦。
Her bottom lip trembled and tears welled up in her eyes.  她的下嘴唇颤抖，泪水也涌上眼眶。
His voice started to tremble and I thought he was going to cry.  他的声音开始颤抖，我以为他要哭了。verb intransitive

words.meaning: a.  谨慎的,小心的
words.example: He's a cautious driver.  他开车很小心。

words.meaning: n.  证(明)书
words.example: She has a Certificate in Drama Education.  她有戏剧教育资格证书。

words.meaning: vt.  指定,指明,称呼a.  选出而未上任的
words.example:
Traditionally, the president designates his or her successor.  按照传统，总统要选定其接班人。
Thompson has been designated (as/to be) team captain.  汤姆森被指定担任队长。
This area of the park has been specially designated for children.  公园的这个区域被指定为儿童活动区。

words.meaning: n.  宽恕; 仁慈
words.example:
She appealed to the judge to have mercy on her husband.  她请求法官宽恕她的丈夫。
The prisoners pleaded for mercy.  囚犯都恳求从轻发落。
The gunmen showed no mercy, killing innocent men and women.  那些枪手毫无怜悯之心，滥杀无辜的男男女女。

words.meaning: n.  礼拜,礼拜式,祭仪,一群信徒
words.example:
Their son ran away from home and joined a religious cult.  他们的儿子离家出走，加入了一个邪教组织。
The singer had a cult following in the 1970's.  这位歌手在20世纪70年代拥有一批狂热的追随者。

words.meaning: a.  敏锐的,激烈的,尖锐的,严重的
words.example:
She felt acute embarrassment/anxiety/concern at his behaviour.  她对他的行为感到极其尴尬／忧虑／担忧。
The problem of poverty is particularly acute in rural areas.  贫穷问题在农村地区尤为严重。

words.meaning: n.  憎恨,仇恨,憎恶
words.example:
What is very clear in these letters is Clark's passionate hatred of his father.  这些信非常清楚地表明了克拉克对他父亲的深切痛恨。
The motive for this shocking attack seems to be racial hatred.  看起来这件令人震惊的攻击事件的动机像是种族仇恨。

words.meaning: n.  直径
words.example:
The diameter measures twice the radius.  直径是半径的两倍。
The pond is six feet in diameter.  这个池塘的直径为六英尺。

words.meaning: n.  前辈; 前任，(被取代的)原有事物
words.example:
My predecessor worked in this job for twelve years.  我的前任做这份工作做了12年。
The latest Ferrari is not only faster than its predecessors but also more comfortable.  最新款的法拉利赛车不仅比旧款的更快，而且更舒适。

words.meaning: vt.  引诱,招致,感应
words.example:
They induced her to take the job by promising editorial freedom.  他们向她保证有编辑自由，以劝服她接受这项工作。
Nothing could induce me (= I definitely cannot be persuaded) to climb a mountain/ride a bike.  没有甚么能诱使我去爬山／骑脚踏车的。UK US  formal
Pills for seasickness often induce drowsiness.  晕船药经常会令人昏昏欲睡。

words.meaning: vt.  征募,参与,谋取vi.  从军,应募,赞助
words.example:
They both enlisted (in the navy) a year before the war broke out.  他们两个人都是在战争爆发前一年入伍（加入海军）的。verb
We've got to enlist some people to help prepare the food.  我们得请些人来帮忙做饭。
The organization has enlisted the support of many famous people in raising money to help homeless children.  这个组织募款帮助无家可归的儿童的活动已经得到了很多名人的支持。

words.meaning: n.  少年,少年读物a.  少年的,不成熟的,适于少年的
words.example: juvenile crime/offenders  青少年犯罪／少年罪犯

words.meaning: n.  停止,立定,休息vt.  使停止,使立定vi.  立定,停止,有缺点,踌躇,蹒
words.example:
Production has halted at all of the company's factories because of the pay dispute.  由于工资纠纷，这家公司所有工厂都停产了。
Security forces halted the demonstrators by blocking the road.  警卫部队用封路的办法来制止示威者前进。UK noun only singular
Severe flooding has brought trains to a halt (= prevented them from moving) on several lines in Scotland.  凶猛的洪水使苏格兰几条铁路线上的火车停驶。

words.meaning: a.  固执的,坚持的,持续的
words.example:
Symptoms of the illness include a high temperature and a persistent dry cough.  此疾病症状包括高烧和持久干咳。
There have been persistent rumours that the managing director might take early retirement.  不断有谣言说总经理可能会提早退休。
Be persistent - don't give up.  要坚持不懈——别放弃。

words.meaning: n. 有相互关系的东西,相关物vt.  使有相互关系vi.  互相有关系
words.example: Sleep correlates with memory.  睡眠与记忆力相关。

words.meaning: n.  放逐,流放,被放逐者vt.  放逐,流放,使背井离乡
words.example:
The king went into exile because of the political situation in his country.  迫于国内的政治局势，国王流亡国外。
The deposed leaders are currently in exile in the neighbouring country.  遭到罢免的那些领导人现在流亡邻国。
The monarch was exiled because of the coup.  由于发生了政变，国王被迫流亡。

words.meaning: n.  合唱队,齐声vt. vi.  齐声说道,合唱
words.example:
I'll sing the verses and I'd like you all to join in the chorus.  我唱独唱部分，我希望你们都加入合唱。
The choir will be performing the Hallelujah Chorus at the concert.  唱诗班将在音乐会上演唱《哈利路亚大合唱》。
They burst into a chorus of (= they sang the song) Happy Birthday.  他们突然开始齐唱“祝你生日快乐”。UK noun

words.meaning: n.  喷泉
words.example: The fountain sprays water high.  喷泉把水喷得很高。

words.meaning: vt.  使苏醒,使复兴,使振奋,回想起vi.  苏醒,复活,复兴,恢复精神
words.example:
My plants revived as soon as I gave them some water.  我给花浇了一些水，它们立即又生机盎然了。
Traditional skills are being revived.  传统手艺正在得到复兴。

words.meaning: a.  将要绝种的
words.example: The panda is an endangered species.  大熊猫是濒危物种。

words.meaning: a.  滑稽的，喜剧的
words.example: a comic actor/performance  滑稽演员／表演UK noun countable

words.meaning: vi.  住,居留,属于
words.example:
The family now resides in southern France.  这家人现居住在法国南部。 formal
The power to sack employees resides in the Board of Directors.  开除雇员的权力属于董事会。

words.meaning: a.  酸(味)的
words.example:
These plums are a bit sour.  这些李子有点酸。UK adjective
Overnight, it seemed, their relationship had turned sour.  一晚上的时间，他们的关系似乎变糟了。
She gave me a sour look.  她没好气地瞪了我一眼。UK adjective

words.meaning: vt.  开始,发明,发起vi.  发源,发生v.  发自
words.example:
Although the technology originated in the UK, it has been developed in the US.  尽管这项技术起源于英国，但它在美国得到了发展。
The game is thought to have originated among the native peoples of Alaska.  据认为，这项运动始于阿拉斯加的土著人。
Who originated the saying 'Small is beautiful'?  “小即美”这句话最早是谁说的？

words.meaning: n.  饵,诱惑vt.  引诱,诱惑
words.example:
She was lured into the job by the offer of a high salary.  她受高薪诱惑接受了那份工作。
He had lured his victim to a deserted house.  他将受害者引诱到一座废弃的房子。
Supermarket chains try to lure customers with price discounts.  连锁超级市场试图用折扣来吸引顾客。

words.meaning: vt.  编译,编辑,编纂,搜集n.  编译
words.example: We're compiling some facts and figures for a documentary on the subject.  我们正在为一部有关这个主题的纪录片汇集资料。verb transitive

words.meaning: vi.  爆发vt.  喷出
words.example:
Since the volcano last erupted, many houses have been built in a dangerous position on its slopes.  自从火山上次喷发后，很多房屋建在了火山山坡上的危险地带。verb intransitive
At the end of a hot summer, violence erupted in the inner cities.  一个炎热的夏末，在市中心贫民区突然爆发了暴力事件。
The crowd erupted in applause and cheering.  人群中爆发出掌声和欢呼声。

words.meaning: a.  形象的; 文字的，图解的
words.example: He insisted on describing his operation in graphic detail while we were eating lunch.  我们吃午饭的时候，他偏要绘声绘色地描述他动手术的情形。adjective

words.meaning: n.  著名人士,值得注意之事物a.  值得注意的,显著的,善理家的
words.example:
Getting both sides to agree was a notable achievement.  使双方达成共识是一项显著的成就。
This attractive building is particularly notable for its garden setting.  这幢漂亮的建筑因其花园布局而格外引人注目。UK noun countable literary
Other notables among his pupils were the kings of Saudi Arabia and Thailand.  他的学生中，另外两位显要人物是沙乌地阿拉伯国王和泰国国王。

words.meaning: a.  幸运的,幸福的
words.example: He was fortunate in his choice of assistant.  他很幸运，选择了一位好助手。

words.meaning: n.  熔炉,铁工厂vt.  打制,锻炼,伪造vi.  锻造,伪造
words.example:
The accident forged a close bond between the two families.  事故使两个家庭紧密地联系在了一起。
She forged a new career for herself as a singer.  她成了一名歌唱家，为自己开创了一番新事业。UK verb
Just 100 metres from the finishing line Jackson forged ahead.  离终点线还有100米时，杰克逊突然加速冲刺。

words.meaning: a.  分裂的,分散的vt.  使分裂,使瓦解
words.example: The meeting was disrupted by a group of protesters who shouted and threw fruit at the speaker.  一群抗议者一边呼喊一边向发言者投掷水果，让会议无法正常进行下去。

words.meaning: n.  商业,商务,贸易
words.example: the world of commerce and industry  工商界

words.meaning: n.  轻敲,拍击,责骂,无价值的东西vt.  轻敲,厉声说出,使着迷,抢走,叱责
words.example:
He always said he was jailed on a bum rap (= false accusation).  他总说自己坐牢是冤枉的。
The police caught him, but somehow he managed to beat the rap (= escape punishment).  员警抓住了他，但不知怎么他竟设法逃脱了罪责。
I'm not going to take the rap for you (= be punished for something you did).  我才不会替你去背黑锅。noun

words.meaning: n.  突破
words.example: Scientists are hoping for a breakthrough in the search for a cure for cancer.  科学家们希望在治愈癌症的研究上取得突破。

words.meaning: a.  专门的; 专业的
words.example:
Her job is very specialized (= involves only one limited area).  她的工作专业性很强。
The hospital is unable to provide the highly specialized care needed by very sick babies.  医院无法为重症婴儿提供非常专业化的护理。

words.meaning: a.  令人想要的
words.example:
Reducing class sizes in schools is a desirable aim.  大家希望减少学校的班别人数。
It's regarded as a highly desirable job.  那是一份很多人都很想得到的工作。
The house is in a very desirable area of the city.  那座房子坐落在城里一个很多人向往居住其中的区域。UK adjective

words.meaning: a.  瘦的,苗条的,无价值的,稀少的vi.  变苗条vt.  使苗条
words.example:
She's got a lovely slim figure.  她有一副迷人的苗条身材。
figurative They've only a slim chance of winning (= It's unlikely that they will win).  他们获胜的机会微乎其微。verb intransitive (-mm-)    UK
You haven't got much lunch - are you slimming?  你午饭吃得不多——在减肥吗？verb intransitive (-mm-)    UK

words.meaning: n.  剩余，残余; 遗骸
words.example:
The remains of lunch were still on the table.  吃剩的午饭仍在桌子上。
We visited the remains of a 12th-century monastery.  我们参观了一处12世纪修道院的遗迹。
Fifty years after he died, his remains were returned to his homeland.  他去世50年后，遗体被送回他的故乡。

words.meaning: vt.  宣称,申述,主张,断言
words.example: The witness alleged bribery.  证人指控行贿。

words.meaning: a.  警觉的,灵敏的,留心的n.  警报vt.  使警觉
words.example:
I'm not feeling very alert today - not enough sleep last night!  今天我感觉特别迟钝——昨晚没睡好！
Parents should be alert to sudden changes in children's behaviour.  父母应该对孩子行为的突然变化有所警觉。UK noun countable or uncountable
The army was put on (full) alert as the peace talks began to fail.  当和谈快要破裂的时候，军队进入（全面）戒备状态。

words.meaning: vt.  达到; 获得
words.example:
He has attained the highest grade in his music exams.  他在音乐考试中得了最高分。
We need to identify the best ways of attaining our objectives/goals.  我们需要确定达到目标的最佳方法。
India attained independence in 1947, after decades of struggle.  经过几十年的斗争，印度于1947年获得独立。

words.meaning: n.  恐龙
words.example: This typewriter's a bit of a dinosaur, isn't it?  这种打字机有点过时了，是吗？

words.meaning: n.  唱诗班，合唱队
words.example: He sings in the church choir.  他在教堂唱诗班唱歌。

words.meaning: a.  紧急的,急切的,催促的
words.example:
He's got to sign that paper - will you tell him it's urgent?  他务必要签署那份文件——请你告诉他这很紧急，好吗?
The most urgent thing in a fire is to make sure everyone is out of the building.  失火时最紧要的事是确保所有人都撤离大楼。
Many people are in urgent need of food and water.  很多人极需食物和水。UK adjective

words.meaning: n.  横幅
words.example:
The demonstrators walked along the street, waving banners and shouting angrily.  示威者沿着大街行进，一边挥舞着横布条，一边怒吼。
They won the election under the banner of lower taxes.  他们打着降低税收的口号，在选举中胜出。

words.meaning: vt.  限制,闭居,禁闭n.  边缘,范围,区域
words.example:
Let's confine our discussion to the matter in question, please!  请把讨论集中在正题上！
Please confine your use of the telephone to business calls.  请注意电话仅限于办公用途。
By closing the infected farms we're hoping to confine the disease to the north of the region (= stop it from spreading to other areas).  透过关闭受感染的农场，我们希望把疾病限制在该地区的北部。

words.meaning: n.  气味,名声,味
words.example: An odor of smoke filled the hall.  大厅里弥漫着烟味。

words.meaning: a.  冷酷的,残忍的,坚强的,讨厌的,可怕的
words.example:
The future looks grim.  未来一片渺茫。 (grimmer, grimmest)
Her face was grim as she told them the bad news.  她满脸愁容地把这个坏消息告诉了他们。
The expression on his face was one of grim determination.  他脸上一副破釜沉舟的神情。

words.meaning: n.  (线等的)股，缕; 线
words.example:
She tucked a loose strand of hair behind her ears.  她把一绺松下来的头发收到耳后。noun countable
There are so many different strands to the plot that it's quite hard to follow.  故事情节的头绪纷乱，很难搞清楚。noun countable

words.meaning: n.  管弦乐队,乐队演奏处
words.example: She's a cellist in the City of Birmingham Symphony Orchestra.  她是伯明罕交响乐团的大提琴手。UK noun

words.meaning: n.  干旱,缺乏
words.example: This year (a) severe drought has ruined the crops.  今年严重的旱灾把庄稼都给毁了。

words.meaning: n.  珠子，水珠
words.example:
She wore a necklace of brightly coloured wooden beads.  她戴着一串由色彩鲜艳的木珠串成的项炼。
Beads of sweat stood out on his forehead.  他额头上冒出了汗珠。

words.meaning: vt.  支撑,赞成,坚持,举起,鼓励
words.example:
As a police officer you are expected to uphold the law whether you agree with it or not.  作为员警，不管你赞成与否都应该维护法律。
Judge Davis upheld the county court's decision.  戴维斯法官维持了郡法院的判决。

words.meaning: (C) 1 注解者2[电视. 广播]时事评论家;  实况报导 [广播] 者
words.example: a sports/football commentator.  体育节目／足球评述员

words.meaning: n.  信徒
words.example:
She's been a believer since she survived a terrible car accident.  自从遇了一场可怕的事故后，她就成了一名宗教信徒。
Harvey's a great believer in health food.  哈威特别迷信健康食品。
I'm a great believer in allowing people to make their own mistakes.  我认为应该允许人犯错误的。

words.meaning: a.  危险的,冒险的,赌运气的
words.example: a hazardous journey/occupation  危险的旅行／职业

words.meaning: vt.  使合并,使消失,吞没vi.  合并,渐渐消失v.  合并
words.example:
They decided to merge the two companies into one.  他们决定将两家公司合并起来。
The country's two biggest banks are planning to merge.  这个国家最大的两家银行正计划合并。
After a while the narrow track merges with a wider path.  过了一会儿，窄道并入了一条较宽的小路。

words.meaning: n. 轴,箭杆,矛,杆状物vt.  装杆于,利用
words.example:
John came out with an unexpected shaft of wit/wisdom.  约翰出人意料地妙语如珠。UK noun countable
After years of loyal service, his boss gave him the shaft by firing him just before he would have qualified for a pension.  他忠实地工作了多年，当他就要获得领退休金的资格时，他的老板却无情地解雇了他。UK verb transitive informal
She was shafted by her agent over the film rights to her book.  她在书的电影版权问题上受到经纪人欺骗。

words.meaning: a.  方便的,合宜的
words.example:
Our local shop has very convenient opening hours.  我们当地的商店营业时间很合宜。
What time would it be convenient for me to come round?  我甚么时候方便过来呢？    Opposite inconvenient
Our new flat is very convenient for (= near to) the kids' school.  我们的新公寓离孩子们的学校很近。adjective

words.meaning: n.  盗窃,盗窃罪,赃物
words.example:
Unfortunately, we have had several thefts in the building recently.  很不幸，我们大厦最近发生了几宗盗窃案。
Shoplifting is theft.  偷拿商店的商品是偷窃。

words.meaning: n.  磨,碾,苦差,书呆子vt.  磨擦,磨碎,磨光,灌输,压榨,折磨vi.  磨,磨
words.example:
Shall I grind a little black pepper over your pizza?  要不要我磨一点黑胡椒粉给你撒在比萨饼上？
They grind the grain into flour (= make flour by crushing grain) between two large stones.  他们把谷粒放在两块大石头之间磨成粉。verb transitive (ground, ground)
She has a set of chef's knives which she grinds every week.  她有一套厨房用刀具，每个星期都把它们磨一次。

words.meaning: vt.  开处方; 规定; 指示
words.example:
The drug is often prescribed for ulcers.  这种药通常是开来治疗溃疡的。
Penalties for not paying taxes are prescribed by law.  法律上规定了不缴税的惩罚措施。

words.meaning: n.  地铁
words.example: We took the subway uptown to Yankee Stadium.  我们搭地铁到城外的洋基体育场去。

words.meaning: n.  流通,循环,发行量
words.example:
Police have warned that there are a lot of fake £50 notes in circulation.  警方提醒说有大量50英镑面额的假钞在流通。
Add her name to the circulation list for this report (= the people who will be given it to read).  把她的名字加进这份报告的传阅名单上。
figurative I hear she's out of circulation/back in circulation (= taking part/not taking part in social activities) after her accident.  我听说车祸后她不参加／又回来参加社交活动了。

words.meaning: v.  迁移; 移植; n.  移植
words.example:
The plants should be grown indoors until spring, when they can be transplanted outside.  这些植物应该先种在室内，到了春天就可以移栽到外面。
Doctors transplanted a monkey's heart into a two-year old child (= removed the child's faulty heart and put a monkey's heart in its place).  医生们给一个两岁的儿童移植了猴子的心脏。    Compare implantUK noun
He had a heart transplant (= Doctors gave him a different, healthier heart instead of his old one).  他接受过心脏移植。

words.meaning: n.  炸药,爆炸物a.  易爆发的,爆炸的,暴躁的
words.example:
Certain gases are highly explosive.  一些气体极易爆炸。
An explosive device (= a bomb) was found at one of London's busiest stations this morning.  今早在伦敦一个最繁忙的火车站发现一枚炸弹。
There was an explosive clap of thunder overhead.  突然一个轰隆声在头顶炸开。UK adjective

words.meaning: n.  国会议员,众议院议员
words.example: The congressman proposed a bill.  议员提出了一项议案。

words.meaning: vt.  穿透,渗透,看穿vi.  刺入,看穿,渗透
words.example:
Amazingly, the bullet did not penetrate his brain.  令人惊讶的是，子弹并未射入他的脑部。
In a normal winter, the frost penetrates deeply enough to kill off insect eggs in the soil.  在正常的冬季里，霜会深深渗入土壤，足以杀死昆虫的卵。
The organization had been penetrated by a spy.  一名间谍渗入了该组织。

words.meaning: vt.  照明,阐明,用灯装饰,使灿烂,说明vi.  照亮
words.example: The streets were illuminated with strings of coloured lights.  这些街道被一串串彩灯照亮了。

words.meaning: n.  缺点,裂纹,瑕疵,一阵狂风
words.example:
There's a fatal flaw in your reasoning.  你的推理有一处致命的缺陷。
This report is full of flaws.  这个报告充满错谬。

words.meaning: adj.  1 进化论的2 展开 [进展] 的;  演变 [演化] 的
words.example: The change has been evolutionary rather than revolutionary.  这种变革是渐进的，而不是革命性的。

words.meaning: n.  姿势,态度,情形,形势vt.  作. . . 的姿势vi.  作姿势
words.example:
She's got very good/bad posture.  她仪态优美／极不优美。
He always adopts/assumes (= moves into) the same posture for the cameras.  他在镜头前总是摆出同样的姿势。UK noun
For the third time this week the opposition has attacked the government's posture on defence.  本周反对派已是第三次攻击政府的国防政策了。

words.meaning: a.  系统的，体系的
words.example:
approving We've got to be a bit more systematic in the way that we approach this task.  我们应该更具条理地完成这项任务。
disapproving We're hearing reports of the systematic rape and torture of prisoners.  我们听到一些报道提及囚犯们受到蓄意强暴和折磨。

words.meaning: vt.  祈求,恳求,引起,援引,实行
words.example:
Police can invoke the law of trespass to regulate access to these places.  员警可以借助有关非法侵入的法律来约束人们进入这些地方。
Their sacred dance is performed to invoke ancient gods.  他们表演圣舞以祈求古代神灵保佑。

words.meaning: vt.  丢弃,抛弃,解雇vi.  垫牌n.  垫牌,抛弃
words.example: Discarded food containers and bottles littered the streets.  街上到处都是被丢弃的食品包装和瓶子。

words.meaning: n.  抑制，限制
words.example:
He showed admirable restraint, and refused to be provoked.  他表现出极大的克制，面对挑衅泰然处之。
The security forces exercised (= used) great restraint by not responding to hostile attacks and threats.  面对充满敌意的攻击和威胁，安全部队没有进行还击，表现出极大的克制。
Lack of space is the main restraint on the firm's expansion plans.  建筑空间的缺乏是阻碍这间公司实施其扩建计划的主要原因。

words.meaning: a.  有希望的,预期的,将来的
words.example: We've had three sets of prospective buyers looking round the house.  已经有三批可能买我们房子的人来看过房子了。

words.meaning: n.  复兴
words.example:
Recently, there has been some revival of (interest in)ancient music.  近来，在一定程度上，古代音乐又重新流行起来。
An economic/artistic revival is sweeping the country.  一股经济／艺术复兴的大潮正席卷全国。
We're staging a revival of a 1950s play.  我们将把一部20世纪50年代的戏剧重新搬上舞台。

words.meaning: v.  相符合; 相应
words.example:
The money I've saved corresponds roughly to the amount I need for my course.  我存的钱大致够我上学所需。
The American FBI corresponds to the British MI5.  美国的联邦调查局相当于英国的军情五处。
His story of what happened that night didn't correspond with the witness's version.  关于那天晚上发生的事情他的陈述和证人所说的不相符。UK verb intransitive

words.meaning: n.  石灰
words.example: Spread lime on the soil.  给土壤撒点石灰。

words.meaning: n.  随从,跟班,出席者a.  伴随的,出席的,注意的,在场的
words.example:
The Prince was followed by his attendants.  王子由其侍从陪同。adjective formal
There are too many risks attendant on such a large investment of money.  这样巨额的投资伴随太多的风险。

words.meaning: v.  履行; 符合
words.example: He fulfilled all the requirements.  他满足了所有要求。

words.meaning: a.  原子的; 原子能的
words.example: atomic structure/nuclei  原子结构／核

words.meaning: a.  可携带的,可搬运的,可移动的
words.example: a portable radio/telephone/computer  可携式收音机／行动电话／手提电脑

words.meaning: n.  峡谷
words.example: The canyon is two kilometers deep.  这峡谷有两公里深。

words.meaning: n.  诗,韵文,诗句vt.  用诗表达vi.  作诗
words.example:
Shakespeare wrote mostly in verse.  莎士比亚主要用韵文来写作。
Each verse was sung as a solo and then everyone joined in on the chorus.  每一节都以独唱形式演唱，然后所有人一同合唱。
She recited a verse from the Bible/the Koran.  她背诵了《圣经》／《可兰经》里的一节。

words.meaning: n.  潮湿，湿气
words.example: These plants need a rich soil which retains moisture.  这些植物需要一种能保持水分、养分充足的土壤。

words.meaning: a.  讽刺的
words.example: an ironic comment/reply  讽刺的评论／挖苦的回答

words.meaning: n.  产生连续声音的器具，拨浪鼓
words.example:
From across the town came the rattle of machine-gun fire.  从城镇的另一边传来机关枪开火的嗒嗒声。
The baby was waving around a plastic rattle.  婴儿正挥舞着一个塑胶拨浪鼓。
The creaking upstairs was starting to rattle me.  楼上发出的吱嘎声使我开始紧张不安起来。UK verb

words.meaning: a.  华丽的,灿烂的
words.example:
What a gorgeous room/dress/colour!  多漂亮的房间／连身裙／颜色啊！
The bride looked gorgeous.  新娘看上去太美丽了。
The weather was so gorgeous.  天气非常怡人。

words.meaning: n.  碎片,粉碎,落叶,乱七八糟的状态vt.  打碎,使散开,粉碎,破坏vi.  粉
words.example:
The glass shattered into a thousand tiny pieces.  玻璃碎成无数块细小的碎片。
His leg was shattered in the accident.  他在事故中腿骨碎裂。
The book shattered all her illusions about the Romans.  这本书让她对罗马人的幻想完全破灭。

words.meaning: n.  血统; 下降
words.example:
She's a woman of mixed/French descent.  她是一个混血／法裔女人。
They trace their line of descent back to a French duke.  他们的先人可以追溯到一位法国公爵。
He claims direct descent from Mohammed.  他自称是穆罕默德的直系后代。noun

words.meaning: n.  揶揄者,戏弄vt.  欺负,嘲弄,取笑,使起毛,梳理,强求
words.example:
It took me a while to tease the truth out of him.  我好不容易才从他嘴里套出真相。
While it was still wet, I gently teased out the tangled knots in Rosie's hair.  趁罗茜的头发还是湿的，我轻轻地用手指梳理开她打了结的头发。noun countable
Johnny, don't be such a tease - leave your sister alone!  强尼，别这样戏弄人——不要惹你妹妹！

words.meaning: n.  惊愕,惊恐vt.  吃惊,使惊愕vi.  惊起
words.example:
She was concentrating on her book and his voice startled her.  她正在聚精会神地看书，被他的声音吓了一跳。
The noise of the car startled the birds and the whole flock flew up into the air.  汽车声把一大群鸟惊吓得振翅飞了起来。
Her article on diet startled many people into changing their eating habits.  她那篇有关饮食的文章使很多人惶惶不安，开始改变饮食习惯。

words.meaning: n.  信条; 福音音乐
words.example: If Mary tells you something, you can take it as gospel.  玛丽告诉你的事，你可以绝对相信。UK noun

words.meaning: a.  硬的,坚硬的,刚性的,刻板的,精密的
words.example: disapproving We were disappointed that they insisted on such a rigid interpretation of the rules.  他们坚持对规则进行如此呆板僵化的解释，令我们非常失望。

words.meaning: n.  学期
words.example: the first/second semester  第一／第二学期

words.meaning: v.  (使)转动; (使)轮流
words.example:
Rotate the handle by 180° to open the door.  要想打开门，将把手旋转180度。
The wheel rotates around an axle.  轮子绕轮轴旋转。
The satellite slowly rotates as it circles the Earth.  人造卫星围绕地球旋转的同时也在缓慢自转。

words.meaning: a.  华丽的,高尚的,丰富的
words.example: They live in a magnificent Tudor house.  他们住在一座都铎时代的豪宅内。

words.meaning: vi.  刮，擦掉; n.  擦痕
words.example:
We'll have to scrape the snow off the car before we go out in it.  我们开车出去之前必须先扫除车上的积雪。
Emily scraped away the dead leaves to reveal the tiny shoot of a new plant.  艾蜜莉把枯叶扫去，使新苗的嫩芽露了出来。verb
Jackie fell over and scraped her knee (on the pavement).  杰基跌倒了，（在路面上）擦伤了膝盖。

words.meaning: a.  眼的，视力(觉)的; 光学的
words.example: an optical effect  视觉效果

words.meaning: n.  监督人,管理人,所长
words.example:
In the US, a school superintendent is in charge of the schools in a particular area.  在美国，教育局长主管一个地区的学校。
We asked the superintendent (also USinformalsuper)to fix the broken window in our apartment.  我们请管理员把我们公寓破碎的玻璃窗修一下。

words.meaning: v.  撞(破); n.  肿块
words.example:
She bumped into his tray, knocking the food onto his lap.  她碰着了他的盘子，把食物撞翻到了他的腿上。
We bumped along the track in our car holding on to our seats.  汽车沿着小路颠簸而行，我们紧紧抓牢座位坐好。verb
We bumped into Alison when we were in London last week.  我们上周在伦敦撞见了爱丽森。verb

words.meaning: n.  战利品; vi.  (on)捕食，掠夺
words.example:
Homeless young people are easy prey for drug-dealers and pimps.  无家可归的年轻人很容易成为毒品贩子和皮条客的猎物。noun uncountable
Small children are prey to all sorts of fears.  幼童深受各种恐惧的折磨。verb
The spider preys on small flies and other insects.  蜘蛛捕食小苍蝇和其他昆虫。

words.meaning: a.  独特的; 罕见的
words.example:
She has the most peculiar ideas.  她的想法非常古怪。
What a peculiar smell!  多么奇怪的气味！
It 's peculiar that they didn't tell us they were going away.  真奇怪，他们并没有告诉我们他们要离开。

words.meaning: n.  稽核,查帐vt.  稽核,旁听vi.  查账
words.example:
As a senior citizen, he is allowed to audit university classes.  作为一个老年人，他得到准许可以旁听大学的课程。UK noun countable
The company has an audit at the end of each financial year.  这间公司在每个财政年度的年末都要进行一次审计。

words.meaning: ad.  不断地,频繁地
words.example: The phone buzzed continually.  手机响个不停。

words.meaning: n.  调制解调器
words.example: Restart the modem to reconnect.  重启调制解调器以重新连接。

words.meaning: n.  申请者,请求者
words.example: How many applicants did you have for the job?  申请这份工作的有多少人？

words.meaning: vt.  使续期; 重建
words.example:
Every year I renew my membership of the sports club.  我每年都将体育俱乐部会员资格续期。
I'll use this material to renew the chair covers.  我要用这块布料做新的椅子罩来换掉旧的。UK verb transitive
The kidnappers renewed their threats.  绑架者又发出威胁了。

words.meaning: n.  养育,营养物,教育vt.  养育,给与营养物,教养
words.example:
She wants to stay at home and nurture her children.  她想留在家里照顾孩子。
As a record company director, his job is to nurture young talent.  作为唱片公司主管，他的职责是培养有才华的年轻人。UK verb transitive formal
Winifred nurtured ambitions for her daughter to be a surgeon.  威妮弗雷德一直盼望她女儿会成为外科医生。UK noun uncountable

words.meaning: a.  生动的,鲜明的,鲜艳的,清晰的,逼真的,活泼的
words.example:
He gave a very vivid and often shocking account/description of his time in prison.  他生动地讲述／描述了他的狱中生活，他说的常让人觉得很震惊。
He's one of those people with a very vivid imagination - every time he hears a noise he's convinced it's someone breaking in.  他是那种想像力异常丰富的人——每次听到声响都以为是有人闯进来了。
She was wearing a vivid pink shirt.  她穿着一件鲜艳的粉红色衬衫。

words.meaning: a.  狂怒的,激烈的,吵闹的
words.example:
He's furious about/at the way he's been treated.  他因自己受到这样的对待而大发雷霆。
We had a furious row last night.  我们昨晚吵了个天翻地覆。UK adjective
There is a furious struggle going on between the two presidential candidates.  两位总统竞选人之间进行着激烈的争斗。

words.meaning: n.  承租人,房客,不动产占有人,居住者vt.  租借
words.example: The tenant paid rent monthly.  房客按月付租。

words.meaning: vt.  省略,删除,疏忽,遗漏
words.example:
She was omitted from the list of contributors to the report.  这篇报道的撰稿人中漏掉了她的名字。
The Prince's tour conveniently omitted the most deprived areas of the city.  亲王的巡查为避开麻烦，没有去该市最贫困的地区。

words.meaning: n.  尸体
words.example: The forensic team examined the corpse.  法医检查了尸体。

words.meaning: n.  湿气a.  潮湿的vt.  使潮湿,阻尼,抑止vi.  变潮湿,衰减
words.example:
The grass is still damp.  草还有些潮湿。
This shirt still feels a bit damp.  这件衬衫摸上去还有点湿的。
It was a damp, misty morning.  那是一个潮湿而又雾气蒙蒙的早晨。verb

words.meaning: n.  营养; 营养学
words.example:
Good nutrition is essential if patients are to make a quick recovery.  病人如果要迅速康复，必须补足营养。
She's a professor of nutrition at Columbia University.  她是哥伦比亚大学的营养学教授。

words.meaning: n.  悦耳的旋律
words.example:
He played a few well-known melodies.  他演奏了几首很有名的乐曲。
His songs are always strong on melody.  他的歌曲一贯以旋律见长。

words.meaning: n.  电子
words.example: An electron carries a negative charge.  电子带负电荷。

words.meaning: vt.  培养,耕作
words.example:
Most of the land there is too poor to cultivate.  那里大部分土地太贫瘠，无法耕种。
The villagers cultivate mostly maize and beans.  村民们主要种植玉米和豆类。UK verb transitive
She has cultivated an image as a tough negotiator.  她将自己的形象塑造成一个强硬的谈判者。

words.meaning: n.  奢侈(品); a.  奢华的
words.example: to live in luxury  生活奢华

words.meaning: vt.  藐视,挑衅,使落空n.  挑战
words.example:
The fact that aircraft don't fall out of the sky always seems to me to defy (= act against) the law of gravity.  我总认为飞机没有从天上掉下来，是不符合万有引力定律的。
The chaos at the airport defies description.  机场里乱得一塌糊涂。

words.meaning: n. 碎片,残余物,些微,吵架,铁屑,片断vt.  扔弃,敲碎,拆毁vi.  互相殴打
words.example:
They're considering scrapping the tax and raising the money in other ways.  他们正在考虑废除这个税目，用其他方法募集款项。
We scrapped our plans for a trip to France.  我们取消了法国之行的计划。
Hundreds of nuclear weapons have been scrapped.  数百件核子武器已被销毁。verb (-pp-)

words.meaning: vt.  诱惑,引诱,冒. . . 风险,吸引
words.example:
The offer of a free car stereo tempted her into buying a new car.  免费赠送汽车音响让她禁不住诱惑买了一辆新车。
You're tempting fate by riding your bike without wearing a cycle helmet.  你不戴头盔骑自行车简直是在玩命。

words.meaning: n.  宣言
words.example:
Members of Parliament must make a declaration of their business interests.  议员们必须将自己的商业股权公诸于众。
As witnesses to the accident, we were asked to make written declarations of what we had seen.  作为事故的目击者，我们被要求以书面形式陈述看到的一切。
The company made a declaration of intent to follow an equal opportunities policy.  公司宣称愿意遵守平等机会原则。noun countable

words.meaning: n.  轴
words.example:
The Earth revolves about the axis which joins the North and South Poles.  地球围绕贯穿南北两极的地轴自转。
The diameter of a circle is also an axis.  一个圆的直径也是一条轴线。
Plot distance on the vertical Y-axis against time on the horizontal X-axis.  用纵坐标Y轴表示距离，用横坐标X轴表示时间。

words.meaning: n.  研究会，学术团体; 专门院校
words.example: a military/police academy  军事／员警学院

words.meaning: vt.  注射,注入,注满
words.example: Phil's a diabetic and has to inject himself with insulin every day.  菲尔患有糖尿病，每天都要替自己注射胰岛素。verb transitive

words.meaning: vt.  在. . . 之前,优于,较. . . 优先vi.  在前面
words.example:
Boutros Boutros-Ghali preceded Kofi Annan as the Secretary-General of the UN.  布特罗斯•布特罗斯－加利在科菲•安南之前担任联合国秘书长。
It would be helpful if you were to precede the report with an introduction.  你帮这份报告加上一段引言会更好些。

words.meaning: a.  双重的,双的n.  双数
words.example:
This room has a dual purpose , serving as both a study and a dining room.  这个房间有两个用途，既作书房又当饭厅。
She has dual British and American nationality.  她有英美双重国籍。

words.meaning: vt.  监督; 指导
words.example:
The UN is supervising the distribution of aid by local agencies in the disaster area.  联合国正在监督灾区地方机构救援物资的发放。
The children play while two teachers supervise (= make certain that they behave correctly and are safe).  孩子们在两位教师的监管下玩耍。

words.meaning: n.  盾,防卫物vt.  保护,遮蔽,避开,挡开,庇护vi.  起保护作用
words.example:
The police held up their riot shields against the flying rocks and bricks.  员警举着防暴盾牌阻挡飞来的石头和砖块。
The anti-personnel mines were laid as a protective shield around the town.  城镇周围布设了杀伤性地雷作为保护屏障。
Anger can function as a shield against (= a way of avoiding) even more painful emotions of loss and hurt.  愤怒可以起到这样的作用：避免更加痛苦的失落感和受伤害情绪。

words.meaning: n.  三角形,三人一组,三角关系
words.example: Which earrings did you buy in the end - the triangles or the circles?  最后你买了甚么样的耳环——三角形的还是圆的？

words.meaning: n.  热望,渴望
words.example:
I've never had any political aspirations.  我从来就没甚么政治抱负。
It's a story about the lives and aspirations of poor Irish immigrants.  这个故事讲述了穷苦的爱尔兰移民的生活与抱负。

words.meaning: n.  手提箱，衣箱
words.example: Have you packed/unpacked your suitcase yet?  你把衣物都放进手提箱了吗／从手提箱里拿出来了吗?

words.meaning: adj.  倾斜的
words.example:
Tom is inclined to be lazy.  汤姆喜欢偷懒。
No one seemed inclined to help.  似乎没有人愿意帮忙。
She's very bright, but she's not academically inclined.  她很聪明，但她在学术方面没有天赋。

words.meaning: n.  钙
words.example: Calcium strengthens bones.  钙强健骨骼。

words.meaning: n.  代替者，代替品; vt.  代替
words.example:
You can substitute oil for butter in this recipe.  这道菜中你可以用食用油代替牛油。
Dayton was substituted for Williams in the second half of the match.  下半场比赛戴顿上场取代了威廉斯。
Gas-fired power stations will substitute for less efficient coal-fired equipment.  以煤气为燃料的发电站将会代替效率较低的燃煤装置。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.  沙砾，砾石
words.example: a gravel path  石子路

words.meaning: n.  民族主义
words.example: The book documents the rise of the political right with its accompanying strands of nationalism and racism.  这本书记载了政治权利的提高，以及随之而来的民族主义和种族主义倾向。

words.meaning: n.  纺织品,织物a.  织的,可织的
words.example: the textile industry  纺织业

words.meaning: a.  永恒的,永远的,不灭的
words.example:
The company is engaged in the eternal search for a product that will lead the market.  该公司一直在进行长期的研究，以开发出可以引领市场的产品。
Will you two never stop your eternal arguing!  你们两个吵个没完没了，就不能停一停吗！UK adjective

words.meaning: n.  起诉,控告,起诉状
words.example:
This seems to me to be a damning indictment of education policy.  我觉得这似乎应看作是对教育政策的一种深刻谴责。
The charges on the indictment include murder and attempted murder.  起诉书上的指控包括谋杀罪及企图谋杀罪。

words.meaning: vt.  (文语)1 围绕,包围2 包含,含有ɔ 造成 <坏的结果等>
words.example: The festival is to encompass everything from music, theatre and ballet to literature, cinema and the visual arts.  本届文化节将涵盖从音乐、戏剧、芭蕾到文学、电影、视觉艺术等各种艺术形式。

words.meaning: vt.  查证,证实,检验v.  校验,检验
words.example:
Are you able to verify your account/allegation/report/theory?  你能证明你的陈述／指控／报告／理论吗？
These figures are surprisingly high and they'll have to be verified.  这些数字高得令人吃惊，必须加以查证。

words.meaning: n.  小溪,小湾
words.example: If any more people resign, we'll be really up the creek.  如果再有更多的人辞职，我们真的就麻烦了。

words.meaning: (U) 1 外交;  外交手腕2 交际手段,策略 (tact)
words.example:
Diplomacy has so far failed to bring an end to the fighting.  外交活动迄今未能结束那场战事。
It took all her tact and diplomacy to persuade him not to resign.  她使出所有计谋和手腕劝说他不要辞职。

words.meaning: n.  香料，调味品
words.example:
Cinnamon, ginger and cloves are all spices.  肉桂、姜和丁香都属于香料。
Spices are widely used in South Asian cooking.  印度菜中广泛使用各种调味香料。noun
He'd spiced up his speech with a few rude jokes.  他讲了几个粗俗的笑话，让自己的讲话显得更有趣一点。

words.meaning: n.  垫子; 草席
words.example:
Wipe your feet on the mat before you come inside.  你进来前先在地垫上擦擦脚。
Please remember to bring a mat and a towel with you to the next aerobics class.  下次上有氧健身课时请记得带垫子和毛巾。noun countable
The top few buttons on his shirt were open, revealing a mat of dark hair on his chest.  他衬衫最上面的几颗钮扣没扣上，露出一片黑色的胸毛。

words.meaning: a.  极广大的,无边的,非常好的
words.example:
They spent an immense amount of time getting the engine into perfect condition.  他们花了大量时间使引擎运转完美。
He's an immense goalkeeper.  他是一名非常出色的守门员。

words.meaning: n.  (pl.  millennia)一千年，千禧年
words.example:
The corpse had lain preserved in the soil for almost two millennia.  那具尸体在地下保存了近两千年。
How did you celebrate the Millennium?  你们是怎么庆祝千禧年的？    Compare century

words.meaning: n.  喘气vi.  喘气,喘息,渴望vt.  气喘吁吁地说
words.example:
When she saw the money hidden in the box she gasped in surprise.  她看到藏在盒子里的钱时，惊得倒吸了一口气。
I'm absolutely gasping for a cigarette.  我真想抽支烟。UK noun countable
He gave a gasp of amazement.  他惊讶得倒吸了一口气。

words.meaning: n.  外壳,坚硬的外壳,面包皮vt.  盖以硬皮vi.  结硬皮
words.example: Could you cut the crusts off the sandwiches, please?  请把三明治的面包皮切掉，好吗？

words.meaning: a.  无用的,无效的,无益的
words.example:
Without fuel, the vehicles will become useless for moving supplies.  没有燃料，车辆就无法运送物资。
She's very good at methodical work, but useless when there's a lot of pressure.  她很善于做条理性强的工作，但要是压力太大她就做不来了。
informal You're absolutely useless (= not able to act effectively) - can't you even go to the shops without getting lost!  你真没用——连去商店买东西都会迷路！

words.meaning: n.  再现,复制,复制品,繁殖,生殖
words.example:
We are researching reproduction in elephants/ the reproduction of elephants.  我们正在研究大象的繁殖问题。noun
The book contains excellent colour reproductions of Monet's paintings.  这本书有莫内作品的精美彩色翻版插图。
This system has excellent sound reproduction.  这套系统的声音效果极佳。

words.meaning: a.  无意识的
words.example: She was hit on the head by a stone and knocked unconscious.  一块石头击中了她的头部，使她昏了过去。

words.meaning: n.  蚊子
words.example: Some types of the anopheles mosquito transmit malaria to humans.  某些种类的按蚊能将疟疾传染给人类。

words.meaning: n.  亲密,熟悉,亲昵行为
words.example:
Intimacy between teachers and students is not recommended.  不提倡师生之间关系过于密切。
It was obvious from their witty intimacies that they had been good friends for many years.  从他们风趣的亲昵言行很容易看出，他们已是多年的好友。

words.meaning: vt.  转移; 使娱乐
words.example:
Traffic will be diverted through the side streets while the main road is resurfaced.  这条主干道重铺路面时，车辆行人将被分流到小路通行。
Our flight had to be diverted to Stansted because of the storm.  由于暴风雨，我们的班机被迫改在斯坦斯特德机场降落。
Should more funds/money/resources be diverted from roads into railways?  是否应该将更多的资金／资源从公路转投到铁路上？UK verb transitive

words.meaning: a.  被动的，消极的
words.example:
He's very passive in the relationship.  他在这段关系中非常被动。
Men have always played an active part in leading worship while women have been confined to more passive roles.  男性在宗教崇拜方面一直起着主导作用，而女性则一直被局限于较被动的角色。
'He was released from prison' is a passive sentence.  He was released from prison 是个被动句。noun only singular specialized

words.meaning: n.  暴行,侮辱,愤怒vt.  凌辱,虐待,触犯
words.example:
These murders have provoked outrage across the country.  这些谋杀事件激起了全国公众的愤慨。
Many politicians and members of the public expressed outrage at the verdict.  许多政治家和公众人物表达了对这判决的愤慨。
The bomb, which killed 15 people, was the worst of a series of terrorist outrages.  炸弹炸死了15人，这是恐怖主义者一系列暴行中最严重的一次。

words.meaning: vt.  召唤,召集,号召,鼓起,唤起
words.example:
General Rattigan summoned reinforcements to help resist the attack.  拉蒂根将军命令增援部队协助抵挡进攻。
humorous I'm afraid I'll have to go - I'm being summoned by my wife.  恐怕我得走了——我妻子命令我回去。
On July 20th, the council was summoned to hear an emergency report on its finances.  7月20日，理事会被临时召集听取有关财务问题的紧急报告。verb transitive

words.meaning: n.  附着,附属物,爱慕
words.example:
This food processor has a special attachment for grinding coffee.  这个食品加工器附有一个专门用来研磨咖啡的装置。noun
I'll email my report to you as an attachment.  我将把我的报告作为附件电邮给你。
At university I formed a strong attachment to one of my tutors.  上大学时，我和一位导师建立了很深厚的感情。

words.meaning: n.  种类,品种vt. vi.  养育,引起,饲养,繁殖
words.example:
Terriers are bred for their fighting instincts.  交配繁殖梗狗是为了保持它们好斗的本性。
His main income comes from breeding cattle.  他的主要收入来自养牛。
The blackbird, like most birds, breeds in the spring.  画眉和大多数鸟一样是在春天繁殖。verb (bred, bred)

words.meaning: n.  港口,避难所,安息所vt.  安置. . . 于港中,庇护,入港
words.example:
The garden was a haven from the noise and bustle of the city.  这个花园是块远离喧嚣都市的静地。
They wanted to provide safe havens for the refugees.  他们想为难民们提供安全的避难场所。

words.meaning: vi.  摇晃地悬挂着, 追求 vt. 使摇晃地悬挂 n. 悬垂
words.example:
Loose electric wires were dangling from the wall.  松散的电线从墙上垂下来。
He dangled the puppet in front of the children.  他在孩子们面前玩木偶。
I've tried dangling all sorts of offers before him/ in front of him to get him to work harder at school, but nothing works.  为了让他学习用心点，我曾试过种种承诺，可是根本不起任何作用。

words.meaning: n.  性情古怪的人,急拉,肌肉抽搐,牛肉干vi.  痉挛,急拉,急推vt.  猛拉
words.example:
The car made a strange noise and then jerked to a halt.  汽车发出一声怪响，接着就猛然停住了。
"What's wrong?" she asked, jerking her head up.  “怎么了？”她猛地抬头问道。
The shock of losing his job jerked him out of his settled lifestyle.  失业的打击一下子改变了他安定的生活方式。UK verb intransitive or transitive [usually + adv/prep]

words.meaning: n.  二氧化物
words.example: carbon/sulphur dioxide  二氧化碳／硫

words.meaning: vt. vi.  断言,确认,肯定
words.example:
She affirmed her intention to apply for the post.  她承认自己有意应征这个职位。
The government has affirmed its commitment to equal rights.  政府声明了其致力于权利平等的承诺。

words.meaning: n.  跨度; 一段时间; vt.  跨越
words.example:
He has a short attention / concentration span.  他的注意力持续时间很短。
Over a span of just three years, the new government has transformed the country's economic prospects.  仅仅三年的时间，新政府已经使该国的经济前景出现改观。
The bridge crosses the river in a single span.  河上的桥是单孔桥。verb

words.meaning: vt. vi.  拍手喝彩,称赞,赞同
words.example:
You should have heard the audience applaud - the noise was fantastic.  你真应该听听观众的掌声——那才叫掌声雷动。
She was applauded for a full five minutes after her speech.  她演讲结束后，掌声持续了整整五分钟。UK verb
We applaud the family's decision to remain silent over the issue.  我们非常赞赏这一家人对此事保持沉默的决定。

words.meaning: vi.  徘徊
words.example:
After the play had finished, we lingered for a while in the bar hoping to catch sight of the actors.  戏演完后我们在酒吧里等了一会儿，希望能与演员见上一面。
The smell from the fire still lingered days later.  大火过后好几天还能闻到烧焦的味道。
It's impossible to forget such horrific events - they linger (on) in the memory forever.  这样恐怖的事件让人难以忘记——它们会永远留在人们的记忆中。

words.meaning: n.  立方体，立方
words.example: Cut the cheese into small cubes.  将起司切成小方块。noun countable

words.meaning: prep.  在…下面; ad.  在下面
words.example:
The tunnel goes right underneath the city.  隧道正好位于城下。
They found a bomb underneath the car.  他们在车底下发现了一枚炸弹。
Underneath that shy exterior, she's actually a very warm person.  在羞涩的外表下，她其实是个非常热心的女孩。

words.meaning: a.  暗淡的,模糊的vt.  使暗淡
words.example:
The lamp gave out a dim light.  那盏灯发出暗淡的光芒。
He sat in a dim corner of the waiting-room.  他坐在候车室一个昏暗的角落里。
We could see a dim (= not easily seen) shape in the fog.  在雾中我们可以看见一个模模糊糊的影子。

words.meaning: n.  日落
words.example:
The fishermen set out at sunset for a night's fishing.  渔夫们日落时分出海，准备夜间捕鱼。
We sat on the beach watching a spectacular sunset.  我们坐在海滩上观看壮丽的晚霞。noun
At the end of the film, the pair of them ride off into the sunset.  在电影的结尾，他们俩过上了幸福的新生活。

words.meaning: a.  面部的
words.example: Beauty treatments range from an eyelash tint at £8 to a deep cleansing facial costing £58.  美容护理服务价格不一，包括收费8英镑的染睫毛和收费58英镑的面部深层清洁。

words.meaning: vt.  假定,推测,擅自,意味着vi.  擅自行动,相信
words.example:
In British law, you are presumed innocent until you are proved guilty.  按照英国法律，你在证明有罪之前，一律假定是无辜的。
He presumes on (= takes unfair advantage of) her good nature.  他利用了她的善良本性。

words.meaning: n.  X射线，X光
words.example:
The X-ray showed a slight irregularity in one lung.  X光照片显示有一叶肺有点不正常。
She had an X-ray to see if any of her ribs were broken.  她作了X光检查，以确定肋骨是否骨折。

words.meaning: n.  过度,剩于,超过,超额a.  过度的,额外的
words.example:
An excess of enthusiasm is not always a good thing.  过分热情不见得总是件好事。
They both eat to excess (= too much).  他们两个都吃得太多了。
There will be an increase in tax for those earning in excess of (= more than) twice the national average wage.  对于那些收入超过全国平均薪资一倍以上的人，税收额将要增加。

words.meaning: n.  要素，组分; 选民
words.example:
What are the basic constituents of the mixture?  这种混合物的基本成分是甚么？noun countable
The senator worked hard, always talking to his constituents and hearing their problems.  这位参议员工作卖力，总是跟本区选民交谈，听取他们的难处。

words.meaning: n.  支持者; 倡导者
words.example: He is one of the leading proponents of capital punishment.  他是死刑的主要支持者之一。    Compare opponent

words.meaning: n.  古董,古物a.  旧式的,过时的
words.example:
You can't give away Granny's old bookcase - it's a valuable antique.  你不能把奶奶的旧书柜送人，那可是件值钱的古董啊。
My mother collects antiques.  我母亲收藏古玩。adjective

words.meaning: vt.  磨光; n.  上光剂
words.example:
Polish your shoes regularly to protect the leather.  定期擦拭你的鞋以保护皮革。UK verb transitive
He polished off the whole pie.  他风卷残云般地吃掉了一整块馅饼。
Arsenal polished off Chelsea 5-0 in Saturday's match.  阿森纳队在周六的比赛中以5：0干净俐落地击败了切尔西队。UK verb transitive

words.meaning: a.  彻底的，广泛的
words.example:
It is obvious that sweeping changes are needed in the legal system.  显然，法制体系需要进行大刀阔斧的改革。
We need to make sweeping cuts to our budget.  我们必须大幅削减预算。
Sweeping generalizations about this complex and difficult situation are not helpful.  对这种复杂困难的情形作泛泛之谈是没有用的。adjective [before noun]

words.meaning: n.  牛奶场; 奶制品
words.example: dairy cattle  奶牛

words.meaning: n.  交点; 十字路口
words.example:
The intersection of the lines on the graph marks the point where we start to make a profit.  图上几条线的交点就是我们开始赚取盈利的地方。UK noun
Turn right at the next intersection.  在下个十字路口向右转。

words.meaning: (U)  [又作 a ~] 和解;  调停;  和谐,一致 [with,between]
words.example: It took hours of negotiations to bring about a reconciliation between the two sides.  双方谈了好几个小时才达成和解。

words.meaning: a.  悲惨的,穷困的,不幸的
words.example:
She's miserable living on her own.  她独自生活，非常可怜。
What a miserable existence! How could anyone live in such dreadful conditions.  多么痛苦的生活！一个人怎么能在这么糟糕的条件下过活。UK adjective
informal She only offered me a miserable £20 for my old computer.  她只出少得可怜的20英镑买我的旧电脑。

words.meaning: n. [总称]机器，机械; 机构
words.example: His hand was injured when he got it caught in the machinery.  他的手卷到机器里受伤了。UK noun uncountable

words.meaning: n.  学会,学院,协会vt.  创立,开始,制定,任命
words.example: She is threatening to institute legal proceedings against the hospital.  她威胁说要对该医院提出诉讼。

words.meaning: vt.  抹去,擦掉
words.example:
It's in pencil so you can just erase anything that's wrong.  这是用铅笔写的，这样你就可以把任何错误的地方擦掉。UK verb transitive
Tiger Woods is determined to erase the memory of a disappointing Cup debut two years ago.  老虎·伍兹决心要把两年前初次参加高球赛时令人失望的表现永远忘掉。
Taylor wants a convincing victory to erase doubts about his team's ability to reach the World Cup finals.  泰勒想要透过大比数获胜来消除人们对他的球队能否打入世界杯决赛的疑虑。

words.meaning: a.  不恰当的,无关系的,不相干的
words.example:
These documents are largely irrelevant to the present investigation.  这些档与目前的调查几乎毫不相干。
Making a large profit is irrelevant to us - the important thing is to make the book available to the largest possible audience.  赚取巨额利润对我们来说并不重要，重要的是要让尽可能多的读者读到这本书。

words.meaning: a.  末端的; n.  终点站
words.example:
She has terminal cancer.  她患有末期癌症。
He has nothing to do all day and is suffering from terminal boredom.  他终日无所事事，极其无聊。
She claims that the shipbuilding industry is in terminal decline.  她声称造船业已经衰败到极点。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.  港口; v.  藏有
words.example: The harbor is frozen in winter.  冬天港口结冰。

words.meaning: n.  无知,不知
words.example:
Public ignorance about the disease is still a cause for concern.  公众对这个疾病的无知仍是一个令人担忧的问题。
Patients, it is claimed, were kept/left in ignorance of what was wrong with them.  据称，病人被蒙在鼓里，对于自己得了甚么病还毫不知情。UK noun uncountable

words.meaning: n.  业余技艺家,爱好者
words.example:
He was an amateur singer until the age of 40, when he turned professional.  40岁之前他一直是个业余歌手，之后才转为职业歌手。    Compare professional
This tennis tournament is open to both amateurs and professionals.  这次网球锦标赛业余运动员和职业运动员都可以参加。    Compare professional    disapproving

words.meaning: a.  能干的,胜任的,有权能的,足够的
words.example: a competent secretary/horse-rider/cook  能干的秘书／骑手／厨师

words.meaning: a.  线的，直线的; 线性的
words.example:
These mental exercises are designed to break linear thinking habits and encourage the creativity that is needed for innovation.  设计这些思维训练旨在打破线性思维习惯，激发革新所需的创造思维。
Is there a linear relationship between salaries and productivity?  薪水和生产效率有直接关系吗？

words.meaning: n.  原始人,早期艺术家a.  原始的,上古的,旧式的
words.example:
Primitive races colonized these islands 2000 years ago.  原始种族2000年前开拓了这些岛屿。
The spiny anteater is a mammal, although a very primitive one.  针鼹属于哺乳动物，尽管是非常原始的一种。
Early settlers had to cope with very primitive living conditions.  早期殖民者不得不克服非常原始的生存条件。

words.meaning: n.  包厢
words.example:
We had drinks on the hotel balcony.  我们在饭店的阳台上喝酒。
Our seats are in row F of the balcony.  我们的座位在楼座的F排。

words.meaning: vt.  回收利用
words.example: The Japanese recycle more than half their waste paper.  日本人将一半以上的废纸回收利用。

words.meaning: a.  毁灭性的,破坏的,有害的
words.example: Lack of trust is very destructive in a relationship.  恋爱时缺乏信任是非常不利的。

words.meaning: n.  重复
words.example:
His books are full of repetition.  他的那些书都是在翻来覆去写同样的东西。
We want to prevent a repetition of last summer's fires which destroyed more than 500,000 acres of land.  去年夏天的火灾毁了超过500,000英亩的土地，我们希望预防此类火灾再次发生。

words.meaning: n.  壁龛; 小生境
words.example:
Lloyd has carved/made a niche for himself as a professional tennis player.  劳埃德成为职业网球员，为自己找到了合适的发展方向。
an ecological niche.  生态龛；生态位UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.  学费
words.example:
All students receive tuition in logic and metaphysics.  所有学生都学习逻辑学和玄学。
Few can afford the tuition of $12 000 a term.  很少人能支付得起每学期12 000美元的学费。

words.meaning: n.  校订,修正,再校稿vt.  校订,修正,校正
words.example:
His helpfulness today has made me revise my original opinion /impression of him.  他今天所表现出的乐于助人的品质使我改变了对他的最初看法／印象。
His publishers made him revise his manuscript three times.  出版公司让他把手稿修改了三次。verb
We're revising (algebra) for the test tomorrow.  我们正在为明天的（代数）考试进行复习。

words.meaning: n.  树皮
words.example:
Don't let her frighten you, her bark is worse than her bite.  别被她吓倒了，她这人口直心快。UK verb
They heard a dog barking outside.  他们听见外面有狗吠声。
The sergeant barked (out) a succession of orders to the new recruits.  中士向那些新兵大声地下了一连串命令。UK verb

words.meaning: vt.  使恐怖,恐吓
words.example: The idea of parachuting out of a plane terrifies me.  一想到从飞机上跳伞，我就害怕。

words.meaning: vt.  令人入神,使着迷vi.  入迷
words.example:
Science has always fascinated me.  科学一直令我着迷。
Anything to do with aeroplanes and flying fascinates him.  一切有关飞机和飞行的东西都令他着迷。

words.meaning: n.  刺,戳,努力,尝试,剧痛vt. 刺,戳,刺入,使伤心,使贯穿,刺痛vi.  刺,
words.example:
She was stabbed several times in the chest.  她胸口被捅了几刀。
He was jailed for fifteen years for stabbing his wife to death.  他因刺死妻子被判入狱15年。
As she spoke she stabbed the air with her finger.  她一边说一边用手指在空中比划着。

words.meaning: n.  支柱,支持者,螺旋桨,道具,倚靠人vt.  支撑,维持
words.example:
She was sitting at the desk with her chin propped on her hands.  她双手托着下巴坐在书桌旁。
This window keeps on closing - I'll have to prop it open with something.  这扇窗老是开了又关——我得用甚么东西撑着不让它关上。UK verb transitive + adverb or preposition (-pp-)
He was sitting upright in his hospital bed, propped up by pillows.  他靠着枕头，直挺挺地坐在医院的病床上。

words.meaning: v.  强调
words.example: The report underscores the need for reform.  报告强调了改革的必要。

words.meaning: v.  阐明
words.example: to formulate a new plan  制订一个新计划

words.meaning: n.  平行,对比,相匹敌之物a.  平行的,相似的vt.  与. . . 平行,与. . .
words.example:
Draw a pair of parallel lines.  画两条平行线。
Hills Road is parallel to Mill Road.  希尔斯路和米尔路平行。UK adjective
Parallel experiments are being conducted in Rome, Paris and London.  类似的实验正在罗马、巴黎和伦敦同时进行。UK noun

words.meaning: n.  微波(炉)
words.example: Put the fish in the microwave and it'll only take 5 minutes.  把鱼放到微波炉里，只需五分钟就可以了。

words.meaning: a.  彻底的; 详尽的; 一丝不苟的)
words.example:
They did a thorough search of the area but found nothing.  他们仔细搜索了该地区，但一无所获。UK adjective
It was a thorough waste of time.  这完全是浪费时间。

words.meaning: n.  范例; 标本
words.example:
He has a collection of rare insect specimens.  他收集了很多稀有昆虫的标本。
Museums will pay large amounts of money for good dinosaur fossil specimens.  博物馆愿意出大价钱购买完好的恐龙化石标本。
Astronauts brought back specimens of moon rock.  太空人带回了月球岩石的样本。

words.meaning: a.  微暗的,难解的,含糊的,不著名的,偏僻的vt.  使阴暗,隐藏,使含糊
words.example:
Official policy has changed, for reasons that remain obscure.  官方的政策已改变，原因尚不清楚。
His answers were obscure and confusing.  他的回答模糊不清，令人费解。UK verb transitive
Two new skyscrapers had sprung up, obscuring the view from her window.  两座新摩天大楼拔地而起，挡住了她窗外的风景。

words.meaning: n.  值得看的东西,光景,公开展示,场面
words.example:
It was a strange spectacle to see the two former enemies shaking hands and slapping each other on the back.  见到两个宿敌握手言欢，彼此拍肩，真是一幅奇怪的场景。
We witnessed the extraordinary spectacle of an old lady climbing a tree to rescue her cat.  我们目睹了一件奇事：有个老妇人爬上树去救她的猫noun
The carnival was a magnificent spectacle.  嘉年华场面十分壮观。

words.meaning: n.  圆锥体,球果vt.  使成锥形
words.example: Part of the road had been coned off for repair work.  部分道路用锥形路标封闭起来以便维修。

words.meaning: adv.  在本地
words.example:
The shopkeeper said all his fruit and vegetables are grown locally.  店主说他店里所有的水果和蔬菜都是当地出产的。
Do they live locally?  他们住在当地吗？

words.meaning: n.  盔甲,装甲vt.  装甲
words.example: The knight's armor was dented.  骑士的盔甲凹了一块。

words.meaning: n.  闲逛,漫步vi. vt.  闲逛,漫步
words.example: We could stroll into town if you like.  如果你愿意的话，我们可以去城里走走逛逛。

words.meaning: n.  氮
words.example: Nitrogen makes up 78% of the air.  氮气占空气的 78%。

words.meaning: a.  透明的,显然的,明晰的n.  透明
words.example:
Grow the bulbs in a transparent plastic box, so the children can see the roots growing.  把球茎种在透明的塑胶盒里，这样孩子就能看到根的生长。
Her blouse was practically transparent!  她的衬衫几乎是透明的！    Compare opaque ; translucent

words.meaning: n.  积分,整数a.  整体的,整数的,积分的n.  积分
words.example:
He's an integral part of the team and we can't do without him.  他是球队不可或缺的一员，没有他我们可不行。
Bars and terrace cafés are integral to the social life of the city.  酒吧和露天咖啡座是这个城市社交生活中不可缺少的一部分。

words.meaning: a.  分别的,各自的
words.example:
Everyone would go into the hall for assembly and then afterwards we'd go to our respective classes.  所有人都去礼堂参加集会，会后各自回各自的班级。
Clinton and Zedillo ordered their respective Cabinets to devise a common counter-drug strategy.  克林顿和塞迪略命令他们各自的内阁制订两国共同的反毒品战略。

words.meaning: vi. vt.  (使)流通,使)循环,(使)传播
words.example:
Hot water circulates through the heating system.  热水在供暖系统中循环。
I've circulated a good luck card for everyone to sign.  我拿了一张好运卡传着让每个人都签名。

words.meaning: vt. n.  预报; 预测
words.example:
The weather forecast said it was going to rain later today.  天气预报说今天晚些时候有雨。UK verb transitive (forecast or forecasted, forecast or forecasted)
They forecast a large drop in unemployment over the next two years.  他们预测今后两年失业人口会大幅下降。
Snow has been forecast for tonight.  预报今晚有雪。

words.meaning: n.  复活节
words.example: We painted eggs for Easter.  我们为复活节染蛋。

words.meaning: a.  引起兴趣(或好奇心)的，吸引人的
words.example: She has a really intriguing personality.  她的个性极具魅力。

words.meaning: n.  插,戳,刺,推力,口头攻击vt. 插入,猛推,刺,戳,延伸,强加,突然提出vi
words.example:
She thrust the money into his hand.  她把钱塞进他手中。
They thrust a microphone in front of me and fired questions at me.  他们把麦克风推到我面前，不断向我发问。
She thrust the papers at me (= towards me).  她把报纸塞给我。

words.meaning: n.  娱乐,消遣,休养
words.example:
His favourite recreations are golf and playing Scrabble.  他最喜欢的消遣方式是打高尔夫球和玩拼字游戏。
Emma's only form of recreation seems to be shopping.  埃玛唯一的消遣好像就是购物。noun countable or uncountable

words.meaning: a.  荒谬的,不合理的,可笑的
words.example:
What an absurd thing to say!  这话多荒唐啊！
Don't be so absurd! Of course I want you to come.  别说傻话了！我当然想让你来。
It's an absurd situation - neither of them will talk to the other.  这情形真是让人哭笑不得——他们谁也不愿意理谁。

words.meaning: n.  水库，蓄水池
words.example: The universities constitute a reservoir of expert knowledge.  大学是专业知识的宝库。

words.meaning: n.  相似,类似
words.example:
He drew an analogy between the brain and a vast computer.  他把大脑比作一台庞大的电脑。
It is sometimes easier to illustrate an abstract concept by analogy with (= by comparing it with) something concrete.  有时用具体事物作比拟来阐释抽象概念会更容易些。

words.meaning: n.  导体; (乐队等的)指挥
words.example:
The conductor raised his baton.  指挥举起了指挥棒。
Metal is a good conductor of heat.  金属是良好的热导体。

words.meaning: n.  居民,居住者
words.example: a city of 5 million inhabitants  拥有500万居民的城市

words.meaning: n.  带,皮带vt.  用皮带捆扎
words.example:
Could you help me fasten this strap around my suitcase?  你能帮我用这条带子把手提箱系紧吗？
Are the kids strapped into their car seats?  给孩子系好坐椅安全带了吗？
We strapped the surfboard to the car roof.  我们把冲浪板绑在汽车顶蓬上。verb transitive usually + adverb or preposition (-pp-)

words.meaning: vt.  加强vi.  强化
words.example: Fighting around the capital has intensified in the last few hours.  首都周围的战斗在过去的几小时里变得更加激烈。

words.meaning: v.  表明，证明; n.  显示
words.example:
The workers chose to manifest their dissatisfaction in a series of strikes.  工人决定藉一连串罢工来表达他们的不满。
The illness first manifested itself in/as severe stomach pains.  这种疾病最初表现为严重的胃痛。
Lack of confidence in the company manifested itself in a fall in the share price.  人们对公司缺乏信心，股价下跌正好显示此情况。 formal

words.meaning: n.  腐蚀,冲蚀,侵蚀
words.example: Wind erosion shaped the rocks.  风蚀塑造了岩石。

words.meaning: n.  流溢,面红,旺盛,一手同花的五张牌,惊飞的鸟,发烧a.  丰足的,齐平的
words.example:
She flushed with pleasure as she accepted the prize.  她领奖时高兴得红光满面。
The champagne had caused his face to flush.  香槟使他脸色发红。verb
My children never flush the loo/toilet after them.  我的孩子们用过马桶后从来不冲。

words.meaning: adv.  主要地
words.example: She is predominantly a dancer, but she also sings.  她主要是跳舞，但也唱歌。

words.meaning: n.  有势力的人a.  有势力的,强大的,有力的ad.  很,极
words.example:
In the next game they will face the mighty Redskins.  下一场比赛中他们将迎战实力强大的红人队。
They offered to raise salaries by 12% - that's a mighty generous deal.  他们表示愿意加薪12%，那可真是慷慨啊。

words.meaning: n.  白痴,极蠢之人
words.example:
Some idiot left the tap running in the bathroom and there's water everywhere.  哪个白痴忘了关浴室的水龙头，水流得到处都是。
[as form of address] You stupid idiot - that's a month's work you've lost!  你这个十足的白痴，你白做一个月的工！

words.meaning: n.  缺点
words.example:
All R45 aircraft have been grounded, after a defect in the engine cooling system was discovered.  自从发现引擎冷却系统有缺陷之后，所有R45型飞机都已经停飞了。
There are so many defects in our education system.  我们的教育制度有太多缺陷了。
It's a character defect in her that she can't ever accept that she's in the wrong.  她在性格上有缺陷，因为她从来都不承认自己有责任。

words.meaning: n.  猫头鹰
words.example: The owl hunted at dusk.  猫头鹰在黄昏狩猎。

words.meaning: n.  请愿,诉状,陈情书vt. vi.  请求,恳求,请愿
words.example:
She's filing a petition for divorce.  她将要递交离婚诉状。verb intransitive or transitive
They're petitioning for/about better facilities for disabled people on public transport.  他们正在请愿，希望当局能在大众交通工具上为残障人士安装更好的设施。
legal She is petitioning for a re-trial.  她将上诉要求重审。

words.meaning: n.  相符,通信,信件
words.example:
Any further correspondence should be sent to my new address.  以后来信请寄到我的新地址。
Her correspondence with Jim lasted many years.  她和吉姆保持了多年的通信联系。UK noun
The survey found no correspondence between crime and unemployment rates.  调查发现犯罪与失业率之间没有关联。

words.meaning: n.  静电,静电干扰a.  静态的,静电的
words.example:
Oil prices have remained static for the last few months.  过去几个月里油价保持稳定。UK noun uncountable
There's so much static on this radio I can't hear what they're saying.  收音机的静电干扰太大，我听不清他们在说甚么。

words.meaning: n.  无意义的事,荒谬的言行,荒唐
words.example:
This report is nonsense and nothing but a waste of paper.  这份报告一派胡言，纯粹是浪费纸张。
The accusations are (absolute/complete/utter) nonsense.  这些指控纯属子虚乌有。
Nonsense/Don't talk nonsense! She's far too ill to return to work!  一派胡言／别胡说！她远不至于病得没法回来上班！

words.meaning: n.  论题,论文
words.example: Their main thesis was that war was inevitable.  他们的主要论点是战争不可避免。

words.meaning: a.  音频的; 声音的
words.example: an audio cassette  卡式录音带

words.meaning: a.  有资格的
words.example:
Tim is now a qualified architect.  提姆现在是一个合格的建筑师了。
What makes you think that you are qualified for this job?  甚么使你觉得自己有资格从事这份工作？
There seems to be qualified support for the idea.  对这个观点的认同似乎有所保留。

words.meaning: a.  宇宙的
