words.example: The earthquake was a disaster of cosmic proportions/scale.  这次地震是一场巨大的灾难。

words.meaning: vt. vi.  沉思,考虑
words.example: She sat back for a minute to ponder her next move in the game.  她靠在椅背上坐了一会儿，思考下一步棋该怎么走。

words.meaning: vt.  弄复杂,使错综,使起纠纷vi.  变复杂
words.example:
It will only complicate the situation if we invite his old girlfriend as well.  如果我们同时也邀请他以前的女友，只会使事情更加复杂。
The rescue operation has been complicated by bad weather.  恶劣的天气使救援工作变得更加艰难。
These new rules have complicated the tax system even further.  这些新规定使税收制度更加复杂。

words.meaning: vt.  告发,公然抨击,谴责
words.example:
The government's economic policy has been denounced on all sides.  政府的经济政策受到了各方面的谴责。
We must denounce injustice and oppression.  我们必须对不公和压迫现象予以谴责。verb transitive
His former colleagues have denounced him as a spy.  他以前的同事告发他是间谍。

words.meaning: n.  等候室，休息室
words.example:
All the family were sitting in the lounge watching television.  全家人都坐在客厅里看电视。
We spent our days lounging around the pool.  我们整天在游泳池消磨时间。

words.meaning: v.  充满难以控制的(怒火等)
words.example:
Leave the vegetables to simmer for a few minutes.  把蔬菜再炖几分钟。
The strike has been simmering for weeks.  罢工已经酝酿了好几个礼拜。
She's been simmering with resentment ever since the meeting.  会议之后她便心生怨恨，一直耿耿于怀。UK verb

words.meaning: n.  水平线,水平面,横的位置a.  水平线的,水平的,横的n.  水平
words.example:
Draw a horizontal line across the bottom of the page.  在本页底部画一条水准线。
Keep the patient horizontal with the feet slightly raised.  让病人平躺，双脚略微抬高。    Compare verticalUK noun countable usually singular
Rotate it slowly from the horizontal into a vertical position.  慢慢将它从水准位置旋转到垂直位置。

words.meaning: n.  正当理由,根据,证明,批准,委任状,许可证,凭证vt.  保证,辩解,使有
words.example:
Obviously what she did was wrong, but I don't think it warranted quite such severe punishment.  显然她做得不对，但我认为她不应该受到如此严厉的惩罚。
It's a relatively simple task that really doesn't warrant a great deal of time being spent on it.  这是一个相对来说比较简单的任务，不必在上面花费大量的时间。
Judge La Riva had issued an arrest warrant/a warrant for his arrest.  拉里瓦法官已经签署了一份逮捕状／逮捕他的令状。UK noun

words.meaning: a.  例外的,异常的,特别的
words.example: The company has shown exceptional growth over the past two years.  过去两年里面，这间公司的发展业绩不俗。

words.meaning: a.  小心的,机警的,周到的,唯恐的
words.example: I'm a bit wary of/about giving people my address when I don't know them very well.  如果不是太熟的话，我不会轻易告诉别人我的地址。

words.meaning: n.  捆，束; vt.  捆
words.example:
Three days after the birth, Paul and Sandra took their precious bundle of joy home.  孩子出生三天后，保罗和桑德拉把宝宝抱回了家。noun countable
He's not exactly a bundle of laughs, is he?  他并不是个很滑稽搞笑的人，是不是？noun countable
Sorry for shouting - I'm a bundle of nerves these days.  很抱歉冲你大叫大嚷——这些天我很焦躁。noun countable

words.meaning: n.  亚麻织品，亚麻布; a.  亚麻(布制)的
words.example: a linen jacket  亚麻上衣

words.meaning: vt.  举起,提拔,鼓舞
words.example:
The platform was elevated by means of hydraulic legs.  平台由液压支架抬升起来。
They want to elevate the status of teachers.  他们想提高教师的社会地位。
These factors helped to elevate the town into the list of the ten most attractive in the country.  这些因素提高了该镇的声望，使之成为该国十大最具魅力城镇之一。

words.meaning: n.  奖券,彩票,运气
words.example: Education in England is something of a lottery.  在英格兰接受教育有点像碰运气。

words.meaning: n.  零工,家务
words.example: I'll go shopping when I've done my chores (= done the jobs in or around the house).  我把家务琐事做完后要去购物。

words.meaning: n.  珊瑚(虫); a.  珊瑚色的，珊瑚红的
words.example: Paul wore pale grey trousers with a coral T-shirt and black jacket.  保罗穿了条浅灰色长裤，配珊瑚红T恤和黑夹克。

words.meaning: n.  租约,租期,租vt.  出租,租出,租得
words.example:
The estate contains 300 new homes, about a third of which are leased to the council.  住宅区里有300所新房屋，其中约1／3租给了市政委员会。
He has the flat on a long lease.  他长期租用该公寓。
The lease runs out/expires in two years' time.  租借契约将在两年后到期。

words.meaning: n.  人口普查
words.example:
We have a census in this country every ten years.  我们在这个国家每十年进行一次人口普查。
She was stopped in her car for a traffic census.  她被拦下来接受交通情况调查。

words.meaning: n.  标准度量,计量器vt.  精确计量,估计
words.example:
Use a thermometer to gauge the temperature.  用温度计测量一下温度。
The fact that the play has transferred to New York is a gauge of its success.  该剧转往纽约演出，从这一点就可以判定它是很成功的。

words.meaning: n.  军团,队,团,兵种
words.example: the Royal Army Medical Corps  皇家陆军医疗队

words.meaning: vt.  居住于,占据,栖息
words.example: These remote islands are inhabited only by birds.  这些偏僻的岛屿上只有鸟类栖息。

words.meaning: n.  配额,限额
words.example:
The country now has a quota on immigration.  该国目前对外来移民人数有限额。
figurative The class contains the usual quota (= number) of troublemakers.  班上也有那些捣乱的人。

words.meaning: n.  摘录,引用vt.  摘录,引用
words.example: An excerpt from her new thriller will appear in this weekend's magazine.  本周末出版的杂志将刊登她的最新惊悚小说的片段。

words.meaning: n.  大步,一跨步,进步vi. vt.  迈大步走,跨过,跨
words.example:
The West made impressive strides in improving energy efficiency after the huge rises in oil prices during the seventies.  20世纪70年代石油价格大幅上涨之后，西方国家在提高能源使用效率方面有了显著进步。
The group has made strides to expand internationally.  这个集团在拓展国际市场方面获得很大的进展。noun
She attributes her record-breaking speed to the length of her stride.  她认为她的速度之所以能打破纪录是因为步幅大。noun

words.meaning: a.  成熟的,熟练的,足够的,成年的
words.example:
Those bananas aren't ripe yet - they're still green.  那些香蕉还没有成熟——还是绿的。adjective
This brie smells good and ripe.  这种法国布里起司味道醇正而浓郁。adjective
There was a ripe smell from his socks.  他的袜子发出一股刺鼻的味道。adjective

words.meaning: a.  吃惊的,惊奇的
words.example:
She was amazed at how calm she felt after the accident.  事故发生后她是如此镇定，这让她自己都觉得惊奇。
We were amazed to discover that we'd been at school together.  我们惊奇地发现原来我们曾经是同学。

words.meaning: n.  呐喊声,标语,口号
words.example: an advertising slogan  广告口号

words.meaning: n.  一致，符合
words.example:
On 31 May the two leaders signed a peace accord.  5月31日两位领导人签署了一项和平协议。
Before 1987, the accord between the Labour government and the unions was a simple affair.  1987年以前，工党政府和工会之间很容易达成一致。
The project is completely in accord with government policy.  该企划案完全符合政府政策。

words.meaning: a.  暴虐的,极无礼的,可恶的
words.example:
The judge criticized the "outrageous greed" of some of the lawyers.  法官批评有些律师“无耻贪婪”。
These prices are just outrageous (= much too high).  这些价格高得吓人。

words.meaning: n.  悲惨,不幸,穷困
words.example:
We have witnessed the most appalling scenes of human misery.  我们目睹了最令人震惊的人间苦难。
Ten years of marriage to him have made her life a misery.  和他的十年婚姻使她的生活非常痛苦。UK noun
Oh come on, don't be such a misery!  好了，别做牢骚大王了！

words.meaning: n.  模子,雏型,霉vt. vi.  形成,塑造,发霉
words.example: Bread grows mold in damp places.  面包在潮湿处会长霉。

words.meaning: n.  途径; 大街
words.example:
We should explore/pursue every avenue in the search for an answer to this problem.  我们应该尝试一切途径寻求该问题的答案。
Only two avenues are open to us - either we accept his offer or we give up the fight completely.  我们只有两条路可走——要么接受他的提议，要么完全放弃斗争。

words.meaning: vt.  使沉溺,使上瘾n.  上瘾者
words.example: humorous I'm a chocolate/shopping addict.  我是个吃巧克力成瘾的人／购物狂。

words.meaning: n.  冰雹,致敬,招呼vt.  向. . . 欢呼,致敬,招呼,使象下雹样落下vi.
words.example:
The Prime Minister was greeted with a hail of insults as she arrived at the students' union.  女首相来到学生会时遭到一阵辱骂。verb
Shall we hail a taxi?  我们要叫计程车吗？
She's being hailed as one of the best up-and-coming young dancers today.  她被誉为当今最有前途的年轻舞蹈家之一。

words.meaning: v.  通报
words.example:
The school is required to notify parents if their children fail to come to school.  如果孩子没来上学，学校必须通知其家长。
Has everyone been notified of the decision?  这决定已经通知每一个人了吗？

words.meaning: vt.  发挥,运用,施以影响
words.example:
If you were to exert your influence they might change their decision.  如果你可以施加你的影响，他们或者会改变决定。
Some managers exert considerable pressure on their staff to work extra hours without being paid.  一些老板向员工施加巨大的压力迫使他们无薪加班。UK verb

words.meaning: a.  天真的; 纯朴的
words.example:
She was very naive to believe that he'd stay with her.  她居然天真地相信他会和她在一起。
They make the naive assumption that because it's popular it must be good.  他们幼稚地认为，流行的就一定是好的。
It was a little naive of you to think that they would listen to your suggestions.  你以为他们会听从你的建议，你真是有点天真。

words.meaning: n.  谷类(食品)
words.example: cereal crops  谷类作物

words.meaning: n.  棉被; vt.  制成棉被
words.example: The quilt kept us warm all night.  被子让我们整夜温暖。

words.meaning: a.  有感觉的,有判断力的,明智的
words.example:
It would be sensible to take an umbrella.  带把伞是明智的。
It could be cold and wet so pack some sensible clothes.  天可能会又冷又湿，因此带些合适的衣服。adjective
He did not appear to be sensible of the difficulties that lay ahead.  他看起来并没有意识到前面的困难。

words.meaning: n.  破碎,骨折vt. vi.  (使)破碎,(使)破裂
words.example:
She fractured her skull in the accident.  她在事故中颅骨骨折。
Two of her ribs fractured when she was thrown from her horse.  她从马上摔下来，折断了两根肋骨。
Intense disagreement over economic policy risks fracturing the coalition government.  经济政策上的严重分歧使联合政府面临解体的危险。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.  金字塔
words.example:
The acrobats formed a pyramid by standing on each other's shoulders.  杂技演员一个站上另一个的肩膀上表演叠罗汉。
figurative Many organizations have a pyramid structure (= there are fewer people at the top levels of them than there are at the bottom).  许多团体呈现金字塔式的组织结构。

words.meaning: n.  地域; 领域
words.example:
Have you read John Milton's tracts on divorce?  你读过约翰‧弥尔顿论离婚的小册子吗？noun countable
The house is surrounded by vast tracts of woodland.  这幢房子周围是大片林地。

words.meaning: n.  围巾，披巾
words.example: a knitted/woollen/silk scarf  针织／羊毛／丝绸围巾UK verb transitive    US for

words.meaning: n.  哺乳动物
words.example: Humans, dogs, elephants and dolphins are all mammals, but birds, fish and crocodiles are not.  人、狗、大象和海豚都是哺乳动物，而鸟、鱼和鳄鱼则不是。

words.meaning: n. 构造；外形；配置
words.example: Check the network configuration.  检查网络配置。

words.meaning: n.  时事通讯
words.example: a monthly newsletter  每月简报

words.meaning: vt.  模仿,效法,冒充,仿造
words.example:
Some of the younger pop bands try to imitate their musical heroes from the past.  一些较年轻的流行乐队极力模仿心目中昔日的音乐巨星。
They produce artificial chemicals which exactly imitate particular natural ones.  他们生产酷似某些天然物质的人造化学品。

words.meaning: v.  增加; 繁殖
words.example:
In warm weather these germs multiply rapidly.  在温暖的天气里这些细菌会迅速繁殖。
If you multiply seven by 15 you get 105.  用15乘以7，结果是105。    Compare add ; divide ; subtract

words.meaning: a.  声名狼藉的,恶名昭张的,众人皆知的
words.example: The company is notorious for paying its bills late.  该公司出了名地喜欢拖欠帐单。

words.meaning: n.  立体声系统(装置); a.  立体声的
words.example: The concert will be broadcast in stereo.  音乐会将用立体声播放。

words.meaning: a.  致命的n.  致死因子
words.example:
Three minutes after the fire started, the house was full of lethal fumes.  起火三分钟后，房子里充满了致命的毒气。
In the car the police found guns, knives and other lethal weapons (= weapons which can kill).  员警在车里找到了枪支、刀具及其他一些凶器。
informal That combination of tiredness and alcohol is lethal (= has a very bad effect).  身体的疲劳加上酒精的作用会产生非常严重的后果。

words.meaning: vt.  使必需,使蒙受,使承担,遗传给n.  限定继承权
words.example: Such a large investment inevitably entails some risk.  这样的钜额投资必然会有一定的风险。

words.meaning: n.  努力,尽力vi.  努力,尽力
words.example: Space exploration is a grand endeavor.  太空探索是伟大的事业。

words.meaning: n.  国书,凭据,印信
words.example:
All the candidates had excellent academic credentials.  所有候选人都具有优秀的学历证书。
She was asked to show her press credentials.  她被要求出示记者证。

words.meaning: ad.  顺利地; 平稳地
words.example:
The road was blocked for two hours after the accident, but traffic is now flowing smoothly again.  事故发生后，这条路堵塞了两个小时，不过现在交通又恢复畅通了。
Lead is added to fuel to make car engines run more smoothly.  燃油中加入了铅，以使汽车引擎运转更流畅。
The pregnancy's gone very smoothly so far.  迄今为止，怀孕以来一切正常。

words.meaning: vi.  漫游，漫步
words.example:
After the pubs close, gangs of youths roam the city streets.  酒馆关门后，成群结伙的年轻人在城里街道上游荡。
She roamed around America for a year, working in bars and restaurants.  她花了一年的时间在美国各地游历，一路在酒吧和饭店里打工。

words.meaning: n.  盆地,盆
words.example: I've cleaned the basin and scrubbed the bath.  我已经清洗了脸盆，还刷了浴缸。noun countable

words.meaning: n. [总称]家畜，牲畜
words.example: The farmer feeds his livestock daily.  农夫每天喂牲口。

words.meaning: n.  泡沫,水沫,泡沫材料vi.  起泡沫,吐白沫vt.  使起泡沫
words.example: The Almeida theatre's recent staging of the opera had critics foaming at the mouth.  阿尔梅达剧院最近上演的歌剧招致评论家大加贬斥。

words.meaning: n.  小行星
words.example: The asteroid passed close to Earth.  小行星近距离掠过地球。

words.meaning: a.  秃头,光秃的,单调的,赤裸的
words.example:
At twenty he was already going bald.  他20岁就开始秃头了。
When he took off his hat, we saw that he was as bald as a coot!  他脱帽后，我们发现他的头全秃了！UK adjective
There was just this bald statement of resignation - no explanation or anything.  只有简单的辞职声明——没有解释之类的东西。

words.meaning: a.  脆的,新鲜的,活泼的vt. vi.  (使)烘脆,(使)卷曲,(使)起皱n.  松脆
words.example: Now that we have cable, we get a wonderfully crisp picture, even on our old TV.  有了有线电视，即便是用我们那台老电视机收看，图像也十分清晰。

words.meaning: a.  光荣的,显赫的
words.example:
The beetroot had turned the soup a glorious pink.  甜菜使汤呈现出极为诱人夺目的粉红色。
Your roses are glorious!  你的玫瑰太漂亮了！
They had glorious weather for their wedding.  他们举行婚礼的那天天气好极了。

words.meaning: a.  紧凑的,紧密的,简洁的vt.  使装满,使简洁vi.  变紧密
words.example:
What a compact office! How did you fit so much into so little space?  多么小巧的办公室！你们是如何把这么多东西塞进这么小的空间的？noun countable UK CASE  盒子
Cars had compacted the snow until it was like ice.  汽车把雪碾得越来越结实，直到变得像冰一样。

words.meaning: v.  (使)失去，剥夺
words.example:
He claimed that he had been deprived of his freedom/rights.  他声称本身自由／权利被剥夺。
You can't function properly when you're deprived of sleep.  如果被剥夺了睡眠，人体就无法正常运作。verb transitive
Where have you been? We've been deprived of your company for far too long!  你到哪里去了？这么长时间都没见到你！

words.meaning: vi.  繁荣，茂盛
words.example:
My tomatoes are flourishing this summer - it must be the warm weather.  今年夏天我的番茄长势很好——这一定是天气暖和的原因。
Watercolour painting began to flourish in Britain around 1750.  1750年左右，水彩画开始在英国兴盛起来。UK verb
She came in smiling, flourishing her exam results.  她微笑着走进来，手里挥舞着她的考试成绩单。UK noun

words.meaning: vt.  卸下,放出,解雇,放电,履行,拔染vi.  卸货,流注n.  卸货,流出,放电
words.example:
Patients were discharged from hospital because the beds were needed by other people.  由于其他人需要床位，患者们便被允许出院了。
More than half of all prisoners discharged (= allowed to leave prison) are reconvicted within two years.  在获释的犯人中有一半多在两年内又被再次判刑。verb UK SEND OUT  发出
Large amounts of dangerous waste are discharged daily by the factory.  这个工厂每天排放大量危险的废物。

words.meaning: n.  用力拉,拖船,绳索,挣扎,苦干vi. vt.  用力拉
words.example:
Tom tugged at his mother's arm.  汤姆拽着妈妈的胳膊。noun countable
Feeling a tug at his sleeve, he turned to see Joe beside him.  他感觉到有人拉他的袖子，一转身，看到乔在他身边。

words.meaning: vt.  授予权力,允许,使能够
words.example: The first step in empowering the poorest sections of society is making sure they vote.  帮助社会最贫困阶层掌握自己命运的第一步就是要确保他们能够参加投票。

words.meaning: n.  鞍,马鞍,车座,拖具vt.  装以马鞍,使负担vi.  跨上马鞍
words.example:
He swung himself into the saddle and rode off.  他跨上马鞍，骑马走了。
The chairman is back in the saddle after his heart attack.  心脏病愈之后，主席又重新掌权了。noun
She saddled (up) the horse for her friend.  她为朋友备好了马鞍。verb transitive

words.meaning: n.  党羽,同党的人,游击队员a.  党徒的,效忠的,献身的,盲目推崇的
words.example: The audience was very partisan, and refused to listen to her speech.  听众的党派观念很强，拒绝听她的演讲。

words.meaning: a.  俯伏的,面向下的有. . . 倾向的
words.example:
I've always been prone to headaches.  我总是容易头痛。
He was prone to depressions even as a teenager.  甚至在青少年时期他就容易情绪抑郁。
She's prone to exaggerate, that's for sure.  她喜欢夸大其词，这一点是肯定的。UK adjective

words.meaning: a.  永久的,永恒的,持久的n.  厚实斜纹织物
words.example:
Few observers believe that the treaty will bring a lasting peace to the region.  没有几个观察家认为该条约会给该地区带来持久的和平。
Did any of your teachers make a lasting impression on you?  有没有哪位老师给你留下了深刻的印象？
The tablets make you feel better for a while but the effect isn't (long-) lasting.  这种药片能让你感觉好一些，但药效不会持久。

words.meaning: a.  丰富的,充分的
words.example:
There is abundant evidence that cars have a harmful effect on the environment.  有充分证据显示，汽车对环境有害。
Cheap consumer goods are abundant (= exist in large amounts) in this part of the world.  在这个地区，大量的低廉消费品充斥其间。

words.meaning: n.  槌; 锤子; v.  锤打
words.example:
Can you hold this nail in position while I hammer it into the door?  你能托住这颗钉子，好让我把它钉进门里吗？
My car's got a dent, and I was hoping they'd be able to hammer it out (= remove it by hammering).  我的车上有一处凹痕，我希望他们能把它敲平。UK verb
He hammered the ball into the net, giving France a 3-2 win over Italy.  他将球劲射入网，使法国队以3比2战胜了义大利队。UK verb

words.meaning: a.  强大的,可怕的,艰难的
words.example: a formidable obstacle/task  令人生畏的障碍／任务

words.meaning: n.  排除,除外,逐出
words.example: her exclusion from the list of Oscar nominees  她被排除在奥斯卡奖提名名单之外

words.meaning: a.  精力充沛的,元气旺盛的,有力的
words.example:
There has been vigorous opposition to the proposals for a new road.  修建一条新路的提议遭到了强烈的反对。
He takes plenty of vigorous exercise.  他做大量的剧烈运动。
Cutting the bush back in the autumn will help promote vigorous growth in the spring.  秋天将灌木丛剪短有利于它在春天茁壮生长。

words.meaning: a.  丈夫的,婚姻的,夫妇间的
words.example:
They've been having marital problems , apparently.  显然他们的婚姻一直有问题。
humorous You can't expect to live in a state of marital bliss.  你别指望婚姻会一直美满。

words.meaning: n.  平衡,均衡,姿势,砝码,安静,镇静vt.  使平衡,使悬着,保持. . . 姿势
words.example:
He looked embarrassed for a moment, then quickly regained his poise.  他一时间显得尴尬，但很快又恢复了平静。
Her confidence and poise show that she is a top model.  她的自信与镇定显示她是一个十分优秀的模特儿。

words.meaning: n.  剩余,过剩,盈余a.  过剩的,剩余的
words.example:
The world is now producing large food surpluses.  世界上目前生产的食品大大过剩。
We are unlikely to produce any surplus this year.  我们今年不太可能有任何盈余。
The government has authorized the army to sell its surplus weapons.  政府已经授权军队出售多余的武器。

words.meaning: n.  干扰; 骚动
words.example:
Residents are fed up with the disturbance caused by the nightclub.  居民受够了夜总会造成的干扰。
Phone calls are the biggest disturbance at work.  接听电话是工作中最大的干扰。
There was a minor disturbance (= violent event in public) during the demonstration, but nobody was injured.  示威活动中发生了一件轻微的骚乱事件，但没有人受伤。

words.meaning: a.  紧张的,拉紧的vt. vi.  (使)紧张,(使)拉紧n.  时态
words.example:
She was very tense as she waited for the interview.  她等待面试时非常紧张。
There were some tense moments in the second half of the game.  比赛下半场有几次紧张的局面。adjective
Don't tense your shoulders, just relax.  别缩紧肩膀，放松点。

words.meaning: n.  空闲，闲暇
words.example:
Most people only have a limited amount of leisure time.  大多数人只有有限的空闲时间。
The town lacks leisure facilities such as a swimming pool or squash courts.  这个城镇缺少游泳池、壁球场等休闲设施。UK noun uncountable
You can take the documents home and study them at (your) leisure.  你可以把这些档带回家，有空时再好好看一看。

words.meaning: vt.  发出; 放射
words.example:
The alarm emits infra-red rays which are used to detect any intruder.  警报器能发出红外线探测入侵者。
The machine emits a high-pitched sound when you press the button.  一按这个按钮，机器就会发出尖厉的鸣叫声。

words.meaning: n.  原型
words.example: a prototype for/of a new car  新型轿车的原型

words.meaning: n.  植物; 植被
words.example:
The railway track will have to be cleared of vegetation if it is to be used again.  那条铁路如果要重新启用，就得清除沿线的草木。
Much of the region's native vegetation has been damaged by developers who are building hotels along the coast.  该地区很多本地植物都被那些沿海岸建造饭店的开发商破坏了。

words.meaning: a.  比较的,相当的n.  匹敌者
words.example:
'Fatter' is the comparative of 'fat'.  fatter 是 fat 的比较级。
'More difficult' is the comparative of 'difficult'.  more difficult 是 difficult 的比较级。UK adjective
She's carrying out a comparative study of health in inner cities and rural areas.  她正在对市中心区和乡村地区的健康问题进行比较研究。

words.meaning: n.  磁铁，磁体
words.example: The United States has always acted as a magnet for people seeking fame and fortune.  美国一直像磁石般吸引着追名逐利的人。

words.meaning: a.  充足的,丰富的
words.example:
You'll have ample opportunity to ask questions after the talk.  演讲结束后你们会有足够的时间提问。
There's ample evidence that the lawyer knew exactly what she was doing.  有充分的证据显示，该律师十分清楚她自己在做甚么。
They had ample warning of the factory closure.  对于工厂的倒闭，他们早就得到了大量警告。adjective

words.meaning: n.  缺点; 不利
words.example:
One disadvantage of living in the town is the lack of safe places for the children to play.  住在城里的一个坏处是缺少可供孩子们放心玩耍的地方。
We need to consider whether the disadvantages of the plan outweigh the advantages.  我们要考虑一下该计划是否弊大于利。
He's at a disadvantage being so shy.  过于害羞使他处于劣势。

words.meaning: n.  条纹，斑纹
words.example:
The zebra is a wild African horse with black and white stripes.  斑马是一种身体上有黑白条纹的非洲野马。noun countable
By the age of 25 he'd already got his third stripe and become a sergeant.  25岁时，他为自己的军服添上了第三道军阶条，成为一名中士。noun countable
Governments of every stripe (= of all political opinions) have a bad habit of interfering in state broadcasting.  持各种政治主张的政府都有干涉公营广播电台的坏习惯。

words.meaning: a.  最初的,最重要的ad.  在最前
words.example:
This is one of the country's foremost arts centres.  这是全国最重要的艺术中心之一。
She's one of the foremost experts on child psychology.  她是儿童心理学领域最顶尖的专家之一。

words.meaning: a.  有力的,有效的
words.example:
Surprise remains the terrorists' most potent weapon.  突袭仍是恐怖分子最强有力的武器。
The Berlin Wall was a potent symbol of the Cold War.  柏林围墙是冷战的有力象征。
This is a very potent drug and can have unpleasant side-effects.  该药效力很强，副作用也不小。

words.meaning: vt. vi.  大叫,呼喊,大声叫
words.example:
"Rubbish!" he exclaimed in disgust.  “废话！”他充满厌恶地大声说。
She exclaimed in delight upon hearing the news.  她听到这个消息高兴得大叫。

words.meaning: n.  牙科医生
words.example:
You should have your teeth checked by a dentist at least twice a year.  你每年至少应该请牙科医生检查两次牙齿。
I've got to go to the dentist's on Friday.  周五我要去看牙。

words.meaning: a.  不利的,敌对的,相反的,逆的
words.example:
The match has been cancelled due to adverse weather conditions.  由于天气恶劣，这场比赛已被取消。
They received a lot of adverse publicity/criticism about the changes.  这些变化为他们招致种种负面报导／非议。
So far the drug is thought not to have any adverse effects.  迄今为止，人们一直认为这种药物没有任何副作用。

words.meaning: vt. vi.  夸大,夸张
words.example:
The threat of attack has been greatly exaggerated.  遭受袭击的威胁被过分夸大了。
Don't exaggerate - it wasn't that expensive.  不要言过其实——没有那么贵。
I'm not exaggerating - it was the worst meal I've ever eaten in my life.  我不是在夸大其词——那是我这辈子吃过最难吃的饭。

words.meaning: n.  牡蛎，蚝
words.example: Oysters filter seawater.  牡蛎过滤海水。

words.meaning: n.  火山
words.example: Erupting volcanoes discharge massive quantities of dust into the stratosphere.  火山喷发导致大量灰尘进入大气平流层。

words.meaning: a.  嫉妒的,羡慕的,留心的,戒备的
words.example:
He had always been very jealous of his brother's good looks.  他总是很妒忌他哥哥帅气的长相。
Anna says she feels jealous every time another woman looks at her boyfriend.  安娜说每当别的女人看她的男朋友她都会感到妒忌。    Compare enviousadjective
She is very jealous of her independence, and doesn't want to get married.  她很珍惜自己的自由，不想结婚。

words.meaning: n.  吃吃的笑声,轻笑vi.  吃吃的笑,咯咯叫
words.example: She was chuckling as she read the letter.  她一边看信一边偷笑。

words.meaning: n.  牧场，草原
words.example:
The sheep were grazing on the lush green pastures.  羊群正在郁郁葱葱的牧场上吃草。
Some fields are planted with crops for several years, and then returned to pasture for the cattle.  有些田地种了几年作物后又退耕还牧用来养牛了。UK noun countable or uncountable
Many scientists working for the government have left for greener pastures in the private sector.  许多原先为政府工作的科学家现在都到私人单位另谋高就了。

words.meaning: n.  沼泽; v.  (以繁多的事)压倒某人
words.example:
The Everglades are an area of swamp in southern Florida.  佛罗里达大湿地是佛罗里达州南部的一片沼泽地区。UK verb
High tides have swamped the coast.  高涨的潮水淹没了海岸。
The boat was swamped by an enormous wave.  小船被巨浪吞没了。UK verb

words.meaning: n.  谋反,叛乱,反抗
words.example: The government has brutally crushed the rebellion.  政府残酷镇压了叛乱。

words.meaning: n.  饵vt.  以饵引诱,欺负vi.  中途休息
words.example:
They were digging up worms to use for bait.  他们在挖虫子制饵。
We put down some poisoned bait to kill the rats.  我们放了一些毒饵灭鼠。noun
Free holidays were offered as (a) bait to customers.  以免费渡假来吸引顾客。

words.meaning: a.  疼痛的; 极度的
words.example:
All the dust has made my eyes sore.  灰尘使我的眼睛酸痛。
I've got a sore throat.  我喉咙痛。
My feet were sore with all the walking.  走了这么多的路，我的脚很痛。UK adjective

words.meaning: a.  审慎的，深思熟虑的
words.example:
We made a deliberate decision to live apart for a while.  经过慎重考虑，我们决定分开居住一段时间。
From her slow, deliberate speech I guessed she must be drunk.  她说话慢吞吞的，我猜她肯定喝醉了。verb intransitive or transitive /dɪˈlɪb.ə.reɪt/    formal
The jury took five days to deliberate on the case.  陪审团花了五天时间对此案进行了慎重讨论。

words.meaning: n.  礁，暗礁
words.example: a dangerous offshore reef  靠近岸边的危险暗礁

words.meaning: a.  直立的,竖立的,笔直的vt.  使竖立,使直立,树立,建立vi.  勃起
words.example:
The war memorial was erected in 1950.  这座战争纪念碑建于1950年。
The soldiers had erected barricades to protect themselves.  士兵们筑起了街垒用以自卫。verb transitive formal
They erected a marquee to accommodate 500 wedding guests.  他们搭起了一个大帐篷以接待参加婚礼的500位客人。adjective

words.meaning: n.  誓约,誓言,咒骂
words.example:
Medieval knights took an oath of allegiance/loyalty to their lord.  中世纪骑士宣誓效忠于君主。
The witness placed her hand on the Bible and took the oath (= promised to tell the truth).  证人将手放在《圣经》上，起誓要讲真话。
The judge reminded the witness that she was under oath.  法官提醒证人她宣过誓要据实作证。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.  不足，缺乏
words.example:
Pregnant women often suffer from iron deficiency.  孕妇常常缺铁。
Deficiencies in the education system have been much in the news.  新闻媒体对教育体制的种种不足进行了大量的报道。

words.meaning: n.  耀眼的光
words.example:
She gave me a fierce glare.  她狠狠瞪了我一眼。UK noun
Tinted windows will cut down the glare/the sun's glare.  有色玻璃窗会遮挡刺眼的阳光。
This screen gives off a lot of glare.  这种萤幕发出的光太刺眼。UK noun

words.meaning: v.  使…模糊
words.example:
If I don't wear my glasses, everything is just a blur.  如果不戴眼镜，我看任何东西都是模糊的。
It all happened so long ago that it's just a blur to me now.  这件事发生在很久以前，我现在记不清了。
The last few days seem to have gone by in a blur.  过去几天似乎是在恍恍惚惚中度过的。UK verb intransitive or transitive (-rr-)

words.meaning: n.  肥料,受精媒介物
words.example: organic fertilizer  有机肥料

words.meaning: n.  (海拔)高度; [常pl.  ]海拔甚高的地方
words.example:
We are currently flying at an altitude of 15 000 metres.  现在我们正在15 000米的高度上飞行。
Mountain climbers use oxygen when they reach higher altitudes.  到了海拔较高的地方，登山者就要使用氧气。

words.meaning: a.  便利的,敏捷的,容易取得的
words.example:
First-time visitors to France will find this guide particularly handy.  初次来法国的游览者会发现这本旅游指南很有用。
It's a nice house and it's handy for (= near) the station.  这座房子很漂亮，离车站也很近。
informal Don't throw those bottles away - they'll come in handy (= be useful) for the picnic next Sunday.  别把那些瓶子扔掉——下周日出去野餐会派上用场。adjective

words.meaning: v.  (使)不同，区别
words.example:
We do not differentiate between our workers on the basis of their background or ethnic origin.  我们不会因工人的背景或种族不同而区别对待。verb
The slate roof differentiates this house from others in the area.  石板瓦屋顶使这座房子在该地区与众不同。

words.meaning: a.  各式各样的
words.example: With its varied climate, the country attracts both winter and summer sports enthusiasts.  该国气候多变，吸引了冬季和夏季运动爱好者。

words.meaning: vi.  合作,通敌
words.example:
Two writers collaborated on the script for the film.  两位作家合写了这部电影的剧本。
The British and Italian police collaborated in catching the terrorists.  英国警方和义大利警方通力合作，抓住了恐怖分子。verb intransitive
Anyone who was suspected of collaborating with the occupying forces was arrested.  任何涉嫌与占领军勾结的人都被逮捕了。

words.meaning: n.  剩余,零碎货,遗迹a.  剩余的,残余的
words.example: the remnants of last night's meal  昨晚的剩饭

words.meaning: a.  公共的; 社区的
words.example:
We each have a separate bedroom but share a communal kitchen.  我们各有一间独立的卧室，但共用一个厨房。
Communal riots/disturbances have once again broken out between the two ethnic groups.  两个种族之间再次爆发了骚乱。

words.meaning: n.  烹调风格,烹调法,烹饪,厨房
words.example: French cuisine  法式烹饪

words.meaning: n.  成熟，完备
words.example:
How long does it take for the chicks to grow to maturity?  小鸡要多久才能长大？UK noun uncountable
The investment reaches maturity after ten years.  这项投资十年后开始获利。

words.meaning: n.  战利品,赃物,次品,掠夺,奖品vt.  损坏,破坏,溺爱vi.  腐坏,掠夺
words.example:
He tried not to let the bad news spoil his evening.  他努力不让那个坏消息破坏他晚上的兴致。
The oil spill has spoilt the whole beautiful coastline.  溢出的石油破坏了整段漂亮的海岸线。
You'll spoil your appetite for dinner if you have a cake now.  你要是现在吃蛋糕的话，就没胃口吃晚饭了。

words.meaning: vt.  毁坏
words.example: The typhoon devastated the island.  台风摧毁了这座岛。

words.meaning: n.  低估vt.  低估,看轻
words.example:
Originally the builders gave me a price of £2000, but now they say they underestimated and it's going to be at least £3000.  起初建筑商向我报价2000英镑，但现在他们说当初估价过低，至少要3000英镑。
One shouldn't underestimate the difficulties of getting all the political parties to the conference table.  要让各个党派都坐下来谈判，其难度不可小觑。    Opposite overestimate
Never underestimate your opponent!  永远不要低估你的对手！

words.meaning: vi.  航行; 飞行; 测定位置和路线
words.example:
Sailors have special equipment to help them navigate.  船员们借助专门的仪器确定航向。
Even ancient ships were able to navigate large stretches of open water.  即使是古老的船只，也能在宽阔的大片水域中航行。
Some migrating birds can navigate by the moon (= using the moon as a guide).  有些迁徙的鸟类可以借助月亮确定方向。

words.meaning: a.  健康的,强健的,粗野的,坚定的
words.example: He looks robust and healthy enough.  他看起来非常强壮健康。

words.meaning: n.  子句,条款
words.example:
They have added/deleted/amended a clause in the contract which says the company can make people redundant for economic reasons.  他们在合同中增加／删除／修改了一项条款，该条款称公司可以因为经济原因裁减人员。
Clause 4 of the constitution is thought to be the most important section.  宪法第四条被认为是最重要的部分。UK US  specialized
In the sentence 'I can't cook very well but I make quite good omelettes', both 'I can't cook very well' and 'I make quite good omelettes' are main/independent clauses (= they are of equal importance and could each exist as a separate sentence).  在 I can't cook very well but I make quite good omelettes（我菜烧得不太好，可是蛋饼煎得很不错）这句话中，I can't cook very well 和 I make quite good omelettes 都是主句／独立分句。

words.meaning: n.  简明新闻; 公告
words.example: The company publishes a fortnightly bulletin for its staff.  这家公司每两周为员工出一期简报。

words.meaning: n.  生态，生态学
words.example:
The oil spill caused terrible damage to the fragile ecology of the coast.  石油外泄给脆弱的海岸生态环境带来严重的破坏。
She hopes to study ecology at college.  她希望在大学里读生态学。

words.meaning: vt.  愤恨,憎恶,怨恨
words.example: She bitterly resented her father's new wife.  她对她父亲新娶的妻子恨之入骨。

words.meaning: n.  花; vi.  开花
words.example:
The cherry tree is beginning to blossom.  樱桃树开始开花了。
She has really blossomed recently.  她近来确实变得惹人喜爱了。
She is suddenly blossoming into a very attractive woman.  她突然出落成了一位很有魅力的女子。

words.meaning: n.  连贯性，连续性
words.example: There has been no continuity in that class - they've had a succession of different teachers.  那个班级的课上得没有连贯性——他们一连换了好几位老师。

words.meaning: n.  附件，零件
words.example:
She wore a green wool suit with matching accessories (= shoes, hat, bag, etc.).  她身穿一套绿色羊毛套装，全身的配饰都是跟它配套的。
Sunglasses are much more than a fashion accessory.  太阳镜不仅仅是时尚的装饰品。
Accessories for the top-of-the-range car include leather upholstery, a CD player, electric windows and a sunroof.  顶级轿车的配置包括真皮座椅、CD播放机、电动窗以及活动车顶。UK noun

words.meaning: n.  马刺; vt.  刺激，促进
words.example:
Rising consumer sales have the effect of spurring the economy to faster growth.  消费的成长有刺激经济加速发展的作用。
Spurred (on) by her early success, she went on to write four more novels in rapid succession.  受到之前成功的鼓励，她紧接着又连续写了四部小说。UK verb transitive (-rr-)
The manager said that the team's win on Saturday would be a spur to even greater effort this season.  主教练说球队周六的胜利将会激励全队在本赛季中有更好的表现。UK noun countable

words.meaning: a.  有威望的，有声望的
words.example: a prestigious literary award  颇具声望的文学奖

words.meaning: n.  壕沟
words.example: the trenches of World War I  第一次世界大战时的战壕

words.meaning: n.  天文学
words.example: Astronomy combines physics and math.  天文学结合了物理和数学。

words.meaning: n.  热爱,投入
words.example:
He inspired respect and devotion from his pupils.  他赢得了学生们的尊敬和爱戴。
She will be remembered for her selfless/unstinting devotion to the cause.  人们将铭记她对这项事业的无私／不遗余力的奉献。UK noun uncountable
He knelt in humble devotion.  他虔诚地跪拜在地上。

words.meaning: n.  梗概; 骨架，框架
words.example:
We found an old sheep skeleton up on the cliffs.  我们在悬崖上发现了一副老绵羊的骨架。
figurative Her long illness reduced her to a skeleton (= made her very thin).  长期的疾病使她瘦得只剩皮包骨了。
The skeleton of my book is written/My book is in skeleton form - now I just have to add the details.  我的书已经有了架构——现在我只需要添加细节了。UK noun countable

words.meaning: v.  缝(纫)
words.example:
I've got to sew up that hole in your jeans.  我得把你牛仔裤上的那个洞缝起来。
The Democrats appear to have the election sewn up.  民主党看来已确信会在选举中获胜。
It's going to take another week or two to sew up this deal.  要再花一两个星期才能谈妥这笔交易。

words.meaning: n.  卵,鱼卵vt.  产卵,酿成vi.  产卵
words.example:
disapproving She started screaming that I was a spawn of Satan because I was smoking a cigarette.  她开始尖叫着说，我是魔鬼之子，因为我抽烟。UK verb
The new economic freedom has spawned hundreds of new small businesses.  新的经济自由催生了上百家新的小企业。
Her death spawned countless films and books.  她的去世促成了无数电影和书籍面世。UK verb

words.meaning: vt.  施以,加害,科以,使承受
words.example:
These new bullets are capable of inflicting massive injuries.  这些新型子弹可以造成重创。
The suffering inflicted on these children was unimaginable.  这些孩子遭受的痛苦无法想像。

words.meaning: a.  患精神病的,极愚蠢的
words.example:
For the last ten years of his life he was clinically insane.  在生命的最后十年，他处于临床上的精神失常状态。
informal I sometimes think I'm going insane (= I feel very confused).  我有时觉得自己快要疯了。
In a fit of insane jealousy he tried to stab her.  在一阵疯狂的嫉妒中，他试图用刀捅她。plural noun

words.meaning: adv.  深深地,深刻地;  大大地
words.example:
Society has changed so profoundly over the last fifty years.  在过去的50年里，社会发生了如此深刻的变化。
We are all profoundly grateful for your help and encouragement.  对于你的帮助和鼓励我们都深怀感激。

words.meaning: a.  显著的; 有记号的
words.example:
There was a marked improvement in my health when I gave up smoking.  戒烟后我的健康有了明显的改善。
Unemployment has fallen again, although the change is less marked than last month.  失业率再度下降，尽管降幅没有上个月般明显。
The president spoke with passion for an hour, in marked contrast to his subdued address to the parliament yesterday.  总统慷慨激昂地讲了一个小时，与昨天在议会上低声平和的发言形成了鲜明的对比。

words.meaning: n.  海龟
words.example: The turtle crawled back to the sea.  海龟爬回了大海。

words.meaning: a.  粘的,有粘性的,顽固的
words.example:
The floor's still sticky where I spilled the juice.  我把果汁洒到地上，现在那里还黏乎乎的。
The children's faces were sticky with chocolate.  孩子们的脸上沾满了巧克力，黏乎乎的。    Compare non-stick ; stuck
There were a few sticky moments during the meeting, but everything turned out all right in the end.  会议过程中有几处困难，但最后总算是一切顺利。adjective

words.meaning: n.  骚动,混乱
words.example:
The whole region is in turmoil.  整个地区一片混乱。
The country is in a state of political turmoil.  该国正处于政治动荡。
The Stock Exchange is in turmoil following a huge wave of selling.  经历了一场抛售狂潮后，股市正处于动荡之中。

words.meaning: n.  圣职者,牧师,僧侣,神职人员
words.example: We were surprised when he announced he wanted to join the clergy (= become a priest).  他宣布自己想成为一名牧师时，我们大吃一惊。

words.meaning: vi.  迁徙; 移居
words.example:
These animals migrate annually in search of food.  这些动物为寻找食物每年都迁徙。
In September, these birds migrate 2000 miles south to a warmer climate.  九月，这些鸟会向南迁徙2000英里到更温暖的地方。
Mexican farm workers migrate into the US each year to find work at harvest time.  每年收获季节来临时，大批墨西哥农场工人都会涌入美国找工作。

words.meaning: a.  持续的
words.example:
The president's speech was greeted by sustained applause.  总统的演讲博得了久久不绝的掌声。
We must make a sustained effort to get this task finished this week.  我们必须坚持不懈，争取在本周完成这项任务。

words.meaning: a.  灵敏的，敏锐的
words.example:
They were very keen to start work as soon as possible.  他们渴望尽早开始工作。
Joan wanted to go to a movie but I wasn't keen (= I didn't want to go).  琼想去看电影，但我不想去。
She's keen on (playing) tennis.  她很喜欢打网球。

words.meaning: n.  仪式,典礼,礼拜式,惯例,习俗
words.example: You have to go through an initiation rite before you become a full member.  你得完成入会仪式才能成为正式会员。

words.meaning: a.  想象的,虚构的,假想的
words.example:
As a child I had an imaginary friend called Polly.  小时候我有个想像中的朋友叫波莉。
The story is set in an imaginary world.  故事发生在一个虚构的世界中。

words.meaning: n.  子孙,后代,产物
words.example:
In the case of the guinea pig, the number of offspring varies between two and five.  以豚鼠为例，它一胎产2到5个幼仔。
Tom's sister came round on Saturday with her numerous offspring.  汤姆的姐姐星期六带着她的一大群子女过来串门。

words.meaning: vi.  依附,粘着,坚持,
words.example:
She adhered to her principles/ideals throughout her life.  她终生对自己的原则／理想忠贞不渝。
They failed to adhere to the terms of the agreement/treaty.  他们没有遵守协议／条约的条款。
The translator has obviously adhered very strictly to the original text.  显然，译者严格忠实于原文。

words.meaning: n.  主题,意念,动机,基本花纹
words.example:
We chose some curtains with a flower motif.  我们选择了一些带花卉图案的窗帘。UK noun countable
The motif of betrayal is crucial in all these stories.  在所有这些故事中背叛是至关重要的主题。

words.meaning: a.  潮湿的,多雨的,感伤的,含泪的
words.example:
Keep the soil in the pot moist, but not too wet.  让花盆中的土保持湿润，但不要太湿。
approving This cake is lovely and moist!  这个蛋糕很好吃，非常松软！

words.meaning: vt.  延迟,使延期,缓办,搁延vi.  延缓发作
words.example: They decided to postpone their holiday until next year.  他们决定将假期延后到来年。

words.meaning: n.  受惠者,受益人a.  受封的
words.example: Her husband was the chief beneficiary of her will.  她丈夫是她的遗嘱的主要受益人。

words.meaning: a.  无助的,无能为力的,无依无靠的
words.example:
You feel so helpless because there's nothing you can do to make the child better.  你觉得如此无助，是因为你没有办法使那个孩子病情好转。
The government is helpless (to act) against these crooks.  政府无法对这些骗子采取行动。

words.meaning: n.  速度，速率
words.example:
Light travels at the highest achievable velocity in the universe.  光的传播速度是宇宙中物体所能达到的最高速度。
He always used high velocity lead bullets in his rifle.  他的步枪一直使用高速铅弹。

words.meaning: vt.  使和解,调停,使和谐,使听从,使顺从,使一致
words.example:
It is sometimes difficult to reconcile science and religion.  有时很难调和宗教和科学之间的矛盾。
It's difficult to reconcile such different points of view.  差别如此悬殊的观点是很难达成一致的。
How can you reconcile your fur coat and/with your love of animals?  如果你爱动物，那怎么还穿毛皮大衣呢？

words.meaning: n.  愤怒,狂暴,狂怒的人
words.example:
He could hardly contain his fury.  他几乎克制不住自己的愤怒。
She flew into a fury at the suggestion.  这个建议使她勃然大怒。UK noun [S or U]
I've been working like fury these past few days to catch up.  过去的这几天里我一直奋力工作以求赶上进度。

words.meaning: n.  侮辱,无礼vt.  傲慢无礼,侮辱,刺激
words.example:
She made several insults about my appearance.  她说了几句侮辱我长相的话。
The steelworkers' leader rejected the 2% pay-rise saying it was an insult to the profession.  钢铁工人的领导者拒绝接受2%的加薪，认为这是对他们职业的侮辱。
The instructions are so easy they are an insult to your intelligence (= they seem to suggest you are not clever if you need to use them).  说明如此简单，简直是在侮辱你的智商。verb transitive /ɪnˈsʌlt/

words.meaning: a.  自然的,自发的,未经琢磨的
words.example:
His jokes seemed spontaneous, but were in fact carefully prepared beforehand.  他讲的笑话看似即兴的，但实际上是事先精心准备好的。
approving She's such a spontaneous, lively woman.  她是个为人率直、充满活力的女子。

words.meaning: n.  花; vi.  开花
words.example:
These flowers will bloom all through the summer.  这些花整个夏天都会绽放。verb intransitive
Rimbaud's poetic genius bloomed early.  兰波很早就展露了诗歌才华。noun
The apple trees are in full bloom (= completely covered in flowers).  苹果树开满了花。

words.meaning: a.  细长的; 纤弱的
words.example:
He put his hands around her slender waist.  他双手搂住了她纤细的腰。
The plant's leaves are long and slender.  这株植物叶子细长。
The chances of settling this dispute through talks seem increasingly slender.  透过对谈解决这场争端的机会似乎越来越渺茫。

words.meaning: a.  赤裸的; 十足的
words.example:
It was a stark room with its white walls, and a bed and chair as the only furniture.  这个房间很简陋，家徒四壁，仅有的家俱就是一张床和一把椅子。
The stark reality is that we are operating at a huge loss.  严酷的事实是我们的经营亏损非常严重。
In the suburbs the spacious houses stand in stark contrast to the slums of the city's poor.  郊区宽敞的大房子和城里的贫民窟形成了鲜明的对比。UK adverb

words.meaning: n.  生菜; 莴苣
words.example: Add fresh lettuce to the burger.  汉堡里加点生菜。

words.meaning: n.  接近,亲近
words.example: The best thing about the location of the house is its proximity to the town centre.  这栋房子地理位置最好的就是邻近市中心。

words.meaning: n.  小册子
words.example: The brochure lists all destinations.  小册子列出了所有目的地。

words.meaning: n.  香味; 香料，香水
words.example:
What perfume are you wearing?  你用的是甚么香水？
She adores French perfume.  她非常喜欢法国香水。
The perfume of the roses filled the room.  玫瑰的香气充满了整个房间。

words.meaning: n.  支柱,曲柄,支撑,一对vt.  紧缚,支撑,激励vi.  打起精神
words.example:
He was recently fitted with a brace for his bad back.  他最近因背部受伤戴了一个支撑架。
The side wall of the old house was braced with a wooden support.  老房子的边墙用木结构加固了。verb transitive
The passengers were told to brace themselves (= to press their bodies hard against something or hold them very stiff) for a crash landing.  乘客们被告知要做好紧急迫降准备。

words.meaning: n.  群; 大量; v.  聚结
words.example:
The shepherd is bringing his flock down from the hills.  牧羊人正把他的羊群往山下赶。
The vicar invited all the members of his flock (= all the people who go to his church) to attend the special service.  牧师邀请教区的所有信徒参加这一特别仪式。UK noun
Hundreds of people flocked to the football match.  数百人蜂拥前来观看足球比赛。

words.meaning: vt.  精炼，精制; 使完善
words.example:
Crude oil is industrially refined to purify it and separate out the different elements, such as benzene.  原油经过工业提炼来提纯并且分离出诸如苯之类的不同元素。
Engineers spent many months refining the software.  工程师们花了数月来完善这个软体。

words.meaning: a.  不稳定性的; 挥发性的
words.example:
Food and fuel prices are very volatile in a war situation.  战争时期食品和燃料的价格极易波动。
The situation was made more volatile by the fact that people had been drinking a lot of alcohol.  人们一直在大喝烈酒，这让情况变得更加不稳定。
He had a rather volatile temper and can't have been easy to live with.  他的脾气十分暴躁，别人很难与他相处。

words.meaning: n.  说教,训诫,布道
words.example:
The Reverend William Cronshaw delivered/preached the sermon.  威廉‧克朗肖牧师进行了布道。
Today's sermon was on the importance of compassion.  今天的布道是关于同情心的重要性。

words.meaning: a.  严厉的,严酷的,严格的,精确的,严密的,苛刻的
words.example: rigorous testing/checking/methods  精确的测试／严格的检查／严谨的方法UK adjective

words.meaning: n.  障碍,跳栏,临时活动篱笆vt.  用篱笆围,越过,克服
words.example:
He fell at the last hurdle.  他在最后一个跨栏处摔倒。
She cleared (= jumped over) all the hurdles easily and raced to the finishing line.  她轻松地跨过所有栏架到达终点。
Getting a work permit was the first hurdle to overcome.  取得工作许可证是要解决的第一个难题。

words.meaning: a.  强健的,健全的
words.example: They put up a sturdy defence of their proposal.  他们坚定地为自己的提议辩护。

words.meaning: vi.  变宽,扩大vt.  放宽,使扩大
words.example:
The track broadens and becomes a road at this point.  小道逐渐拓宽，到这里就成了一条马路。
They are broadening the bridge to speed up the flow of traffic.  他们正在拓宽大桥以提高交通流量。UK verb
They've introduced all sorts of new elements to that programme in order to broaden its appeal.  他们已经给那个节目加入了各种新元素以增强其吸引力。

words.meaning: n.  旅行; 航程
words.example:
He was a young sailor on his first sea voyage.  他第一次出海航行时还是个年轻的水手。
figurative The first year of a loving relationship is a voyage (= period) of discovery.  谈恋爱的第一年是彼此了解的阶段。verb intransitive old use or literary
In their little boat they planned to voyage to distant lands.  他们打算乘他们的小船出行去遥远的地方。

words.meaning: a.  确定的，最后的
words.example:
There are no definitive answers/solutions to this problem.  这个问题没有彻底的解决办法。
The police have no definitive proof of her guilt.  员警并未掌握她犯罪的确凿证据。
He's written the definitive (= best and most complete) guide to Britain's Lake District.  他写出了最完美的英国湖区指南。

words.meaning: vt.  推进,驱使
words.example:
The Kon-Tiki sailed across the Pacific Ocean propelled by wind power.  “太阳号”草船借助风力横渡了太平洋。
The film propelled him to international stardom.  这部电影使他成为了国际巨星。

words.meaning: vt.  扭曲,歪曲
words.example: My original statement has been completely distorted by the media.  我最初的说法被媒体彻底歪曲了。

words.meaning: n.  铲子,勺子,独家新闻,口,穴vt.  汲取,舀取,挖空,抢先登出
words.example:
Just one scoop of mashed potato for me, please.  请给我一球马铃薯泥就够了。noun countable
The paper managed to secure a major scoop and broke the scandal to the world.  这家报纸设法抢先报道了重要的独家新闻，把这件丑闻公诸于世。verb transitive
He scooped the sand into a bucket with his hands.  他用手把沙子舀进桶里。

words.meaning: v.  复制
words.example:
Researchers tried many times to replicate the original experiment.  研究者们作了很多次努力，试图重复这一实验。
Chromosomes replicate before cells divide and multiply.  染色体自我复制后，细胞便开始分裂、繁殖。

words.meaning: n.  雨燕,大滚筒a.  迅速的,快的,敏捷的,立刻的ad.  迅速地,敏捷地
words.example:
The local police took swift action against the squatters.  当地警方对擅自占地者采取了迅速的行动。
Thank you for your swift reply.  感谢您的即时回覆。
The gazelle is one of the swiftest and most graceful of animals.  瞪羚是最敏捷、最优雅的动物之一。noun countable

words.meaning: vt.  解开,打开,取消,扰乱,毁灭,破坏vi.  松开v.  撤消
words.example:
Can someone help me to undo my seat belt?  有人能帮我解开安全带吗？ (undoing, undid, undone)
It's very difficult to undo the damage that's caused by inadequate parenting in a child's early years.  孩子年幼时缺少父母关爱所造成的不良后果很难消除。

words.meaning: n.  茎,追踪,高视阔步vi.  悄悄靠近,蹑手蹑脚地走近,蔓延,高视阔步vt.
words.example:
She trimmed the stalks of the tulips before putting them in a vase.  她修剪了一下郁金香的花梗，然后把它们插进了花瓶。
The eyes of shrimps are on movable stalks.  虾的眼睛长在能够活动的肉柄上。UK noun countable
His eyes were out on stalks as he watched his neighbour drive past in a brand new Porsche.  看到邻居开着一辆崭新的保时捷经过时，他吃惊得瞪大了眼睛。UK verb

words.meaning: vt.  威胁,恐吓,胁迫
words.example: They were intimidated into accepting a pay cut by the threat of losing their jobs.  他们因为受到失去工作的威胁而被迫同意减薪。

words.meaning: n.  瘟疫,麻烦,灾祸vt.  折磨,使苦恼,使得灾祸
words.example:
Financial problems have been plaguing their new business partners.  财务问题一直困扰着他们的新业务伙伴。
My shoulder's been plaguing me all week.  我的肩膀整个星期都很难受。
The children plagued him with questions all through lunch.  吃午餐时孩子不停地问他问题，使他感到烦厌。

words.meaning: n.  蕾丝; 缎带
words.example:
Your shoe laces are undone.  你的鞋带没有系好。verb transitive
She can lace up her shoes and she's only five!  她才五岁就能自己系鞋带！

words.meaning: v.  阻止
words.example:
These measures are designed to deter an enemy attack.  这些措施旨在阻止敌人的进攻。
High prices are deterring many young people from buying houses.  高昂的价格让很多年轻人对于买房屋望而却步。

words.meaning: vi.  期满,呼气,断气vt.  呼出
words.example:
Our television license expires next month.  我们的电视下个月到期要缴费了。
The contract between the two companies will expire at the end of the year.  两间公司之间的合约将在年底到期。UK verb intransitive

words.meaning: a.  毗连的,邻近的,接近的
words.example:
They work in adjacent buildings.  他们在相邻的两座楼里工作。
They lived in a house adjacent to the railway.  他们家住在铁路旁边。

words.meaning: a.  散乱的,污秽的,麻烦的
words.example:
His bedroom's always messy.  他的卧室总是凌乱不堪。
Eating spaghetti can be a messy business.  吃义大利面有时会把周围弄得脏兮兮。
Vicky cooks really well but she's rather messy.  维琪的厨艺真的很不错，不过她把东西弄得乱糟糟的。adjective

words.meaning: n.  大灾难,大祸
words.example:
They were warned of the ecological catastrophe to come.  警告过他们生态灾难即将来临。
The emigration of scientists is a catastrophe for the country.  大量科学家移居国外对这个国家大为不利。

words.meaning: a.  不可预知的
words.example:
The weather there can be a bit unpredictable - one minute it's blue skies and the next minute it's pouring down.  那里的天气有点儿变幻莫测—— 一会儿晴空万里，一会儿又大雨倾盆。
The hours in this job are very unpredictable - you sometimes have to work late at very short notice.  这份工作的时间非常不固定——有时突然接到通知就得工作到很晚。

words.meaning: n.  象牙
words.example: intricately carved ivory earrings  精雕细琢的象牙耳饰

words.meaning: n.  胚胎; 雏形
words.example:
Between the eighth week of development and birth a human embryo is called a foetus.  从发育第八周到出生这段时间，人类的胚胎被称作胎儿。
The department's plans for enlargement are still in embryo.  这个系的扩建计划仍在酝酿之中。

words.meaning: vi.  一致,符合
words.example:
If the heavy rain had coincided with an extreme high tide, serious flooding would have resulted.  如果暴雨来临时潮水汹涌，就会导致严重的水灾。
Our views coincide on a range of subjects.  我们在一系列问题上的观点不谋而合。
If our schedules coincide, we'll go to Spain together.  如果我们的排程一致，就能一起去西班牙。

words.meaning: vt.  超越,胜过
words.example:
The best films are those which transcend national or cultural barriers.  最优秀的影片是那些超越了民族或文化障碍的影片。
The underlying message of the film is that love transcends everything else.  这部电影内在的中心意旨是爱超越其他一切。

words.meaning: n.  护送者,护卫者,护航舰vt.  护卫,护送
words.example:
Several little boats escorted the sailing ship into the harbour.  在数只小船的护航下，帆船驶入海港。
Security guards escorted the intruders from the building.  保安把闯入者押送出了大楼。
The police escorted her to the airport, and made sure that she left the country.  员警将她押送到机场，确保其离境。

words.meaning: n.  厩,停车处,牧师职位,拖延,托辞,货摊vt.  关入厩,停顿,使陷于泥中,
words.example:
In the village market, the stalls are piled high with local vegetables.  村子市集的摊位上高高堆着当地产的蔬菜。UK noun
There was one bathroom with a shower stall in the corner.  有一个洗手间，角落里有个淋浴的小隔间。UK noun
She says she'll give me the money next week but I think she's just stalling (for time).  她说下周会把钱给我，但我认为她只不过是在拖时间。

words.meaning: n.  契约,协定,条约
words.example: The United States and Canada have signed a free-trade pact.  美国和加拿大签署了自由贸易协定。

words.meaning: vt.  得出，引出
words.example:
Have you managed to elicit a response from them yet?  你设法得到他们的回覆了吗？
The questionnaire was intended to elicit information on eating habits.  该调查问卷旨在收集人们饮食习惯方面的资讯。
They were able to elicit the support of the public.  他们获得了大众的支持。

words.meaning: v.  打听，询问
words.example:
Shall I inquire about the price of tickets?  我可以问一下票价吗？
Saturday staff needed - Inquire within.  招聘周六工作人员——详情请入内查询。(UK also enquire) UK verb intransitive or transitive
She inquired after his grandfather's health.  她询问了他祖父的健康状况。(UK also enquire) UK verb intransitive or transitive

words.meaning: vt.  象征,预示vi.  要紧
words.example:
Nobody really knows what the marks on the ancient stones signify.  没人真正知道那些古老石头上的记号代表甚么含意。
She signified her agreement by nodding her head.  她点头表示同意。
Don't worry about being late - it doesn't signify.  别担心迟到——不要紧。

words.meaning: n.  引人注目的事物; v.  溅，泼
words.example:
Water was splashing from a hole in the roof.  水从屋顶的洞里泼溅下来。
Unfortunately some paint splashed onto the rug.  糟糕的是小地毯上溅到了一些油漆。
She splashed her face with cold water.  她往脸上泼冷水。

words.meaning: n.  声望,威望,威信
words.example:
The company has gained international prestige.  该公司赢得了国际声誉。
Many people are attracted by the prestige of working for a top company.  在一家一流公司工作令人羡慕，很多人因此被吸引了。adjective [before noun]

words.meaning: n.  立体感(表现法)
words.example: The modeling clay is soft.  橡皮泥很软。

words.meaning: a.  语言的，语言学的
words.example: I'm particularly interested in the linguistic development of young children.  我对幼儿语言能力的发展尤其感兴趣。

words.meaning: n.  污点，污渍
words.example:
Tomato sauce stains terribly - it's really difficult to get it out of clothes.  蕃茄酱一沾上就很麻烦——很难把它从衣服上洗掉。
While she was changing the wheel on her car, her coat had become stained with oil.  她帮汽车换轮胎时，外套沾上了油污。
This carpet is ideal for the kitchen because it doesn't stain easily.  这块地毯很适合在厨房里用，因为它很耐脏（不怕脏）。

words.meaning: vt.  揭开,揭幕,除去. . . 的面纱vi.  显露,除去面纱
words.example: The memorial to those who had died in the war was unveiled in 1948 by the Queen.  缅怀战争死难者的纪念碑于1948年由女王揭幕。

words.meaning: a.  即将来临的,逼近的
words.example: imminent disaster/danger  迫在眉睫的灾难／危险

words.meaning: n.  箔,烘托,衬托vt.  衬托,阻止,贴箔于,挫败,挡开
words.example:
The older, cynical character in the play is the perfect foil for the innocent William.  剧中年迈、愤世嫉俗的人物角色正好衬托出威廉的天真单纯。noun
The prisoners' attempt to escape was foiled at the last minute when police received a tip-off.  由于警方收到密报，囚犯的越狱企图在最后一刻被挫败。

words.meaning: n.  娱乐，消遣
words.example:
She looked at him with amusement.  她忍俊不禁地看着他。
Carl came last in the race, (much) to my amusement.  卡尔比赛得了个倒数第一，（真）把我给乐坏了。
There was a range of fairground amusements, including rides, stalls and competitions.  在露天游乐场有很多好玩的，可以骑马、逛货摊以及参加比赛。

words.meaning: n.  人类学
words.example: She majors in anthropology.  她主修人类学。

words.meaning: a.  活生生的,活泼的,愉快的
words.example:
There was an extremely animated discussion on the subject.  这个话题引起了极其热烈的讨论。
They must have been having an interesting conversation - they both looked very animated.  他们一定是在进行甚么有趣的谈话，两人看上去都兴致勃勃的。UK adjective

words.meaning: n.  抑制,勒马绳,边石vt.  抑制,束缚,勒住
words.example:
The Government should act to curb tax evasion.  政府应该采取行动抑制逃税。UK noun countable
You must try to put a curb on your bad temper/spending habits.  你必须尽量控制你的坏脾气／挥霍无度的习惯。UK noun countable

words.meaning: a.  暗示的,盲从的,绝对的,固有的
words.example:
He interpreted her comments as an implicit criticism of the government.  他将她的评论理解为对政府的含蓄批评。
Implicit in the poem's closing lines are the poet's own religious doubts.  在这首诗最后几行中隐含着诗人自己的宗教疑虑。    Compare explicitadjective
All her life she had implicit faith in socialism.  她一生都对社会主义坚信不疑。

words.meaning: adv.  由基因决定地，与遗传有关地
words.example: The crop is genetically modified.  这作物是转基因的。

words.meaning: a.  圆形的,循环的,周围的
words.example: Circulars and other junk mail go straight in the bin.  传单和其他的垃圾邮件直接扔进垃圾桶。

words.meaning: a.  空的,空白的,空灵的,空缺的,茫然的
words.example:
The hospital has no vacant beds.  这家医院没有空床位。    Compare engaged
When the post fell (= became) vacant, Dennis Bass was appointed to fill it.  邓尼斯．巴斯被任命填补那个职位空缺。adjective
She had a vacant look/expression on her face.  她一脸的茫然。

words.meaning: n.  补足物,补语,余角vt.  补助,补足
words.example:
Strawberries and cream complement each other perfectly.  草莓加鲜奶油相得益彰。
The music complements her voice perfectly.  音乐使她的嗓音妙不可言。

words.meaning: vt.  分派,分配
words.example:
The government is allocating £10 million for health education.  政府将拨出1000万英镑作为健康教育经费。
It is not the job of the investigating committee to allocate blame for the disaster/to allocate blame to individuals.  调查委员会的任务不是确定谁该为这场灾难负责任／哪些人应该负责任。

words.meaning: a.  茂盛的
words.example:
He's so lush.  他真有吸引力。noun countable slang
She's a bit of a lush by all accounts.  不管怎么说她都有点像酒鬼。

words.meaning: adj.  1 a.  慈悲为怀的;  仁慈的,慈善的b.  [对…]慈悲 [仁慈] 的[to]
words.example:
The entire organization is funded by charitable donations.  整个组织由慈善捐款资助。
The school has charitable status (= It is officially a charity).  这是一所慈善学校。UK adjective
Some critics said the show was good in parts - those less charitable said the whole thing was a disaster.  有些批评家说演出有些部分还不错——而那些不那么厚道的批评家则说整场演出都糟透了。

words.meaning: a.  难得的,蟍钡?缺乏的
words.example:
Food and clean water were becoming scarce.  食物和干净的水越来越少了。
Dad's really angry with you, so you'd better make yourself scarce.  爸爸很生你的气，你最好离他躲远一点。

words.meaning: n.  包围,围攻,再三的努力vt.  包围,围攻
words.example:
The siege of Mafeking lasted for eight months.  对马弗京的围攻持续了八个月。
The soldiers laid siege to (= started a siege of) the city.  士兵们包围了这座城市。
The castle was under siege for months.  城堡被围困了数月。

words.meaning: a.  普遍深入的
words.example:
The influence of Freud is pervasive in her books.  佛洛伊德的影响在她的作品中随处可见。
Reforms are being undermined by the all- pervasive corruption in the country.  改革正受到国内普遍存在的腐败现象侵蚀。

words.meaning: a.  普遍的; 流行的
words.example:
The prevailing mood is one of optimism.  普遍的情绪是乐观的。
The town is kept cool by the prevailing westerly winds.  由于西风盛行，这个城镇很凉爽。

words.meaning: n.  烧烤野餐
words.example: The barbecue lasted till midnight.  烧烤持续到午夜。

words.meaning: a.  明确的,一定的
words.example:
The date for the meeting is now definite: 5th March.  开会的日期现在已经确定了：3月5日。
She has very definite opinions.  她的意见非常明确。
We need a definite answer by tomorrow.  我们需要在明天之前得到明确的答覆。

words.meaning: n.  沼泽，湿地
words.example:
At the mouth of the river is a large area of marsh.  河口处是一大片沼泽地。
Rain had been falling steadily all day and the ground had become a marsh.  雨整天下个不停，地面成了一片泽国。
At low tide in the estuary, cows graze on the marshes.  河口水位低时，牛就在那里的沼泽地上吃草。

words.meaning: a.  逐渐的，逐步的
words.example:
There has been a gradual improvement in our sales figures over the last two years.  在过去的两年里，我们的销售额一直在逐步上升。
As you go further south, you will notice a gradual change of climate.  当你一路往南走下去的时候，你就会注意到气候的细微变化。

words.meaning: vt.  移置,替换,转移
words.example: The building of a new dam will displace thousands of people who live in this area.  建造新水坝将迫使居住在这一地区的数千人迁往别处。

words.meaning: n.  独居者a.  孤独的,独居的
words.example:
On the hill, a solitary figure was busy chopping down trees.  山上，有个人正忙着砍树。
In the distance was a solitary building.  远处是一栋孤零零的建筑。
He was a solitary child (= He enjoyed being alone).  他是个喜欢独处的小孩。

words.meaning: n.  文件
words.example: Passengers without proper documentation (= official papers saying who they are) will not be allowed to travel.  没有相关证件的乘客将不允许旅行。

words.meaning: a.  (南、北)极的
words.example: The novel deals with the polar opposites of love and hate.  这部小说涉及爱和恨的两个对立面。

words.meaning: n.  剩余物，残余
words.example:
It rained the first day but the remainder of the trip was lovely.  旅行中第一天下了雨，不过其余的日子天气都很好。UK noun
His autobiography never sold very well and was soon remaindered.  他的自传一直卖得不太好，过了不久就被削价处理了。

words.meaning: n.  海军
words.example:
My brother is an officer in the Navy.  我兄弟是海军军官。
Gabriel joined the navy in 1997.  加伯利于1997年加入海军。
He was wearing a navy sweater.  他穿着一件深蓝色的毛线衣。

words.meaning: a.  未决定的,待决的prep.  当. . . 的时候,在. . . 期间
words.example:
There were whispers that a deal was pending.  有传言说即将达成一笔交易。
The pending releases of the prisoners are meant to create a climate for negotiation.  囚犯即将获释，此目的是要营造一个有利谈判的氛围。preposition formal
The identity of the four people was not made public, pending (the) notification of relatives.  四名受害者的身分要等到家属确认之后才能公开。

words.meaning: n.  空虚,空间,空虚感,空隙,真空a.  空的,无人的,空闲的,无效的,无用的
words.example:
She stood at the edge of the chasm and stared into the void.  她站在裂缝的边缘凝视着下面的深渊。
Before Einstein, space was regarded as a formless void.  在爱因斯坦之前，太空被认为是无形的虚空之地。
They tried to describe their attempts to fill the void left by their son's death.  他们竭力想要描述他们曾如何试图填补儿子死后留下的空虚感。adjective

words.meaning: n.  暴跌,意气消沉vi.  猛然掉落,陷入,消沉
words.example:
The value of property has slumped.  房产价值突然下跌。
Car sales have slumped dramatically over the past year.  过去一年汽车的销售额大幅下降。verb
She slumped into the chair, exhausted.  她颓然跌坐在椅子上，筋疲力尽。noun countable

words.meaning: v.  发嗡嗡声; interj.  嗯嗯(表示犹豫)
words.example:
The computers were humming in the background.  电脑在某个不显眼的地方嗡嗡作响。
What's that strange humming sound?  那种奇怪的嗡嗡声是甚么？
She hummed to herself as she walked to school.  她在上学的路上边走边哼曲子。

words.meaning: n.  合成物质a.  综合性的,人造的
words.example: She criticized the synthetic charm of television presenters.  她批评电视节目主持人矫揉造作。

words.meaning: n.  花岗岩
words.example: The countertop is polished granite.  台面是抛光花岗岩。

words.meaning: n.  糖浆，果汁
words.example: cough syrup  止咳糖浆

words.meaning: vt.  模仿
words.example:
She was mimicking the various people in our office.  她在学我们办公室里各人的样子。noun countable
She's a brilliant mimic.  她非常擅长模仿。

words.meaning: vt.  抑制,阻止,束缚
words.example:
When he started fighting, it took four police officers to restrain him.  他要是出手打人，要四个员警才能把他制服。
You should try to restrain your ambitions and be more realistic.  你应该尽量控制自己的野心，更现实一些。
Growth in car ownership could be restrained by increasing taxes.  或许可以透过提高税费来限制汽车保有量的增长。

words.meaning: vt.  腐蚀,侵蚀vi.  受腐蚀
words.example:
Wind and rain have eroded the statues into shapeless lumps of stone.  这些雕像遭受风雨侵蚀，成了一堆堆不成形的乱石。
The cliffs are eroding several feet a year.  这些悬崖每年都被侵蚀掉数英尺。
His behaviour over the last few months has eroded my confidence in his judgment.  他过去几个月的表现已经使我对他的判断力渐渐失去了信心。

words.meaning: n.  饮料
words.example:
Hot beverages include tea, coffee and hot chocolate.  热饮包括茶、咖啡和热巧克力。
We do not sell alcoholic beverages.  我们不出售含酒精的饮料。

words.meaning: n.  混血儿,杂种,混合物a.  混合的,杂种的,混合语的
words.example: The garden strawberry is a large-fruited hybrid.  人工栽种的草莓是一种果实较大的混合品种。

words.meaning: n.  (海狸等的)巢穴
words.example:
She lodged with Mrs Higgins when she first came to Cambridge.  她第一次来剑桥时借宿在希金斯太太家里。UK verb
The US lodged a formal protest against the arrest of the foreign reporters.  美国就外国记者被捕一事提出正式抗议。
Lee's solicitor said last night that they would be lodging an appeal against the sentence.  昨晚李的律师说他们将对此项判决提起上诉。UK verb

words.meaning: vt.  刺穿,穿透,洞悉vi.  刺入
words.example:
The needle pierces the fabric four times a second.  针穿过布料的速度是每秒钟四次。
The gun fires a shell capable of piercing the armour of an enemy tank.  这种炮所发射的炮弹能打穿敌人坦克的装甲。
The hole they drilled pierces 6 km into the Earth's crust.  他们钻的孔深入地壳六公里。

words.meaning: n.  大草原
words.example: Buffalo once roamed the prairie.  野牛曾在草原上漫游。

words.meaning: vt.  超越,凌驾,胜过
words.example:
His time for the 100 metres surpassed the previous world record by one hundredth of a second.  他以0.01秒的优势打破了100米短跑的前世界纪录。
The book's success has surpassed everyone's expectations.  这本书获得出乎所有人意料的成功。

words.meaning: v.  坐公交车上下班
words.example:
It's exhausting commuting from Brighton to London every day.  每天上下班要往返于布莱顿与伦敦之间，令人疲惫不堪。verb
People used to believe that you could commute base metals into gold.  人们过去曾认为能将贱金属变成黄金。
Her sentence was commuted from death to life imprisonment.  对她的判决由死刑减为无期徒刑。noun countable informal

words.meaning: n.  闲聊,随笔,流言,爱讲闲话的人vi.  说闲话,闲聊
words.example:
Her letter was full of gossip.  她信里讲的都是些闲言闲语。
Jane and Lyn sat in the kitchen having a good gossip about their friends.  简和琳恩坐在厨房里大聊特聊自己的那班朋友。
I've got some juicy gossip for you.  我有些特别有趣的小道传闻告诉你。

words.meaning: vt.  反驳,与. . . 抵触,与. . . 矛盾vi.  反驳
words.example:
If you're both going to lie, at least stick to the same story and don't contradict each other!  如果你们俩都要撒谎，至少也要口径一致，不要互相矛盾！
How dare you contradict (me)!  你怎么敢顶撞我！
Recent evidence has tended to contradict established theories on this subject.  关于这一问题，最近发现的证据与即存理论有相抵触的倾向。

words.meaning: n.  中间物,调停者a.  中间的,中级的vi.  起媒介作用n.  中级
words.example:
There are three levels of difficulty in this game: low, intermediate and high.  这个游戏有三个难度级别
This novel is too difficult for intermediate students of English.  这本小说对于中等程度的英语学习者来说太难了。

words.meaning: a.  当时的,暂时的,太阳穴的,世俗的,现世的n.  世间万物,教会财产
words.example: The temple shows both sacred and temporal power.  寺庙体现了神权与世俗权力。

words.meaning: a.  月亮的
words.example: the lunar surface  月球的表面

words.meaning: n.  崩,薨,死亡vt.  让渡,遗赠,转让
words.example: The demise of the company was sudden and unexpected.  该公司出人意料地突然倒闭了。

words.meaning: v.  说; a.  完全的
words.example:
She sat through the whole meeting without uttering a word.  整个会议期间她干坐着，一言不发。UK adjective [before noun]
The meeting was a complete and utter waste of time.  这个会议完全是浪费时间。
Lying back in the hot bath was utter bliss.  泡热水澡真是神仙般的享受。

words.meaning: n.  火山口; (弹)坑
words.example: With a good telescope, you can see craters on the moon.  用好的望远镜能看到月亮上的环形山。

words.meaning: vt.  使富足,使肥沃
words.example:
Fertilizer helps to enrich the soil.  化肥可以提高土壤肥沃度。
My life was greatly enriched by knowing her.  认识了她，让我的生活变得非常充实。verb
He claimed that the large stores were enriching themselves at the expense of their customers.  他声称大型商店藉由剥削顾客而获利。

words.meaning: n.  潜水艇，潜艇
words.example: a nuclear submarine  核潜艇

words.meaning: vt.  处理,排列,布置vi.  处置
words.example:
His rudeness when we first met didn't dispose me very kindly to/towards him.  我们首次会面时，他那粗暴的态度使我对他没产生甚么好感。UK US  formal
How did they dispose of the body?  他们是如何处理尸体的？
It took a mere five minutes for the world champion to dispose of (= defeat) his opponent.  世界冠军只用五分钟就击败了对手。

words.meaning: n.  垫子,橡皮软垫vt.  加垫褥,缓冲,掩盖
words.example:
She sank back against/into the cushions.  她向后靠在垫子上。
The soft grass cushioned his fall.  柔软的草地减缓了他摔落时的冲力。verb transitive
He's lost his job, but the redundancy money will cushion the blow.  他丢了工作，不过遣散费会减轻对他的打击。

words.meaning: vt.  理解,包括
words.example: He doesn't seem to comprehend the scale of the problem  他似乎没意识到问题的严重性。

words.meaning: n.  松鼠
words.example: As soon as I get paid, I squirrel some money away so I won't be tempted to spend it.  我一发薪水，就把一部分存起来，以免忍不住想花。

words.meaning: n.  青春期
words.example: a troubled adolescence  经历坎坷的青春期

words.meaning: n.  营业性高级服务厅
words.example: a beauty salon  美容院

words.meaning: vt.  注定,预定
words.example: The ship was destined for Shanghai.  轮船开往上海。

words.meaning: a.  描述性的
words.example: a descriptive essay/passage  描述性文章／段落

words.meaning: a.  堂堂的,华丽的,极好的
words.example:
He is a superb dancer.  他是一个杰出的舞蹈家。
Taylor scored a superb goal at the end of the first half.  泰勒在上半场要结束的时候攻入了一个极为精彩的进球。

words.meaning: vt. vi.  疏散,撤出,排泄
words.example:
The police evacuated the village shortly before the explosion.  在爆炸前不久，员警将这个村庄里的人全都疏散了。
When toxic fumes began to drift toward our homes, we were told to evacuate.  当毒雾开始朝我们住宅区方向飘移时，我们被通知撤离。

words.meaning: n.  压碎的东西,南瓜,拥挤嘈杂的人群vt.  压扁,镇压,压制vi. 被压扁,发
words.example:
He accidentally sat on her hat and squashed it.  他不小心坐在她的帽子上，把它坐扁了。UK verb
The room was so full you couldn't squash another person in.  房间里挤得满满的，再也挤不进一个人了。
If you all squashed up (= moved closer together) , we could fit an extra person in the car.  要是你们再挤挤，我们车里就能多坐一个人。

words.meaning: a.  难懂的,易忘的,难捉摸的
words.example:
The answers to these questions remain as elusive as ever.  这些问题的答案仍然是不得而知。
Success, however, remained elusive for her.  但是对她来说，成功仍然不可企及。

words.meaning: vt.  附属,接纳vi.  有关
words.example:
The school is affiliated with a national association of driving schools.  这所学校隶属于一个全国驾驶学校协会。noun countable /əˈfɪl.i.ət/
Our college is an affiliate of the university.  我们学院隶属于这所大学。

words.meaning: vi. vt.  避开,躲避n.  诡计,躲藏
words.example:
He dodged to avoid the hurtling bicycle.  他闪身躲过了疾驰而来的脚踏车。
The minister dodged questions about his relationship with the actress.  部长迴避了关于他与那位女演员之间关系的问题。UK noun countable informal
They bought another car as a tax dodge (= a way to avoid paying tax).  为了逃税，他们又买了一辆汽车。

words.meaning: a.  令人惊异的,了不起的,不平常的
words.example: What a marvelous performance!  多么精彩的演出！

words.meaning: n.  保护; 免除
words.example:
The vaccination gives you immunity against the disease for up to six months.  注射这种疫苗会使你对这种疾病有长达六个月的免疫力。
He was granted immunity from prosecution because he confessed the names of the other spies.  他因供出了其他间谍的名字而免受起诉。

words.meaning: n.  飓风，龙卷风
words.example: The tornado tore through the town.  龙卷风席卷了小镇。

words.meaning: n.  水牛
words.example: A herd of buffalo crossed the river.  一群水牛过了河。

words.meaning: [pl.  nuclei]n.  核子，核心
words.example: These three players will form the nucleus of a revised and stronger team.  这三名运动员将成为一支调整后实力更强的队伍的核心。

words.meaning: vi.  遵守，符合; 适应
words.example:
At our school, you were required to conform, and there was no place for originality.  我们学校要求每个人循规蹈矩，容不得创新求变。UK verb intransitive
Before buying a pram, make sure that it conforms to the official safety standards.  购买婴儿车之前，要确保它符合官方的安全标准。
Members must conform to a strict dress code.  成员们必须遵守严格的衣着规定。

words.meaning: n.  装船,出货
words.example: The shipment arrived without damage.  货物完好到达。

words.meaning: n.  芽,花蕾vi.  发芽,萌芽vt.  使发芽
words.example:
It was springtime and the fruit trees were in bud.  春天到了，果树发芽了。noun countable
The unusually cold winter has caused many plants to bud late this year.  今年冬天异常寒冷，许多植物抽芽都晚了。

words.meaning: vt.  经得住，耐
words.example:
Our toys are designed to withstand the rough treatment of the average five-year-old.  我们的玩具设计要能经得住一般五岁儿童粗野的摆弄。
The aircraft base is protected with specially designed shelters which are built to withstand ground and air attacks.  空军基地有特殊设计的掩体保护，能够抵挡地面和空中袭击。
She is an artist whose work will undoubtedly withstand the test of time (= it will still be popular in the future).  她这样一位元艺术家的作品毫无疑问能经受得起时间的考验。

words.meaning: vt.  排出
words.example:
The new government has expelled all foreign diplomats.  新政府驱逐了所有外国外交官。
My brother was expelled from school for bad behaviour.  我弟弟因为行为不当被学校开除了。 (-ll-)
She took a deep breath, then expelled the air in short blasts.  她深深吸了一口气，然后一下子把空气呼出来。

words.meaning: n.  消失,消灭,废止
words.example:
The extinction of the dinosaurs occurred millions of years ago.  恐龙在几百万年前已经绝种
Many species of plants and animals are in danger of/threatened with extinction (= being destroyed so that they no longer exist).  多种动植物都面临绝种的危机。
Some people predict the extinction of family life as we know it today.  一些人预言我们现在熟知的家庭生活方式将会消失。

words.meaning: a.  普遍的,流行的
words.example:
These diseases are more prevalent among young children.  这些疾病在幼儿中更普遍。
Trees are dying in areas where acid rain is most prevalent.  树木在酸雨非常严重的地区正面临枯死。

words.meaning: a.  良性的
words.example: The biopsy showed a benign growth.  活检显示良性增生。

words.meaning: n.  木材，木料
words.example: In the distance, we could see a herd of elephants lumbering across the plain.  我们可以看见远处有一群大象缓缓穿过平原。UK verb intransitive usually + adverb or preposition

words.meaning: n.  奉献; 题献词
words.example:
He has always shown great dedication to the cause.  他对这项事业一直都表现出强烈的奉献精神。
She thanked the staff for their dedication and enthusiasm.  她感谢全体员工的奉献精神和工作热情。noun
The dedication at the front of the book read 'For my Father'.  书前面的致谢辞中写道：“献给我的父亲。”noun

words.meaning: a.  高低不平的,崎岖的,粗糙的
words.example:
Jeeps are rugged vehicles, designed for rough conditions.  吉普车是种很皮实的车，专为崎岖难行的路况而设计的。
She fell for his rugged good looks.  她为他英俊粗犷的相貌所倾倒。

words.meaning: n.  大石头
words.example: A boulder blocked the path.  一块巨石挡住了路。

words.meaning: a.  互相密合着的,凝聚性的,连贯的
words.example: When she calmed down, she was more coherent (= able to speak clearly and be understood).  她冷静下来后，讲话有条理多了。

words.meaning: vt.  绑架,诱拐,拐骗
words.example: The wife of a businessman has been kidnapped from her home in Surrey.  一个商人的妻子在她萨里郡的家中遭绑架。noun countable or uncountable

words.meaning: a.  倾向于的,易于的,恰当的,聪明的
words.example:
The kitchen roof is apt to (= likely to) leak when it rains.  一下雨厨房屋顶就容易漏水。
She's in her eighties now and apt to be a bit forgetful.  她已经80多岁了，有些健忘。adjective
We have some particularly apt students in the class this year.  这学年班里有几个特别聪明的学生。

words.meaning: a.  最佳的，最理想的
words.example: Find the optimal solution for the problem.  为问题找到最优解。

words.meaning: n.  主要(食品、产品); 原材料; vt.  把…订起来; a.  主要的
words.example:
Would you mind stapling the reports together ?  你能把报告用订书机订好吗？noun countable
Shortages mean that even staples (= basic foods) like bread are difficult to find.  物资短缺意味着连面包之类的主食都难觅踪影。
Phosphate has been a staple of this area for many years.  磷酸盐多年来一直是这一地区的主要产品。

words.meaning: a.  机密的,获他人信赖的,易于信任他人的
words.example: All information will be treated as strictly confidential.  所有的情报都将被视作绝密。

words.meaning: a.  能共处的,可并立的,适合的
words.example:
It was when we started living together that we found we just weren't compatible.  等到开始生活在一起时，才发现我们根本合不来。
This software may not be compatible with older operating systems.  该软体可能与较早期的作业系统不相容。
Such policies are not compatible with democratic government.  此类政策与民主政体格格不入。

words.meaning: a.  易受影响的,易感动的,容许. . . 的
words.example:
She isn't very susceptible to flattery.  她不太听信别人的奉承。
These plants are particularly susceptible to frost.  这些植物很容易受霜冻影响。
Among particularly susceptible children, the disease can develop very fast.  在特别易受感染的儿童中，这种疾病会扩展得非常迅速。

words.meaning: a.  无情的,冷酷的,残酷的
words.example: relentless criticism/pressure  不断的严厉批评／施压

words.meaning: n.  天篷，遮篷
words.example: Sunlight filtered through the canopy.  阳光透过树冠洒下。

words.meaning: vi.  崩溃,破碎,灭亡vt.  弄碎n.  面包屑
words.example:
She nervously crumbled the bread between her fingers.  她紧张地在指间捻着面包。
The cliffs on which the houses are built are starting to crumble.  上面建有房屋的悬崖开始倾颓瓦解。
Support for the government is crumbling.  对政府的支援日渐减少。noun countable or uncountable UK (US crisp)

words.meaning: n.  固定物,设备
words.example:
All fixtures and fittings are included in the house price.  所有固定装置和可拆除设备都包括在房价里。
figurative They've been together so long he's become a permanent fixture in her life.  他们在一起太久了，他已经成为她生活中不可缺少的一部分。    Compare fittingUK noun countable
Next season's fixtures will be published early next month.  下赛季的赛事日程将在下月初公布。

words.meaning: a.  愤世嫉俗的,讽刺的,冷嘲的
words.example:
I've always been deeply cynical about politicians.  我对政客们总是嗤之以鼻。
She works in that most cynical of industries - advertising.  她于最具煽惑性的行业中工作——广告行业。
He praises my cooking but it's just a cynical ploy to get me to make his meals.  他夸我烧一手好菜只不过是在耍花招，哄我给他做饭。

words.meaning: n.  商品,存货vi. vt.  交易,买卖
words.example:
Shoppers complained about poor quality merchandise and high prices.  顾客抱怨商品品质差、价格高。
Japan exported $117 billion in merchandise to the US in 1999.  1999年日本向美国出口了价值1170亿美元的商品。verb transitive UK US     US specialized
She had to merchandise the new product line.  她不得不推销这条新产品线。

words.meaning: a.  钝的,坦率的,麻痹的
words.example:
I'll be blunt - that last piece of work you did was terrible.  我就直说了——你创作的最后一件作品糟糕透了。verb transitive
My recent bad experience has rather blunted my enthusiasm for travel.  最近的倒楣经历已经使我对旅游的热情减弱了不少。

words.meaning: n.  感谢的心情
words.example:
She sent them a present to show/express her gratitude.  她送了他们一件礼物，以表达她的感激之情。
Take this as a token of my gratitude for all your help.  你帮了我那么多忙，这个就当是我的一点心意吧。

words.meaning: n.  颜色; 类型
words.example:
In the Caribbean waters there are fish of every hue.  加勒比海水域的鱼五颜六色。noun countable
Politicians of all hues wish to get sleaze off the agenda so that they can discuss the real issues.  各个党派的与会者都希望将那些卑劣之事从议事日程中去掉，这样他们就可以讨论真正的问题了。noun countable
There has been a great hue and cry about the council's plans to close the school.  市政会关闭这所学校的计划受到强烈抗议。

words.meaning: n. [pl.  fungi]真菌，菌类植物
words.example:
Mushrooms and mould are funguses.  蘑菇和霉菌都是真菌。
Fungus can be poisonous.  真菌类植物可能会有毒。

words.meaning: n.  酶，酵素
words.example: An enzyme in the saliva of the mouth starts the process of breaking down the food.  由于唾液中酶的作用，食物进入口腔时就开始了分解过程。

words.meaning: n.  截取,妨碍,截距vt.  拦截,阻止,截取
words.example:
Law enforcement agents intercepted a shipment of drugs from Latin America.  执法人员截获了一批从拉丁美洲运来的毒品。
Batistuta intercepted Neville's pass and scored the third goal.  巴迪斯图达断下纳维尔的传球，射入了第三个球。

words.meaning: n.  圆柱体; 气缸
words.example: Deep-sea divers carry cylinders (= containers) of oxygen on their backs.  深海潜水员背上背有氧气筒。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.  薄膜; 细胞膜
words.example: The cornea is the transparent membrane that covers the front of the eye.  角膜是覆盖在眼球前部的透明膜。

words.meaning: n.  自助餐厅
words.example: The cafeteria offers three menus.  自助餐厅提供三种套餐。

words.meaning: a.  暧昧的,不明确的
words.example:
His reply to my question was somewhat ambiguous.  他对我的提问回答得有些含糊不清。
The wording of the agreement is ambiguous.  该协议的措辞模棱两可。
The government has been ambiguous on this issue.  在此问题上政府立场一直不明确。

words.meaning: n.  配给，分配
words.example: The allocation of funds was debated.  资金分配被讨论了一番。

words.meaning: n.  滑动,滑过,流水vi.  滑动,滑翔,溜走vt.  使滑动
words.example:
She came gliding gracefully into the ballroom in a long flowing gown.  她身穿一袭飘逸的礼服，优雅轻盈地快步走进舞厅。
Some people glide effortlessly through life with no real worries.  有些人一生过得轻松自在，无忧无虑。verb
We saw a condor gliding high above the mountains.  我们看到一只秃鹫在群山上空翱翔。

words.meaning: v.  铺; 密布
words.example:
The area from the shops to the beach is paved with bricks set in patterns.  商店到海滩的这个区域是用拼花砖铺成的。verb transitive
Scientists hope that data from the probe will pave the way for a more detailed exploration of Mars.  科学家希望探测船传回的数据会为更深入的火星探索提供条件。verb transitive
Unemployed youngsters still come to London in their hundreds thinking that the streets are paved with gold.  失业的年轻人继续成百上千地来到伦敦，认为这里遍地都是黄金。

words.meaning: a.  有传染性的,易传染的
words.example: an infectious disease/patient  传染病／传染病病人

words.meaning: a.  红外线的
words.example: Their pilots are guided by an infrared optical system that shows images clearly even at night.  他们的飞行员使用红外线光学系统导航，即使在晚上也能清楚地显示影像。

words.meaning: n.  敬畏vt.  使敬畏
words.example:
I've always held musicians in awe.  我对音乐家们总是肃然起敬。
As children we were rather in awe of our grandfather.  小时候，我们对祖父非常敬畏。
You can't help but stand in awe of (= respect greatly and fear slightly) powerful people.  在权势人物面前，你不由自主会毕恭毕敬。UK verb transitive ( UK aweing or US awing)

words.meaning: n.  攻击,进攻,肇端
words.example: The new treatment can delay the onset of the disease by several years.  新的治疗方法可以把发病时间延后几年。

words.meaning: n.  无数; a.  无数的; 种种的
words.example: And now myriads of bars and hotels are opening up along the coast.  目前有数不胜数的酒吧和饭店在沿岸开张营业。

words.meaning: n.  守候,侦察,侦察机,侦察员,搜索vi.  守候,侦察,巡视,嘲笑vt.  侦察,
words.example:
Manchester United's chief scout spotted him when he was playing for his school football team.  他在校足球队踢球时，曼联队的首席球探就看上了他。
He's scouting about/around for somewhere better to live.  他到处寻找更好的住处。
She's opened an office in Connecticut to scout out (= discover information about) the east coast housing market.  她在康乃狄克州开了一家办事处，搜集东海岸房产市场的资讯。

words.meaning: a.  不足的，不够的
words.example: insufficient information/time  不充足的资讯／时间

words.meaning: n.  炖(煨或焖)的食物; v.  炖，焖
words.example:
She prepared a hearty stew for dinner.  她为晚餐准备了一道丰盛的炖菜。UK noun countable or uncountable
William is in a stew about/over the demand he received from the tax office.  威廉正在为收到税务署的传唤而坐立不安。UK verb
You're not still stewing about what happened yesterday, are you?  你不会还在为昨天的事生气吧？

words.meaning: a.  似真实的,似合理的,说得煞有其事的,巧嘴的
words.example: a plausible explanation/excuse  貌似有理的解释／借口

words.meaning: a.  空气传播的
words.example:
The airborne radioactive particles have covered a huge area of Russia.  透过空气传播的放射性粒子覆盖了俄罗斯广大地区。
Airborne troops were dropped by parachute behind enemy lines.  空降部队伞降到敌后阵地上。
The old plane had great difficulty getting airborne (= rising into the air).  这架老掉牙的飞机起飞非常困难。

words.meaning: vt.  使困扰,使烦恼,折磨,反复袭击
words.example: Stop harassing me!  别烦我！

words.meaning: a.  精力充沛的,积极的
words.example: an energetic young woman  精力充沛的年轻女子

words.meaning: vt.  赠予,协议vi.  协商
words.example: An honorary doctorate was conferred on him by Edinburgh University.  爱丁堡大学授予他荣誉博士学位。

words.meaning: vt.  (使)麻痹
words.example: Fear can paralyze decision-making.  恐惧会瘫痪决策。

words.meaning: vt.  危及
words.example:
He would never do anything to endanger the lives of his children.  他不会做任何危及自己孩子生命安全的事。
We must be careful not to do anything that might endanger the economic recovery.  我们一定要谨慎，不能做任何妨碍经济复苏的事。

words.meaning: vt.  使困窘,使局促不安,阻碍
words.example: You're embarrassing him with your compliments!  你的赞美之词使他很不好意思。

words.meaning: a.  表示实在的,有实质的,独立的n.  实词,名词
words.example:
Substantive research on the subject needs to be carried out.  需要针对这课题开展实质性的研究。
The documents are the first substantive information obtained by the investigators.  这些档是调查者得到的第一批实质材料。

words.meaning: n.  灌木(丛)
words.example: She planted some roses and other flowering shrubs.  她种了一些玫瑰及其他一些开花灌木。

words.meaning: vt.  巩固,使联合,统一vi.  巩固
words.example:
The success of their major product consolidated the firm's position in the market.  公司主打产品取得的成功巩固了该公司在市场上的地位。
She hoped that marriage would consolidate their relationship.  她希望婚姻能巩固他们的关系。
The party consolidated its hold on power during its term of office.  该党在执政期间加强了对政权的控制。

words.meaning: vt.  唤醒,鼓励,引起vi.  睡醒
words.example:
It's a subject which has aroused a lot of interest.  这个话题引起了很多人的兴趣。
Our suspicions were first aroused when we heard a muffled scream.  我们听到一声闷声尖叫，就开始起了疑心。

words.meaning: a.  丰富的,富裕的n.  支流
words.example: affluent nations/neighbourhoods  富有国家／富人区

words.meaning: a.  舒适的,安逸的,惬意的
words.example: The cafe is small but cozy.  咖啡馆小但温馨。

words.meaning: v.  呻吟; 叹息
words.example:
We could hear the groans of the wounded soldiers.  我们能听到伤兵们的呻吟声。

He collapsed, groaning with pain.  他痛苦地呻吟着倒了下去

words.meaning: vi.  居住,踌躇
