She dwelt in remote parts of Asia for many years.  她在亚洲偏远地区居住了很多年。 (dwelt or dwelled, dwelt or dwelled)    formal
In his speech, he dwelt on the plight of the sick and the hungry.  演讲时他一直在说遭受疾病和饥饿折磨的人们所处的困境。

words.meaning: n.  有形资产a.  实体的,明白的,有形的,明确的
words.example:
We need tangible evidence if we're going to take legal action.  如果我们要采取法律行动，就需要有实实在在的证据。
Other tangible benefits include an increase in salary and shorter working hours.  其他实实在在的好处包括加薪和缩短工作时间。

words.meaning: n.  壮举,功绩,技艺表演a.  漂亮的,合适的
words.example:
The Eiffel Tower is a remarkable feat of engineering.  艾菲尔铁塔是工程技术上的一大非凡杰作。
She's performed remarkable feats of organization for the office.  她为办事处所做的组织工作成绩斐然。noun countable
Getting the job finished in under a week was no mean feat.  一周内就把这项任务完成了，真了不起。

words.meaning: n.  潜伏,潜行vi.  潜藏,潜伏,埋伏
words.example:
Someone was lurking in the shadows.  有人藏在黑影里。
Why are you lurking about in the corridor?  你干吗在走廊里鬼鬼祟祟的？
Danger lurks around every corner.  每个角落里都潜伏着危险。

words.meaning: n.  干草
words.example: The hay was baled for winter.  干草打捆备过冬。

words.meaning: n.  侏儒; 矮小的东西; v.  使…显得矮小
words.example:
You can grow dwarf conifers in pots on the patio.  你可以在阳台上种些矮小的针叶树盆栽。UK verb transitive
The new skyscraper will dwarf all those near it.  新建的摩天大楼跟周围的建筑相比鹤立鸡群。
This new crisis may well dwarf most that have gone before.  这场新的危机可能比以往的大多数危机都严重得多。

words.meaning: a.  有结尾的,有限的vi.  结束,终止,满期vt.  使停止,使结束,使终止
words.example:
They terminated my contract in October.  他们在十月终止了我的合约。
This train will terminate at the next stop - passengers who wish to continue should change trains.  下一站就是本次列车的终点，想继续行程的乘客请换车。UK US  formal

words.meaning: v.  居住于; 移民
words.example:
The inner cities are no longer densely populated.  市中心的人口密度已下降。
The river is populated mainly by smaller species of fish.  这条河里大部分是小型鱼类。
The settlers began to move inland and populate the river valleys.  移民开始迁往内陆，居住在河谷地带。

words.meaning: n.  演习,调遣,策略vi. vt.  调遣,演习,用计
words.example: The boat made a tight maneuver.  船做了一个急转弯。

words.meaning: vi.  挤在一起
words.example:
Everyone huddled round the fire to keep warm.  所有人都挤在炉火旁取暖。
It was so cold that we huddled together for warmth.  太冷了，我们只好挤在一起取暖。
Sophie was so frightened by the noise of the fireworks that she huddled (up) in a corner of the room.  苏菲被烟火爆竹的声音吓坏了，在屋角缩成一团。noun countable

words.meaning: n.  星座,灿烂的一群
words.example: At our annual ceremony we had a whole constellation of film stars/directors.  在我们的年度庆典上，影星／导演济济一堂。

words.meaning: vt.  失事; 破坏
words.example:
The explosion shattered nearby windows and wrecked two cars.  爆炸震碎了附近的窗子，并毁坏了两辆汽车。
Our greenhouse was wrecked in last night's storm.  我们的温室在昨晚的暴风雨中遭到破坏。
He has been warned that his behaviour might wreck his chances of promotion.  有人警告他说，他的行为可能会毁掉自己晋升的机会。noun countable

words.meaning: a.  有名的,有声誉的
words.example:
The region is renowned for its outstanding natural beauty.  该地区因其秀美壮丽的自然风光而享有盛誉。
Marco Polo is a renowned explorer/is renowned as an explorer.  马可．孛罗是著名的探险家。

words.meaning: n.  污水，污物
words.example:
Some cities in the world do not have proper facilities for the disposal of sewage.  世界上的某些城市没有适当的污水处理设施。
Raw/untreated sewage is being pumped into the sea, from where it pollutes our beaches.  未经处理的污水被排入大海，污染了我们的海滩。

words.meaning: n.  过敏症
words.example: an allergy to wheat  对小麦过敏

words.meaning: n.  性情,处置,处理,布置
words.example: She is of a nervous/cheerful/sunny disposition.  她神经质／性情开朗／性格阳光。

words.meaning: n.  内倾,击球手vt.  打坏,猛击,使内倾vi.  猛击,内倾
words.example:
He was battered to death with a rifle-butt.  他被人用枪托连续猛打致死。
He was battering (at/on) the door with his fists and howling.  他不停地用拳头砸门，边砸边吼。
The waves battered against the rocks at the bottom of the cliff.  波涛不停地拍打着悬崖底部的岩石。

words.meaning: n.  飞镖,投射vt.  投射vi.  疾走,突进
words.example:
We made a dart for (= moved quickly towards) the exit.  我们向出口冲去。UK verb intransitive + adverb or preposition
She darted an angry look at me.  她狠狠地瞪了我一眼。

words.meaning: n.  忠贞,效忠
words.example:
Soldiers must swear allegiance to the Crown/the King.  士兵必须宣誓效忠国王。
In many American schools, the students pledge allegiance (to the flag) at the beginning of the school day.  在很多美国学校里，学生每天上课前要（向国旗）进行宣誓。
As an Englishman who'd lived for a long time in France, he felt a certain conflict of allegiances when the two countries played soccer.  作为一个在法国生活了很长时间的英国人，当两国足球队比赛时，对于要支持哪一方，他的内心会有一番思想斗争。

words.meaning: n.  蜡; 蜡状物
words.example:
She watched the wax as it dripped down the side of the candle.  她注视着蜡从蜡烛边缘滴落下来。
I've waxed the floor so I'm afraid it's a bit slippery.  我刚给地板打了蜡，所以恐怕会有点滑。verb
My mother, a Spaniard, always used to wax lyrical about the lemon trees in the family garden.  我母亲是西班牙人，过去总是会深情地谈起她家中花园里的那些柠檬树。verb

words.meaning: n.  熔合物,结合,熔合
words.example: Their music is described as 'an explosive fusion of Latin American and modern jazz rhythms'.  他们的音乐被描述为“拉丁美洲和现代爵士节奏的爆炸性融合”。

words.meaning: n.  铲子; 挖掘机; v.  铲
words.example:
Should I put another shovelful of coal on the fire?  我需要往火上再加一铲煤吗?verb intransitive or transitive (-ll- or US USUALLY -l-)

He was sitting in front of the TV shovelling down a pizza.  他正坐在电视机前大口地吃着比萨。

words.meaning: n.  木偶
words.example:
We took the children to a puppet show/theatre.  我们带孩子去看了木偶剧。
Western powers have been accused of trying to establish a puppet government/regime in the divided country.  西方列强被指责企图在这个分裂国家建立傀儡政府。

words.meaning: n.  小礼堂
words.example: The college/hospital/prison has its own chapel.  学院／医院／监狱有自己的小教堂。

words.meaning: v.  补助，资助
words.example: The refugees live in subsidized housing provided by the authorities.  难民居住在当局提供的有政府补贴的住房里。

words.meaning: a.  损失惨重的,悲伤的
words.example:
Such a war would be disastrous for the country.  这样一场战争会给国家带来灾难性的后果。
This decision will have a disastrous impact on foreign policy.  这个决定将对外交政策产生极为不利的影响。
His first attempt was disastrous.  他第一次尝试败得很惨。

words.meaning: a.  复杂的,错综的,缠结的,难懂的
words.example:
The watch mechanism is extremely intricate and very difficult to repair.  手表的机械结构非常复杂精密，很难修理。
Police officers uncovered an intricate web of deceit.  警官揭开了一个错综复杂的网路骗局。

words.meaning: n.  听者,收听者,稽核员
words.example: The external (= from outside the company) auditors come in once a year.  外聘审计员每年来进行一次审计。

words.meaning: n.  壁画，壁饰
words.example: The mural covers the whole wall.  壁画覆盖了整面墙。

words.meaning: n.  胶; 胶水; v.  粘合; 紧附于
words.example:
Is it worth trying to glue this plate back together?  还值得把这个碟子重新黏好吗？
I've nearly finished making my model aeroplane - I just have to glue the wings on.  我快把飞机模型做好了——只需把机翼黏上就行。verb transitive usually + adverb or preposition (glueing or gluing, glued, glued)
We were glued to the television watching the election results come in.  我们目不转睛地盯着电视，等待大选结果揭晓。verb transitive usually + adverb or preposition (glueing or gluing, glued, glued)

words.meaning: n.  狂暴,狂怒
words.example:
In a frenzy of rage she hit him.  她盛怒之下打了他。
The audience worked/whipped themselves up into a frenzy as they waited for her to come on stage.  观众在期待她登上舞台的过程中情绪变得狂热起来。
There was a frenzy of activity on the financial markets yesterday.  昨天金融市场极度活跃。

words.meaning: n.  行李
words.example:
How many pieces of baggage do you have?  你有多少件行李？
We had to pay extra for our excess baggage (= our bags and cases which weighed more than was allowed).  我们必须为超重的行李额外付款。noun uncountable
We all carry a lot of emotional baggage around with us.  我们每个人都有许多感情的负担。

words.meaning: a.  最后的,终于的,可能的
words.example:
The Dukes were the eventual winners of the competition.  此次比赛的最终赢家是杜克一家。
Although the original budget for the project was $1 billion, the eventual cost is likely to be 50% higher.  虽然这项工程最初的预算是十亿美元，但最终耗资很可能要超出50%。

words.meaning: n.  否决权vt.  否决,禁止
words.example:
The Ministry of Defence has the power of veto over all British arms exports.  国防部有权禁止英国所有的武器出口。
In theory the British government could use its veto to block this proposal.  理论上英国政府可以利用否决权来阻止这项议案通过。
The Senate voted to override the President's veto of the proposed measures.  参议院投票推翻了总统对拟议中的措施的否决。

words.meaning: a.  萧瑟的,苍白的,荒凉的,阴冷的
words.example:
The house stands on a bleak, windswept moor.  这座房子坐落在一片饱受风雨侵袭的荒野上。
The economic outlook is bleak.  经济前景暗淡。

words.meaning: n.  坚持
words.example:
Insistence on better working conditions by the union has resulted in fewer employee absences.  工会坚决要求改善工作条件使员工缺勤的现象有所减少。
At her father 's insistence, Amelia's been moved into a new class.  基于阿梅莉亚父亲的坚决要求，她被转到了一个新的班级。

words.meaning: n.  十字军(远征); 运动; v.  加入十字军，投身正义运动
words.example:
They have long been involved in a crusade for racial equality.  他们长期以来一直致力于争取种族平等的运动。
She crusaded against sex and violence on television.  她致力于反对电视节目中的色情和暴力。

words.meaning: a.  有微毛的,失真的,模糊的
words.example:
Is the picture always fuzzy on your TV?  你的电视一直这么不清楚吗？
You can pick up a lot of stations on the car radio but the sound is usually a bit fuzzy.  汽车上的收音机可以收到一大堆电台，但声音通常都会有些干扰。
The basic facts of the story are starting to emerge though the details are still fuzzy.  虽然一些细节仍然并不清晰，但事情的基本事实已经浮出水面了。

words.meaning: n.  图表
words.example: The teacher drew a diagram showing how the blood flows through the heart.  老师画了一张示意图来说明血液如何进出心脏。

words.meaning: n.  用力的投掷vt.  用力投掷,愤慨地说出,丢下vi.  猛投,猛掷
words.example:
In a fit of temper he hurled the book across the room.  他一怒之下把书本扔到房间的另一边。
Youths hurled stones at the soldiers.  年轻人向士兵们投掷石头。

words.meaning: n.  摩擦,医疗摩擦,不和
words.example:
When you rub your hands together the friction produces heat.  揉搓双手时，摩擦会产生热量。noun uncountable
There's a lot of friction between my wife and my mother.  我妻子和我母亲之间有很多龃龉。
Politics is a source of considerable friction in our family.  政治问题在我们家是矛盾的一大根源。

words.meaning: v.  提供; 装备
words.example:
They've furnished the room very simply.  他们把房间布置得很简单。UK verb transitive
Furnished with a compass and sandwiches, they set off for a day's hiking.  他们带着罗盘和三明治开始了一天的徒步旅行。

words.meaning: a.  聪明的,有知识的
words.example: He's very knowledgeable about German literature.  他精通德国文学。

words.meaning: a.  空中的
words.example: Meanwhile, the massive aerial bombardment/bombing of military targets continued unabated.  同时，对于军事目标的大规模空袭仍进行得如火如荼。

words.meaning: a.  成功的,繁盛的,顺利的,幸运的
words.example: In a prosperous country like this, no one should go hungry.  在这样一个繁荣的国家里，不应该有人挨饿。

words.meaning: n.  关税，税率
words.example: The tariff on imports was lowered.  进口关税下调了。

words.meaning: n.  树叶; 植物
words.example: The dense foliage overhead almost blocked out the sun.  头顶上方浓密的枝叶几乎遮住了阳光。

words.meaning: a.  无知识的,不知道的,幼稚的
words.example:
Many teenagers are surprisingly ignorant about current politics.  许多青少年对时事政治无知得让人吃惊。
We remained blissfully ignorant of the troubles that lay ahead.  我们对将要出现的麻烦一无所知，这或许是一种幸运。
Ignorant lout!  没礼貌的混蛋！

words.meaning: vt.  派遣n.  派遣,急件
words.example:
Two loads of woollen cloth were dispatched to the factory on December 12th.  12月12日两车毛料被发到工厂。(UK also despatch) [dɪ'spætʃ]
Our handsome hero manages to dispatch another five villains.  我们英俊的男主人翁设法又杀死了五个坏蛋。(UK also despatch) [dɪ'spætʃ]
In her latest dispatch, Clare Duggan, our war correspondent, reported an increase in fighting.  我们的战地记者克莱尔‧达根在其最新报道中说战事正在加剧。

words.meaning: v. n.  掩饰; 伪装
words.example:
Minor skin imperfections can usually be disguised with a spot of make-up.  微小的皮肤瑕疵通常可以用化妆品来掩盖。
We tried to disguise the fact that it was just a school hall by putting up coloured lights and balloons.  我们不想让人看出这里实际上只是挂着彩灯和气球的学校礼堂。
He put on a large hat and glasses as a disguise and hoped no one would recognise him.  他戴上大帽子和眼镜来伪装自己，希望没人会认出他来。

words.meaning: n.  孵化,舱口vt.  孵,孵出,策划vi.  孵化
words.example: It was in August of 1978 that the Bolton brothers hatched their plot to kill their parents.  那是在1978年的8月，博尔顿兄弟策划了杀害他们父母的计划。noun countable (also hatchway)

words.meaning: n.  木筏
words.example:
We lashed together anything that would float to make a raft.  我们把所有能漂浮的东西都捆绑在一起来做一个木筏。
We have designed a whole raft of measures to improve the transport system.  我们已经制定了一整套措施来完善交通系统。UK verb intransitive or transitive
They rafted their supplies down the river.  他们用筏子把生活用品运到河的下游。

words.meaning: vt.  修正,改善,改良vi.  改过自新
words.example:
MPs were urged to amend the law to prevent another oil tanker disaster.  下院议员被敦促修订该法律，以防止油轮泄漏灾难再次发生。
In line 20, 'men' should be amended (= changed) to 'people'.  第20行中的 men 应改为 people。
Until the constitution is amended, the power to appoint ministers will remain with the president.  在宪法修正之前，总统仍然有权任命部长。

words.meaning: a.  延长的
words.example: Prolonged use of the drug is known to have harmful side-effects.  据了解，长期服用此药会产生对人体有害的副作用。

words.meaning: a.  居间的,间接的vt.  斡旋,调停vi.  处于中间,调解
words.example:
Negotiators were called in to mediate between the two sides.  请来了谈判人员为双方调解。
The two envoys have succeeded in mediating an end to the war.  两位使节透过谈判斡旋促成了战争的结束。

words.meaning: n.  大教堂
words.example: Salisbury Cathedral  索尔斯堡主教堂

words.meaning: vt.  塞满,填满,猛吃vi.  贪吃n.  塞满
words.example:
Eight children were crammed into the back of the car.  八个孩子被塞进了汽车的后座。
The room was packed and we were crammed against the door.  房间里挤得水泄不通，我们被挤靠在门边。 (-mm-)
She's cramming for her history exam.  为应付历史考试她拼命突击。 (-mm-)

words.meaning: n.  悲叹,悔恨,悼词,挽歌vt.  哀悼vi.  悔恨,悲叹
words.example:
The poem opens by lamenting (over) the death of a young man.  这首诗的开篇表达了对一位青年之死的惋惜之情。
My grandmother, as usual, lamented the decline in moral standards in today's society.  和往常一样，我奶奶对当今社会世风日下深感痛惜。
The late lamented (= dead and remembered with love) Frank Giotto used to live here.  已故的受人爱戴的法兰克‧焦托曾在此居住。noun countable formal

words.meaning: a.  自私的,利己主义的,自我中心的
words.example: The judge told him: "Your attitude shows a selfish disregard for others."  法官告诉他：“你的态度表明你只顾自己而不顾他人。”

words.meaning: a.  交互的,轮流的vt. vi.  轮流,(使)交替
words.example:
She alternated between cheerfulness and deep despair.  她时而情绪亢奋，时而又深陷绝望之中。
He alternated working in the office with long tours overseas.  他在办公室工作一段时间后就会安排一次海外长途旅行。adjective [before noun] UK US [ɑːlˈtɜ˞ː-/
Private cars are banned from the city on alternate days.  该市私家车限隔日出行。

words.meaning: vt.  点燃,使灼热,使兴奋
words.example:
The fuel spontaneously ignites because of the high temperature and pressure.  燃料因高温和高压而自燃。
The proposed restrictions have ignited a storm of protest.  拟议中的限制规定激起了抗议的浪潮。

words.meaning: vt.  弄污,弄脏,毒害,传染,染污
words.example:
Much of the coast has been contaminated by nuclear waste.  大部分海岸已受到核废料污染。
The food which had been contaminated was destroyed.  受污染的食物已被销毁了。

words.meaning: vt.  阻碍，抑制
words.example:
Some workers were inhibited (from speaking) by the presence of their managers.  一些工人在他们的经理面前不敢讲话。
This drug inhibits the growth of tumours.  这种药可以抑制肿瘤的生长。

words.meaning: n.  男毕业生,男校友
words.example: Several famous alumni have agreed to help raise money for the school's restoration fund.  几位有名望的校友已经同意帮助母校筹集资金修复校舍。

words.meaning: n.  境况,誓约,困境vt.  宣誓,保证,约定
words.example: Few of us can be unmoved by the plight of the Romanian orphans.  我们几乎无一不为罗马尼亚孤儿的困难处境而心有所感。verb old use or humorous

words.meaning: n.  振动,颤动
words.example:
Vibrations were felt hundreds of miles from the centre of the earthquake.  距震中数百哩范围内都有震感。
Aircraft manufacturers want to reduce vibration for the sake of safety.  飞机制造商出于安全的考虑而想要减轻震动。

words.meaning: a.  惊人的
words.example: He made some startling admissions about his past.  他承认了自己过去一些令人震惊的事。

words.meaning: n.  假设值,不履行责任,缺席vt. vi.  疏怠职责,缺席,拖欠v.  默认
words.example:
People who default on their mortgage repayments may have their home repossessed.  未能按期偿还抵押贷款者，其房屋可能会被没收。UK verb intransitive
Unless something else happens, the default is to meet at the hotel at 7.00 p.m.  如果没有别的事情，按约定下午七点在饭店见面。
The computer will take '0' as the default value , unless you type in something different.  如果不输入其他数值，电脑就把0当作预设值。

words.meaning: a.  空心的; 虚伪的; n.  山谷; vt.  挖空
words.example:
Hollow blocks are used because they are lighter.  使用空心砖是因为它们更轻。
It was something of a hollow victory - she won the case but lost all her savings in legal fees.  这是一个毫无价值的胜利——她赢了诉讼，却也为此花光了所有积蓄。
Even sex had become a hollow pleasure.  甚至连性都变得无聊乏味，失去了原有的乐趣。

words.meaning: a.  清醒的,稳重的,节制的,严肃的,朴素的,合理的,不夸大的vt.  使清醒,
words.example:
Are you sober enough to drive, Jim?  吉姆，你够不够清醒，可以开车吗？
I'd had no wine all evening so I was stone cold (= completely) sober.  我一晚上没有喝酒，所以我非常清醒。UK adjective
In fact the whole wedding was a sober affair - no dancing, just people standing around in groups chatting politely.  事实上，整场婚礼气氛很严肃——没有人跳舞，人们只是聚在一起礼貌地交谈。

words.meaning: n.  虹
words.example: The tropical butterfly's wings were shimmering with all the colours of the rainbow.  热带蝴蝶的翅膀像彩虹一样闪烁着五彩缤纷的色彩。

words.meaning: a.  本质的,原有的,真正的
words.example: Maths is an intrinsic part of the school curriculum.  数学是中小学的基础课。

words.meaning: n.  小睡
words.example:
Grandpa usually has/takes a nap after lunch.  爷爷通常在午饭后小睡片刻。noun
He likes to nap for an hour when he gets home from work.  他喜欢下班回家后小睡一个小时。

words.meaning: a.  不耐烦的,着急的,急切的
words.example:
He's a good teacher, but inclined to be a bit impatient with slow learners.  他是个好老师，但对学得慢的学生却总有些不耐烦。
You'd be hopeless looking after children - you're far too impatient!  照顾孩子你是不行的——你太没有耐心了！
He's got a lot of exciting ideas and he's impatient to get started.  他有许多好主意，迫不及待地想动手做。

words.meaning: n.  木炭
words.example: The uniform is charcoal (grey) (= dark grey) and red.  制服是深灰色配红色的。

words.meaning: vt.  使饿死vi.  饿得要死
words.example:
Whole communities starved to death during the long drought.  在这场漫长的大旱中，整个村落的人都饿死了。
From talking to former prisoners in the camps, an obvious conclusion is that they have been starved.  透过和从集中营出来的囚犯谈话，一个很明显的感觉就是他们一直在挨饿。
People starved of sleep start to lose their concentration and may hallucinate.  睡眠严重不足的人开始注意力不集中，而且可能会产生幻觉。

words.meaning: vt.  损害,减少,削弱
words.example: Sleep deprivation impairs memory.  睡眠不足损害记忆。

words.meaning: a.  肥沃的,生产多的,能生产的
words.example:
People get less fertile as they get older.  随着年龄增长，人的生育能力逐渐下降。    Opposite infertile
British politics remains very fertile ground for comedy.  英国政治依然为喜剧提供丰富的素材。

words.meaning: n.  散文
words.example: I've always preferred reading prose to poetry.  我一直偏好读散文而不是诗歌。    Compare verse

words.meaning: n.  厌恶,嫌恶vi.  令人厌恶vt.  使作呕
words.example:
She walked out in disgust.  她厌恶地走了出去。
We are demonstrating to show our anger and disgust at the treatment of refugees.  我们示威是对难民受到的待遇表示愤怒和憎恶。
He resigned from the committee in disgust at the corruption.  出于对腐败的憎恶，他辞去了在该委员会的职务。

words.meaning: vt.  使用,挥舞,运用
words.example:
She was confronted by a man wielding a knife.  她被一名持刀男子威胁。
He still wields enormous influence within the party.  他在党内仍然很有影响力。

words.meaning: n.  酸奶(酪)
words.example: natural/plain yogurt  天然／纯酸乳酪

words.meaning: n.  顶部
words.example: Mrs Singh is still riding the crest of a wave of popularity.  辛格夫人的声望仍然如日中天。

words.meaning: n.  规划，布局
words.example: Application forms vary greatly in layout and length.  申请表在格式和篇幅上差别很大。

words.meaning: a.  正直的,诚实的,竖式的,垂直的,合乎正道的
words.example:
Please return your seat to an upright position and fasten your belt.  请把坐椅恢复到竖直位置并系好安全带。
She behaved as any upright citizen would have under the circumstances.  她在这种情况下的做法和所有正直公民一样。adverb
The sound of breaking glass made her sit bolt upright (= sit with her back straight).  听到玻璃破碎的声音她一下子坐直了起来。noun countable

words.meaning: vt.  废止,革除,取消
words.example: National Service was abolished in Britain in 1962.  英国的国民兵役制度于1962年废止。

words.meaning: a.  意外的,偶然的n.  非本质属性
words.example:
Reports suggest that 11 soldiers were killed by accidental fire from their own side.  报导暗示11名士兵被己方炮火误射而丧生。
The site was located after the accidental discovery of bones in a field.  有人在田地里意外地发现遗骨后，这个遗址才被发现。

words.meaning: n.  图书管理员
words.example: The librarian shelved the new books.  图书管理员把新书上架。

words.meaning: vt.  解放,释放,使自由
words.example:
They said they sent troops in to liberate the people/the country from a dictator.  他们称他们向该国派出军队是要把那里的人民／那个国家从独裁者手中解放出来。
She liberated those spoons from a restaurant last week.  上周她从一家餐厅偷了那些汤匙。

words.meaning: n.  士气,民心
words.example: There have been a lot of recent redundancies so morale is fairly low.  近来裁员很多，所以士气很低。

words.meaning: a.  次等的,较低的,下方的,下级的n.  低下的人,次品,下附文字
words.example:
These products are inferior to those we bought last year.  这些产品比我们去年买的差些。
She cited cases in which women had received inferior health care.  她引用了一些妇女得到低劣保健服务的事例。
It was clear the group were regarded as intellectually/morally/socially inferior.  很明显的是，这个群体被认为在智力／道德水准／社会地位上很低下。    Compare superior    specialized

words.meaning: vt.  减轻,使缓和
words.example: The drugs did nothing to alleviate her pain/suffering.  这些药物对减轻她的病痛／痛苦没有丝毫作用。

words.meaning: n.  小旅馆，客栈
words.example: the Holiday Inn, Harrogate  哈罗盖特假日酒店

words.meaning: adv.  全体地，共同地
words.example: She has a staff of four who collectively earn almost $200 000.  她有四名员工，创造收入近20万美元。

words.meaning: a.  顽固的,不听话的,执拗的,棘手的
words.example:
They have massive rows because they're both so stubborn.  他们俩吵得很凶，因为他们两个人都很固执。
He was famed for his stubborn resistance and his refusal to accept defeat.  他以顽强抵抗、不甘失败著称。
Stubborn stains can be removed using a small amount of detergent.  使用少量清洁剂即可去除顽渍。UK US  mainly disapproving

words.meaning: n.  嘲笑,戏弄,模仿a.  假的,伪造的,模拟的ad.  虚伪地vt.  嘲弄,模仿,
words.example:
They were mocking him because he kept falling off his bike.  他们不断嘲笑他，因为他老是从脚踏车上摔下来。
She made fun of him by mocking his limp.  她模仿他一瘸一拐地走路来取笑他。
The wind mocked their attempts to reach the shore by pushing the boat further and further out to sea.  风把船往海里刮得越来越远，使他们靠岸的努力落空。UK verb transitive

words.meaning: n.  灌木丛
words.example:
She scrubbed (at) the mark on the wall for ages, but it wouldn't come off.  她花了很长时间擦洗墙上的印迹，但仍然没有擦掉。
We had to scrub our plans when I lost my job.  我失业了，我们不得不取消计划。verb (-bb-)
Mary scrubs up well.  玛丽总是打扮得漂漂亮亮的。noun

words.meaning: n.  慎重,辨别力,考虑,处理权
words.example: Students can be expelled at the discretion of the headteacher (= if the headteacher decides it).  校长有权开除学生。

words.meaning: n.  仇敌,反对者,敌人
words.example:
The two countries have united against their common foe.  两国联合起来对抗共同的敌人。
They were bitter foes for many years.  他们结仇多年。
Foes of the government will be delighting in its current difficulties.  政府的敌人会对政府目前的困难处境幸灾乐祸。

words.meaning: vt.  转开,避免,防止
words.example: We tried to avert our thoughts from our massive financial problems.  我们尽量不去想我们面临的严重财政问题。

words.meaning: vt.  扣留,扣押,阻止
words.example:
Several of the injured were detained overnight in hospital.  伤者中有几个人被留院观察了一晚。
I'm sorry I'm late - I was unavoidably detained.  对不起我来晚了——没办法我被耽搁了一会儿。

words.meaning: n.  腔; 洞
words.example: The gold was hidden in a secret cavity.  黄金藏在一个隐秘的洞穴里。

words.meaning: n.  新手,初学者
words.example:
I've never driven a car before - I'm a complete novice.  我以前从未开过车——完全是个新手。
This is quite a difficult plant for novice gardeners to grow.  让园艺新手来培育这种植物是相当有难度的。

words.meaning: n.  动画制作
words.example:
She spoke with great animation about her latest discoveries.  她兴致盎然地谈了她最新的发现。noun
Encyclopedias on CD-ROM include sound, illustrations and simple animations.  光碟电子百科全书里有声音、插图和简单的动画。
Thanks to computer animation, it is now possible to make cartoon films much more quickly than in the past.  有了电脑动画制作技术，现在制作动画片比过去快多了。

words.meaning: n.  称赞,恭维,致意vt.  称赞,褒扬,恭维
words.example:
She complained that her husband never paid her any compliments any more.  她抱怨说丈夫再也不赞美她了。
Are you fishing for (= trying to get) compliments?  你在沽名钓誉吗？
You should take it as a compliment when I fall asleep in your company - it means I'm relaxed.  我在你面前睡着了你应该感到荣幸——这意味着我很放心。

words.meaning: vt. vi.  渴望,热望,恳求
words.example: Many young children crave attention.  许多小孩子渴望得到关注。

words.meaning: n.  残渣,剩余,余数
words.example:
She cut off the best meat and threw away the residue.  她切下最好的肉，把剩下的扔掉了。
The white residue in/on the kettle is a result of minerals in the water.  壶中／上白色的渣子是水中的矿物质沉淀。
The residue (of the estate) went to her granddaughter.  剩余遗产由她的孙女继承。

words.meaning: v.  使习惯于
words.example: It'll take time for me to accustom myself to the changes.  我要一段时间后才能适应这些变化。

words.meaning: v.  变坏; 变质
words.example:
She was taken into hospital last week when her condition suddenly deteriorated.  她是在上周病情突然恶化时被送进医院的。
The political situation in the region has deteriorated rapidly.  该地区的政治形势已急剧恶化。

words.meaning: v.  碰撞; 冲突
words.example:
The two vans collided at the crossroads.  两辆货车在十字路口相撞。
It was predicted that a comet would collide with one of the planets.  预计一颗彗星将与某行星相撞。

words.meaning: a.  能实行的,可行的,适宜的
words.example:
With the extra resources, the scheme now seems feasible.  有了额外的资源，这个计划现在看来是可行的。
It 's quite feasible (that) we'll get the money.  我们很有可能拿到这笔钱。

words.meaning: a.  可应用的，可实施的
words.example:
This part of the law is only applicable to companies employing more than five people.  该法律这一部分条款仅适用于有五名以上雇员的公司。
The new qualifications are applicable to all European countries.  新的限定条件适用于所有欧洲国家。

words.meaning: n.  剧作家
words.example: The playwright won a Pulitzer.  这位剧作家获了普利策奖。

words.meaning: n.  正面; 表面
words.example:
Behind that amiable facade, he's a deeply unpleasant man.  他外表和善，实际上是个极不讨人喜欢的人。
We are fed up with this facade of democracy.  我们厌倦了这种民主的幌子。

words.meaning: a.  傲慢的,自大的
words.example: His arrogant tone silenced the room.  他傲慢的语气让全场安静。

words.meaning: n.  通风口; 排出口
words.example:
If you have a gas fire in a room, you should have some kind of outside vent.  如果你的屋里有煤气炉，那你就应该有个通向外面的排气口。
The skirt is long and straight with two side vents.  这条裙子是很长的直筒裙，两侧开衩。noun
The meeting will be an opportunity for everyone to give vent to their feelings.  这次会议将给每个人一吐为快的机会。verb transitive

words.meaning: a.  可疑的,不确定的
words.example:
These claims are dubious and not scientifically proven.  这些说法未经科学证实，有些可疑。
He has been associated with some dubious characters.  他曾经与一些可疑人物有交往。
Ruth Ellis has the dubious (= bad) distinction of being the last woman to be hanged in Britain.  露丝‧艾理斯背负着英国最后一个被绞死的女人这样一个恶名。

words.meaning: vt.  预见,预知
words.example: We couldn't foresee the crash.  我们没料到崩盘。

words.meaning: vi.  跋涉vt.  涉水n.  跋涉,浅滩
words.example:
The river was full but we managed to wade across.  河里涨满了水，但我们设法涉水过去了。
We waded a shallow river.  我们涉水过了一条浅浅的小河。
Even when she knows nothing about it, she wades in with her opinion.  即使对事情一无所知，她也要插嘴说说自己的意见。

words.meaning: n.  面团，浆糊
words.example:
Are these real diamonds or paste?  这些是真钻石还是人造宝石？verb
You can make your own distorting mirror by pasting a sheet of kitchen foil to a piece of thin cardboard.  你可以将一张厨房用铝箔纸贴在一块薄纸板上自己做一个哈哈镜。verb
Cut that paragraph and then paste it at the end of the page.  将那一段剪下来，贴到页尾上。

words.meaning: n.  危险,冒险vt.  置. . . 于险境,冒险
words.example:
The journey through the mountains was fraught with peril (= full of dangers).  穿越山岭的旅途充满了危险。
Teenagers must be warned about the perils of unsafe sex.  青少年必须被告诫不安全的性行为所隐藏的重大危险。
We underestimate the destructiveness of war at our peril.  我们低估了战争的破坏力，这对我们是很危险的。

words.meaning: n.  (日、月)食; vt.  使相形见绌
words.example:
On Wednesday there will be a total/partial eclipse of the sun.  周三将有一次日全／偏蚀。noun
The eclipse of the ruling political party was inevitable.  执政党大势已去，无可挽回。
His remarkable contribution to literature has been too long in eclipse.  他对文学的杰出贡献已被人们遗忘太久了。verb

words.meaning: n.  执政,君主统治,统治,支配vi.  当政,统治,支配,占优势
words.example:
Queen Victoria reigned over Britain from 1837 to 1901.  维多利亚女王自1837年到1901年间在位统治英国。
The bomb attacks produced a panic which reigned over the city.  炸弹袭击引起的恐慌笼罩全城。
Love reigned supreme in her heart.  爱情完全占据了她的心。noun countable

words.meaning: n.  瘀伤,擦伤vi.  受伤,擦伤vt.  使受伤,研碎
words.example:
His arms and back were covered in bruises.  他手臂和背部到处是瘀伤。
She had a few cuts and bruises but nothing serious.  她有几处伤口和瘀痕，但不严重。
One or two of the peaches had bruises on them.  有一两个桃子上有碰伤的痕迹。verb intransitive or transitive

words.meaning: n.  家禽
words.example: Some poultry farmers keep turkeys and ducks as well as chickens.  一些饲养家禽的农民不仅养鸡，还养火鸡和鸭子。UK noun uncountable

words.meaning: n.  遗传学
words.example: Genetics explains inherited traits.  遗传学解释了遗传特征。

words.meaning: vt.  使永存,使不朽
words.example:
Increasing the supply of weapons will only perpetuate the violence and anarchy.  增加武器供应只会使暴力和混乱持续下去。
The aim of the association is to perpetuate the skills of traditional furniture design.  该协会致力于促进传统家俱设计工艺的传承延续。

words.meaning: a.  时髦的,上流社会的,流行的
words.example: It's not fashionable to wear short skirts at the moment.  现在不流行穿短裙了。

words.meaning: a.  数量的,定量的
words.example: quantitative analysis  定量分析    Compare qualitative

words.meaning: a.  无耻的,不名誉的,声名狼藉的
words.example:
The list included the infamous George Drake, a double murderer.  名单中包括臭名昭著的双重杀人犯乔治‧德雷克。
He's infamous for his bigoted sense of humour.  他以那种带有偏执的幽默感而臭名昭著。

words.meaning: n.  边缘,水滨
words.example:
Extreme stress had driven him to the brink of a nervous breakdown.  极大的压力使他处于精神崩溃的边缘。
Scientists are on the brink of (= extremely close to) a major new discovery.  科学家们就快有新的重大发现了。
She was standing right on the brink of the gorge.  她就站在峡谷的边缘。

words.meaning: n.  污染物质
words.example: Sulphur dioxide is one of several pollutants that are released into the atmosphere by coal-fired power stations.  二氧化硫是火力发电站排放到大气中的若干污染物之一。

words.meaning: vi.  (in)富于; 大量存在; 充满
words.example:
Theories abound about how the Earth began.  地球的起源怎样，众说纷纭。verb intransitive
The coast here abounds with rare plants.  这儿的海岸生长着大量稀有植物。

words.meaning: n.  迷宫,迷惘vt.  使迷惘,使混乱,迷失
words.example:
The old part of the town was a maze of narrow passages.  旧城区通道狭窄，纵横交错，简直就是一座迷宫。noun countable
It's almost impossible to get through the maze of bureaucracy.  要逐一完成错综复杂的官僚式繁文缛节几乎是不可能的。

words.meaning: a.  显著的,断然的,明白的
words.example:
I'm told I have a very pronounced English accent when I speak French.  有人告诉我说，我在说法语时有明显的英国口音。
She's a woman of very pronounced views which she is not afraid to air.  她是个从不讳言其观点的女人。

words.meaning: n.  严酷的考验,痛苦的经验
words.example: The hostages' ordeal came to an end when soldiers stormed the building.  士兵突袭那栋大楼后，人质们的苦难终于结束了。

words.meaning: a.  光亮的,了不起的,灿烂的,杰出的,显著的,壮丽的
words.example:
We had splendid food/a splendid holiday/splendid weather.  我们的食物／我们的假期／我们碰到的天气简直太棒了。
You look splendid in that outfit.  你穿那一身衣服简直棒极了。

words.meaning: vt.  含意,暗示,牵连n.  包含的东西
words.example: Have they any evidence to implicate him in the robbery?  他们有证据证明他涉嫌抢劫案吗？

words.meaning: a.  周期的; 定期的
words.example: He suffers periodic mental breakdowns.  他周期性地精神失常。

words.meaning: a.  精炼的,优雅的,精细的
words.example: refined foods such as white bread and white sugar  诸如白面包和白糖之类的精制食品

words.meaning: vt. vi.  辨别,看清楚
words.example: It is difficult to discern any pattern in these figures.  在这些数字中很难找出规律。

words.meaning: vt.  崇拜,爱慕,喜爱
words.example:
She has one son and she adores him.  她只有一个儿子，是她的掌上明珠。
Let us adore God for all his works.  让我们崇拜上帝所创造的一切。

words.meaning: a.  滑的,光滑的,靠不住的,含糊的,不稳固的,圆滑的
words.example:
The road was wet and slippery.  道路又湿又滑。
He's as slippery as an eel - you can never get a straight answer out of him.  他非常狡猾——你永远无法从他嘴里得到直率的回答。
He's a slippery customer (= person) , that Tim, I've never felt comfortable with him.  那个蒂姆是个狡猾的家伙，和他在一起我总是感到不舒服。

words.meaning: a.  污秽的,邪恶的,恶臭的,淤塞的,恶劣的vt.  弄脏,妨害,淤塞,犯规,污
words.example:
Those toilets smell foul!  那些卫生间太难闻了！
I've had a foul day at work.  我今天工作上很不顺利。
Why are you in such a foul mood this morning?  你今天早晨的情绪怎么这么糟糕？

words.meaning: n.  郊游,远足a.  远足适用的
words.example:
Rosie's going on a class/school outing to the Museum of Modern Art.  罗西要跟全班／全校去参观现代艺术博物馆。UK noun
There have been several outings of well-known film stars recently.  最近曝出好几宗著名电影明星是同性恋者的事。

words.meaning: vt. vi.  请求,乞求,诱惑,征求
words.example: It is illegal for public officials to solicit gifts or money in exchange for favours.  公务员利用职务之便索求他人财物是非法的。verb

words.meaning: n.  试验,假设a.  试验性质的,暂时的
words.example: The results are tentative.  结果还是初步的。

words.meaning: n.  蹒跚,踌躇vi.  蹒跚,犹豫vt.  使摇摆,使踌躇,交错,错开a.  交错的,
words.example:
After he was attacked, he managed to stagger to the phone and call for help.  他遇袭后，跌跌撞撞地走到电话旁打电话求救。
figurative The company is staggering under a $15 million debt and will almost certainly collapse by the end of the year.  公司背负着1500万美元的债务，举步维艰，年底前几乎肯定要倒闭。UK verb
He staggered all his colleagues by suddenly announcing that he was leaving the company at the end of the month.  他突然宣布月底要离开公司，把所有同事都吓了一跳。UK verb

words.meaning: vt.  以咒文召唤,变戏法,想象vi.  变戏法,施魔法vt.  祈求,恳求
words.example:
In an instant, the magician had conjured (up) a dove from his hat.  魔术师眨眼间便从他的帽子里变出了一只鸽子。UK verb intransitive or transitive
The glittering ceremony conjured up images of Russia's imperial past.  辉煌的典礼让人联想起俄罗斯帝国昔日的景象。
For some people, the word 'England' may still conjure up images of pretty gardens and tea parties.  “英格兰”这个词仍能使一些人联想到漂亮的花园和茶会。

words.meaning: n.  起义,升起
words.example: Following a determined resistance in the east, there was eventually a popular uprising in the capital.  在东部发生坚决的抵抗运动后，最终在首都爆发了人民起义。

words.meaning: vt.  强迫,勉强,驱使
words.example: Rules constrain what we can do.  规则限制了我们的行动。

words.meaning: n.  装饰,装饰,教堂用品vt.  装饰,修饰
words.example:
The building relies on clever design rather than on ornament for its impressive effect.  这幢大楼给人留下深刻印象，是依靠它巧妙的设计而非装饰。verb transitive UK US     slightly formal
She ornamented her letters with little drawings in the margin.  她在信的页边空白处画上小图案来作装饰。

words.meaning: n.  国籍,国家,民族性
words.example:
She has British nationality.  她拥有英国国籍。
What nationality are you?  你是哪个国家的人？
At the International School they have pupils of 46 different nationalities.  这所国际学校有来自46个不同民族的学生。

words.meaning: n.  薄片; v.  使成薄片; 雪片般落下
words.example:
This room needs decorating - flakes of paint keep coming off the walls.  这个房间需要装修——墙上的油漆不断地一片片地往下掉。noun countable
Patches of skin are starting to flake off.  片片皮屑开始脱落。verb intransitive

words.meaning: a.  立方体的,立方的
words.example: The room measures ten cubic meters.  房间是十立方米。

words.meaning: a.  巨大的，庞大的
words.example: The cost has been gigantic.  费用非常庞大。

words.meaning: n.  (剧团等)常备剧目，保留剧目
words.example:
The Royal Shakespeare Company also have many modern plays in their repertoire.  皇家莎士比亚剧团的演出剧目中也包括很多现代戏剧。
There is an extensive repertoire of music written for the flute.  为长笛演奏而谱写的曲目林林总总，丰富多彩。

words.meaning: vt.  预演,排演,使排练,复述,背诵,练习vi.  排练,练习,演习
words.example:
The musicians rehearsed (the symphony) for the concert.  乐师们为音乐会排练（交响曲）。
figurative On her way to her interview she silently rehearsed what she would say.  在去面试的路上，她默诵了一下要说的话。
These are arguments that I've heard rehearsed at meetings many times before.  这些论点都是我多次在会议上听到的老生常谈了。

words.meaning: vt.  例证,例示
words.example: This painting perfectly exemplifies the naturalistic style which was so popular at the time.  这幅油画是那个时期风靡一时的自然主义风格的完美典范。

words.meaning: n.  拖着脚走,曳步,洗纸牌,蒙混vt. vi.  拖曳,搅乱,洗牌,推诿,慢吞吞地
words.example:
He shuffled into the kitchen, leaning on his walking stick.  他拄着手杖拖着脚走进厨房。
Don't shuffle your feet like that! Lift them properly.  不要那样拖着脚走路！把脚抬起来。
The woman in front of me kept shuffling around in her seat all the way through the performance.  演出期间，我前面的那个女人在座位上不停地动来动去。

words.meaning: n.  蜥蜴
words.example: A lizard sat on the warm wall.  一只蜥蜴趴在暖墙上。

words.meaning: n.  奇异的事物; 奇迹
words.example:
We paused to marvel at the view.  我们停下来，感叹景色之美。
This miniature TV is the latest technological marvel from Japan.  这台微型电视是日本的科技新宠。
It 's a marvel (to me) how they've managed to build the tunnel so quickly.  （我觉得）真不可思议，他们能这么快就把隧道建好。

words.meaning: vi.  变亮,活跃vt.  使生辉,事快活
words.example:
The room was small and dark, without so much as a ray of light to brighten the gloom.  房间窄小昏暗，连一丝光线也没有。
It was rainy this morning, but it brightened up (= the sun started shining) after lunch.  今天早晨下雨，但午饭后天晴了。UK verb intransitive or transitive
Her eyes brightened when she saw him enter the room.  当她看见他进入房间时，眼睛一亮。

words.meaning: n. [常pl.  ]陶瓷器
words.example: The artist fired the ceramic vase.  艺术家烧制了陶瓷花瓶。

words.meaning: vt.  集合,召集,召唤vi.  聚集,集合
words.example:
The Prime Minister convened (a meeting of) his ministers to discuss the matter.  首相召集部长（开会）讨论这个问题。
The council will be convening on the morning of the 25th.  市政会议将于25日上午召开。

words.meaning: ad.  猛(激)烈地，极端地
words.example:
He claimed to have been violently assaulted while in detention.  他宣称在拘留期间曾遭到暴力殴打。
She violently disagreed with what we said.  她强烈反对我们所说的。
He was violently sick.  他非常不舒服。

words.meaning: n.  珠宝,宝石,珍贵之物vt.  饰以宝石
words.example:
You've been an absolute gem - I couldn't have managed without your help.  你可真是难能可贵——没有你的帮助我可应付不过去。
He came out with a gem (= clever or pleasing remark) about the absurdity of the situation.  他对这种荒诞的情形发表了粲花之论。

words.meaning: vi.  热望,立志
words.example: Few people who aspire to fame ever achieve it.  追求显赫名声的人很少能如愿以偿。

words.meaning: vt.  1 细察,详审2 仔细打量,端详
words.example: He scrutinized the men's faces carefully/closely, trying to work out who was lying.  他仔细端详这些男子的脸，想弄清谁在撒谎。

words.meaning: n.  几何学
words.example: the laws of geometry  几何定律

words.meaning: n.  镍
words.example: a nickel alloy  镍合金noun

words.meaning: n.  裂口,违背,破坏,破裂,突破,违反vt.  攻破,突破vi.  跳出水面
words.example:
They felt that our discussions with other companies constituted a breach of/in our agreement.  他们认为我们与别的公司谈判违反了我们之间的协定。
He was sued for breach of contract.  他因为违约而被起诉。
There have been serious security breaches (= breaks in our security system).  保安系统出了大问题。

words.meaning: n.  冰河
words.example: The glacier carved the valley.  冰川侵蚀出了山谷。

words.meaning: n.  沉淀物,沉积
words.example:
There was a brown sediment in the bottom of the bottle.  瓶子底部有褐色的沉淀物。
It is hoped that the oil slick will sink to the seabed where it would be covered within a few years by sediments and eventually decompose.  人们希望浮油会沉到海底，并且在数年后被沉积物覆盖，逐渐分解。

words.meaning: n.  记忆,回想,回忆
words.example:
His powers of recollection are extraordinary.  他的记忆力超群。 formal
To the best of my recollection I have never seen her before.  如果我没记错的话，我以前从来没有见过她。

words.meaning: vi.  屈从,屈服,死
words.example:
The town finally succumbed last week after being pounded with heavy artillery for more than two months.  在遭受了两个多月的猛烈炮火轰击后，小镇最终在上星期放弃抵抗。
I'm afraid I succumbed to temptation and had a piece of cheesecake.  我还是没抵挡住诱惑，吃了一块乳酪蛋糕。
Thousands of cows have succumbed to the disease in the past few months.  过去几个月里，几千头乳牛都得了这种病。

words.meaning: vi.  蒸发,失去水分,消失vt.  使蒸发
words.example:
The high concentration of sugars forms a syrup when the sap evaporates.  当树汁中的水分蒸发时，糖分就浓缩成糖浆。
Plants keep cool during the summer by evaporating water from their leaves.  夏天植物透过叶子蒸发水分保持清凉。UK verb
Halfway through the film reality evaporates and we enter a world of pure fantasy.  电影看到一半，我们就离开现实世界，完全进入了幻境中。

words.meaning: vt.  模拟,假装,模仿
words.example:
In cheap furniture, plastic is often used to simulate wood.  廉价家俱经常用塑胶冒充木材。
formal Ruth simulated pleasure at seeing Simon, but really she wished he hadn't come.  看见西蒙，露丝假装很高兴，可是实际上她希望他没来。
Some driving teachers use computers to simulate (= represent) different road conditions for learners to practise on.  有些驾驶教练用电脑类比不同的路况供学员练习。

words.meaning: n.  摄生,养生法,食物疗法
words.example: After his heart attack the doctor put him on a strict regimen.  他的心脏病发作后，医生给他制订了严格的生活规则。

words.meaning: a.  粗糙的,下等的,粗俗的a.  粗略的
words.example: Linen is a coarse -grained fabric.  亚麻布是一种质地粗糙的布料。UK adjective

words.meaning: n.  身材; 地位
words.example:
His stature as an art critic was tremendous.  他作为艺术评论家，享有非常高的声誉。
If the school continues to gain in stature, it will attract the necessary financial support.  如果学校能继续提高声誉，将会吸引到必要的资金补助。UK noun
His red hair and short stature made him easy to recognize.  他红头发，五短身材，很容易认出来。

words.meaning: a.  放射性的
words.example: Uranium is a radioactive material.  铀是一种放射性物质。

words.meaning: n.  图表; 坐标图
words.example: This graph shows how crime has varied in relationship to unemployment over the last 20 years.  这幅图显示出在过去20年里犯罪率与失业率的变化关系。

words.meaning: a.  著名的; 有名的
words.example: a celebrated opera singer/city/novel  著名歌剧演唱家／名城／著名小说    Compare notorious

words.meaning: a.  恒星的
words.example: a stellar explosion  恒星爆炸

words.meaning: n.  催化剂
words.example: The high suicide rate acted as a catalyst for change in the prison system.  高自杀率促成了监狱制度的改革。

words.meaning: n.  轮廓vt.  画轮廓a.  与轮廓相符的
words.example:
He studied the contours of her face.  他仔细端详她的面部轮廓。
Her latest collection of swimwear shows off the contours of the human body to perfection.  她的最新系列泳装衬托出了人体曲线的完美。
This map has contours marked at 250m intervals.  这张地图示有等高距为250米的等高线。

words.meaning: n.  海湾; 分歧
words.example:
The Gulf states include Iran, Iraq, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman, Qatar, and the United Arab Emirates.  海湾国家包括伊朗、伊拉克、沙乌地阿拉伯、科威特、巴林、阿曼、卡塔尔以及阿拉伯联合酋长国。
There is a widening gulf between the middle classes and the poorest sections of society.  中产阶级和社会最贫困阶层之间的贫富差距在日益加大。
It is hoped that the peace plan will bridge the gulf (= reduce the very large difference) between the government and the rebels.  人们希望和平计划能够缩小政府和叛乱分子之间的分歧。

words.meaning: n.  兽脂,油脂,贿赂vt.  涂脂于,贿赂
words.example:
The dinner plates were thick with grease.  餐盘上厚厚一层油
You'll have to put some grease on those ball bearings.  你要往滚珠轴承上涂些油。verb transitive
Grease the tins well before adding the cake mixture.  在烤盘里面涂好油脂，然后再把蛋糕混合料加进去。verb transitive

words.meaning: n.  鹰
words.example: On every street corner there were traders hawking their wares.  每个街角都有商贩在兜售商品。

words.meaning: a.  想象的,虚构的
words.example: The architects have made imaginative use of glass and transparent plastic.  建筑师别出心裁地使用了玻璃和透明塑胶。

words.meaning: n.  航空，航空学; 飞行
words.example: the British Civil Aviation Authority  英国民航局

words.meaning: n. [M-]水星; 水银
words.example:
Mercury is used in batteries, pesticides and thermometers.  水银用于电池、杀虫剂与温度计中。UK noun uncountable
With the mercury climbing to 40 degrees, beaches and pools will be crowded this afternoon.  随着气温攀升到40度，今天下午海滩和游泳池都会人满为患。

words.meaning: n.  衰退,腐败vi.  (使)衰退,(使)腐败
words.example:
Sugar makes your teeth decay.  糖能引起蛀牙。
The role of the extended family has been decaying for some time.  大家庭的作用开始减弱已经有一段时间了。
Pollution has decayed the surface of the stonework on the front of the cathedral.  大教堂前部的石刻表面已经因为污染受到了侵蚀。

words.meaning: n.  蜜饯,果酱vt.  保存,保全
words.example: apricot/strawberry conserve  杏脯／草莓蜜饯

words.meaning: vt.  吐露,信托vi.  信赖
words.example: She's nice, but I don't feel I can confide in her.  她人很好，但我还是觉得我不能对她推心置腹。

words.meaning: vt.  强加于; 使固定; 系
words.example:
Make sure your seat belt is securely fastened.  请务必将您的安全带系好。
This shirt fastens at the back.  这件衬衫是在后面系扣的。
The tabloid newspapers have fastened on popular psychology.  这些小报处处捉摸大众心理。

words.meaning: n.  共鸣,回声,共振,谐振,反响
words.example: This poem has many resonances for me.  这首诗使我浮想联翩。

words.meaning: a.  持久的,耐用的
words.example:
The machines have to be made of durable materials.  这种机器必须使用耐用的材料来制造。
The resolution calls for a durable peace settlement.  该决议呼吁得出一个持久的和平解决方案。

words.meaning: n.  罗盘; [pl.  ]圆规; 范围
words.example:
It's a musical instrument made of brass, somewhat like a cornet and with a similar compass.  这是一件黄铜乐器，跟短号有些类似，音域也与之相近。
The discussion went beyond the compass of my brain.  讨论超出了我的理解能力。

words.meaning: n.  新奇,新鲜,新奇的事物
words.example:
The novelty of these toys soon wore off and the children became bored with them.  孩子们对这些玩具的新鲜感很快就消失了，开始厌倦起来。
In Britain in the 1950s, television had a novelty value.  在20世纪50年代的英国，电视机曾经是一种新奇的事物。
Tourists are still a novelty on this remote island.  鲜有游客造访这偏僻的岛屿。

words.meaning: n.  氖; 霓虹灯
words.example: a neon light/sign  霓虹灯／霓虹灯广告牌

words.meaning: v.  破坏，危及
words.example: She knew that by failing her exams she could jeopardize her whole future.  她知道考试不及格会影响自己整个未来的前途。

words.meaning: n.  芽,萌芽vt.  使发芽,摘去芽vi.  长芽,抽条
words.example:
It takes about three days for the seeds to sprout.  这些种子大概要三天时间才会发芽。
Your hair is sticking up - it looks like you're sprouting horns!  你的头发竖起来了——看起来跟长了角一样！
New factories have sprouted up everywhere.  新工厂如雨后春笋般地四处涌现。noun countable

words.meaning: n.  腺
words.example: The glands in my neck are a bit swollen.  我颈部的腺体有点肿胀。

words.meaning: n.  鸽子
words.example: Transport? That's not my pigeon - ask Danny.  运输？这不归我管——去问丹尼。

words.meaning: n.  社会学
words.example:
She has a degree in sociology and politics.  她拥有社会学和政治学学位。
He specializes in the sociology of education/law/the family.  他专门研究教育／法律／家庭社会学。

words.meaning: vi.  渴望,想念,怀念
words.example: Despite his great commercial success he still yearns for critical approval.  尽管他在商场非常成功，但还是渴望得到评论家的认可。

words.meaning: n.  跃,回跳,范围,边界a.  受约束的,装订的,有义务的,关联的,便秘的,准
words.example:
You're bound to feel nervous about your interview.  面试时你很可能会感到紧张。
These two young musicians are bound for international success (= are certain to be successful).  这两位年轻的音乐家一定会蜚声国际。
They are bound and determined to build their own house someday.  他们坚信总有一天他们会盖起自己的房子。

words.meaning: n.  纬度,范围
words.example:
At these latitudes the sun does not rise at all on winter days.  处于这些纬度的地区冬天根本就见不到太阳。UK noun
Courts can show a considerable degree of latitude when it comes to applying the law.  法庭在依法量刑断案方面有较大的自由度。

words.meaning: vt.  装饰，装扮
words.example: The bride's hair was adorned with pearls and white flowers.  新娘的头上戴着珍珠和白花。

words.meaning: vt.  使相等,视为平等vi.  等同
words.example:
He complained that there was a tendency to equate right-wing politics with self-interest.  他抱怨说，人们往往会把右翼政见和自私自利混为一谈。verb transitive
The price of such goods in those days equates to about $50 a kilo at current prices.  那个时候这类商品的价格大概相当于现价50美元1公斤。

words.meaning: vt.  统一
words.example: If the new leader does manage to unify his warring party it will be quite an achievement.  如果新领导人能将党内互相争斗的各派力量整合起来，那将是个了不起的成就。

words.meaning: n.  冷漠，不关心
words.example:
Many native speakers of a language show indifference to/towards grammatical points.  许多人都不关注其母语的文法。
His attitude was one of bored indifference.  他的态度既不耐烦又漠不关心。

words.meaning: n.  药店
words.example: The pharmacy is open all night.  药房整夜开门。

words.meaning: a.  螺旋形的; v.  盘旋
words.example:
This year's downward spiral of house prices has depressed the market.  今年房价的持续下跌造成了市场的疲软。
We must avoid the downward spiral in which unemployment leads to homelessness and then to crime.  我们必须避免失业导致无家可归，进而导致犯罪的恶性循环。UK verb intransitive usually + adverb or preposition (-ll- or US USUALLY -l-)
With one wing damaged, the model airplane spiralled downwards.  模型飞机的一个机翼坏了，盘旋下坠。

words.meaning: a.  心脏的，心脏病的
words.example: cardiac arrest (= a condition in which the heart stops beating)  心脏停搏

words.meaning: n.  犁; vt.  耕作
words.example: The farmer plowed the field at dawn.  农夫黎明时犁了地。

words.meaning: a.  受祝福的
words.example:
Blessed are the meek for they shall inherit the Earth.  温柔的人有福了，因为他们必承受土地。
Fortunately we were blessed with fine weather.  幸运的是我们碰上了好天气。
She is blessed with both beauty and brains.  她的命真好，既漂亮又聪慧。

words.meaning: vt.  删除v.  删除
words.example:
They insisted that all expletives be deleted from the article.  他们坚持要删除文中所有的诅咒性词语。
Here is a list of possible answers. Please delete (= draw a line through them) as appropriate.  这里列出了各种备选答案，请酌情删除。

words.meaning: n.  闪烁,闪光,颤动vi.  闪动,闪烁,摇动,扑动翅膀vt.  使摇曳,使闪烁
words.example:
He'd been in a coma for weeks, when all of a sudden he flickered an eyelid.  他已经昏迷几个星期了，突然他的眼皮动了一下。UK noun countable usually singular
There was a flicker of hope in his eyes.  他的眼中闪过一丝希望。

words.meaning: vt.  招致,蒙受,遭遇
words.example:
The play has incurred the wrath/anger of both audiences and critics.  这部剧引起了观众和评论家的愤怒。
Please detail any costs/expenses incurred by you in attending the interview.  请详细列出你参加这次面试所需承担的一切费用。

words.meaning: a.  富有魅力的,迷人的
words.example: She was looking very glam.  她看上去美极了。

words.meaning: n.  吹牛vt. vi.  吹牛
words.example: She's always bragging about how much money she earns.  她老是吹嘘自己赚钱如何如何多。

words.meaning: a.  继承的,连续的
words.example:
It was the team's fourth successive defeat.  那是球队接连第四次失利。
He won the World Championship for the third successive year.  他连续第三次赢得世界锦标赛冠军。

words.meaning: n.  纪念品
words.example:
He bought a model of a red London bus as a souvenir of his trip to London.  他买了一个红色的伦敦公车模型，作为他伦敦之行的纪念。
We brought back a few souvenirs from our holiday in Greece.  我们从希腊度假回来时买了一些纪念品。

words.meaning: n.  弟子,门徒
words.example: an ardent disciple of the prime minister  首相狂热的追随者

words.meaning: n.  乡愁,乡往过去,怀旧之情
words.example:
Some people feel nostalgia for their schooldays.  有些人对自己的学生时代充满了怀旧之情。
Hearing that tune again filled him with nostalgia.  再次听到那首曲子让他心中充满对往事的怀念。

words.meaning: vt.  预先排除,预防,阻止,妨碍
words.example:
His contract precludes him from discussing his work with anyone outside the company.  合约中禁止他与公司外的人谈论工作。
The fact that your application was not successful this time does not preclude the possibility of you applying again next time.  这次应征失败并不妨碍你下次再来应征。

words.meaning: n.  垃圾; vi.  乱丢垃圾使凌乱
words.example:
About 2% of fast-food packaging ends up as litter.  约有2%的速食包装会被人当作垃圾随手扔掉。UK noun
The park was littered with bottles and cans after the concert.  音乐会结束后，公园里到处都是被人丢弃的瓶瓶罐罐。
Dirty clothes littered the floor of her bedroom.  她的睡房地板上到处都是脏衣服。

words.meaning: a.  精致的,细腻的,敏锐的
words.example:
She has exquisite taste.  她品味高雅。adjective
The pain was quite exquisite.  疼痛得剧烈难忍。

words.meaning: a.  不平均的，不均匀的
words.example:
Take care when you walk on that path - the paving stones are rather uneven.  走那条路时要小心——铺路石很不平坦。
There is an uneven distribution of wealth across the country from the north to the south.  全国的财富分配南北很不均衡。
The contest was very uneven - the other team was far stronger than us.  比赛很不平等——对方参赛队的实力比我们强很多。adjective

words.meaning: vt.  沉浸,使陷入
words.example:
She got some books out of the library and immersed her self in Jewish history and culture.  她从图书馆借了一些书，然后沉浸于犹太历史和文化之中。
The shells should be immersed in boiling water for two minutes.  贝类应在沸水中浸上两分钟。

words.meaning: adv.  有意识地，自觉地
words.example: We consciously reduced waste.  我们有意识地减少浪费。

words.meaning: n.  气味,气氛
words.example:
The woods have an aura of mystery.  这片树林透着神秘的气息。
There's an aura of sadness about him.  他看上去一副悲伤的样子。

words.meaning: n.  石油
words.example: Petroleum refining needs high heat.  炼油需要高温。

words.meaning: n.  拍打; v.  (使)摆动; 拍打
words.example:
Flags flapped in the breeze above their tents.  微风中，旗子在他们帐篷上方飘动。verb (-pp-)
Don't flap - there's plenty of time to cook before they arrive.  别慌，在他们到来之前还有充裕的时间准备饭菜。
Stop flapping about/around !  别慌里慌张的！noun

words.meaning: n.  屈服,服从,谦逊,意见,提交,递呈
words.example:
No date has yet been set for the submission of applications.  申请的提交日期还未确定。
The final deadline for submissions is February 21st.  提交的最后期限是2月21日。
They thought the country could be bombed into submission.  他们认为轰炸可以使该国屈服。

words.meaning: a.  激烈的
words.example: Many employees have had to take drastic cuts in pay.  许多员工不得不接受大幅降薪。

words.meaning: n.  到来，出现
words.example: Life in Britain was transformed by the advent of the steam engine.  蒸汽机的出现使英国人的生活发生了翻天覆地的变化。

words.meaning: vt.  使疏远,离间,让与
words.example:
All these changes to the newspaper have alienated its traditional readers.  报纸改头换面疏远了老读者。verb transitive
Disagreements can alienate teenagers from their families.  家庭争吵会使青少年跟家人产生感情裂痕。

words.meaning: n.  (昆虫的)尾刺; 刺痛
words.example:
Do all types of bee sting?  所有种类的蜜蜂都蜇人吗？
The soap/smoke/sweat stung my eyes.  肥皂／烟雾／汗水刺痛了我的双眼。
This type of disinfectant doesn't sting, even if you put it on a fresh cut.  这种消毒药水即使涂在新伤口上也不会有灼痛感。

words.meaning: a.  懒散的; 空闲的
words.example:
Half these factories now stand idle.  这些工厂如今有半数闲置。
It's crazy to have £7000 sitting idle in the bank.  把7000英镑闲置在银行里简直是疯了。
If you have an idle moment, call me.  如果你有空，给我打电话。

words.meaning: n.  海豚
words.example: A dolphin jumped beside the boat.  海豚在船边跃起。

words.meaning: n.  解剖构造; 解剖
words.example:
An understanding of human anatomy is important to a dancer.  对于一个舞蹈演员来说，通晓一些人体解剖学知识非常重要。
He later became professor of anatomy at Kiel.  后来他成为基尔大学的解剖学教授。
On which part of her anatomy is she tattooed?  她的纹身刺在甚么部位？

words.meaning: vt.  精准定位
words.example:
It is not possible to pinpoint precisely the time of death.  准确地确定死亡时间是不可能的。
Emergency workers at the site are still unable to pinpoint the cause of the explosion.  现场的急救人员仍然无法确定爆炸的起因。UK noun countable
The computer will calculate your position with pinpoint accuracy.  这台电脑能够精确地计算出你的位置。

words.meaning: a.  枢轴的,关键的
words.example: a pivotal figure/role/idea  关键人物／角色／想法

words.meaning: a.  衣衫褴褛的,参差的,刺耳的,粗糙的,不协调的
words.example:
The children were wearing dirty ragged clothes.  孩子们身上的衣服又脏又破。
Two ragged children stood outside the station begging for money.  两个衣衫褴褛的孩子站在车站外乞讨。
The leaves of this plant have ragged edges.  这种植物的叶子边缘参差不齐。

words.meaning: n.  孤独,单独,孤寂
words.example:
After months of solitude at sea it felt strange to be in company.  在海上独居了几个月之后，对有人陪伴感到有些不适应。
It provides one with a chance to reflect on spiritual matters in solitude.  它为人们提供了幽居独处、玄思冥想的机会。

words.meaning: n.  风景,景色,舞台布景
words.example: They stopped at the top of the hill to admire the scenery.  他们在山顶上停了下来，欣赏起风景来。UK noun uncountable

words.meaning: n.  宇宙
