They've got one daughter, Isabel, aged 3.  他们有个女儿，叫伊莎贝尔，三岁了。adjective
She has two rather aged aunts.  她有两位年迈的姑姑。plural noun]Diːˈeɪdʒɪd/
The hospital was built to meet the needs of the aged.  这所医院是为了满足老年人的需要而建立的。

words.meaning: a.  感觉的; 感官的
words.example: The experiment tests sensory response.  实验测试感官反应。

words.meaning: a.  明显的; 值得注意的
words.example: There has been a noticeable improvement in Tim's cooking.  提姆的烹饪水准显著提高。

words.meaning: a.  补充的,补足的
words.example: My family and my job both play an important part in my life, fulfilling separate but complementary needs.  家庭和工作都是我生活中重要的组成部分，两者互为补充，满足我不同的需要。

words.meaning: vt.  放射,散发,广播,传播,辐射vi.  发光,辐射,流露a.  有射线的,辐射
words.example:
The planet Jupiter radiates twice as much heat from inside as it receives from the Sun.  木星内部散发出的热量是它吸收太阳热量的两倍。
He was radiating joy and happiness.  他显得快乐而又幸福。
Enthusiasm was radiating from her.  她热情洋溢。verb

words.meaning: a.  有人情的,人道的,仁慈的
words.example: The humane way of dealing with a suffering animal (= the way that causes the least pain) is to kill it quickly.  对待为病痛所折磨的动物，比较人道的办法就是尽快结束它的生命。    Opposite inhumane

words.meaning: vt.  撇萚∧?略读,掠过vi.  擦过,浏览n.  脱脂乳,擦过a.  撇萚∧说?
words.example:
The birds skimmed (across/along/over) the tops of the waves.  鸟儿从浪头上飞过。
We watched a child skimming stones across the lake.  我们看着一个孩子在湖上打水漂。 (-mm-)
I've only skimmed (through/over) his letter; I haven't read it carefully yet.  我只是大致看了一遍他的来信，还没有细读。

words.meaning: a.  金属(性)的
words.example:
Beer from a can often has a metallic taste.  罐装啤酒常有一股金属味道。
Our new car is metallic blue.  我们新车的颜色是带有金属质感的蓝色。
Brass is a metallic alloy of copper and zinc.  黄铜是铜和锌的合金。

words.meaning: n.  直觉,直觉的知识
words.example: Often there's no clear evidence one way or the other and you just have to base your judgment on intuition.  很多时候，往往没有这样或那样的确凿证据，你只好凭直觉进行判断。

words.meaning: a.  习惯了的
words.example:
She quickly became accustomed to his messy ways.  她很快就习惯了他的邋遢作风。
I'm not accustomed to being treated like this.  我不习惯别人这样待我。
She performed the task with her accustomed ease.  她以一贯的轻松自如完成了任务。

words.meaning: n.  怪人,偏心圆a.  古怪的,反常的,不同圆心的,
words.example: My mother's a bit of an eccentric.  我妈妈有点古怪。

words.meaning: a.  亲切的,高尚的
words.example:
He was gracious enough to thank me.  他很有礼貌地向我道谢。
The losing team were gracious in defeat.  失利的球队豁达地面对失败。adjective
We can't afford gracious living.  我们过不起安逸的生活。exclamation old-fashioned

words.meaning: vt.  冷藏; 使变冷
words.example: Fresh orange juice should be refrigerated after opening and drunk within three days.  新鲜橘子汁开瓶后应冷藏，并应在三天内喝完。

words.meaning: n.  连续统一体
words.example: It's not 'left-wing or right-wing' - political opinion is a long continuum.  这不是“左翼或右翼”的问题——政治观点是长期形成逐渐演变的。

words.meaning: vt.  使成形形色色,使多样化,使变化
words.example:
Millions of years ago, changes in the Earth's climate caused animal and plant life to diversify.  数百万年前，地球气候的变化导致了动植物的多样化。
Many wheat farmers have begun to diversify into other forms of agriculture.  很多麦农已经开始采用其他农业种植模式。

words.meaning: n.  堡垒,易货站,要塞vt.  设要塞保卫vi.  设要塞
words.example: The remains of the Roman fort are well preserved.  这个罗马要塞的遗址保存完好。

words.meaning: n.  不利点,退税
words.example: One of the drawbacks of living with someone is having to share a bathroom.  和别人合住的缺点之一就是不得不合用洗手间。

words.meaning: a.  眼花缭乱的,耀眼的
words.example: a dazzling white light  一道刺眼的白光

words.meaning: n.  货运
words.example:
The ship carries both freight and passengers.  这艘船既载货又载客。
Will the goods be sent by air or sea freight?  这些货物要空运还是海运？
Grapes from this region are freighted all over the world.  这个地区生产的葡萄被运到世界各地。adverb

words.meaning: a.  不注意的,大意的,卤莽的,不顾后果的
words.example: He was found guilty of reckless driving.  他被判鲁莽驾驶罪名成立。

words.meaning: a.  平滑的,有光泽的
words.example:
She has wonderfully glossy hair.  她有一头顺滑的秀发。
This magazine is full of glossy advertisements for aftershave.  这本杂志中满是介绍刮胡水的广告，尽是些夸夸其谈的东西。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.  怨言,满腹牢骚vi. 呻吟,抱怨,发牢骚vt.  喃喃地说出
words.example:
She spent the evening grumbling to me about her job.  她整晚都在向我抱怨她的工作。
If I hear any more grumbles about the food, you can do the cooking yourself!  要是再让我听到你抱怨饭不好吃，你就自己做！

words.meaning: n.  流入,河口,汇集
words.example: Turkey is expecting an influx of several thousand refugees over the next few days.  未来几天涌入土耳其的难民预计会达几千人。

words.meaning: n.  学徒,生手vt.  使做学徒
words.example:
Most of the work was done by apprentices.  大部分工作是由学徒做的。
Michelangelo was apprenticed to Ghirlandaio in Florence for three years.  米开朗基罗曾在佛罗伦斯师从吉尔兰达约三年。

words.meaning: n.  蛾
words.example: Some types of moth eat holes in clothes.  某些种类的飞蛾会蛀蚀衣物。

words.meaning: vi.  暗示,提及
words.example: She mentioned some trouble that she'd had at home and I guessed she was alluding to her son.  她提到家中有些麻烦事，我猜她是指她的儿子。

words.meaning: n.  (地球或天体的)半球; 大脑的半球
words.example: the northern hemisphere  北半球

words.meaning: n.  障碍,困难vt.  加障碍于,妨碍
words.example:
In cases of severe mental handicap, constant supervision is recommended.  对于严重的智障病人，建议进行不间断的监护。noun
Handicaps give people with different abilities an equal chance of winning.  让步赛给具有不同能力的人同等的获胜机会。
My current golf handicap is nine.  我现在的高尔夫让分是九杆。verb transitive (-pp-)

words.meaning: n.  史诗; a.  英雄的
words.example:
It's one of those old Hollywood epics with a cast of thousands.  这是老牌的好莱坞史诗电影之一，演员阵容达到数千人。adjective
The problem of inflation has reached epic proportions.  通货膨胀问题已经到了极其严重的地步。

words.meaning: vt.  更新,革新,恢复,修复,刷新
words.example: He renovates old houses and sells them at a profit.  他靠翻修老房子再出售赚钱。

words.meaning: vt.  哄,诱骗,慢慢的做好vi.  哄骗n.  哄骗
words.example:
Perhaps you could coax your father into taking you to the station.  也许你能花言巧语说服父亲带你去车站。
He has some information I want, so I'm going to try to coax it out of him over a drink.  他知道一些我想要的消息，所以我要设法在喝酒时从他那里把它套出来。

words.meaning: n.  流星
words.example: A meteor lit up the sky.  一颗流星照亮了天空。

words.meaning: n.  变化,转变,元音变化
words.example:
It is well known that radiation can cause mutation.  众所周知，辐射可以造成基因突变。
Environmental pressures encourage genes with certain mutations to persist and others to die out.  环境的影响使某些发生了若干突变的基因存活下来，却使另一些消亡了。
These plants carry the mutation for red flowers.  这些植物携带红花变种。

words.meaning: n.  目击者,见证人
words.example: According to an eyewitness account , the thieves abandoned their vehicle near the scene of the robbery.  据一位目击证人的描述，这帮盗贼在抢劫现场附近弃车潜逃。

words.meaning: n.  委屈,冤情,苦况
words.example:
Bill still harbours/nurses a grievance against his employers for not promoting him.  因为没有得到提升，比尔对他的雇主仍然心怀不满。
The small amount of compensation is a further source of grievance to the people forced to leave their homes.  被迫离开家园的人们仅获得很少的补偿，这成为激起他们不满的另一诱因。

words.meaning: n.  纸浆
words.example:
Mash the bananas to a pulp and then mix in the yoghurt.  把香蕉捣成糊状，然后拌到酸乳酪里。
Old newspapers are pulped and recycled.  旧报纸被化成纸浆重新利用。

words.meaning: n.  帝王,统治者,元首
words.example: Britain's head of state is a constitutional monarch (= only has very limited powers).  英国的国家元首是君主立宪的女王。

words.meaning: v.  漏出，渗漏
words.example:
Pesticides are seeping out of farmland and into the water supply.  杀虫剂正从农田中渗出，进入供水系统。
figurative Given the intense secrecy of the arms business, information only seeps out in company literature.  由于军火贸易极度保密，只能从公司的资料中获得一点蛛丝马迹。

words.meaning: vt.  珍爱,怀有,爱护
words.example:
Although I cherish my children, I do allow them their independence.  尽管我爱护自己的孩子，但我也的确允许他们独立。
Her most cherished possession is a 1926 letter from F. Scott Fitzgerald.  她最珍爱之物是佛兰西斯‧史考特‧费兹杰罗在1926年写给她的一封信。
Freedom of speech is a cherished (= carefully protected) right in this country.  在这个国家，言论自由是备受保护的权利。

words.meaning: a.  广大的,大规模的
words.example: a spacious house/living room  宽敞的房子／起居室

words.meaning: v.  弄清楚
words.example:
You'd better mend that hole before the whole sweater starts to unravel.  你最好把那个洞补上，免得整件毛衣脱线。
We've got a long way to go before we unravel the secrets of genetics.  在揭开遗传学之谜前，我们还有很长的路要走。 (-ll- or US USUALLY -l-)
As talks between the leaders broke down, several months of careful diplomacy were unravelled.  由于领导人之间的会谈破裂，几个月精心策划的外交努力付诸东流。

words.meaning: a.  生气的
words.example:
He was annoyed at the way she tried to take over the whole meeting.  她试图操控整个会议，这使他很恼火。
My parents were rather annoyed (that) I hadn't told them about the accident.  我没有告诉父母这次事故，这让他们很生气。
She was annoyed to discover that her husband had taken her car keys.  她丈夫拿走了她的汽车锁匙，她发现后很生气。

words.meaning: v.  铸造(硬币); n.  造币厂
words.example: If his books sell in the States, he'll make a mint.  如果他的书在美国销量理想的话，他会赚一大笔钱。adjective [before noun]

words.meaning: adj.  有说服力的,善于游说的,令人信服的 adv.  ~ly n.  ~ness
words.example:
Your arguments are very persuasive.  你的论据非常有说服力。
He can be very persuasive.  他有时也很有说服力。

words.meaning: a.  热望的,急切的,贪婪的
words.example:
He took an avid interest in the project.  他对这个企划案产生了极大的兴趣。
formal She hadn't seen him for six months and was avid for news.  她已六个月未曾见到他，正望穿秋水地盼着他的音讯。

words.meaning: n.  神话学，神话
words.example:
She's fascinated by the stories of classical mythology (= ancient Greek and Roman myths).  她被古典神话故事迷住了。UK noun uncountable
It's just a piece of popular mythology that people always get sacked when they are away.  缺勤总会遭到解雇其实是一种普遍的错误观念。

words.meaning: n.  厌烦,厌倦,令人厌烦的事物
words.example: They started quarrelling out of sheer boredom.  他们开始吵架完全是出于无聊。

words.meaning: v.  纪念，庆祝
words.example: Gathered all together in this church, we commemorate those who lost their lives in the great war.  我们聚集在这座教堂里，缅怀那些在大战中丧生的人。

words.meaning: v.  (动物)将…的皮毛弄干净; 使做好准备
words.example:
Polly spends hours in the stables grooming her pony.  波莉在马厩里刷洗她的小马，一洗就几个小时。verb transitive
She was being groomed for leadership.  她正在接受训练以担任领导。
The bride and groom walked down the aisle together.  新娘和新郎一起走过教堂的通道。noun countable

words.meaning: a.  污秽的,丑恶的
words.example:
Wash your hands - they're filthy!  去洗手，你的手太脏了！
Look at this cloth - it's filthy!  看看这块布，太脏了！
I've never smoked - it's a filthy habit.  我从不吸烟，那是一个极坏的习惯。

words.meaning: vi.  推迟,延期,听从vt.  使推迟,使延期
words.example: My bank has agreed to defer the repayments on my loan while I'm still a student.  银行同意在我上学期间延迟偿还贷款。

words.meaning: a.  漂亮的，时髦的
words.example: The film's direction is subtle and stylish.  这部电影导演手法精巧细致、格调高雅。

words.meaning: a.  突然的，意外的
words.example:
Our conversation came to an abrupt end when George burst into the room.  乔治突然冲进房间里，我们的谈话戛然而止。
The road ended in an abrupt (= sudden and very steep) slope down to the sea.  道路沿一个险峭陡坡俯冲到海边，就到了尽头。adjective
He is sometimes very abrupt with clients.  他有时对待客户非常粗鲁。

words.meaning: a.  同时的
words.example: There were several simultaneous explosions in different cities.  几起爆炸同时在不同的城市发生。

words.meaning: n.  古老,古代,古代的遗物
words.example:
Cannabis has been used for medicinal purposes since antiquity.  自古以来，大麻就一直用于治病。
Before creating this sculpture, she studied all the masterpieces of classical antiquity.  在创作这件雕塑之前，她研究了所有古希腊和古罗马时代的雕塑杰作。
Under Greek law, all antiquities that are discovered in Greece belong to the government.  根据希腊法律，在希腊发现的所有古物均归政府所有。

words.meaning: a.  使人耳目一新的; 提神的
words.example:
There's nothing more refreshing on a hot day than a cold beer.  炎热的天气里，没有比喝杯冰镇啤酒更令人感到凉爽的了。
It's a refreshing change to see a losing team shaking hands and still smiling after a match.  看到输球的球队队员依然面带微笑跟对手握手，真是令人觉得与众不同。

words.meaning: a.  多才多艺的,万用的,万向的
words.example: He's a very versatile young actor who's as happy in horror films as he is in TV comedies.  他是一个非常多才多艺的年轻演员，无论是演恐怖片还是电视喜剧都一样得心应手。

words.meaning: n.  隆隆声,辘辘声vi.  发隆隆声,辘辘响vt.  使隆隆响,低沉地说
words.example:
Please excuse my stomach rumbling - I haven't eaten all day.  不好意思，我肚子在咕咕叫——我一整天都没吃东西了。
The tanks rumbled (= moved slowly, making a continuous noise) across the battlefield.  坦克轰鸣着驶过战场。verb
I'm afraid our little tax dodge has been rumbled.  恐怕我们逃税的小把戏被识破了。verb

words.meaning: n.  交响乐
words.example: Mahler's 9th symphony  马勒的《第九交响曲》

words.meaning: n.  纯度; 纯净
words.example: For Christians, the Virgin Mary is a symbol of purity.  对基督徒来说，圣母玛莉亚是贞洁的象征。

words.meaning: vt.  反复地说,重申,反复地做
words.example: The government has reiterated its refusal to compromise with terrorists.  政府重申拒绝向恐怖分子妥协。

words.meaning: n. a.  外部(的)，外表(的)
words.example:
In some of the villages the exterior walls of the houses are painted pink.  在一些村子里，房屋外墙被漆成粉红色。
Exterior to the main house there is a small building that could be used as an office or studio.  房屋的主要单位外有一个小屋，可以用作办公室或工作间。
The Palace of Fontainebleau has a very grand exterior.  枫丹白露宫殿的外观雄伟壮丽。

words.meaning: n.  怀疑者,怀疑论者,无神论者
words.example: The skeptic demanded evidence.  怀疑论者要求证据。

words.meaning: a.  增氧健身法的; [pl.  ]n.  有氧运动
words.example: Aerobic exercise strengthens the heart.  有氧运动强健心脏。

words.meaning: vt.  即席写作,即席即兴,即席而作
words.example:
To sleep on, we improvised a mattress from a pile of blankets.  为了能有地方睡觉，我们临时用一堆毯子作床垫。
During certain scenes of the play there isn't any script and the actors just improvise (the dialogue).  这出戏有几场没有剧本，演员就即兴表演（对白）。

words.meaning: n.  小平面,方面,刻面
words.example: She has so many facets to her personality.  她的性格具有多面性。

words.meaning: a.  不法的,不正的,禁止的
words.example: illicit drugs such as cocaine and cannabis  古柯碱和大麻之类的违禁药物

words.meaning: vt.  解除武装,回复平常的编制,缓和vi.  放下武器
words.example:
With one movement, she disarmed the man and pinned him against the wall.  她一下子就缴了那男子的械，并把他按到墙上。
Many politicians argued that this was no time to disarm (= give up the country's weapons and army).  很多政治家争辩说现在不是交出国家的武器和军队的时候。
Experts successfully managed to disarm the bomb (= stop it from exploding).  专家们成功地拆除了炸弹的引信。UK verb

words.meaning: n.  小测验
words.example:
There are so many inane television quiz shows.  电视上有那么多愚蠢的智力竞赛节目。
There was a pop (= surprise) quiz in history at school today.  今天的历史课上进行了突击测验。verb transitive (-zz-)
She spent an hour being quizzed by journalists.  她花了一小时时间回答记者的提问。

words.meaning: a.  不育的,贫瘠的n.  荒地
words.example:
We drove through a barren, rocky landscape.  我们驾车时，经过一个到处都是岩石的不毛之地。
She became very depressed during the barren years when she was unable to paint.  她在作品匮乏的那几年间，变得非常消沉。    Compare fertile

words.meaning: a.  贫穷的,贫困的,生活艰苦的
words.example:
The proceeds from the sale go to help needy people in the area.  此次义卖的收入用来帮助该地区的穷人。
Sybil was very insecure and needy.  西比尔很缺乏安全感，很需要别人的关怀。plural noun
Let us pray for those who are not so fortunate as ourselves - the sick, the old and the needy.  让我们为那些比我们不幸的病弱者、老人和穷人祈祷吧。

words.meaning: n.  铰链,关键,枢纽vt.  装铰链vi.  靠铰链移动,依. . . 而转移
words.example:
We had to take the front door off its hinges to get our new sofa into the house.  我们不得不把前门从铰炼上卸下来，这样我们的新沙发才能搬进屋子里。verb
The prosecution's case hinged on the evidence of a witness who died before the trial.  控方的案子取决于一位证人的证词，而该证人已在审判前死去。
The film's plot hinges on a case of mistaken identity.  该电影的情节围绕着一宗身份误认案件展开。

words.meaning: a.  直言无讳的,坦率的,坦白无隐的
words.example: Mr Masack is an outspoken critic of the present government.  马塞克先生是一位对现政府直言不讳的批评家。

words.meaning: a.  受约束的，限制的
words.example:
Building in this area of town is restricted.  在该城区建房是受限制的。
Membership is restricted to (= It is only for) chief executive officers.  能获得会员资格的人只限于首席执行官们。
Our view of the stage was restricted (= objects prevented us from seeing the whole stage).  在我们的座位上视野受限，看不清整个舞台。

words.meaning: vt.  假定; 假设
words.example: There's no point hypothesizing about how the accident happened, since we'll never really know.  假设意外是如何发生根本没有任何意义，因为我们永远也不会知道真相。

words.meaning: n.  最前沿; 中心
words.example: The company is at the forefront of AI.  公司处于人工智能最前沿。

words.meaning: a.  世俗的，平凡的
words.example: Mundane matters such as paying bills and shopping for food do not interest her.  她对付帐单、购买食物等单调的琐事不感兴趣。

words.meaning: a.  审慎的,三思而后行的,精明的,节俭的
words.example: It's prudent to keep some savings.  存点钱是明智的。

words.meaning: a.  天的,天国的,天空的
words.example: The moon is a celestial body.  月亮是天体中的一员。

words.meaning: a.  意见一致的,无异议的
words.example:
The jury returned a unanimous verdict of guilty after a short deliberation.  陪审团经过短时间商讨后一致裁决有罪。
After a lengthy discussion we reached a unanimous decision on the proposal.  经过长时间讨论，我们对这一提案作出了一致决定。
The new format has unanimous support and could be introduced next season.  新的设计获得了一致支持，将会在下个季度推广使用。

words.meaning: n.  延长，延续
words.example:
The continuation of the strike caused a lot of poverty.  持续罢工造成了大量贫困现象。
It's just a continuation of the bigger river, but called by a different name.  它实际上是那条大河的延续，只是名称不同而已。

words.meaning: n.  暗杀者,刺客
words.example:
John Lennon's assassin was Mark Chapman.  刺杀约翰，蓝侬的人是马克‧查普曼。
She hired an assassin to eliminate her rival.  她雇用刺客，除掉她的对手。

words.meaning: vt.  涂,擦上,玷污,抹擦使变模糊vi.  被弄脏n.  污点,污迹,污蔑
words.example:
The children had smeared peanut butter all over the sofa.  孩子们把花生酱抹得沙发上到处都是。
Can you explain why the front of your car is smeared with blood?  你能解释一下为甚么你的汽车前部沾有血迹吗？UK verb
She decided to sue for libel after the newspaper smeared her private life.  这家报纸对她的私生活造谣诬蔑，她决定告以诽谤罪。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.  智力，理解力
words.example:
Her energy and intellect are respected all over the world.  她的干劲和才智得到了全世界的尊重。
He is a man more noted for his intellect than his charm.  相比其魅力，他的才智更为人瞩目。

words.meaning: vt.  暗杀,行刺
words.example: a plot to assassinate the Queen  暗杀女王的阴谋

words.meaning: a.  四季不断的,继续多年的
words.example:
The film 'White Christmas' is a perennial favourite.  《白色圣诞》是一部经久不衰、深受欢迎的影片。
We face the perennial problem of not having enough money.  我们长期面临资金不足的问题。    Compare annual ; biennialnoun countable
Roses and geraniums are perennials, flowering year after year.  玫瑰和天竺葵是多年生植物，年复一年地开花。    Compare annual

words.meaning: vt.  (与…)交迭
words.example:
The fence is made of panels which overlap (each other).  这个围栏是由交叠的板条搭成的。
My musical tastes don't overlap with my brother's at all.  我对音乐的喜好和我弟弟完全不一样。noun countable or uncountable UK US [ˈoʊ.və˞-/
The roof tiles will need an overlap of several centimetres.  屋顶的瓦片需要互相重叠几公分。

words.meaning: vt.  使充气; 使膨胀
words.example:
He inflated the balloons with helium.  他给气球充了氦气。
We watch the hot-air balloon slowly inflate.  我们看着热气球慢慢胀大。verb
They inflated their part in the rescue every time they told the story.  他们每次讲这个故事时都要夸大自己在营救中的贡献。

words.meaning: vt.  注入,泡出味道,鼓舞vi.  泡,注
words.example:
The pulling down of the Berlin Wall infused the world with optimism.  柏林围墙的倒塌使全世界欢欣鼓舞。
The arrival of a group of friends on Saturday infused new life into the weekend.  星期六一群朋友的到来给周末生活注入了新的活力。verb
Allow the tea to infuse for five minutes.  让茶泡五分钟。

words.meaning: n.  滴,细流vi.  滴流,细细地流vt.  使滴,使细流
words.example:
Blood trickled out of the corner of his mouth.  血从他的嘴角滴了下来。
Oil was trickling from a tiny hole in the tank.  油正从油罐上的一个小孔往下滴。verb intransitive
Gradually people trickled back into the theatre for the second half.  渐渐地，人们开始三三两两地回到剧院看下半场。noun

words.meaning: n.  变体,异体a.  不同的,差别的
words.example:
There are many colas on the market now, all variants on the original drink.  现在市场上有多种可乐，都跟原先那种饮料差不多。
There are four variants of malaria, all transmitted to humans by a particular family of mosquitoes.  疟疾有四个变种，都是透过一种特殊的蚊子传播给人。UK adjective
Words spelt with 'ae', such as 'encyclopaedia', have a variant spelling with 'e', as in 'encyclopedia'.  拼写中带 ae 的单词，如 encyclopaedia，有一种可以只拼出 e 的变异拼法，如 encyclopedia。

words.meaning: n.  不规则,异常的人或物
words.example:
Statistical anomalies can make it difficult to compare economic data from one year to the next.  统计上的不规范会使年与年之间的经济数据难以互相比较。
The anomaly of the social security system is that you sometimes have more money without a job.  社会保障制度下的反常现像是，失业有时反而拿钱更多。

words.meaning: a.  荒废的,成废物的,陈旧的n.  废词,陈腐的人,废物
words.example: Gas lamps became obsolete when electric lighting was invented.  电灯发明以后煤气灯就被淘汰了。

words.meaning: n.  仲裁,公断
words.example: Both sides in the dispute have agreed to go to arbitration to have the disagreement solved by an arbitrator .  争议双方都同意提请仲裁。

words.meaning: a.  贪婪的,贪得的,贪吃的
words.example: He's greedy for power/success.  他贪恋权力／极度渴望成功。

words.meaning: n.  海上救助,抢救,打捞vt.  海上救助,抢救,打捞,营救
words.example:
After the fire, there wasn't much furniture left worth salvaging.  火灾之后，没有剩下多少值得抢救的家俱。
It was a desperate attempt to salvage the situation.  挽回这种局面的希望渺茫。
After the fraud scandal he had to make great efforts to salvage his reputation.  诈骗丑闻传出后，他不得不极力挽回自己的声誉。

words.meaning: n.  轶事,奇闻
words.example: He told one or two amusing anecdotes about his years as a policeman.  他讲了一两件他当员警时发生的趣事。

words.meaning: n.  大豆
words.example: Soybean oil is widely used.  豆油被广泛使用。

words.meaning: n.  衣服,装具vt.  使穿衣,装饰
words.example: sports apparel  运动服装

words.meaning: a.  完成的,实现的,善社交的,有造诣的
words.example:
She's a very accomplished pianist/painter/horsewoman.  她是一位很有造诣的钢琴家／很有才华的画家／技艺高超的骑师。
He was accomplished in all the arts.  他精通各门艺术。

words.meaning: a.  脆弱的,虚弱的,意志薄弱的n.  灯心草篓
words.example: a frail old lady  孱弱的老妪

words.meaning: n.  疹，皮疹
words.example:
I've got an itchy rash all over my chest.  我胸部出满了疹子，痒得要命。
He came out/up in a rash after he fell in a patch of nettles.  他摔倒在一片荨麻地里，结果身上就起了疹子。
If you stay in the sun too long you'll get (a) heat rash.  如果你在阳光下呆得太久，就会生痱子。noun

words.meaning: n.  拥塞
words.example: Traffic congestion wastes hours.  交通拥堵浪费数小时。

words.meaning: vt.  切断,脱离,分开,中断,断绝,使分离vi.  断,裂开,被分开
words.example:
The knife severed an artery and he bled to death.  刀子割断了动脉，他流血过多而死。
Her foot was severed from her leg in a car accident.  在一次车祸中，她的脚断了。
Electricity cables have been severed by the storm.  风暴弄断了电缆。

words.meaning: a.  必不可少的
words.example:
This book is an indispensable resource for researchers.  这本书是研究人员必不可少的资料。
His long experience at the United Nations makes him indispensable to the talks.  在联合国长期的工作经验使他成为谈判中不可或缺的人物。

words.meaning: n.  颜料,染料vt.  染,染色vi.  着色
words.example:
For a change, why not dye your T-shirts?  为什么不变一变把T恤染成别的颜色？
She dipped the material into the dye.  她把布料浸在染料中。
There are dozens of different dyes to choose from.  可供选择的染料有数十种之多。

words.meaning: v.  反叛; n.  起义; 反抗
words.example:
The people revolted against foreign rule and established their own government.  人们奋起反抗外来统治，并成立了自己的政府。UK verb
We were revolted by the dirt and mess in her house.  她家里又脏又乱，我们看着心里生厌。
It revolts me to know that the world spends so much money on arms when millions are dying of hunger.  这个世界有数以百万计的人因饥饿挣扎在死亡线上，但却有那么多的钱花在军备上，这真让我感到震惊。

words.meaning: a.  实际的，真实的
words.example: She gave a clear, factual account of the attack.  她如实地清晰陈述了遇袭经过。

words.meaning: n.  小册子
words.example: The pamphlet explains the vaccination.  小册子讲解了疫苗接种。

words.meaning: n.  皮带扣环; v.  扣紧
words.example:
The intense heat from the fire had caused the factory roof to buckle.  大火的高温烤得工厂的屋顶变了形。
Both wheels on the bicycle had been badly buckled.  脚踏车的两个车轮都已严重变形。
But these were difficult times and a lesser man would have buckled under the strain.  但当时是困难时期，脆弱的人肯定会被压力压垮。verb

words.meaning: vt.  镇静,缓和,减轻
words.example: It is unclear how to mitigate the effects of tourism on the island.  人们还不清楚如何减低旅游业对这个岛屿的影响。

words.meaning: n.  群,大群,蜂群vi.  群集,聚集一块,云集,爬树vt.  挤满,爬(树)
words.example:
The dead sheep was covered with swarms of flies.  这头死羊身上爬满一群群的苍蝇。
After the game, thousands of football fans swarmed onto the pitch.  比赛后，成千上万的足球迷涌进球场。UK verb intransitive
The garden is swarming with wasps.  花园里到处都是黄蜂。

words.meaning: n.  拖,拖曳所用之绳,麻的粗纤维vt.  拖,曳,牵引
words.example:
You shouldn't drive fast when your car is towing a caravan.  汽车在拖动活动住房时不能开快车。
The road was closed while the vehicles that had been involved in the accident were towed away/off.  在发生交通事故的车辆被拖走时，这条道路被封闭。
The damaged boat was towed to safety.  受损船只被拖至安全区。UK verb transitive

words.meaning: n. 水坑；泥洼
words.example: The child jumped in the puddle.  孩子跳进了水坑。

words.meaning: vt.  缓和,使安静,安慰,奉承vi.  起安慰作用
words.example: to soothe a crying baby  让哭闹的婴儿安静下来verb transitive

words.meaning: n.  半岛
words.example: the Korean/Arabian/Florida Peninsula  朝鲜／阿拉伯／佛罗里达半岛

words.meaning: vt.  轻视
words.example:
The two groups despise each other.  这两个团体互相鄙视。
She despised him for the way he treated her sister.  他那样对待她姐姐，让她感到很厌恶。

words.meaning: n.  沮丧vt.  使惊愕,使气馁
words.example:
Aid workers were said to have been filled with dismay by the appalling conditions that the refugees were living in.  据说援助人员看到难民所处的恶劣生活环境时都感到非常沮丧。
The supporters watched in/with dismay as their team lost 6-0.  球队的支持者们郁闷地看着自己的球队以０比６的比分输掉了比赛。
She discovered, to her dismay, that her exam was a whole month earlier than she'd expected.  她郁闷地发现考试比她预料的早了整整一个月。

words.meaning: vt.  效法,尽力赶上,同. . . 竞争
words.example:
They hope to emulate the success of other software companies.  他们希望能够效仿其他软体公司的成功先例。
Fitzgerald is keen to emulate Martin's record of three successive world titles.  费兹杰罗渴望能像马丁那样创下连夺三次世界冠军的纪录。

words.meaning: a.  可疑的,疑心的,不确的
words.example:
The teacher is doubtful about having parents working as classroom assistants.  这位老师对由家长担任课堂助教一事拿不定主意。
It is doubtful whether/if they ever reached the summit before they died.  他们死前不太可能到过山顶。
It was doubtful that the money would ever be found again.  再找到那些钱不太可能了。

words.meaning: n.  果冻
words.example:
I've made a strawberry jelly for the children's tea.  我做了份草莓果冻给孩子当茶点。
Frogs' eggs are covered in a sort of transparent jelly.  青蛙卵上覆盖着一种透明的胶状物。noun
They've threatened to beat him to a jelly if he doesn't repay the money.  他们威胁说，如果他不还钱，就把他打成肉酱。noun

words.meaning: a.  尖的; 尖角的
words.example:
He's got funny little pointed ears.  他长着一对尖尖的小耳朵，很滑稽。UK adjective
My aunt made a few pointed remarks about my taste in clothes.  姑姑一针见血地批评了我对服装的品味。

words.meaning: vt.  缩减,剥夺,简略
words.example: The last government severely curtailed trade union rights.  上届政府严格限制工会权利。

words.meaning: n.  仪式a.  正式的
words.example: The ceremonial hall hosts weddings.  礼堂举办婚礼。

words.meaning: n.  食盒,食篮,阻碍物vt. 阻碍,使困累,妨碍
words.example: Fierce storms have been hampering rescue efforts and there is now little chance of finding more survivors.  猛烈的暴风雨妨碍了救援工作的进行，现在找到更多生还者的希望已经很渺茫了。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.  素食者
words.example:
Of the four million people who have become vegetarians in Britain, nearly two-thirds are women.  在英国已有的400万素食主义者中，将近三分之二是女性。    Compare veganUK adjective (informal veggie)
She's recently gone/become vegetarian.  她最近成了素食主义者。

words.meaning: n.  宴会
words.example: Medieval banquets are held in the castle once a month.  每个月在城堡里举行一次中世纪风格的宴会。

words.meaning: n.  霜; 结霜
words.example:
There was a frost last night.  昨天晚上下霜了。
When I woke up this morning the ground was covered with frost.  我今天早晨醒来的时候地面上覆盖了一层霜。
There were a lot of hard/heavy (= severe) frosts that winter.  那年冬天多次出现严重的霜冻。UK verb

words.meaning: a.  豪华的,奢侈的,放纵的
words.example:
They have a very luxurious house.  他们有一座十分豪华的房子。
We spent a luxurious weekend at a country hotel.  我们在一家乡村饭店渡过了一个奢华的周末。
The cat gave a long, luxurious stretch.  猫舒舒服服地伸了一个长长的懒腰。

words.meaning: vt.  批准,认可
words.example:
Many countries have now ratified the UN convention on the rights of the child.  很多国家现在已经正式签署了联合国儿童权利公约。
The decision will have to be ratified (= approved) by the executive board.  这个决议必须要经过管理委员会的批准。

words.meaning: n.  平衡,平静,均衡
words.example:
The disease destroys much of the inner-ear, disturbing the animal's equilibrium.  这种疾病破坏动物内耳的大部分组织，妨碍其保持均衡。
Yoga is said to restore one's inner equilibrium.  据说练瑜伽可以使人恢复内心的平静。

words.meaning: n.  1 a.  (U) 调味b.  (C) 调味品,佐料,香辣调味料2 (C) 增添趣味的东
words.example: Taste the soup and adjust the seasoning, adding more salt or pepper as desired.  尝一下汤，调好佐料，根据口味再加些盐或胡椒粉。

words.meaning: a.  芬香的,馥郁的,愉快的
words.example: The sauce itself was light, fragrant and slightly sweet.  酱料本身味道清淡、芳香，而且稍微有点甜味。

words.meaning: n.  剧变
words.example:
Yesterday's coup brought further upheaval to a country already struggling with famine.  昨天的军事政变使这个正在饥荒中挣扎的国家更加动荡不安。
It would cause a tremendous upheaval to install a different computer system.  安装一个不同的电脑系统会导致极大的混乱。

words.meaning: n.  岩浆，熔岩
words.example: molten lava  融化的熔岩

words.meaning: a.  不可抵抗的,不能压制的
words.example: She gave me one of those irresistible smiles and I just had to agree.  她对我那莞尔一笑真是令人无法抗拒，我只好同意了。

words.meaning: a.  令人难忘的,壮丽的,威风的
words.example:
He was an imposing figure on stage.  他在舞台上气度不凡。
Would it be too much of an imposition to ask you to pick my parents up from the airport?  请您去机场接我父母是不是太强人所难了？noun

words.meaning: n.  粉笔,白垩vt.  用粉笔写,记录
words.example:
My brother and I are like chalk and cheese.  我哥哥和我截然不同。UK verb intransitive or transitive
Today's victory is the fifth that the Irish team has chalked up this year.  今天的胜利是爱尔兰队今年获得的第五次胜利。
It was doubtful whether the Conservatives could chalk up a fourth successive election victory, but they did.  保守党能否连续四次在选举中获胜令人怀疑，但是他们做到了。

words.meaning: a.  苛求的
words.example: She's a very demanding child.  她是个特别不让人省心的孩子。

words.meaning: n.  家庭教师; vt.  辅导
words.example:
His tutor encouraged him to read widely in philosophy.  他的导师鼓励他广泛阅读哲学著作。
During my illness I was taught by a series of home tutors.  我生病期间由一些家庭教师教我。

words.meaning: n.  颜料; 色素
words.example:
Melanin is the dark brown pigment of the hair, skin and eyes which is present in varying amounts in every human being.  黑色素是头发、皮肤和眼睛中的黑褐色色素，每个人体内或多或少都有这种色素。
Pigment is mixed into oil, glue, egg, etc. to make different types of paint.  将颜料与油、胶水、鸡蛋等混合，制成各种涂料。

words.meaning: n.  暖气锅炉; 熔炉
words.example:
People who work with furnaces in a steel factory need to wear protective clothing.  钢厂里在熔炉边工作的人都需要穿防护服。
This room's like a furnace (= is very hot) !  这个房间热得像熔炉！
It's cold in here - should I turn on the furnace?  这里很冷——要不要我把暖气炉打开？

words.meaning: n.  特技,绝技,花招,噱头,矮小物,发育迟缓,手腕vt.  阻碍成长vi.  表演
words.example:
It's a typical action film with plenty of spectacular stunts.  这是部典型的动作片，有很多精彩好看的特技。
Tom Cruise has performed his own stunts for Mission Impossible 2, defying warnings from professionals.  汤姆‧克鲁斯不顾专业人员的警告，在《不可能的任务 2》中亲自表演自己的特技动作。noun countable
Their marriage was just a cheap publicity stunt.  他们的婚姻不过是低级宣传噱头。noun countable

words.meaning: a.  直觉的
words.example:
Most people have an intuitive sense of right and wrong.  大多数人具有基于直觉的是非感。
Men are often regarded as less intuitive than women.  一般都认为男人的直觉不如女人敏锐。

words.meaning: n.  城堡,要塞vt.  筑要塞,以要塞防守
words.example: The fortress guarded the border.  要塞守卫着边境。

words.meaning: vt. vi.  增加,增大n.  增加
words.example: He would have to find work to augment his income.  他可能不得不找一些工作来增加收入。

words.meaning: n.  触摸a.  动人的,悲惨的
words.example: The way she looked after her little sister was really touching.  她照顾小妹妹的方法真令人感动。

words.meaning: vt.  避开,规避,避免
words.example:
She has shunned publicity since she retired from the theatre.  告别舞台生涯后，她便远离了大众的注意。
After the trial he was shunned by friends and family alike.  审判后，朋友和家人都躲着他。

words.meaning: n. [pl.  larvae]幼虫
words.example: The larva hatches from the egg.  幼虫从卵里孵出。

words.meaning: n.  注意; 留心
words.example:
The airline has been criticized for failing to heed advice/warnings about lack of safety routines.  该航空公司因没有理会针对其日常安全工作不力所提出的建议／警告而受到批评。 formal

words.meaning: a.  严肃的,郑重的,庄严的

words.meaning: a.  (指空间)狭小的，狭窄的

words.meaning: n.  生计; 谋生手段

words.meaning: n.  恐惧,可怕的人,可怕的事a.  可怕的,可怖的vt. vi.  恐惧,害怕

words.meaning: n.  降雨; 降雨量

words.meaning: n.  脚蹼

words.meaning: a.  笨拙的,不雅观的,粗陋的

words.meaning: a.  迫切的,严厉的,银根紧的
words.example:
The most stringent laws in the world are useless unless there is the will to enforce them.  除非能够坚持严格执法，否则即使是世界上最严苛的法律也毫无用处。

words.meaning: n.  石灰石

words.meaning: n.  刺针,刺棒,签子vt.  戳,刺,刺激vi.  戳,刺

He prodded at the fish with his fork a few times, but he didn't eat a mouthful.  他用叉子戳了几次鱼，但一口也没有吃。
He gets things done, but only after I've prodded him into doing them.  他把事情做完了，不过是在我的督促下他才这么做的。UK noun

words.meaning: vt.  使活跃,给予精力
words.example: A short walk energizes the mind.  短暂散步能提神。

words.meaning: n.  轧棉机

words.meaning: n.  微生物; 细菌
