words.meaning: a.  显著的，突出的
words.example:
She began to summarize the salient features/points of the proposal.  她开始总结提议中的重点／要点。
The article presented the salient facts of the dispute clearly and concisely.  这篇文章简明清楚地介绍了这场争端中的主要事实。

words.meaning: vt.  授予,适用,留宿,放置,使用
words.example:
The Chancellorship of the University was bestowed upon her in 1992.  她在1992年被授予大学校长一职。
The George Cross is a decoration that is bestowed on British civilians for acts of great bravery.  乔治十字勋章是为了表彰英国平民的英勇行为而颁发的。

words.meaning: n.  升高,起重机,推动vt. vi.  升起,升高,举起
words.example: With some difficulty he hoisted her onto his shoulders.  他费了些力气才把她扛到自己肩上。

words.meaning: n.  事业,企业,保证
words.example: The bridge was a massive undertaking.  这座桥是浩大的工程。

words.meaning: vt.  使同化,比较,吸取,吸收,比拟vi.  被吸收,被同化
words.example:
The European Union should remain flexible enough to assimilate more countries quickly.  欧盟应该保持足够的灵活性，以加快步伐吸收更多的国家为其成员。
You shouldn't expect immigrants to assimilate into an alien culture immediately.  你不应该指望移民能够马上融入一种外国文化中。
It's hard to assimilate (= learn and understand) so much information.  很难吸收这么多的资讯。

words.meaning: n.  缠结,纠缠,混乱,纠纷vt.  使缠结,使纠缠vi.  缠结,被纠缠
words.example: He was a self-opinionated, overbearing tyrant, and he was the last man she should want to tangle with.  他这个人固执己见、盛气凌人、专横跋扈，她绝不要与他有甚么瓜葛。

words.meaning: vt.  催促,促进vi.  赶快,急忙
words.example:
There is little doubt that poor medical treatment hastened her death.  毫无疑问，劣质的治疗加速了她的死亡。
The president hastened to reassure his people that he was in perfect health.  总统立即解释说他的身体状况非常好，让他的人民放心。
It was an unfortunate decision and I hasten to say it had nothing to do with me.  那是个令人遗憾的决定，我急忙表示那与我没有关系。

words.meaning: vt.  延长,拖延,拖长
words.example:
We were having such a good time that we decided to prolong our stay by another week.  我们过得非常愉快，决定再多待一个星期。
She chewed each delicious mouthful as slowly as she could, prolonging the pleasure.  她细嚼慢咽，尽情地享受每一口美食。

words.meaning: v.  消化，吸收
words.example:
Sit still and allow your meal to digest.  静静地坐着，让胃里的食物消化消化。verb[daɪˈdʒest/
This chapter is so difficult to digest, I shall have to read it again later.  这一章不容易理解消化，稍后我还得再看一遍。noun countable /ˈdaɪ.dʒest/
The company publishes a monthly digest of its activities.  该公司每月出一份活动简报。

words.meaning: vt.  放弃,撤回,让与,放手
words.example:
He has relinquished his claim to the throne.  他放弃了继承王位的要求。
She relinquished control of the family investments to her son.  她把家庭投资的掌控权移交给了儿子。
She relinquished her hold/grip on the steering wheel.  她松开了握着轪盘的手。

words.meaning: a.  阴沉的,凄凉的,暗的n.  低落的情绪,沼泽
words.example:
The acting was dismal, wasn't it?  表演很糟糕，是不是？
What dismal weather!  天气太糟糕了！

words.meaning: vt. vi.  开始,倡导
words.example:
We will commence building work in August of next year.  我们将于明年八月开始破土动工。
Shall we let the meeting commence, gentlemen?  各位先生，我们开始会议，好吗？

words.meaning: n.  理解,忧惧,逮捕
words.example:
It's normal to feel a little apprehension before starting a new job.  在开始新工作前感到有些忐忑不安是很正常的。
There is some apprehension in the office about who the new director will be.  不知谁将担任新主任，办公室里人心惶惶。noun uncountable
Both the army and the police were involved in the apprehension of the terrorists.  军队和警方都参与了抓捕恐怖分子的行动。noun uncountable

words.meaning: n.  障碍,重物vt. vi.  障碍,阻塞
words.example:
The roads are clogged with holiday traffic.  节假日期间，马路上堵满了车辆。
Eating too much fat causes your arteries to clog (up).  摄入过多脂肪会导致动脉栓塞。
Leaves are clogging (up) the drain.  树叶堵塞了下水道。UK noun countable usually plural

words.meaning: a.  被泼水弄湿的,泥泞的,多阴雨的,粗心的
words.example:
The batter was a bit sloppy so I added some more flour.  面糊有点稀，于是我又加进了一些面粉。UK adjective
Spelling mistakes always look sloppy in a formal letter.  在正式信函中出现拼写错误总让人感觉写信者草率马虎。
Another sloppy pass like that might lose them the whole match.  再出现一次那样的草率传球，可能会使他们输掉整场比赛。

words.meaning: n.  装饰,装饰品vt.  装饰
words.example: Garnish the dish with parsley before serving.  这道菜端上桌之前，上面配些欧芹点缀一下。UK noun countable or uncountable

words.meaning: v.  灭亡
words.example:
Three hundred people perished in the earthquake.  有300人在此次地震中丧生。
He believes that Europe must create closer ties or it will perish.  他认为整个欧洲必须建立更紧密的联系，否则就会灭亡。verb intransitive
Sunlight has caused the rubber to perish.  橡胶因暴露于阳光下而老化。verb intransitive

words.meaning: a.  令人喜爱的,愉快的,舒适的
words.example:
The music was very pleasing to the ear (= to listen to).  音乐很好听。
It was pleasing to know that the presentation had gone so well.  得知演出进行得如此顺利，真令人欣慰。

words.meaning: n.  跛行a.  柔软的,无力的,软弱的vi.  跛行
words.example:
Three minutes into the match, Jackson limped off the pitch with a serious ankle injury.  比赛刚刚开始三分钟，杰克逊就因脚踝严重受伤而下场。verb
The little boat limped slowly towards the shore.  那艘小船缓慢地向岸边靠近。
After limping along for almost two years, the economy is starting to show signs of recovery.  经过差不多两年的徘徊，经济开始出现了复苏的迹象。adjective

words.meaning: a.  瘦骨嶙峋的
words.example: long bony fingers  细长瘦削的手指

words.meaning: n.  虚荣心,虚无,手袋,空虚,自负
words.example: He wants the job purely for reasons of vanity and ambition.  他想得到那份工作纯粹是为了满足虚荣和野心。UK noun

words.meaning: vt.  冲淡,稀释a.  淡的,稀释的
words.example:
Dilute the juice (with water) before you drink it.  果汁先（用水）稀释一下再喝。
These measures are designed to dilute public fears about the product's safety.  采取这些措施是为了减轻公众对该产品安全的恐慌。adjective (US usually diluted)

words.meaning: n.  小枝,末梢vt. vi.  注意,了解
words.example:
We collected dry twigs to start the fire.  我们捡干的细树枝生火。verb intransitive or transitive (-gg-)    informal
She's six months pregnant and he still hasn't twigged.  她怀孕六个月了，可他还没意识到。

words.meaning: a.  庞大的
words.example: bulky equipment  庞大的设备

words.meaning: a.  紫外(线)的
words.example: Ultraviolet light sterilizes water.  紫外线能给水消毒。

words.meaning: vi.  上升,追溯,登高vt.  攀登
words.example:
They slowly ascended the steep path up the mountain.  他们沿着陡峭的山路，缓缓地向上攀登。
There's a long flight of steps ascending (= leading up) to the cathedral doors.  要往上走很长一段楼梯，才能到达大教堂的门前。 formal
He eventually ascended to the position of chief executive.  他最终登上了总裁的宝座。 formal

words.meaning: n.  免税者,被免除义务者a.  免除的vt.  使免除,豁免
words.example:
Small businesses have been exempted from the tax increase.  小公司可免增税。adjective
Goods exempt from this tax include books and children's clothes.  免征这项税收的商品包括书籍和童装。
Pregnant women are exempt from dental charges under the current health system.  在现行的医疗制度下，孕妇看牙医是免费的。

words.meaning: vt.  压缩; 缩短
words.example:
Firmly compress the soil in the pot so that the plant is secure.  把盆里的泥土压实以固定植物。
The course compresses two year's training into six intensive months.  这个课程把两年的培训内容压缩成六个月的强化训练。

words.meaning: n.  凡人,人类a.  不免一死的,人类的,临终的
words.example:
For all men are mortal.  人终有一死。    Compare immortal
figurative New computing technology dealt a mortal blow to the power of the old printing unions.  新的电脑技术向传统印刷联合会的权威送上致命一击。    Compare lethal
We live in mortal dread of further attacks.  我们生活在极度恐惧中，担心会再受袭击。

words.meaning: n.  硫磺
words.example: Volcanoes release sulfur dioxide.  火山释放二氧化硫。

words.meaning: vt. vi.  规避,逃避,躲避
words.example:
The police have assured the public that the escaped prisoners will not evade recapture for long.  警方向大众保证，逃犯很快就会再次落网。
She leant forward to kiss him but he evaded her by pretending to sneeze.  她身子前倾想要吻他，可是他假装打喷嚏躲开了。
An Olympic gold medal is the only thing that has evaded her in her remarkable career.  在其辉煌的运动生涯中，唯一没有得到的荣誉就是奥运金牌。

words.meaning: n.  氯
words.example: The chlorine in the pool makes my eyes sore.  游泳池里的氯气刺得我眼睛发痛。

words.meaning: vt.  卷入,吸进,使全神贯注,吞没,投入深渊
words.example:
The flames rapidly engulfed the house.  大火很快吞没了那座房子。
Northern areas of the country were engulfed by/in a snowstorm last night.  昨晚一场暴风雪席卷了这个国家的北部地区。
The war is threatening to engulf the entire region.  战火有可能会席卷整个地区。

words.meaning: vt.  放大，扩大
words.example:
Although our skin looks smooth, when magnified it is full of bumps and holes.  我们的皮肤看上去很光滑，但放大后却满是坑坑洼洼。
The hot summer magnified the racial tensions in the community.  炎热的夏日加深了社区的种族矛盾。

words.meaning: n.  神,神性
words.example: Ares and Aphrodite were the ancient Greek deities of war and love.  阿瑞斯和阿佛洛狄特分别是古希腊的战神和爱神。

words.meaning: a.  不吉利的,凶恶的,左边的
words.example: The ruined house had a sinister appearance.  那栋倒塌的房子外观给人一种不祥之感。

words.meaning: n.  新陈代谢,变形
words.example: Exercise is supposed to speed up your metabolism.  人们认为运动可加速新陈代谢。

words.meaning: vt.  确定,探知
words.example: The police have so far been unable to ascertain the cause of the explosion.  警方到目前为止尚未查明爆炸原因。

words.meaning: n.  担保,保证,根据
words.example: The warranty covers the car mechanically for a year, with unlimited mileage.  保用单承诺对汽车的机械部件保修一年，不限里程。

words.meaning: n.  礼堂,会议厅,听众
words.example: No smoking in the auditorium.  观众席中禁止吸烟。

words.meaning: vt.  打歪,使偏斜vi.  偏斜
words.example:
The crowd cheered as the goalkeeper deflected the shot.  当守门员把球挡出去的时候人们欢呼了起来。
He deflected the ball away from the goal.  他把球挡出了球门。
The Prime Minister deflected mounting criticism today by announcing tax cuts.  今天首相宣布减税，从而平息了越来越多的批评声音。

words.meaning: a.  高的,高超的,傲慢的,玄虚的,高级的
words.example: a lofty ceiling/mountain/wall  高顶／山／墙UK adjective

words.meaning: a.  巨大的; 势不可挡的
words.example: It costs a staggering $50 000 per week to keep the museum open to the public.  维持博物馆对外开放所需的支出每周竟高达五万美元。

words.meaning: vt.  扩大,详述,使增幅vi.  引伸
words.example: amplified music/guitar  经过放大的音乐／带有扩音设备的电吉他

words.meaning: a.  不足的，贫乏的
words.example: They survived on a meager diet.  他们靠微薄的食物活了下来。

words.meaning: n.  花粉
words.example: Pollen triggers his allergies.  花粉引发他的过敏。

words.meaning: n.  修剪,剪下的东西,羊的一岁,大剪刀,切,剪,切变vt.  修剪,割,砍,切,
words.example:
The farmer taught her how to shear sheep.  那个农夫教了她如何剪羊毛。
He recalled the humiliation of having his hair shorn and exchanging his clothes for the prison uniform.  他记起了曾被剃光头、被迫换上囚服的耻辱。
The ex-President, although shorn of his official powers, still has influence.  前总统虽然被剥夺了权力，但是仍有影响力。UK US  (sheared, sheared or shorn)

words.meaning: a.  陆地的，陆生的; 地球的
words.example: Earth is a terrestrial planet.  地球是一颗类地行星。

words.meaning: a.  发光的,明亮的
words.example: luminous clothing  夜光服

words.meaning: a.  海的,海上的,海员的,沿海的
words.example:
Amalfi and Venice were important maritime powers.  阿马尔菲和威尼斯一度是重要的海事基地。
Make sure you visit the maritime museum if you're interested in anything to do with ships or seafaring.  如果你对舰船或航海感兴趣，一定要参观一下那家海事博物馆。
The temperature change in winter is less pronounced in maritime areas.  沿海地区的冬季温度变化不那么明显。

words.meaning: n.  腐烂,腐蚀,败坏vi.  腐烂,烂,堕落,憔悴vt.  使腐烂,使腐朽,使堕落
words.example:
The fruit had been left to rot on the trees.  水果无人采摘，就烂在树上。
Rain has got in and rotted (away) the woodwork.  雨水漏了进来，使屋中的木建部分都朽烂了。
Ruben Carter was left to rot in jail for most of his life.  鲁宾．卡特的大半生都是在牢狱中度过的。UK noun uncountable

words.meaning: vt.  弥漫,渗透,充满vi.  透入
words.example:
Dissatisfaction with the government seems to have permeated every section of society.  社会的每一个角落似乎都弥漫着对政府的不满。
The table has a plastic coating which prevents liquids from permeating into the wood beneath.  桌子上铺了一层塑胶，防止液体渗到下面的木材里。

words.meaning: v.  使认识; 使熟悉
words.example: The Broadcasting Museum also offers Saturday workshops to acquaint children with the world of radio.  广播博物馆还举办周六讲习班让孩子了解无线电世界。

words.meaning: n.  统计数值; [pl.  ]统计学
words.example:
Statistics show/suggest that women live longer than men.  统计资料显示女性寿命比男性长。
According to official statistics, the Japanese work longer hours than workers in most other industrialized countries.  根据官方统计数字，日本人比其他大多数工业国家劳工的工作时间都要长。
The city's most shocking statistic is its high infant mortality rate.  这座城市最令人震惊的统计数字是其高婴儿死亡率。

words.meaning: vt.  使痛苦,折磨
words.example: It is an illness which afflicts women more than men.  患这种疾病的女性多于男性。

words.meaning: a.  挑衅的,目中无人的
words.example:
The protesters blocking the entrance to the offices remained defiant this morning.  堵在办公室入口的抗议者今天早晨态度依然强硬。
The Prime Minister was in defiant mood in the House of Commons.  首相在下议院听不进不同的意见。

words.meaning: vt.  收集,积聚
words.example:
She has amassed a huge fortune from her novels.  她靠写小说慢慢积攒了一大笔钱。
Some of his colleagues envy the enormous wealth that he has amassed.  他积聚了大笔财富，这引起了一些同事的妒忌。

words.meaning: n.  横贯,横木,反驳,否认vt.  横过,穿过,经过,在. . . 来回移动,反对vi
words.example:
Stanley traversed the continent from west to east.  斯坦利自西向东穿越了整个大陆。
Bounded on the east by Lake Winnebago, the county is traversed by the Wolf and Fox rivers.  该县东临温纳贝戈湖，沃尔夫河和福克斯河穿县而过。

words.meaning: n.  温度计,体温计
words.example: The thermometer reads 37 degrees.  体温计显示 37 度。

words.meaning: n.  轻蔑vt.  蔑视,鄙弃
words.example:
He regards the political process with disdain.  他对这一政治进程持鄙视的态度。 formal
The older musicians disdain the new, rock-influenced music.  老一代音乐家鄙视新出现的摇滚风格的音乐。

words.meaning: n.  海角，岬
words.example: the Cape of Good Hope  好望角noun countable

words.meaning: vt.  给予,传授,告知
words.example: Preservatives can impart colour and flavour to a product.  防腐剂能保持产品的色泽和味道。

words.meaning: vt.  颤动，振动
words.example:
The whole station seemed to vibrate as the express train rushed through.  快速列车急驰而过时，整个车站似乎都在震动。
His voice vibrated with anger.  他非常愤怒，声音微微颤抖。

words.meaning: n.  先驱者,前导,先进者
words.example:
Sulphur dioxide is the main precursor of acid rain.  二氧化硫是形成酸雨最重要的先决条件。
Biological research has often been a precursor to medical breakthroughs.  生物学研究往往是医学突破的先驱。

words.meaning: a.  快的,迅速的
words.example:
He's a very speedy worker.  他做起事来很迅速。
We need to take speedy action/make a speedy decision.  我们需要迅速采取行动／迅速作出决定。
Everyone is hoping for a speedy end to the conflict (= hoping that an end to it will happen quickly).  每个人都希望冲突可以尽快结束。

words.meaning: v.  逗乐，逗笑
words.example:
I've brought with me an article from yesterday's paper that I thought might amuse you.  我带来了昨天报上的一篇文章，或许可以让你开怀一笑。
Apparently these stories are meant to amuse.  显然这些故事的目的就在于搞笑。
Shall I put on a video to amuse the kids while we're packing?  我们收拾行李时，要不要给孩子放段影片，逗他们开心？

words.meaning: n.  残干,根株,断牙,意外障碍vt.  阻碍,抢到,清除障碍物
words.example:
We don't anticipate any snags in/with the negotiations.  我们预料谈判不会出现任何麻烦。
The drug is very effective - the only snag is that it cannot be produced in large quantities.  这种药很有效——唯一的问题就是，它不能大量生产。noun countable
This sweater's full of snags.  这件毛衣被钩得全是洞。noun countable

words.meaning: vi.  阴谋,协力,共谋vt.  图谋
words.example:
As girls, the sisters used to conspire with each other against their brother.  还是小女孩的时候，姐妹俩常常在一起密谋对付她们的哥哥。UK verb intransitive
The weather had conspired to ruin their day out.  坏天气凑在一起，天公也不作美，破坏了他们的一日游。
I'd planned a romantic evening together, but circumstances conspired against it - friends arrived unexpectedly and then Dave was called out to an emergency.  我计划两人共度一个浪漫的夜晚，可是事不凑巧——先是朋友们不期而至，接着戴夫被叫去出急诊。

words.meaning: vt.  逐出,夺取,驱逐
words.example:
The president was ousted (from power)in a military coup in January 1987.  总统在1987年1月的一次军事政变中被赶下台。
Police are trying to oust drug dealers from the city centre.  警方正试图将毒品贩子们从市中心撵走。
The champions were defeated by Arsenal and ousted from the League Cup.  冠军们被阿森纳队打败，并被淘汰出联赛杯。

words.meaning: a.  制止,防止,挽留n.  挽留的事物,妨碍物
words.example: Tougher prison sentences may act/serve as (= be) a deterrent to other would-be offenders.  从严判决可以起到震慑其他潜在犯罪者的作用。

words.meaning: a.  狡猾的,诡密的,淘气的,偷偷摸摸的
words.example:
He's a sly old devil - I wouldn't trust him with my money.  他是个老滑头——我不会把钱交付给他的。
"You'll find out eventually," said Mary with a sly smile.  “你最后就知道了，”玛丽诡秘地笑着说。noun
He drives his mother's car on the sly while she's at work.  他趁母亲上班的时候偷开她的汽车。

words.meaning: vt.  诱骗,引诱,怂恿
words.example:
The adverts entice the customer into buying things they don't really want.  广告诱使顾客购买他们并不真正需要的东西。
People are being enticed away from the profession by higher salaries elsewhere.  别处更加丰厚的薪水诱使人们辞职另谋高就。

words.meaning: v.  量化
words.example: It's difficult to quantify how many people will be affected by the change.  很难确定将有多少人受到该变化的影响。

words.meaning: n.  硅
words.example: Silicon Valley leads in tech.  硅谷在科技领域领先。

words.meaning: vt.  指示,表示
words.example: The colour red is used to denote passion or danger.  红色用于表示激情或危险。

words.meaning: a.  发光的,明亮的,辐射的,容光焕发的
words.example: He gave a radiant smile when he heard her news.  当他听到她的消息时，脸上绽放出灿烂的笑容。adjective

words.meaning: vt.  毁坏,破坏,粉碎
words.example:
He completely demolished all her arguments.  他彻底推翻了她的全部论点。UK verb transitive
In a surprise result, Hibs demolished Rangers 5-0.  希伯尼安队出人意料地以5比0的比分轻易击败流浪者队。UK verb transitive
Joe demolished an enormous plateful of sausages and chips.  祖狼吞虎咽地吃光了满满一大碟香肠和薯条。

words.meaning: n.  感受器
words.example: The nerve receptor fired.  神经感受器被激活了。

words.meaning: a.  油腻的,滑溜溜的,泥泞的
words.example: greasy food/dishes/skin/hair  油腻的食物／油乎乎的盘子／油性皮肤／油性头发

words.meaning: a.  全无的,缺乏的
words.example:
Their apartment is devoid of all comforts.  他们的公寓没有任何能提供舒适享受的设施。
He seems to be devoid of compassion.  他似乎缺少同情心。

words.meaning: vt.  使悲伤vi.  悲痛,伤心
words.example: He is still grieving for/over his wife.  他仍沉浸在丧妻之痛中。

words.meaning: n.  标题
words.example: Choose a heading for the essay.  给文章选个标题。

words.meaning: n.  精力,活力
words.example: She plays with great vigor.  她打得很有活力。

words.meaning: n.  石矿; 被追求人或事物
words.example: The dogs pursued their quarry into an empty warehouse.  那几只狗追逐着猎物进了一个空置的仓库。UK verb transitive

words.meaning: a.  无能力的,无力的,不适当的,不胜任的n.  无能力者
words.example:
He has described the government as corrupt and incompetent.  他形容政府是腐败无能的。UK noun countable
The country's being governed by a bunch of incompetents.  这个国家目前由一群无能之辈统治着。

words.meaning: n.  马具,系在身上的绳子,甲胄vt.  束以马具,披上甲胄,利用. . . 以产
words.example: There is a great deal of interest in harnessing wind and waves as new sources of power.  人们对开发利用风和波浪这些新能源非常感兴趣。

words.meaning: vt.  散失,驱散,浪费vi.  消散,放荡
words.example:
The heat gradually dissipates into the atmosphere.  热量逐渐消失在大气中。
His anger dissipated as the situation became clear.  随着局势的明朗，他渐渐消了气。

words.meaning: n. [常pl.  ]剩余物，剩饭菜
words.example: This recipe can serve four easily, and the leftovers are just as good eaten cold.  这份食谱足够四人享用，剩下的可作冷食。

words.meaning: vt.  宣传; 宣扬
words.example:
Attitudes seem to be changing as a result of recent highly publicized cases of sexual harassment.  由于最近的几宗性骚扰案件受到连续报道，大众的看法似乎正在转变。
The event was well publicized all over town.  这件事在全城传得沸沸扬扬。
The work of the charity has been widely publicized throughout the media.  慈善组织的工作获得媒体的广泛宣传。

words.meaning: n.  细雨vi. vt.  下毛毛雨
words.example:
Tomorrow will be cloudy with outbreaks of rain and drizzle.  明天多云，有阵雨和零星小雨。noun
Serve the pasta hot with a drizzle of olive oil.  趁热在义大利粉上淋些橄榄油即可上桌了。verb
Drizzle the syrup over the warm cake.  在热蛋糕上洒些糖浆。verb

words.meaning: a.  淫秽的,猥亵的
words.example:
In the raid, police found several boxes of obscene videotapes.  警方在这次突击搜查中发现了几箱淫秽录影带。
He was jailed for making obscene phone calls (= ones in which unwanted sexual suggestions were made to the listener).  他因拨打色情骚扰电话而入狱。
The salaries some company directors earn are obscene.  有些公司董事的薪水高得令人咋舌。

words.meaning: n.  氧化物
words.example: iron oxide  氧化铁

words.meaning: n.  通风,空气流通,公开讨论
words.example: Her tiny attic room had poor ventilation and in summer it became unbearably stuffy.  她那小小的阁楼房间通风非常不好，到了夏天就闷得要命。

words.meaning: n.  属下,附属物a.  下级的,次要的,附属的vt.  使居下位,使服从
words.example: Her personal life has been subordinated to her career.  她将个人生活置于事业之下。

words.meaning: n.  肥料,粪肥vt.  施肥于
words.example: Manure enriches the soil.  粪肥能肥田。

words.meaning: n.  命令,邀请,出价
words.example:
Most of the bidding was done by telephone.  大部分的出价是透过电话进行的。
At my grandmother's bidding, I wore my best dress.  按照祖母的要求，我穿上了最漂亮的衣服。

words.meaning: a.  动乱的; 狂暴的，汹涌的
words.example:
This has been a turbulent week for the government.  对政府来讲，这是动荡多事的一周。UK adjective
The sea was too turbulent for us to be able to take the boat out.  大海波涛汹涌，我们无法驾船出海。

words.meaning: a.  引人动心的,有魅力的
words.example:
The room looked cosy and inviting.  这个房间看起来舒适宜人。
Companies saddled with high debt have become inviting targets for cash-rich competitors.  负债累累的公司成为了现金充足的竞争者的好目标。

words.meaning: n.  乡下人,村夫,农民a.  乡村的,纯朴的,手工粗糙的
words.example: The property has a certain rustic charm.  这座宅院有种迷人的田园风情。

words.meaning: a.  不连续的a.  离散的
words.example: These small companies now have their own discrete identity.  这些小公司现在都各有各的特点。

words.meaning: n.  覆盖物; 【地】地幔
words.example:
She unsuccessfully attempted to assume the mantle of presidency.  她想接任总统，但未成功。
He has been asked to take on the mantle of managing director in the New York office.  他获邀请出任纽约办事处总经理一职。UK noun
We watched the building vanish under a mantle of thick grey smoke as the fire swiftly moved through it.  大火在楼内迅速蔓延，我们看到大楼被灰色的浓烟吞噬。

words.meaning: vt.  使恶化,使更严重加重
words.example:
Attempts to restrict parking in the city centre have further aggravated the problem of traffic congestion.  在市中心限制停车的试验方案使交通挤塞的问题更加严重。
The treatment only aggravated the condition.  这种疗法反而使病情恶化。verb transitive
Stop aggravating me, will you!  别再气我了，好不好！

words.meaning: n.  精神错乱，疯狂
words.example:
He was found not guilty of murder by reason of insanity.  他因为精神失常而未被裁定犯有杀人罪。
He suffered from periodic bouts of insanity.  他患有周期性精神失常。
It would be insanity to expand the business now.  现在扩大经营规模简直是疯了。

words.meaning: a.  抑沉的,忧闷的,黑暗的,悲观的
words.example:
The cemetery is a gloomy place.  墓地是个让人感到压抑的地方。
The vet is rather gloomy about my cat's chances of recovery.  兽医对我的猫儿康复表示很不乐观。
What gloomy weather we're having!  今天天气太阴沉了！

words.meaning: vt.  使苦恼,骚扰
words.example:
Tim really annoyed me in the meeting this morning.  在今天上午的会上，蒂姆真是把我气坏了。
I'm sorry - is my cough annoying you?  对不起，我咳嗽打扰你了吧？
It really annoys me when people expect me to tip as well as pay a service charge in a restaurant.  在饭店里，付了服务费后他们还想要小费，这很让我恼火。

words.meaning: n.  变迁
words.example: Our plans are in a state of flux at the moment.  我们的计划目前处在不断变化之中。noun uncountable

words.meaning: n.  疑问,疑问号,质问vt. vi.  询问,质问n.  查询
words.example: If you have any queries about your treatment, the doctor will answer them.  医生将解答您对治疗的任何疑问。UK verb transitive

words.meaning: n.  大风雪
words.example:
We once got stuck in a blizzard for six hours.  我们曾被暴风雪困了六个小时之久。
In Sussex, blizzard conditions made the main roads almost impassable.  在萨塞克斯郡，暴风雪导致主要道路几乎瘫痪。UK noun

words.meaning: n.  监禁,下狱,坐牢
words.example: He faced ten years' imprisonment.  他面临十年监禁。

words.meaning: a.  哥特式的
words.example: The cathedral is in Gothic style.  大教堂是哥特式风格。

words.meaning: a.  富幽默感的,滑稽的,诙谐的
words.example: Her latest book is a humorous look at teenage life.  她的新书是对青少年生活的一种幽默审视。

words.meaning: a.  相关的,中肯的,切题的
words.example: Chapter One is pertinent to the post-war period.  第一章讲述的是战后时期。

words.meaning: n.  愤怒,激怒,猛烈的力量,神谴
words.example: The people feared the wrath of God.  人们害怕上帝发怒。

words.meaning: n.  专横,放肆,可能性,推测,假定
words.example:
The presumption of innocence is central to British law.  英国法律的核心是无罪假定。
There is no scientific evidence to support such presumptions.  并无科学依据支持这样的推测。

words.meaning: n.  天命,天职,职业,行业,才能
words.example:
"We need teachers who regard their profession as a vocation, not just a job," said the Minister.  部长说：“我们需要的老师要把他们的工作当成职业，而不仅仅是一份工作。”
To work in medicine, you should have a vocation for it.  要从事医务工作，你就要有一种使命感。

words.meaning: n.  服从,顺从,忠实
words.example: He demands unquestioning obedience from his soldiers.  他要求士兵们绝对服从。

words.meaning: vt.  使天生具有
words.example:
The state of Michigan has endowed three institutes to do research for industry.  密西根州已经向三所研究所提供资助进行产业研究。
This hospital was endowed by the citizens of Strasbourg in the 16th century.  这所医院是16世纪斯特拉斯堡市民捐建的。verb transitive
Some lucky people are endowed with both brains and beauty.  一些幸运之人生来就智慧和美貌并存。

words.meaning: a.  公平的,公正的
words.example: an equitable tax system  合理的税收制度

words.meaning: vt.  散播,传播,宣传vi.  广为传播
words.example: One of the organization's aims is to disseminate information about the disease.  该组织的宗旨之一就是宣传关于这种疾病的知识。

words.meaning: a.  富于机智的,诙谐的
words.example: He was witty and very charming.  他既风趣又很有魅力。

words.meaning: n.  (网球等的)球拍
words.example:
They were making such a racket outside that I couldn't get to sleep.  他们一直在外面大吵大闹，弄得我根本睡不着。noun
They were jailed for running a protection/prostitution racket.  他们因为勒索保护费／做拉皮条的勾当而被监禁。
Telephone chat lines are a real racket.  电话聊天热线纯属暴利行为。

words.meaning: a.  有利的; 受优待的，首选的
words.example: The favored candidate won.  被看好的候选人赢了。

words.meaning: n.  烦躁,磨损,焦急,网状饰物vi.  烦恼,不满,磨损vt.  使烦恼,腐蚀,使
words.example:
Don't fret - I'm sure he's OK.  别发愁——他肯定没事。
She spent the day fretting about/over what she'd said to Nicky.  她为对尼基说的话而担心了一整天。noun countable

words.meaning: n.  严格,严厉,苛刻,精确,严密
words.example: The research is marked by rigor.  这研究以严谨著称。

words.meaning: vt.  过分夸赞,奉承,阿谀,使高兴
words.example:
She was flattered by his attention.  他的关注使她格外高兴。
They were flattered to be invited to dinner by the mayor.  市长邀请他们共进晚餐，他们深感荣幸。
We felt flattered that so many people came to our party.  这么多人来参加我们的派对，我们感到十分荣幸。

words.meaning: n.  尿a.  不新鲜的,陈腐的,疲倦的,陈旧的vt.  使变旧,走味vi.  变陈旧
words.example:
The bread/biscuits/cake had gone stale.  面包／饼干／蛋糕已经不新鲜了。
The morning after the party, their apartment smelled of stale cigarette smoke.  派对后的次日早上，他们的公寓里有一股污浊的烟味。
They had been working together for over five years and they had both become a little stale.  他们两个已经在一起共事五年多了，彼此都有一点厌倦。

words.meaning: n.  差事; 差使
words.example: I'll meet you at six, I've got some errands to do/run first.  我会在六点和你见面，我得先去办些事情。noun countable

words.meaning: n.  叛逆者,叛国者
words.example:
The leaders of the rebellion were hanged as traitors.  叛乱的首领被作为叛国者，绞死了。
The Chinese Communist Party branded (= called) Mr Gorbachev 'a traitor to socialism'.  中国共产党给戈巴契夫先生打上了社会主义叛徒的烙印。（即称他为社会主义叛徒）

words.meaning: n.  驳船，游艇
words.example:
They barged through the crowds.  他们在人群中横冲直撞。
When the doors opened she barged her way to the front of the queue.  门一开她就冲到了队伍前面。
The man barged (= pushed) into her and ran on without stopping.  那个男人撞倒她后，停也没停接着就跑了。UK verb intransitive or transitive [usually + adv/prep]

words.meaning: a.  非传统的
words.example: an unconventional childhood/lifestyle/marriage  不一样的童年／生活方式／婚姻

words.meaning: n.  外交使节,特使
words.example: a United Nations special envoy  联合国特使

words.meaning: n.  染色体
words.example: sex chromosomes  性染色体

words.meaning: n.  冰山,冷冰冰的人
words.example: Only a tenth of the iceberg shows.  冰山只露出十分之一。

words.meaning: n.  啮齿目动物(如松鼠或海狸)
words.example: A rodent chewed the wires.  啃齿动物咬坏了电线。

words.meaning: n.  酵母，发酵粉
words.example: dried/fresh yeast  干／新鲜酵母

words.meaning: n.  重打,重击声vt. vi.  重打,砰地撞到,用拳头打
words.example:
He thumped him in the face.  他一拳狠狠打在他的脸上。
He thumped on the door but nobody came.  他使劲敲门，但没人来应。
When I woke up my mouth was dry and my head was thumping.  我醒来时口干舌燥、头痛欲裂。

words.meaning: vt.  开释,释放,完成,表现
words.example:
She was acquitted of all the charges against her.  她被宣判无罪，所有对其指控皆不成立。
Five months ago he was acquitted on a shoplifting charge.  五个月前，法庭宣判对他在商店扒窃货物的指控不成立。    Compare convict

words.meaning: a.  温和的,乏味的,冷漠的
words.example: Pop music these days is so bland.  现今的流行音乐十分乏味。

words.meaning: n.  徽章
words.example: The dove is an emblem of peace.  鸽子是和平的象征。

words.meaning: n.  尊崇,尊敬,效忠
words.example: On this occasion we pay homage to him for his achievements.  在此我们谨就他取得的成就向他表示敬意。

words.meaning: a.  荒废的; 无人的
words.example: The coastal resorts are deserted (= do not have many visitors) in winter.  冬季海滨胜地游客稀少。UK adjective

words.meaning: a.  原始的,土著的n.  土著居民,土生生物
words.example: aboriginal forests  原始森林

words.meaning: v.  衰退
words.example:
By the late seventies the band's popularity was beginning to wane.  上世纪70年代末，这支乐队的人气开始下滑。
There are signs that support for the party is on the wane.  有迹象表明该党的支持率正日益下降。

words.meaning: n.  柳，柳树，柳木制品
words.example: A willow leans over the pond.  柳树倾斜在池塘上。

words.meaning: n.  赞助,光顾,任免权,保护人的身分
words.example:
The Conservative Party enjoys the patronage of much of the business community.  保守党获得了众多企业的资助。
Patronage is a potent force if used politically.  任命权用在政治上会成为一种强大的力量。noun uncountable
We would like to thank all of our customers for their patronage in the past.  我们衷心感谢所有顾客过去的惠顾。

words.meaning: adj.  1 a.  不动的,静止的,停止的b.   (不移动而) 定居的c.  无变化的
words.example:
The traffic got slower and slower until it was stationary.  车流移动得越来越慢，最后完全不动了。
The rate of inflation has been stationary for several months.  通货膨胀率已经几个月保持不变。

words.meaning: n.  长方形,矩形
words.example: The field is a rectangle.  场地是长方形的。

words.meaning: n.  一时的兴致,幻想,反复无常,怪念头
words.example:
We booked the holiday on a whim.  我们一冲动就预订了假日游。
You can add what you like to this mixture - brandy, whisky or nothing at all - as the whim takes you.  你可以在这种混合饮料里加入任何你喜欢的东西——白兰地、威士卡或甚么也不加——全看你自己。
Oh for a husband who would indulge my every whim!  啊，我多么想有一个对我百依百顺的丈夫呀！

words.meaning: a.  迷人的
words.example: an engaging smile/manner/person  迷人的微笑／迷人的风度／魅力十足的人

words.meaning: n.  政治家
words.example: The statesman urged restraint.  政治家敦促克制。

words.meaning: a.  无价的,价值无法衡量的
words.example:
The new job will provide you with invaluable experience.  这份新工作将使你获得宝贵的经验。
Such data will prove invaluable to/for researchers.  这些资料对于研究人员来说将是非常宝贵的。

words.meaning: vi.  恢复,复归,回复vt.  使颠倒,使回转n.  恢复原信仰的人
words.example:
Why does the conversation have to revert to money every five minutes?  为甚么话题每五分钟就会回到钱上去？
When I die, the house will revert to my sister.  我死后，这座房子归我妹妹所有。

words.meaning: a.  (半)透明的
words.example:
This china is so fine and delicate that it's translucent.  这件瓷器手工精细，晶莹剔透。
Delia's skin has a translucent quality.  迪莉娅皮肤白晰清透。    Compare opaque ; transparent

words.meaning: a.  适宜的n.  试穿,试衣,装配,装置
words.example:
I'm having the final fitting of my wedding dress on Thursday.  周四我要最后试穿一次结婚礼服。UK noun
The house price, including fixtures and fittings, is £200 000.  包括固定装置和附加设备在内，房屋价格是20万英镑。

words.meaning: n.  马赛克; 镶嵌细工
words.example: figurative The country is now a cultural and social mosaic (= mixture) due to the influx of different ethnic groups.  因有不同种族融入，现在这个国家呈现出文化与社会的多元化景象。

words.meaning: n.  雪崩,山崩,涌到之物vi.  崩落,涌至vt.  大量投入
words.example: We were swamped by an avalanche of letters/phone calls/complaints.  雪片般的来信／潮水般涌进的电话／纷至沓来的投诉使我们应接不暇。

words.meaning: n.  卫生; 卫生设施
words.example: Many illnesses in these temporary refugee camps are the result of inadequate sanitation.  这些临时难民营中许多疾病都源于排污设施不完善。

words.meaning: n.  礼券，优惠券
words.example:
If you collect ten coupons from the newspaper, you can get a free beach towel.  从报纸上收集十张礼券你就可以免费得到一条沙滩浴巾。
To find out more about our products, fill in the coupon and send it to us at the address given below.  如果想更多了解我们的产品，请填写本资料索取单，并按以下位址寄给我们。

words.meaning: n.  蛤
words.example: He just clams up if you ask him about his childhood.  要是你问起他的童年，他就干脆不说话了。

words.meaning: vi. vt. n.  摸索
words.example:
She groped for her glasses on the bedside table.  她在床头柜上摸索着找眼镜。
He groped me as I was going to the bar.  我走向吧台时，他暗中摸了我一下。UK verb
I'm groping for the right words here.  我正在绞尽脑汁寻找此处合适的措词。UK noun countable informal

words.meaning: a.  毛绒绒的,蓬松的,愚蠢的
words.example: Beat the eggs and sugar together until they are pale and fluffy.  搅打鸡蛋和糖直到其颜色变浅且松软为止。

words.meaning: a.  偷懒的,懒惰的,迟钝的
words.example:
Something is wrong with the car - the engine feels a bit sluggish.  这辆车出了问题——引擎运转不太顺畅。
The housing market has been very sluggish these past few years.  过去这几年房地产市场一直很萧条。

words.meaning: n.  微生物，细菌
words.example: Microbes live everywhere.  微生物无处不在。

words.meaning: n.  中子
words.example: A neutron has no charge.  中子不带电。

words.meaning: n.  反常，变态
words.example: He specializes in pathology.  他专攻病理学。

words.meaning: a.  宁静的,沉着的,安详的,晴朗的n.  晴朗,平静
words.example: She has a lovely serene face.  她长着一张可爱而安详的脸。

words.meaning: a.  不相容的,不能并存的,矛盾的
words.example:
When we started living together we realized how incompatible we were - our interests were so different.  开始共同生活后，我们发现彼此是多么合不来——我们的兴趣差别太大了。
Maintaining quality is incompatible with increasing output.  保持品质和增加产量是互相对立的。
Any new video system that is incompatible with existing ones has little chance of success.  任何与现有系统不相容的新视讯系统都难以成功。

words.meaning: vi.  闯入,侵入vt.  强挤入
words.example: Newspaper editors are being urged not to intrude on/into the grief of the families of missing servicemen.  人们强烈要求报纸编辑不要烦扰失踪军人悲痛的家属。

words.meaning: vt. vi.  挖,挖开,凿通
words.example:
Tintagel Castle is being excavated.  考古学家正在发掘廷塔杰尔城堡遗址。
In tin mining today, workers excavate tunnels horizontally from a vertical shaft.  如今开采锡矿，工人们从竖井中横向开挖隧道。

words.meaning: a.  米制的; 公制的
words.example:
The recipe is given in both metric and imperial measures.  食谱中材料的份量均以公制和英制两种计量方法标出。
Most high-tech industry has been metric for decades.  大多数高科技工业采用公制已达数十年了。

words.meaning: a.  可仿效的,可做模范的
words.example:
His tact was exemplary, especially considering the circumstances.  他的外交手腕堪称典范，尤其是考虑到当时的情形。
The judge awarded exemplary damages.  法官判罚损害赔偿金，以儆效尤。

words.meaning: n.  微弱的闪光,瞬息的一现vi.  闪烁,隐约地闪现vt.  使发微光,使闪烁
words.example:
He polished the table until it gleamed.  他把桌子擦得光洁明亮。
His eyes gleamed with/in triumph.  他眼中闪现出胜利的光芒。noun countable usually singular

words.meaning: n.  对称,调和,匀称
words.example: The design of the house had a pleasing symmetry, its oblong shape being picked up in its elongated windows.  房子的设计透出一种赏心悦目的对称美，狭长的窗户使长方形的结构显得更加和谐。    Compare asymmetry    specialized

words.meaning: a.  非电声乐器的; 听觉的
words.example:
The microphone converts acoustic waves to electrical signals for transmission.  麦克风把声波转换成电信号进行传送。
The concert was recorded in a French church that is famous for its acoustics.  这场音乐会是在一座以音响效果闻名的法国教堂内录制的。

words.meaning: v.  破译，解释
words.example: Can you decipher the writing on this envelope?  你能辨认出信封上的字吗？

words.meaning: a.  先天的,天生的
words.example: Cyril's most impressive quality was his innate goodness.  西里尔给人印象最深的品质是他天生的善良。

words.meaning: v.  (使)枯竭，耗尽
words.example:
If we continue to deplete the Earth's natural resources, we will cause serious damage to the environment.  如果继续耗费地球的自然资源，我们将对环境造成严重的破坏。
The illness depletes the body of important vitamins.  这种疾病能消耗人体中重要的维他命。
humorous That last holiday has seriously depleted my bank account!  上次渡假花掉了我银行帐户里的一大笔钱！

words.meaning: n.  韵，押韵; v.  押韵
words.example:
'Blue' and 'flew' rhyme.  blue 和 flew 押韵。
Can you think of a word that rhymes with 'orange'?  你能想出一个和 orange 押韵的词吗？noun
Can you think of a rhyme for 'orange'?  你能想出一个和 orange 押韵的词吗？

words.meaning: a.  熟练的,老练的n.  名手,专家
words.example:
She's very adept at dealing with the media.  她应付媒体游刃有余。
Tamsin Palmer gave an impressive and technically adept performance on the piano.  塔姆辛‧帕尔默演奏的钢琴曲技法纯熟、感人至深。

words.meaning: a.  类似的,相似的
words.example: The heart is analogous to a pump.  心脏类似于泵。

words.meaning: a.  易碎的,脆弱的,易坏的
words.example:
As you get older your bones become increasingly brittle.  随着年龄增长，人的骨头变得越来越脆。
The pond was covered in a brittle layer of ice.  池塘上结了薄薄的一层冰。UK adjective
She gave a brittle laugh and turned away.  她冷笑了一声，转身走了。

words.meaning: n.  鼻涕虫,懒汉,子弹,金属小块vi.  偷懒,捕鼻涕虫vt.  插嵌片于
words.example:
The poor guy wound up with a slug in his stomach.  那个可怜的家伙腹部中了一枪。noun countable
She slugged him and he fell against the bar.  她猛地打了他一拳，他扑倒在柜台上。

words.meaning: vt.  减去,扣掉,减少vi.  作减法
words.example: Four subtracted from ten equals six.  10减4等于6。    Compare add ; divide ; multiply

words.meaning: vt.  滋养; 养育
words.example:
Children need plenty of good fresh food to nourish them.  孩子们需要大量的新鲜食物来提供营养。
She looks happy and well nourished.  她看起来很快乐，且营养良好。
This cream is supposed to help nourish your skin.  这种润肤霜可以滋养肌肤。

words.meaning: n.  沉淀物vt.  猛抛,使陷入,促成,使沉淀vi.  猛地落下a.  猛地落下的,
words.example:
An invasion would certainly precipitate a political crisis.  入侵肯定会加剧政治危机。
Fear of losing her job precipitated (= suddenly forced) her into action.  对丢掉工作的恐惧促使她立即付诸行动。verb[prɪˈsɪp.ɪ.teɪt/
Cooling the beaker helps precipitate the compound.  让烧杯降温有助于化合物沉淀。

words.meaning: n.  节约,繁荣
words.example: Thrift is a traditional virtue.  节俭是传统美德。

words.meaning: n.  锈,生锈,衰退vi.  生锈,衰退vt.  使生锈,腐蚀
words.example:
Older cars will begin to rust.  旧车将会开始生锈。
Years of being left out in the rain had rusted the metal chairs.  这些铁椅子由于长年在室外淋雨已经生锈了。
The floor of the car had rusted away/through (= been destroyed by rust) , so I was careful where I put my feet.  车的底板都锈坏／烂了，所以我放脚时很小心，不能乱踩。

words.meaning: v.  使隔离，使隔绝
words.example:
You can insulate a house against heat loss by having the windows double-glazed.  你可以给窗户装上双层玻璃来防止热量散失。verb transitive
Children should be insulated from the horrors of war.  应该让孩子远离战争的恐怖。
Until recently the country's economy has been insulated from recession by its reserves of raw materials.  该国由于原材料储备充足，直到最近其经济也没有受到衰退的影响。

words.meaning: n.  听,听力,试听
words.example:
His audition went well and he's fairly hopeful about getting the part.  他试镜时表现出色，很有希望能获得这个角色。
The director is holding auditions next week for the major parts.  导演将在下周举行试演，以确定主要角色的人选。UK verb intransitive or transitive
I'm auditioning for the part of Lady Macbeth.  我将参加试演，看能否出演麦克白夫人这个角色。

words.meaning: vt.  铭记，牢记; n.  印记，印痕
words.example:
That look of grief would be imprinted on her mind forever.  那种悲伤的神情会永远印在她的脑海中。noun]ˈɪm.prɪnt/
The button had left an imprint on my arm.  这颗钮扣在我的手臂上留下了一个印痕。
War has left its imprint on the strained faces of these people.  战争在这些人饱经沧桑的脸上留下了痕迹。

words.meaning: a.  雄辩的,有口才的,动人的
words.example:
She made an eloquent appeal for action.  她发表了富有说服力的演讲，呼吁采取行动。
The pictures were an eloquent reminder of the power of the volcano.  这些图片清楚有力地展现了火山的巨大威力。

words.meaning: a.  古雅的,离奇有趣的,奇怪的
words.example: "What a quaint idea!" she said, laughing at him.  “多奇怪的想法啊！ ”她嘲笑他说。

words.meaning: a.  史前的; 陈旧的
words.example:
Painting originated in prehistoric times.  绘画始于史前时期。
He has prehistoric views about women who have careers.  他对职业女性的看法完全过时。

words.meaning: n.  上升,上坡路
words.example:
She made her first successful ascent of Everest last year.  她去年第一次成功攀登了珠穆朗玛峰。
As the plane made its ascent, we saw thick smoke coming from one engine.  飞机上升时，我们看到一个引擎中冒出了浓烟。noun
We struggled up the slippery ascent.  那段上坡路很滑，我们吃力地向上走。noun

words.meaning: n.  光辉; 显赫
words.example: Her first novel showed signs of brilliance.  她的第一部小说显示出她过人的才气。noun uncountable

words.meaning: n.  绿洲,舒适的地方
words.example: Her office was an oasis of peace and sanity amid the surrounding chaos.  在周围乱哄哄的环境中，她的办公室是一方宁静之地。

words.meaning: n.  尊敬,敬重,威望,尊严vt.  崇敬,敬畏,尊敬
words.example: She has/shows/feels great reverence for her professors.  她对教她的那些教授们很崇敬。

words.meaning: n.  障碍,错误,失败vt.  阻止,突然停止,退缩vi.  逡巡不前
words.example: The horse balked at the jump.  马在障碍前退缩了。

words.meaning: vt.  声称,以. . . 为业,伪称,讲授vi. 表白,承认,当教授
words.example: She professes ignorance of the whole affair, though I'm not sure I believe her.  她声称对整个事件一无所知，但我不能确定是否该相信她。

words.meaning: n.  养鱼池; 水族馆
words.example: The aquarium has rare fish.  水族馆有珍稀鱼类。

words.meaning: n.  开端，开始
words.example: Since its inception in 1968, the company has been at the forefront of computer development.  这家公司自从1968年成立以来一直处于电脑发展的最前列。

words.meaning: n.  不和,封地,争执vi.  长期不和,长期争斗
words.example: They've been feuding with their neighbours for years over a boundary issue.  多年来，他们一直为了地界问题与邻居不和。

words.meaning: n.  耻辱,不名誉vt.  使耻辱,使失体面
words.example:
They were sent home in disgrace.  他们蒙着羞被送回了家里。
He brought disgrace on the whole team by falsifying the results.  他篡改比分的行为让全队丢了脸。
Three families living in one room - it's a disgrace!  三家人住在一间房里——太糟糕了！

words.meaning: v.  熔合; 合并
words.example:
My hairdrier's stopped working - I think the fuse has blown/ UK also gone (= broken).  我的吹风机坏了——我想可能是保险丝断了。
Have you tried changing the fuse?  你有没试过换根保险丝？noun countable
He lit the fuse and ran.  他点燃了导火索后就跑了。noun countable

words.meaning: vt.  制造,建造,装配,伪造
words.example:
He was late, so he fabricated an excuse to avoid trouble.  他迟到了，就编了个理由以免惹上麻烦。
He claims that the police fabricated evidence against him.  他声称警方伪造了对他不利的证据。

words.meaning: vt.  播种
words.example:
Sow the seeds in pots.  把这些种子种在花盆里。
We'll sow this field with barley.  我们将在这块田里播种大麦。verb UK US
Now that you've sown doubts in my mind, I'll never be sure I can trust him.  既然你已经使我心存疑虑，我想我很难再信任他了。verb UK US

words.meaning: a.  难的,艰苦的,坚硬的,勇敢的ad.  努力地,辛苦地,坚硬地
words.example: a hardy perennial  耐寒的多年生植物

words.meaning: a.  并行的,附随的,旁系的n.  支亲,副保,附属担保物
words.example: She used/put up her house as collateral for a loan.  她用自己的房屋作抵押来贷款。UK adjective formal

words.meaning: adv. prep.  虽然，尽管如此
words.example:
Notwithstanding some members' objections, I think we must go ahead with the plan.  尽管遭到一些成员反对，我还是认为我们应该实施该计划。
Injuries notwithstanding, he won the semi-final match.  尽管身上有伤，他还是在半决赛中获胜。

words.meaning: n.  实习医师; 实习医师期
words.example:
He served his internship at Garfield Hospital.  他在嘉菲尔医院渡过了实习期。UK noun countable
Jane has a summer internship at a local TV station.  暑期时，简在当地一家电视台实习。

words.meaning: n.  肌腱
words.example: The tendon was torn in the match.  肌腱在比赛中撕裂了。

words.meaning: vt.  质问,讯问,审问vi.  提出问题
words.example: Thousands of dissidents have been interrogated or imprisoned in recent weeks.  数千名持不同政见者在最近几周遭到审问或拘禁。

words.meaning: v.  (使)瓦解; (使)碎裂
words.example:
The spacecraft disintegrated as it entered the Earth's atmosphere.  太空船进入大气层时解体了。
The Ottoman Empire disintegrated into lots of small states.  奥斯曼帝国分裂为许多个小国家。
The situation disintegrated into chaos.  局势恶化后陷入混乱状态。

words.meaning: n.  融雪,融化,温暖气候vt.  使融解,使缓和vi.  融化,解冻
words.example:
Allow the meat to thaw properly before cooking it.  烹制这些肉之前要先解冻。
The sun came out and thawed the ice.  太阳出来了，冰雪开始融化。
It 's beginning to thaw (= The weather is warm enough for snow and ice to melt).  冰雪开始融化了。    Compare freezeUK verb

words.meaning: vt.  分离,分遣
words.example:
You can detach the hood if you prefer the coat without it.  如果不想要大衣上的帽兜，可以拆掉。
Detach the lower part of the form from this letter and return it to the above address.  请将表格的下半部分从信中剪下来，并寄到上述位址。    Compare attach

words.meaning: a.  奢侈的,挥霍无度的,浪费的
words.example:
That was very extravagant of you to buy strawberries out of season.  在不适当的时令买草莓，你真是太奢侈了。
He rarely used taxis, which he regarded as extravagant.  他很少坐计程车，他认为这是一种奢侈的行为。
The product does not live up to the extravagant claims of the advertisers.  这种产品根本就没有广告商讲的那样好。

words.meaning: n.  酿造酒,酝酿vt. vi.  酿造,酝酿
words.example:
It was too quiet - I felt that trouble was brewing.  太安静了——我觉得要出事了。
Make us a brew, Bren.  布伦，替我们泡杯茶吧。noun
They gave her a strange brew to drink.  他们让她喝一种奇怪的混合饮料。

words.meaning: n.  锌
words.example: Zinc deficiency slows growth.  缺锌会减缓生长。

words.meaning: a.  不好不坏的,通常,平凡的
words.example:
The film's plot is predictable and the acting is mediocre.  这部影片的情节都能猜得到，演员的演技也不够好。
Parents don't want their children going to mediocre schools.  家长不想让孩子上普普通通的学校。

words.meaning: a.  稀疏的，稀少的
words.example: Information coming out of the disaster area is sparse.  来自灾区的资讯很少。

words.meaning: vt. vi.  说故事,说明,叙述
words.example:
Documentaries are often narrated by well-known actors.  纪录片常常由著名演员作旁白。
One by one the witnesses narrated the sequence of events which led up to the disaster.  目击者一个接一个叙述了导致惨剧发生的一系列事件。

words.meaning: a.  融化的，溶化的
words.example: The glaciers are melting fast.  冰川正在快速融化。

words.meaning: a.  可钦佩的,优良的,令人惊奇的
words.example: The police did an admirable job in keeping the fans calm.  警方在控制球迷的激动情绪方面表现可嘉。

words.meaning: n.  讽刺文学,讽刺
words.example: Her play was a biting/cruel satire on life in the 80s.  她的剧作是对80年代生活的辛辣讽刺。

words.meaning: ad.  预先
words.example: Tell me beforehand if you're busy.  忙的话提前告诉我。

words.meaning: n.  扭绞,拧,挤,榨vt.  拧,绞,扭,榨取,使痛苦,折磨,勒索vi.  蠕动,扭动
words.example:
She wrung out the shirt and hung it out to dry.  她拧干衬衫并挂到外面晾干。
I'll wring his neck if he does that again!  他要是再那样做，我就拧断他的脖子！ (wrung, wrung)
Car dealers are wringing their hands over low sales this summer.  汽车销售商正为今夏低迷的销量而着急烦恼。 (wrung, wrung)

words.meaning: n.  日圆,瘾vi.  渴望
words.example: She had a yen for travel.  她渴望旅行。

words.meaning: a.  沉闷的,冗长乏味的
words.example: The trouble is I find most forms of exercise so tedious.  问题是我觉得大多数形式的锻炼都很乏味。

words.meaning: a.  有威严的,有品格的
words.example:
He has maintained a dignified silence about the rumours.  关于那些谣言他很有尊严地保持着沉默。
The defeated candidate gave a dignified speech in which he congratulated his rival.  落败的候选人发表了不失尊严的讲话，祝贺对手获胜。

words.meaning: n.  爬行动物
words.example: A reptile suns itself on the rock.  爬行动物在岩石上晒太阳。

words.meaning: vt.  使混淆,使狼狈,挫败
words.example:
An elderly man from Hull has confounded doctors by recovering after he was officially declared dead.  赫尔市的一位老人在被正式宣布死亡后居然活了过来，令医生们大惑不解。
The singer confounded her critics with a remarkable follow-up album.  这位歌手随后又推出了一张不同凡响的专辑，令评论家们大感意外。

words.meaning: n.  减少,折扣vt.  减少,打折扣vi.  给回扣,打折扣
words.example: a tax rebate  退还部分税款

words.meaning: vi.  呕吐,喷涌vt.  呕出,喷n.  呕吐物,喷涌物
words.example:
The volcano spewed a giant cloud of ash, dust and gases into the air.  火山向空中喷出大量的烟灰、灰尘和气体。
The drains spew (out) millions of gallons of raw sewage into the river.  几百万加仑未经处理的污水从排水管里喷涌而出，倾泻进河里。
Paper came spewing from the computer printer.  纸一张张地从印表机里被吐出来。verb intransitive or transitive [+ adv/prep]

words.meaning: vt.  使清洁,净化,使纯洁
words.example:
Cleanse the cut/wound thoroughly before you bandage it.  扎绷带之前要彻底清洗伤口。
Roman Catholics go to confession to be cleansed of their sins.  罗马天主教徒藉忏悔来洗涤他们的罪恶。
figurative The mayor has promised to cleanse the city of drug dealers (= to remove them from the city).  市长承诺要肃清城市里的毒贩。

words.meaning: vt.  描绘. . . 的轮廓,描绘,描写
words.example:
The main characters are clearly delineated in the first chapter.  作者在第一章里对主要人物进行了清晰的描述。
The boundary of the car park is delineated (= its edges are marked) by a low brick wall.  停车场的四周用一堵矮砖墙围了起来。

words.meaning: vt.  委托给,推荐,嘉奖
words.example:
The judge commended her for/on her bravery.  法官称赞了她的勇敢。
For a low-budget film, it has much to commend it (= it deserves praise).  作为一部低预算影片，它有不少值得称道之处。
It says on the back cover of the book ' highly commended'.  书的封底上写著「极力推荐”。

words.meaning: vt.  没收,充公,查抄a.  被没收的
words.example:
Miss Edwards has confiscated my comics till the end of term!  爱德华兹小姐没收了我的漫画，要到学期末才还给我！
His passport was confiscated by the police to prevent him from leaving the country.  警方没收了他的护照，以防他出境。

words.meaning: adv.  1 慷慨地,大方地,不吝啬地2 [修饰整句] (真) 宽大ɔ 丰富地
words.example: He donated generously to the school.  他慷慨地向学校捐赠。

words.meaning: a.  较好的,较喜爱的,较合宜的
words.example: Surely a diplomatic solution is preferable to war.  外交途径当然要比战争好。

words.meaning: n.  囚禁,被关
words.example:
All the hostages, when released from captivity, looked remarkably fit and well.  人质被释放后看上去居然都很健康。
Animals bred in captivity would probably not survive if they were released into the wild.  在樊笼里饲养的动物如果被放归到野生环境中很可能无法生存。

words.meaning: v.  使恢复生机
words.example: Japanese investment has revitalized this part of Britain.  日本的投资使得英国这一地区的经济复苏了。

words.meaning: adj. 互惠的；相互的 n. 倒数
words.example: Trade should be reciprocal.  贸易应当互惠。

words.meaning: n.  外观,伪装vt. vi.  伪装
words.example:
The men who arrived in the guise of drug dealers were actually undercover police officers.  以毒贩身份到来的人实际上是卧底员警。
The company has been accused of trying to sell their products under the guise of market research.  这家公司被指控试图打着市场调研的旗号销售其产品。

words.meaning: a.  病毒(性)的
words.example: viral infections  病毒感染

words.meaning: a.  格式上的，体裁上的
words.example:
In their second album, the band tried to expand their stylistic range.  在他们的第二张专辑里，乐队尝试着拓展他们的风格。
Notice the stylistic similarities in the work of these three sculptors.  注意这三位元雕塑家作品风格的相似之处。

words.meaning: n.  食品,食物a.  可食用的
words.example: Only the leaves of the plant are edible.  这种植物仅叶子可食。    Compare eatable     Opposite inedible

words.meaning: vt.  使中立,使成中立地带,使中和,抵销vi.  中立化,变无效,中和
words.example:
The aerial bombardments have neutralized the threat of artillery attacks on allied ground forces.  空袭压制了炮火，减轻了盟军地面部队受到的威胁。UK verb transitive
Acidity in soil can be neutralized (= have the acid removed) by spreading lime on it.  在土壤上面撒石灰可以中和其酸性。

words.meaning: n.  摩天大楼
words.example: A skyscraper replaced the old theater.  摩天楼取代了老剧院。

words.meaning: n.  古怪的人,漂泊无定的人a.  不稳定的,奇怪的
words.example:
He drove in an erratic course down the road.  他开车忽左忽右地在路上蛇行。
She can be very erratic, one day she is friendly and the next she'll hardly speak to you.  她喜怒无常，今天待你很友善，明天又懒得理你。

words.meaning: a.  喜不自禁的,欢闹的,愉快的
words.example: He didn't like the film at all - I thought it was hilarious.  他根本就不喜欢这部电影——但我觉得它好笑极了。

words.meaning: vt.  崇敬,敬畏,尊敬
words.example: Nelson Mandela is revered for his brave fight against apartheid.  纳尔逊．曼德拉与种族隔离制度进行了无畏斗争，赢得了世人的崇敬。

words.meaning: n.  辱骂,嘲弄vt.  嘲弄,奚落a.  很高的
words.example: The other children used to taunt him in the playground because he was fat and wore glasses.  其他孩子以前经常在操场上嘲笑他，因为他长得胖，还戴眼镜。

words.meaning: vt.  拒绝,放弃,否认,垫牌vi.  垫牌,放弃权利n.  垫牌
words.example:
Her ex-husband renounced his claim to the family house.  她的前夫宣布放弃对家里房子的所有权要求。
Gandhi renounced the use of violence.  甘地声明放弃使用暴力。

words.meaning: vt.  包封,遮盖,包围n.  信封
words.example: The graveyard looked ghostly, enveloped in mist.  墓地笼罩在薄雾中，显得阴森森的。

words.meaning: vi. vt.  (使)移居,(使)移民
words.example:
Millions of Germans emigrated from Europe to America in the nineteenth century.  在19世纪，数百万的德国人从欧洲移民到了美国。
Thousands of Britons emigrate every year.  每年有数以千计的英国人移居国外。

words.meaning: vt.  阻隔,妨碍,阻塞vi.  设障碍
words.example:
After the earthquake many roads were obstructed by collapsed buildings.  地震过后，许多道路都被倒塌的建筑物堵住了。
Her view of the stage was obstructed by a pillar.  一根柱子挡住了她的视线，她看不见舞台。
An accident is obstructing traffic on the M11.  一场事故堵塞了11号高速公路上的交通。

words.meaning: n.  高潮,极点,层进法vi. vt. (使)达到顶点,(使)达到高潮
words.example:
The climax of the air show was a daring flying display.  航空展的高潮是惊险刺激的飞行表演。
The election campaign reaches its climax next week.  下周竞选活动将进入白热化阶段。
The show climaxed with all the performers singing on stage together.  所有演员同台高歌把演出推向了高潮。

words.meaning: n.  沉重的步伐,长途跋涉vi.  沉重地走,蹒跚地走vt.  跋涉
words.example:
We trudged back up the hill.  我们跋涉回到山上。
I'd had to trudge through the snow.  我不得不在雪地里跋涉。verb intransitive usually + adverb or preposition
We came back from our trudge across the moor wet and tired.  经过长途跋涉穿过荒野回来后，我们浑身都湿透，筋疲力尽。

words.meaning: n.  水龙头; 插口
words.example: The faucet dripped all night.  水龙头滴了一夜。

words.meaning: vt.  发掘,掘出,发现,揭露,从洞中赶出
words.example: Building at the site was halted after human remains were unearthed earlier this month.  自从本月初在工地挖出人类遗骸之后，施工就停止了。

words.meaning: n.  口径,才干,器量
words.example: The department hires people of high caliber.  系里招高素质人才。

words.meaning: vt. vi.  拾落穗,收集
words.example:
From what I was able to glean, the news isn't good.  从我辛苦收集到的资讯来看，情况不妙。
They're leaving on Tuesday - I managed to glean that much (from them).  他们将在星期二离开——我辛辛苦苦（从他们那里）打探到的就只有这些。

words.meaning: a.  潮湿的,湿润的,多湿气的
words.example: New York is very hot and humid in the summer.  纽约的夏天炎热潮湿。

words.meaning: a.  世间的,世俗的,世上的
words.example:
For many of the refugees, the clothes they are wearing are all the worldly goods (= possessions) they have.  对于这些难民中的许多人来说，身上穿的衣服就是他们在这世上拥有的全部财产。
Her worldly success can hardly be denied.  她物质上的成功不可否认。UK adjective
She seems to be much more worldly than the other students in her class.  她似乎比班里的其他学生世故得多。

words.meaning: vi.  减少,缩小,衰落vt.  使缩小
words.example:
The community has dwindled to a tenth of its former size in the last two years.  该社区在过去的两年里缩小到了原来的十分之一。
Her hopes of success in the race dwindled last night as the weather became worse.  随着昨晚天气的恶化，她在比赛中获胜的希望减小了。

words.meaning: vt.  藏匿
words.example: The stolen pictures were stashed (away) in a London warehouse.  失窃的画被藏匿在伦敦的一个仓库里。

words.meaning: a.  干燥的,不毛的
words.example:
The desert is so arid that nothing can grow there.  沙漠中极其干旱，寸草不生。
After several arid years, the company has started to become successful.  经过了几个不景气的年头后，公司已经开始走向成功发展之路。

words.meaning: n.  方言,语调
words.example: The poem is written in northern dialect.  这首诗是用北方方言写成的。

words.meaning: vt.  一般化,概括,推广vi.  形成概念,笼统讲
words.example: You can't generalize about a continent as varied as Europe.  对于欧洲这样一个异彩纷呈的大陆，你无法一言以蔽之。

words.meaning: n.  暂态,短期居留者,侯鸟,瞬变值a.  短暂的,易变的,瞬变的,路过的
words.example:
The city has a large transient population (= many people who are living in it only temporarily).  这个城市有大量暂住人口。UK noun countable mainly US formal
It's an organization set up to provide money and help for transients.  这个组织建立的目的就是给暂住者提供金钱和帮助。

words.meaning: n.  洗劫,抢夺vt. vi.  洗劫,抢夺
words.example: During the riot shops were looted and cars damaged or set on fire.  在暴乱期间商店遭洗劫，汽车被砸坏或烧毁。noun uncountable

words.meaning: vt.  法律上认为正当,公认,使合法化
words.example: The Irish government announced it was to legalize homosexuality.  爱尔兰政府宣布将使同性恋合法化。

words.meaning: n.  比赛，竞赛; a.  比赛的
words.example: He joined the racing club.  他加入了赛车俱乐部。

words.meaning: n.  节制,禁欲,戒酒
words.example: The best way to avoid pregnancy is total abstinence from sex.  最有效的避孕方法是完全禁欲。

words.meaning: n.  狂热,狂热者,盲信a.  狂热的,盲信的
words.example: a fitness/film fanatic  健身狂／对电影着迷的人

words.meaning: n.  达到

words.meaning: a.  图示的; 图片的

words.meaning: n.  美洲或欧洲的野牛

words.meaning: n.  结合,凝聚,内聚
words.example: The lack of cohesion within the party lost them votes in the election.  党内缺乏凝聚力使他们在选举中失去了选票。

words.meaning: n.  卫生保健,卫生学,保健法
words.example: Poor standards of hygiene mean that the disease spreads fast.  恶劣的卫生情况意味着疾病会快速传播。

words.meaning: n.  百年纪念
words.example: The town celebrated its centennial.  小镇庆祝了百年纪念。

words.meaning: vt.  持,举止,驱逐
words.example:
Thousands of illegal immigrants are caught and deported every year.  每年都有数千名非法移民被捕并被驱逐出境。
The refugees were deported back to their country of origin.  那些难民被遣返回国了。

words.meaning: a.  热心的,激烈的,燃烧般的
words.example: an ardent supporter of Manchester United  曼联队的狂热支持者

words.meaning: n.  震摇,摇动,颠簸vi.  颠簸而行,震摇vt.  使颠簸,使慌张,猛击
words.example:
The train stopped unexpectedly and we were jolted forwards.  火车突然停住了，我们都猛然向前晃了一下。
The truck jolted along the rough track through the field.  卡车沿着田野里崎岖的小路颠簸前行。UK verb
The charity used photos of starving children in an attempt to jolt the public conscience (= make them feel guilty and take action).  慈善机构用饥饿儿童的照片来触发大众的良知。

words.meaning: n.  改进,改良,修补处,好转vt.  修改,改进,加快,修理vi.  好转,改善
words.example:
Could you mend this hole in my shirt?  你能把我衬衫上的这个洞补一下吗？
I've left my watch at the jeweller's to be mended.  我把手表留在钟表店那里修理了。
The plumber came to mend the burst pipe.  水管工来修理爆裂的水管。

words.meaning: n.  自然主义者，博物学家
words.example: The naturalist documented the birds.  博物学家记录了这些鸟。

words.meaning: a.  有害的

These chemicals have a detrimental effect/impact on the environment.  这些化学品对环境有危害。
Their decision could be detrimental to the future of the company.  他们的决定可能会对公司的未来产生不利影响。

words.meaning: a.  著名的,显著的,扬名的
words.example:
Summerhill school is noted for its progressive policies.  夏山学校以其先进的办学方针而著名。
She's not noted for her patience (= She is not a patient person).  她不是个有耐心的人。

words.meaning: vt.  以重音念,强调,重读

words.meaning: a.  虔诚的,虔敬的,衷心的
words.example: a devout Buddhist/Christian/churchgoer  虔诚的佛教徒／基督教徒／教徒

words.meaning: n.  拴狗颈之皮带vt.  以皮带束缚,束缚
words.example: Keep the dog on a leash.  给狗拴上牵引绳。

words.meaning: vt.  使喘不过气,使窒息,闷熄,覆盖,抑制,忍住vi.  窒息,被抑制n.  浓烟
words.example:
They threatened to smother the animals with plastic bags.  他们威胁要用塑胶袋把这些动物闷死。
Snow soon smothered the last of the blooms.  不久大雪便扼杀了最后的花朵。
figurative I tried desperately to smother a sneeze (= I tried not to sneeze) during his speech.  他发言的时候，我努力控制自己不打喷嚏。

words.meaning: n.  偿还vt.  付还,偿还借款,换回新公债vi.  归还,偿还
words.example: When I went on business to Peru, the office refunded my expenses.  我到秘鲁出差，费用由事务所报销。

words.meaning: n.  倾向,爱好,习性
words.example: He's well-known for his natural propensity for indiscretion.  他天生粗心的毛病是出了名的。

words.meaning: vt.  合成
words.example: There are many vitamins that the body cannot synthesize itself.  有很多维他命是人体无法自己合成的。

words.meaning: n.  幼年; (发展或生长的)初期
words.example:
Her youngest child died in infancy.  她最小的孩子在幼年时夭折了。
The system is still in its infancy.  这个体系尚处于初期发展阶段。

words.meaning: a.  怪诞的,可怕的,离奇的,神秘的
words.example: an uncanny resemblance  神秘的相似性

words.meaning: vt.  横断vi.  交错,相交
words.example:
The roads intersect near the bridge.  这些道路在大桥附近相交。
The gardens are intersected by gravel paths.  这些花园里碎石小道纵横交错。

words.meaning: a.  丑恶的,可憎的,可怕的
words.example:
They've just built some hideous new apartment blocks on the seafront.  他们刚在海滨新盖了一些极为难看的公寓大楼。
She wears the most hideous colour combinations you could ever imagine.  她的穿着是你能想像到的颜色搭配得最难看的

words.meaning: n.  生理学
words.example: She teaches physiology.  她教生理学。

words.meaning: vt.  (to)把…归于
words.example:
To what do you ascribe your phenomenal success?  你认为你取得如此巨大成功的原因是甚么？verb
After years of research, scholars have finally ascribed this anonymous play to Christopher Marlowe.  经过多年研究，学者们终于认定，这部佚名剧作是出自克里斯多夫‧马洛的手笔。verb
People like to ascribe human feelings to animals.  人们倾向认为动物有像人一样的情感。

words.meaning: vt.  弄湿,使衰减vi.  变湿,丧气
words.example:
Rain had dampened the tent so we left it to dry in the afternoon sun.  雨水打湿了帐篷，午后我们把它放到太阳底下晒了晒。verb transitive
Nothing you can say will dampen her enthusiasm.  不管你说甚么，她的热情仍丝毫不减。

words.meaning: n.  宿舍
words.example: The dormitory is close to the lab.  宿舍离实验室很近。

words.meaning: vt.  逐放,放逐,喷射n.  推断的事物
words.example:
How do you eject the tape?  怎样才能把磁带弹出来？
The coffee machine suddenly ejected a handful of coins.  咖啡自动售卖机里突然弹出一把硬币。

words.meaning: vt. vi.  规定,保证
words.example: She agreed to buy the car, but stipulated racing tyres and a turbo-powered engine.  她同意买这辆车，但指明要装赛车轮胎和涡轮动力引擎。

words.meaning: a.  神话的; 虚构的
words.example: Start living life here and now instead of waiting for that mythical day when you'll be slim.  现在就赶快回到现实吧，不要坐着幻想身材苗条的那一天。

words.meaning: a.  过期的,未兑的,迟到的

My library books are a week overdue.  我借图书馆的书过期一个星期了。
The baby is two weeks overdue (= The baby was expected to be born two weeks ago).  已经超过预产期两周了。
Changes to the tax system are long overdue.  税收制度早该改革了。

words.meaning: a.  新陈代谢的
words.example: Exercise boosts metabolic rate.  运动提高新陈代谢率。

words.meaning: a.  衣衫褴褛的,不体面的,卑鄙的,吝啬的,破旧的
words.example:
He wore a shabby old overcoat.  他穿着一件破旧的大衣。
Her home is a rented one-bedroom flat in a shabby part of town.  她的住所是一套租来的雅房公寓，位于城里很差的地段。
The refugees were shabby (= wore old clothes in bad condition) and hungry.  难民们衣衫褴褛，饥肠辘辘。adjective

words.meaning: n.  仔细检查
words.example: The government plans to overhaul the health service.  政府计划彻底改革公共医疗保健服务。

words.meaning: a.  生子的,结果实的,多产的,丰富的
words.example:
He was probably the most prolific songwriter of his generation.  他可能是他这一代中最多产的歌曲作家。
Rabbits and other rodents are prolific (= have a lot of babies).  兔子和其他啮齿类动物繁殖能力都很强。

words.meaning: n.  认知，认识(力)
words.example: a book on human learning, memory and cognition  一本关于人类学习、记忆和认知过程的书

words.meaning: a.  有缺陷的,欠缺的n.  有缺陷的人,不完全变化动词
words.example: defective brakes  有问题的刹车装置

words.meaning: n.  猛犸象; a.  巨大的

Cleaning up the city-wide mess is going to be a mammoth task.  清扫全市范围内的垃圾将是一项艰巨的任务。

words.meaning: n.  检查员vt.  检查,审查,删改
words.example: The book was heavily censored when first published.  这本书首次出版时经过了严格的审查。

words.meaning: ad.  主要地
words.example: The island chiefly attracts upmarket tourists.  这个岛屿所吸引的主要是高消费阶层的游客。

words.meaning: n.  最适宜a.  最适宜的
words.example: The optimum dose varies by person.  最佳剂量因人而异。

words.meaning: n.  匕首vt.  用剑刺
words.example: The two sides have been at daggers drawn for some months now with no sign of improvement in relations.  双方一连冷战了好几个月，到现在依然没有任何缓和的迹象。

words.meaning: n.  神智健全,头脑清楚,健全
words.example:
He'd been behaving so strangely that they began to doubt/question his sanity.  他的行为举止非常怪异，他们开始怀疑他的精神是否正常。
Maybe Jenny can bring some sanity into (= think and act with good judgment in) this crazy situation.  也许珍妮能够为这疯狂的局面带来几分清醒。

words.meaning: vt.  解释,分析,逐字翻译vi.  作句法分析n.  逐字翻译
words.example: Any change in plan would be construed as indecision.  对计划的任何改动都会被视为优柔寡断。

words.meaning: n.  窃贼
words.example: A burglar tried the window.  盗贼撬了窗户。

words.meaning: n.  群,人群,群集,众多a.  拥挤的,忙的vi.  群集,蜂拥vt.  挤入,挤满
words.example:
Crowds thronged the market place.  市场里挤满了人。
The narrow streets were thronged with summer visitors.  狭窄的街道上挤满了夏天来此的游客。

words.meaning: a.  精明的,锐利的,厉害的,机灵的,剧烈的
words.example:
She is a shrewd politician who wants to avoid offending the electorate unnecessarily.  她是一个精明的政治家，想避免不必要地得罪选民。
It was a shrewd move to buy your house just before property prices started to rise.  在房地产价格开始攀升之前购买房子是个明智之举。

words.meaning: v.  渗出; n.  淤泥
words.example:
Blood was still oozing out of the wound.  伤口还在往外渗血。
She removed the bandage to reveal a red swollen wound oozing pus.  她解下绷带，露出红肿渗脓的伤口。
The waiter brought her a massive pizza oozing (with)cheese.  侍者给她端来一大块淌着起司的薄饼。

words.meaning: n.  巨穴,洞窟vt.  放于山洞中,挖空
words.example: The cavern echoes with water drops.  洞窟里回荡着滴水声。

words.meaning: n.  先决条件，前提
words.example:
Passing a written exam is a prerequisite for taking the advanced course.  通过笔试是学习进阶课程的前提。
Public support is a prerequisite for/to the success of this project.  大众支持是这一计划取得成功的必备条件。
They had to agree to certain conditions as a prerequisite of being lent the money.  他们不得不同意一些条件才能借到钱。

words.meaning: adj.  惊异
words.example:
They looked astonished when I announced I was pregnant.  我宣布我怀孕的消息时，他们看上去很吃惊。
The doctors were astonished at the speed of her recovery.  她康复速度之快令医生们感到惊讶。

words.meaning: n.  鸟嘴，喙
words.example:
Birds use their beaks to pick up food.  鸟用嘴叼食。noun countable
He'd be quite handsome if it wasn't for that great beak of his.  要不是长着那个硕大的钩形鼻，他会很英俊的。noun countable

words.meaning: n.  地点; 位置
words.example: In 19th-century Britain, industries became concentrated in particular localities.  在19世纪的英国，工业都被集中到了某些特定地区。

words.meaning: a.  稀薄的,微细的,纤细的,脆弱的
words.example: We were only able to make a tenuous connection between the two robberies.  我们只能认定这两桩抢劫案之间可能有某些联系。

words.meaning: n. 辉煌；壮丽；光彩
words.example: The splendor of the palace amazed visitors.  宫殿的辉煌令游客惊叹。

words.meaning: a.  细心的，很注意细节的
words.example: Many hours of meticulous preparation have gone into writing the book.  为写此书，投入了大量时间细心做前期准备。

words.meaning: vt.  驳倒,反驳
words.example: to refute a person/theory/argument/claim  驳斥一个人／理论／论点／说法

words.meaning: n.  冲击
words.example:
It is unlikely that his forces could withstand an allied onslaught for very long.  他的军队不大可能长时间抵御联军的强攻。
Scotland's onslaught on Wales in the second half of the match earned them a 4-1 victory.  苏格兰队在下半场猛攻威尔士队，以4比1赢取胜利。

words.meaning: n.  谷仓,积蓄vt.  储存,贮藏
words.example: Coppola garnered several Oscar awards for 'The Godfather'.  哥普拉以其执导的电影《教父》获得数项奥斯卡奖。

words.meaning: a.  显赫的,杰出的,有名的
words.example: an eminent historian  声名显赫的历史学家

words.meaning: vt.  使浸水,使陷入,淹没vi.  潜入水中,
words.example:
The submarine submerged when enemy planes were sighted.  潜艇发现敌机后马上下潜。
She was taken to hospital after being submerged in an icy river for 45 minutes.  她在冰冷的河水中浸了45分钟后被送进了医院。
She has submerged her identity in the role of photographer's wife and muse.  她完全湮没了自我，全心全意地做摄影师的妻子，并为他提供艺术灵感。UK verb

words.meaning: a.  欺诈的,不正的,不诚实的
words.example: They claim that the fall in unemployment is based on a fraudulent manipulation of statistics.  他们声称失业率下降是对统计资料进行欺骗性操纵的结果。

words.meaning: n.  小圆石，鹅卵石
words.example: This part of the coast has pebble beaches.  海岸的这一部分有几处砾石海滩。

words.meaning: vi.  移动,微微一动vt.  推动n.  羔皮
words.example:
I've tried moving the desk but it won't budge/I can't budge it.  我试着移动书桌，但它纹丝不动。verb intransitive or transitive
I've tried persuading her, but she won't budge.  我试图说服她，可她就是不改变想法。verb intransitive or transitive

words.meaning: vt.  使渗透,浸透,使充满,使饱和a.  浸透的,饱度高的,深颜色的
words.example:
The grass had been saturated by overnight rain.  一夜的雨把草地淋透了。
He had cut his leg badly, and his trousers were saturated with/in blood.  他划破了腿，伤势严重，裤子都被血浸透了。verb UK FILL  充满
The police saturated (= A large number of police officers were sent into) the area in an attempt to find the missing child.  大批员警被派往该地区寻找失踪的孩童。

words.meaning: n.  甲烷，沼气
words.example: Methane is the main constituent of natural gas.  甲烷是天然气的主要成分。

words.meaning: a.  小心的,慎重的
words.example:
The family made discreet enquiries about his background.  那家人小心翼翼地打听他的背景。
They are very good assistants, very discreet - they wouldn't go shouting to the press.  他们都是很好的助手，非常谨慎——不会向新闻界嚷嚷甚么的。

words.meaning: n.  提及,暗示
words.example:
The film is full of allusions to Hitchcock.  这部电影处处都在向希区考克致敬。
Her novels are packed with literary allusions.  她的小说充满了文学典故。

words.meaning: a.  分歧的
words.example: The two theories are divergent.  两种理论存在分歧。

words.meaning: n.  草料; v.  寻找
words.example:
The children had been living on the streets, foraging for scraps and sleeping rough.  那些孩子无家可归，四处寻找残羹剩饭，露宿街头。
The pigs foraged in the woods for acorns.  那些猪在树林里找橡果吃。UK noun uncountable
forage crops.  饲料作物

words.meaning: a.  有日期的,陈旧的
words.example: Spy thrillers with plots based on the Cold War look particularly dated nowadays.  冷战题材的惊险间谍影片现在看起来尤为落伍。

words.meaning: n.  刺，荆棘
words.example: A thorn stuck in the tire.  一根刺扎进了轮胎。

words.meaning: n.  点火，点燃
words.example: Switch/Turn the ignition on.  打开点火开关。

words.meaning: vt.  逐退,抵制,使厌恶,抗vi.  反抗,击退
words.example:
This coat has a special surface that repels moisture.  这件外套的面是特殊料子做的，可以防潮。
formal The defenders repelled the attack without losing any men.  守军击退了敌人的进攻，自己没有损失一个人。
Similar poles of magnets repel each other, and opposite poles attract.  磁铁同极相斥，异极相吸。 (-ll-)

words.meaning: vt.  赦,宽恕
words.example: If the government is seen to condone violence , the bloodshed will never stop.  一旦认定政府纵容暴力，那流血事件就永远不会停止。

words.meaning: a.  残忍的,凶猛的
words.example:
She's got a ferocious (= very bad) temper.  她的脾气极为暴躁。
The president came in for some ferocious criticism.  总统遭到了一些猛烈抨击。

words.meaning: v.  使恢复原状，修复
words.example:
The prison service should try to rehabilitate prisoners so that they can lead normal lives when they leave prison.  监狱应该努力改造犯人，使他们在刑满释放后能重新过上正常生活。
Physiotherapy is part of rehabilitating accident victims.  物理治疗是对事故受伤者进行康复治疗的一部分。
After 20 years in official disgrace, she's been rehabilitated (= given a positive public image again).  20年的官僚生涯曾使她名誉扫地，但是现在她已恢复了自己的良好形象。

words.meaning: a.  同种的,同质的,均质的
words.example: The population of the village has remained remarkably homogeneous.  这个村庄的人口保持着显著的同族特征。    Compare heterogeneous

words.meaning: a.  地震(引起)的
words.example: The news that the chairman would resign set off seismic waves in the business community.  主席要辞职的消息在商界引发了剧烈震撼。

words.meaning: a.  寒冷的,严寒的,冷淡的
words.example:
There's a rather frigid atmosphere in the school.  学校里气氛很严肃。adjective
Few plants can grow in such a frigid environment.  几乎没有甚么植物能够在如此寒冷的环境下生长。

words.meaning: a.  节俭的,经济的,合算的
words.example:
There's increasing demand for cars which are more economical on fuel.  对低油耗汽车的需求与日俱增。
What's the most economical way of heating this building?  给这栋大楼供应暖气，怎样做才是最经济的方法？UK adjective

words.meaning: n.  涌出,滔滔不绝的讲话vi. vt.  涌出,迸出,滔滔不绝的讲话
words.example:
Oil gushed (out) from the hole in the tanker.  石油从油轮的那个漏洞中喷涌而出。
Blood was gushing from his nose.  他的鼻子流血不止。
Her arm gushed blood where the knife had gone in.  她肩膀上被刀扎伤的地方鲜血直冒。verb

words.meaning: n.  半位元组,细咬,轻咬,啃vt. vi.  一点一点地咬,细咬,吹毛求疵n.  半
words.example:
Have you got some peanuts for us to nibble while the party warms up?  你有花生让我们边吃边活跃聚会的气氛吗？
Jenny's hamster's nibbled a hole in the sofa.  珍妮的仓鼠把沙发咬了个洞。
She nibbled his ear.  她轻轻地咬着他的耳朵。verb

words.meaning: a.  更远的,此外的,更多的vt.  促进,增进,助长ad.  更进一步地,更远地,
words.example:
I'm afraid I never got further than the first five pages of 'Ulysses'.  恐怕我看《尤利西斯》从未超过开头的五页，之后就看不下去了。
We discussed the problem but we didn't get much further in actually solving it.  我们讨论了这个问题，但在实际解决方面没有取得多大进展。
The whole matter is further complicated by the fact that Amanda and Jo refuse to speak to each other.  阿曼达和乔彼此拒绝说话，使得整个事件更加复杂了。

words.meaning: n.  尊敬,尊重vt.  尊敬,尊重,认为
words.example:
There has been a drop in public esteem for teachers.  大众对教师的尊重程度有所下降。
Because of their achievements they were held in (= given) (high) esteem.  他们的成就使他们备受尊重。verb transitive not continuous
Her work is highly esteemed by all her colleagues.  她所有的同事对她的工作都十分推崇。

words.meaning: n.  防卫工事,障碍vt.  设路障于,阻碍
words.example:
Inmates erected a barricade between themselves and prison officers.  囚犯们设置了路障，把狱警和他们隔开。verb transitive
Barricade the doors!  堵住门！

words.meaning: a.  商议好的,协定的,预定的
words.example:
The richer countries of the world should take concerted action to help the poorer countries.  世界上较富有的国家应该共同采取行动来帮助较贫困的国家。
The D-Day invasion was a concerted exercise by the armed forces of Britain, the US and Canada.  诺曼地登陆行动是英国、美国和加拿大军队的一次联合行动。
There has been a concerted campaign against the proposals.  人们一致行动反对这些提议。

words.meaning: n.  踩踏,蹂躏vt. vi.  践踏,轻视
words.example:
Somebody trampled all over my flowerbeds in the night!  晚上有人把我的花坛全部踩坏了！
Eight people were trampled to death (= killed) when the stadium collapsed and the crowd rushed out onto the football pitch.  体育场突然倒塌时，人群冲进足球场，其间八人被踩踏致死。verb intransitive or transitive [usually + prep]
She accused the government of trampling on the needs and rights of the ordinary citizen.  她谴责政府无视普通公民的需求和权利。

words.meaning: n.  沼泽
words.example:
I'm just going to nip to the bog.  我正要跑去上厕所。
We've run out of bog paper / roll.  我们的厕纸用完了。UK verb (-gg-)
Bog off and leave me alone.  走开，别管我。

words.meaning: vi.  打瞌睡,假寐vt.  打瞌睡度过n.  瞌睡
words.example:
My cat likes dozing in front of the fire.  我的猫喜欢在火炉前打盹。UK verb intransitive
The office was so hot I nearly dozed off at my desk.  办公室里很热，我差点在办公桌上睡着了。

words.meaning: n.  副总统(或大学副校长等)
words.example:
Greed, pride, envy, dishonesty and lust are considered to be vices.  贪婪、骄傲、妒忌、欺骗和淫欲都被视为罪恶。
mainly humorous My one real vice (= bad habit) is chocolate.  我一个真正的恶习就是爱吃巧克力。
The chief of police said that he was committed to wiping out vice in the city.  警察局长说他将坚定不移地扫除该市的犯罪行为。noun

words.meaning: a.  粗俗的,庸俗的,本土的,通俗的,普通的
words.example:
I've no idea how much the clothes cost because there was nothing so vulgar as a price tag in evidence.  我不知道那些衣服值多少钱，因为上面连一个普通的价格标签都看不到。
Isn't it rather vulgar to talk about how much money you earn?  谈论赚多少钱难道不庸俗吗？UK US disapproving
It was an extremely vulgar joke.  那是个极为下流的笑话。

words.meaning: n.  禁忌,禁止接近,禁止使用a.  禁忌的,忌讳的vt.  禁忌,禁制,禁止
words.example:
In this society there is a taboo on/against any sort of public display of affection.  在这个社会里，人们忌讳当众示爱。
For some people, death is a taboo subject.  对有些人而言，死亡是个忌讳的话题。

words.meaning: n.  顺从,尊重
words.example:
He treats her with such deference.  他非常尊重她。
She covered her head out of/in deference to (= because of a polite respect for) Muslim custom.  出于对穆斯林习俗的尊重，她把头蒙了起来。

words.meaning: n.  不幸,灾祸
words.example:
She was always cheerful in adversity.  身处逆境时，她也从不垂头丧气。
The road to happiness is paved with adversities.  通往幸福的道路上荆棘满途。

words.meaning: n.  (硬壳果)仁; (谷物去核后的)粒，子
words.example: There is often a kernel of truth in what they say.  他们的话里常包含些真理。

words.meaning: vt.  使坚固,确证
words.example: Recent research seems to corroborate his theory.  最新研究似乎证实了他的理论。

words.meaning: vt.  刺激,激励,引诱
words.example:
She incited racial hatred by distributing anti-Semitic leaflets.  她派发反犹太传单煽动种族仇恨。
They denied inciting the crowd to violence.  他们否认煽动群众闹事。

words.meaning: v.  重新塑造，改造
words.example: We've completely remodelled the kitchen.  我们把厨房彻底改造过了。

words.meaning: n.  灵长类动物
words.example: He was made the Roman Catholic Primate of All Ireland last year.  他去年被任命为全爱尔兰天主教大主教。

words.meaning: n.  不朽的人物a.  永远的,不死的,神的
words.example:
The priest said he was endangering his immortal soul.  神父说他正在危及自己不朽的灵魂。
In the immortal words of Samuel Goldwyn, "Include me out".  用塞缪尔‧戈尔德温那句不朽的名言来说就是：“把我包括在外。”UK noun literary
She is one of the immortals of classical opera.  她是古典歌剧不朽的演唱家之一。

words.meaning: a.  生动的,如画的,独特的
words.example: the picturesque narrow streets of the old city  古城里如画的狭窄街道

words.meaning: n.  上腭
words.example: a discriminating palate  敏锐的鉴赏力

words.meaning: a.  骨胳的，骸骨的
words.example:
Her body was skeletal (= very thin).  她骨瘦如柴。
He suffered serious skeletal injuries in the accident.  他在事故中骨头严重受伤。
The newspaper report gave only a skeletal account of the debate.  报纸只报道了辩论的大致情况。

words.meaning: adj.  宽心的
words.example: He was relieved to see Jeannie reach the other side of the river safely.  看到珍妮安全到达河对岸，他心头一块石头落了地。

words.meaning: n.  算术,算法
words.example: I've never been very good at arithmetic.  我从来不擅长算术。

words.meaning: n.  民间传说
words.example:
Her books are often based on folklore and fairy-tales.  她的书常常以民间传说和神话故事为创作基础。
In Irish folklore, the leprechaun had a large piece of gold.  爱尔兰民间传说中的小矮妖有一大块金子。
Arguments between directors and stars are part of the folklore of Hollywood.  导演和演员之间发生争吵已成为好莱坞传统的一部分。

words.meaning: vt.  推翻,颠覆,毁灭
words.example:
The rebel army is attempting to subvert the government.  叛军试图推翻政府。
Our best intentions are sometimes subverted by our natural tendency to selfishness.  我们的良好意图有时会被自私的本性破坏。

words.meaning: n.  支流; a.  支流的
words.example: the Indre, a lesser tributary of the Loire  安德尔河，卢瓦尔河的一条较小的支流

words.meaning: (C) [对…的]强烈嗜好,偏好;  倾向[for]
words.example: Her penchant for disappearing for days at a time worries her family.  她喜欢不时失踪几天，这让她的家人非常担心。

words.meaning: vt.  诱拐,绑走
words.example: The company director was abducted from his car by terrorists.  公司董事被恐怖分子从自己的车里劫走了。

words.meaning: vt.  使沮丧,压低,降低,使萧条
words.example:
This weather depresses me.  这种天气让我感到心情忧郁。
The rise in the value of the dollar has depressed the company's earnings/profits this year.  今年美元升值导致该公司营业额／利润降低。
High interest rates are continuing to depress the economy.  高利率使经济持续萧条。

words.meaning: n.  恩惠
words.example: Guide dogs are a great boon to the partially sighted.  导盲犬对视力有障碍的人来说是非常有用的。

words.meaning: n.  地质学
words.example: a geology course/teacher  地质学课程／教师

words.meaning: n.  牛仔竞技表演
words.example: The rodeo attracts cowboys from everywhere.  牛仔竞技吸引各地牛仔。

words.meaning: n.  蜂房，蜂箱
words.example:
She broke out in hives after eating strawberries.  她吃过草莓之后，身上就起了疹子。noun
The whole house was a hive of activity on the day before the wedding.  婚礼的前一天，整幢房子里一派忙碌的景象。verb
The plan is to hive off individual companies as soon as they are profitable.  该计划就是一旦某个公司开始获利，就将其分立出去。

words.meaning: n.  纱，纱线
words.example: He knew how to spin a good yarn (= tell a good story).  他知道如何编造有趣的故事。

words.meaning: vi.  交谈
words.example:
In the US, you drive on the right hand side of the road, but in Britain the converse applies.  在美国汽车靠右行驶，但在英国却正好相反。
However, the converse of this theory may also be true.  可是，该原理的逆命题也有可能成立。adjective UK US
She's so shy that conversing with her can be quite difficult.  她那么害羞，跟她交谈很难。

words.meaning: a.  慈善的
words.example: He was a benevolent old man, he wouldn't hurt a fly.  他是个仁慈的老人，连一只苍蝇都不愿伤害。

words.meaning: n.  震动,颤抖,箭袋,大群vi.  颤抖,振动,射中vt.  使颤动a.  敏捷的
words.example:
Lennie's bottom lip quivered and tears started in his eyes.  雷尼的下唇颤抖着，眼里涌出了泪光。UK noun countable
The opening bars of the music sent a quiver of excitement through the crowd.  音乐起始的几小节让人群顿时兴奋激动起来。

words.meaning: a.  迷惑的,虚伪的,欺诈的
words.example: It's deceptive - from the outside the building looks small, but inside it's quite big.  这是一种错觉——从外面看这栋建筑物很小，但内部空间却相当大。

words.meaning: a.  睡眠状态的,静止的
words.example:
The long-dormant volcano has recently shown signs of erupting.  休眠了很久的火山最近出现了要喷发的迹象。
These investments have remained dormant for several years.  这些投资好几年都没有甚么动静。
Her talent might have lain dormant had it not been for her aunt's encouragement.  如果不是姑姑鼓励她，她的才能可能现在还不会被挖掘出来。

words.meaning: n.  大屠杀,残杀
