words.meaning: n.  畏缩,后退,后座力,反作用,弹回vi.  退却,畏缩,弹回,报应,反冲,撤退
words.example:
He leant forward to kiss her and she recoiled in horror.  他俯身去吻她，她惊恐地后退避开。
She wondered how it would be to touch him and recoiled at the thought.  她想知道摸一摸他会是甚么感觉，但这个念头一进入脑海，她马上感到一阵厌恶。noun uncountable /ˈriː.kɔɪl/

words.meaning: n.  遗迹,痕迹,退化的器官,丝毫,残余
words.example:
These old buildings are the last vestiges of a colonial past.  这些旧建筑是殖民历史最后的痕迹。
There is now no vestige of hope that the missing children will be found alive.  失踪儿童现在已经毫无生还的希望了。

words.meaning: adj.  可分别的
words.example:
The influence of Rodin is discernible in the younger artist.  从这位稍微年轻一些的艺术家身上可以看到罗丹的影响。
There is no discernible reason why this should be the case.  没有理由可以解释为甚么会这样。

words.meaning: a.  已废的,古老的,古代的
words.example: an archaic system of government  古老的政体

words.meaning: vt.  评价,估价,鉴定
words.example:
At the end of each teaching practice, trainee teachers are asked to appraise their own performance.  在每次教学实习结束时，都要求实习教师对自己的表现作自我评定。
In co-operation with other professionals, social workers will appraise the individual's needs.  社会工作者将与其他专业人士携手合作，对个体的需要作出评估。
He coolly appraised the situation , deciding which person would be most likely to succeed.  他冷静地审时度势，判断哪个人最可能获得胜利。

words.meaning: vt.  辩护,表白,维护
words.example:
The decision to include Morris in the team was completely vindicated when he scored three goals.  莫里斯攻入了三球，证明当初将他招入队中是完全正确的。
The investigation vindicated her complaint about the newspaper.  调查证明了她对那家报纸的投诉属实。

words.meaning: n.  喧嚣,骚动
words.example:
The book caused an uproar in France.  该书在法国引起了轩然大波。
The whole hall was in uproar after the announcement.  宣布完后，整个大厅一片哗然。

words.meaning: vi.  犯错,做错,犯罪
words.example:
He erred in agreeing to her appointment.  他错在同意了对她的任命。UK UK US UK formal
Twenty-five people have replied to the invitation, but I've erred on the side of caution and put out 30 chairs.  25人回覆了邀请函，但为谨慎起见我准备了30把椅子。UK UK US UK formal

words.meaning: n.  毛虫，蝴蝶的幼虫
words.example: A caterpillar became a butterfly.  毛虫变成了蝴蝶。

words.meaning: n.  大错,大失策vi.  失策,绊倒,犯错vt.  做错
words.example:
He said that the tax was a major political blunder.  他称这项税收政策是一大政治错误。
Police blundered by not releasing more details about the case to focus public interest.  警方因没有提供更多的详细案情以引起公众关注而酿成了大错。

words.meaning: vt.  欺骗,哄骗,愚弄n.  愚弄人,恶作剧
words.example:
The bomb threat turned out to be a hoax.  那次炸弹恐吓结果发现是场恶作剧。
He'd made a hoax call claiming to be the President.  他搞了个恶作剧，打电话自称是总统。UK verb transitive

words.meaning: n.  连接,会合处,交叉点
words.example: You should slow down as you approach the junction.  接近交叉口时你应该减速。

words.meaning: vt.  分配,分摊指定
words.example:
They allotted a separate desk to everyone.  他们给每一个人都单独配发了桌子。
The ministry of culture will be allotted about $6 million less this year.  今年文化部得到的拨款将会比去年少600万美元。
Three hours have been allotted to/for this task.  这项任务限定在三小时内完成。

words.meaning: vt.  包住
words.example: The nuclear waste is encased in concrete before being sent for storage in disused mines.  核废料在送往废弃的矿井存放之前，先用混凝土密封起来。

words.meaning: n.  凝块,群vt. vi.  (使)凝结,(使)聚集
words.example:
He had a blood clot removed from his brain.  他颅内的一个血块被取了出来。UK noun countable
Look what you've done, you clot!  看看你做了甚么，笨蛋！UK verb intransitive (-tt-)
He was rushed into hospital because his blood wasn't clotting properly.  他被匆忙送进医院，因为他的血液不能正常凝结。

words.meaning: vt.  缓和,减弱,减少,废除vi.  缓和,减弱,减少
words.example:
The storm/wind/rain has started to abate.  暴风雨／风／雨开始减弱了。
The fighting in the area shows no sign of abating.  这个地区的战事没有任何缓和的迹象。

words.meaning: n.  水中呼吸器
words.example: We went scuba diving at the reef.  我们在礁石区水肺潜水。

words.meaning: a.  熔化的，熔融的
words.example: molten glass/lava/lead  熔融的玻璃／岩浆／铅

words.meaning: n.  即席演出,即兴曲a.  即席的ad.  即席
words.example: an impromptu party/performance  临时晚会／即兴表演

words.meaning: vt.  开拓(或建立)殖民地; 移居于
words.example: Peru was colonized by the Spanish in the sixteenth century.  秘鲁在16世纪沦为西班牙的殖民地。

words.meaning: n.  遵守,仪式,惯例
words.example: Religious observances such as fasting can be hard to follow.  像斋戒这样的宗教习俗很难遵行。

words.meaning: a.  不能想像的,想不到的,难信的
words.example:
The idea that they might not win was inconceivable to them.  他们可能赢不了的念头对他们来说是不可想像的。
It would be inconceivable for her to change her mind.  要她改变主意是不可想像的。
Another nuclear accident in the same place is virtually/almost inconceivable.  同一地方再次发生核事故简直／几乎是不可能的。

words.meaning: n.  征税,召集,课征vi.  征税,课税vt.  征收,发动,召集
words.example: They imposed a 5% levy on alcohol.  他们对酒品征收5%的税。

words.meaning: a.  夜的,夜曲的
words.example: Most bats are nocturnal.  大部分蝙蝠在夜间活动。    Compare diurnal

words.meaning: n.  暂停,间歇,稍息,麻痹vt.  使平静,哄骗,使安静vi.  变平静
words.example:
The motion of the car almost lulled her to sleep.  汽车的颠簸让她昏昏欲睡。verb transitive
Most exercise classes start gently, lulling you into thinking that you're fit.  健身课程一开始大多都很容易，让人误以为自己很健康。
Their promises lulled us into a false sense of security (= made us feel safe, when in fact we were not).  他们的承诺让我们以为很安全。noun countable

words.meaning: a.  栽植的; 有修养的
words.example: cultivated fields/soil/land  耕地

words.meaning: n.  垂饰，下垂物
words.example:
She was wearing a crystal pendant.  她戴着一个水晶垂饰。
It was a necklace with a diamond pendant.  那是一条带有钻石垂饰的项炼。adjective

words.meaning: a.  冲动的,受感情驱使的,任性的
words.example: Don't be so impulsive - think before you act.  不要如此冲动——要三思而后行。

words.meaning: n.  烈啤酒,矮胖子a.  强壮的,稳重的,勇敢的,矮胖的,结实的,坚定的
words.example:
Mrs Blower was the rather stout lady with the glasses.  布洛尔太太就是那个肥硕、戴眼镜的女人。adjective
I've bought myself a pair of good stout boots for hiking.  我给自己买了双厚实耐穿的靴子健行时穿。adjective
He needed a cool head, a stout heart and nerves of steel.  他需要具备冷静的头脑、不屈不挠的勇气和钢铁般的意志。noun uncountable

words.meaning: n.  急忙，匆忙
words.example:
Unfortunately the report was prepared in haste and contained several inaccuracies.  遗憾的是，这份报告准备得有些仓促，里面有几处不准确的地方。
His father had just died and he didn't want to marry with indecent haste.  父亲刚刚去世，他不想太过匆忙地结婚——那样做有悖情理。noun uncountable disapproving
Make haste!  快一点！noun uncountable disapproving

words.meaning: (U) [常 ~s] [对有关未来之事的] 不安,疑惑,忧虑,缺乏信心[about]
words.example:
Many teachers expressed serious misgivings about the new exams.  许多教师表示对新的考试非常担忧。
My only misgiving is that we might not have enough time to do the job properly.  我唯一担心的是我们可能没有足够的时间把这项工作做好。

words.meaning: n.  保留剧目
words.example: 'Macbeth' is in repertory at the RSC.  《马克白》是皇家莎士比亚剧团的保留剧目之一。

words.meaning: n.  债务人,借主,借方
words.example: The debtor missed two payments.  债务人欠了两期款。

words.meaning: vt. vi.  斥责,责骂
words.example: She chided him for his bad manners.  她训斥他没有礼貌。

words.meaning: n.  顶,峰,绝顶
words.example: He reached the apex of his career during that period.  那个时期他的事业达到顶峰。

words.meaning: n.  倾斜,斜面,歪曲,偏见,观点a.  倾斜的vt. vi.  (使)倾斜
words.example:
Italic writing slants to the right.  斜体字向右倾斜。
The evening sun slanted (= shone with the light moving in a slope) through the narrow window.  夕阳穿过狭窄的窗户斜射进来。
The police claimed that reports in the media were slanted against/towards the defendant.  警方称媒体的报道倾向于指责／袒护被告。UK noun

words.meaning: vt.  围攻,使苦恼,镶嵌
words.example: With the amount of traffic nowadays, even a trip across town is beset by/with dangers.  目前交通如此拥挤，即使穿城而行也充满了危险。

words.meaning: n.  打扮,装束vt.  打扮,穿衣
words.example: prison/clerical/military garb  囚衣／教士服／军装

words.meaning: a.  不便的; 让人不舒服的
words.example: It will be very inconvenient for me to have no car.  没有车对我来说会很不方便。adjective

words.meaning: v.  使…受精，受粉; 施肥
words.example:
Bees fertilize the flowers by bringing pollen.  蜜蜂透过传播花粉使花朵受粉。
Once an egg is fertilized by the sperm, it becomes an embryo.  卵子受精后即成胚胎。

words.meaning: n.  多样化
words.example: Diversification reduces risk.  多元化能降低风险。

words.meaning: n.  挖苦,讽刺
words.example: "You have been working hard, " he said with heavy sarcasm, as he looked at the empty page.  “你工作真卖力，”他看着空白页狠狠地挖苦我。    Compare ironyUK noun uncountable

words.meaning: n.  煤油，火油
words.example: The lamp burns kerosene.  这灯烧煤油。

words.meaning: vt.  假装,装作vi.  作假
words.example:
You know how everyone feigns surprise when you tell them how old you are.  你知道当你告诉别人你的年龄时，他们如何故作惊讶。
She responded to his remarks with feigned amusement.  她假装对他的话感兴趣。

words.meaning: n.  推测,猜测vt. vi.  推测,臆测
words.example:
My surmise turned out to be right.  最后证实我的推测是正确的。
The article is pure surmise and innuendo.  这篇文章完全是主观臆测、含沙射影。

words.meaning: n.  淀粉; [pl.  ]淀粉类食物
words.example:
Corn starch is used as a thickener in stews.  玉米淀粉在炖煮的菜肴中当作增稠剂。    Compare carbohydrateUK noun uncountable
She wore a starched white apron over her black dress.  她在黑色连衣裙外套了件浆过的白色围裙。

words.meaning: a.  旋律的，曲调的; 音调优美的
words.example: The melody is slow and melodic.  旋律缓慢而优美。

words.meaning: n.  饱和(状态)
words.example: The market reached saturation.  市场达到了饱和。

words.meaning: a.  能渗透的; 多孔的
words.example: The border in this region is porous and many refugees have simply walked across.  这个地区的边界管理很松懈，许多难民很容易就越过了。

words.meaning: n.  舞蹈指导
words.example: The choreographer created new steps.  编舞设计了新舞步。

words.meaning: n.  恶意,蓄意,怨恨
words.example:
There certainly wasn't any malice in her comments.  她的话绝对没有任何恶意。
formal I bear him no malice (= do not want to harm or upset him).  我对他没有恶意。

words.meaning: a.  哀伤的
words.example:
She was deeply distressed by the news of his death.  他的死讯让她感到非常忧伤。
The government is taking steps to stimulate business development in (economically) distressed areas.  政府正采取措施促进（经济）困难地区的商业发展。

words.meaning: n.  海上抢劫，海盗行为
words.example: Piracy is alive and flourishing on the world's commercial sea-lanes.  在世界商业航线上，海盗抢劫仍然十分猖獗。UK noun uncountable

words.meaning: v.  美化; 赞扬
words.example:
There are 99 prayer beads - one for each way Allah can be glorified in the Koran.  有99颗念珠，每一颗都代表着真主的一大功德，每种功德都在《可兰经》中留下了浓墨重彩的一笔。
informal My word processor's really just a glorified typewriter.  我那个玩意美其名曰文字处理机，可极其量也只是部打字机。

words.meaning: a.  不活动的; 怠惰的
words.example:
It's bad for your health to be physically inactive.  不活动筋骨对健康不好。
The property market remains largely inactive.  房地产市场仍很不活跃。

words.meaning: n.  晦暗,玷污,污点vt.  使失去光泽,玷污vi.  失去光泽,被玷污
words.example: By this time a series of scandals had severely tarnished the leader's image/reputation.  到这时，一连串的丑闻已使这位领导人的形象／名誉大大受损。

words.meaning: vt.  离婚,抛弃,拒绝履行,拒付,拒绝
words.example: He repudiated the allegation/charge/claim that he had tried to deceive them.  他们指控／谴责／声称他企图欺骗他们，他对此进行了驳斥。

words.meaning: n.  裂缝
words.example:
The harsh light revealed every crevice and wrinkle in his face.  他脸上每条深浅不一的皱纹在强光下都清晰可见。
Sweat poured out of every crevice of the fat man's body.  那个胖子身上的每一条褶皱都涌出了汗水。

words.meaning: n.  恩人,捐助者,赠送者
words.example: A benefactor funded the library.  一位赞助人资助了图书馆。

words.meaning: a.  沉默寡言的,心照不宣的,缄默的
words.example: tacit agreement/approval/support  默契／默许／暗中支持

words.meaning: a.  愉快的,和蔼可亲的,同意的
words.example:
We spent a most agreeable evening by the river.  我们在河边渡过了一个极为愉快的夜晚。adjective
The talks are aimed at finding a mutually agreeable solution.  会谈旨在找出一个双方都能接受的解决办法。
We must find a compromise that is agreeable to both sides of the party.  我们必须找出一个党内双方都能接受的折衷方案。

words.meaning: n.  寓言
words.example:
The play can be read as allegory.  这个剧本可以作为一个寓言来读。
Saint Augustine's 'City of God' is an allegory of the triumph of Good over Evil.  《上帝之城》是一部正义战胜邪恶的讽喻作品。

words.meaning: n.  废除，废止
words.example: The abolition of slavery changed history.  废奴改变了历史。

words.meaning: n.  礼貌,规矩,适当
words.example:
The director insisted that there was no question as to the propriety of how the funds were raised.  经理坚持说集资方式是完全正当的。
She was careful always to behave with propriety.  她时刻注意行为得体。
They'd invited us to dinner so we thought we'd better observe the proprieties and invite them back.  他们请我们吃饭，所以我们认为最好遵循礼数回请他们。

words.meaning: v.  (使)压缩; (使)凝结
words.example: Water vapour in the air condenses into fog.  空气中的水汽凝结形成雾。

words.meaning: vt.  泄露,暴露
words.example: Journalists do not divulge their sources.  记者们不会透露消息的来源。

words.meaning: n.  赞美,称赞vt.  赞美,称赞
words.example: The German leadership lauded the Russian initiative.  德国领导人赞扬了俄罗斯的倡议。

words.meaning: n.  少量,轻拍,比目鱼,熟手vt. vi.  轻拍,轻擦
words.example:
Can't you just put a dab of paint over the mark and cover it up?  你就不能在那块污迹上抹点油漆把它盖住吗？
I'll give that stain a quick dab with a wet cloth.  我会用湿布轻擦一下那个污迹的。verb intransitive or transitive (-bb-)
She dabbed at her eyes with a tissue.  她用纸巾轻轻地擦了擦眼睛。

words.meaning: n.  海峡,困难a.  困难的,窘迫的,狭窄的
words.example: So many companies are in such dire/difficult straits that their prices have come right down.  许多公司财务状况极为窘迫，导致其股价直线下跌。

words.meaning: a.  刑的,刑罚的,刑法上的n.  刑事
words.example:
Many people believe that execution has no place in the penal system of a civilized society.  许多人认为文明社会的刑罚制度中不应有死刑。
He had been in and out of penal institutions (= prison) from the age of 16.  他自16岁起多次被捕入狱。adjective
They complained about the penal and counter-productive tax rates.  他们抱怨税率繁重、不利生产。

words.meaning: vt.  存疑,归咎,弹劾,检举,怀疑
words.example: The governor was impeached for wrongful use of state money.  州长因滥用本州公帑而遭到弹劾。

words.meaning: a.  土生的，不移栖的
words.example: My doctor says I should start playing sport because my lifestyle is too sedentary.  医生说，我应该做些运动，因为我的生活方式太缺乏运动。

words.meaning: vt.  译解
words.example:
Decoding the paintings is not difficult once you know what the component parts symbolise.  一旦明白了画中各部分的象征意义，也就不难搞清楚这幅画的含义了。    Compare encode
Grammatical information helps learners to decode sentences.  文法资讯有助于学习者正确理解句子的含义。

words.meaning: vi.  坚持,孜孜不倦,不屈不挠
words.example:
It looks as if the policy will be a success, providing that the government perseveres and does not give in to its critics.  看来如果政府锲而不舍，不向批评家屈服，这项政策就有可能成功。
The education director is persevering in his attempt to obtain additional funding for the school.  教育局长正坚持不懈地为该校争取更多资金补助。
Despite receiving little support, the women are persevering with their crusade to fight crime.  尽管得不到甚么支持，这些妇女仍然坚持与犯罪搏斗。

words.meaning: vt.  刺绣,镶边,装饰vi.  绣花
words.example: Naturally, I embroidered the tale a little to make it more interesting.  很自然地，我讲这个故事时作了一点渲染，好让它更有趣。

words.meaning: vi.  脱离,出轨vt.  使偏离a.  脱离常规的n.  脱离常规的人
words.example:
The recent pattern of weather deviates from the norm for this time of year.  近来的天气状况与往年同期相比有些异常。verb intransitive
The path follows the river closely, occasionally deviating round a clump of trees.  这条小路紧挨着河，只是在遇到树林时才偶尔分开。

words.meaning: a.  田园诗的,牧歌的,悠闲的
words.example: an idyllic childhood/summer  恬静愉快的童年／诗情画意的夏天

words.meaning: vi.  自制,戒绝,弃权,避免
words.example: He took a vow to abstain from alcohol/smoking/sex.  他发誓戒酒／戒烟／ 禁欲。verb intransitive

words.meaning: vt.  使移居入境vi.  移来
words.example: He immigrated with his parents in 1895, and grew up in Long Island.  1895年，他与父母一起移民，并在长岛长大。

words.meaning: n.  背叛,脱党,离会
words.example:
Over the years there were hundreds of defections to the West/defections from the East.  这些年来发生了数百宗向西方／从东方投奔的事件。
Recent changes in policy have resulted in large-scale defection from the party.  最近的政策变化导致了大规模的党员倒戈行为。

words.meaning: vt.  刺穿,使呆住
words.example: The conference delegates were transfixed by her speech.  与会代表被她的发言吓呆。 literary

words.meaning: vt.  解散,使退伍vi.  解散
words.example: She formed a political group which disbanded a year later.  她曾经成立了一个政治团体，但一年后就解散了。

words.meaning: n.  反驳,顶嘴,蒸馏器,曲颈瓶vi.  反驳,回嘴,反击vt.  反击,反驳,提纯
words.example: "I'm going to tell him," said Max. "Just you try!" came the retort.  “我要去告诉他，”马克斯说。“你倒试试！”有人回嘴道。

words.meaning: n.  富矿带,带来好运的事物,幸运
words.example:
The rise in house prices meant that those who were selling enjoyed a bonanza.  房价的上升意味着那些卖房者发了大财。
April was a bonanza month for car sales.  四月份是汽车销售的旺季。
The magazine will hold another fashion bonanza in the spring.  该杂志将在春天再举办一次盛大的时装节。

words.meaning: vi.  分歧,岔开vt.  使岔开
words.example:
They walked along the road together until they reached the village, but then their paths diverged.  他们一直沿着那条路走到那个村子，然后才分道扬镳。
Although the two organizations have worked together for many years, their objectives have diverged recently.  虽然这两个组织在一起合作了很多年，但它们的目标近来出现了分歧。    Opposite converge

words.meaning: n.  圆形隆起物,瘤vi.  隆起成圆丘形,弓起,努力vt.  使弓起,使努力干
words.example:
The car hit a hump in the road and swerved.  汽车撞上了路面的一个隆起而突然转向。
Some types of camel have two humps and others have one.  有些种类的骆驼有两个驼峰，而其他的只有一个。
It's been hard work but I think we're over the hump now.  这是一项很艰苦的工作，但我想我们已经完成最困难的部分了。noun

words.meaning: n.  腐蚀(状态)，侵蚀
words.example: Rust is a form of corrosion.  铁锈是一种腐蚀。

words.meaning: vt. vi.  缩回,收回,取消,撤消
words.example:
When questioned on TV, the minister retracted his allegations.  在接受电视采访时，部长收回了他以前的说法。
The wheels retract after the aircraft takes off.  飞机起飞后轮子便收了起来。
The cat retracted its claws.  猫把爪子缩了回去。

words.meaning: a.  惰性的,迟钝的,无活力的,呆滞的
words.example:
The inert figure of a man could be seen lying in the front of the car.  可以看到一个男人躺在汽车前座上，一动也不动。
The narrative is inert and sloppy, as if the author had been writing half-asleep.  这个故事既没有意思又没有条理，好像作者是在半睡半醒中写的。UK adjective

words.meaning: a.  义不容辞的,义务的,必须的
words.example:
The medical examination before you start work is obligatory.  工作前必须先体检。
Some secret service agents turned up, all wearing the obligatory raincoat and hat.  几名特工出现了，当然是一律穿着风雨衣，戴着帽子。

words.meaning: vi.  搀杂,混杂vt.  搞乱,使混乱n.  混乱,薄饼
words.example:
He rummaged through the jumble of papers on his desk.  他在书桌上一堆乱糟糟的文件中翻找东西。
Her clothes were all jumbled up/together in the suitcase.  她的衣服都胡乱扔在手提箱里。

words.meaning: a.  椭圆的
words.example: His message was written in a deliberately elliptical style.  他的留言故意写得很隐晦。

words.meaning: a.  空前的; 无比的
words.example: They enjoyed success on a scale unparalleled by any previous pop group.  他们取得了以前任何流行乐队都无法比拟的成功。

words.meaning: n.  闹剧,滑稽剧,胡闹
words.example:
The play suddenly changes from farce to tragedy.  这出戏突然从闹剧转变成悲剧。UK noun
No one had prepared anything so the meeting was a bit of a farce.  谁也没有作任何准备，因此会议有点像一出闹剧。

words.meaning: n.  1 a.   (常指两个坚硬物体的) 撞击,碰撞b.  震动;  音响2 [the ~]
words.example:
Drums, tambourines and cymbals are all percussion instruments.  鼓、铃鼓和铜钹都是打击乐器。
Jean plays the guitar and her brother is on percussion (= plays percussion instruments).  琼弹奏吉他，她弟弟演奏打击乐器。    Compare brass ; woodwind

words.meaning: n.  破裂,断裂,敌对,决裂,裂开vt. vi.  (使)破裂
words.example:
His appendix ruptured and he had to be rushed to hospital.  他突然盲肠穿孔，不得不被紧急送进医院。
figurative This news has ruptured (= violently ended) the delicate peace between the rival groups.  这个消息打破了这些敌对群体间脆弱的和平局面。
You're going to give yourself a rupture if you lift that.  如果你硬举那个东西，会发疝气的。

words.meaning: a.  不适当的,无能的,笨拙的
words.example:
He was always rather inept at sport.  他一直不擅长体育运动。
He was criticized for his inept handling of the situation.  他由于对这个局面处理不当而受到批评。
Dick was socially inept and uncomfortable in the presence of women.  迪克在女性面前显得笨拙和不安。

words.meaning: n.  最后通牒
words.example:
He gave her an ultimatum - she could either stop seeing Peter and come back to him or it was divorce.  他向她下了最后通牒——她要么不再见彼得，回到他身边，要么离婚。
On Wednesday night the UN issued its toughest ultimatum to date, demanding that all troops withdraw from the city.  星期三晚上，联合国发出了迄今为止最强硬的最后通牒，要求所有部队从该城撤出。

words.meaning: vt.  掌握,控制,支配vi.  统治,成为主流
words.example: In industrial areas, the dark-coloured variety of the moth now predominates.  在工业区，深色的蛾现在占绝大多数。

words.meaning: a.  模糊的,不确定的,无限的
words.example: The project has been postponed for an indefinite period.  这专案被无限延期了。

words.meaning: a.  感激的,狂热的,热烈的
words.example: Relatives of the dead made an impassioned plea for the bodies to be flown back to this country.  死者亲属强烈恳求将尸体空运回国。

words.meaning: vt.  悲悼,哀叹,悔恨
words.example:
We deeply deplore the loss of life.  我们对人员丧生深表遗憾。
He said that he deplored all violence.  他说他反对一切暴力。

words.meaning: n.  袭击，入侵
words.example: incursions into enemy territory  攻入敌方领土

words.meaning: a.  任性的
words.example: The child's willful behavior worried the parents.  孩子任性的行为让父母担心。

words.meaning: a.  疏忽的,粗心的,不在意的
words.example: The judge said that the teacher had been negligent in allowing the children to swim in dangerous water.  法官说允许孩子们在危险水域游泳是教师失职。

words.meaning: n.  怨恨,恶意vt.  怀恨,嫉妒,吝惜
words.example:
Philippa still has/holds a grudge against me for refusing to lend her that money.  菲莉帕到现在仍对我不借钱给她一事耿耿于怀。verb transitive
She grudged every hour she spent helping him.  她很不情愿花时间帮他。

words.meaning: n.  反对,敌对,敌意
words.example: There's a history of antagonism between the two teams.  这两支球队是宿敌。

words.meaning: a.  冰期的; 冰河时代的
words.example: She gave me a glacial smile/stare.  她向我微微冷笑了一下／冷冷地瞪了我一眼。

words.meaning: n.  不幸之事,灾祸,恶运
words.example: The parade was very well organised and passed without mishap.  游行队伍组织得很好，通过时没有发生意外。

words.meaning: a.  温顺的,谦恭的
words.example: She seemed so very meek and mild.  她看起来非常温柔和善。

words.meaning: n.  烧焦,枯黄vt. vi.  烧焦,拷焦,(使)枯萎,讽刺
words.example:
The iron was too hot and he scorched the shirt.  熨斗太烫了，他把衬衫烫焦了。
The surrounding buildings were scorched by the heat of the explosion.  周围建筑被爆炸产生的高温熏得变色了。UK verb
The sports car scorched past and disappeared into the distance.  跑车疾驶而过，消失在远方。

words.meaning: n.  (织物的)经(线)
words.example:
Left in the garage where it was damp, the wooden frame had warped.  由于放在潮湿的车库里，木头框架已经变形了。
If I put the shelves near the radiator, the heat might warp them.  如果我把架子放在暖气附近，热度可能会使其变形。UK verb
Prison warps people. Had it warped Kelley enough that he would kill a stranger?  监狱扭曲人性。它有没有使凯利变态到会杀死一个陌生人呢？UK noun

words.meaning: a.  令人震惊的
words.example: The crippling debt forced closures.  沉重的债务迫使关门。

words.meaning: n.  贵族
words.example: Many aristocrats were killed in the French Revolution.  法国大革命中很多贵族被处死。

words.meaning: a.  语调强的,用力的,强调了的
words.example:
Poland reached the final of the championship yesterday with an emphatic 5-0 victory over Italy.  波兰队昨天五比零大胜义大利队，杀入了锦标赛的决赛。
The minister has issued an emphatic rejection of the accusation.  部长发表声明断然驳斥了这一指控。

words.meaning: n.  细颈瓶
words.example: a flask of coffee/tea  一保温瓶的咖啡／茶UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.  女高音
words.example: The soprano hit a perfect high note.  女高音唱出了完美的高音。

words.meaning: a.  短暂的，转瞬即逝的
words.example: Fame in the world of rock and pop is largely ephemeral.  在摇滚和流行音乐界，名声大多转瞬即逝。

words.meaning: n.  语言学家
words.example: The linguist speaks nine languages.  语言学家会说九种语言。

words.meaning: a.  热的,炎热的,热心的
words.example: It is his fervent hope that a peaceful solution will soon be found.  他热切地希望能很快找到和平解决的方案。

words.meaning: a.  敏捷的,灵活的,轻快的
words.example:
Monkeys are very agile climbers.  猴子动作敏捷，善于攀爬。
You need to have agile fingers to do this kind of work.  从事这种工作，手指必须非常灵巧。UK adjective
For a man of 80, he has a remarkably agile mind.  对于一个80岁的老人来说，他才思惊人地敏捷。

words.meaning: a.  沙哑的,嘶哑的,刺耳的
words.example:
She sounded a bit hoarse.  她的声音听起来有些嘶哑。
You'll make your self hoarse if you keep shouting like that!  如果你再那样一直大喊大叫下去，嗓子会哑的！

words.meaning: a.  勤勉的,用功的
words.example:
Leo is very diligent in/about his work.  利奥工作非常勤奋。
Their lawyer was extremely diligent in preparing their case.  律师为他们这个案子做了认真扎实的准备。
The discovery was made after years of diligent research.  这一发现是数年潜心研究的成果。

words.meaning: n.  生计,食物
words.example:
During this freezing weather, the food put out by householders is the only form of sustenance that the birds have.  在这种严寒的天气里，住户放在外面的食物成了鸟儿唯一的粮食。
When her husband died, she drew sustenance from /she found sustenance in her religious beliefs.  丈夫死后，她从宗教信仰上寻求精神寄托。

words.meaning: a.  很大的,惊人的,异常的
words.example:
She wrote a truly prodigious number of novels.  她确实写了大量的小说。
She was a prodigious musician.  她是一位不同凡响的音乐家。
He had a prodigious appetite for both women and drink.  他对女人和酒有着强烈的欲望。

words.meaning: a.  即时的,瞬间的,同时发生的
words.example: an instantaneous response/reply/reaction  即时的回应／回答／反应

words.meaning: n.  榆树
words.example: An old elm shades the yard.  一棵老榆树遮着院子。

words.meaning: vt.  代替,取代,接替
words.example: Most of the old road has been superseded by the great Interstate highways.  大多数的旧公路都被宽阔的州际公路取代了。

words.meaning: n.  干梅子,梅干,深紫红色,傻瓜vt.  修剪,砍掉,删除vi.  删除,删节
words.example:
She spent the afternoon pruning roses.  她用下午的时间修剪了玫瑰。
Arco has reacted to the loss in revenue by pruning (back) its expansion plans.  恒高公司缩减其扩张计划以应付收益亏损。

words.meaning: n.  喳喳声,唧唧声vt. vi.  吱喳而鸣
words.example: "Morning!" she chirped.  “早上好！”她欢快地说道。

words.meaning: n.  弹力,弹性
words.example:
As the skin grows older it loses its elasticity.  随着皮肤老化，弹性会慢慢丧失。
There is some elasticity in our plans - nothing has been firmly decided yet.  我们的计划有一定的灵活性——没有甚么是定死的。

words.meaning: a.  易怒的,急躁的
words.example:
Be careful what you say - he's rather irritable today.  说话小心点——他今天脾气很大。
"Don't disturb me again," she said in an irritable (= angry) voice.  “不要再打扰我，”她烦躁地说。

words.meaning: n.  购买,购物,好买的
words.example:
Are you sure that I can follow this diet without detriment to my health?  你能肯定我遵循这样的饮食不会对健康有害吗？
She was very involved with sports at college, to the detriment of (= harming) her studies.  她上大学时热衷于参加体育运动，甚至还因此影响了学业。

words.meaning: n.  (心理、精神)分析
words.example: Sigmund Freud is known as the father of psychoanalysis.  西格蒙德•佛洛德是广为人知的精神分析学的鼻祖。

words.meaning: n.  谜,不可思议的东西
words.example:
She is a bit of an enigma.  她有点让人捉摸不透。
The newspapers were full of stories about the enigma of Lord Lucan's disappearance.  报纸上充斥著有关卢肯伯爵失踪之谜的报道。

words.meaning: vt.  使纠缠,卷入,使混乱
words.example:
The dolphin had become entangled in/with the fishing nets.  海豚被渔网缠住了。
He went to the shop to buy bread, and got entangled in/with a carnival parade.  他去商店买面包，却被卷进嘉年华游行队伍里去了。
The mayor and the city council are anxious to avoid getting entangled in the controversy.  市长和市议会迫切希望能避免卷入这场争议。

words.meaning: n.  展览会，博览会
words.example: It purports to be an exposition of Catholic social teaching.  它主要在详细阐述天主教的社会教义。noun

words.meaning: a.  风格化的，程式化的
words.example: The rock drawings depict a variety of stylized human, bird and mythological figures and patterns.  这些岩画刻画了大批非写实人物、禽鸟、神话形象和图案。

words.meaning: n.  廉租公寓
words.example: The tenement housed dozens of families.  这栋公寓楼住着几十户人家。

words.meaning: n.  类星体
words.example: A quasar shines brighter than a galaxy.  类星体比星系还亮。

words.meaning: n.  远见,深谋远虑
words.example: She'd had the foresight to sell her apartment just before house prices came down.  她非常有远见，刚好在房价下跌之前把她的公寓卖掉了。

words.meaning: n.  异端,异教
words.example:
Radical remarks like this amount to heresy for most members of the Republican party.  像这样的激进言论对于大多数共和党人来说相当于异端邪说。
She committed the heresy of playing a Madonna song on a classical music station.  她在一个古典音乐节目中打破常规，播放了一首玛丹娜的歌。
He was burned at the stake in the fifteenth century for heresy.  15世纪，他因信仰异教而被烧死在火刑柱上。

words.meaning: vt.  嘲弄,嘲笑
words.example:
He derided my singing as pathetic.  他嘲笑说我的歌声不堪入耳。
This building, once derided by critics, is now a major tourist attraction.  这座曾被评论家嘲笑的建筑如今已成为一个主要的旅游景点。

words.meaning: a.  小的,小型的,指小的n.  小的人,指小辞,指小词,爱称
words.example: He's a diminutive figure, less than five feet tall.  他身材矮小，不足五英尺高。

words.meaning: vt. vi.  减去,贬低
words.example: All that make-up she wears actually detracts from her beauty, I think.  我认为她的那种化妆效果实际上有损她的美。

words.meaning: n.  梯度
words.example: a steep/gentle gradient  陡／缓坡

words.meaning: n.  啄痕,啄食,许多vt.  以喙啄,啄食,扔vi.  啄,吹毛求疵,啄食,扔石头
words.example:
The birds learn to peck holes in the foil milk bottle tops.  鸟儿学习在牛奶瓶的箔纸盖上啄洞。
Geese were pecking around for food.  鹅在地上四处啄食。
Chickens pecked at the seeds which covered the ground.  小鸡啄食着撒在地上的种子。

words.meaning: ad.  留心地,小心地
words.example: The animal approached warily.  动物小心翼翼地靠近。

words.meaning: n.  兴奋剂,补品a.  热忱的,诚恳的,兴奋的
words.example:
Relations between the two leaders are said to be cordial.  据说两位领导人关系友好。UK adjective
The two statesmen are known to have a cordial dislike for each other.  众所周知，这两位政治家是死对头。UK noun uncountable    UK

words.meaning: a.  本能的,天生的,直觉的
words.example: an instinctive reaction  本能反应

words.meaning: vt.  插嘴,突然插入
words.example: She interjected with a question.  她插嘴问了个问题。

words.meaning: n.  辛苦,苦心,工夫a.  辛苦的,勤勉的,小心的
words.example:
It took months of painstaking research to write the book.  这本书是经过好几个月的苦心研究才写出来的。
He was described by his colleagues as a painstaking journalist.  同事都把他描述成一名认真而严谨的记者。

words.meaning: a.  秘密的,神秘的,含义模糊的,隐藏的
words.example: He gave a cryptic reply.  他给了个含糊的回答。

words.meaning: vt.  使无效
words.example: The error invalidates the result.  该错误使结果无效。

words.meaning: a.  好客的,招待周到的
words.example:
The villagers were very hospitable to/towards anyone who passed through.  村民们对所有过路人都非常热情友好。    Opposite inhospitable
It's difficult to think of a less hospitable environment than the surface of the Moon.  很难想像还有甚么地方比月球表面的环境更为恶劣。

words.meaning: n.  争吵vi.  争吵,哗哗地流水
words.example: The young men had nothing better to do than brawl in the streets.  这些年轻人除了在大街上打架殴斗做不出甚么好事。

words.meaning: vi.  兴奋,激动,感到刺痛,抖动vt.  使感刺痛n.  刺痛,震颤,耳鸣
words.example:
My toes and fingers are tingling with the cold.  我的脚趾和手指冻得刺痛。
There's a line in that poem that makes my spine tingle every time I read it.  每当我读起那首诗，里面有一行诗句总是令我感到激动不已。
She tingled with fear as she entered the dark alleyway.  她走进那黑暗的小巷时，感到一阵阵恐惧。noun countable

words.meaning: vt.  放弃,断念,抛弃
words.example:
Do not forsake me!  不要抛弃我！UK US  (forsook, forsaken)
He decided to forsake politics for journalism.  他决定离开政界，转向新闻界。

words.meaning: a.  美味的,好吃的,可口的
words.example:
The meal was barely palatable.  这顿饭根本谈不上可口。    Opposite unpalatableUK adjective
I'm afraid the members won't find all these changes very palatable.  恐怕会员不会觉得这些改变全都很合他们的心意。

words.meaning: n.  野蛮人a.  野蛮的
words.example:
The walled city was attacked by barbarian hordes.  那座筑有城墙的城市遭到大批野蛮人的攻击。
How can you call those barbarians your friends?  你怎么能把那些没教养的人称作朋友？

words.meaning: a.  枯萎的,烤焦的vt.  烤焦,使枯萎vi.  凋谢,干枯
words.example:
The heat from the explosion seared their hands and faces.  爆炸的热浪灼伤了他们的手和脸。
The disaster is indelibly seared into the villagers' memory.  这场灾难在村民的记忆中留下了挥之不去的烙印。

words.meaning: n.  喷射,冲刺vt.  喷射vi.  喷出,迸发,冲刺
words.example:
Blood was spurting out all over the place.  血喷得到处都是。
His arm was spurting blood where the vein had been severed.  他手臂上割破的血管正在往外喷血。UK verb intransitive or transitive
Shares of the jewellery-store chain spurted $6.  珠宝连锁店的股价飙升了六美元。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.  要求，主张
words.example:
The Chronicle has pretensions to being a serious newspaper.  《记事报》想办成一份严肃的报纸。
United's championship pretensions took a dent when they were beaten 5-1.  曼联队以1比5败北后，夺冠意志受挫。

words.meaning: a.  现存的,未毁的
words.example: We have some extant parish records from the sixteenth century.  我们保存了一些16世纪留下来的教区记录。

words.meaning: n.  鉴识家,鉴定家,内行
words.example: a wine/art connoisseur  葡萄酒／艺术鉴赏家

words.meaning: a.  拥挤的
words.example: The congested road added an hour.  拥堵的路多花了一小时。

words.meaning: a.  敏捷的,伶俐的,精明的
words.example: His nimble mind calculated the answer before I could key the numbers into my computer.  我还没来得及把数字输入电脑，他那敏捷的头脑已经算出答案。

words.meaning: n.  狂风,大风,定期租金
words.example: Hundreds of old trees were blown down in the gales.  数百棵老树被大风刮倒了。noun countable

words.meaning: a.  兴奋的
words.example:
I'm feeling a bit feverish - I hope it's not the start of flu.  我有点发烧，希望这不是患流感的前兆。adjective
Have you seen the feverish activity in the kitchen?  你看到厨房里的紧张忙乱了吗？

words.meaning: vt.  颂扬,称赞,吹捧
words.example:
His book extolling the benefits of vegetarianism sold thousands of copies.  他那本宣扬素食益处的书卖出了好几千本。
She is forever extolling the virtues of her children.  她经常夸耀自己小孩的优点。

words.meaning: a.  紧粘不放的,固执的,紧握的,不屈不挠的

The baby took my finger in its tenacious little fist.  那个婴儿用他的小拳头紧紧攥着我的手指。
There has been tenacious local opposition to the new airport.  当地人一直坚决反对这个新机场。

words.meaning: a.  不断的,不绝的,无尽的
words.example: incessant rain/noise/complaints  没完没了的雨／噪音／抱怨

words.meaning: a.  旋转的; n.  纺纱
words.example: The spinning wheel makes yarn.  纺车纺出线来。

words.meaning: n.  文具,信纸
words.example: Buy envelopes and stationery.  买信封和文具。

words.meaning: n.  时尚,时髦,流行a.  流行的,时髦的
words.example:
In the 1920s, short hair for women became the vogue.  20世纪20年代，女性留短发成为时尚。
The postwar vogue for tearing down buildings virtually destroyed the city's architecture.  战后盛行的拆毁建筑行为实际上破坏了该城市的建筑风格。
The short hemline is very much in vogue (= fashionable) this spring.  今年春天短裙非常时兴。

words.meaning: n.  高大的或宏伟的建筑物
words.example:
The town hall is the only edifice surviving from the fifteenth century.  市政厅是唯一一座存留下来的15世纪的雄伟建筑。
It looks as if the whole political edifice of the country is about to collapse.  看来整个国家的政治局势是风雨飘摇、大厦将倾。

words.meaning: a.  柔软的,逢迎的,顺从的vt.  使柔软,使顺从
words.example:
I'm not supple enough (= My body doesn't bend easily enough) to be able to touch the floor with my hands while I'm standing up.  我身体的柔韧性不够好，站着的时候双手无法触到地面。
The gloves were made of very supple leather.  这副手套是用非常柔软的皮革造成。adjective
She has shown that she has a supple mind.  她已经证明了自己头脑很灵活。

words.meaning: n.  自发性
words.example: The speech lacked spontaneity.  演讲缺乏即兴感。

words.meaning: n.  朴素,节俭,苦行,酸涩,严峻
words.example:
The wartime austerity of my early years prepared me for later hardships.  早年战火纷飞年代里的艰苦经历使我能够忍受日后的艰难困苦。
The austerities of life in a small rural community were not what I was used to.  穷乡僻壤的清苦生活可不是我所习惯的。

words.meaning: vt.  掩饰,与. . . 不符,使失望
words.example: Her calm face belied the terror she was feeling.  她平静的表情掩盖了内心的恐惧。

words.meaning: vi.  喷出
words.example:
He squirted some tomato sauce on his burger.  他往自己的汉堡上挤了些蕃茄酱汁。

words.meaning: a.  兄弟的,兄弟似的,友爱的
words.example: The President's official visit marks the start of a more fraternal relationship between the two countries.  总统的正式访问标志着两国间开始建立起一种更加亲密友好的关系。

words.meaning: n.  附属物,裙房附属建筑物vt.  并吞,附加,盖
words.example: Britain annexed this small island west of Scotland in 1955.  英国于1955年将这个位于苏格兰以西的小岛并入其领土。

words.meaning: a.  属于范畴的,绝对的,明确的
words.example: a categorical statement/reply/assurance  明确的声明／回覆／保证

words.meaning: vt.  奴役,束缚,沉溺,征服
words.example:
Women in this region were enslaved by poverty.  这一地区的妇女饱受贫困摧残。

words.meaning: vt.  漂白vi.  变白n.  漂白,漂白剂

words.meaning: v.  刺穿

She had a puncture wound in her arm, from a wasp sting.  她的手臂被黄蜂蜇伤了。UK verb
She had used a screwdriver to puncture two holes in the lid of a paint tin.  她用螺丝起子在颜料罐的盖子上戳了两个洞。

words.meaning: n.  不调和,不和vi.  不一致,倾轧
words.example: marital discord  婚姻不和

words.meaning: a.  假想的,编造的,虚伪的
words.example:
He dismissed recent rumours about his private life as fictitious.  他否认了近来有关他私生活的流言，称流言都是捏造的。
Characters in this film are entirely fictitious.  这部影片里的人物全都是虚构的。

words.meaning: a.  有方法的,有系统的
words.example: Tom is a very methodical person and writes lists for everything.  汤姆是个非常有条理的人，他把要做的每件事都一一列出。

words.meaning: n.  评分; 等级
words.example: Grading the exams took all weekend.  改卷子占了整个周末。

words.meaning: n.  富裕,富足,流入
words.example: The region is known for its affluence.  这地区以富裕著称。

words.meaning: n.  (商界)巨头
words.example: a business/property/shipping tycoon  商业／地产业／船业巨头

words.meaning: n.  敏捷,灵活,轻快
words.example: The gymnast's agility impressed everyone.  体操运动员的敏捷令人赞叹。

words.meaning: a.  添加的; 加法的; n.  添加剂
words.example: This margarine is full of additives - just look at the label!  这种人造奶油里面都是添加剂——看看那标签说明就知道了！

words.meaning: a.  愤怒的,愤慨的
words.example:
She wrote an indignant letter to the paper complaining about the council's action.  她给报纸写了一封义愤填膺的信抗议市政会的做法。
He became very indignant when it was suggested he had made a mistake.  当有人提出他犯了错误时，他非常生气。

words.meaning: a.  能适应的,可修改的
words.example: The survivors in this life seem to be those who are adaptable to change.  能在这种生活状态下幸存的人好像都是那些可以适应变化的人。

words.meaning: a.  敏捷熟练的,灵巧的
words.example:
Her movements were deft and quick.  她的动作灵巧敏捷。
She answered the journalist's questions with a deft touch.  她巧妙地回答了记者的提问。
He's very deft at handling awkward situations.  他善于处理尴尬的局面。

words.meaning: n.  不受惩罚,无事,无患
words.example: Criminal gangs are terrorizing the city with apparent impunity.  犯罪集团使市民人心惶惶却显然没有受到惩罚。

words.meaning: vi.  畏缩,退缩,抖缩
words.example: Stop cowering! I'm not going to hit you.  别往后缩了！我不会打你的。

words.meaning: a.  彬彬有礼,谦恭的
words.example: Although she often disagreed with me, she was always courteous.  尽管她常常和我意见不一致，却总是客气有礼。

words.meaning: vt. vi.  破坏,侵犯,违反
words.example:

words.meaning: vt.  围攻,包围
words.example:
The town had been besieged for two months but still resisted the aggressors.  这座城镇虽然已被围困了两个月，但仍然能把侵略者拒之城外。

words.meaning: vt.  使恢复
words.example: Tissue regenerates after skin is scratched.  皮肤擦伤后，组织会再生。

words.meaning: n.  雷达上显示的点
words.example: Last month's rise in inflation was described by the chancellor as only a blip.  财政大臣认为上个月通货膨胀的加剧只是暂时的。

words.meaning: a.  矮胖的,健壮结实的

words.meaning: n.  泥砖，土坯

words.meaning: a.  上升的，向上的

words.meaning: n.  废物,垃圾,胡说

The film was rubbish.  这部电影纯属垃圾。

words.meaning: a.  孤独的,悲惨的,凄凉的

words.meaning: n.  花蜜

words.meaning: n.  果断的人a.  坚决的,刚毅的,毅然的

words.meaning: n.  无力,虚弱,无效,阳萎

words.meaning: a.  暗黑的,邋遢的

words.meaning: a.  游牧的

words.meaning: vt.  隐秘,隐藏,隐匿,分泌

He was arrested at the airport with a kilo of heroin secreted in his clothing.  他在机场被捕时衣服里藏了一公斤海洛因。

words.meaning: a.  闷热的,窒息的,自以为是的,固步自封的,乏味的

It 's really hot and stuffy in here - let's open the window.  这里又热又闷——我们打开窗户吧。
The bedroom gets a bit stuffy in the summer.  这个房间在夏天有点闷。 disapproving
Sir William had the ability to conduct proceedings in a dignified manner without ever becoming stuffy.  威廉爵士能够以庄重但毫不刻板的方式主持会议。

words.meaning: n.  色彩,浅色vt.  染色于
words.example:
The paint we're using for the bathroom is white with a yellow tint.  我们刷浴室的涂料是白色的，但有点偏黄。
The evening sky was deep pink, with tints of purple and red in it.  傍晚的天空呈深粉红色，夹杂着淡淡的紫色和红色。
She's had blonde tints put in her hair.  她把头发染成淡淡的金黄色。

words.meaning: vt.  列举,计算,枚举,数
words.example: He enumerated the benefits of the insurance scheme.  他列出了这项保险方案的种种益处。

words.meaning: vt.  重新装饰

words.meaning: a.  无效力的,无效的,无价值的n.  零,空,零迅号

words.meaning: vi.  斗嘴,潺潺而流,闪动n.  口角,流水声

words.meaning: vt.  弄湿vi.  变潮湿

words.meaning: n.  肉食动物

humorous I did mostly vegetarian food but put a couple of meat dishes out for the carnivores (= people who eat meat).  我做的主要是素菜，不过还准备了几道荤菜给吃肉的人。    Compare herbivore

words.meaning: v.  迷住

words.meaning: a.  无私欲的,廉洁的,公平的

words.meaning: a.  运动的，运动引起的

words.meaning: n.  戴桂冠的人

words.meaning: n.  印第安人村庄

words.meaning: n.  祈祷,符咒

words.meaning: n.  细绳
words.example:

words.meaning: ad.  直接地,马上,立即a.  直接的,直率的,坦白的,豪爽的n.  直路
words.example: His forthright manner can be mistaken for rudeness.  他率直的态度可能会被误认为无礼。

words.meaning: n.  油漆,清漆,掩饰,光泽面vt.  粉饰,涂油漆于,装饰,使有光泽
words.example:
Polyurethane varnish provides a tough, scratch-resistant finish.  聚胺酯罩光漆可以形成一层坚硬防划的表面。
The varnish had been deliberately scratched.  清漆层被故意刮花了。UK verb transitive
They decided to spend the weekend varnishing their boat.  他们决定用周末的时间给他们的船上清漆。

words.meaning: n.  低能者,笨人
words.example:
Some moron smashed into the back of my car yesterday.  昨天一个笨蛋撞毁了我的车尾。
[as form of address] You moron!  你这个笨蛋！

words.meaning: n.  抒情诗,歌词a.  抒情的
words.example:
Paul Simon writes the lyrics for most of his songs.  保罗‧赛门的歌大多都是他自己写的词。
William Wordsworth wrote lyric poetry/was a lyric poet.  威廉‧华兹华斯创作抒情诗／是一位抒情诗人。

words.meaning: a.  渴望的,想望的
words.example: a wistful smile  向往的微笑

words.meaning: n.  清道夫; 食腐动物
words.example: The scavenger feeds on dead animals.  食腐动物以腐肉为生。

words.meaning: a.  有杂色的，斑驳的
words.example: mottled skin  有斑点的皮肤

words.meaning: n.  浓缩，凝结
words.example: We get a lot of condensation on the walls in the winter.  冬天，墙上会凝结很多水珠。

words.meaning: n.  蚂蚱，蝗虫
words.example: A grasshopper leaped from the grass.  蚂蚱从草丛里跳了出来。

words.meaning: a.  透不过的,不渗透的,无动于衷的,不受影响的

words.meaning: a.  有害的,有毒的,精神不健全的

words.meaning: n.  枢轴,支点a.  枢轴的vi.  在枢轴上转动vt.  装枢轴于

words.meaning: a.  知觉的,有知觉力的,感知的
words.example: Her books are full of perceptive insights into the human condition.  她的书里有很多对人类现况的深入洞见。

words.meaning: vt. vi.  发明,设计,图谋
words.example:
Couldn't you contrive a meeting between them? I think they'd be ideally suited.  你不能为他们安排一次会面吗？我想他们俩会挺配的。

words.meaning: a.  无畏的,勇猛的,豪勇的
words.example: a team of intrepid explorers  一队无畏的探险者

words.meaning: n.  月桂树,荣誉vt.  使戴桂冠,授予荣誉

words.meaning: a.  无被选任资格的,不适任的,不适当的n.  无被选任资格的人,不合录用

words.meaning: a.  爱挑剔的,难取悦的,易烦恼的
words.example:
All my children were fussy eaters.  我所有的孩子都挑食。

words.meaning: vt.  使苦恼,折磨vi.  感到痛苦
words.example: She agonized for days about whether she should take the job.  几天来她为是否该接受这份工作大伤脑筋。

words.meaning: n.  长颈鹿

words.meaning: n.  物物交换,实物交易vt. vi.  物物交换,交换

words.meaning: vt.  使同步,使合拍vi.  同时发生

words.meaning: a.  安抚的,怀柔的,融和的

words.meaning: n.  葫芦

words.meaning: a.  坚定的,踏实的,固定的,不变的
words.example: The group remained steadfast in its support for the new system, even when it was criticized in the newspapers.  这个团体始终坚定不移地支持新体制，即使遭到报纸批评的时候也毫不动摇。

words.meaning: n.  电报(机)

words.meaning: n.  利他主义,利他
words.example: She's not known for her altruism.  她并不是一个无私的人。

words.meaning: n.  飞行员,飞行家
words.example: Amy Johnson was a pioneering aviator who made record-breaking flights to Australia and South Africa in the 1930s.  艾美‧约翰逊是一位飞行先驱，她在20世纪30年代完成了到澳大利亚和南非的飞行，打破了前人的纪录。

words.meaning: n.  病,疾病,弊病
words.example:
All the rose bushes seem to be suffering from the same mysterious malady.  所有的玫瑰丛似乎都得了同一种怪病。noun countable formal
Apathy is one of the maladies of modern society.  冷漠是现代社会的弊病之一。

words.meaning: a.  感觉上的,给人美感的
words.example:
She luxuriated in the sensuous feel of the silk sheets.  她尽情地享受着丝绸床单所带来的愉悦感。
He had a very sensuous mouth.  他有一张非常性感的嘴。

words.meaning: n.  恐惧,惊惶,忧虑
words.example: We view future developments with some trepidation.  我们对未来的发展动态感到惴惴不安。

words.meaning: a.  不健全的,病态的,疾病的,可怕的

words.meaning: n.  语言学

words.example:
What are you insinuating, Daniel?  丹尼尔，你究竟在影射甚么？verb transitive

words.meaning: vt.  教唆,怂恿,煽动

words.meaning: a.  变幻无常的,浮燥的,薄情的
words.example:
She's so fickle - she's never been interested in the same man for more than a week!  她是如此变幻无常，从未喜欢过一个男人超过一星期。

words.meaning: a.  无限的,无边无际的
words.example: She has boundless energy and enthusiasm.  她有无穷的精力和无限的热情。

words.meaning: a.  可容忍的,可以的
words.example:

words.meaning: a.  应服从的,会接纳的,肯服从的,有义务的
words.example:
She might be more amenable to the idea if you explained how much money it would save.  你当时要是跟她解释这样做会省下多少钱，她或许会更乐意接受这个主意。

words.meaning: v.  分解; (使)腐烂
words.example:
The body must have been decomposing for several weeks.  那具尸体肯定已经腐烂好几个星期了。
Microbes decompose organic waste into a mixture of methane and carbon dioxide.  微生物把有机废物分解为一种甲烷和二氧化碳的混合物。

words.meaning: n.  格言,座右铭
words.example: He lives by one maxim: never lie.  他信奉一条格言：永不撒谎。

words.meaning: n.  起源
words.example: In her autobiography, she describes the song's genesis late one night in a Dublin bar.  在其自传中，她描述了一天深夜在都柏林一家小酒馆创作这首歌的过程。

words.meaning: a.  逐退的,可恶的,冷淡的,排斥的
words.example: What a repulsive old man!  这老头子真是令人厌恶！

words.meaning: n.  优势

words.meaning: n.  欺骗,谎言

words.meaning: a.  亲切的,和蔼可亲的

words.meaning: n.  古话,格言,谚语

words.meaning: vt.  严责

words.meaning: n.  复旧,故态复萌,再发,恶化vi.  故态复萌,再陷邪道,再度堕落

words.meaning: a.  没有偏见的

words.meaning: a.  自负的,自任不凡的,夸耀的

words.meaning: a.  腐蚀(性)的

words.meaning: a.  易怒的,难以取悦的,过敏的

words.meaning: n.  逗留,旅居vi.  逗留,旅居

words.meaning: a.  和蔼可亲的,友善的,殷勤的

words.meaning: vt.  厌恶,憎恨

words.meaning: adv.  不断地

words.meaning: n.  兴高采烈,着迷,欢天喜地,狂喜vt.  使狂喜

words.meaning: a.  难受的,费劲的
words.example:
I've had a very trying day at work.  我今天上班非常不顺利。
He can be rather trying at times.  他有时很难缠。

words.meaning: vi.  挣扎,折腾,挣扎着前进n.  挣扎,焦躁,辗转,比目鱼
words.example:
He lost the next page of his speech and floundered (about/around) for a few seconds.  他把演讲稿的下一页弄丢了，支支吾吾了几秒钟。
Although his business was a success, his marriage was floundering.  他虽然事业有成，可婚姻却陷入困境。
In 1986 Richardson resigned as chairman, leaving the company floundering.  1986年，理查森辞去了董事长职务，公司因此在困境中苦苦挣扎。UK noun countable or uncountable (plural flounder or flounders)

words.meaning: n.  幕间,幕间时间,过场,穿插,插曲
words.example:
Except for a brief Christian interlude at the beginning of the 11th century, Istanbul has been a Muslim city for almost 1300 years.  除了在11世纪初受基督教短暂控制外，伊斯坦堡作为一座伊斯兰教城市已经存在了将近1300年。
The musical interludes don't really fit in with the rest of the play.  穿插的音乐片段与这部剧的其他部分并不协调。

words.meaning: a.  可鄙的,卑劣的
words.example:
He's a despicable human being!  他是个令人厌恶的人！
It was despicable of her to lie about her friend.  她就朋友的事说谎实在可憎。

words.meaning: n.  气压计
words.example: This survey is considered to be a reliable barometer of public opinion.  这项调查被看作是可靠的晴雨表，能反映出民意。

words.meaning: a.  封建(制度)的
words.example: the feudal system  封建制度

words.meaning: a.  无生命的; 无生气的
words.example: He looks at me as if I'm an inanimate object.  他看着我的样子好像我是个没有生命的物体。

words.meaning: n.  叫吠,叫喊声vi.  叫吠,叫喊vt.  叫喊着说
words.example: The dog yelped in pain.  狗疼得叫了一声。

words.meaning: vt.  阐明,说明
words.example: The reasons for the change in weather conditions have been elucidated by several scientists.  已经有好几位科学家对天气状况变化的原因作了解释。

words.meaning: n.  润滑剂
words.example: Apply lubricant to the chain.  给链条上润滑剂。

words.meaning: n.  章鱼
words.example: An octopus changed its color.  章鱼变了个颜色。

words.meaning: a.  像小束状的，纤细的
words.example: a wispy cloud/fringe  一缕云／一绺浏海

words.meaning: vt. vi.  详细说明,解释
words.example:
He's always expounding on what's wrong with the world.  他总是在痛斥这个世界的弊病。
She uses her newspaper column to expound her views on environmental issues.  她利用主笔的报纸专栏阐述自己对环境问题的观点。

words.meaning: vt.  调整,使转调,调制vi.  转调,调制
words.example:
His gentle introductory tone modulates into a football coach's pre-game pep talk.  他语气温和的开场白变成了足球教练赛前鼓舞士气的慷慨陈词。UK verb transitive
An elected committee will meet monthly to modulate the council's energy policy.  一个选举产生的委员会将每月碰面以调整市政会的能源政策。UK verb transitive

words.meaning: vi.  延期,休会,换地方vt.  使中止
words.example:
The meeting was adjourned until Tuesday.  会议延期至星期二。
Shall we adjourn for lunch?  我们暂停先去吃午餐好吗？UK US  formal
Shall we adjourn to the sitting room for coffee?  我们到客厅喝杯咖啡好吗？

words.meaning: n.  领土,主权,统治
words.example:
God has dominion over (= controls) all his creatures.  上帝主宰着他创造的一切生灵。
The chief's son would inherit all his dominions.  首领的儿子将继承他的所有领地。

words.meaning: a.  英勇的n.  勇敢的人
words.example: The company has made a valiant effort/attempt in the last two years to make itself more efficient.  公司在过去两年里为提高效率进行了不懈的努力／大胆的尝试。

words.meaning: a.  教条的,独断的
words.example: He is dogmatic about the method.  他对这个方法很独断。

words.meaning: adv.  并列地，并排地
words.example:
We were running/cycling two abreast.  我们俩并肩跑步／骑车。
The motorcyclist came abreast of her car and shouted abuse at her.  那个骑摩托车的人跟上来，在她车旁并排行着，对她破口大骂。

words.meaning: n.  子孙,后裔
words.example: Every attempt is being made to ensure that these works of art are preserved for posterity.  当局正在采取一切措施以确保这些艺术品能流传后世。

words.meaning: a.  节俭的,朴素的
words.example: a frugal lifestyle  节俭的生活方式

words.meaning: n.  军备,武器
words.example: As the country prepares for war, more and more money is being spent on armament.  这个国家准备开战，军备开支越来越大。

words.meaning: vt.  点燃,使着火,引起,照亮vi.  着火,激动,发亮
words.example: Her imagination was kindled by the exciting stories her grandmother told her.  她祖母给她讲述的精彩故事激发了她的想像力。

words.meaning: a.  著名的,辉煌的,明亮的
words.example: She comes from an illustrious political family which includes two former Cabinet ministers.  她出身政治世家，家中曾出过两位内阁大臣。

words.meaning: n.  隔离,孤立,隐退
words.example:
He's been living in seclusion since he retired from acting.  自从他退出演艺圈以来，一直过着隐居的生活。
In some societies women are kept in seclusion, so that they are hardly ever seen in public.  在有些社会里，女性深居简出，很少在公共场合露面。
After being with a tour group all week I was glad to return to the seclusion of my own home.  跟团旅游一周之后，我很高兴又回到安静的家中。

words.meaning: n.  石英
words.example: The quartz clock keeps perfect time.  石英钟走时精准。

words.meaning: a.  逃避的,回避的,托辞的
words.example:
The Minister was her usual evasive self, skilfully dodging reporters' questions about her possible resignation.  部长还是保持顾左右而言他的一贯风格，当记者问及她是否可能辞职时，她驾轻就熟地避而不答。
By the time the pilot realised how close the plane was to the building, it was too late to take evasive action.  当飞行员意识到飞机与大楼非常接近时，已经来不及采取任何闪避措施了。
Drivers had to make sudden evasive manoeuvres.  驾驶员必须做出突然的闪避动作。

words.meaning: n.  赔偿,救济,矫正vt.  纠正,赔偿,重新调整,重新穿衣,救济
words.example:
Most managers, politicians and bosses are men - how can women redress the balance (= make the situation fairer and more equal) ?  大多数的经理、政治家和老板都是男性——女性怎样才能改变这种不平衡的状况呢？ formal
He went to the industrial tribunal to seek redress for the way his employers had discriminated against him.  因为雇主对他有所歧视，他走上了劳资仲裁法庭为自己讨回公道。

words.meaning: a.  不动的,不变的,固定的,静止的
words.example: She sat immobile, wondering what to do next.  她一动不动地坐着，寻思着下一步该怎么办。

words.meaning: a.  过度的,过高的,过分的
words.example: The bill for dinner was exorbitant.  晚餐的价钱太高了。

words.meaning: a.  倒转的,相反的n.  反白,反色
words.example:
Their generosity was in inverse proportion/relation to their income (= the more money they had the less generous they were).  他们的慷慨程度与他们的收入水准成反比。UK noun only singular formal
Dividing by two is the inverse of multiplying by two.  除以2与乘以2正好相反。

words.meaning: vt.  使陶醉,醉人
words.example: The views intoxicated our senses.  景色让我们陶醉。

words.meaning: vt.  使解脱,救出
words.example: It took hours to extricate the car from the sand.  用了几个小时才把陷入沙地中的车拉出来。

words.meaning: n.  鲤鱼
words.example: Carp swim in the pond.  鲤鱼在池塘里游。

words.meaning: vi.  干涉,干预,乱搞
words.example:
My sister's always meddling in other people's affairs.  我姐姐总是爱管别人的闲事。
People shouldn't meddle with things they don't understand.  自己不懂的事情，就不该管闲事。

words.meaning: vt.  战胜,超越,克服
words.example:
They managed to surmount all opposition/objections to their plans.  他们设法摆平了对他们计划的所有反对意见。
There are still a few technical problems/obstacles/hurdles to be surmounted before the product can be put on sale to the public.  在这个产品对大众销售之前，还有一些技术问题要解决。UK US formal
The central 12-foot column is surmounted by a bronze angel with outspread wings.  中央12英尺高的柱子顶上立着一座展翅欲飞的天使铜像。

words.meaning: a.  不敬的,不逊的,无礼的
words.example: an irreverent comment/approach/attitude  无礼的批评／方式／态度

words.meaning: vt.  憎恶,痛恨
words.example: He abhors cruelty to animals.  他痛恨虐待动物。

words.meaning: n.  口才,雄辩术,雄辩
words.example: Her eloquence moved the crowd.  她的口才打动了观众。

words.meaning: a.  不规则的,反常的
words.example: The anomaly puzzled the researchers.  异常现象难倒了研究者。

words.meaning: n.  鸟,飞禽,家禽vi.  打鸟
words.example: The flock of fowl flew south.  鸟群飞向南方。

words.meaning: vt.  缓和,减轻,镇定
words.example: The government has tried to assuage the public's fears.  政府努力消除公众的恐慌。

words.meaning: a.  要人领情的
words.example: It's that patronizing tone of hers that I can't bear.  我受不了的正是她那屈尊俯就的语气。

words.meaning: a.  有恶意的,坏心肠的
words.example: The central character is a malevolent witch out for revenge.  主角是一个想复仇的恶毒女巫。

words.meaning: n.  经度,经线
words.example: Lines of longitude meet at the poles.  经线在两极相交。

words.meaning: n.  字典,辞典,词汇表n.  图文集,词汇,术语
words.example: a glossary of technical terms  术语汇编

words.meaning: a.  免费的,无理由的
words.example: The violence in the film was gratuitous.  电影里的暴力毫无必要。

words.meaning: vi.  逝去,过去n.  逝去,过去
words.example: Four years had elapsed since he left college and still he hadn't found a job.  他大学毕业都四年了，但还没有找到工作。

words.meaning: n.  分泌,分泌物,分泌液
words.example: The excessive secretion of gastric juices in the gut causes ulcers.  胃中胃液分泌过多会导致胃溃疡。

words.meaning: a.  轻蔑的,侮辱的,瞧不起人的
words.example: He was very contemptuous of 'popular' writers, whom he described as having no talent.  他很看不起“当红”作家，认为他们缺少天赋。

words.meaning: vt.  使茫然,发昏,使眼花缭乱n.  迷乱,眼花缭乱
words.example: She was wandering around in a daze this morning.  今天早上她神情恍惚地四处游荡。

words.meaning: a.  尊贵的,高位的,高尚的,兴奋的
words.example: She rose to the exalted post of Foreign Secretary.  她升到了外交部长这个崇高的位置。UK adjective

words.meaning: vi.  争论,杀价vt.  乱砍,乱劈n.  杀价,讨论,争论
words.example: It's traditional that you haggle over/about the price of things in the market.  传统上买卖东西时都会讨价还价。

words.meaning: vt.  使残废,使不能工作,使伤残
words.example: Many children have been maimed for life by these bombs.  许多孩子被这些炸弹炸至重伤，终身残废。

words.meaning: n.  同义词
words.example: The words 'small' and 'little' are synonyms.  small 和 little 是同义词。    Compare antonym

words.meaning: vt.  在. . . 周围画线,限制
words.example:
Their movements have been severely circumscribed since the laws came into effect.  自从这些法律生效以来，他们的活动受到了严格约束。
There followed a series of tightly circumscribed visits to military installations.  随之而来的是对参观军事设施的一系列严格限制。

words.meaning: a.  单调的,无变化的
words.example: The music became monotonous after a while.  过了一会儿音乐变得单调起来。

words.meaning: a.  不整洁的
words.example: They live in a rather scruffy part of town.  他们住在镇上脏乱的地段。

words.meaning: vt.  明确地叙述,表明vi.  发音
words.example:
He doesn't enunciate (his words) very clearly.  他（说话）发音不是太清晰。 formal
In the speech, the leader enunciated his party's proposals for tax reform.  在演讲中，这位领导人阐明了该政党的税收改革计划。

words.meaning: a.  着火的,闪亮的,激昂的ad.  着火,闪耀
words.example:
The house was ablaze, and the flames and smoke could be seen for miles around.  房子燃起了熊熊大火，方圆几英里都能看到烈焰和浓烟。
The ballroom was ablaze with lights.  舞厅里灯火辉煌。
The field was ablaze with poppies and wild flowers.  田野里开满了罂粟和野花，五彩缤纷。

words.meaning: vt.  毁灭,刮去,把. . . 夷为平地,破坏,抹去,消除
words.example: The town was razed to the ground in the bombing raid - not a building was left standing.  整个城镇在空袭中被夷为平地——没有一座建筑物幸存。

words.meaning: a.  不情愿的,勉强的
words.example: I'm loath to spend it all at once.  我不想把它一次花光。

words.meaning: n.  表层土
words.example: Topsoil was washed away by rain.  表土被雨水冲走了。

words.meaning: a.  可争论的,成问题的,未决定的
words.example: The value of some of the experiments is debatable.  有些实验的价值还有待确定。

words.meaning: vt.  推动,激励,驱使,逼迫
words.example: Curiosity impelled him forward.  好奇心驱使他前进。

words.meaning: ad.  公正地,理由充分地,正当地
words.example: The reward was justly earned.  这奖励挣得光明正大。

words.meaning: n.  调味品
words.example: Salt is a common condiment.  盐是常见调味品。

words.meaning: vt.  宣告. . . 无罪,赦免,免除
words.example:
The report absolved her from/of all blame for the accident.  那份报告免除了她对那次事故的全部责任。
The priest absolved him (of all his sins).  神父赦免了他（所有的罪过）。

words.meaning: vt.  使恼怒,激怒,恶化a.  恼怒的,激怒的,恶化的
words.example: The delays exasperate the passengers.  延误惹恼了乘客。

words.meaning: n.  端正,礼貌合宜,礼仪
words.example: As young ladies we were expected to act/behave with proper decorum.  人们认为我们年轻女子的行为举止应该沉稳端庄。

words.meaning: a.  昏昏欲睡的
words.example: The room is so warm it's making me feel drowsy.  房间非常暖和，让我有些昏昏欲睡。

words.meaning: vi.  争吵,口角n.  争吵,口角
words.example: Polly and Susie were having a squabble about who was going to hold the dog's lead.  波莉和苏茜在为谁来牵狗而争吵。

words.meaning: a.  英勇的,壮丽的,华丽的
words.example:
Despite fierce competition she made a gallant effort to win the first medal of the championships.  面对激烈的竞争，她顽强拼搏，终于夺得了锦标赛的首面奖牌。UK adjective
That wasn't very gallant of you, Paul, pushing a young lady out of the way like that!  保罗，那样子推开一位年轻女士可真没风度。

words.meaning: vt.  遍布,弥漫,充满
words.example: His voice was low and suffused with passion.  他的嗓音低沉，饱含热情。

words.meaning: n.  日冕，光环
words.example: The corona was visible during the eclipse.  日食时能看到日冕。

words.meaning: n.  阻止,延迟vt.  妨碍,延迟,迟缓vi.  减速,延迟
words.example: I'm not playing with him, he's a total retard.  我才不跟他玩呢，他整个一大笨蛋。

words.meaning: a.  体贴的,体谅的,顾虑周到的
words.example: It wasn't very considerate of you to drink all the milk.  牛奶全给你喝光了，真不关心别人。    Opposite inconsiderate

words.meaning: a.  不屈曲的,不屈挠的,顽固的
words.example:
The prime minister has adopted an inflexible position on immigration.  首相在移民问题上采取了强硬的立场。
This type of computer is too slow and inflexible to meet many business needs.  这种电脑速度慢、应变功能弱，无法满足多种商业需要。

words.meaning: a.  想问的,想知道的,好追根究底的
words.example: She could see inquisitive faces looking out from the windows next door.  她可以看到一张张好奇的面孔从隔壁房子的窗户向外探望。

words.meaning: a.  阳光照射的
words.example: a sunlit room/courtyard/patio  阳光充足的房间／庭院／露台

words.meaning: a.  芳香的,温和的,止痛的
words.example: a balmy summer evening  宜人的夏夜

words.meaning: vt.  减轻，减少
words.example: The government is trying to allay public fears/concern about the spread of the disease.  政府正努力消除公众对疾病蔓延的恐惧／担心。

words.meaning: a.  惊骇的,吓呆的
words.example: He looked at her aghast.  他惊恐地看着她。

words.meaning: n.  嗜食同类
words.example: Cannibalism occurs in some species.  某些物种存在同类相食。

words.meaning: a.  社交的,群居的
words.example: Emma's a gregarious, outgoing sort of person.  艾玛是个喜欢交际、性情爽直的人。

words.meaning: n.  地牢
words.example: The prisoner was thrown into a dungeon.  囚犯被扔进了地牢。

words.meaning: n.  刚毅,坚毅,不屈不挠
words.example: She faced illness with fortitude.  她以坚毅面对疾病。

words.meaning: a.  粘着的,有粘性的n.  粘剂
words.example: You'll need a/some strong adhesive to mend that chair.  你需要用一种／一些强力黏合剂来修好这把椅子。adjective

words.meaning: vt.  欺骗
words.example:
He was found guilty of defrauding the Internal Revenue Service.  他被判欺诈国内税务署罪名成立。
They are both charged with conspiracy to defraud an insurance company of $20 000.  他们俩被指控合谋诈骗保险公司二万美元。

words.meaning: vt.  假缝,润以油脂,涂以奶油,狠揍
words.example:
Baste the turkey at regular intervals.  每隔一会儿就给火鸡涂一次油脂。verb transitive
Baste the seams.  把线缝缝上。

words.meaning: n.  烧全兽的祭
words.example: The book documents the holocaust.  这本书记录了那场大屠杀。

words.meaning: n.  青霉素
words.example: Penicillin revolutionized medicine.  青霉素彻底改变了医学。

words.meaning: vt.  提升,提高,赞扬,使得意vi.  使人兴奋
words.example: The poem exalts the heroes.  这首诗颂扬英雄。

words.meaning: vi. 存活，生存
words.example: The prisoners were subsisting on a diet of bread and water.  犯人靠面包和水勉强度日。

words.meaning: n.  赝品,伪造品a.  假冒的,假装的vt. vi.  仿造,伪装,假装
words.example: counterfeit jewellery/passports/coins  假珠宝／护照／钱币

words.meaning: n.  指责,谴责,非难vt.  斥责,指责,非难
words.example: The teacher rebuked the lazy student.  老师训斥了偷懒的学生。

words.meaning: a.  起初的,发端的,初期的
words.example: signs of incipient public frustration  公众中开始出现的种种失望的迹象

words.meaning: vt.  蔑视,贬损
words.example: The actor's work for charity has recently been disparaged in the press as an attempt to get publicity.  该演员为慈善事业所做的工作近来被报纸说成是想出名。

words.meaning: n.  蓝宝石
words.example: a sapphire ring/bracelet  蓝宝石戒指／手镯

words.meaning: a.  大无畏的,勇敢的

The team remain undaunted, despite three defeats in a row.  尽管已遭三连败，球队仍然斗志昂扬。

words.meaning: a.  和蔼的,亲切的,友善的
words.example: The headteacher is very genial/has a genial manner.  这位校长非常友好／态度和蔼。

words.meaning: a.  白痴的,愚蠢的,呆头呆脑的
